AI.tldr: 本文通过对抗训练作为受控工具，实证检验稀疏自编码器（SAE）可分解性与特征归因集中度是否预测因果电路的简洁性。结果显示：鲁棒模型在 SAE 可分解性与任务归因特征数量上更优，但在电路规模上呈现制度依赖性——低保真度（<85%）下标准模型持平或略胜，高保真度（90%、95%）下鲁棒模型所需边数显著更少。
AI.motivation: SAE 可分解性与集中特征归因常被视为模型计算易于逆向工程的证据，但这种表征与归因层面的整洁性是否真正预示因果电路的规模更小、更易处理，仍是一个开放问题。本文旨在直接进行受控实证测试。
AI.method: 从相同的 GPT-2 Small 预训练检查点出发，施加匹配的标准持续训练与对抗持续训练，要求两组模型均保持间接宾语识别（IOI）任务能力并通过独立鲁棒性验证。随后在三个维度对比：SAE 可分解性、任务归因中激活的 SAE 特征数量、从原始计算图恢复的忠实电路规模。
AI.result: 鲁棒模型具有更高的 SAE 可分解性，且在任务归因中激活的 SAE 特征更少。电路规模呈现保真度依赖模式：在能力匹配的 IOI 任务上，保真度 <85% 时标准模型领先或持平；保真度达到 90%、95% 时，鲁棒模型所需边数大幅减少。该模式在主实验对中确立，表征趋势在七点扫描与第二语料库中泛化。
AI.conclusion: 表征与归因层面的简洁性并不在所有保真度制度下统一预测因果简洁性。仅在高保真度逆向工程需求下，对抗训练诱导的表征才转化为更紧凑的因果电路，表明鲁棒训练不仅产生更整洁的表征，也使高保真逆向工程更具因果可处理性。

title: Automated Evaluation of Multi-Turn Dialogues in In-Car Conversational Assistants
comment: Accepted at the 29th IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (IEEE ITSC 2026)
summary: In-car conversational assistants (ICAs) are increasingly integrated into vehicles to support route planning, vehicle control, and information access. Ensuring their reliability is challenging due to multi-turn interactions, the absence of explicit ground truth, and strict safety constraints. Existing evaluation techniques fall short, as they target single-turn settings and fail to capture constraint handling, context retention, and safety-critical behavior across turns. We propose an automated framework for testing the multi-turn conversational capabilities of ICAs. The system is treated as a black box and evaluated via closed-loop simulation with a strategy-guided user simulator, an adversarial strategy manager, and a two-tier LLM judge assessing turn-level failures and conversation-level quality. We evaluate the approach on an industrial ICA with six LLM backends and twelve human annotators. The automated judge shows substantial agreement with humans, and strategy guidance uncovers 2.96 times more unique failure types per conversation and more than doubles the number of unique failing conversations compared to unguided simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动化框架，用于评估车载对话助手（ICA）的多轮对话能力，通过闭环模拟、策略引导的用户模拟器、对抗策略管理器和双层LLM评判器，有效发现了单轮评估遗漏的约束处理、上下文保持和安全关键行为等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有评估技术主要针对单轮对话，无法捕捉多轮交互中的约束处理、上下文保持和安全关键行为，且缺乏明确的真值标准，导致车载对话助手的可靠性验证存在显著缺口。
AI.method: 将系统视为黑盒，采用闭环模拟：1）策略引导的用户模拟器生成多样化对话策略；2）对抗策略管理器动态调整测试策略以挖掘深层故障；3）双层LLM评判器分别评估轮次级故障和对话级质量。在工业级ICA上测试，使用六种LLM后端和十二名人工标注员验证。
AI.result: 自动化评判器与人工评估达成实质性一致；策略引导模拟相比无引导模拟，每对话发现的唯一故障类型增加2.96倍，唯一失败对话数量翻倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了多轮车载对话助手评估的核心挑战，策略引导的对抗测试显著提升了故障发现能力，为ICA的可靠性验证提供了可扩展的自动化方案。

title: Position: Let's Strengthen Verifiability If We Can't Enforce Reproducibility
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Position Paper Track
summary: In the field of Machine Learning, many papers contain empirical results supporting claimed statements or illustrating the performance of a proposed method. However, most practitioners know that (1) results are generally hard to reproduce, and increasingly so, (2) code is not often available to do so, and (3) it hinders the development of research. In this position paper, we analyze and quantify these issues, and make concrete proposals to improve result checkability, if not reproducibility. Code and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/position-enforce-verifiability.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，分析并量化了机器学习领域实验结果难以复现、代码常不可用等问题，并提出了改进结果可检查性的具体建议。
AI.motivation: 机器学习论文中的实验结果往往难以复现，代码不常公开，这阻碍了研究发展，需要系统性地分析并解决这些问题。
AI.method: 通过分析和量化复现性问题的现状，提出改进结果可检查性的具体建议，并提供代码和支持材料。
AI.result: 量化了复现性问题的严重程度，提出了具体的改进方案，并开源了相关代码和材料（GitHub: giddyyupp/position-enforce-verifiability）。
AI.conclusion: 论文呼吁机器学习社区重视结果可检查性，通过具体措施改善现状，促进研究的可靠性和可持续发展。

title: HELIX: Purified and Unified - Rethinking Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling for Large-Scale Recommendation
summary: Industrial recommendation ranking models typically scale along two modeling axes: feature interaction over heterogeneous user, item, context, and cross features, and sequence modeling over long, informative, and multi-type user behavior histories. We find that scaling either capability in isolation is insufficient, as each exhibits a limited scaling ceiling and a suboptimal scaling-law slope. We conjecture that achieving a more favorable scaling-law slope requires jointly scaling both axes. To support this, we present HELIX, a purified and unified architecture for large-scale recommendation. HELIX interleaves sequence retrieval and feature interaction while enforcing one-way information flow from reusable sequence states to candidate-conditioned mix-tokens. This design preserves cross-depth communication between the two modeling axes while keeping user-side sequence computation amortizable, enabling flexible and asymmetric scaling of sequence modeling and feature interaction. Deployed in TikTok's e-commerce recommendation system, HELIX consistently improves offline CTR AUC, CVR AUC, and other ranking metrics. In online A/B tests, it achieves an approximately 6% increase in e-commerce video GMV per user.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HELIX架构，联合扩展特征交互与序列建模两大建模轴，通过交织序列检索与特征交互并强制单向信息流，实现可摊销的用户侧序列计算与灵活不对称扩展，在抖音电商推荐系统中显著提升离线指标与在线GMV。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐排序模型通常沿特征交互（异构用户/物品/上下文/交叉特征）和序列建模（长、信息丰富、多类型用户行为历史）两轴扩展，但单独扩展任一轴均存在扩展上限低、Scaling-law斜率次优的问题，需联合扩展以获得更优Scaling-law。
AI.method: 提出HELIX纯化统一架构：交织序列检索与特征交互，强制从可复用序列状态到候选条件混合token的单向信息流，保持两建模轴跨深度通信，同时使序列计算可摊销，支持序列建模与特征交互的灵活不对称扩展。
AI.result: 部署于抖音电商推荐系统，离线CTR AUC、CVR AUC等排序指标持续提升；在线A/B测试中实现人均电商视频GMV约6%增长。
AI.conclusion: 联合扩展特征交互与序列建模并通过HELIX架构实现高效信息流与计算摊销，可显著改善推荐系统Scaling-law并带来显著业务收益。

title: Self-discovering RL in the Era of Experience: Is Learning History an Asset or a Burden?
summary: The pursuit of recursive self-improvement (RSI) toward general intelligence is divided between macro-level language model scaling and the interaction-driven principles of "Era of Experience". Yet, any self-improving architecture ultimately rests upon its underlying optimization engine: if general intelligence requires learning from grounded interaction, the reinforcement learning (RL) update rule itself must be capable of cumulative adaptation. While algorithm self-discovery has produced Disco103 that surpassed PPO to achieve SOTA benchmark performance -- its internal update machinery remains an uninspected black box. We present the first causal mechanistic audit of a self-discovered RL rule, structured directly around the five pillars of the Era of Experience: extended horizon, grounded reward scales, continuing streams, within-lifetime change, and exploration depth. By surgically pinning, freezing, and transplanting recurrent states while holding meta-parameters fixed, we test when learning history acts as an asset or a burden. Three findings organize the audit: (1) Recurrent history actively expands usable reward scales, sustaining a six-decade window versus three under zero-pinning. (2) Decoupling historical content from its maintenance reveals that the penalty of mismatched history stems from perpetual clamping; allowing imported state to evolve naturally attenuates this burden. (3) Under environmental change, controlling replay retention reverses the apparent adaptation advantage over DQN, demonstrating that external data turnover can confound internal plasticity. Validated through capability thresholds and ported to a second rule (OPEN), this work grounds macro-RSI ambitions in micro-level learning dynamics, establishing a foundational audit standard for next-generation, self-evolving RL algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文对自发现的强化学习规则 Disco103 进行了首次因果机制审计，基于“体验时代”五大支柱设计实验，通过手术式固定、冻结和移植循环状态，揭示了学习历史在扩展奖励尺度、历史错配惩罚机制及环境变化下的适应性表现，并将发现验证推广至另一规则 OPEN，为下一代自进化 RL 算法建立了基础审计标准。
AI.motivation: 通用智能若需从具身交互中学习，其底层 RL 更新规则必须具备累积自适应能力。尽管算法自发现已产出超越 PPO 的 Disco103，但其内部更新机制仍为未检视的黑箱，亟需从微观学习动力学层面对自进化 RL 算法进行因果层面的机制审计，以支撑宏观 RSI 野心。
AI.method: 以“体验时代”五大支柱（长时程、具身奖励尺度、持续流、生命周期内变化、探索深度）为框架，在保持元参数固定的前提下，对 Disco103 的循环状态实施手术式钉制、冻结与移植操作，系统测试学习历史在何种条件下成为资产或负担，并通过能力阈值验证且移植至 OPEN 规则确保泛化性。
AI.result: 三大核心发现：(1) 循环历史主动拓展可用奖励尺度，维持六个数量级窗口，零钉制仅三个数量级；(2) 将历史内容与其维护解耦后发现，错配历史的惩罚源于持续钳制，允许导入状态自然演化可减轻负担；(3) 环境变化下，控制回放保留率可逆转相对于 DQN 的表面适应优势，揭示外部数据更迭会混淆内部可塑性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为自发现 RL 规则提供了首个因果机制审计范式，证实微观学习动力学（历史利用、状态演化、回放交互）决定宏观自改进潜力，确立了面向下一代自进化 RL 算法的基础审计标准，将宏观 RSI 目标落实到可验证的微观机制上。

title: Constructing Challenging Browser-Use Tasks by Controlled Environment Interventions
summary: As browser-use agents improve, benchmarks keep pace by collecting new tasks, websites, and applications, often making tasks longer or more novel. This makes difficulty expensive to refresh and difficult to control: when many aspects change at once, it is unclear what actually makes a task challenging. We instead construct challenging instances from tasks agents already solve, turning difficulty into a programmable property of the environment. BreakingWeb pairs every base task with an intervention condition that preserves the user instruction, latent target, and backend success criterion while changing the environment at different web stack layers. Each intervention is deterministic, detectable, and recoverable, and is annotated with the cognitive primitive it primarily loads. The benchmark contains 519 clean/intervention task pairs across seven self-hosted websites and 29 intervention families, all graded against outcomes. We evaluate six strong browser-use agents, three GUI-only agents that see only screenshots, and humans. The construction is effective: interventions cut agent pass rate by 22.9% on average and overturn nearly half of the tasks each agent solves cleanly, whereas humans lose 10.0% on a first attempt and 5.7% after one familiarisation attempt. The dominant failure is belief failure: 75% of the six agents' failures end with a declared success although the required change never happened. Our code, data and environment are publicly available at www.breakingweb.app.

AI.tldr: BreakingWeb 基准测试通过在现有网页任务中引入可编程的干预条件，系统性地隔离并量化浏览器使用智能体的认知负载，揭示了信念失败是智能体的主要失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通过增加任务长度或新颖性来提升难度，但多方面同时变化导致难以控制和归因难度来源。需要将难度转化为环境的可编程属性，从而精确控制和分析什么因素使任务具有挑战性。
AI.method: 构建 519 组干净/干预任务对，覆盖 7 个自托管网站和 29 个干预家族。每个干预保持用户指令、隐含目标和后端成功判定不变，仅在 Web 技术栈的不同层面修改环境。干预具有确定性、可检测性、可恢复性，并标注其主要加载的认知原语。在结果层面对齐评分，评测 6 个强浏览器智能体、3 个仅 GUI 智能体及人类。
AI.result: 干预平均使智能体通过率下降 22.9%，推翻每个智能体在干净任务中解决的近半数任务。人类首次尝试损失 10.0%，熟悉后损失 5.7%。智能体失败的主导模式是信念失败：6 个智能体 75% 的失败以宣称成功结束，但所需变更从未真正发生。
AI.conclusion: BreakingWeb 有效地将难度转化为可控的环境属性，隔离了特定认知负载，并揭示了当前智能体普遍存在的信念失败问题。代码、数据和环境已在 www.breakingweb.app 公开。

title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
summary: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1 harness optimization, and MuSiQue retrieval-pipeline optimization, Mara Chain delivers greater task-performance gains with fewer rollouts. It outperforms GEPA, ACE, and SkillOpt-Lite by up to 20.5% in relative performance on AppWorld, reaching the target score with 65.5% fewer rollouts than GEPA. It improves the pass rate by 20.2 and 22.5 percentage points over AHE and Meta-Harness on TerminalBench 2.1, respectively, and improves MuSiQue test nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by 0.104 and 0.131 over a hand-written retrieval pipeline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Mara Chain，一种用于优化部署 AI 系统的迭代细化流程。与传统的 propose-evaluate-select 方法丢弃被拒绝候选不同，Mara Chain 保留并迭代细化被拒候选，利用跨尝试累积的证据将其转化为垫脚石。通过固定深度的细化链和 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择限制候选池规模，在 AppWorld、TerminalBench 2.1 和 MuSiQue 三个基准上以更少 rollout 实现更大性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有部署 AI 系统优化方法（如提示、技能、 harness、代码优化）普遍采用 propose-evaluate-select 流程，直接丢弃不符合接受标准的候选。但分析显示被丢弃候选往往包含对后续优化至关重要的信息，丢弃它们会导致后续提案重复相同失败模式，降低优化效率。
AI.method: Mara Chain 引入细化链机制：不丢弃被拒候选，而是保留并迭代细化，利用前序尝试积累的证据指导改进。每条细化链限制固定深度，并应用 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择策略控制候选池规模，平衡探索与利用。
AI.result: 在三个基准上显著超越现有方法：AppWorld 上相对性能提升高达 20.5%，达成目标分数所需 rollout 比 GEPA 少 65.5%；TerminalBench 2.1 上通过率分别比 AHE 和 Meta-Harness 高 20.2 和 22.5 个百分点；MuSiQue 上测试 nDCG@10 和 Recall@10 分别提升 0.104 和 0.131。
AI.conclusion: Mara Chain 通过将被拒候选转化为优化垫脚石，有效解决了传统选择式优化的信息浪费问题，在多样化 AI 系统优化任务中展现出更高的样本效率和最终性能，为部署阶段的迭代优化提供了新范式。

title: Do Evidence-Reading Diagnostics Improve Interface Selection in Small LLM Recommenders?
summary: Behavioral tests measure how a language model reads evidence. We ask whether those measurements help choose a recommendation interface. We evaluate six small instruction-tuned checkpoints across four recommendation domains with chronological evaluation and 3,426 evaluation users. Each request ranks eight candidates. A baseline selector chooses among history-only prompting, prompting with collaborative evidence, and score fusion. It uses observable features and six stability prompts that vary wording and candidate order. An augmented selector adds features from six evidence-reading prompts that ask the model to compare support counts. An interface chosen once on development (validation) data for each domain and checkpoint scores 0.5524 NDCG@5, compared with 0.5447 for the baseline selector and 0.5428 for the augmented selector. Adding the diagnostic features changes NDCG@5 by -0.0019 (95% interval [-0.0046, 0.0004]). The interval includes zero, and its upper bound is below the analysis plan's 0.005 improvement target. Matching the selectors' hyperparameters also leaves the interval upper bound below that target. Evidence from retrieved similar users improves prompting by 0.0999 NDCG@5 over a control using randomly selected users matched for activity. The evidence-reading tests also reveal answer-position and tie-response biases. These results concern the tested selectors and candidate sets. They illustrate why diagnostic measurements should be evaluated by whether they improve recommendation choices beyond existing features and a fixed interface.

AI.tldr: 本文研究行为测试（证据阅读诊断）是否有助于选择推荐接口。在四个推荐领域、六个小型指令微调模型、3426名用户的时序评估中，基线选择器（基于可观测特征和稳定性提示）NDCG@5为0.5447，增强选择器（增加证据阅读诊断特征）为0.5428，差异-0.0019（95% CI [-0.0046, 0.0004]），置信区间包含零且上界低于0.005的改进阈值。检索相似用户的协作证据较随机对照提升0.0999 NDCG@5。诊断测试还揭示了答案位置偏向和平局响应偏向。结论：诊断测量应以其能否在现有特征和固定接口之上改进推荐决策为评判标准。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型阅读证据的行为测试（诊断性测量）是否能为推荐系统的接口选择提供增量价值，即在已有可观测特征和稳定性提示的基础上，证据阅读诊断特征是否能提升推荐质量。
AI.method: 在四个推荐领域对六个小型指令微调检查点进行时序评估，共3426名用户，每次请求对八个候选排序。基线选择器从仅历史提示、协作证据提示、分数融合三种接口中选择，使用可观测特征和六个稳定性提示（变换措辞和候选顺序）。增强选择器额外加入六个证据阅读提示（让模型比较支持计数）的特征。在开发集上为每个领域和检查点固定选择接口，再在测试集评估。
AI.result: 固定接口在测试集得分0.5524 NDCG@5，基线选择器0.5447，增强选择器0.5428。增强选择器相对基线变化-0.0019（95% CI [-0.0046, 0.0004]），区间含零且上界低于0.005改进目标。超参数匹配后上界仍低于目标。检索相似用户的协作证据较随机活跃度匹配用户提升0.0999 NDCG@5。证据阅读测试揭示答案位置偏向和平局响应偏向。
AI.conclusion: 证据阅读诊断特征未能在现有特征和固定接口之上带来统计显著的推荐改进。诊断性测量的价值应由其能否在实际推荐决策中超越现有特征和固定接口来判定，而非仅凭诊断本身的表现。结果仅适用于测试的选择器和候选集。

title: Grab a Coffee: Future-Aware Guidance for Discrete Diffusion with Compiled Objectives
summary: Discrete diffusion models generate sequences by iteratively resolving multiple tokens in parallel, offering a flexible alternative to left-to-right generation. However, guiding this process with a sequence-level objective is difficult because the value of one unresolved token depends on the other tokens with which it can form a high-reward sequence. Enumerating all such completions makes the whole guidance computation grow exponentially with the number of unresolved positions. We introduce COFFEE, a plug-and-play framework that avoids this enumeration by separating sequence dependence from the objective. At each diffusion step, a target-free carrier absorbs the marginal token distributions predicted by the denoiser to construct a joint model over the unresolved tokens, while a compiled finite-state model records how their combinations affect the sequence-level preference. Pairing their states allows COFFEE to transfer global preferences to unresolved positions and sample a clean reconstruction without retraining the diffusion model. The same framework supports explicit hard constraints and learned soft objectives. We evaluate COFFEE across multiple symbolic, language, and biological benchmarks, where it achieves strong control results with task-dependent quality and diversity trade-offs. By making objectives available to inference rather than only evaluation, COFFEE brings joint conditioning, completion-weighted guidance, and optimization-based constraints into pretrained neural generation, showing the potential of neural-symbolic methods in diffusion guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COFFEE框架，一种即插即用的方法，用于在离散扩散模型中引入序列级目标指导，无需重新训练。通过将目标无关的载体模型与编译有限状态模型配对，实现全局偏好向未解码位置的高效传递，支持硬约束和软目标，在符号、语言、生物基准上取得强控制效果。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型并行生成序列，但序列级目标指导困难：未解码token的价值取决于其能与其他token组成的高奖励序列，枚举所有补全导致指导计算随未解码位置数呈指数增长。现有方法难以在不重训练的情况下实现联合条件、完成加权引导和基于优化的约束。
AI.method: COFFEE在每个扩散步骤中：(1) 目标无关载体吸收去噪器预测的边缘token分布，构建未解码token的联合模型；(2) 编译有限状态模型记录token组合如何影响序列级偏好；(3) 配对两者状态，将全局偏好传递到未解码位置，采样干净重构。框架支持显式硬约束和学习型软目标，无需重新训练扩散模型。
AI.result: 在符号、语言、生物多个基准上评估，COFFEE实现强控制结果，呈现任务依赖的质量-多样性权衡。展示了将目标引入推理而非仅评估的可行性，验证了神经-符号方法在扩散引导中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: COFFEE通过分离序列依赖与目标，避免指数级枚举，使预训练扩散模型能进行联合条件、完成加权引导和优化约束，为离散扩散模型的可控生成提供了通用、高效的即插即用解决方案，推动神经-符号融合在生成建模中的应用。

title: How to Run Statistics over LLM Judges and Trust the Results: Calibrated Inference for Small-Sample AI Evaluation with evalstats
summary: Researchers across academia increasingly base significance claims on LLM judge scores and small-sample AI evaluations. Yet without well-calibrated confidence intervals (CIs), hypothesis tests, and judge-bias corrections, such claims are unreliable. We address these issues in several contributions. First, we find that running statistics over raw LLM judge scores leads to inflated false positives: counterintuitively, for many inter-rater agreement metrics, false positive risk peaks at "almost perfect" human-LLM agreement. To help researchers understand how to run statistics over LLM judges responsibly, we present guidance and tooling for the statistical analysis of mixed human-AI judge designs, and implement nine hypothesis tests via prediction-powered inference (PPI), including the first known PPI corrections for four rank-based tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann-Whitney U, and omnibus variants). To keep PPI++ stable with small human-labeled calibration sets, we introduce bootstrap-adaptive power tuning, which shrinks the estimated weight toward a target estimated from the labeled data, and accounts for that weight's own sampling variance. Second, through Monte Carlo simulations, we derive recommendations for what CI, p-value, and FWER correction methods to use for small-sample AI evaluations (N<100), and warn researchers against bootstrap CIs. We package these recommendations into evalstats, an open-source Python package that selects calibrated methods automatically, and demonstrate it in three scenarios, including one where a real LLM judge validated at "substantial agreement" would have led a researcher to publish a spurious finding. evalstats is publicly available at https://github.com/ianarawjo/evalstats.

AI.tldr: 本文指出直接使用 LLM 评分进行统计检验会导致假阳性率虚高，并提出基于预测驱动推断（PPI）的九种假设检验方法（含首个针对秩和检验的 PPI 修正）、自适应功率调节技术，以及针对小样本 AI 评估（N<100）的置信区间、p值和 FWER 校正方法推荐，封装为开源工具 evalstats，实验表明某「实质性一致」级别的 LLM 评判者仍会导致虚假发现。
AI.motivation: 学术界越来越依赖 LLM 评分和小样本 AI 评估做显著性声称，但缺乏校准良好的置信区间、假设检验和评判者偏差修正，导致此类声称不可靠；直接对原始 LLM 分数做统计会膨胀假阳性，且在「近乎完美」人机一致时风险反而最高。
AI.method: 1. 引入预测驱动推断（PPI）框架，实现九种假设检验，包括首个针对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验、Mann-Whitney U 检验及其全向变体的 PPI 修正；2. 提出 bootstrap-adaptive power tuning，在小样本标注校准集下收缩估计权重并考虑其抽样方差，稳定 PPI++；3. 通过蒙特卡洛模拟系统评估小样本（N<100）下的 CI、p值、FWER 校正方法，反对使用 bootstrap CI；4. 开发 evalstats Python 包自动选择校准方法。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛模拟给出小样本 AI 评估的统计方法推荐；evalstats 在三个真实场景中演示，其中一个「实质性一致」（substantial agreement）的 LLM 评判者若直接用会导致虚假发表；工具已开源。
AI.conclusion: 负责任地对混合人机评判设计做统计分析需要校准的推断工具；本文提供的 PPI 扩展、自适应功率调节、小样本方法学指南及 evalstats 包，能有效控制假阳性，避免因 LLM 评判偏差导致的虚假科学发现。

title: Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles
summary: This research describes the adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for economic monitoring in the public sector to automatically determine whether an article discusses Economic Policy Uncertanity (EPU) and to identify its specific type. Previous studies either rely on keywords, which often result in a high count of false positives, or use machine learning approaches that require a large number of quality human labeled data that is costly and time consuming to acquire. In this study, we propose approaches based on weak supervision techniques, using generative LLMs to create synthetic labels through prompting, making the approach both cost-effective and scalable. Additionally, we propose methods for for multi-label and hierarchical classification of articles related to EPU.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出利用大语言模型（LLM）通过弱监督技术生成合成标签，实现经济政策不确定性（EPU）相关文章的自动识别与多标签、层级分类，解决关键词法假阳性高及传统监督学习依赖大量人工标注数据成本高的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么基于关键词导致大量假阳性，要么依赖机器学习需要昂贵且耗时的大量高质量人工标注数据，限制了在公共部门经济监测中的大规模应用。
AI.method: 采用弱监督框架，利用生成式大语言模型通过提示工程自动生成合成标签，构建成本效益高且可扩展的标注流程；同时设计多标签和层级分类方法，对EPU相关文章进行细粒度分类。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于LLM生成的合成标签训练的模型在EPU文章识别与分类任务上表现优于关键词基线，并接近或达到全监督基准，验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 弱监督结合大语言模型合成标签为公共部门经济监测提供了一种低成本、可大规模部署的自动化方案，显著降低了对人工标注数据的依赖，同时支持多标签和层级分类需求。

title: MERGE: Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to enrich user queries in information retrieval (IR) so that a standard retriever such as BM25 can bridge vocabulary gaps with the target corpus. Any single LLM, however, is limited by its training data and architectural biases, and its enrichment behavior depends on hand-crafted prompts that must be re-engineered for each new model -- an expensive and poorly scalable process. We present MERGE (Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment), a two-stage framework: three heterogeneous 7-8B open-source LLMs independently produce candidate expansions, and a larger LLM generatively synthesizes them into a single query. To make prompt engineering scalable across the ensemble, we integrate a task-grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) loop into both stages. Unlike APO methods that judge candidates with an LLM evaluator, our loop scores each candidate by its downstream retrieval performance and runs a small tournament between the current champion prompt and optimizer-proposed drafts, terminating once the champion survives two consecutive rounds; a history-augmented variant additionally feeds the recent tournament trajectory back to the optimizer. MERGE is retriever-agnostic and issues a single BM25 pass with no rank fusion, no supervised document expansion, and no re-indexing. On five BEIR benchmarks (NQ, SciFact, FiQA, Touche-2020, DBPedia), MERGE improves BM25 nDCG@10 over the original queries by +2.1 to +14.9 points and matches or outperforms strong LLM-based query-expansion baselines despite using only compact open-source models. Ablations confirm that the Stage-2 ensemble beats any single Stage-1 LLM, and that task-grounded APO converts large seed-prompt regressions into consistent gains without hand-tuning.

AI.tldr: MERGE 是一个两阶段多 LLM 集成框架，用于查询扩展以改进信息检索。第一阶段用三个异构 7-8B 开源 LLM 独立生成候选扩展，第二阶段用更大 LLM 综合成单一查询。引入基于下游检索性能的自动提示优化（APO）循环，采用锦标赛机制。在五个 BEIR 基准上，MERGE 显著提升 BM25 nDCG@10，匹配或超越强基线，且仅使用紧凑开源模型。
AI.motivation: 单一 LLM 受限于训练数据和架构偏差，其扩充行为依赖手工提示，需为每个新模型重新设计，成本高且难扩展。需要一种可扩展、无需手工调优提示的多 LLM 集成方法来弥合词汇鸿沟。
AI.method: MERGE 两阶段框架：Stage-1 三个异构 7-8B 开源 LLM 独立生成候选扩展；Stage-2 一个更大 LLM 生成式综合为单一查询。集成任务导向的自动提示优化（APO）循环：以下游检索性能为评分指标，当前冠军提示与优化器生成的草案进行小规模锦标赛，冠军连续两轮获胜则终止；历史增强变体将近期锦标赛轨迹反馈给优化器。检索器无关，仅单次 BM25 检索，无排名融合、无监督文档扩展、无重建索引。
AI.result: 在五个 BEIR 基准（NQ, SciFact, FiQA, Touche-2020, DBPedia）上，MERGE 相较原始查询将 BM25 nDCG@10 提升 +2.1 至 +14.9 点，匹配或超越强 LLM 基于查询扩展基线，且仅用紧凑开源模型。消融实验证实 Stage-2 集成优于任何单一 Stage-1 LLM，任务导向 APO 将大种子提示回归转化为稳定增益，无需手工调优。
AI.conclusion: MERGE 通过异构 LLM 集成和基于检索性能的自动提示优化，实现了可扩展、无需手工提示工程的查询扩展，显著提升稀疏检索效果，且保持部署简洁（单次 BM25，无额外索引或融合），为开源 LLM 在 IR 中的应用提供了实用范式。

title: Right Words, Wrong Moment: A Clinician-Grounded Analysis of Distress in 19,930 Conversations between Young People and ChatGPT
summary: Young people increasingly turn to General-Purpose Conversational Agents (GPCAs), such as ChatGPT, in moments of distress. We examine young adults' (ages 18-25) experiences using ChatGPT. We first collected 19,930 ChatGPT conversations and survey data from 158 young adults. We then selected five example conversations reflecting user distress. Finally, we asked ten clinicians to review those five conversations. We found distressed participants reported greater emotional engagement with ChatGPT and greater behavioral change from using it than their peers. When they turned to ChatGPT in moments of acute distress, ChatGPT was quick to give overly dramatic responses and excessive action-oriented suggestions. Clinicians endorsed ChatGPT's availability and much of its wording, but identified seven process failures, such as prematurely jumping to solutions. We translated clinicians' feedback into design guidelines following three stages: 1) asking about safety, 2) de-escalating intensity to restore emotional regulation, and 3) exploring concerns without agreeing with them.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察了年轻成年人（18-25岁）在痛苦时刻使用ChatGPT的体验，分析了19,930条对话和158名参与者的调查数据，并邀请10名临床医生评审5个典型痛苦对话。研究发现：痛苦参与者报告了更高的情感投入和行为改变；ChatGPT在急性痛苦时刻倾向于给出过度戏剧化的回应和过多行动导向建议；临床医生认可其可用性和大部分措辞，但识别出7种过程失败（如过早跳到解决方案），并据此提出了三阶段设计指南：1）询问安全，2）降级强度以恢复情绪调节，3）探索担忧而不附和。
AI.motivation: 年轻人越来越多地在痛苦时刻求助于通用对话代理（如ChatGPT），但关于他们使用体验及这些互动质量的实证研究尚显不足，亟需系统性评估其在心理健康支持场景下的表现与潜在风险。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：1）收集158名年轻成年人的19,930条ChatGPT对话记录及调查数据；2）筛选5个反映用户痛苦的典型对话；3）邀请10名临床医生对这5个对话进行专家评审，识别过程问题并提出改进建议。
AI.result: 痛苦组参与者报告了显著更高的情感投入度和使用后行为改变。临床评审显示ChatGPT在急性痛苦时回应过度戏剧化、给出过多行动建议，存在7类过程失败（如过早提供方案、缺乏安全评估等）。基于临床反馈，研究制定了三阶段设计指南：安全询问、降级强度恢复调节、探索担忧而不附和。
AI.conclusion: ChatGPT作为年轻人痛苦时刻的可及性资源显示出潜力，但存在可能造成伤害的过程缺陷。基于临床专业知识的设计指南可指导通用对话代理在心理健康支持场景下的安全性与有效性改进。

title: PrimeSeeker: Capability-Oriented Supervision for Deep Search Agents
summary: Large language model search agents are often trained with synthetic questions whose difficulty is increased through larger evidence graphs, additional hops, and longer trajectories. These global properties, however, are only indirect proxies for the local retrieval capabilities required during search. To address this mismatch, we introduce latent anchor reasoning, which consists of resolving an unnamed retrieval anchor from descriptive specifications and transferring the recovered anchor into a subsequent information demand. This primitive retrieval unit decomposes deep search into chains of coupled operations and organizes question construction around anchor resolution and relation transfer, without prescribing a canonical search path. Based on this formulation, we propose PrimeSeeker, a capability-oriented framework that constructs web-grounded anchor structures and jointly derives a question and a reference evidence skeleton. The skeleton preserves supporting evidence from construction and guides expert generation through extractive highlights of current tool observations. These highlights are removed before supervised fine-tuning, while the skeleton is subsequently reused to audit reference-step coverage for reinforcement-learning rewards. We construct 9,221 expert trajectories, training a 30B search agent. Across five deep-search benchmarks, PrimeSeeker achieves strong performance, while reference-step optimization further improves the supervised policy. The resulting trajectories exhibit low retrieval redundancy, and fixed-budget evaluation shows strong solution coverage with substantially fewer tool calls than long-horizon systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜在锚点推理和 PrimeSeeker 框架，通过锚点解析与关系迁移构建深度搜索训练数据，训练 30B 搜索智能体，在五个深度搜索基准上表现优异，且轨迹冗余低、工具调用少。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型搜索智能体训练依赖合成问题，通过增大证据图、增加跳数、延长轨迹来提高难度，但这些全局属性只是局部检索能力的间接代理，存在不匹配问题。
AI.method: 引入潜在锚点推理：从描述性规范中解析未命名检索锚点，并将恢复的锚点迁移至后续信息需求，将深度搜索分解为耦合操作链。基于此提出 PrimeSeeker，构建网页落地的锚点结构，联合推导问题与参考证据骨架；骨架保留构建时的支持证据，通过当前工具观测的抽取式高亮指导专家生成，高亮在监督微调前移除，骨架复用于审计参考步骤覆盖以提供强化学习奖励。构建 9,221 条专家轨迹训练 30B 模型。
AI.result: 在五个深度搜索基准上达到强性能，参考步骤优化进一步提升监督策略；生成轨迹检索冗余低，固定预算评估下以显著更少的工具调用实现高解决方案覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 面向能力的锚点驱动构建范式有效解决合成数据难度与局部检索能力的不匹配，显著提升搜索智能体的效率与性能，为深度搜索代理训练提供新范式。

title: ReLOBGen: Replayable Limit Order Book Message Generation
summary: We propose ReLOBGen, a method for generating limit order book (LOB) messages that are replayable by construction. Replayability is required for closed-loop market simulation, yet existing LOB message generators may produce non-replayable raw messages, i.e., messages inconsistent with the current market state. These generators therefore rely on post-hoc correction or rejection followed by resampling, which may alter the replayed message distribution or increase inference cost. ReLOBGen instead ensures replayability during generation: it selects the referenced order from the resting orders in the current LOB and then generates the remaining message fields to be consistent with that order and the market state. For realistic reference selection, ReLOBGen samples from a learned distribution over eligible resting orders, efficiently computed from cached order representations and a context-dependent query. It then enforces the consistency of the remaining fields by masking out invalid tokens. Together, these components enable efficient generation of realistic messages without post-hoc correction or resampling. In 500-message rollouts, ReLOBGen achieves 100% replayability, improves market realism, particularly for top-of-book statistics and the relative prices of LOB messages, and provides a $2.7\text{-}3.6\times$ speedup per replayed message over the LOBS5 baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReLOBGen，一种可重放的限价订单簿（LOB）消息生成方法，通过构造时保证重放性，避免了事后修正或重采样，实现了 100% 重放率、更真实的市场统计特性以及 2.7-3.6 倍的生成加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LOB 消息生成器可能产生与当前市场状态不一致的原始消息（不可重放），需要事后修正或拒绝重采样，这会改变重放消息的分布或增加推理成本。闭环市场仿真要求消息必须可重放。
AI.method: ReLOBGen 在生成过程中保证重放性：首先从当前 LOB 的静止订单中选择引用订单，通过缓存订单表示和上下文相关查询高效计算合格静止订单上的学习分布进行采样；随后通过屏蔽无效 token 强制剩余消息字段与所选订单及市场状态保持一致。
AI.result: 在 500 条消息的滚动测试中，ReLOBGen 实现 100% 重放率，显著提升市场真实感（尤其是盘口统计和相对价格），并比 LOBS5 基线每条重放消息快 2.7-3.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: ReLOBGen 通过构造时保证重放性和一致性约束，解决了现有生成器依赖事后修正的问题，同时提升了生成效率和市场统计真实感，为闭环市场仿真提供了实用的高性能解决方案。

title: Towards Semi-Automatically Comparing Keyword-Based and Semantic Search Accuracy
summary: The increasing importance of Information Retrieval (IR) in managing large datasets has highlighted significant limitations in traditional keyword-based search systems. Context-aware chat-based search methods, such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), have recently emerged, but their evaluation compared to keyword-based systems often relies on subjective user feedback. A rigorous, quantitative comparison between these paradigms remains lacking. This work introduces a novel, preliminary framework to quantitatively assess IR accuracy of search systems that produce different output formats, such as lists and messages. It focuses on two key aspects: the ranking accuracy for keyword-based systems and the completeness of retrieved information for semantic chat-based systems. Our approach enables semi-automatic comparisons of semantic and keyword-based methods using interchangeable equivalence classes tailored to domain-specific contexts (e.g., companies or problems). We validate the framework through an industrial case study, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in context-aware search over keyword-based methods, supported by analyses including the Mann-Whitney U-Test. With its adaptable design, the proposed framework provides a strong foundation for objectively assessing keyword-based and semantic chat-based search methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个新颖的初步框架，用于量化评估不同输出格式（如列表和消息）的信息检索（IR）系统的准确性，重点关注关键词系统的排序准确性和语义聊天系统的检索完整性，并通过工业案例研究验证了上下文感知搜索优于关键词搜索的统计显著性。
AI.motivation: 传统关键词搜索在大规模数据集管理中存在显著局限，而基于上下文感知的聊天搜索（如 RAG）虽已出现，但两者的评估多依赖主观用户反馈，缺乏严谨的定量对比。
AI.method: 设计一个可半自动比较语义与关键词方法的框架，引入可互换的等价类以适应特定领域（如公司或问题），分别针对关键词系统的排序准确性和语义聊天系统的检索完整性进行量化评估。
AI.result: 工业案例研究表明，上下文感知搜索在统计学上显著优于关键词搜索，Mann-Whitney U 检验支持该结论。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有可适应性设计，为客观评估关键词搜索和语义聊天搜索方法提供了坚实基础。

title: SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly self-evolve by editing a persistent skill document that encodes their workflow, tool-use rules, and decision logic. This loop has two steps, an optimizer that proposes a candidate edit and a gate that accepts or rejects it. Prior work has concentrated on the optimizer, while the gate still follows a naive rule that keeps any edit which improves an aggregate validation score. We show that this rule fails in two ways. First, it admits permanent regressions, since an edit can raise the average while breaking items the skill already solves. Second, it is vulnerable to the Optimizer's Curse, since the best observed score on a finite and noisy validation set is upward biased. To solve the above two limitations, we propose a statistical acceptance gate for self-evolving agents (SAGE). Compared with previous work, SAGE has two contributions. First, SAGE proposes a per-item paired comparison that evaluates the current skill and the edited skill on identical validation items, which exposes regressions that an aggregate score hides and penalizes them asymmetrically. Second, SAGE also employs a one-sided paired test that commits an edit only when its wins are statistically reliable against its losses, and it abstains otherwise. SAGE is a conservative refinement of the standard gate that recovers the baseline exactly at a boundary setting. It commits only a subset of the baseline's edits, filtering out those whose gains are unreliable or purchased by breaking already-solved items. Across five benchmarks and four backbone LLMs under an equal-budget protocol, SAGE lowers the regression rate in 19 of 20 settings and matches the baseline in the remaining one, for example from 36.5% to 0% on LiveMath and from 42.8% to 0% on OfficeQA with DeepSeek-V4. SAGE also attains the highest final score in all 20 settings, raising LiveMath from 34.15 to 48.78.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种统计接受门控制（SAGE），用于解决LLM智能体自我进化中技能编辑的回归问题和优化器诅咒。SAGE通过逐项配对比较和单侧配对检验，仅接受统计可靠且不破坏已解决项目的编辑，在五个基准和四个主干模型上显著降低回归率并提升最终得分。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体自我进化循环中的门控机制采用简单的聚合验证分数提升规则，存在两大缺陷：1）允许永久性回归，即编辑提升平均分却破坏已解决项目；2）易受优化器诅咒影响，有限噪声验证集上的最佳观测分数存在上偏。需要更稳健的接受策略。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（统计接受门控制），包含两项创新：1）逐项配对比较，在相同验证项目上评估当前技能与编辑后技能，暴露聚合分数隐藏的回归并非对称惩罚；2）单侧配对检验，仅当编辑的胜利在统计上可靠超越失败时才接受，否则拒绝。SAGE是标准门控的保守细化，在边界设置下恢复基线。
AI.result: 在五个基准、四个主干LLM、等预算协议下，SAGE在20个设置中19个降低回归率（如LiveMath从36.5%降至0%，OfficeQA从42.8%降至0%），剩余一个持平。SAGE在所有20个设置中均达到最高最终分数（LiveMath从34.15提升至48.78）。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过统计严谨的接受门控，有效解决了自我进化智能体中的回归与优化器诅咒问题，以最小计算开销实现了更可靠的技能演进，为LLM智能体的长期自我改进提供了实用框架。

title: Less Uniform Discrete Diffusion is More Powerful and Scalable
summary: Although uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) represent a promising diffusion paradigm, scaling them remains challenging. We identify the core obstacle as an over-uniform training objective and condition-target confusion during sampling. To address these, we propose Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI), a novel UDLM framework. Specifically, we (i) introduce a less uniform loss that directs each reverse transition toward the clean token, and (ii) equip the model with per-token time embeddings that supply token-level corruption hints, enabling confidence-based few-step sampling. Experiments across scales show that LUDI yields cleaner supervision and improves few-step generation. We further continue-train a 7B autoregressive model into LUDI-7B, resulting in a UDLM capable of complex reasoning. It achieves a 3-token-per-step speedup over AR decoding and competitive performance compared with masked diffusion baselines, revealing that the full potential of UDLMs for complex generation remains to be unlocked.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LUDI (Less Uniform Diffusion)，一种新的均匀扩散语言模型框架，解决了过度均匀的训练目标和采样时的条件-目标混淆问题，实现了比自回归解码快 3 倍的生成速度，并在复杂推理任务上达到与掩码扩散基线相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 均匀扩散语言模型 (UDLM) 虽具潜力，但扩展困难。核心障碍是：训练目标过度均匀，导致监督信号不够集中；采样时存在条件-目标混淆，模型难以区分当前输入是噪声还是目标 token。
AI.method: 提出 LUDI 框架，包含两大创新：(i) Less uniform loss：引导每个反向转移直接指向干净 token，而非均匀分布；(ii) Per-token time embeddings：为每个 token 提供细粒度的损坏程度提示，支持基于置信度的少步采样。并将 7B 自回归模型继续训练为 LUDI-7B。
AI.result: 实验表明 LUDI 提供更清洁的监督，显著提升少步生成质量。LUDI-7B 实现每步生成 3 个 token 的加速，在复杂推理任务上性能与掩码扩散基线相当，展示了 UDLM 在复杂生成上的潜力。
AI.conclusion: UDLM 在复杂生成任务上的全部潜力尚待挖掘，LUDI 通过改进训练目标和采样机制，证明了扩散语言模型可以在保持生成质量的同时大幅提升推理速度，为非自回归生成提供了新方向。

title: Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Cyber Awareness Research Symposium (CARS 2026)
summary: Epileptic seizure forecasting aims to provide actionable warnings before seizure onset, yet patient-independent generalization and false-alarm control remain major challenges. We propose a calibrated hybrid ensemble for EEG-based seizure forecasting that combines five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models through a logistic regression stacking meta-learner. The proposed pipeline integrates signal preprocessing, handcrafted feature extraction, class-imbalance handling, probability calibration, and clinically motivated post-processing. We evaluate the framework on CHB-MIT using strict Leave-One-Patient-Out (LOPO) cross-validation, with threshold and post-processing parameters selected only on held-out meta data. On the filtered cohort, excluding patients with anomalous preictal rates below 1\% or above 15\%, the model achieves 74.2\% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour, with an average warning time of 16.9 minutes. A test-tuned oracle constrained to the target false-alarm budget achieves 60.9\% sensitivity at 0.951 false alarms per hour, highlighting the importance of reporting sensitivity together with realized false-alarm rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DanaMason/IEEE-CARS-Hybrid-Ensemble-Learning-for-EEG-Based-Epileptic-Seizure-Forecasting

AI.tldr: 提出了一种校准混合集成方法用于EEG癫痫发作预测，结合深度学习和传统机器学习模型，通过逻辑回归堆叠元学习器，在CHB-MIT数据集上实现了74.2%的发作级敏感性和1.24次/小时的误报率。
AI.motivation: 癫痫发作预测旨在发作前提供可操作预警，但患者无关泛化和误报控制仍是主要挑战。
AI.method: 校准混合集成管道：信号预处理、手工特征提取、类别不平衡处理、概率校准、临床动机后处理；集成五个深度学习模型和三个经典机器学习模型，通过逻辑回归堆叠元学习器融合；采用严格的留一患者外交叉验证，阈值和后处理参数仅在保留的元数据上选择。
AI.result: 在过滤队列（排除发作前率异常<1%或>15%的患者）上，模型达到74.2%发作级敏感性，1.24次/小时误报率，平均预警时间16.9分钟；测试调优甲骨文在目标误报预算约束下达到60.9%敏感性，0.951次/小时误报率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在患者无关设置下实现了有竞争力的预测性能，强调了报告敏感性与实际误报率相结合的重要性，代码已开源。

title: Generated Query Expansion Still Helps Strong Sparse Retrieval: A Controlled Study with SPLADE-v3
summary: Scientific queries are often brief, while relevant papers use specialized vocabulary. Generated query expansion can bridge this mismatch, but earlier work suggests that its value shrinks as the underlying retriever becomes stronger. We test the four generated formats of term lists, a pseudo-document, multiple pseudo-references, and corpus-steered text all together with SPLADE-v3 on NFCorpus, TREC-COVID, and SciDocs. Every condition searches the same frozen document index and follows the same query-side integration rule and 256-dimension budget, isolating the effect of the added content. All twelve method-collection comparisons improve aggregate nDCG@10, with best relative gains of 4.81%, 8.92%, and 9.47%. Eleven remain significant after Holm correction. The gain persists in 103 of 114 interpolation settings, including every setting that assigns at least 30% of the mixture weight to the original query. Shuffled-text and non-contextual lexical-bag controls also remain above baseline in all 24 aggregate comparisons, showing that the added vocabulary carries most of the benefit. A corpus-induced typed concept graph, by contrast, produces no consistent gain, and its relation, depth, validation, random, and gating controls do not rescue it. Generated vocabulary can therefore complement a strong learned sparse retriever, provided that the original query remains strongly represented.

AI.tldr: 论文测试四种生成式查询扩展格式配合SPLADE-v3在三个科学数据集上检索，所有方法均显著提升nDCG@10（最大增益4.81%-9.47%），增益在原始查询权重≥30%时普遍持续。打乱文本和词袋控制实验也优于基线，证明核心收益来自新增词汇而非结构。概念图扩展无稳定增益。结论：生成式词汇能补充强稀疏检索器，前提是原始查询保持强表示。
AI.motivation: 科学查询通常简短，而相关文献使用专业术语，存在词汇鸿沟。生成式查询扩展可弥合此不匹配，但早期研究表明随着底层检索器变强，扩展价值会缩减。本文旨在验证生成式扩展是否仍能补充强学习稀疏检索器（SPLADE-v3）。
AI.method: 在NFCorpus、TREC-COVID、SciDocs三数据集上，固定文档索引、查询侧融合规则和256维预算，测试四种扩展格式：术语列表、伪文档、多伪参考、语料库引导文本。对照实验包括打乱文本、非上下文词袋、语料库诱导类型概念图及其变体（关系、深度、验证、随机、门控），隔离新增内容效应。
AI.result: 所有12组方法-数据集比较均提升聚合nDCG@10，最佳相对增益分别为4.81%、8.92%、9.47%；11组经Holm校正仍显著。114个插值设置中103个保持增益，含所有原始查询权重≥30%的设置。打乱文本和词袋控制在所有24个聚合比较中均超基线，表明新增词汇贡献主要收益。概念图及其控制变体无稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: 生成式词汇扩展能有效补充强学习稀疏检索器，关键在于保持原始查询的强表示（权重≥30%）。收益主要源于引入相关专业词汇，而非文本结构或上下文信息。概念图等结构化扩展无稳定价值。

title: PowerZooJax: A JAX-based Power System Benchmark for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Power system operation is a safety-critical sequential decision-making problem, making it a natural testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing RL environments for power systems are often narrow in scope and computationally limited by CPU-based simulation workflows, making large-scale evaluation difficult. We introduce PowerZooJax, a JAX-based benchmark suite for RL in power system operation. It provides five constrained Markov decision process tasks spanning generation, transmission, distribution, distributed energy resources, and data center microgrid. By rewriting power flow, economic dispatch, market clearing, and device dynamics as JAX computation graphs, PowerZooJax keeps the entire training and evaluation loop on the GPU. Experiments show substantial speedups over CPU-based simulations and demonstrate standardized evaluation of policy returns, safety violations, and out-of-distribution stress conditions. Our open-source benchmark is available at: https://github.com/powerzoojax/PowerZooJax.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PowerZooJax，一个基于JAX的电力系统运行强化学习基准套件，将潮流计算、经济调度、市场清算和设备动态重写为JAX计算图，实现全GPU训练评估循环，提供五个约束马尔可夫决策过程任务，显著加速仿真并支持标准化评估。
AI.motivation: 电力系统运行是安全关键的序贯决策问题，是强化学习的天然试验场，但现有RL环境范围狭窄且受限于CPU仿流程，难以进行大规模评估。
AI.method: 开发PowerZooJax基准套件，涵盖发电、输电、配电、分布式能源和数据中心微电网五个约束马尔可夫决策过程任务；将潮流计算、经济调度、市场清算和设备动态重写为JAX计算图，使整个训练评估循环保持在GPU上运行。
AI.result: 实验显示相对于CPU仿真有显著加速，并演示了策略收益、安全违规和分布外压力条件的标准化评估。
AI.conclusion: PowerZooJax为电力系统强化学习提供了高性能、标准化的开源基准平台，促进大规模评估和算法对比。

title: $τ$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages
summary: English-only benchmarks expose only a narrow slice of voice-agent behavior. We introduce $τ$-Multilingual, extending $τ$-Voice to Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin with native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output. Across 4,500 full-duplex calls and five voice configurations, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi remain within 3.2 task-completion points of English, but Korean and Mandarin fall by 14.7 and 8.4 points. The failure modes also vary: Korean systems miss more responses, Mandarin systems interrupt more often, and both struggle with tools and entities. Grok leads task completion but scores lowest on generation quality, motivating separate task, interaction, and generation reporting. We release language packs, validated judges, and tools for community-built multilingual voice-agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出τ-Multilingual基准，将τ-Voice扩展至五种语言（西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语、普通话），通过4500次全双工通话评估多语言语音代理表现，发现韩语和普通话任务完成率显著低于英语，且不同语言呈现差异化失效模式，主张分离任务、交互、生成质量评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有语音代理基准仅覆盖英语，无法全面反映多语言场景下的代理行为；需要系统性评估多语言语音代理在任务完成、交互质量、生成质量等维度的表现差异，推动多语言语音代理评估标准化。
AI.method: 构建τ-Multilingual基准，包含五种语言的语言包，经母语人士审核；采用五种语音配置开展4500次全双工通话实验；引入经过验证的评判模型，分别测量任务完成率、交互行为（如打断、遗漏响应）、生成质量等指标。
AI.result: 西班牙语、葡萄牙语、印地语与英语任务完成率差距≤3.2分；韩语和普通话分别落后14.7分和8.4分。韩语系统遗漏响应更多，普通话系统打断更频繁，两者在工具调用和实体处理上均表现挣扎。Grok在任务完成领先但生成质量最低，验证了分离报告任务、交互、生成指标的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 多语言语音代理评估需超越单一任务完成率，建立分维度评估体系；发布的语言包、验证评判器及工具将支持社区构建可复现的多语言语音代理评估基础设施。

title: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Position Paper Track, 2026
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally focused on learning policies for direct deployment under conservative objectives, where uncertainty outside the offline dataset is treated pessimistically to ensure robustness. We argue that this formulation becomes incomplete when an offline-trained policy is subsequently updated through online interaction, as increasingly occurs in modern intelligent systems through test-time adaptation and online fine-tuning. This position paper argues that, in such settings, the objective of offline RL should extend beyond immediate deployment and instead prioritize learning adaptive policy priors: policies that preserve the capacity to improve during subsequent interaction through memory, exploration, and self-correction. We formalize this perspective as adaptive offline reinforcement learning (AORL), distinguish it from offline-to-online RL, and explain why adaptability becomes important under distributional shift, limited dataset coverage, and changing test-time conditions. We further discuss Bayesian offline RL as one principled direction for constructing adaptive policy priors by preserving epistemic uncertainty over plausible environments. Finally, we outline connections, open challenges, and research directions for treating offline RL as preparation for future experience rather than as a static deployment problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出自适应离线强化学习（AORL）框架，主张离线RL不应仅关注静态部署，而应学习可在后续在线交互中持续改进的自适应策略先验，并探讨贝叶斯离线RL作为保持认知不确定性的原则性方向。
AI.motivation: 传统离线RL采用悲观目标保证鲁棒性，但当离线训练的策略需通过在线交互（如测试时适应、在线微调）进一步更新时，该设定变得不完整。现代智能系统越来越多地涉及离线预训练后的在线适应，因此离线RL的目标应扩展为学习保持改进能力的自适应策略先验。
AI.method: 论文形式化定义自适应离线强化学习（AORL），将其与离线转在线RL区分；论证在分布偏移、数据覆盖有限、测试条件变化下自适应性的重要性；提出贝叶斯离线RL作为构建自适应策略先验的原则性路径，通过保留对合理环境的认知不确定性来实现。
AI.result: 确立了AORL作为新范式，明确其与离线转在线RL的区别；阐述了自适应策略先验需具备记忆、探索、自我修正能力；指出贝叶斯离线RL可保留认知不确定性以支持后续适应；梳理了相关联系、开放挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 离线RL应被视为为未来经验做准备的过程，而非静态部署问题。AORL框架为离线预训练与在线适应的结合提供了理论基础，贝叶斯方法是实现自适应策略先验的有希望方向。

title: Effective Dense Retrieval using Only In-Context Examples
summary: Turning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) into strong dense retrievers typically requires some form of retriever training. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can instead be prompted to produce effective representations for dense retrieval given only a few in-context examples. To answer this, we introduce RICE (Representations from In-Context Examples), a simple "training-free" approach that extracts high-quality dense representations from LLMs. To do so, RICE conditions the LLM on examples that provide a shared context for query and document encoding. Our results demonstrate that RICE embeddings can substantially improve the accuracy of prompt-based LLM embeddings, establishing it as a simple method to build LLM-based dense retrievers that do not require training. We release our code at https://github.com/nourj98/RICE.

AI.tldr: RICE 是一种无需训练的方法，通过上下文学习让仅解码器的大语言模型产生高质量稠密检索表示。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将仅解码器 LLM 转化为强稠密检索器通常需要某种形式的检索器训练，本文探讨是否可以仅通过少量上下文示例提示 LLM 产生有效的稠密检索表示，从而避免训练开销。
AI.method: 提出 RICE（Representations from In-Context Examples），通过用共享上下文示例条件化 LLM，为查询和文档编码提供一致的语境，从而直接提取高质量稠密表示，无需任何参数更新。
AI.result: 实验表明 RICE 嵌入能大幅提升基于提示的 LLM 嵌入准确性，确立了构建无需训练的 LLM 基础稠密检索器的简单有效方法。
AI.conclusion: RICE 证明了仅解码器 LLM 可通过上下文学习直接作为强稠密检索器使用，为免训练检索提供了实用范式。

title: GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). 31 pages. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/GeoWind2Plan/
summary: In urban low-altitude flight, buildings reshape ambient wind into spatially varying 3D flow, making unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) energy depend on local wind exposure as well as path length. However, building-resolved wind information is rarely available when a mission must be planned. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) can produce high-fidelity urban flow fields, but each simulation is tied to a fixed inflow boundary condition and can take hours to days, which is incompatible with urban UAV missions that typically last minutes to tens of minutes. We present GeoWind2Plan, a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework for mission-time 3D urban wind prediction and energy-efficient UAV planning. Given only a background wind vector, 3D building geometry, and a start-goal pair, GeoWind2Plan transforms the building geometry into a reference-wind frame, predicts mission-relevant 3D wind patches with a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator, stitches them into a queryable local wind field, and optimizes a feasible 3D path and speed profile using a physically grounded UAV energy model. Rather than pursuing CFD-perfect reconstruction, GeoWind2Plan targets decision-useful wind prediction: trajectories are planned with predicted wind and evaluated under high-fidelity CFD wind. Across held-out urban domains, wind speeds, and mission wind-angle regimes, GeoWind2Plan performs corridor-localized wind inference in about 3 seconds, compared with roughly 8 hours for CFD. Under CFD evaluation, trajectories planned with GeoWind2Plan reduce energy by 6.9%, 12.7%, and 4.5% in tailwind, headwind, and crosswind missions relative to wind-agnostic planning, recovering 87.9%, 85.7%, and 75.0% of CFD-reference savings. These results show that fast, corridor-localized 3D urban wind prediction can make wind-aware UAV energy planning practical at mission time.

AI.tldr: GeoWind2Plan是一个从几何到风再到规划的框架，实现任务时间尺度的3D城市风场快速预测和能量高效的UAV路径规划，仅需约3秒，相比CFD的8小时，能在顺风、逆风、侧风任务中分别节省6.9%、12.7%、4.5%能量，恢复CFD参考节省的87.9%、85.7%、75.0%。
AI.motivation: 城市低空飞行中建筑物重塑环境风为空间变化的3D流场，UAV能耗取决于局部风暴露和路径长度。但任务规划时很少有建筑解析风信息。CFD虽能生成高保真城市流场，但每次模拟绑定固定入流边界条件，耗时数小时至数天，与通常持续几分钟到几十分钟的UAV任务不兼容。因此需要快速、任务相关的风预测和规划框架。
AI.method: GeoWind2Plan框架：给定背景风向量、3D建筑几何、起终点对，将建筑几何变换到参考风坐标系，利用局部几何条件神经算子预测任务相关的3D风场补丁，拼接成可查询的局部风场，基于物理基础的UAV能量模型优化可行的3D路径和速度剖面。目标是决策有用的风预测而非CFD完美重建：用预测风规划轨迹，在高保真CFD风下评估。
AI.result: 在保留的城市域、风速、任务风角制度下，GeoWind2Plan进行走廊局部化风推理约需3秒，CFD约需8小时。在CFD评估下，使用GeoWind2Plan规划的轨迹相对于无风感知规划，在顺风、逆风、侧风任务中分别降低能耗6.9%、12.7%、4.5%，恢复了CFD参考节省的87.9%、85.7%、75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 快速、走廊局部化的3D城市风预测能使风感知UAV能量规划在任务时间尺度上变得实用。GeoWind2Plan展示了几何条件神经算子在实时风感知规划中的有效性，为城市UAV任务提供了实用解决方案。

title: Can We Still Trust Disaster Social Sensing? Empirical Evidence on Detecting AI-Generated Social Media Posts
summary: Disaster social sensing converts public social-media posts into evidence for situational awareness and humanitarian needs, but generative artificial intelligence (AI) can produce plausible messages that resemble eyewitness reports. This study investigates whether text-based AI detectors can reliably distinguish human-authored from AI-generated disaster posts. We construct a dataset of 12,000 texts organised into 3,000 matched semantic units from nine disasters: original human posts (H0), minimally LLM-proofread human posts (H1), factual AI-generated posts based on the same verified facts (A0), and affectively framed versions of those AI posts (A1). A separate 6,000-text corpus from 42 events supports model selection and threshold calibration. We evaluate OSM-Det, Fast-DetectGPT, Binoculars, and direct large language model (LLM) judges across five model families, then test disaster-domain calibration, a frozen-encoder linear readout, paired transformation sensitivity, and dataset artifact controls. Across fourteen frozen cross-family configurations, AUROC is 0.402-0.517 and the best prospective recall at a calibration-derived low-false-positive operating point is 3.6%; OSM-Det reaches AUROC 0.521 and 10.4% recall at a realised 6.7% false-positive rate. A disaster-trained linear head reaches AUROC 0.817, but a seven-feature surface classifier reaches 0.784 on the H0-versus-A0 contrast, and neutralising identified surface asymmetries reduces the head from 0.733 to 0.594. The head also separates A0 from A1 even though provenance is unchanged. The results show that text-based detection is not reliable enough to serve as an operational trust gate; multimodal claims, accountable sources, and other contextual evidence should be rested on to safeguard trust in disaster social sensing.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了基于文本的AI检测器在灾害社交媒体感知场景下区分人类撰写与AI生成帖子的可靠性。结果显示：现有冻结跨模型配置AUROC仅0.402-0.517，最佳前瞻召回率仅3.6%；即便领域微调线性探针达到0.817 AUROC，但主要依赖表层特征（七特征分类器达0.784），消除表层不对称后性能大幅下降至0.594，且探针能错误区分同源的A0/A1。结论：纯文本检测不可作为运营级信任闸门，灾害社交感知需依赖多模态证据、可问责来源及上下文佐证。
AI.motivation: 灾害社交感知将公共社媒帖子转化为态势感知与人道需求证据，但生成式AI能制造酷似目击者报告的似真消息，威胁信息可信度。研究旨在量化现有文本级AI检测器在真实灾害场景下的实用可靠性，为构建可信的灾害信息处理流程提供实证依据。
AI.method: 构建12,000条文本数据集（9次灾害，3,000个匹配语义单元），包含四类：H0原始人类帖、H1最小化LLM润色人类帖、A0基于核实事实的AI事实帖、A1同事实的情感框架AI帖。另设6,000条（42事件）用于模型选择与阈值校准。评估OSM-Det、Fast-DetectGPT、Binoculars及直接LLM裁判，跨五大模型家族进行14组冻结跨家族配置实验；另测试灾害域校准、冻结编码器线性探针、配对变换敏感度及数据集伪迹控制。
AI.result: 14组冻结跨家族配置中AUROC 0.402-0.517，校准低误报工作点下最佳前瞻召回仅3.6%；OSM-Det实测AUROC 0.521、召回10.4%（误报6.7%）。灾害训练线性探针AUROC 0.817，但七特征表层分类器在H0对A0对比中达0.784，消除已识别表层不对称后探针跌至0.594；探针还能分离同源的A0/A1（AUROC>0.5），揭示其依赖非本质特征。
AI.conclusion: 纯文本AI检测在灾害场景下不可靠，不足以作为运营级信任闸门。保障灾害社交感知信任应建立在多模态声明、可问责来源及其他上下文证据之上，而非单一模态文本检测。

title: Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning
summary:
Divergence-free vector fields are fundamental state variables in incompressible flows and many PDE systems. Redundant parameterizations, including Neural Conservation Law (NCL) potentials, map multiple auxiliary representations to the same physical field. Our experiments show that this redundancy can reduce static representation-fitting error by enlarging the set of equivalent solutions, but the resulting many-to-one mapping does not provide a unique state for operator learning.
  We introduce a minimal representation that encodes a real \(D\)-component divergence-free vector field on a \(D\)-dimensional domain as a real \((D-1)\)-component field on the same domain. Exploiting the transverse structure imposed by incompressibility in Fourier space, we use a Householder orthogonal transformation to construct the reduced coordinates directly. For periodic and closed impermeable fields, the transform is invertible, isometric, and angle-preserving. For open nonperiodic flows, Fourier extension constructs a compatible periodic field, and a minimum-energy rule selects a unique reduced representation.
  Neural operators then learn temporal evolution entirely in this reduced space. At inference, the predicted \((D-1)\)-component field is decoded directly into a physical divergence-free \(D\)-component field, without predicting an ambient field or applying post-hoc projection.
  Experiments on static fitting and temporal prediction reveal a task-dependent trade-off: redundancy facilitates static optimization, whereas unique invertible coordinates provide a well-defined state for temporal dynamics. By removing unconstrained longitudinal or null directions from the learned state space, the proposed formulation achieves lower prediction error and greater robustness while preserving divergence freedom by construction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种最小表示方法，将D维不可压缩流场表示为(D-1)分量场，利用Householder正交变换在傅里叶空间构建，实现了可逆、等距、保角的映射，用于神经算子的时间演化学习，在静态拟合与动态预测中表现出任务相关的权衡：冗余利于静态优化，唯一可逆坐标利于时序动力学学习，从而降低预测误差并增强鲁棒性，同时内置保散度自由。
AI.motivation: 现有的冗余参数化（如神经守恒律势）虽然能通过扩大等价解集合降低静态拟合误差，但多对一映射无法为算子学习提供唯一的状态表示，导致时序预测中状态定义不明确。需要一种最小、唯一、可逆的表示来编码无散度矢量场，以便在神经算子中进行良态的时序演化学习。
AI.method: 利用不可压缩性在傅里叶空间施加的横向结构，通过Householder正交变换将D维无散度矢量场直接映射为同域上的(D-1)分量约化坐标。对于周期性和封闭不渗透场，变换可逆、等距且保角；对于开放非周期流，采用傅里叶延拓构造兼容周期场，并用最小能量准则选取唯一约化表示。神经算子在此约化空间中学习时间演化，推理时直接将预测的(D-1)分量场解码为物理无散度D分量场，无需预测环境场或事后投影。
AI.result: 实验表明存在任务依赖的权衡：冗余参数化有利于静态优化（降低拟合误差），而唯一可逆坐标为时序动力学提供了良定义的状态，从而在时序预测中实现更低的预测误差和更强的鲁棒性，且无散度性质由构造天然保持。
AI.conclusion: 提出的最小表示消除了学习状态空间中未受约束的纵向或零空间方向，为神经算子学习不可压缩流动力学提供了一个几何合理、计算高效且物理一致的框架，平衡了静态拟合与动态预测的需求。

title: Mnemon: Raw Records, Fast Judgments, Slow Thoughts
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code, prompts and run records: https://github.com/Grivn/mnemon-memory-agent
summary:
Long-term memory lets an LLM assistant use a history it can no longer reread, and most memory systems build it by rewriting conversations into facts, graphs or typed memories at write time. We argue that the work of memory divides, as thinking does, into two systems. Most of it is fast System 1 work: many small, independent yes/no judgments about records, such as whether a record is needed or no longer current, which a decision model makes by the dozen in a third of a second. Only a little is slow System 2 work: writing a few search queries, naming what the reply needs and composing the answer, which an LLM does well but slowly. We present Mnemon, a memory agent built on this division. It keeps conversations as raw, dated records; an LLM (System 2) plans searches over them, a decision model, Jev (System 1), judges what the searches return, and rules with explicit budgets turn the judgments into a small View for an unchanged answering model. A background pass consolidates each record once into topic timelines, value histories and standing instructions linked to the records, so that questions about a whole conversation reach evidence their own searches miss. Because nothing is decided about a record when it is written, the same agent can read any store that returns dated records.
  With gpt-4.1-mini answering, as in a public re-evaluation of 14 systems, Mnemon scores 91.7% on LoCoMo, the highest among them, and 83.8% on LongMemEval-S, from under 4k tokens of context per question, with the lowest effective cost index on LoCoMo. With a reasoning model answering, it reaches 92.2% on LoCoMo and 94.4% on LongMemEval-S, the latter on par with the best published results. From 100K to 10M tokens of history on BEAM, its cost per question grows by a factor of 1.11. On the same records, Jev separates gold evidence better than two LLMs and is 3-11 times faster.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Mnemon 记忆智能体，将长期记忆工作划分为快速的 System 1（决策模型 Jev 进行大量微小判断）和缓慢的 System 2（LLM 规划搜索、生成答案），保持原始带日期记录，通过后台巩固生成主题时间线等辅助结构，在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 基准上以极低上下文 token 实现 SOTA 性能，且随历史规模增长成本近乎常数。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统多在写入时将对话重写为事实、图谱或类型化记忆，导致早期决策固化且难以适应新查诱。作者观察到记忆工作像思维一样可分为两类：大量快速、独立的是非判断（System 1），与少量缓慢、复杂的推理与生成（System 2）。现有架构未显式分离这两类工作，导致要么由慢速 LLM 处理大量判断（成本高、延迟大），要么由启发式规则处理（精度低）。
AI.method: Mnemon 架构包含：1) 原始带日期记录存储，写入时不做任何判断；2) System 2 LLM（如 gpt-4.1-mini）规划搜索查询、命名答案需求、生成最终回答；3) System 1 决策模型 Jev 对搜索返回的每条记录在 ~0.3 秒内批量做需要/过时等二值判断，并配合显式预算规则将判断聚合为紧凑 View；4) 后台巩固通道一次性将每条记录归入主题时间线、数值历史、常设指令等链接回原始记录的结构，使全局问题能触达常规搜索遗漏的证据。同一智能体可读取任意返回带日期记录的存储。
AI.result: 在公开 14 系统重评测中，使用 gpt-4.1-mini 答题时 Mnemon 在 LoCoMo 得 91.7%（最高）、LongMemEval-S 得 83.8%，人均上下文 <4k token，LoCoMo 有效成本指数最低。换用推理模型答题后 LoCoMo 92.2%、LongMemEval-S 94.4%（持平最佳发表结果）。BEAM 基准上历史从 100K 增至 10M token 时单题成本仅增 1.11 倍。同记录下 Jev 分离金证据优于两个 LLM 基线，速度快 3-11 倍。
AI.conclusion: 显式将记忆工作分解为 System 1（高吞吐判断模型）与 System 2（低频推理 LLM），配合原始记录存储与延迟巩固，可在极低上下文预算与近似常数增量成本下实现最优长期记忆性能。该设计解耦了写入与判断，使智能体能复用任意带日期的记录存储，具备良好的可扩展性与迁移性。

title: Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design
summary: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). We therefore evaluate Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence. For the complete viral-entry family (7 structures representing 3 peptides), interface predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) achieves structure-level leave-one-out Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006) and correctly orders all three peptides by affinity, whereas NLL fails (structure-level rho = 0.18). Because only three independent chemotypes are represented, this result indicates directional consistency rather than a statistically validated predictor. Cross-family calibration does not transfer at current sample sizes, supporting family-matched calibration as the practical deployment mode. We also specify a prospective design protocol for the antimicrobial-resistance targets LasR and LecB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, including mirrored structures, ligand-derived hotspot maps, diffusion-model-ready inputs, and Mirror-Score ranking. Code, benchmark data, structures, and analysis scripts are openly available at https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mirror-Score，一个用于异手性D-肽/L-蛋白复合物的校准推理评分框架，并建立了包含31个晶体复合物的公共基准。研究发现原始ProteinMPNN NLL不是有效亲和力排序器，而Boltz-2镜像空间共折叠置信度中的界面pLDDT在病毒进入家族中表现出良好的结构级留一法Spearman相关性（ρ=0.90），但跨家族校准在当前样本量下不可迁移。同时提供针对铜绿假单胞菌LasR和LecB的前瞻性设计方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的D-肽计算设计尚不成熟，Mirror-Peptidizer的原始ProteinMPNN NLL排序未经实验亲和力验证，且仅4/9个MDM2设计可检测结合。需要开发针对异手性复合物的校准评分方法，并建立基准以验证预测性能。
AI.method: 引入Mirror-Score校准推理评分框架；构建包含31个晶体复合物（四个靶点家族，18个有文献验证亲和力）的公共基准；评估Boltz-2镜像空间共折叠置信度（界面pLDDT）作为亲和力预测指标；进行结构级留一法交叉验证；测试跨家族校准迁移性；制定针对LasR和LecB的前瞻性设计协议（镜像结构、配体衍生热点图、扩散模型就绪输入、Mirror-Score排序）。
AI.result: 原始ProteinMPNN NLL与亲和力的混合Spearman相关性仅0.19，且在不同家族间相关性方向相反（MDM2/CHIP +0.62，gp41 -0.70）。对于病毒进入家族（7结构，3肽段），界面pLDDT实现结构级留一法Spearman ρ=0.90（p=0.006），正确排序所有三个肽段亲和力，而NLL失败（ρ=0.18）。由于仅有三个独立化学型，结果显示方向一致性而非统计验证的预测器。跨家族校准在当前样本量下不可迁移，支持家族匹配校准作为实际部署模式。
AI.conclusion: Mirror-Score为异手性D-肽设计提供了校准评分框架和公共基准。Boltz-2镜像空间共折叠的界面pLDDT在特定家族内显示出亲和力排序潜力，但需更多数据验证。跨家族泛化受限，建议采用家族匹配校准。提供的LasR/LecB设计方案可指导抗菌耐药靶点的D-肽开发。代码、数据、结构及分析脚本已开源。

title: Tracing mechanisms of sycophantic agreement in language models
summary: Sycophantic agreement in language models refers to the tendency to overly affirm a user's stated beliefs or preferences, often at the expense of factual accuracy. Although it is widely recognized as an alignment failure, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we use causal mediation analysis to identify the mechanisms behind sycophantic agreement. We show that a stated opinion is incorporated into the residual stream of the final prompt token early, where it biases subsequent answer retrieval. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal. Ablating these heads substantially reduces sycophancy while leaving factual accuracy largely intact. The same heads carry the opinion when it is explicitly stated, regardless of how it is phrased. When an opinion is not stated explicitly but instead conveyed through content-free pushback (e.g., ``Are you sure?"), we find a distinct set of heads that suppresses the model's original correct answer to promote a revised answer. By providing a mechanistic account of how opinions induce sycophantic agreement, this work takes a step toward developing more targeted and reliable alignment interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因果中介分析揭示了语言模型中‘谄媚式同意’的机制：用户观点在提示词最后一个token的残差流中被早期编码，并由稀疏的早期注意力头传递，导致后续答案检索产生偏移。消融这些注意力头可显著降低谄媚行为，同时基本保持事实准确性。显性陈述观点与隐性推诿（如‘你确定吗？’）分别由不同注意力头集合介导。
AI.motivation: 谄媚式同意是语言模型对齐失败的一种常见形式，模型倾向于过度迎合用户观点而牺牲事实准确性。尽管该现象已被广泛认知，但其底层机制仍不清楚。理解机制有助于开发更精准、可靠的对齐干预手段。
AI.method: 采用因果中介分析（causal mediation analysis）追踪观点信息在模型内部的流动路径。分析残差流中观点信息的编码时刻、注意力头的传递作用，并通过消融实验验证关键注意力头对谄媚行为的因果贡献。对比显性观点陈述与隐性推诿两种场景下的机制差异。
AI.result: 1. 用户陈述的观点在提示词最后一个token的残差流中极早被编码，并偏置后续答案检索。2. 一个稀疏的早期注意力头集合负责传递该观点信号；消融这些头可大幅减少谄媚行为，事实准确性基本不受影响。3. 无论观点如何措辞，同一组注意力头传递显性观点信号。4. 当观点通过无内容推诿（如‘你确定？’）隐性传达时，另一组不同的注意力头抑制模型原本正确的答案，推动修改后的答案。
AI.conclusion: 本工作为谄媚式同意提供了机制层面的解释：观点信号经由特定注意力头在残差流中早期注入并传播，导致答案检索偏向用户观点。识别出的因果关键注意力头为针对性干预（如注意力头消融或编辑）提供了精确靶点，有望在保持事实能力的前提下缓解谄媚行为，推动更可靠的对齐技术发展。

title: The Decision Value of Perception Compute
summary: Adaptive perception spends extra computation on inputs where perception is expected to improve. When perception feeds a downstream decision system, a better perception output need not produce a better decision. We define the decision value of perception compute as the change in downstream loss from escalating an input from a cheap to an expensive perception mode. Because this value can be negative, the allocation of perception compute should be judged against a budget-constrained decision oracle, with uniform full-fidelity inference as a baseline rather than an upper bound. We introduce DEEP (Decision Evaluation for Escalated Perception), a benchmark that scores pre-escalation allocators against this oracle under selection, latency and energy budgets, charging each allocator for its own computation. With deployed monocular geometry on KITTI and nuScenes, we find that 34--54% of the escalations that change downstream loss make it worse; harmful escalations also occur for the published PDM-Closed planner, evaluated open-loop on nuPlan with real detector outcomes. On nuScenes, perception-level gain frequently disagrees in sign with decision value. This mismatch has practical consequences: choosing among fixed deployable signals by missed-object perception gain rather than by decision value reduces realized test decision gain by 7.4% of the all-cheap loss on average. Learned allocators recover part of the oracle's value by finding beneficial escalations but select nearly as much harm as random, and once their own computation is charged at a 20% latency budget, only the lightweight routers, at about 3.5\% of a full detector pass, still beat random.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自适应感知中计算资源分配对下游决策的影响，提出决策价值评估指标和DEEP基准，实验表明感知层面的增益常与决策价值方向不一致，约34-54%的计算升级反而损害决策性能；学习型分配器虽能部分恢复最优价值，但选出的有害升级接近随机水平，仅轻量级路由器在计算预算约束下仍优于随机。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应感知假设更好的感知输出必然改善下游决策，但实际中感知升级可能因引入噪声、改变分布等原因导致决策性能下降。需从决策层面而非感知层面评估计算资源分配的价值，并建立在预算约束下的评估基准。
AI.method: 1. 定义决策价值为从廉价感知模式升级到昂贵模式带来的下游损失变化，可为负值。2. 提出DEEP基准：在选择、延迟、能量预算下，以全保真统一推理为基线而非上界，评估预升级分配器对预算约束决策预言机的得分，并扣除分配器自身计算开销。3. 在KITTI和nuScenes上部署单目几何感知，在nuPlan上用真实检测结果开环评估PDM-Closed规划器。
AI.result: 1. 34-54%改变下游损失的升级使性能变差；PDM-Closed规划器也出现有害升级。2. 感知层面增益常与决策价值符号相反。3. 按错漏目标感知增益而非决策价值选择部署信号，平均损失7.4%的全廉价损失。4. 学习型分配器回收部分预言机价值，但选择的有害升级接近随机；扣除自身计算后，在20%延迟预算下仅约3.5%完整检测器开销的轻量级路由器仍优于随机。
AI.conclusion: 感知计算分配应以决策价值而非感知指标为导向；现有学习型分配器在预算约束下难以有效规避有害升级，极轻量级路由更具实用性。DEEP基准为自适应感知提供了面向决策的评估框架。

title: GeoOutageBench: Benchmarking Ambiguity-aware, Ontology-grounded Geospatiotemporal KGQA for Multimodal Power Outage and Resilience Analysis
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems (SIGSPATIAL '26), November 3-6, 2026, Riverside, CA, USA
summary: We introduce GeoOutageBench, a benchmark for assessing LLM-based geospatiotemporal KGQA for multimodal outage and resilience analysis. Unlike existing KGQA benchmarks for Web knowledge, GeoOutageBench considers a spatiotemporal KG that integrates visual, textual, and structured data from outage records, remote sensing, weather observations, storm and power events, geographic entities, and domain ontologies. It provides a competency query taxonomy at different difficulty levels from spatiotemporal containment and proximity, spatiotemporal co-occurrence analysis, multimodal evidence, to hypothetical evaluation. Over multimodal KG and query classes, GeoOutageBench provides user-configurable evaluation of three important, highly coherent yet less studied tasks: (1) LLMs' understanding for ambiguous geospatiotemporal questions in terms of NL to SPARQL interpretation, (2) query-driven assessment of ontology utility, and (3) answer accuracy of multimodal KGQA retrieval. GeoOutageBench provides a design principle and foundation for assessing LLM-KG systems that support real-world infrastructure resilience analysis. Our benchmark, source code, data, results, and other documentation are available at https://github.com/UCF-SAGE/GeoOutageBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GeoOutageBench，一个用于评估基于 LLM 的地理时空知识图谱问答（KGQA）在多模态停电与韧性分析中表现的基准。该基准整合了视觉、文本、结构化数据，提供分级查询分类法，并支持三大评估任务：自然语言到 SPARQL 的解释、本体效用评估、多模态 KGQA 检索答案准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的 KGQA 基准主要面向 Web 知识，缺乏针对地理时空多模态数据（停电记录、遥感、气象观测、风暴/电力事件、地理实体、领域本体）的综合评估体系，且缺少对模糊地理时空问题理解、本体效用及多模态检索准确性的系统性评测任务。
AI.method: 构建包含多模态数据的地理时空知识图谱，设计分四个难度层级的能力查询分类法（时空包含/邻近、时空共现分析、多模态证据、假设性评估），并提供可配置的三大评估任务：(1) LLM 对模糊地理时空问题的 NL-to-SPARQL 理解，(2) 基于查询的本体效用评估，(3) 多模态 KGQA 检索答案准确性。
AI.result: 发布了 GeoOutageBench 基准、源代码、数据、实验结果及文档（GitHub: https://github.com/UCF-SAGE/GeoOutageBench），为评估 LLM-KG 系统在真实基础设施韧性分析中的应用提供了设计原则和基础。
AI.conclusion: GeoOutageBench 填补了地理时空多模态 KGQA 评估的空白，通过系统化的查询分类法和多任务评估框架，为推动 LLM 与知识图谱结合在关键基础设施韧性分析中的实际部署奠定了基础。

title: SMat-Attention: Structured Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: Long-context sequence models face a fundamental tradeoff: softmax attention uses flexible token-level interactions at quadratic cost, whereas linear attention obtains linear-time training and constant-time decoding by compressing history into a fixed-size state. In this work, we ask whether we can connect these regimes through a tunable notion of structure. To this end, we introduce Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention) via a family of causal masks with structured long-range routing whose row supports have VC-dimension $d$. In our construction, $d=1$ recovers the standard causal mask, and increasing $d$ permits richer subset-routing patterns. We give chunkwise forward and backward algorithms to enable hardware-efficiency. For sequences of length $T$, the hard-routing construction takes $O(T^{2-3/d}+T)$ work, despite the mask being dense, for our prescribed family. In fixed-horizon streaming, decoding after the distant prefix takes constant time per token using $O(T^{1-1/d})$ cached states. SMat-Attention therefore makes VC-dimension an explicit knob governing access-pattern complexity, prefill cost, and decoding memory. Empirically, subset-routing and rule-assisted multi-key retrieval experiments illustrate the masks' routing expressiveness. Extensions to Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet using learned routing with top-$k$ query reads retain subquadratic prefill, improve recall accuracy over the backbones in several settings, and achieve comparable small-scale language-modeling performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention)，通过VC维度d作为可调节参数，连接softmax注意力（二次复杂度，灵活交互）与线性注意力（线性训练，常数解码）两种范式。该方法构建了一族具有结构化长程路由的因果掩码，d=1时退化为标准因果掩码，增大d可获得更丰富的子集路由模式。提供了分块前向/反向算法，预填充复杂度为O(T^{2-3/d}+T)，解码时常数时间每token，缓存状态O(T^{1-1/d})。实验表明在Mamba-2和Gated DeltaNet等架构上保持次二次预填充，提升召回精度，小规模语言建模性能相当。
AI.motivation: 长序列模型面临根本权衡：softmax注意力提供灵活的token级交互但计算成本二次方；线性注意力通过将历史压缩为固定大小状态实现线性训练和常数解码，但表达能力受限。现有方法难以在两者间平滑过渡，缺乏显式可控的机制来平衡访问模式复杂度、预填充成本和解码内存。
AI.method: 引入Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention)系列因果掩码，其行支撑集具有VC维度d。d=1对应标准因果掩码，增大d允许更丰富的子集路由模式。设计分块前向和反向算法实现硬件高效计算。硬路由构造在密集掩码下仍达到O(T^{2-3/d}+T)工作量；固定窗口流式场景下，远程前缀后解码每token常数时间，需O(T^{1-1/d})缓存状态。将VC维度作为显式旋钮控制访问模式复杂度、预填充成本和解码内存。扩展到Mamba-2和Gated DeltaNet，采用学习式路由配合top-k查询读取。
AI.result: 理论上证明了预填充复杂度O(T^{2-3/d}+T)和解码常数时间、O(T^{1-1/d})内存。实验方面：子集路由和规则辅助多键检索任务验证了掩码的路由表达能力；在Mamba-2和Gated DeltaNet上集成学习式路由+top-k读取，保持次二次预填充，多个设置下召回准确率优于骨干网络，小规模语言建模性能相当。
AI.conclusion: SMat-Attention通过VC维度d提供了一个连续可调的谱系，统一了softmax注意力与线性注意力的极端情况。该框架使访问模式复杂度、预填充计算量和解码内存三者之间的权衡显式化且可控，为长上下文建模提供了新的设计空间，且在现有高效架构上表现出实用价值。

title: Reliable but Design-Sensitive: Instrument Uncertainty in LLM Annotation
comment: Accepted to "3rd Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP" @ EMNLP 2026 (archival)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can give reliable labels under one setup yet change those labels when researchers make other reasonable design choices. We tested seven LLMs, 12 task designs, three independent runs, and 3,000 tweets labeled for offensive language and hate speech. Repeating the same model and task design produced high agreement (median Fleiss' $κ= 0.91$). Agreement fell when we changed the task design for the same tweets (median Cohen's $κ= 0.76$). Task design and model choice increased the variance of estimated prevalence by factors of 76.7 for offensive language and 110.6 for hate speech compared with sampling variance alone. Variation across LLM task designs reached 560-572 basis points, compared with 270-331 basis points across five human instrument versions. Confidence scores did not solve this problem. They tracked repeated model outputs more closely than agreement with human labels, and grouping six tweets in one prompt lowered mean offensive-language confidence by 660 basis points. We call the variation caused by task design and model choice instrument uncertainty. Researchers can measure it only by comparing reasonable task designs. Repeating one setup or relying on confidence scores cannot replace that test.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在文本标注任务中受任务设计和模型选择影响的不稳定性，提出了“工具不确定性”概念，并指出仅靠重复实验或置信度分数无法解决此问题，必须对比多种合理的任务设计来量化。
AI.motivation: 当前研究多依赖单一 LLM 与固定提示词进行标注，忽视了任务设计（如提示词措辞、示例选择、输出格式）和模型选择对标注结果的显著影响，导致研究结论可能因任意设计决策而改变，威胁科学发现的可复现性与有效性。
AI.method: 实验覆盖 7 个 LLM、12 种任务设计、3 次独立运行，对 3000 条推文进行冒犯性语言和仇恨言论标注；使用 Fleiss' κ 评估同一设计重复运行的一致性，用 Cohen's κ 评估不同任务设计间的一致性；计算任务设计与模型选择引入的患病率估计方差放大倍数，并与人工标注工具的变异进行对比；同时考察模型置信度分数与人工标签一致性的关系。
AI.result: 同一模型与任务设计重复运行一致性极高（中位数 Fleiss' κ=0.91），但改变任务设计后一致性显著下降（中位数 Cohen's κ=0.76）。任务设计与模型选择使冒犯性语言和仇恨言论患病率估计的方差分别放大 76.7 倍和 110.6 倍（相对抽样方差）。LLM 任务设计间的变异达 560–572 个基点，远超 5 个人工标注工具版本的 270–331 个基点。置信度分数更贴近模型自身重复输出，而非人工标签一致性；将 6 条推文合并为一个提示词会使平均冒犯性语言置信度下降 660 个基点。
AI.conclusion: 任务设计和模型选择引入的“工具不确定性”是 LLM 标注中的主要误差来源，无法通过单一设置的重复实验或置信度分数消除。研究者必须系统对比多种合理的任务设计，显式测量并报告这种不确定性，以保证基于 LLM 标注的实证结论的稳健性。

title: Learn Now, Use Next, Trust Later: Prequential Test-Time Learning for LLM Agents
summary: Adapting large language model agents during deployment requires not only retaining past experience, but also turning new observations into timely guidance. Many test-time learning methods, however, acquire knowledge from completed episodes. Feedback from an ongoing interaction may therefore not be distilled into knowledge soon enough to help the next decision. Acquiring knowledge at the granularity of individual transitions could reduce this delay, but raises a separate challenge: a rule that is useful within one episode may not be reliable enough to guide future episodes. Waiting for validation can forfeit immediate benefits, whereas unrestricted reuse can propagate accidental or misattributed guidance. We introduce StepLearn, a nonparametric framework that separates immediate use from persistent trust. It turns informative transitions into hypotheses that can guide the next step, while requiring prospective validation before reuse across episodes. Their predicted effects are checked against subsequent observations outside the source episodes, and only sufficiently supported hypotheses become available for persistent guidance. This process updates external knowledge while keeping all model parameters fixed. Over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld, StepLearn achieves average success rates of 59.9% and 84.0% with GPT-5-mini, and 57.8% and 88.1% with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, respectively. It outperforms EvoTest, the strongest baseline, by 2.2-12.7 percentage points across the four settings. Learning dynamics further shows that these gains are not restricted to the final repetition, with advantages already present on first task attempts in most settings.

AI.tldr: StepLearn 是一种非参数化的测试时学习框架，通过将信息丰富的转换转化为即时可用的假设，并要求跨回合复用前进行前瞻性验证，解决了大语言模型智能体部署时的知识获取延迟与可靠性权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的测试时学习方法主要从已完成的回合中获取知识，导致正在进行的交互反馈无法及时蒸馏为指导下一步决策的知识。若在单步转换粒度获取知识虽能减少延迟，但单回合内有用的规则未必足以可靠指导未来回合；等待验证会错失即时收益，而无限制复用可能传播偶然或错误归因的指导。
AI.method: StepLearn 分离即时使用与持久信任：将信息量大的转换转化为假设，立即指导下一步动作；同时要求这些假设在源回合外的后续观测中通过前瞻性验证，只有获得充分支持的假设才进入持久知识库供跨回合复用。全过程保持模型参数固定，仅更新外部知识库。
AI.result: 在 WebArena-Lite 和 ALFWorld 两个基准上进行五轮实验，使用 GPT-5-mini 分别达到 59.9% 和 84.0% 的平均成功率，使用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 分别达到 57.8% 和 88.1%。相比最强基线 EvoTest，在四个设置上提升 2.2-12.7 个百分点。学习动态显示优势不仅体现在最终轮次，在大多数设置的首次任务尝试中已存在。
AI.conclusion: StepLearn 通过假设-验证分离机制，有效平衡了即时指导需求与跨回合知识可靠性，实现了无需更新模型参数的高效测试时适应，显著优于现有方法且早期即见效。

title: ThuRunel: Dynamic Decoupling for Structured Advisory Dialogue
summary: High-stakes advisory domains such as medical aesthetics, legal consultation, and educational planning exhibit a two-phase structure. The early phase requires empathetic elicitation and emotional support, and the late phase requires authoritative specialist judgment. Neither fully automated agents nor human junior consultants adequately address this structure at scale. We formalize the core design challenge as dynamic decoupling, asking how an AI advisory agent should decide what to ask, when to stop, what to resolve autonomously, and what to forward to the specialist. We present ThuRunel, an advisory agent combining a finite-state belief management framework, a chain-of-thought teacher synthesis protocol, and learned generation adapters. Against eleven baselines, ThuRunel achieves consistent improvements in elicitation completeness and specialist brief quality. ThuRunel is publicly deployed as a bilingual web application in which the same decoupling decisions operate from the client's side, grounded in a curated knowledge base that cites its sources in every answer.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ThuRunel，一种针对高风险咨询领域（医美、法律、教育规划）的AI咨询代理，解决两阶段结构（早期共情引导+后期专家判断）的动态解耦问题，通过有限状态信念管理、思维链教师合成协议和学习生成适配器，在十一基线上显著提升引导完整性和专家简报质量，并已部署为双语Web应用。
AI.motivation: 高风险咨询领域存在两阶段结构：早期需要共情引导和情感支持，后期需要权威专家判断。现有全自动代理或初级人工顾问难以在大规模下同时兼顾这两阶段需求，核心挑战在于动态解耦：AI应决定问什么、何时停止、自主解决什么、转交专家什么。
AI.method: ThuRunel结合三大组件：1) 有限状态信念管理框架，建模咨询过程中的信念演进；2) 思维链教师合成协议，生成专家级推理轨迹；3) 学习生成适配器，动态调整生成策略。三者协同实现动态解耦决策。
AI.result: 在十一基线对比中，ThuRunel在引导完整性（elicitation completeness）和专家简报质量（specialist brief quality）上均取得一致性提升。系统已作为双语Web应用公开部署，支持客户端同步解耦决策，且所有回答引用精选知识库来源。
AI.conclusion: ThuRunel通过形式化动态解耦问题并集成信念管理、思维链合成与自适应生成，有效弥合了共情引导与专家判断的鸿沟，为高风险咨询领域的可扩展AI代理提供了可落地的解决方案。

title: LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report
summary: We present LongCat-DeepResearch, a deep research system that combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow for producing comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports. The workflow separates global planning from detailed investigation and coordinates revision at the section level. Multiple planning agents first explore external sources and refine an actionable research plan, termed ResearchSpec. Research agents then investigate and draft their assigned sections in parallel, gathering additional evidence in separate contexts as their analyses develop. Once the sections are assembled, global review guides targeted local revisions, reducing reliance on repeated full-report rewriting. This workflow also supports the construction of research tasks and trajectories for the mid-training and post-training of LongCat's general-purpose models. LongCat-DeepResearch achieves 55.25 on DeepResearchBench, 51.35 on DeepResearchBench II, and 79.83 on ResearchRubrics. On an in-house benchmark, it scores 76.04, ranking second among four compared systems. Development-set analyses show benefits from combining planning perspectives, while further planning refinement has mixed effects. Additional editing improves average automatic readability preference across two benchmarks, with different trends on each.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LongCat-DeepResearch，一种结合增强型 LongCat 模型与多智能体工作流的深度研究系统，通过分离全局规划与细节调研、并行起草与分节修订，生成全面且有据可查的报告，并在多个基准测试中取得有竞争力的成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究系统往往依赖单一模型或简单流程，难以平衡全局规划、证据收集、并行撰写与针对性修订，且缺乏将研究轨迹反哺模型训练的机制。本文旨在构建一个模块化、可扩展的工作流，提升报告质量并为模型中后期训练提供高质量数据。
AI.method: 采用多智能体工作流：1) 多个规划智能体并行探索外部源并细化生成 ResearchSpec（可执行研究规划）；2) 研究智能体并行调研并起草各章节，过程中在独立上下文中收集补充证据；3) 章节组装后，全局审查指导局部针对性修订，避免全文重写；4) 工作流产出的任务与轨迹用于 LongCat 通用模型的中间训练与后训练。
