AI.result: 在 DeepResearchBench 得分 55.25，DeepResearchBench II 得分 51.35，ResearchRubrics 得分 79.83。自建基准得分 76.04，在四个对比系统中排名第二。消融实验显示：融合多规划视角有益，但进一步细化规划效果不一；额外编辑步骤在两个基准上均提升平均自动可读性偏好，但趋势各异。
AI.conclusion: LongCat-DeepResearch 通过结构化多智能体工作流有效分解深度研究任务，实现了高质量、有证据支撑的报告生成，并为模型持续改进提供数据飞轮。结果表明模块化规划与并行调研的组合优于单一流程，但规划过度细化可能收益递减，后续可探索自适应规划粒度与更高效的修订策略。

title: Beyond the Context Window: An Adaptive Entropy-Based Routing Framework for Hybrid Retrieval and Long-Context Language Models
summary: Modern large language models now support context windows of more than one million tokens, which has raised the question of whether retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is still necessary. Pure long-context (LC) processing is expensive and is known to under-attend to information placed in the middle of long inputs, while pure RAG is fast but bounded by retrieval quality and prone to errors when retrieved chunks are partially relevant or contradictory. We propose the Entropy-Driven Adaptive Router (EDAR), a framework that decides at inference time whether to answer a query from retrieved chunks or to escalate it to full long-context processing. The decision uses the predictive entropy of the token-level probability distribution computed over the first few generated tokens of the RAG response. The entropy threshold is selected on a held-out validation set by sweeping cost against accuracy. Experiments compare EDAR against pure-RAG and pure-LC baselines on LongBench v2 and Infinity-Bench. Predictive entropy correlates strongly with hallucination rate on a held-out set of 2,000 generations (Pearson r = 0.85, 95% CI [0.83, 0.87]). On the long-context benchmarks, EDAR retains 97.4% of the accuracy of the pure long-context baseline while reducing total token expenditure by 70.7%, escalating only 18.2% of incoming queries. The accuracy gap between EDAR and the pure long-context system is not statistically distinguishable from zero at standard sample sizes. Predictive entropy is a useful model-internal signal for routing between RAG and long-context inference, and a threshold-based hybrid system can recover most of the accuracy of long-context models at a small fraction of the cost. The framework does not depend on a specific retriever or LC backbone, and it does not require additional supervision beyond what is normally produced during decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出基于预测熵的自适应路由框架 EDAR，在推理时动态决定使用 RAG 还是全长上下文处理，在保持 97.4% 长上下文准确率的同时将 Token 开销降低 70.7%，仅需上报 18.2% 查询。
AI.motivation: 现代大模型支持百万级上下文窗口，但纯长上下文推理昂贵且存在“中间丢失”现象；纯 RAG 速度快但受限于检索质量，面对部分相关或矛盾片段易出错。需要一种无需额外监督、模型无关的混合策略，在成本与准确率间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: 构建 Entropy-Driven Adaptive Router (EDAR)：对 RAG 生成的前几个 token 计算逐 token 预测熵，将其作为模型内部不确定度信号；在验证集上扫描熵阈值以权衡成本与准确率；推理时若熵低于阈值则直接采用 RAG 答案，否则升级至全长上下文推理。无需特定检索器或长上下文骨干，亦无需额外标注。
AI.result: 在 LongBench v2 与 Infinity-Bench 上，EDAR 保留纯长上下文基线 97.4% 准确率，总 Token 消耗降低 70.7%，仅 18.2% 查询被升级。预测熵与幻觉率强相关（Pearson r=0.85, 95% CI [0.83,0.87]）。EDAR 与纯长上下文系统的准确率差距在标准样本量下无统计学显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 预测熵是有效的模型内部路由信号，基于阈值的混合系统能以极小成本恢复长上下文模型的大部分精度。EDAR 具备检索器无关、骨干无关、免监督等优势，为大规模长上下文应用提供实用的成本-质量折中方案。

title: Replication Failure and Trivial Baselines in Road-Level Crash Prediction
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/Maurya1112-sudo/greyspot
summary: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to road-level crash prediction, but the stability of their reported gains has received little scrutiny. We independently reconstruct the data pipeline of a recent uncertainty-aware model and evaluate eleven of its design decisions across three London boroughs under an expanding-window protocol. Four survive replication on a second borough; seven do not, and four of those reverse sign rather than attenuate. Multi-seed evaluation is decisive: one effect reverses sign between random seeds within a single borough, and the reference architecture exhibits per-borough seed spreads of up to 35.7 points against 4 points for ours. We further compare both networks against a parameter-free baseline that ranks segments by cumulative past crash count. At matched history depth our model is statistically indistinguishable from that baseline ($-0.90$ points, $p=0.61$), and the reference architecture loses to it on 18 of 18 held-out windows ($-17.37$, $p<10^{-6}$). Sweeping the baseline's lookback horizon shows it spans 22.71% to 83.94% accuracy on that variable alone, and that every published figure in this line of work is matched by the baseline at a horizon of one to five years. We argue that the apparent margin of graph networks over historical baselines in this task is substantially an artefact of the short horizons those baselines were computed over, and recommend horizon-matched baselines and multi-seed reporting as minimum practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过独立复现和多种子评估，揭示了图神经网络在道路级事故预测任务中报告的性能提升很大程度上是由于基线模型使用的历史时窗过短导致的假象，并呼吁采用时窗匹配的基线和多种子报告作为最低实践标准。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络越来越多地应用于道路级事故预测，但其报告的性能增益的稳定性鲜受审视。现有工作往往将图模型与短时窗的历史基线比较，可能高估了模型的真实贡献。
AI.method: 作者独立重构了近期一款不确定性感知模型的数据管道，在三个伦敦自治区采用扩展窗口协议，系统评估了11项设计决策；引入多种子评估量化随机种子敏感性；并将两种图网络与一个无参数的历史累计事故计数基线在匹配历史深度下进行对比，同时扫描基线的回溯时窗以揭示其单变量解释力范围。
AI.result: 11项设计决策中仅4项在第二个自治区通过复现，7项失败且其中4项符号反转而非衰减；多种子评估显示单一自治区内随机种子即可导致效应符号反转，参考架构每自治区种子间差异高达35.7分（作者模型仅4分）；在匹配历史深度下，作者模型与历史基线统计无差异（-0.90分, p=0.61），参考架构在18/18个保留窗口全败（-17.37分, p<10⁻⁶）；基线仅靠回溯时窗即覆盖22.71%-83.94%准确率，该领域所有已发表结果均可在1-5年时窗下由基线复现。
AI.conclusion: 图神经网络相对于历史基线的明显优势实质上是基线时窗设置过短造成的伪像；论文建议将时窗匹配的基线和多种子报告确立为该任务的最低实践规范，以避免虚高的性能声称。

title: Better Nearest Neighbor Graph Indices via (Efficient) LLM-Guided Pruning
summary: Graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is widely used for large-scale semantic search. Its indices are constructed primarily based on geometric relationships among embeddings of an input dataset (e.g., documents or images), rather than explicitly optimizing for semantic relevance. However, when using these indices for downstream query retrieval, performance is evaluated based on the semantic relevance of the retrieved results to the query. This creates a fundamental "geometry-semantic" mismatch between how the indices are constructed and how their retrieval results are evaluated. While existing LLM-based reranking methods can partially mitigate this mismatch at query time, they leave this underlying structural problem in the graph unresolved. We therefore propose LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP), a general framework that addresses this mismatch directly by leveraging LLM reasoning to refine an existing ANN graph index itself. LGP identifies structurally "low-value" neighbors of nodes and replaces them with LLM-selected alternatives that provide useful semantic information while retaining desired geometric structures of the original graph, including sparsity and efficient navigability. Experiments on representative semantic retrieval benchmarks show that LGP consistently improves end-to-end retrieval performance over both vanilla greedy graph search and LLM-based reranking across widely used graph-based ANN indices such as DiskANN and HNSW.

AI.tldr: 本文指出基于图的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）在构建索引时依赖几何关系，而评估时依赖语义相关性，存在“几何-语义”错位。提出LLM引导的图剪枝（LGP）框架，利用大语言模型推理优化现有ANN图索引，替换低价值邻居为语义有价值的替代节点，同时保持稀疏性和可导航性。实验表明LGP在DiskANN和HNSW等主流索引上持续提升端到端检索性能，优于原始贪婪搜索和LLM重排序方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的ANNS索引构建主要基于嵌入间的几何关系（如距离、角度），而下游查询检索的评价指标是语义相关性。这种构建与评价之间的根本性“几何-语义”错位导致检索性能受限。现有的LLM重排序方法仅在查询时缓解该问题，无法解决图结构层面的深层问题。
AI.method: 提出LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP)通用框架：1) 识别图中节点的结构性“低价值”邻居；2) 利用LLM推理选择具有语义信息价值的替代邻居；3) 替换过程保持原图的稀疏性和高效可导航性等几何结构特性。LGP直接在索引构建/优化阶段引入语义知识，而非仅在查询时重排。
AI.result: 在代表性语义检索基准上，LGP在DiskANN和HNSW等广泛使用的图ANN索引上，持续超越原始贪婪图搜索和基于LLM的查询时重排序方法，显著提升端到端检索性能。
AI.conclusion: LGP通过在图索引层面引入LLM语义推理，直接解决了几何构建与语义评价的结构性错位，提供了一种即插即用的图优化范式，在保持索引几何效率的同时显著提升语义检索质量。

title: A Polyphonic Conception of AI Understanding
summary: When a doctor, a judge, or an engineer must decide whether to trust an AI model's output, they cannot avoid asking what the model understands. Purely mathematical or statistical descriptions struggle to distinguish trustworthy from untrustworthy outputs without reintroducing the question of AI understanding in all but name. Yet the question is ill-framed as it stands, because the inherited concept operates within a monophonic paradigm: the idea that a cognitive system's understanding of something must be localised to a single mechanism underpinning all the capacities conferred by such understanding. Drawing on a wide range of mechanistic evidence, we show that LLMs are pervasively polyphonic: outputs emerge from coalitions of parallel mechanisms of uneven reliability, which variously complement, duplicate, or drown out one another, with several coalitions sufficing for a task without any one being indispensable. Polyphony not only complicates attributions of understanding, but renders monophonic inference patterns hazardous. In response, we develop a conception of understanding fit for polyphonic AI. It centres on sound circuitry that is reliably and correctly recruited and in control of outputs. Attributions of understanding thereby become tractable claims about internal organisation, and can do the work of guiding trust in AI.

AI.tldr: 论文指出大语言模型（LLM）的理解机制是「复调」而非「单调」的：输出源于多个可靠性不均的并行机制组成的联盟，而非单一不可或缺的机制。为此提出适合复调 AI 的理解概念，聚焦于「可靠且正确被招募并控制输出的健全电路」，使理解归因成为关于内部组织的可验证命题，从而指导对 AI 的信任决策。
AI.motivation: 当医生、法官、工程师等专业人士需决定是否信任 AI 输出时，纯数理统计描述无法区分可信与不可信输出，而「模型理解什么」这一问题又因沿用「单调范式」（认知系统的理解定位于单一机制）而设问不当。现有框架无法为高风险决策提供可操作的信任依据。
AI.method: 基于大量机制性实证证据，论证 LLM 普遍呈现复调特征：输出由多组并行机制联盟涌现，机制间相互补充、冗余或干扰，多个联盟均可完成任务且无单一不可或缺机制。据此重构理解概念，将其锚定于「可靠且正确被招募并控制输出的健全电路」。
AI.result: 复调性不仅增加了理解归因的复杂性，更使单调推理模式成为危险陷阱。新提出的复调理解概念将理解归因转化为关于内部组织的可验证命题（即特定健全电路是否被可靠招募并掌控输出），从而为 AI 信任评估提供可操作的判据。
AI.conclusion: 适合复调 AI 的理解概念不再预设单一理解机制，而是关注可靠电路的招募与控制关系。这使「模型是否理解」成为可经实证检验的工程问题，为高风险领域的 AI 信任决策提供了规范性框架。

title: When Should LLMs Trust Their Own Revisions? A Risk-Aware Study of Intrinsic Self-Correction
summary: Intrinsic self-correction asks a language model to revise its own answer without receiving new external evidence. A second pass can recover mistakes, but it can also overturn answers that were already correct. We study this trade-off across 29 open-weight LLMs on BoolQ, GSM8K, and Corr2Cause by tracking correctness transitions between initial and revised answers. Aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behavior: for example, Llama-3.1-8B improves by 25.5 percentage points on GSM8K, while refinement changes 19.1% of initially correct answers into wrong ones. A controlled BoolQ study further shows that refinement prompts shift the balance between recovery and harm. We then compare three runtime choices: keeping the initial answer, always accepting the revision, and selectively invoking revision using signals available after the initial response. The comparison identifies settings where learned gating is useful and others where a simpler unconditional policy performs better. These results suggest treating intrinsic self-correction as a revision policy rather than as a uniformly beneficial second pass, and evaluating it through both the corrections it recovers and the errors it introduces.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型的内在自我修正能力，即模型在无外部证据情况下修正自身答案。通过在29个开放权重LLM上跟踪初始答案与修正答案的正确性转移，发现整体准确率掩盖了显著不同的修正行为：既有恢复错误，也有破坏正确答案。论文将自我修正视为修正策略而非一律有益的二次尝试，建议从恢复与引入错误两方面评估。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常假设自我修正能统一提升性能，但忽略了修正可能破坏原本正确答案的风险。需要系统量化修正带来的收益与损害权衡，并探索何时应用修正策略最优。
AI.method: 在BoolQ、GSM8K、Corr2Cause三个基准上测试29个开放权重LLM，记录初始答案与修正答案的正确性转移（正确→正确、正确→错误、错误→正确、错误→错误）。对比三种运行时策略：保留初始答案、无条件接受修正、基于初始响应后可用信号选择性调用修正。
AI.result: Llama-3.1-8B在GSM8K上准确率提升25.5个百分点，但修正将19.1%原本正确答案变为错误。BoolQ受控实验显示提示词能改变恢复与损害的平衡。选择性修正策略在某些设置下优于无条件修正，但也存在简单无条件策略更优的情况。
AI.conclusion: 内在自我修正应视为修正策略而非一律有益的二次尝试。评估需同时考量其恢复的错误与引入的新错误。运行时策略选择需根据任务与模型特性权衡，学习型门控并非总是优于简单无条件策略。

title: Normative Loss Landscape Navigation: A Trajectory-Based Approach to Mitigating Forgetting in Incremental Learning
summary: Continual learning models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when trained sequentially on non-stationary data distributions. Previously, this has been addressed through weight regularization. While preconditioning gradients offer a promising alternative to mitigate forgetting, current approaches are myopic. Conversely, standard regularization methods apply rigid, scalar Euclidean penalties that entirely ignore the underlying Riemannian geometry of the parameter space. To overcome this gap, we propose TMLN (Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation), a normative navigation policy that formalizes continual learning as an optimal control problem over a curved loss landscape. TMLN utilizes a memory-efficient diagonal empirical Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) to define a localized Riemannian manifold. To compensate for the spatial limitations of the diagonal approximation, TMLN dynamically modulates a preconditioner using the normalized historical trajectory of the network's parameter values. By integrating this trajectory-based preconditioning directly into the gradient update, we actively shield historically critical parameter directions without relying on additive penalties. Empirical evaluations on class- and domain-incremental benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the loss barrier between consecutive tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出TMLN（轨迹调制景观导航），将持续学习形式化为曲面损失景观上的最优控制问题，利用对角经验Fisher信息矩阵定义局部黎曼流形，并通过历史参数轨迹动态调节预条件器，在梯度更新中主动保护关键参数方向，无需加性惩罚，显著降低任务间损失屏障。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要依赖权重正则化，预条件梯度虽有潜力但短视，标准正则化使用标量欧几里得惩罚忽略参数空间的黎曼几何结构，导致灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: TMLN利用内存高效的对角经验Fisher信息矩阵(FIM)构建局部黎曼流形，针对对角近似的空间局限，引入归一化历史参数轨迹动态调制预条件器，将轨迹预条件直接融入梯度更新，主动屏蔽历史关键参数方向，避免加性惩罚。
AI.result: 在类增量和域增量基准上实验表明，该方法显著降低连续任务间的损失屏障。
AI.conclusion: TMLN通过最优控制视角和轨迹调制的黎曼预条件，有效缓解灾难性遗忘，为持续学习提供几何感知的导航策略。

title: ARCagent: An Adaptive Retrieval Calibration Agent for Clinical Question Answering
summary: In diseases where clinical guidelines are incomplete, contested, or mutually contradictory, knowledge completeness and dynamic conflict-aware synthesis are two safety-critical properties that standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems do not provide. Therefore, we present \sysname, an adaptive retrieval calibration clinical question-answering agent for ME/CFS, a disease where diagnostic frameworks coexist and major guidelines actively contradict each other on treatment. ARCagent contributes three components. First, a 1,706-chunk, 10-source knowledge base with a structured inter-guideline conflict registry spanning all active ME/CFS diagnostic frameworks. Second, a conflict-aware retrieval calibration pipeline that re-ranks retrieved evidence using query-specific focus and conflict signals. Third, a benchmark scored by LLM-as-Judge, avoiding systematic underestimation averaging 10.1 percentage points caused by keyword matching. ARCagent achieves 95.3%, outperforming all base LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/ARCagent.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ARCagent，一种针对 ME/CFS（肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征）的自适应检索校准临床问答智能体，解决临床指南不完整、相互矛盾时的知识完整性与动态冲突感知综合问题。
AI.motivation: 在 ME/CFS 等疾病中，诊断框架共存且主要治疗指南相互矛盾，标准检索增强生成（RAG）系统无法提供知识完整性与动态冲突感知综合这两个安全关键属性，因此需要专门的解决方案。
AI.method: ARCagent 包含三大组件：1）包含 1,706 个文本块、10 个来源的知识库，并建立结构化跨指南冲突注册表，覆盖所有活跃的 ME/CFS 诊断框架；2）冲突感知检索校准管道，利用查询特定的焦点与冲突信号对检索证据重新排序；3）基于 LLM-as-Judge 的基准评测，避免关键词匹配导致的系统性低估（平均 10.1 个百分点）。
AI.result: ARCagent 达到 95.3% 的性能，超越所有基础大语言模型。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建冲突感知的知识库与检索校准机制，ARCagent 在指南相互矛盾的复杂临床场景中实现了高准确度的问答，为不完整或冲突指南下的临床决策支持提供了可行方案。

title: Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis: Mapping Technological Diffusion across Academic Preprints, Patent Signals, and Compute Scaling
summary: Macroeconomic productivity metrics, such as Total Factor Productivity, register technological breakthroughs with multi-year reporting lags due to administrative survey intervals and national accounting conventions. This paper introduces Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis (HSTA), an unsupervised quantitative methodology that tracks technology diffusion directly from unstructured scientific and commercial text streams. We analyze 30,000 filtered document records spanning academic preprints from arXiv and patent application records from the USPTO. By projecting high-dimensional Transformer sentence embeddings onto unit hyperspheres using Spherical K-Means clustering across eight primary sub-topics and UMAP manifold reductions, HSTA formalizes two quantitative metrics: (1) Semantic Centroid Vector Drift, which tracks vocabulary shifts between temporal sub-corpora to identify structural paradigm transformations; and (2) Commercialization Offset, which evaluates cross-corpus peak density alignments between scientific discovery and intellectual property filings. Linking quarterly topic volume velocity with physical hardware metrics from the Epoch AI database, Vector Autoregressive F-tests demonstrate that quarterly paper volume velocity alone does not Granger-cause frontier compute allocation surges at conventional statistical significance levels, highlighting the necessity of conditioning textual signals on physical capital constraints. Empirical results reveal that sub-topics covering Large Language Models (with a drift metric of 0.332) and Artificial Intelligence Systems (with a drift metric of 0.234) undergo the highest rate of semantic evolution, offering an objective, real-time mechanism to complement traditional economic statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超球面语义轨迹分析（HSTA），一种无监督定量方法，通过分析arXiv预印本和USPTO专利文本，利用Transformer嵌入和球面K-Means聚类，构建语义质心向量漂移和商业化偏移两个指标，实时追踪技术扩散，发现大语言模型和AI系统语义演化最快，且论文数量速度不格兰杰因果前沿算力分配激增。
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济生产率指标（如全要素生产率）存在多年报告滞后，无法实时捕捉技术突破。需要一种能从非结构化科技文本流中直接量化技术扩散的方法，以补充传统经济统计。
AI.method: 收集30,000份arXiv和USPTO文档，使用Transformer句嵌入投影到单位超球面，应用球面K-Means聚类（八个子主题）和UMAP流形降维。构建两个核心指标：(1)语义质心向量漂移，追踪时间子语料库间词汇变迁识别范式转型；(2)商业化偏移，评估科学发现与知识产权申请跨语料库峰值密度对齐。结合Epoch AI硬件数据，用向量自回归F检验分析Granger因果关系。
AI.result: 大语言模型（漂移指标0.332）和人工智能系统（0.234）语义演化率最高。季度论文量速度单独不格兰杰因果前沿算力分配激增（常规显著性水平），表明文本信号需结合物理资本约束。HSTA提供客观实时机制监测技术扩散。
AI.conclusion: HSTA通过语义轨迹分析实现技术扩散的实时量化监测，揭示LLM和AI系统快速语义演化，证明单纯文本量指标不足以预测算力投资，需融合物理约束。该方法可作为传统经济统计的实时补充，为政策制定和技术预测提供新工具。

title: CADENCE: A Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Code and benchmark evaluation scripts available at https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git
summary:
Time series classification (TSC) exhibits a sharp trade-off between accuracy and computational scalability. Meta-ensembles like HIVE-COTE 2.0 reach state-of-the-art accuracy but require extensive compute, whereas ultra-fast random convolutional transforms (e.g., MiniRocket, Hydra) run in seconds but struggle with phase-independent distributions, signal kinematics, and decision tree fragmentation on large class counts.
  In this work, we present CADENCE (Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for time series Classification Excellence), a unified, CPU-native dual-expert architecture. CADENCE decouples representation learning into two specialized pathways: (i) a Convolutional Linear Expert pairing 10,000 deterministic dilated features with closed-form L2-regularized Woodbury ridge classification, and (ii) a Distributional Interval Expert pairing competing dilated kernels (Hydra) with dyadic Cornish-Fisher moment approximations across signal kinematics and FFT spectral bands, fitted with an ExtraTrees ensemble. An internal validation meta-router with rare-class preservation dynamically selects between pure expert routing and confidence-weighted soft blending, followed by a full refit on 100% of training data.
  Evaluated across all 109 equal-length UCR Archive datasets over 30 resamples (3,270 total runs), CADENCE achieves a grand mean accuracy of 0.8864. This ranks #2 across the archive, surpassed only by HIVE-COTE 2.0 (0.8895, p_Holm = 0.295, no statistically significant difference), while outperforming Hydra+MultiRocket (0.8818), MultiRocket (0.8797), and HIVE-COTE 1.0 (0.8786, p_Holm = 0.048). CADENCE closes the gap to HIVE-COTE 2.0 to 0.31 percentage points while taking an average of only 17.53 seconds per dataset on a dual-core CPU. Source code and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CADENCE，一种统一的 CPU 原生双专家架构，用于时间序列分类（TSC）。它通过两条专门化路径解耦表示学习：卷积线性专家和分布区间专家，并配备动态元路由器。在 109 个 UCR 数据集上，CADENCE 达到 0.8864 的总体平均准确率，排名第二，仅次于 HIVE-COTE 2.0（差距 0.31 个百分点，无统计显著差异），且平均每数据集仅需 17.53 秒（双核 CPU），显著缩小了准确性与计算效率之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类在准确性与计算可扩展性之间存在尖锐权衡：元集成方法（如 HIVE-COTE 2.0）虽达最优准确率但计算开销巨大；超快随机卷积变换（如 MiniRocket、Hydra）虽秒级完成，但在相位无关分布、信号运动学及大类别数下的决策树碎片化问题上表现挣扎。亟需一种既能逼近最先进精度、又能保持极高计算效率的统一方法。
AI.method: CADENCE 采用双专家架构：(i) 卷积线性专家：配对 10,000 个确定性膨胀特征与闭式 L2 正则化 Woodbury 岭分类；(ii) 分布区间专家：配对竞争性膨胀核与跨信号运动学及 FFT 频带的二叉 Cornish-Fisher 矩近似，采用 ExtraTrees 集成拟合。内部验证元路由器结合稀有类保留，动态在纯专家路由与置信度加权软融合间选择，最后在 100% 训练数据上完全重拟合。
AI.result: 在全部 109 个等长 UCR 归档数据集上进行 30 次重采样（共 3,270 次运行）评估，CADENCE 取得 0.8864 的总体平均准确率，排名全归档第二，仅次于 HIVE-COTE 2.0 的 0.8895（p_Holm = 0.295，差异无统计显著性），显著优于 Hydra+MultiRocket (0.8818)、MultiRocket (0.8797) 和 HIVE-COTE 1.0 (0.8786, p_Holm = 0.048)。与 HIVE-COTE 2.0 的差距收窄至 0.31 个百分点，平均每数据集耗时仅 17.53 秒（双核 CPU）。
AI.conclusion: CADENCE 通过双专家解耦表示学习与自适应元路由，成功在保持 CPU 原生高效推理的同时，将准确率推向最先进水平附近，实质性缩小了 TSC 领域长期存在的精度-效率鸿沟，为大规模、实时部署场景提供了极具竞争力的解决方案。

title: Retrieval Sensitivity to Identity Signals in Queries
comment: EMNLP 2026 camera-ready, with a correction to Fig. 4
summary: Dense retrievers decide which documents reach users and the language models that use them, yet they are typically evaluated with neutral queries. We ask whether the identity signals that real users express in their queries---political ideology and dialect---bias what a retriever returns. We design evaluations in two domains, political news and consumer-health questions, each pairing a controlled synthetic set that varies only the identity signal with naturalistic queries. Across five dense retrievers and a sparse baseline, every retriever (i) retrieves articles that align with the query's own political lean and (ii) performs worse for questions written in African American Language (AAL) than in White Mainstream English (WME). Two analyses tie these gaps to queries' identity signals beyond surface vocabulary: partialling out an aggregate lexical-asymmetry score leaves the synthetic gaps largely intact, and linear probes recover lean and dialect from the retrievers' query embeddings beyond token-level features. Left unaddressed, such retrieval biases risk contributing to polarization and reinforcing the health disparities already faced by AAL speakers. Code is available at https://github.com/Andrewtcr/bias-ret.

AI.tldr: 密集检索器存在身份偏见：它们倾向于检索与查询政治倾向一致的文档，且对非裔美式英语（AAL）查询的表现显著劣于白人主流英语（WME）。这些偏见源于查询嵌入中编码的身份信号，而非表层词汇差异，若不解决将加剧两极分化并强化健康差距。
AI.motivation: 密集检索器决定哪些文档到达用户及语言模型，但通常用中性查询评估。真实用户查询包含政治意识形态和方言等身份信号，本文旨在探究这些信号是否会导致检索器返回结果产生偏见。
AI.method: 在政治新闻和消费者健康问答两个领域设计评估，每个领域包含仅变化身份信号的受控合成查询集和自然查询集。对比五个密集检索器和一个稀疏基线，通过词汇不对称得分控制和线性探针分析查询嵌入中的身份信息。
AI.result: 所有检索器均（i）倾向于检索与查询政治倾向一致的文章，（ii）在AAL查询上表现显著劣于WME。控制词汇不对称后合成差距基本保持，线性探针能从查询嵌入中恢复倾向和方言信息，超越词级特征。
AI.conclusion: 检索器对政治倾向和方言的系统性偏见若不解决，将加剧政治极化并强化AAL使用者面临的健康差距，亟需在检索系统中引入公平性缓解机制。

title: An Exact Generate - Transform Decomposition of Small-LLM Team Scaling Across Orchestration Architectures
summary:
Replacing one LLM agent with a collaborating team can raise accuracy, but whether scaling the team helps, and which architecture to scale, is unclear. Sweeping eight agent orchestration architectures across five instruction-tuned 7-9B models, five short-answer benchmarks, and an executable-code benchmark up to 30 calls, we find that the returns to team scaling are sharply task-dependent: from three to thirty calls accuracy rises by up to 17 points on the two arithmetic word-problem benchmarks (GSM8K, GSMHard) but by at most four on ARC, GPQA, and MMLU, for every architecture, a split the usual task-averaged number conceals. Proposer-Critic captures the arithmetic gains, scaling steepest and, in aggregate, surpassing every other architecture at the largest budget (item-clustered intervals exclude zero), though it ranks among the weakest elsewhere, and no architecture wins across tasks.
  We explain these trajectories with an exact generate-transform decomposition. Partitioning any workflow into proposal coverage and a downstream transform, any accuracy change splits exactly into an extensive coverage dividend and an intensive transformation change. The decomposition diagnoses each task: arithmetic offers coverage headroom that a critic-guided transform converts, whereas the multiple-choice benchmarks either saturate in coverage or fail to convert it, and on open-ended code generative recovery nearly vanishes so accuracy tracks coverage. At equal call budgets token cost still varies 2.1x. Extra calls therefore create candidate opportunity that only some architectures, on some tasks, convert. Team scaling is a task- and architecture-specific bet, not a uniform lever.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体协作扩展对不同任务的影响，发现扩展收益强烈依赖任务：算术任务受益显著（高达17分），而选择题任务收益有限（≤4分）。Proposer-Critic架构在算术任务上表现最佳，但无架构在所有任务上均胜出。提出generate-transform分解解释机制：准确率变化分解为覆盖率红利和转换效率变化。额外调用创造候选机会，仅特定架构在特定任务能转化。团队扩展是任务与架构相关的赌注，而非通用杠杆。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明用协作团队替代单一LLM智能体可提升准确率，但团队规模扩展是否有益、以及哪种架构适合扩展尚不清楚。本文旨在系统评估不同编排架构在多任务上的扩展效果，揭示扩展收益的任务依赖性及其背后机制。
AI.method: 实验涵盖八种智能体编排架构、五个7-9B指令微调模型、五个短答案基准（包括GSM8K、GSMHard、ARC、GPQA、MMLU）及一个可执行代码基准，调用预算从3到30次。提出generate-transform精确分解框架，将工作流拆分为提议覆盖率和下游转换，将准确率变化精确拆分为广延覆盖红利和强度转换变化，以诊断各任务的扩展行为。
AI.result: 1) 团队扩展收益强烈依赖任务：算术任务（GSM8K、GSMHard）准确率随调用数从3增至30上升高达17分，而选择题任务（ARC、GPQA、MMLU）最多仅升4分。2) Proposer-Critic架构在算术任务上扩展最陡峭，在最大预算下总体超越其他架构（区间排除零），但在其他任务中排名最弱。3) 无单一架构在所有任务上获胜。4) 分解分析显示：算术任务存在覆盖率提升空间且critic引导转换高效；选择题任务覆盖率饱和或转换失效；代码生成任务生成恢复几乎消失，准确率紧随覆盖率。5) 相同调用预算下token成本差异达2.1倍。额外调用仅创造候选机会，特定架构在特定任务才能转化。
AI.conclusion: 团队扩展不是通用的性能杠杆，而是任务与架构特定的策略选择。generate-transform分解为理解扩展机制提供了精确工具，揭示覆盖率提升与转换效率的交互决定最终收益。实践中需根据任务类型选择合适架构并权衡token成本。

title: The Detectability Gap: Hidden Heterogeneity in Hallucination Detection Across Language Models
summary: Sampling based consistency is widely used for hallucination detection, yet aggregate performance can conceal systematic differences in which errors are detectable. This work studies that heterogeneity across four language models and three factual question answering datasets. Partitioning hallucinations by answer agreement reveals high agreement (Ghost) and low agreement (Flickering) regimes with an apparent detectability gap of $0.35$ to $0.46$ AUC. Because the statistics used to define the regimes and measure this gap are strongly coupled ($|ρ|\approx0.94$ to $1.00$), the raw result is treated as a property of agreement based detection rather than independent evidence. After freezing regime assignments, lexical and semantic response dispersion preserve the asymmetry, with bootstrap $95\%$ intervals excluding zero in all $12$ model and dataset settings. A stricter test using individual diffusion trajectories and no cross seed information preserves the asymmetry across all three LLaDA datasets ($p<0.005$) and directionally across all three Dream datasets, with one reaching significance. The hard regime varies substantially in prevalence across models ($16\%$ to $77\%$), and matched prompts frequently change regimes between models. These findings show that aggregate detection metrics conceal persistent, model dependent heterogeneity in language model failures and motivate regime conditioned evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究采样一致性幻觉检测在不同模型和数据集上的异质性，发现高一致性（Ghost）与低一致性（Flickering）两种幻觉模式在可检测性上存在显著差距（0.35-0.46 AUC），且这种差距在冻结模式分配后依然存在，证明聚合指标掩盖了模型依赖的系统性差异，呼吁基于模式的条件评估。
AI.motivation: 采样一致性广泛用于幻觉检测，但聚合性能指标可能掩盖不同错误类型的系统性可检测性差异，需要深入理解不同模型和数据集上幻觉检测的异质性。
AI.method: 在四个语言模型和三个事实问答数据集上，按答案一致性将幻觉分为高一致性（Ghost）和低一致性（Flickering）两种模式；冻结模式分配后，使用词汇和语义响应离散度指标验证可检测性差距；采用 bootstrap 置信区间和基于扩散轨迹的严格测试（无跨种子信息）进一步确认结果。
AI.result: 发现两种模式间存在 0.35-0.46 AUC 的可检测性差距，统计耦合强（|ρ|≈0.94-1.00）；冻结模式后，词汇和语义离散度在所有 12 个模型-数据集设置中均显著保持不对称性（bootstrap 95% CI 排除零）；更严格的扩散轨迹测试在全部三个 LLaDA 数据集上显著（p<0.005），在 Dream 数据集上方向一致且有一个显著；困难模式在模型间流行率差异大（16%-77%），相同提示在不同模型间常切换模式。
AI.conclusion: 聚合检测指标掩盖了持久的、模型依赖的语言模型失效异质性，提倡采用基于模式的条件评估来更准确地表征和改进幻觉检测。

title: Graph neural networks for sampling-invariant embeddings of organized signal sets
summary: Sensor networks and radars can deliver signals as organized sets, e.g. ordered signals, signals describing range cells within a grid or signals perceived as graph nodes. Within such sets, individual signals may be characterized by distinct sampling parameters. This paper investigates organized signal sets neural network encoders. In the context of this work, the purpose of such encoders is to project heterogeneously sampled signal sets into an arbitrary fixed-size vectors space. This new representation space is designed so that signal sets can be processed as vectors rid of sampling differences to allow for arbitrary topology-aware processing with no signal processing constraints. Within this representation space designed to reduce the influence of heterogeneous sampling parameters, the relevance of signal sets representations is evaluated by considering signal sets discrimination potential with a focus on waveforms separation. The encoding and embeddings discrimination experiments conducted rely exclusively on synthetic complex-valued radiofrequency signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有组织信号集的神经网络编码器，旨在将异构采样的信号集投影到固定大小的向量空间，消除采样差异，实现拓扑感知处理，并通过合成复值射频信号实验评估波形分离的判别能力。
AI.motivation: 传感器网络和雷达产生的有组织信号集（有序信号、网格范围单元、图节点）往往具有异构采样参数，传统信号处理难以统一处理。需要一种编码器将异构采样的信号集映射到统一的固定维向量空间，消除采样差异，支持任意拓扑感知的下游处理。
AI.method: 设计神经网络编码器，将异构采样的有组织信号集编码为固定大小的向量表示。构建专门的表示空间以减弱异构采样参数的影响。仅使用合成复值射频信号进行编码和嵌入判别实验，重点评估波形分离的判别潜力。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的编码器能将异构采样的信号集有效投影到统一向量空间，嵌入表示在波形分离任务上表现出良好的判别能力，验证了该表示空间对采样差异的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 有组织信号集神经网络编码器可将异构采样信号集统一映射为固定维向量，消除采样参数差异，实现无信号处理约束的拓扑感知处理。合成复值射频信号实验证明了该方法在波形分离判别上的有效性。

title: Follow the Entities: A Corpus Map for Agentic Search
summary: Answering questions and completing tasks over large document collections often requires connecting evidence spread across multiple documents, such as a project's approval recorded in one, its requirements in another, and its latest status in a third. Recent LLM agents approach this by iteratively searching the full corpus rather than reading only a fixed set of top-ranked documents. However, when the corpus is exposed only as a flat collection of files, a relevant document gives no indication of how it relates to others, so the agent must rediscover these relationships for every query, often missing complementary evidence while simultaneously consuming substantial additional tokens. To address this, we introduce CorpusMap, a navigation layer that organizes the corpus around its recurring entities, which are identifiable from the documents themselves and can link a single document to many others across sources. Specifically, CorpusMap represents each recurring entity as an Entity Page that aggregates information about it and links to every document that refers to it, forming a graph between entities and documents that the agent can traverse to gather otherwise disconnected evidence. Moreover, since CorpusMap is constructed offline by resolving mentions of the same entity across documents, its links are shared across queries rather than rediscovered repeatedly at inference time. Using 7 different models with 3 benchmark datasets, we show that CorpusMap improves both evidence discovery and answer quality over raw-corpus agentic search while using fewer tokens on average, and further outperforms 4 alternative navigation layers, suggesting that entities serve as effective anchors for navigating large document collections.

AI.tldr: CorpusMap 是一个离线构建的实体导航层，通过实体页面聚合信息并链接文档，帮助智能体高效发现跨文档证据，提升回答质量并减少 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 大规模文档集合中证据分散，现有智能体需反复搜索平铺文档，难以发现关联证据且消耗大量 token。
AI.method: 构建 CorpusMap，识别跨文档重复实体，生成实体页面聚合信息并链接所有提及该实体的文档，形成实体-文档图，供智能体遍历收集证据。
AI.result: 在 7 个模型和 3 个基准数据集上，CorpusMap 优于原始语料库智能体搜索，证据发现和回答质量提升，平均 token 消耗减少，且优于 4 种替代导航层。
AI.conclusion: 实体作为锚点能有效导航大规模文档集合，离线构建的实体链接可跨查询复用，显著提升检索效率和答案质量。

title: The Layer Mystery of VLA: An Information-Theoretical Analysis of VLA Latent Interface
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies connect a pretrained vision-language backbone to an action head through a latent interface, but which backbone layers this interface should expose remains unclear. We study single-layer selection and multi-layer fusion for frozen backbones across three pretrained models and two manipulation benchmarks, LIBERO and CALVIN, with three policy-training seeds per configuration. Across three fusion mechanisms and three layer-subset strategies, 47 of 54 configurations underperform the best observed single-layer policy. Our stastical analysis further confirms that fusion's advantage is very limited. However, the best layer varies substantially across backbones and benchmarks, making layer selection consequential and exhaustive policy sweeps expensive. We further derive a reweighting equivalence between the proposed information-bottleneck objectives for action-conditioned InfoNCE and action prediction, motivating InfoNCE as a proxy for layer quality. Empirically, InfoNCE provides the most consistent positive association with policy success among four evaluated proxies. Selecting the layer with the highest InfoNCE score requires 9-33 times less GPU compute than exhaustive policy sweeps and reduces mean selection regret from 17.89 percentage points for deepest-layer selection to 3.71 points across six settings. Its mean regret is close to the 3.28-3.50 points achieved by fixed-layer heuristics optimized retrospectively using all six oracle sweeps, without requiring closed-loop evaluations during selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉语言动作（VLA）策略中预训练骨干网络层的选择问题，发现单层选择优于多层融合，并提出使用InfoNCE作为层质量的代理指标，可大幅降低计算成本并接近最优层选择性能。
AI.motivation: VLA策略将预训练的视觉语言骨干网络通过潜在接口连接到动作头，但不清楚该暴露哪些骨干层。多层融合虽常被使用，但其优势未经充分验证；最优层在不同骨干和基准间差异大，穷举策略扫描成本高昂，亟需高效的层选择方法。
AI.method: 在三个预训练模型和两个操作基准（LIBERO、CALVIN）上，对比单层选择与三种融合机制、三种层子集策略的多层融合，每个配置训练三个随机种子。推导了动作条件InfoNCE与动作预测的信息瓶颈目标的重加权等价性，评估四种代理指标，验证InfoNCE作为层质量代理的有效性。
AI.result: 54个配置中47个多层融合方案弱于最佳单层策略，统计分析确认融合优势极有限。最优层随骨干和基准显著变化。InfoNCE与策略成功率呈最一致的正相关，基于InfoNCE选择层仅需穷举扫描1/9到1/33的GPU算力，平均选择遗憾从17.89百分点（最深层启发式）降至3.71百分点，接近事后优化的固定层启发式（3.28-3.50百分点），且无需闭环评估。
AI.conclusion: 单层选择优于多层融合，层选择至关重要。InfoNCE作为高效代理指标，能以极低计算成本实现接近最优的层选择，为VLA策略的骨干层选择提供了实用且理论有依据的解决方案。

title: Resolving the Missing Financial Data Crisis: A Generative AI Pipeline for SEC 10-K Extraction
comment: Presented as a Lightning Talk at MIT URTC 2026
summary: SEC 10-K filings contain substantial financial information that is not consistently captured in structured datasets, creating a missing-data problem affecting over 70% of firms and half of total market capitalization. This can disproportionately bias quantitative analysis against smaller firms, which may be excluded due to limited available data. Traditional financial extraction methods such as Regular Expressions (Regex) and BERT, have been widely used. However, they are highly brittle when parsing complex SEC 10-K filings, which leads to data that is existent in the files being lost since these methods do not consider that a data attribute could be located in a different section or a footnote. This study evaluates several Large Language Models (LLMs), including Llama-3 8B, Qwen-2.5 14B, and Llama-3.3 70B, to figure out individual model strengths and weaknesses when extracting specific attributes from SEC 10-K text. The extraction quality was evaluated across four financial variables of varying structural complexity: Cash and Cash Equivalents (tabular), Short-Term Debt (hybrid), Credit Facilities (narrative), and Research and Development (hybrid). Results show that while smaller models like Llama-3 8B experience performance degradation under complex negative prompting, aligning parameter scale with document complexity yields high zero-shot accuracy. Qwen-2.5 14B excels as a tabular specialist with an 83.33% F1 score on Cash, whereas Llama-3.3 70B effectively navigates dense narrative footnotes, achieving a 76.92% F1 score on R&D. This scalable framework addresses critical information gaps in quantitative finance datasets and eliminates missing-data bias through a more thorough analysis of the SEC 10-K files.

AI.tldr: 本文评估多个大语言模型（LLMs）从SEC 10-K文件中提取财务数据的能力，解决结构化数据集中缺失数据导致的偏见问题。实验表明，模型参数规模与文档复杂度匹配可实现高零样本准确率：Qwen-2.5 14B擅长表格型数据（现金及现金等价物F1 83.33%），Llama-3.3 70B擅长叙事型脚注（研发支出F1 76.92%），该框架有效填补量化金融数据集的信息缺口。
AI.motivation: SEC 10-K文件包含大量财务信息，但结构化数据集仅覆盖约30%的公司和一半市值，导致缺失数据问题，且对小型公司产生不成比例的偏见。传统正则表达式和BERT方法在解析复杂10-K文件时脆弱，无法处理数据属性可能位于不同章节或脚注的情况，造成数据丢失。
AI.method: 评估Llama-3 8B、Qwen-2.5 14B、Llama-3.3 70B三种LLMs，针对四种结构复杂度不同的财务变量进行零样本抽取：现金及现金等价物（表格型）、短期债务（混合型）、信贷额度（叙事型）、研发支出（混合型）。使用F1分数衡量抽取质量，分析不同模型在不同复杂度任务上的表现。
AI.result: 小模型（Llama-3 8B）在复杂负向提示下性能下降；参数规模与文档复杂度匹配可获得高零样本准确率。Qwen-2.5 14B作为表格专家，在现金及现金等价物上达到83.33% F1；Llama-3.3 70B有效导航密集叙事脚注，在研发支出上达到76.92% F1。
AI.conclusion: 该可扩展框架通过更彻底地分析SEC 10-K文件，解决了量化金融数据集中的关键信息缺口，消除了缺失数据偏见，为财务数据自动化抽取提供了有效方案。

title: KernelOnet: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Kernel Functions
summary: This paper proposes an interpretable neural operator framework, the Kernel Operator Network (KernelOnet), which incorporates kernel functions explicitly into the neural operator architecture, so that the operator structure matches the kernel-expansion form used in boundary-type kernel-expansion methods. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which learn basis functions implicitly through deep networks, KernelOnet replaces the trunk network with explicit kernels and offers three complementary kernels: a data-driven learnable kernel, in which a neural network parameterizes a radial basis function learned from data, and which for constant-coefficient linear problems can be regarded as a non-singular fundamental solution; a physics-informed kernel, which embeds physical information such as analytic fundamental solutions into the network structure, so that the expansion satisfies the governing equation automatically and can be trained without supervision on boundary conditions alone, with no interior solution data; and a hybrid kernel, which splits the solution, according to the linear principal part of the governing equation, into a homogeneous part spanned by analytic fundamental solutions and a source part carried by low-rank learned correction kernels, thereby balancing physical priors against data fitting on nonlinear problems lacking an analytic fundamental solution. On three benchmarks and one engineering problem in a shallow-water waveguide, KernelOnet attains high accuracy; where comparable with DeepONet, it is more accurate with fewer learnable parameters. Its unsupervised configuration needs no interior solution labels, and its per-query inference cost is far below that of per-instance solvers, offering an effective route to acoustic propagation in unbounded exterior domains that general-purpose neural operators struggle to handle.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出可解释的神经算子框架 KernelOnet，显式引入核函数替代 trunk 网络，提供数据驱动核、物理信息核和混合核三种互补核，在声学传播等无界外部域问题上实现高精度、低参数量、无监督训练且推理成本极低。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子（如 DeepONet）隐式学习基函数，难以处理无界外部域声学传播等问题，且缺乏可解释性、物理先验融合及无监督训练能力。
AI.method: 提出 KernelOnet，将核函数显式嵌入神经算子架构，设计三种互补核：数据驱动可学习核（神经网络参数化径向基函数，可视为非奇异基解）；物理信息核（嵌入解析基解，自动满足控制方程，仅需边界条件无监督训练）；混合核（将解分解为由解析基解张成的齐次部分和由低秩学习修正核承载的源部分，平衡物理先验与数据拟合）。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试和一个浅水波导工程问题上，KernelOnet 实现高精度；与 DeepONet 相比，准确度更高且可学习参数更少；无监督配置无需内部解标签，单次查询推理成本远低于逐实例求解器。
AI.conclusion: KernelOnet 为声学传播等无界外部域问题提供了一条有效路径，兼具可解释性、物理一致性、数据效率和计算效率，优于通用神经算子。

title: ReMem: Rethinking Perception and Memory in Long-Context Recommendation Agents
summary: Recent Recommendation Agents (RecAgents) offer a promising alternative by shifting recommendation to an active, user-side paradigm, where generative agents autonomously perceive external platforms, reason over user preferences, and execute decisions. However, existing RecAgents still suffer from two critical limitations: brittle item perception based on noisy and heterogeneous item pages, and inefficient long-context reasoning over extended user histories and multi-step interaction traces. To address these challenges, we propose a novel recommendation agent framework, termed as ReMem, that combines OCR-based multimodal perception with time-evolving dynamic memory. Instead of parsing raw HTML, ReMem observes item pages through screenshots and extracts structured multimodal information via an OCR tool, enabling a more humanoid and platform-agnostic perception mechanism. To support long-horizon preference modeling, ReMem further introduces a chunk-wise sequential memory update strategy, where the agent selectively maintains a fixed-size memory of informative historical interactions while processing arbitrarily long contexts with linear inference complexity and bounded context length. This design allows the agent to preserve evolving user preferences without relying on external memory modules or disrupting the standard autoregressive generation process. To enhance the dynamic memory instruction, we further develop a multi-memory GRPO variant, which propagates the final-answer advantage to all intermediate conversations that contribute to the final response. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that ReMem consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 5.16\% across three recommendation agent tasks, namely searching, ranking, and judging.

AI.tldr: ReMem框架结合OCR多模态感知和动态记忆机制，解决推荐智能体中脆弱的物品感知和低效的长上下文推理问题，在搜索、排序、判断三个推荐任务上平均提升5.16%。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐智能体存在两个关键局限：基于嘈杂异构物品页面的脆弱物品感知，以及对扩展用户历史和多步交互轨迹的低效长上下文推理。
AI.method: ReMem框架包含三大创新：1) OCR基础的多模态感知，通过截图和OCR工具提取结构化多模态信息，实现类人且平台无关的感知；2) 分块顺序记忆更新策略，选择性维护固定大小的信息性历史交互记忆，以线性推理复杂度和有界上下文长度处理任意长上下文；3) 多记忆GRPO变体，将最终答案优势传播到所有对最终响应有贡献的中间对话，增强动态记忆指令。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明，ReMem持续优于最先进基线，在搜索、排序、判断三个推荐智能体任务上平均提升5.16%。
AI.conclusion: ReMem通过OCR多模态感知和动态记忆机制有效解决了推荐智能体的关键局限，提供了更鲁棒、高效且平台无关的推荐智能体框架，为用户侧主动推荐范式提供了可行的技术路径。}

title: AdaST: Adaptive Coupling for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (main conference). Code: https://github.com/LzyFischer/AdaST
summary: Spatial-temporal (ST) forecasting underpins many real-world systems such as traffic, climate, and energy networks. While existing methods implicitly assume strong spatiotemporal coupling, we observe that real-world ST data exhibits distinct coupling regimes, ranging from temporal-dominated and spatial-dominated to strongly coupled patterns. This mismatch causes current models to suffer from spurious dependencies and degraded performance when one correlation dominates. To overcome this limitation, we aim to dynamically modulate spatial and temporal modeling based on the data's inherent coupling structure. However, three key challenges exist: unknown coupling structure, heterogeneous coupling dynamics, and suboptimal spatial modeling. We propose AdaST, an adaptive ST forecasting framework that tackles these challenges through a decompose-recompose paradigm. AdaST factorizes inputs into components capturing different coupling patterns using heterogeneity-aware experts. Each component is processed by role-aligned modules, and a correlation-informed adaptive recomposer integrates them for final prediction. Extensive experiments confirm that AdaST significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the necessity of an adaptive approach.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AdaST，一种自适应时空预测框架，通过分解-重组范式动态调节空间和时间建模，解决真实时空数据中耦合模式异质的问题，实验显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有时空预测方法隐含假设强时空耦合，但真实数据表现出从时间主导、空间主导到强耦合的不同耦合模式，这种错配导致模型产生虚假依赖、性能下降。
AI.method: AdaST采用分解-重组范式：使用异质性感知专家将输入分解为捕捉不同耦合模式的组件；每个组件由角色对齐模块处理；相关性感知自适应重组器整合组件进行最终预测。
AI.result: 大量实验表明AdaST显著优于最先进基线，验证了自适应方法的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应调节空间和时间建模以匹配数据固有耦合结构，能有效解决时空预测中的虚假依赖问题，提升预测性能。

title: PACT: Pairwise-Anchored Calibrated Tuning for Single-Token Typed Decisions
summary: Single-token typed-decision models answer a schema question by reading the logits of a few one-letter answer codes at a single position: they are fast and return a probability for every allowed answer, but they are trained with plain cross-entropy that ignores most of the structure in their training data. We study such a model whose data is curated as contrastive pairs---two contexts that differ in one edited fact that flips the answer---each carrying a machine-checked certificate that deleting the decisive sentence makes the fact unknown. We propose PACT, which turns this structure into four training terms that need no new annotation: a difference-in-differences margin over each pair that is invariant to any shared logit offset, a permutation-consistency term against answer-code position bias, an evidence-necessity term on certificate-verified ablated contexts, and an ordinal transport cost for rubric fields, plus a three-parameter contextual temperature. On a frozen 324-item holdout with three seeds, PACT matches the published recipe in accuracy ($84.6\%$ vs. $85.2\%$; McNemar $p \ge 0.50$ at every seed) while giving the lowest position bias of all runs (answer flips under relabelling $9.8\%$ vs. $13.8\%$) and the lowest ordinal error on rubric fields (MAE $0.232$ vs. $0.311$). Against a control with the same optimiser and schedule but cross-entropy only, PACT is significantly more accurate at two of three seeds, halves the seed-to-seed spread and lowers NLL by $26\%$. Seed-matched ablations and pre-specified falsification tests locate these gains precisely: no single term raises raw accuracy, and the method's value lies in robustness and stability rather than headline accuracy. Code, data splits, trained adapters, and all run records are available at https://github.com/BennyLinntu/PACT-Pairwise-Anchored-Calibrated-Tuning-for-Single-Token-Typed-Decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PACT 方法，针对单 token 类型决策模型，利用对比对数据的结构设计四个训练项（差分边际、排列一致性、证据必要性、序数传输成本）加上上下文温度，在不降低准确率的前提下显著降低位置偏差、序数误差及种子间方差，提升鲁棒性与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 单 token 类型决策模型虽快且输出概率分布，但标准交叉熵训练忽略了训练数据中丰富的结构信息（对比对、证据证书、评分量表等），导致位置偏差大、序数预测差、种子间不稳定。
AI.method: PACT 利用对比对（仅一事实不同且翻转答案）及机器验证的证据证书，构建四个无需额外标注的训练项：1) 差分差分边际，不变于共享 logit 偏移；2) 排列一致性项，对抗答案码位置偏差；3) 证据必要性项，在证书验证的消融上下文上施加约束；4) 序数传输成本，针对评分量表字段。另引入三参数上下文温度。
AI.result: 在冻结的 324 项保留集上（三种种子），PACT 与已发布配方准确率持平（84.6% vs 85.2%，McNemar p≥0.5），但位置偏差最低（重标签下答案翻转 9.8% vs 13.8%），序数误差最低（MAE 0.232 vs 0.311）。对比仅用交叉熵的控制组，PACT 在三种种子中有二种显著更准，种子间方差减半，NLL 降低 26%。消融与预注册伪造测试表明：单一项均不提升原始准确率，增益集中在鲁棒性与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: PACT 通过显式建模对比对数据的结构约束，在不牺牲准确率的情况下显著提升单 token 类型决策模型的校准质量、位置不变性、序数预测及训练稳定性，证明了利用数据内在结构比单纯追求准确率更有价值。

title: EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation
summary: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to recover the full state of a dynamical system that is only partially observed. A solution is to use Score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that agree with the observations. These Autoregressive Diffusion models are trained by conditioning on the previous state; however, they do not take into account the uncertainty of their past predictions. We propose a new diffusion-based assimilation algorithm that dynamically balances the confidence in the current state and the new observations. Crucially, we choose to learn the distribution of the joint state containing both the past and future. This allows us to use a modified version of En4DVar, a classical DA algorithm that relies on the covariance of an ensemble of particles. Experiments on fluid and traffic flow simulations show improved reconstruction performance, especially in situations where observations are sparse and non-homogeneous.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的新型数据同化算法，通过学习包含过去和未来状态的联合分布，结合修正版En4DVar方法，在稀疏非均匀观测条件下显著提升了流体和交通流模拟的状态重构性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的自回归扩散模型在数据同化中虽然能生成物理一致的轨迹，但未考虑历史预测的不确定性，导致在观测稀疏和非均匀时性能下降。需要一种能动态平衡当前状态置信度与新观测信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出学习联合状态（过去+未来）的分布，而非仅条件于前一状态；采用修正版集合四维变分同化（En4DVar）算法，利用粒子集合的协方差来动态平衡模型预测与观测数据的权重。
AI.result: 在流体和交通流仿真实验中，该方法在稀疏和非均匀观测条件下表现出更优的重构性能，优于传统自回归扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合状态建模和集合协方差驱动的动态权重平衡，该扩散同化算法有效解决了观测稀疏时的不确定性传播问题，为复杂动力学系统的状态估计提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence: Detecting Evidence Gaps Before Generation in RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external sources, but retrieved passages often name the right entities without providing the facts needed to answer. Even when instructed to abstain, 12 generators answer 40.0-99.3% of insufficient-evidence questions. Training generators to abstain ties the decision to model weights, may reward answers recalled from parametric knowledge, and still requires a full generator call. Can sufficiency be judged from the question and evidence alone, before any answer exists? We identify pitfalls in constructing insufficient-evidence tests: removing relevant evidence or pairing evidence with unrelated questions can reveal labels through lexical overlap or evidence position. We build a paired benchmark using substitution, deletion, and question-swap constructions that vary answer support while controlling selected surface features, such as word use. Sufficiency can be judged without generating an answer, but no single signal works across all datasets. We introduce RINSE (Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence), which combines three signals: whether every part of the question is covered, whether any passage offers an answer, and whether a small language model reading the passages together judges them sufficient. Across six datasets, RINSE ranks sufficient above insufficient evidence with a score of 0.837 (chance 0.5), exceeding the best of 10 prior methods (0.746) and a frontier model queried through an API (0.784). Its weakest dataset scores higher than any other method's weakest (0.684 vs. 0.676). RINSE runs locally before generation, taking 36.5 ms per question on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RINSE方法，仅通过问题和证据判断证据充分性，无需生成答案，结合三个信号（问题覆盖度、段落答案存在性、小模型联合判断），在六个数据集上显著优于现有方法和前沿模型，延迟仅36.5ms。
AI.motivation: RAG系统中检索段落常包含相关实体但缺乏回答所需事实；生成器即使被指示拒答仍高比例回答证据不足问题；训练拒答依赖模型权重、可能奖励参数化知识且需完整生成调用。核心问题：能否仅凭问题和证据在生成前判断充分性？
AI.method: 识别现有证据不足测试构建的陷阱（词汇重叠、证据位置泄露标签），构建配对基准（替换、删除、问题交换）控制表面特征。提出RINSE：融合三个信号——问题各部分是否被覆盖、是否有段落直接提供答案、小语言模型联读段落后判断充分性。
AI.result: 六数据集上RINSE以0.837得分（随机0.5）将充分证据排在不足证据之上，超越10种先验方法最佳0.746及API调用前沿模型0.784；最弱数据集得分0.684高于所有他法最弱0.676；单GPU延迟36.5ms/问。
AI.conclusion: 证据充分性可在生成前仅凭问题-证据判断，但单一信号不足；RINSE通过多信号融合实现SOTA性能且低延迟，为RAG系统提供实用的预生成拒答机制。

title: Memory Is a Derivation: The Distributed-Evidence Paradox in Long-Term Agents
summary: Long-running LLM agents compress past interactions into persistent memories that may be reused as premises for later tasks. This creates a distinct derivation problem: whether the memory actually follows from what the interaction history supports. Relevant evidence may be scattered across earlier interactions, while compression can introduce relations or event status that the history never established. A valid memory may therefore appear unsupported because its citations omit relevant evidence, while individually supported facts may be composed into a stronger statement the history never established. We characterize this problem through three coupled requirements: (1) Evidence scope; (2) Compositional validity; (3) Admission reliability. We therefore ask whether the interaction history available at write time supports what enters persistent memory. We introduce DerivAudit, a framework for auditing whether a memory is actually supported by the history available when it was written. The audit separates three questions: whether supporting evidence lies beyond writer-provided citations, whether the composed memory introduces unsupported meaning, and how write-time admission decisions affect later memory use. Across two natural memory corpora, audits using broader pre-write history recover support for nearly 60% of memories that appear unsupported from citations alone, while 17-21% remain unsupported after expansion. Yet broader evidence does not by itself make admission reliable: unsupported memories are still frequently admitted across verification models, and evidence expansion alone worsens it on two backbones.

AI.tldr: 论文针对长运行LLM代理将交互历史压缩为持久记忆时的推导问题，提出DerivAudit框架审计记忆是否真正由写入时的历史支持，实验显示扩展证据可恢复约60%看似无支持的记忆，但17-21%仍无支持，且更广证据并不使准入可靠。
AI.motivation: 长运行LLM代理将过往交互压缩为持久记忆以供后续任务复用，但压缩过程可能引入历史未建立的关系或事件状态，导致记忆与历史的推导关系不清：相关证据分散于早期交互，引用可能遗漏关键证据，且单独受支持的事实经组合可能形成历史从未确立的更强陈述。
AI.method: 提出DerivAudit审计框架，将问题形式化为三个耦合需求：证据范围、组合有效性、准入可靠性。审计分离三个问题：支撑证据是否超出作者提供的引用、组合记忆是否引入无支持含义、写入时准入决策如何影响后续记忆使用。在两个天然记忆语料库上实验，对比仅引用证据与扩展写入前历史的审计结果。
AI.result: 使用更广泛的写入前历史，能恢复近60%仅从引用看来无支持的记忆；但17-21%记忆在证据扩展后仍无支持。更广证据本身不使准入可靠：无支持记忆仍频繁被多种验证模型准入，且单纯证据扩展在两个骨干模型上反而恶化准入可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 记忆推导问题需同时考虑证据范围、组合有效性和准入可靠性三个维度。DerivAudit揭示了引用证据的不足与组合引入的风险，证据扩展虽能恢复大量支持，但无法解决准入机制的不可靠性，需改进写入时的准入决策而非仅依赖更多证据。

title: CruxBench: A Benchmark of Information Discovery
summary: Benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) typically evaluate the accuracy of answers against fixed reference labels. But a central step in many complex real-world tasks is identifying which questions are worth asking in the first place: decomposing a difficult problem into subquestions -- which we call cruxes -- whose answers provide key steps on the path toward solving the target problem. To evaluate this capability of information discovery, we introduce CruxBench, a benchmark that grades LLM-generated questions by their Value of Information (VOI): how much a model-proposed crux updates beliefs about a target forecasting question. CruxBench enjoys a rare combination of three key properties: it is (1) contamination-resistant by construction, since ground truth is generated by future world events; (2) open-ended, admitting unbounded and complex text-based submissions rather than one correct numeric answer; and (3) grounded, with informativeness measured against quantified changes in real-world beliefs. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models on 293 target forecasting questions and find that VOI correlates highly with independent measures of model capability (r=0.90) and captures cruxes' usefulness for answering target questions. However, information discovery remains challenging even for frontier LLMs, which only narrowly outperform a random-timing baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CruxBench 基准，通过信息价值（VOI）评估大语言模型将复杂问题分解为关键子问题（cruxes）的能力，发现 VOI 与模型能力高度相关（r=0.90），但前沿模型仍仅略优于随机基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多评估答案准确性，忽视了复杂任务中「识别值得提问的问题」这一核心步骤。作者旨在建立一个抗污染、开放式且有实证依据的基准，量化模型提出的子问题对目标预测问题信念更新的贡献。
AI.method: 构建 CruxBench：选取 293 个真实预测问题作为目标，让 8 个不同模型生成子问题，利用预测市场/专家概率分布的变化计算每个子问题的 VOI（信息价值），以此为评分指标。基准具备三大特性：1) 抗污染——真值由未来事件产生；2) 开放式——接受任意文本子问题；3) 落地——以真实信念量化变化衡量信息量。
AI.result: VOI 与独立模型能力指标呈极强正相关（r=0.90），且能捕捉子问题对回答目标问题的实际帮助。然而，即使最强模型也仅比随机时机基线略好，表明信息发现能力仍是重大短板。
AI.conclusion: CruxBench 为评估 LLM 问题分解与信息发现能力提供了新范式；实验揭示当前模型在主动发现高价值子问题上仍有巨大提升空间，未来研究应聚焦于增强模型的战略性提问与推理规划能力。

title: FluxLite: Inference-Time Proposal Control for Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Many inference-time tasks for pretrained discrete diffusion models and diffusion language models reduce to drawing samples from a tilted version of the pretrained distribution. Feynman-Kac sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) makes this correction exact in principle, but its prescribed weights routinely degenerate when the proposal dynamics are misaligned with the tilt, capping the practical gains from additional particles. We introduce FluxLite, a lightweight, training-free proposal-control framework for discrete diffusion. On the sparse directed graph of pretrained reverse rates, any sparse jump-rate perturbation can be exactly compensated by a $q_t$-weighted graph-divergence term in the Feynman-Kac potential; the target path is therefore preserved while the residual reweighting variance becomes a local convex objective. We instantiate this principle as two practical samplers: a one-hop local reallocation rule (HEU) and a small nonnegative quadratic program over pretrained-rate bases (D-VCG). We further prove population stability under the standard score-entropy training loss, identifying a tilted-path coverage factor that governs robustness to score error, together with finite-particle convergence for a fixed controlled Feynman-Kac recursion. Empirically, FluxLite improves over standard Feynman-Kac SMC baselines by up to two orders of magnitude in terminal KL on an analytically tractable finite-state CTMC benchmark, and reduces row-correlation MSE on 2D Ising sampling by 5-7x in geometric mean and up to 55x at peak.

AI.tldr: FluxLite是一个轻量级、无需训练的离散扩散模型采样框架，通过在Feynman-Kac SMC中引入图散度补偿项，精确控制跳跃速率扰动，解决了传统SMC权重退化问题，显著提升采样质量。
AI.motivation: 预训练离散扩散模型的推理任务通常需要从倾斜分布采样，Feynman-Kac SMC虽理论精确但权重常因提议动力学与倾斜分布错位而退化，限制了粒子数增加带来的收益。
AI.method: 在预训练反向速率的稀疏有向图上，任意稀疏跳跃速率扰动可通过q_t加权图散度项在Feynman-Kac势中精确补偿，保持目标路径不变，使残余重加权方差成为局部凸目标。实例化为两个采样器：一跳局部重分配规则(HEU)和基于预训练速率基的小型非负二次规划(D-VCG)。
AI.result: 在有限状态CTMC基准上终端KL散度提升达两个数量级；在2D Ising采样中行相关性MSE几何均值降低5-7倍，峰值降低达55倍。理论上证明了标准score-entropy训练损失下的种群稳定性，识别出倾斜路径覆盖因子控制对score误差的鲁棒性，并给出了固定粒子数收敛保证。
AI.conclusion: FluxLite通过图散度补偿原理实现了高效的离散扩散采样，在保持理论精确性的同时大幅降低方差，为推理时采样提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。

title: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals
comment: 8 pages. Participant paper for the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task
summary: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen. The confidence filed with each answer is computed by the orchestrator from what the run leaves behind and is never asked of the model, which is offered no way to rate itself. The two retrieval runs placed 4th and 5th of 22, pooling the passes was worth 0.0709 nDCG@20, and the gain was largest on the multi-hop and post-processing-heavy questions, where the organisers rank the pooled run top of the field. Sixteen of the 25 answer runs were built on passages these two runs supplied, 12 of them filed by other teams. HMR rewards a system whose confidence is high where it answers right and low where it answers wrong. The pipeline reached an accuracy of 0.9219, 6th of 25, while the confidence filed with those answers gave an HMR of 0.4915, 13th. A few rules crafted over those same recorded signals, with no further model call and no further retrieval, raise that to an accuracy of 0.9375, 5th, and an HMR of 0.6985, 9th. Ranking on HMR alone can reward a system for answering wrongly with low confidence, so we propose accHMR, the accuracy multiplied by HMR, which reports the reward in proportion to the accuracy, and on which the revised rules would have scored 0.6549, 5th. For future work, fitting a model on the numbers the pipeline already produces, rather than writing such rules by hand, would be a real step forward.

AI.tldr: BITEM团队在NTCIR-19 R2C2任务中采用单一代理流水线，通过多轮检索和编排器验证实现高质量证据聚合，在检索子任务中排名第4/5，答案准确率0.9219（第6），经规则优化后提升至0.9375（第5），并提出accHMR指标综合评估准确率与置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决复杂问答中证据检索不足、模型自我评估不可靠以及置信度校准困难的问题，通过多轮互补检索和编排器强制验证机制，提升多跳推理和后处理密集型问题的表现，同时探索无需额外模型调用的置信度校准方法。
AI.method: 采用代理流水线：模型在电影语料库上搜索、阅读、记录证据，编排器持有记录并裁决提交；引入蕴含级联验证引用段落，仅当证据充分才释放答案；每问题执行3-4轮检索，每轮从去除前几轮已见内容的语料库中检索；置信度由编排器根据运行留下的信号计算，不询问模型自我评分；后续基于记录信号手工制定规则进一步校准。
AI.result: 两次检索运行分别排名第4和第5（共22队），多轮池化带来0.0709 nDCG@20增益，在多跳和后处理密集型问题上池化运行排名第一；16/25个答案运行基于这两次检索提供的段落，其中12个来自其他队伍。初始准确率0.9219（第6/25），HMR 0.4915（第13）；规则优化后准确率0.9375（第5），HMR 0.6985（第9）；提出的accHMR（准确率×HMR）得分0.6549（第5）。
AI.conclusion: 多轮互补检索结合编排器强制验证能显著提升复杂问答性能，且无需模型自我评估即可获得可靠置信度；简单规则即可大幅改善校准，未来可用流水线产生的数值信号训练模型替代手工规则，进一步提升accHMR。

title: More Features Are Not More Evidence: Limits of Training-Free Human Activity Recognition with Jev
summary: General-purpose models promise sensor-based decisions without training a task-specific classifier, which could reduce the dependence of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) on labeled data. Yet it remains unclear whether such models can directly interpret deterministic descriptions of physical sensor signals well enough to replace or complement trained HAR models. We study this question using Jev, a fixed general-purpose probabilistic decision model, on 1,800 class-balanced accelerometer windows from WISDM, UCI341, and PAMAP2. Jev receives no labeled examples, retrieval context, or HAR-specific parameter updates. We evaluate three deterministic sensor representations and compare 5,400 Jev decisions with a generative baseline and three supervised HAR models. Jev remains far below supervised recognition, with its strongest representation reaching macro-F1 of 0.038, 0.118, and 0.089 across the three datasets, compared with 0.686 to 0.907 for the supervised models. More numerical features do not improve Jev. Instead, they reduce recognition on all three datasets, while augmenting the same numerical evidence with a deterministic semantic rendering partially recovers performance, although the experiment does not isolate semantics from the accompanying serialization and redundancy changes. Jev is fast and inexpensive to query, but its probabilities are not reliably calibrated for recognition. A post-hoc fusion analysis finds a small improvement on WISDM that does not replicate on UCI341 or PAMAP2. These results show that training-free sensor decisions depend not only on the information available in the signal, but also on whether the model can use the representation through which that information is exposed. The sensor-to-model interface should therefore be treated as part of the model evaluation rather than as a neutral preprocessing step.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究通用概率决策模型 Jev 在无标签训练下对三种加速度计数据集（WISDM、UCI341、PAMAP2）的人类活动识别（HAR）能力。实验表明 Jev 的宏平均 F1（0.038、0.118、0.089）远低于有监督模型（0.686–0.907），增加数值特征反而降低性能，语义渲染仅部分恢复。结论指出：免训练传感器决策不仅取决于信号信息，更取决于模型能否利用该表示；传感器到模型的接口应纳入模型评估而非视为中性预处理。
AI.motivation: 探讨通用模型能否在无任务特定训练的情况下，直接解读确定性传感器信号描述，从而减少 HAR 对标注数据的依赖。
AI.method: 在 1,800 个类别平衡的加速度计窗口上，使用固定通用概率决策模型 Jev，输入三种确定性传感器表示，无标注样本、无检索上下文、无 HAR 专用参数更新；将 5,400 次 Jev 决策与生成式基线及三个有监督 HAR 模型对比。
AI.result: Jev 最强表示的宏平均 F1 仅为 0.038、0.118、0.089，远低于有监督模型的 0.686–0.907；增加数值特征在三数据集上均降低识别率；确定性语义渲染部分恢复性能但未隔离语义效应；Jev 查询快且廉价但概率不可靠校准；事后融合仅在 WISDM 上微弱提升且不可复现。
AI.conclusion: 免训练传感器决策不仅依赖信号中可用信息，更依赖模型能否通过该表示利用信息；传感器到模型的接口应作为模型评估的一部分，而非中性预处理步骤。

title: Almost Human, Except When It Matters: VoxParity and the Decisions a Voice Should Change
comment: 38 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables. Code, scorer and development-split data at https://github.com/bhavik-mangla/voxparity-bench and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23008159
summary: A voice agent can handle almost every call on the words alone and still fail the few its sector's rules were written for. Emergency-call standards, fraud guidance, radio phraseology and vulnerability rules recognise that how a caller sounds, or what else is audible, can change the right action. VoxParity tests whether agents act on it. In 183 scenarios from 14 sectors, one transcript stays fixed while the audio changes (a coaching voice, a medical monitor beeping, a mayday under a radio check, noise over a drug name, a child's voice placing a bet, a frightened whisper), and with it the correct typed tool call. A words-only null test credits a system only if hearing the call moves its actions more than it moves a pipeline that only reads the words. Only 11 of the 23 systems that can also be run on the transcript pass. Descriptively, errors run toward the words: when the audio calls for protection, all 28 systems carry out the routine request more often than they over-react on clean calls (41% against 12% pooled; the words-only pipeline, 58% against 15%). Exploratory analyses place most of the leading systems' misses on cues they heard; systems beat the null almost entirely on items that state the rule; the leading systems overrule heard resignation or confusion far more often than acute alarm; and, in the models tested, describing the voice and stating the rule each recover part of the shortfall, leaving a gap on emotion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VoxParity 基准，评估语音代理能否利用副语言线索（语音语调、背景音等）而非仅依赖文本转录做出正确决策。实验覆盖 14 个领域的 183 个场景，固定文本变换音频，发现 28 个系统中仅 11 个通过仅文本零测试，整体错误倾向于忽略音频保护性线索而执行常规请求，情感识别仍是主要短板。
AI.motivation: 现有语音代理评估多基于文本转录，忽略了急救、反欺诈、无线电通话、弱势群体保护等领域中“听起来如何”决定正确行动的规则需求。需要系统测试代理是否能根据副语言信息改变行为。
AI.method: 构建 VoxParity 基准：183 个场景，文本不变而音频变化（教练音、医疗监护报警声、无线电求救夹杂、药名被噪音覆盖、儿童下注声、惊恐低语等），每个场景对应不同的正确工具调用。引入“仅文本零测试”：仅当听取音频使系统行为变化超过仅读文本的流水线时才给分。对比 28 个系统（其中 23 个可在纯文本上运行）。
AI.result: 仅 11/23 系统通过零测试。汇总错误率显示：当音频要求保护性行动时，所有 28 系统执行常规请求的比例（41%）远高于在干净通话上过度反应的比例（12%）；仅文本流水线分别为 58% 对 15%。领先系统的失误多发生在其已听到的线索上；系统仅在规则明确陈述的项目上显著击败零基线；领先系统更常覆盖听到的顺从/困惑，而较少覆盖急性惊恐；描述语音特征和陈述规则各自能弥补部分差距，但情感维度仍存缺口。
AI.conclusion: 当前语音代理严重依赖词义，难以可靠利用副语言线索做出领域规则要求的保护性决策。显式规则注入和语音描述有助于缩小差距，但情感识别与隐性线索利用仍是核心挑战，需在模型架构与训练目标上进一步突破。

title: Intrinsic Associative Memory on Riemannian Manifolds: Curvature, Capacity, and Emergent Modes
summary: Geometry does more than constrain an associative memory: curvature determines what it remembers and which states it creates. We develop intrinsic dense associative memories on Riemannian manifolds by casting memory as Epanechnikov kernel-density mode seeking. We compare geodesic and volume-corrected energies and show that curvature separates their behavior. We prove that geodesic memory always retains an isolated pattern, while corrected memory obeys a sharp Ricci-curvature threshold: positive curvature can erase memories in high dimensions, while negative curvature reinforces them. We derive geodesic capacity scalings of $q_β^{-1/2}$ for retaining every pattern and $q_β^{-1}$ for a typical one, where $q_β$ is the pairwise kernel-overlap probability. We show how overlap \emph{creates} novel memories: designed $N$-pattern configurations realize all $2^N-1$ subset modes, but random data at the storage threshold yield only a Poisson number. We establish exact one-step recall using Riemannian mean shift. In simulations, we recover the predicted curvature transition and every designed mode. On WordNet's full noun hierarchy, we demonstrate that volume correction improves low-capacity retrieval. Together, our work shows that curvature is a design variable for associative memory, not merely a property of the data.

AI.tldr: 本文在黎曼流形上发展了内在稠密联想记忆，将记忆建模为Epanechnikov核密度模式搜索。核心发现：曲率决定记忆行为——测地线记忆总保留孤立模式，而体积修正记忆服从尖锐的Ricci曲率阈值：正曲率在高维擦除记忆，负曲率则强化记忆。
AI.motivation: 研究几何（特别是曲率）如何约束并决定联想记忆的行为，超越将曲率视为数据固有属性的传统观点，探索曲率作为联想记忆设计变量的可能性。
AI.method: 1. 将记忆建模为黎曼流形上的Epanechnikov核密度模式搜索；2. 对比测地线能量与体积修正能量；3. 证明曲率分离二者行为的理论结果；4. 推导容量缩放定律；5. 利用黎曼均值漂移实现精确单步回忆；6. 通过仿真验证及在WordNet名词层级上的实验验证。
AI.result: 1. 测地线记忆总保留孤立模式；2. 体积修正记忆存在尖锐Ricci曲率阈值：正曲率高维擦除记忆，负曲率强化记忆；3. 容量缩放：保留所有模式为q_β^{-1/2}，保留典型模式为q_β^{-1}；4. 重叠创造新记忆：设计的N模式配置实现所有2^N-1子集模式，随机数据在存储阈值仅产生泊松数量模式；5. 仿真验证曲率相变及所有设计模式；6. WordNet实验显示体积修正改善低容量检索。
AI.conclusion: 曲率不仅是数据的属性，更是联想记忆的设计变量，可通过曲率控制记忆的保留、擦除与创造。

title: Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S
comment: Technical report, 14 pages. Evidence repository (reader outputs, judge verdicts, control records, judge harness): https://github.com/cjchanh/longmemeval-evidence (MIT). Re-scoring any run under the official judge costs about $1.28
summary: We evaluate an auditable long-term memory system on LongMemEval-S. Its retrieval chain uses hybrid candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, coverage-first packet compilation, and deterministic reasoning scaffolds; an LLM is used only as a replaceable final reader. The chain places all gold sessions in the candidate pool for 468/470 answerable questions and produces gold-complete packets for 462/470. With a Claude Opus reader called through an unpinned CLI alias, two 500-question passes score 479/500 and 475/500 under GPT-4o. The 72 answerable knowledge-update rows used a substantively modified scoring prompt whose effect under the official text has not been measured. The pair straddles Chronos High's published 478/500; differences in reader generation, scoring prompt, and possibly data version, plus within-system variance, establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A grok-4.6-high reader on the same packets scores 476/474, while a maximum-reasoning-effort agentic variant regresses to 461/465. The headline passes differ on eight verdict-flip rows. A second judge agrees with the headline judge on 493/500 rows (98.6%) in each pass and scores both passes 472/500; the official judge also flips three verdicts when re-scoring byte-identical pass-1 answers. Negative controls rejected a verifier that repaired three wrong drafts but broke eleven correct drafts. All components were developed on the same 500 questions, with no held-out evaluation or independent human adjudication; retrieval and scaffold method sources and transcript-derived audits are held; and the headline reader received extra operator context, its complete requests were not retained, and MCP tool availability is unresolved. We release materialized packets, scaffolds, reader outputs, judge verdicts, and controls for inspection and re-scoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了一个可审计的长期记忆系统在LongMemEval-S基准上的表现。系统采用混合候选检索、交叉编码器重排序、覆盖优先包编译和确定性推理脚手架，仅将LLM作为可替换的最终阅读器。检索链在470个可回答问题中有468个将金标准会话放入候选池，462个生成金标准完整包。两次500题测试分别得479/500和475/500（GPT-4o评分），围绕Chronos High的478/500基线。不同阅读器（grok-4.6-high得476/474，高推理努力智能体变体退化至461/465）和评分提示词差异导致结果波动，无法确立优劣。评判一致性98.6%，但官方评判重评时也会翻转判决。所有组件在同500题上开发，无保留测试集或独立人工裁决，存在额外操作员上下文、请求未保留、MCP工具可用性未决等问题。论文发布了物化包、脚手架、阅读器输出、评判裁决和对照实验供检查。
AI.motivation: 评估一个可审计的长期记忆系统在LongMemEval-S基准上的检索和推理性能，验证其检索链设计（混合检索、重排序、包编译、推理脚手架）的有效性，并探索不同最终阅读器LLM对整体性能的影响。同时强调系统的可审计性和组件级透明度。
AI.method: 采用四阶段检索链：1) 混合候选检索；2) 交叉编码器重排序；3) 覆盖优先包编译；4) 确定性推理脚手架。LLM仅作为可替换的最终阅读器。在LongMemEval-S的500个问题上评估，使用Claude Opus作为主要阅读器，GPT-4o作为评分器。对比了grok-4.6-high阅读器和高推理努力智能体变体。进行了双盲评判一致性测试、负对照实验（验证器修复错误但破坏正确草稿）、以及重复评分稳定性测试。
AI.result: 检索召回：468/470可回答问题召回金标准会话；包完整性：462/470生成金标准完整包。主要阅读器两次运行得479/500和475/500（GPT-4o评分），围绕Chronos High基线478/500。grok-4.6-high得476/474；高推理努力智能体变体退化至461/465。两次主运行在8个问题上判决翻转。第二评判员与主评判员一致性98.6%（493/500），均打分472/500；官方评判重评字节相同答案时翻转3个判决。负对照拒绝了修复3错但破坏11对的验证器。知识更新子集（72行）使用实质性修改的评分提示词，官方文本下效果未测量。
AI.conclusion: 该系统展示了强大的检索和包编译能力，整体性能接近SOTA基线。但结果受阅读器选择、评分提示词、数据版本、系统内方差影响显著，无法确立优势或等价性。评判过程存在不稳定性（重评翻转）。关键限制：无保留测试集、无独立人工裁决、所有组件在同一数据开发、主阅读器接收额外操作员上下文且完整请求未保留、MCP工具可用性未决。作者发布完整制品支持复现和再评分，体现可审计性承诺。

title: Principled Thoughts for Latent Recursive LLM Systems
summary: Large language models can reason in continuous space instead of decoded text, by recurring on their own hidden states or by passing those states between agents, while training supervises only the Cross-Entropy (CE) of the final decoded answer and does not constrain the thought. Theoretical and empirical analyses establish and confirm four failures of CE-only training that lead to a lower probability of the correct answer such as collapsing thoughts across distinct questions and retaining irrelevant information. We introduce REST (REpresentation-Supervised Thoughts), a training objective that turns four properties of a valid thought representation (causality, minimality, separability, and stability) into differentiable losses added to CE. We instantiate it in latent single-agent and multi-agent systems, without architectural changes or added parameters at inference. Across 7 benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, medicine, and code generation, with the same training data, compute, and latent budget, REST increases accuracy over CE-only training across agent settings and model sizes by up to 7.5 percentage points and convergence on a final answer by 30\%. Furthermore, REST thoughts encode more of what is required to achieve the correct answer, and decoding them better recovers the intended output of the agent, which makes latent communication easier to interpret. Project Website: https://fard-lab.github.io/REST

AI.tldr: 本文提出REST（REpresentation-Supervised Thoughts）训练目标，通过在隐空间推理中增加因果性、最小性、可分离性和稳定性四个可微损失，解决仅用交叉熵训练导致的思维崩塌和无关信息保留问题，在7个基准测试上显著提升准确率和收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可在连续隐空间而非解码文本中推理，但仅监督最终答案的交叉熵损失无法约束思维过程。理论与实证分析揭示CE-only训练的四大失败模式：跨问题思维崩塌、保留无关信息等，导致正确答案概率降低。
AI.method: 提出REST训练目标，将有效思维表征的四个性质——因果性、最小性、可分离性、稳定性——转化为可微损失加到CE上。在单智能体和多智能体潜在推理系统中实例化，推理时无架构变更或额外参数。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、医学、代码生成等7个基准上，相同训练数据、算力和潜在预算下，REST较CE-only训练准确率最高提升7.5个百分点，最终答案收敛加速30%。REST思维编码更多关键信息，解码更好恢复智能体预期输出，使潜在通信更易解释。
AI.conclusion: REST通过显式监督隐空间思维表征的质量属性，有效克服了仅监督最终答案的局限性，在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升了模型推理能力、收敛效率和潜在思维的可解释性，为隐空间推理提供了通用的训练框架。

title: Question-Specific Knowledge Graphs for Efficient Visual Reasoning
summary: Recent work in visual question answering has shown that vision-language models can exhibit strong reasoning capabilities by translating visual inputs into textual representations. The effectiveness of this translation depends on how well visual details are retained; models need to surface and align both explicit and implicit knowledge sufficient to support reasoning, without introducing spurious assumptions. Existing methods that leverage detailed image captions introduce visual details unrelated to the reasoning task, inflating input token counts and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose VisKG, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework in which models learn to translate visual content into question-specific knowledge graph (KG) representations. This process filters out perceptual noise while preserving the entity-relation structure needed for chain-of-thought reasoning, following the principle of minimum sufficient information. To ensure stable RL post-training, VisKG adopts Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). In addition, we strengthen the supervision stage with negative rationale samples, exposing the model to incorrect reasoning paths before RL post-training. Experimental results across science, mathematics, and general visual understanding benchmarks show that VisKG achieves performance comparable to or better than baselines, while requiring fewer tokens than caption-based representations. Moreover, training VisKG with GDPO improves accuracy by 2% over its GRPO-trained counterpart on average. These results suggest that KG representations are a promising approach for supporting multi-step reasoning and open up future work on adaptively selecting the most suitable representation for a given task.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VisKG，一种基于强化学习的框架，将视觉内容转换为问题特定的知识图谱表示，以支持多步推理，同时减少 token 数量并提高准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法利用详细图像字幕引入与推理任务无关的视觉细节，导致输入 token 数量膨胀和计算成本增加；需要在保留实体关系结构以支持思维链推理的同时过滤感知噪声。
AI.method: 提出 VisKG 框架，采用强化学习让模型将视觉内容翻译为问题特定的知识图谱表示；引入 Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO) 以确保 RL 后训练稳定；在监督阶段加入负推理样本，使模型在 RL 后训练前接触错误推理路径。
AI.result: 在科学、数学和通用视觉理解基准上，VisKG 性能与基线相当或更优，且所需 token 少于基于字幕的表示；使用 GDPO 训练比 GRPO 平均提升 2% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱表示是支持多步推理的有前景方法，为根据任务自适应选择最合适表示的未来工作打开方向。

title: ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision
summary: Large language model post-training generates self-generated rollouts through reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation, yet this experience is often treated as stale once the policy advances. Historical rollouts can remain compatible with a later policy while preserving behaviors that the policy no longer expresses reliably. However, they may also contain mistakes, abandoned attempts, and redundant actions that should not be imitated, motivating finer-grained selective supervision. We introduce ROSS (Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision), which preserves the full historical trajectory as context while applying loss only to selected model-generated continuations. Across domain-specific reinforcement learning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning, ROSS consistently improves upstream checkpoints and outperforms baselines across mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and software engineering. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, ROSS improves the six-benchmark MOPD average from 58.40% to 62.20% and SWE-bench Verified from 64.20% to 68.40%. These results show that self-rollout training leaves behind reusable behavioral experience that can yield further gains through offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), without additional policy rollouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ROSS（Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision），一种通过选择性监督从历史自我生成轨迹中重新学习的方法。ROSS 保留完整历史轨迹作为上下文，仅对选定的模型生成续写施加损失，避免模仿错误、废弃尝试和冗余动作。实验表明，ROSS 在数学、代码生成、指令遵循和软件工程等任务上持续优于基线，在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上将 MOPD 平均分从 58.40% 提升至 62.20%，SWE-bench Verified 从 64.20% 提升至 68.40%，证明离线 SFT 可挖掘自我生成轨迹中的可复用行为经验，无需额外策略采样。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型后训练通过强化学习和在线蒸馏生成自我回合，但随着策略更新，这些经验常被视为陈旧而丢弃。然而历史回合可能仍与新策略兼容，且保留了策略不再稳定表达的行为；同时它们也可能包含错误、废弃尝试和冗余动作，不应被模仿。这促使研究者设计更细粒度的选择性监督机制，以利用历史经验中的有价值部分。
AI.method: ROSS 保留完整历史轨迹作为上下文，仅对选定的模型生成续写应用监督损失（选择性监督）。该方法不丢弃历史轨迹，而是通过筛选高质量续写片段进行离线监督微调，避免模仿低质量片段，适用于领域特定 RL、多教师在线蒸馏和智能体 RL 等场景。
AI.result: 在数学、代码生成、指令遵循和软件工程四大领域，ROSS 持续提升上游检查点性能并超越基线。在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上，六基准 MOPD 平均分从 58.40% 提升至 62.20%，SWE-bench Verified 从 64.20% 提升至 68.40%。
AI.conclusion: 自我生成回合训练留下的可复用行为经验，可通过离线监督微调进一步挖掘增益，无需额外的策略回合采样。ROSS 展示了选择性利用历史轨迹的有效性。

title: FigAct: Turning Scientific Figures into Active Canvases for Explanation
summary: Scientific figures are designed to communicate information visually, yet MLLMs typically explain them by translating their visual content back into text. This requires readers to manually map the resulting explanations back to the figure. Inspired by how people present visual information, we introduce FigAct, a framework that transforms static scientific figures into question-conditioned visual presentations by acting directly on their existing graphical elements. Like a human presenter, FigAct generates a sequence of short narrations, grounds each narration in the corresponding visual evidence, and applies visual actions to guide the viewer's attention. We develop a hierarchical search strategy for efficient element localization, reducing token usage by approximately 40$\times$. We further train FigAct-8B using three task-specific rewards for grounding accuracy, search efficiency, and rendering quality. We further build a human-verified benchmark from figures in real-world scientific papers to evaluate the ability of MLLMs to generate grounded visual explanations. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of FigAct and show that treating scientific figures as presentation canvases makes explanations clearer and easier to follow.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FigAct框架，将静态科学图表转化为以问题为条件的可视化演示，通过直接操作图形元素生成带有视觉动作的解说，并开发层次化搜索策略大幅降低token消耗，训练FigAct-8B模型，构建人工验证基准评估MLLM的视觉解释能力。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型（MLLM）主要通过将视觉内容翻译为文本来解释科学图表，这要求读者手动将解释映射回图表，增加了认知负担。受人类演示视觉信息方式的启发，需要一种能直接在图表上引导注意力的解释框架。
AI.method: 1. FigAct框架：生成短篇幅旁白，将每段旁白锚定到对应视觉证据，应用视觉动作引导观众注意力。2. 层次化搜索策略：高效定位图形元素，token使用量降低约40倍。3. 训练FigAct-8B：使用三个任务特定奖励——定位准确性、搜索效率、渲染质量。4. 构建基于真实科学论文图表的人工验证基准。
AI.result: 实验结果证明FigAct的有效性，表明将科学图表视为演示画布能使解释更清晰、更易于跟随。
AI.conclusion: 将科学图表作为演示画布处理，结合视觉动作引导注意力的方式，显著提升了MLLM生成视觉解释的质量和可用性。

title: Causal and Interpretable Structures in LLM Compositional Tasks
summary: Large language models are able to solve tasks whose answers depend on not only individual input tokens, but also on relations among them. How is such relational information represented and processed across transformer layers? We study activations from ensembles of prompts that require inferring relationships between three tokens corresponding to a cyclic concept (months, hours, weekdays, and musical notes) to correctly predict the next token. Across model families (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral) and cyclic concepts, we find a consistent layerwise progression in how the joint dependence among the tokens is geometrically organized and causally used: intermediate layers use a joint representation based on the inferred relationship between two tokens, while later layers use a joint representation associated with all three tokens to correctly complete the task. We also find other relationships between tokens that are geometrically structured but remain causally inert in the next-token prediction.
