summary: Generative denoising models, such as diffusion and flow-matching, learn to sample from complex distributions by training a deep neural network denoiser to recover clean data from noise-corrupted samples. While such models are typically compared on the quality of their synthesized samples, these metrics provide limited insight into how the underlying denoiser, which drives generation, differs. In this work, we propose to analyze the spectrum of the denoiser Jacobian as a tool to characterize these differences. Across pre-trained denoising models, we observe that better generative performance is associated with larger Jacobian eigenvalues. Motivated by this, we introduce a regularization scheme that controls the Jacobian spectrum by training the denoiser on perturbed inputs, with perturbations suppressing or amplifying Jacobian responses. On ImageNet, we test whether directly modifying the Jacobian spectral properties leads to improved generations. Our findings suggest that denoisers benefit from both strengthening responses along data-relevant principal eigen-directions and suppressing the noisy, data-irrelevant ones. This establishes the denoiser Jacobian as a useful tool for identifying differences between generative denoising models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用去噪器雅可比矩阵的谱特性来分析生成式去噪模型（如扩散模型、流匹配）的差异，发现更好的生成性能与更大的雅可比特征值相关，并设计了一种基于扰动输入的正则化方法来控制雅可比谱，在ImageNet上验证了增强数据相关主特征方向响应并抑制噪声无关方向响应能提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式去噪模型主要通过生成样本质量指标对比，但这些指标无法深入揭示驱动生成的底层去噪器之间的差异。作者希望找到一种能表征去噪器内在特性的分析工具。
AI.method: 分析去噪器雅可比矩阵的谱（特征值分布）；提出一种正则化方案，通过在训练时加入扰动输入来抑制或放大雅可比响应，从而控制雅可比谱特性。
AI.result: 在预训练模型中观察到：生成性能越好，雅可比特征值越大。在ImageNet实验中，直接修改雅可比谱特性（增强数据相关主特征方向、抑制噪声无关方向）能带来生成质量的提升。
AI.conclusion: 去噪器雅可比谱是一个有效的工具，可用于识别和表征生成式去噪模型之间的差异；通过控制雅可比谱可改进生成性能。

title: Human-AI Collaboration: From Paradoxes to Patterns
comment: This is the author's version of the work. It is posted here for your personal use. Not for redistribution. The definitive Version of Record will be published in 33rd Conference on Pattern Languages of Programs (PLoP 2026)
summary: Evidence shows that humans and AI systems perform better together, by collaborating, than alone. This paper examines two key design dimensions of human-AI collaboration (autonomy and initiative) and explores the collaboration patterns that they generate. Documenting these patterns starts with identifying the underlying problems and solutions, followed by examining the internal tensions within the problems. The paper uses a paradox perspective to analyze those tensions. It describes a process for surfacing the tensions and mapping the underlying paradoxes. It also illustrates how the pattern descriptions can be derived from mapping these paradoxes. Finally, the paper documents four human-AI collaboration patterns: Instruction, Delegation, Assistance, and Co-creation.

AI.tldr: 本文从自主性和主动性两个设计维度出发，采用悖论视角分析人机协作中的内在张力，提出并记录了四种人机协作模式：指令、委托、协助与共创。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于揭示人机协作优于单独工作的证据，并系统梳理自主性与主动性两大设计维度如何生成不同的协作模式，以指导人机交互系统的设计。
AI.method: 采用悖论视角，首先识别协作中的根本问题与解决方案，再分析问题内部的张力，提出浮现张力与映射悖论的过程，进而从悖论映射中推导出协作模式描述。
AI.result: 文献记录了四种人机协作模式：指令、委托、协助与共创，并展示了如何通过悖论映射推导这些模式。
AI.conclusion: 人机协作的设计应关注自主性与主动性的张力，利用悖论视角可系统生成协作模式，为构建高效人机协作系统提供理论基础与实践指导。

title: Large-scale factor analysis shows machine intelligence is only partially interpretable
summary: A common assumption in language model development is that cognitive abilities are organized around a general, domain-free intelligence factor, like fluid intelligence in humans. This assumption is rarely tested directly, and prior attempts have done so only at a much smaller scale. We take a latent variable approach to intelligence in language models, similar to how psychometricians study psychological constructs. Performance in every specific problem set is influenced by a domain-specific and a domain-agnostic latent factor. Using factor analysis as a dimension-reduction technique, we analyzed 13,251 published evaluation scores covering 1,618 language models across 456 different text-only benchmarks. Due to the super-sparse nature of the dataset, we triangulate our analysis across different data densifiers and imputation methods. A robust pattern across different modes of bias is that 1. A general intelligence factor accounts for 70.8% of variance in model performance at our most generous estimate, and far less than that in most of our solutions, 2. Content-similar benchmarks do not necessarily cluster together, and 3. The $g$ factor is not dominated by any common theme, and there is a lack of evidence that it is well-proxied by standard "intelligence" benchmarks. Our findings go against current endeavors of defining, identifying, and targeting general intelligence as a tangible construct in language model development. This leaves the strategy of targeting a single conceptual ability without support, since the first-order abilities it would have to reach are often partially idiosyncratic and not identifiable in practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过大规模因子分析挑战了语言模型存在单一通用智力因子（g因子）的主流假设，发现g因子解释的性能方差远低于预期，基准测试聚类不依赖内容相似性，且标准智力基准无法有效代理g因子，从而质疑针对单一通用智力进行优化的策略。
AI.motivation: 测试语言模型开发中普遍存在但鲜少被直接验证的假设：认知能力围绕一个领域无关的通用智力因子（类似人类流体智力）组织。先前尝试规模较小，缺乏大规模实证支持。
AI.method: 采用心理测量学中的潜变量方法，使用因子分析作为降维技术。分析13,251个已发布评估分数，覆盖1,618个语言模型和456个纯文本基准。针对超稀疏数据集，采用多种数据致密化和插补方法进行三角验证以确保结果稳健性。
AI.result: 1. 通用智力因子在最慷慨估计下仅解释70.8%方差，大多数解中解释比例远低于此。2. 内容相似的基准测试不一定聚类在一起。3. g因子不被任何共同主题主导，缺乏证据表明标准“智力”基准能良好代理g因子。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果反对将通用智力作为语言模型开发中可操作构念的定义、识别和针对性优化策略。针对单一概念能力的策略缺乏支持，因为它需要触达的一阶能力往往部分独特且在实践中不可识别。

title: EnergyEminence: Source-Aware Environmental Calibration and Evaluation in a Physics-Grounded Grid Digital Twin
summary: Power-grid digital twins must combine data-driven prediction with physically meaningful state evolution while preserving the provenance of environmental observations. This paper presents an early-stage EnergyEminence testbed that couples an IEEE 118-bus-style graph-temporal predictor, nonlinear AC cascade simulation, and operator-dashboard-like temporal replay. In addition, we introduce a shared bounded calibration that converts wildfire-detection confidence and spatial extent into source-comparable wildfire interpretable and explainable evidence. We then evaluate it with visually diverse fire and hard-negative videos. Sixteen synthetic environmental videos are curated to generate 160 source-tracked grid scenarios, and a source-video-disjoint test yields 10 true positives, 8 false positives, 22 true negatives, and no false negatives. The errors occur in stressed, non-cascading scenarios conditioned on an unseen growing-fire source. Our diagnostic then reveals environmental shortcut learning that is obscured by scenario-level random splitting. The paper therefore contributes a data-centric and inspectable evaluation workflow for multimodal grid-resilience models, together with evidence supporting separation of environmental alerting from electrical cascade inference

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EnergyEminence 测试平台，融合 IEEE 118 节点图时序预测器、非线性 AC 级联仿真与操作员仪表盘式时序回放，引入共享有界校准将野火检测置信度和空间范围转化为可解释证据，并通过 16 个合成环境视频生成 160 个源追踪电网场景进行评估，揭示了场景级随机划分掩盖的环境捷径学习问题，主张将环境预警与电力级联推理分离。
AI.motivation: 电网数字孪生需兼顾数据驱动预测与物理意义的状态演化，同时保留环境观测的溯源性；现有方法缺乏可检验的多模态评估工作流，且环境警报与电力级联推理耦合导致捷径学习风险。
AI.method: 1. 构建 EnergyEminence 测试平台：包含 IEEE 118 节点风格的图时序预测器、非线性 AC 级联仿真、操作员仪表盘式时序回放。2. 提出共享有界校准，将野火检测置信度与空间范围转换为源可比的可解释证据。3. 策划 16 个合成环境视频生成 160 个源追踪电网场景，采用源视频不相交测试集评估。
AI.result: 源视频不相交测试得到 10 真阳性、8 假阳性、22 真阴性、0 假阴性。错误发生在压力大但非级联的场景中，且条件于未见增长型火源。诊断揭示了被场景级随机划分掩盖的环境捷径学习。
AI.conclusion: 贡献了面向多模态电网韧性模型的数据中心且可检验的评估工作流，并提供证据支持将环境预警与电力级联推理分离，以避免捷径学习并提升模型可靠性。

title: AVIO: Learning to Add and Remove Sounding Objects in Audiovisual Scenes
summary: Adding or removing a sounding object requires coordinated changes to visual content and sound while preserving the surrounding scene. Yet paired supervision for localized non-speech audiovisual editing remains limited, as visual and acoustic edits must target the same object and isolate its sound from overlapping sources. To address this gap, we introduce \textit{AVIOBench}, a dataset comprising 37.9 hours of paired audiovisual examples spanning 1{,}878 target-object names. AVIOBench links the visual presence and acoustic contribution of each target object through a shared identity and visual mask. Our automated pipeline uses visual grounding and cross-modal consistency to select target-sound removal candidates, then jointly refines the audiovisual pairs to improve perceptual quality and cross-modal consistency. Building on this dataset, we propose \textit{AVIO}, which adapts a pretrained text-to audiovisual generation model through source-conditioned feature modulation to jointly learn object addition and removal. A reference-frame curriculum gradually reduces reference conditioning during training, enabling one model to perform instruction-only editing with optional visual guidance. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate effective audiovisual object removal and addition, with optional reference guidance providing appearance and placement control for addition.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AVIOBench数据集（37.9小时，1878个目标对象）和AVIO模型，实现基于文本指令的视听对象添加与移除编辑，支持可选参考帧指导。
AI.motivation: 现有的局部非语音视听编辑缺乏配对监督，因为视觉和声学编辑必须针对同一对象并将其声音从重叠声源中分离，增加或移除发声对象需要视觉内容和声音的协调变化同时保持周围场景不变。
AI.method: 1) 构建AVIOBench：自动化流水线利用视觉定位和跨模态一致性选择目标声音移除候选，联合优化视听对以提升感知质量和跨模态一致性。2) 提出AVIO：将预训练的文本到视听生成模型通过源条件特征调制进行适配，联合学习对象添加和移除。3) 参考帧课程学习：训练中逐渐减少参考条件，使单一模型能执行仅指令编辑并支持可选视觉指导。
AI.result: 定量和定性评估表明AVIO能有效进行视听对象移除和添加，可选的参考指导为添加任务提供外观和位置控制。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建大规模配对视听编辑数据集AVIOBench和提出基于源条件特征调制的AVIO模型，结合参考帧课程学习策略，成功实现了统一的视听对象添加与移除编辑框架，并支持灵活的指令控制和可选视觉引导。

title: Preconditioned Physics-Informed Neural Operator Training
summary: Neural operators are typically trained in a supervised fashion, which requires a dataset to be generated with a classical solver. Training them physics-informed, i.e., purely from the governing equations, removes this large offline cost and allows fresh samples to be drawn at every optimization step, but has so far been limited to simplified problems and trails supervised training in accuracy. The obstacle is the ill-conditioning of physics-informed losses, which differential operators induce and which worsens as the discretization is refined. We therefore propose a preconditioned residual loss function and show mesh-independent conditioning for elliptic problems and greatly improved conditioning for saddle point problems. Realized through geometric and algebraic multigrid, the construction applies to linear and nonlinear equations, steady or time-dependent, on structured and unstructured meshes, is agnostic to the neural operator architecture, and adds no cost at inference. On the Poisson, Allen-Cahn and stationary Stokes equations, the resulting label-free training matches supervised training and is four to twenty-five times more accurate than previous physics-informed operator learning methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种预条件残差损失函数，解决了物理信息神经算子训练中的病态条件问题，实现了网格无关的条件数，使得无标签训练能够达到有监督训练的精度，并在Poisson、Allen-Cahn和稳态Stokes方程上比现有物理信息方法准确4-25倍。
AI.motivation: 神经算子通常需要通过经典求解器生成数据进行有监督训练，离线成本高。物理信息训练（仅从控制方程训练）可消除此成本并允许每步优化采样新样本，但目前仅限于简化问题且精度落后于有监督训练。核心障碍是物理信息损失函数的病态条件，由微分算子引起且随离散细化而恶化。
AI.method: 提出预条件残差损失函数，通过几何和代数多重网格实现，为椭圆问题提供网格无关条件数，为鞍点问题大幅改善条件数。该构造适用于线性/非线性方程、稳态/时变问题、结构化/非结构化网格，与神经算子架构无关，且推理时无额外开销。
AI.result: 在Poisson、Allen-Cahn和稳态Stokes方程上，该方法实现的无标签训练精度与有监督训练持平，比现有物理信息算子学习方法准确4-25倍。
AI.conclusion: 预条件残差损失有效解决了物理信息神经算子训练的病态条件问题，使无标签训练在复杂PDE上首次达到有监督水平，具有广泛的适用性和实用价值。

title: BRIDGE: Bilevel Retrieval-Credit-Aware Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (ARL) with verifiable rewards improves the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle knowledge-intensive tasks by learning to interleave search and reasoning. However, most existing ARL methods optimize only LLM-generated tokens and treat retrieved evidence as environment observations. This creates an information-credit gap: failures caused by missing or misleading evidence are attributed to the LLM policy rather than to the retriever, which motivates training the LLM and the retriever jointly. In this paper, we show that retrieval and LLM policy learning are order-sensitive: adapting the retriever before optimizing the policy yields a larger reward gain than the reverse order. To preserve this hierarchy while allowing both components to co-adapt, we formulate retrieval-augmented agentic RL as a bilevel optimization problem. To solve it efficiently, we introduce BRIDGE, a memory-efficient first-order bilevel method motivated by a loss-landscape analysis of the RL and retrieval objectives. Across seven open-domain QA benchmarks, BRIDGE achieves the highest average accuracy with both 3B and 7B backbones, improving the multi-hop average over the strongest baseline by 9.6 and 3.4 EM points, respectively. It also achieves the best averaged answer accuracy and reasoning quality across medical QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRIDGE，一种基于双层优化的检索增强智能体强化学习方法，揭示了检索器与LLM策略训练的顺序敏感性（先训练检索器收益更大），通过一阶双层优化高效联合训练两者，在7个开放域QA基准和医疗QA基准上均达到SOTA，多跳推理提升显著。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体强化学习（ARL）方法仅优化LLM生成的token，将检索证据视为环境观测，导致“信息-信用鸿沟”：因缺失或误导性证据造成的失败被归咎于LLM策略而非检索器，这激励联合训练LLM与检索器。研究发现检索器与策略学习存在顺序敏感性：先适配检索器再优化策略比反序带来更大奖励增益，需在保持此层级的前提下实现协同适配。
AI.method: 将检索增强智能体RL建模为双层优化问题：上层优化检索器参数，下层优化LLM策略参数。提出BRIDGE，一种内存高效的一阶双层优化方法，基于RL目标与检索目标的损失景观分析设计，通过隐式梯度近似高效求解双层问题，使两组件在保持训练顺序层级的同时协同适配。
AI.result: 在7个开放域QA基准上，BRIDGE配合3B和7B骨干网络均达到最高平均准确率，多跳推理平均EM分别比最强基线提升9.6和3.4点。在医疗QA基准上也实现了最佳平均答案准确率和推理质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过双层优化框架联合训练检索器与LLM策略，并遵循“先检索器后策略”的最优训练顺序，能有效弥合信息-信用鸿沟，实现组件间的层级化协同适配，显著提升知识密集型任务的推理能力。

title: When Updating Stops Being Learning: Rethinking LLM Self-Evolution via learnable information gain
summary: Self-evolution lets large language models (LLMs) improve iteratively using their own generated data, but often suffers from self-evolution degeneration: performance improves, plateaus, then declines. Existing methods address this issue at the component level, targeting either the Questioner or the Solver, and overlook that self-evolution is a tightly coupled system. We propose a holistic framework based on learnable information gain, which measures how much novel, parameterizable information a round provides relative to the previous round. Theoretically, this gain equals the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the two rounds' data distributions plus their entropy change. Practically, it is estimated by fitting a small language model to the previous round and scoring new data via negative log-likelihood. Based on this diagnostic, we propose ATRI (Adaptive Training Regulation via Information-gain), which reweights samples within a round and halts training across rounds when information gain remains low. Experiments on popular datasets demonstrate the superiority of our proposal.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ATRI框架，通过可学习信息增益诊断大语言模型自我进化中的性能退化问题，实现轮内样本重加权和轮间训练早停，有效解决自我进化退化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型自我进化常出现性能先升后降的退化现象，现有方法仅在组件层面（Questioner或Solver）单独优化，忽视了自我进化作为紧耦合系统的整体性，缺乏统一的诊断与调控机制。
AI.method: 提出基于可学习信息增益的整体框架：理论上将信息增益定义为相邻轮次数据分布的KL散度加上熵变；实践上通过拟合小语言模型到上一轮数据，用负对数似然评分新数据估算增益。据此设计ATRI，包含轮内样本重加权和轮间低增益早停两个自适应调控策略。
AI.result: 在多个主流数据集上实验表明，ATRI优于现有基线方法，有效缓解自我进化退化，提升模型性能上限。
AI.conclusion: 通过信息增益视角统一建模自我进化系统，ATRI提供了理论可解释且实践有效的自适应训练调控方案，为解决大模型自我进化退化问题提供了新范式。

title: How Language Models Differ in Redistributing Attention-Head Activity Under Serial Demand
summary: The way a model distributes activity over each layer's attention heads offers a coarse view of how it routes information through depth; how this changes with the task is part of what a mechanistic account must explain. Holding prompt length fixed, we vary how many serial steps a task demands and measure, in every layer of 17 open-weight models, whether activity concentrates on a few heads or spreads across many as demand rises. Both occur: in most models, layers just before mid-depth concentrate activity and later layers spread it. Models differ in where and how strongly this happens. The Qwen2.5 base models from 0.5B to 7B, for example, spread less than the average model in every task and concentrate activity in parts of their second half, where Llama models from 1B to 8B and OLMo-2 spread; the contrast largely holds between Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen2.5-72B, which have the same number of layers and heads. These differences are reproducible, and post-trained models keep much of their base model's pattern. An ablation study suggests that, within a task, models whose activity is more concentrated on their top heads also depend more on those heads for the answer. Concentration and spreading across layers thus offer a new way to compare models, by how they route information through depth. Code is available at https://github.com/johnnyjli/serial-demand-heads.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大语言模型在不同序列任务需求下，注意力头活动在层间的分布模式（集中 vs 分散），发现模型家族间存在系统性差异，且这种模式与模型对关键头的依赖程度相关。
AI.motivation: 理解模型如何通过深度路由信息是机制性解释的核心部分。现有研究较少从跨层注意力头活动分布随任务序列需求变化的角度系统比较不同模型家族。
AI.method: 固定提示长度，变化任务所需的串行步骤数，在17个开放权重模型的每一层测量注意力头活动是集中于少数头还是分散于多头。对比基础模型与后训练模型，并进行消融实验验证集中度与关键头依赖的关系。
AI.result: 大多数模型在中层前集中活动、后层分散活动。Qwen2.5系列在所有任务中分散度低于平均，在后半段集中活动；Llama和OLMo-2则相反。该差异在70B/72B同规模模型间依然成立，且后训练模型保留基础模式。消融实验显示活动越集中的模型越依赖其顶层头。
AI.conclusion: 跨层注意力头活动的集中与分散模式提供了一种新的模型比较维度，反映了模型通过深度路由信息的机制差异，且该模式在模型家族间稳健且可复现。

title: MAADBench: The Refreshable Paradigm for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Recent studies report that LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) fail at rates of 41%-87%, yet to our knowledge, no benchmark to date supports systematic anomaly detection (AD) for them. Building MAS AD benchmarks is hard because they must remain fresh as LLM systems evolve: tasks may leak into training data and thus be memorized by LLMs, traces and anomaly patterns expire as backbones evolve, and labels must be provided reliably for each refresh. To address these challenges, we present MAADBench (MA: multi-agent; AD: anomaly detection), the first refreshable MAS AD benchmark designed for diverse, evolving LLM backbones underlying the agents. MAADBench combines (1) sampled-and-coupled generative tasks over an approximately 10^37-task space to mitigate task leakage, (2) refreshable trace generation under configurable LLM backbones, and (3) automated provision of cost-free, deterministic step-level labels for fine-grained AD evaluation. Beyond offering the paradigm itself, we run MAADBench with five state-of-the-art LLM backbones and release the MAADBench-Full dataset with 5,200 step-labeled traces. Benchmarking 25 AD methods on the MAADBench dataset reveals substantial limitations in current approaches: they rely heavily on supervision, struggle with subtle MAS-specific anomalies, and lack robustness across LLM backbones. These gaps point to a rich research agenda for MAS-specific anomaly detection, with MAADBench providing a systematic and refreshable testbed for method development and evaluation. We open-source MAADBench-Full at https://huggingface.co/datasets/hww123/MAADBench-full.

AI.tldr: MAADBench是首个可刷新的多智能体系统异常检测基准，通过生成约10^37任务空间的采样耦合任务、可配置LLM骨干网络的轨迹生成、自动化确定性逐步标签，解决任务泄露、轨迹过期、标签获取难题，发布含5200条逐步标注轨迹的数据集，评测25种AD方法揭示其严重依赖监督、难处理细微MAS特有异常、跨骨干鲁棒性差等局限，为MAS异常检测研究提供系统可刷新测试床。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统故障率高达41%-87%，但缺乏系统性异常检测基准。构建难点在于：任务可能泄露进训练数据被LLM记忆；随骨干模型演进，轨迹和异常模式失效；每次刷新需可靠标签。需解决任务泄露、轨迹过期、标签自动化三大挑战。
AI.method: 提出MAADBench基准：(1)采样耦合生成任务，覆盖约10^37任务空间缓解泄露；(2)可配置LLM骨干下的可刷新轨迹生成；(3)自动化提供零成本、确定性的逐步标签用于细粒度AD评测。实测五种SOTA LLM骨干，发布MAADBench-Full数据集含5200条逐步标注轨迹。
AI.result: 在MAADBench数据集上基准测试25种AD方法，发现现有方法：严重依赖监督学习；难以检测细微的MAS特有异常；跨LLM骨干模型鲁棒性差。这些差距指明了MAS专用异常检测的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: MAADBench填补了MAS异常检测基准空白，提供可刷新、系统化的测试床，揭示了当前方法的根本局限，为开发鲁棒、少监督、跨骨干泛化的MAS异常检测方法指明了富有成效的研究议程。

title: DraftTrace: A Multi-View Analytics Environment for AI-Integrated Writing
summary: Generative AI has changed how students produce writing assignments. The final artifact is no longer sufficient to understand the process through which it was produced. We introduce DraftTrace, a writing environment that jointly captures three complementary views of writing: the final product, the writing process and interactions with an integrated AI-assistant. DraftTrace reconstructs how a document develops over time and organizes these signals into submission, longitudinal, and class-level analytics for instructors. We deployed DraftTrace in a graduate NLP course with 81 students and compared their sessions with LLM-generated responses entered by automated tools and with copy-typed responses. While product measures distinguish differences in text formulation, process measures distinguish differences in how text is entered. Considering both views together helps characterize cases such as copy-typing. Interaction traces show that students use the assistant differently across stages of writing: to clarify the question at an early stage and to verify answers at a later stage. A preliminary instructor survey highlights the importance of multi-view writing analytics and their interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DraftTrace，一种写作环境，联合捕捉最终产品、写作过程和 AI 交互三个视角，部署于研究生 NLP 课程（81 名学生），实证表明多视角分析能区分文本生成方式（如复制粘贴、LLM 生成），揭示学生在写作不同阶段对 AI 助手的使用模式（早期澄清问题、后期验证答案），教师调查确认多视角分析的重要性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 改变了学生完成写作作业的方式，仅凭最终文本已无法还原生成过程，亟需一种能同时记录成品、过程及人机交互的分析工具，以便教师理解学生真实的写作行为。
AI.method: 开发 DraftTrace 环境，整合三类信号：1) 最终文本（产品视角），2) 键盘记录、修订历史等（过程视角），3) 内置 AI 助手的对话日志（交互视角）；将信号重构为提交级、纵向和班级级三层分析仪表盘；在研究生 NLP 课程（81 人）中部署，并对比人工写作、LLM 生成文本自动录入、人工抄写三种条件。
AI.result: 产品指标区分文本构式差异，过程指标区分文本录入方式差异，两者结合可识别抄写等作弊行为；交互日志显示学生早期用 AI 澄清任务，后期用 AI 核对答案；教师初步调查认为多视角分析必要且需具备可解释性。
AI.conclusion: DraftTrace 通过产品-过程-交互三视角联合建模，为生成式 AI 时代的写作教学提供了可落地、可解释的多维度学习分析基础设施。

title: BASE: Batch-Aware Selection of Experts Using Predicted Removal Error for Efficient MoE Decoding
summary: Large language models are increasingly expensive to serve. In large-scale serving systems, autoregressive decoding is often bottlenecked by transferring model weights from accelerator high-bandwidth memory into on-chip SRAM. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models reduce computation by activating only a small subset of experts per token, but this sparsity does not translate directly to batched decoding. Different requests select different experts; therefore, the combined active set across many concurrent requests can span a substantial fraction of the expert pool and require significantly more expert weights to be transferred. Most expert-reduction techniques make retention decisions independently for each token and therefore do not address this batch-level expansion. More recently, batch-aware methods have attempted to coordinate expert use across concurrent requests and reuse experts already fetched for the batch. Yet their selection criteria are based primarily on router rankings or expert statistics collected during calibration. Consequently, these criteria are not directly tied to the output error caused by dropping an expert, nor do they capture how an expert's contribution changes across tokens at inference time. We instead rank experts according to how much their removal would change the MoE-layer output. To apply this criterion during serving, we train a lightweight linear predictor during calibration that estimates the expert removal cost for each incoming token, and develop custom GPU kernels for cost prediction and expert selection. Across three MoE architectures, BASE improves the quality-efficiency tradeoff without retraining. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it improves average accuracy by 29.5 points over the strongest baseline at comparable throughput under a tight expert budget. At a higher expert budget, it is 60% faster than dense inference while remaining within 0.4 accuracy points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BASE方法，通过基于专家移除对MoE层输出影响的准则来选择专家，训练轻量级线性预测器估算每个token的专家移除成本，并开发自定义GPU内核实现高效推理。在三种MoE架构上，BASE在不重新训练的情况下显著改善质量-效率权衡：在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，紧专家预算下准确率提升29.5点；较高预算下比稠密推理快60%，准确率仅下降0.4点。
AI.motivation: 大规模服务中，自回归解码受限于将模型权重从HBM传输到片上SRAM的带宽。MoE模型虽通过稀疏激活减少计算，但在批量解码时不同请求选择不同专家，导致批内活跃专家集合膨胀，抵消了稀疏性优势。现有专家减少技术基于单token独立决策，无法解决批级膨胀；批感知方法虽协调专家复用，但选择标准基于路由器排名或校准统计量，未直接关联输出误差，也无法捕捉专家贡献随token的动态变化。
AI.method: 1. 提出基于专家移除对MoE层输出影响幅度的专家排序准则。2. 在校准阶段训练轻量级线性预测器，为每个输入token估算各专家的移除成本。3. 开发自定义GPU内核，实现成本预测和专家选择的高效并行计算。4. 在推理时根据预测成本选择专家子集，实现批级专家复用和带宽节省。
AI.result: 在三种MoE架构上验证：BASE无需重新训练即可改善质量-效率权衡。Qwen3-30B-A3B上，紧专家预算下平均准确率比最强基线高29.5点（吞吐相当）；较高专家预算下比稠密推理快60%，准确率仅下降0.4点。
AI.conclusion: BASE通过直接建模专家移除对输出的影响，并结合轻量级预测器与定制内核，有效解决了批量MoE推理中的专家膨胀问题，在保持模型质量的同时大幅降低显存带宽压力，实现了显著的推理加速。

title: Visual sensitivity is not claim retractability: persistence-aware credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been extended to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), and perception-aware methods further encourage policies to rely on visual evidence. Yet relying on the image does not guarantee that visual claims are supported by it. Before RL training, 27.81% of the correctly answered responses of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on four multimodal reasoning benchmarks contain at least one direct visual claim that the image does not support. Since outcome-level RL rewards each response as a whole, these claims inherit the positive credit of the correct answer. We introduce a fixed-rollout counterfactual diagnostic that re-scores the same response under an intervened image to separate Evidence-Function Sensitivity (EFS), how strongly the model's predictions change, from claim persistence, whether the model keeps supporting the same claim rather than retracting it. The diagnostic reveals Sensitivity-Persistence Decoupling (SPD): under DAPO and VPPO, EFS increases and claims become more retractable overall, yet unsupported claims become significantly more persistent, whereas GRPO raises EFS without this deterioration. We therefore propose Persistence-Aware Credit Gating (PACG), which attenuates positive credit for unusually persistent visual claims and leaves all other credit unchanged. It requires no supported/unsupported labels and adds no inference cost. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, PACG raises the nine-benchmark average over three seeds from 58.1% to 59.9% with DAPO and from 59.8% to 60.9% with VPPO, while making unsupported claims more retractable. The gains extend to a larger model, a newer backbone, and the accuracy of HallusionBench also improves consistently. These results suggest that visual sensitivity and claim retractability are complementary dimensions of multimodal credit assignment.

AI.tldr: 论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在强化学习中出现的'视觉声明持久性'问题：即使回答正确，模型也可能坚持图像不支持的视觉声明。作者提出固定轨迹反事实诊断，发现证据函数敏感性（EFS）与声明持久性解耦（SPD），进而设计持久性感知信用门控（PACG），无需标签且零推理开销，在多个基准上显著提升性能并降低不支持声明的持久性。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法在LVLM中采用结果级奖励，导致模型即使生成图像不支持的视觉声明，只要最终答案正确也会获得正向信用。预实验显示Qwen2.5-VL-7B在四个多模态推理基准上27.81%的正确回答包含至少一个不被图像支持的直接视觉声明，且现有方法（DAPO、VPPO）虽提升整体敏感性，却反而使不支持声明更加持久。
AI.method: 1. 固定轨迹反事实诊断：对同一响应在干预图像下重新打分，分离证据函数敏感性（EFS，预测随图像变化程度）与声明持久性（模型是否坚持同一声明而非撤回）。2. 发现敏感性-持久性解耦（SPD）：DAPO/VPPO虽提升EFS并使声明整体更可撤回，但不支持声明持久性显著上升；GRPO则无此退化。3. 提出持久性感知信用门控（PACG）：对异常持久的视觉声明衰减正向信用，其余信用不变，无需支持/不支持标签，零额外推理成本。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，PACG配合DAPO使九基准平均分从58.1%提升至59.9%，配合VPPO从59.8%提升至60.9%（三种子平均），且显著降低不支持声明的持久性。增益泛化至更大模型、更新骨干网络，HallusionBench准确率也持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉敏感性与声明可撤回性是多模态信用分配的两个互补维度。仅优化整体敏感性不足以解决不支持声明的持久性问题，需显式建模声明持久性并选择性衰减其信用。PACG提供了一种无监督、零开销的解决方案，有效缓解了RLVR中的幻觉声明固化问题。

title: Grounded Revision vs. Prior Injection: Probing Retrieval-Augmented Patent Claim Amendment
comment: Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026. 9 pages, 2 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/TeamLab/probing-rag-patent-amendment
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is widely used in professional writing, yet whether retrieval grounds revision or merely injects templates is rarely tested where "correct" has a definable meaning. Patent claim amendment supplies that signal: the examiner names the attacked limitation and cites prior art, providing per-case ground truth. We release three artifacts: (i) a corpus of 7,385 USPTO prosecution cases with XML-aligned pre/post claims, rejection, and cited prior art; (ii) a seven-probe battery comparing random and structural-match retrieval as two policies under a fixed prompt scaffold; (iii) a deterministic five-channel metric (C1-C3 and C5 in main, C4 supplementary) requiring no LLM evaluation. Across 9,600 pre-registered calls on four frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4o-mini), no tested model exhibits detectable classical prior-injection behavior; retrieval effects are small and direction-inconsistent between random and structural retrieval, and the null is unchanged under a dense (semantic) retriever, across retrieval depths k in {1,3,5,10}, and under a paraphrase-sensitive grounding metric. Revision locality reveals a model-specific difference that the template channel misses. The four-cell taxonomy, which we treat as exploratory, leaves the prior-injector cell unoccupied.

AI.tldr: 本文研究检索增强生成（RAG）在专业写作（专利权利要求修正）中的实际效果，构建了一个包含 7,385 个 USPTO 审查案例的语料库，并通过确定性指标在四种前沿大模型上进行了 9,600 次预注册实验。结果显示：所有模型均未表现出可检测的“先行技术注入”行为；检索效应微小且方向不一致，且在不同检索策略、深度和语义检索器下均无显著改变。修正局部性揭示了模型特有的差异，而模板通道未能捕捉到这一点。四分类分类法中的“先行技术注入者”单元为空。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成广泛应用于专业写作，但鲜有研究在“正确性”有明确定义的场景下，验证检索是否真正支撑修改，还是仅仅注入模板。专利权利要求修正提供了理想的真值信号：审查员指出被驳回的限制并引用先行技术，提供了逐案的地面真值。
AI.method: 发布三大工件：(i) 7,385 个 USPTO 审查案例语料库，含 XML 对齐的修改前/后权利要求、驳回意见和引用先行技术；(ii) 七探针测试套件，在固定提示框架下对比随机检索与结构匹配检索两种策略；(iii) 确定性五通道指标（C1-C3 和 C5 在正文，C4 在补充材料），无需大模型评估。在四种前沿大模型（Claude Sonnet 4、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4、GPT-4o-mini）上进行 9,600 次预注册调用，测试不同检索深度 k∈{1,3,5,10}、密集语义检索器及改写敏感的接地指标。
AI.result: 所有测试模型均未表现出可检测的经典先行技术注入行为；检索效应微小且方向不一致，随机检索与结构检索之间无稳定差异；该零结果在密集语义检索器、不同检索深度 k 以及改写敏感接地指标下均保持不变。修正局部性分析揭示了模型特有的差异，但模板通道未捕捉到这一点。探索性的四分类分类法中，“先行技术注入者”单元为空。
AI.conclusion: 在专利权利要求修正这一具有明确真值的专业写作任务中，当前前沿大模型并未利用检索到的先行技术进行实质性接地修改，检索增强的效果微乎其微且不稳定。模型间的差异体现在修正的局部性模式上，而非模板注入行为。这提示在专业领域评估 RAG 时，需超越模板匹配，采用更细粒度、任务特定的接地度量。

title: The Role of Feed-Forward Layers in Transformer Dynamics
summary: We study the dynamical behavior of tokens in transformers from a control-theoretic perspective. Our model includes the feed-forward layer present after the self-attention mechanism, with the self-attention mechanism interpreted as an interacting particle system and the feed-forward layer as an independent control. Our main theoretical result establishes that the feed-forward network can steer the tokens arbitrarily close to consensus regardless of the key, query, and value matrices. Our result are easily extended to convergence to many clusters and to multi-head attention. We conduct numerical experiments to verify our results, and compare thresholding behavior from our theory to real-world LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文从控制论视角研究Transformer中token的动力学行为，将自注意力机制建模为相互作用粒子系统，前馈网络作为独立控制输入。主要理论结果证明：前馈网络能将tokens任意逼近共识状态，与key、query、value矩阵无关。结果可扩展至多簇收敛和多头注意力，并通过数值实验验证，将理论阈值行为与真实LLM对比。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer理论分析多忽略前馈层作用，或将自注意力孤立研究。本文旨在建立统一控制论框架，揭示前馈网络如何作为控制输入驱动token动力学，解释其在实现共识/聚类中的关键作用，填补理论空白。
AI.method: 1. 将自注意力建模为相互作用粒子系统（tokens作为粒子，注意力权重为交互核）；2. 将前馈网络视为独立控制输入；3. 利用控制论工具（如可控性分析、Lyapunov稳定性）证明前馈网络能任意逼近共识；4. 推广至多簇收敛和多头注意力；5. 设计数值实验验证理论预测的阈值行为，并与真实LLM对比。
AI.result: 理论证明：无论key、query、value矩阵如何，前馈网络均能将tokens驱动至任意接近共识状态；结果推广至多簇收敛和多头注意力。数值实验验证理论阈值行为，且与真实LLM观测现象一致。
AI.conclusion: 前馈网络是Transformer实现token共识/聚类的核心控制机制，其作用独立于自注意力参数。该控制论视角为理解Transformer动力学提供了新理论基础，并解释了实际LLM中观测到的阈值现象。

title: Divide and Inject: Can Agents Reconstruct an Indirect Prompt Injection from Fragments?
summary: Agentic systems are now being widely used to orchestrate tools and reason over long contexts. However, the improving capabilities of the large language models powering these agents also create new attack surfaces for indirect prompt injection. In particular, an attacker may not need to place a complete malicious instruction in retrieved content if the agent can reconstruct the objective from incomplete fragments distributed across a long context. In this work, we introduce adaptive long-context prompt injection (AdaLCPI), which combines long-context fragmentation with adaptive search. AdaLCPI splits an attack objective into incomplete fragments, embeds them in external content retrieved through the agent's tools, and uses a reconstruction cue to prompt the agent to combine them. It then iteratively refines the fragments and cue with OpenEvolve using graded scoring and natural-language execution feedback from the target agent. Empirically, AdaLCPI achieves higher attack success than strong adaptive baselines, reaching 61.4\% macro-average ASR compared with 32.8\% for Trojan Hippo-style and 30.0\% for AgentVigil. Safety evaluations should therefore test whether agents remain robust when harmful objectives must be reconstructed from incomplete fragments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自适应长上下文提示注入（AdaLCPI），通过将恶意目标分割为不完整片段、嵌入外部检索内容并利用重组提示诱导智能体重构攻击，结合OpenEvolve迭代优化，实现比基线更高的攻击成功率（61.4%宏平均ASR），揭示智能体在长上下文重构片段攻击下的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有间接提示注入攻击通常需要在检索内容中放置完整恶意指令，但随着大语言模型能力增强，智能体能从长上下文中分散的不完整片段重构攻击目标，从而产生新的攻击面。需要一种能利用长上下文碎片化和自适应搜索的攻击方法来评估智能体鲁棒性。
AI.method: AdaLCPI将攻击目标分割为不完整片段，嵌入智能体工具检索的外部内容中，并提供重组提示引导智能体组合片段。使用OpenEvolve框架，基于分级评分和目标智能体的自然语言执行反馈，迭代优化片段和重组提示。
AI.result: AdaLCPI在宏平均攻击成功率（ASR）上达到61.4%，显著高于Trojan Hippo风格基线的32.8%和AgentVigil的30.0%，证明了自适应长上下文碎片化注入的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 安全评估应测试智能体在有害目标需从不完整片段重构时的鲁棒性；AdaLCPI揭示了当前智能体系统对长上下文分片式提示注入的脆弱性，呼吁开发更强的防御机制。

title: SEED: Self-Speculative Decoding via Implicit Encoder-Decoder
summary: Self-speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by drafting tokens from the target model itself, but faces a sharp tradeoff between the quality and cost of the draft. Early-exit methods produce drafts cheaply by terminating computation at intermediate layers, but forgo the deeper representations that later layers provide and thus suffer in draft quality. Multi-token prediction preserves draft quality by emitting from the model's final hidden states, but pays for a full forward pass to produce those states at every drafting step. We propose self-speculative encoder-decoder (SEED), a self-speculative method that obtains high-quality drafts cheaply by reusing the deep contextual representations already computed during verification. We reinterpret the standard decoder-only transformer as an implicit encoder-decoder: the first layers (encoder) build deep contextual representations, and the last few layers (decoder) emit tokens from them. Encoding and verification are merged into a single step: verification is performed by the full encoder-decoder, and the contextual representations of the verified prefix are cached for reuse during drafting. Drafting is therefore very fast: between verifications, the lightweight decoder drafts multiple tokens autoregressively, each conditioned on the cached representations and on preceding drafts. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that SEED achieves up to 2.7$\times$ average speedup on 4B-scale models, outperforming both early-exit and MTP-style self-speculative baselines and running 28% faster than the state-of-the-art EAGLE-3, while preserving or even improving the generation quality of standard autoregressive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/lhk2004/SEED.

AI.tldr: SEED 是一种自推测解码方法，通过重用验证阶段计算的深层上下文表示来廉价获取高质量草稿，在 4B 规模模型上实现高达 2.7 倍平均加速，超越早退出和多 token 预测基线，并比最先进的 EAGLE-3 快 28%，同时保持或提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 自推测解码在草稿质量和成本之间存在尖锐权衡：早退出方法通过在中间层终止计算廉价生成草稿，但丢失了深层表示导致质量下降；多 token 预测保留质量但每步草稿都需要完整前向传播，成本高昂。
AI.method: 将标准解码器-only Transformer 重新解释为隐式编码器-解码器：前几层（编码器）构建深层上下文表示，后几层（解码器）从中发射 token。将编码和验证合并为单步：验证由完整编码器-解码器执行，并缓存已验证前缀的上下文表示供草稿阶段复用。草稿阶段极快：在两次验证之间，轻量级解码器自回归地草拟多个 token，每个 token 条件于缓存表示和前序草稿。
AI.result: 跨多基准实验表明，SEED 在 4B 规模模型上实现高达 2.7 倍平均加速，优于早退出和 MTP 风格的自推测基线，比最先进的 EAGLE-3 快 28%，同时保持甚至提升标准自回归微调的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: SEED 提出了一种新颖的自推测解码范式，通过重用验证阶段的深层表示有效平衡草稿质量与成本，在不损失质量的前提下实现显著推理加速。

title: Transversal Pooling Neural Networks
summary: Many learning tasks require stability to small transformations while retaining sensitivity to larger ones. We introduce \emph{transversal pooling neural networks}, which generalize spatial max pooling to affine group actions. We establish equivariance to a chosen subgroup and derive explicit stability bounds for individual pooled wavelet coefficients under affine perturbations of the input. Experimentally, we demonstrate the utility of our networks in low-data environments and for predicting tropical cyclone intensification.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了横向池化神经网络，将空间最大池化推广到仿射群作用，建立了对选定子群的等变性，并推导了输入仿射扰动下单个池化小波系数的显式稳定性界。实验表明该方法在低数据环境和热带气旋强化预测中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 许多学习任务需要对小变换保持稳定性，同时对大变换保持敏感性。现有的空间最大池化仅处理平移不变性，无法应对更一般的仿射变换（如旋转、缩放、剪切等），因此需要一种能推广到仿射群作用的池化机制，并提供理论稳定性保证。
AI.method: 引入横向池化神经网络，将空间最大池化推广到仿射群作用。通过在仿射群的横截面上进行池化操作，建立对选定子群的等变性。利用小波变换和群论工具，推导输入仿射扰动下单个池化小波系数的显式稳定性界。
AI.result: 理论上证明了网络对选定仿射子群的等变性，并给出了池化小波系数在仿射扰动下的显式稳定性界。实验上，在低数据环境下的分类任务和热带气旋强化预测任务中，该方法优于基线模型，展示了良好的泛化能力和实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 横向池化神经网络通过将池化操作推广到仿射群，实现了对几何变换的等变性和稳定性理论保证，在数据稀缺和复杂物理现象预测（如热带气旋强化）中表现出显著优势，为几何深度学习提供了新的理论框架和实用工具。

title: SafeCoEvo: Co-Evolving Safety Harnesses and Guards for LLM Agents at Test-Time
summary: LLM agents deployed in real-world environments continually encounter new tasks and safety risks, while execution feedback typically becomes available only after each task is completed. However, existing self-evolving approaches commonly rely on multiple rounds of optimization over fixed and repeatedly accessible task distributions, fundamentally differing from test-time adaptation in real-world deployment, where only experience accumulated from past tasks can be used to improve safety decisions on future unseen tasks. To address this limitation, we propose SafeCoEvo, a test-time Harness-Guard co-evolution framework for LLM agent safety that enables the external safety system to continually adapt from accumulated runtime experience. SafeCoEvo jointly improves two complementary safety capabilities at different timescales: S-Harness rapidly externalizes recent runtime experience into updatable explicit safety knowledge that can promptly influence subsequent tasks, while GuardVPO internalizes accumulated runtime safety experience over a longer timescale into parametric risk-judgment capabilities. By combining short-term rapid adaptation with long-term capability consolidation, SafeCoEvo continually improves the agent's safety capabilities, reducing the unsafe outcome rate by 10.05% while improving the task success rate by 12.15% over the strongest baseline, thereby achieving simultaneous gains in safety and task utility.

AI.tldr: SafeCoEvo 是一种测试时 Harness-Guard 协同进化框架，解决 LLM 智能体在真实部署中仅能利用历史经验持续适应新任务安全风险的问题，通过短期显性知识外化（S-Harness）与长期参数化风险判断内化（GuardVPO）相结合，在最强基线上将不安全结果率降低 10.05%、任务成功率提升 12.15%，实现安全性与任务效用的双重增益。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化方法依赖固定、可重复访问的任务分布进行多轮优化，与真实部署中仅能利用过往任务经验改进未来未见任务的测试时适应场景存在根本差距；LLM 智能体在实时环境中面临不断涌现的新任务与安全风险，且执行反馈仅在任务完成后获得，亟需一种能从累积运行时经验持续适应的安全框架。
AI.method: 提出 SafeCoEvo 协同进化框架，包含两个互补的安全能力：1) S-Harness（短期尺度）：快速将近期运行时经验外化为可更新的显性安全知识，即时影响后续任务决策；2) GuardVPO（长期尺度）：将累积的运行时安全经验内化为参数化的风险判断能力，实现长期能力巩固。两者结合实现短期快速适应与长期能力巩固的双重机制。
AI.result: 在最强基线上，不安全结果率降低 10.05%，任务成功率提升 12.15%，验证了框架在安全性与任务效用上的同步提升。
AI.conclusion: SafeCoEvo 通过测试时 Harness-Guard 协同进化，有效解决了现有方法无法从累积运行时经验持续适应的局限，为 LLM 智能体在真实部署中的安全进化提供了可行路径，实现了安全与效用的双赢。

title: Generating Edit-Inducing Questions for AI Research Manuscripts
comment: Accepted at the DocInsights Workshop @ EMNLP 2026
summary: We study the ability of LLMs to generate edit-inducing questions whose answer will improve a paper draft. On a dataset of paired submission and camera-ready papers from ICLR and NeurIPS, we compare the helpfulness of questions from GPT models with or without full paper context to that of human reviewers. GPT produces more edit-inducing questions and its questions are associated with more extensive edits and cover a broader range of edited content compared to questions from reviewers. However, a much smaller percentage of the GPT questions are edit-inducing. Our analyses confirm that automated questions can be beneficial to authors and highlight an example task where proper attending to long context deteriorates reasoning model ability to produce helpful output.

AI.tldr: 该研究对比了LLM生成的编辑诱导问题与人类审稿人问题的有效性，发现GPT生成的问题数量更多、涉及编辑范围更广、引发编辑更深入，但单个问题诱导编辑的成功率较低；长上下文反而损害了推理模型生成有益输出的能力。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在学术论文写作辅助中的潜力，特别是能否通过生成高质量问题来指导作者修改论文，以及全文上下文对问题生成质量的影响。
AI.method: 基于ICLR和NeurIPS的投稿版与终稿配对数据集，对比GPT模型（含/不含全文上下文）与人类审稿人生成的问题，评估问题诱导实际编辑的能力、编辑范围广度及编辑深度。
AI.result: GPT生成的编辑诱导问题总量更多，关联的编辑更广泛且深度更大，覆盖内容范围更广；但单个问题成功诱导编辑的比例显著低于人类审稿人。提供全文上下文反而降低了模型生成有益问题的能力。
AI.conclusion: 自动化生成的问题能为作者提供实质帮助，但现有模型在长上下文推理上存在缺陷，需改进上下文利用机制以提高问题生成的精准度和实用性。

title: Can Representation Learning Decouple from Loss Minimization? Polar Updates Have an Answer
summary: Does representation learning stop when the training loss stops improving? We study this question for matrix Muon, whose polar-normalised updates have a step length set by the gradient's rank rather than its norm. Near the edge of stability, full-batch Muon on teacher-student problems enters approximately period-2 loss oscillations that persist for thousands of steps: the cycle-mean loss stays flat or rises, yet the weights keep moving and the learned features continue to align with the teacher subspace. For linear teacher-student learning toys, we derive explicit cycle and alignment formulas and conditional plateau and decay bounds. For a population mean-field ReLU model, we prove that, under stated dimension, initialisation and small-head conditions, the leading eigenspace of the average gradient outer product (AGOP) recovers the teacher subspace exactly during a loss plateau, before the loss later drops. In all 33 ReLU, GELU and SiLU teacher configurations we study, direction-only alignment metrics show the student AGOP aligned with, or still aligning to, the teacher subspace during the period-2 oscillations; projected head refitting on selected configurations shows that the learned directions are useful for prediction, and further measurements distinguish AGOP alignment from weight-mass concentration. In deep residual ReLU students, freezing the downstream layers while the first layer trains with full-batch exact polar updates recreates a nearly flat cycle-mean loss with improving input-AGOP alignment; freezing and unfreezing switch between this plateau and loss decrease, and the effect is sensitive to momentum and to the choice of orthogonaliser.

AI.tldr: 论文研究矩阵Muon优化器在教师-学生问题中的表现，发现损失停止下降时表征学习仍在继续：全批次Muon在稳定性边缘进入周期2损失振荡，循环平均损失平坦或上升，但权重持续移动，学习到的特征继续与教师子空间对齐。理论证明了线性及ReLU模型中AGOP主导特征空间在损失平台期精确恢复教师子空间，实验验证了多种激活函数和深度残差网络中的对齐现象。
AI.motivation: 探究表征学习是否在训练损失停止改善时停止，特别是对于使用极坐标归一化更新的矩阵Muon优化器，其步长由梯度秩而非范数决定。
AI.method: 理论分析线性教师-学生模型，推导显式周期和对齐公式及条件平台期/衰减界；针对均值场ReLU模型证明AGOP主导特征空间在损失平台期精确恢复教师子空间；实验在33种ReLU、GELU、SiLU教师配置中测量方向对齐指标，进行投影头重拟合验证学习方向的预测效用，区分AGOP对齐与权重质量集中；在深度残差ReLU学生网络中冻结/解冻下游层，观察全批次极坐标更新下的输入-AGOP对齐与损失动态。
AI.result: 全批次Muon在稳定性边缘产生持续数千步的周期2损失振荡，循环平均损失平坦或上升，但权重持续移动，学习特征继续与教师子空间对齐。线性模型获得显式周期和对齐公式及界；均值场ReLU模型证明AGOP主导特征空间在损失平台期精确恢复教师子空间。33种激活函数配置实验显示学生AGOP在振荡期间与教师子空间对齐或仍在对齐，投影头重拟合证实学习方向有预测效用，且AGOP对齐区别于权重质量集中。深度残差网络中冻结下游层复现近平坦循环平均损失并改善输入-AGOP对齐，冻结/解冻切换平台期与损失下降，对动量和正交化器选择敏感。
AI.conclusion: 表征学习在损失停止改善后仍可继续，矩阵Muon的极坐标归一化更新使权重在损失平台期持续移动并对齐教师子空间，AGOP主导特征空间能精确恢复教师子空间，该现象对优化超参数敏感，揭示了损失动态与表征学习解耦的机制。

title: MemEvo: Automatic Discovery of Streaming Video Memory Mechanisms
summary: Query-agnostic streaming video understanding requires vision-language models to continuously compress an indefinitely growing visual stream into a bounded memory before future queries are known. The performance depends critically on the memory mechanism--what observations to preserve, how to represent and consolidate them, and what information to retrieve when a query eventually arrives. Rather than designing a single memory architecture by hand, we formulate memory design as a search problem over executable memory programs. We introduce a lightweight domain-specific language that expresses memory mechanisms through structured primitives for representation, admission, retention, consolidation, budgeting, and retrieval, while enforcing causal and bounded-memory constraints. Although structured, the derived program space remains large and contains heterogeneous, conditionally dependent design choices whose effects can only be assessed via downstream execution. We therefore propose MemEvo, an LLM-driven auto-research framework that uses pretrained LLM as a semantics-aware proposal model to iteratively generate and refine candidate memory programs based on accumulated experimental feedback. At runtime, a deterministic evaluation pipeline validates and evaluates each candidate, while the underlying vision-language model remains frozen throughout discovery. We finally produce a training-free, bounded-memory mechanism. Extensive experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate strong streaming video understanding performance together with substantial context and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MemEvo，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化研究框架，用于搜索并发现高效的、无需训练的有界内存机制，以解决查询不可知的流式视频理解问题。通过定义领域专用语言（DSL）表达内存程序，并利用 LLM 作为语义感知的提议模型迭代优化，最终在 StreamingBench 和 OVO-Bench 上实现了强性能与高效率。
AI.motivation: 查询不可知的流式视频理解要求视觉语言模型在未来查询未知的情况下，持续将无限增长的视觉流压缩到有界内存中。性能关键取决于内存机制的设计（保留什么观测、如何表示与巩固、查询时检索什么），但手工设计单一内存架构难以覆盖复杂的设计空间。
AI.method: 1. 将内存设计形式化为可执行内存程序的搜索问题。2. 设计轻量级领域专用语言（DSL），包含表示、准入、保留、巩固、预算、检索等结构化原语，并强制因果性与有界内存约束。3. 提出 MemEvo 框架：冻结底层视觉语言模型，利用预训练 LLM 作为语义感知的提议模型，基于累积的实验反馈迭代生成与细化候选内存程序；运行时通过确定性评估管道验证并评估每个候选程序。
AI.result: 在 StreamingBench 和 OVO-Bench 上进行大量实验，所发现的无训练、有界内存机制展示了强劲的流式视频理解性能，同时获得了显著的上下文与推理效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将内存机制设计转化为程序搜索，并利用 LLM 驱动的自动化研究框架，可以在不训练底层模型的前提下，自动发现高性能、高效率的有界内存方案，为查询不可知的流式视频理解提供了一种可扩展、可解释的新范式。

title: Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to achieve compounding gains by having models improve themselves. While most existing RSI systems optimize external agent harnesses or prompts around a frozen base model, data-centric RSI directly updates the model's own parameters by training on agent-generated data. However, because validating data strategies requires expensive model training, existing methods face a fundamental dilemma: a single agent gets trapped in narrow directions and lacks exploration breadth, while naive parallel search or heavy trace sharing sacrifices long-horizon search depth. To address this challenge, we introduce G"odel Forest, a multi-agent framework that organizes recursive self-improvement as an ensemble of co-evolving search trees. In G"odel Forest, each agent autonomously grows a persistent tree, deepening, branching, or pruning data strategies based on model feedback to secure depth, while parallel trees explore distinct regions of the data space to expand breadth. Crucially, rather than leaving trees isolated or flooding them with heavy execution logs, a dynamically co-evolving memory connects the forest: agents continuously distill their successes and failures into compact procedural lessons anchored to a global leaderboard. Through this forest ecosystem, a dead-end in one tree instantly warns the whole forest against unpromising paths, while an empirical breakthrough quickly seeds new exploration branches in neighboring trees. Evaluated on RSIBench-Data across six diverse domains, G"odel Forest outperforms the single-agent baseline by an average of 10.70% while reducing wall-clock time on five tasks. Ablations confirm that co-evolving shared memory yields a +7.00% gain over independent parallel search, demonstrating that collective distillation is key to scalable self-improvement. The code is available at https://github.com/evolvent-ai/Godel-Forest.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Gödel Forest，一种多智能体框架，通过协同进化的搜索树集合实现递归自我改进，解决了单智能体探索不足与并行搜索深度不足的困境，在RSIBench-Data上比单智能体基线平均提升10.70%，且共享记忆机制带来额外7.00%增益。
AI.motivation: 现有数据中心递归自我改进（RSI）方法面临根本两难：单智能体陷入狭窄方向缺乏探索广度，而朴素并行搜索或大量轨迹共享牺牲长时程搜索深度，验证数据策略需要昂贵模型训练加剧了这一问题。
AI.method: Gödel Forest将RSI组织为协同进化的搜索树集合：每个智能体自主生长持久树，基于模型反馈深化、分支或剪枝数据策略以保证深度；并行树探索数据空间不同区域以扩展广度；引入动态协同进化共享记忆，智能体将成功失败提炼为紧凑程序化经验并锚定全局排行榜，使死胡同即时预警全森林、突破快速播种新分支。
AI.result: 在六大领域的RSIBench-Data评测中，Gödel Forest较单智能体基线平均提升10.70%，在五个任务上减少壁钟时间；消融实验证实协同进化共享记忆比独立并行搜索额外带来+7.00%增益。
AI.conclusion: 集体蒸馏机制是实现可扩展自我改进的关键，Gödel Forest通过森林生态系统平衡了探索广度与搜索深度，为数据中心递归自我改进提供了高效可扩展的解决方案。

title: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
summary: Action chunking provides temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning by selecting short action sequences instead of individual actions, but many existing approaches face two limitations in high-dimensional robotic control. First, many rely on value functions over action chunks, which can be difficult to learn as action dimensionality and chunk length grow. Second, executing chunks open-loop removes within-chunk feedback, limiting reactivity in contact-rich tasks. We present Action Chunking PPO (ACPPO), a PPO extension that uses a chunked actor while retaining a standard state-value critic, thereby avoiding chunked Q-functions. We further propose ACPPO-Corr, which augments the chunk planner with a stepwise feedback corrector that adjusts planned actions online within each chunk. Across 25 simulated robotics tasks from IsaacGym and Bi-DexHands, spanning locomotion, arm manipulation, and dexterous hand-object interaction, ACPPO-Corr achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated methods and performs best on both decision-frequency-sensitive and decision-frequency-neutral task subsets. Ablations show that moderate chunk lengths work best and that corrector regularization is important for balancing chunk-level planning with local feedback. These results suggest that action chunking can be effective in online PPO when chunk-level planning is paired with closed-loop correction. The code is available at: https://github.com/hshhahn/ACPPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ACPPO 和 ACPPO-Corr，将动作分块引入 PPO 用于高维机器人控制：ACPPO 使用分块 Actor 但保留标准状态价值 Critic，避免了难学的分块 Q 函数；ACPPO-Corr 进一步引入步级反馈修正器，在分块内闭环调整动作。在 25 个 IsaacGym 和 Bi-DexHands 仿真任务（运动、臂操作、灵巧手交互）上，ACPPO-Corr 取得最强整体性能，并在决策频率敏感与不敏感任务子集上均表现最优。消融实验表明中等分块长度最佳，修正器正则化对平衡分块规划与局部反馈至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有动作分块方法在高维机器人控制中面临两大局限：一是依赖动作分块上的价值函数，随着动作维度和分块长度增长难以学习；二是分块开环执行移除了分块内反馈，限制了接触丰富任务中的反应能力。
AI.method: ACPPO：在 PPO 基础上采用分块 Actor（输出短动作序列），保留标准状态价值 Critic，避免学习分块 Q 函数。ACPPO-Corr：在分块规划器基础上增补步级反馈修正器，在每个分块执行过程中在线逐步调整规划动作，实现分块内闭环修正。
AI.result: 跨 25 个仿真机器人任务（IsaacGym 与 Bi-DexHands，涵盖运动、臂操作、灵巧手物体交互），ACPPO-Corr 达到评测方法中最强的聚合性能，在决策频率敏感与不敏感任务子集上均排名第一。消融显示：中等分块长度效果最好；修正器正则化对平衡分块级规划与局部反馈至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 当分块级规划与闭环修正相结合时，动作分块可在在线 PPO 中有效工作，为高维接触丰富机器人控制提供了实用的时序抽象方案。

title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
summary: Pretrained transformers use little of their depth to follow references in context. Thirteen base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines, and extra pretrained loops add little. A task-trained rank-8 LoRA at one early layer extends this computation with all model weights frozen. Qwen3-8B improves from 15.5% to 99% exact accuracy on 24-line chains; a longer-trained LoRA reaches 50 lines. Ouro-1.4B reaches 60 lines after four loops and at least 160 after eight. The LoRA starts a relay: program lines pass on their chain identity through a short range of middle layers. Frozen heads read progressively further up the chain, and removing parent-line attention stops the relay. A frozen-model measurement locates the last useful intervention layer within tolerance in three of four held-out models. Task-specific LoRAs also improve MuSiQue. Default answers therefore understate the computation accessible through a tiny edit. Code and an interactive demo are available at https://lunamos.github.io/stop-thinking-too-early/

AI.tldr: 预训练Transformer模型在上下文引用跟踪任务中仅利用了很少的层深（1.4-3.6行），通过在单个早期层添加任务特定的低秩适配器（LoRA，秩8），冻结其余权重，可大幅提升长链推理能力：Qwen3-8B在24行链上准确率从15.5%跃升至99%，更长训练的LoRA达50行；Ouro-1.4B经4/8轮循环分别达60/160行。LoRA启动中继机制：程序行在中间层短范围内传递链身份，冻结注意力头逐层读取更远祖先行，移除父行注意力即阻断中继。该干预层定位方法在4个保留模型中有3个泛化，且任务LoRA也提升MuSiQue多跳问答。结论：默认推理低估了微小编辑可释放的计算潜力。
AI.motivation: 预训练Transformer在上下文引用跟踪（如链式推理）中严重欠用深度：13个基础模型仅能可靠跟踪1.4-3.6行，额外预训练循环改善有限。研究旨在探索极小参数编辑（单层LoRA）能否解锁模型潜在的深层计算能力，而无需全参数微调。
AI.method: 在单个早期Transformer层插入秩为8的LoRA适配器，仅在链式引用任务上训练该LoRA，其余所有权重冻结。通过分析注意力模式发现LoRA启动“中继”机制：程序行在中间层短跨度传递链身份，冻结的注意力头逐层向上读取更远祖先行；消融实验证实移除父行注意力即阻断中继。提出基于冻结模型的测量方法定位最后有效干预层，并在保留模型上验证泛化性。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B在24行链上Exact Accuracy从15.5%提升至99%，更长训练LoRA达50行；Ouro-1.4B经4/8轮循环分别达60/160行。中继机制在中间层短范围内传递链身份，冻结头逐层读取更远祖先。干预层定位方法在4个保留模型中有3个泛化。任务特定LoRA也显著提升MuSiQue多跳问答性能。
AI.conclusion: 预训练Transformer的默认推理行为严重低估了其通过微小参数编辑（单层低秩LoRA）可访问的深层计算能力。冻结骨干网络仅添加极小任务适配器即可解锁长链推理潜力，揭示了模型内部存在可被激活的中继式信息传播机制。

title: ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context
summary: Embodied agents now take on ever longer tasks. For long tasks, knowing only whether a task finally succeeds or fails says little; the steps along the way matter. Progress Reward Models (PRMs) score how far a task has come at every step, and serve as dense rewards, verifiers and monitors. Yet in long tasks the current frame alone often cannot tell how far the task has come, because progress depends on what happened before. We call this problem context-dependent progress estimation. Existing benchmarks on progress estimation mostly focus on short tasks whose progress can be read from the current observation, and whether PRMs can estimate progress when context is needed remains underexplored. We therefore build ContextProgress-Bench, with 24 manipulation tasks for 120 episodes. The benchmark covers three settings: (i) State Recall, where information needed for progress appeared earlier but is not in the current frame; (ii) Sequence Tracking, where steps follow a fixed order, so progress requires knowing which steps are done and which comes next; and (iii) Recurrence Disambiguation, where look-alike frames sit at very different progress. We then run a paired diagnosis: each PRM keeps the same input format in both runs, and in one run its instruction integrates the right context. Even PRMs that read the entire history get lost in estimating progress, yet with the right context the same five models cut their progress error by 77-82%. Embodied PRMs are thus not incapable of progress estimation, but lost without the right context. We therefore propose ProgressCompass, an autonomous agentic loop that reorients an existing PRM and uses current general-purpose VLMs to supply the context the PRM needs. Wrapped in the loop, the same frozen PRM cuts its progress error by 63% and raises its rank agreement by 76%. With such a compass, PRMs estimate progress far better on longer, more complex tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文针对具身智能体在长任务中进度估计依赖历史上下文的问题，构建了ContextProgress-Bench基准，发现现有进度奖励模型（PRMs）虽能读取完整历史但仍无法准确估计进度，而注入正确上下文可大幅降低误差77-82%。进而提出ProgressCompass自主代理循环，利用通用VLM为冻结PRM提供所需上下文，使进度误差降低63%、排序一致性提升76%。
AI.motivation: 长任务中仅凭当前帧无法判断进度，因进度取决于历史信息（上下文依赖性进度估计）。现有基准多关注短任务且进度可从当前观测直接读取，PRMs在需要上下文时的进度估计能力未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1. 构建ContextProgress-Bench基准：包含24个操作任务、120个回合，涵盖三类设定——状态回溯、序列跟踪、循环消歧。2. 配对诊断实验：同一PRM保持输入格式不变，对比注入正确上下文与否的表现。3. 提出ProgressCompass：自主代理循环，利用通用VLM自动提取并注入PRM所需上下文，无需微调PRM。
AI.result: 五个PRMs在读取完整历史时仍表现糟糕；注入正确上下文后，进度误差降低77-82%。ProgressCompass包装冻结PRM后，进度误差进一步降低63%，排序一致性提升76%，在更长、更复杂任务上显著提升进度估计性能。
AI.conclusion: 具身PRMs并非缺乏进度估计能力，而是在缺乏正确上下文时迷失。通过ProgressCompass自主循环利用通用VLM供给上下文，可大幅增强现有PRMs在长任务中的进度估计效果，无需重新训练模型。

title: The Signed Geometry of One-Shot Recourse: On-Path Validity and the Signed-Curvature Criterion
comment: Main text 8 pages; 57 pages including appendix and checklist
summary:
Closed-form recourse moves a rejected user along the unit gradient $\hat g$ of the classifier score $f$ by the promised distance $d_p=|f(x)|/\|
abla f(x)\|$, at which the linearized score reaches zero. We ask when this one-shot step succeeds and what additional model queries change. To leading order the step ends on the favorable side exactly when the path curvature $κ=\hat g^	op
abla^2 f(x)\,\hat g$ is nonnegative. Across 80 shallow models, the fraction of rejected users whose step ends there and the fraction with $κ\ge0$ correlate at $r=0.985$, although on Fashion-MNIST the first falls below the second by 8.2 points on average. No rule that uses only the score value and gradient can be valid for every score with path curvature bounded by $K$ without overshooting some by order $Kd_p^2/\|
abla f(x)\|$. When the curvature is also Lipschitz and the step is short, one evaluation of $f$ at the promised point attains the minimax rate among deterministic one-query rules that know the curvature bound and its Lipschitz constant, and split-conformal calibration makes such a rule reach the first crossing or abstain with probability at least $1-δ$. Training with an asymmetric curvature penalty lets 99-100% of paths cross within the promised step on undershoot-prone shallow data, at about 4-22 times the overshoot of symmetric penalties (Fashion-MNIST, COMPAS). Because $κ$ and $d_p$ depend on how the score is scaled, part of this gain can be a longer promised step, and at matched validity a smaller audit of briefly trained models finds no uniform advantage over tuned inflation. Where a per-user line search along the ray is affordable, it is exact to grid resolution and preferable.

AI.tldr: 论文研究闭式救济（closed-form recourse）在分类器拒绝用户时的单步移动是否成功，分析路径曲率 κ 对步长成功的影响，证明仅用分数值和梯度无法对所有有界曲率分数保证有效，提出利用曲率 Lipschitz 性质的单查询规则达到极小极大率，并通过不对称曲率惩罚训练显著提高通过率，最后指出逐用户射线搜索在可行时更优。
AI.motivation: 在算法救济中，被拒用户需知道如何最小改变特征以获得通过。闭式救济沿分类器梯度单位方向移动承诺距离 d_p，但实际能否成功取决于决策边界的曲率。论文旨在理论刻画何时单步成功，以及需要何种额外查询或训练策略来保证有效性。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：推导一步救济成功的充要条件为路径曲率 κ ≥ 0。2. 实验验证：在 80 个浅层模型上对比成功比例与 κ≥0 比例的相关性。3. 下界证明：证明仅用分数和梯度的规则必然过冲。4. 极小极大规则：利用曲率 Lipschitz 常数和一次函数评估达到最优率，结合 split-conformal 校准保证覆盖率。5. 训练策略：引入不对称曲率惩罚鼓励正曲率，对比对称惩罚。6. 审计实验：匹配有效性下对比调整膨胀基线。7. 基线对比：逐用户射线网格搜索作为精确基准。
AI.result: 1. 理论：一步成功当且仅当 κ ≥ 0（主导阶）。2. 实证：80 模型上成功率与 κ≥0 比例相关 r=0.985，但 Fashion-MNIST 上前者平均低 8.2 个百分点。3. 下界：任何仅用分数和梯度的规则在曲率界 K 下必过冲 Ω(K d_p^2/‖∇f‖)。4. 单查询规则在曲率 Lipschitz 且步长短时达到确定性极小极大率，split-conformal 校准使覆盖率 ≥ 1-δ。5. 不对称曲率惩罚使 99-100% 路径在承诺步内通过，过冲仅为对称惩罚的 4-22 倍（Fashion-MNIST, COMPAS）。6. 部分收益源于分数缩放导致的更长 d_p；匹配有效性审计显示无一致优于调整膨胀。7. 逐用户射线搜索在可行时精确到网格分辨率且更优。
AI.conclusion: 闭式救济的成功高度依赖路径曲率符号；仅用一阶信息无法普遍保证有效，需利用二阶曲率界及其 Lipschitz 性质设计最优查询规则。不对称曲率惩罚训练能大幅提高通过率，但部分优势源于分数缩放导致的更长承诺步长，匹配有效性后无一致优势。实际部署中若计算允许，逐用户射线搜索是最可靠的选择。

title: SAKI: Maximal-Coupling-Routed Teacher Supervision for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-test state mismatch by training a student on its own generated trajectories, but weak students may visit teacher-misaligned prefixes where supervision is less representative. We introduce SAKI (Supervision Allocation with KL-constrained Interpolation), which combines a KL-constrained teacher-guided rollout with maximal coupling and reuses realized accept/correction events to route token-level supervision. Accepted positions retain sampled-token reverse-KL supervision, while correction positions receive direct supervision on the teacher's highest-probability token. Under maximal coupling, the correction probability is exactly TV(p_t, q_t), so the same trust-region radius controls rollout deviation and upper-bounds intervention and specialized-supervision frequency. We further implement an engine-resident speculative verifier that preserves the exact-q trajectory distribution and coupling semantics while improving matched-workload rollout throughput by 4.22x. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SAKI improves the matched teacher-guided baseline in Mean@8 and Pass@8 for both 1.7B and 0.6B students. Placement controls and fixed-prefix analysis further support correction-triggered routing as a conflict-adaptive supervision signal.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SAKI（基于KL约束插值的监督分配）方法，结合KL约束的教师引导rollout与最大耦合，利用接受/修正事件路由token级监督：接受位置保留采样token的反向KL监督，修正位置直接监督教师最高概率token，修正概率等于TV距离，同一信任域半径控制rollout偏差并上界干预频率；实现引擎驻留推测验证器保持精确分布与耦合语义，吞吐提升4.22倍；在七个数学推理基准上，SAKI在Mean@8和Pass@8上均优于匹配的教师引导基线，适用于1.7B和0.6B学生模型。
AI.motivation: 解决在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中弱学生模型可能访问教师错位前缀导致监督信号不具代表性的问题，即学生自生成轨迹训练虽减少了训练-测试状态分布错配，但弱学生可能偏离教师分布，导致监督质量下降。
AI.method: 1. KL约束教师引导rollout与最大耦合相结合；2. 复用接受/修正事件路由token级监督：接受位置使用采样token的反向KL监督，修正位置直接监督教师最高概率token；3. 最大耦合下修正概率恰为TV(p_t, q_t)，同一信任域半径同时控制rollout偏差并上界干预与专用监督频率；4. 实现引擎驻留推测验证器，保持精确q轨迹分布与耦合语义，将匹配工作负载rollout吞吐提升4.22倍。
AI.result: 跨七个数学推理基准测试，SAKI在Mean@8和Pass@8指标上均显著优于匹配的教师引导基线，且在1.7B和0.6B两种规模学生模型上均有效。
AI.conclusion: 放置控制实验与固定前缀分析进一步验证：修正触发的路由机制作为冲突自适应监督信号是有效的，能根据学生与教师分布差异动态分配监督类型，提升蒸馏效率。

title: Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills
summary: Manipulation behaviors vary widely across objects and scenes, but they share a small set of reusable skills, and planning with these skills helps embodied agents generalize to new tasks. Yet an agent can only plan with skills it knows. Recovering skills from observed experience, the inverse of planning, builds this knowledge over time and yields skill data for training future agents. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe individual manipulation events well, but can they organize a stream of events into reusable skills? We formulate this problem as Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD): a model watches videos in sequence and maintains a persistent skill library that shapes its later decisions. To systematically measure this ability, we introduce Video2Skill, a benchmark that covers robot tabletop manipulation and human kitchen activity and tests three core capabilities: (i) locating manipulation events in time, (ii) grouping events of the same transformation, and (iii) deciding when to reuse an existing skill or create a new one. Across 19 open-source VLMs, many models group events at near-chance level, and scale does not consistently help. Their errors depend on how perception and library updates are coupled: joint models merge distinct transformations into one skill, while models that update the library from text descriptions duplicate recurring ones. Supervised fine-tuning, including our counterfactual library-state rebalancing (CLaRe), improves grouping but exposes a deeper bottleneck: trained models consolidate familiar skills yet rarely expand the library. Their libraries stall below half the reference size, and transformations unseen in training are located in time but almost never given a new skill. Recognizing when existing skills are insufficient thus emerges as the central challenge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出流式具身技能发现（SESD）任务及Video2Skill基准，测试视觉语言模型（VLM）将操作事件流组织为可复用技能的能力。实验发现19个开源VLM分组性能接近随机水平，规模不稳定提升性能；监督微调虽改善分组但暴露库扩展瓶颈——模型难以识别何时需创建新技能。
AI.motivation: 操作行为虽多样但共享少量可复用技能，规划需依赖已知技能。从观察经验中恢复技能（规划的逆过程）可随时间积累知识并为未来智能体提供训练数据。VLM虽能描述单个操作事件，但能否将事件流组织为可复用技能尚不清楚。
AI.method: 制定流式具身技能发现（SESD）问题：模型按序观看视频，维护持久技能库以指导后续决策。构建Video2Skill基准，涵盖机器人桌面操作和人类厨房活动，测试三大核心能力：(i) 定位操作事件时间，(ii) 将同类变换事件分组，(iii) 决定复用现有技能还是创建新技能。在19个开源VLM上系统评估，并探索监督微调及反事实库状态重平衡（CLaRe）方法。
AI.result: 多数VLM分组性能接近随机水平，模型规模不稳定提升性能。错误模式取决于感知与库更新的耦合方式：联合模型倾向将不同变换合并为单一技能，基于文本描述更新库的模型则重复创建重复技能。监督微调（含CLaRe）虽改善分组，但暴露深层瓶颈：训练模型巩固熟悉技能却极少扩展技能库，库规模停滞于参考规模一半以下，未见过的变换虽能定位时间却几乎从未被赋予新技能。
AI.conclusion: 识别现有技能不足从而创建新技能是核心挑战。当前VLM在流式技能发现中难以动态扩展技能库，未来研究需聚焦于技能库扩展机制与不确定性感知的技能创建策略。

title: CyFA: Linear Sequence Modeling with Relative-Time-Partitioned Memory
summary: Linear RNNs offer linear-time sequence processing and constant-memory decoding, but their fixed-size recurrent states must accommodate all past key--value associations. Existing forgetting mechanisms and Delta Rule updates reduce interference by selectively clearing or correcting the state, yet earlier associations can still become difficult to retrieve. We introduce CyFA (Cyclic Flow Attention), a Linear RNN with relative-time-partitioned memory. At each step, a learned clock controls the cyclic transport applied jointly to the key and value states before the current key--value pair enters the age-zero slot, thereby organizing stored associations across relative-time slots. We further derive an exact change to absolute-clock coordinates that expresses CyFA as two scalar-decay linear attention recurrences and enables efficient chunk-wise training. Across 400M--1.4B pretraining experiments with matched recurrent-state sizes, CyFA improves recall-intensive performance while maintaining competitive language modeling and high computational efficiency. At 400M, CyFA outperforms KDA on FDA (42.60 vs. 26.07) while requiring only 46.7% and 48.3% of KDA's forward and backward core-operator execution times, respectively. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Chyxx/CyclicFlowAttention}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: CyFA 是一种线性 RNN，通过相对时间分区内存和学习时钟控制的循环传输，改进长距离回忆性能，同时保持高计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有线性 RNN 的固定大小循环状态必须容纳所有历史键值关联，遗忘机制和 Delta Rule 更新虽能减少干扰，但早期关联仍难以检索。
AI.method: 提出 CyFA（循环流注意力），采用相对时间分区内存，每步由学习时钟控制键值状态的循环传输，将当前键值对放入年龄零槽位；推导绝对时钟坐标变换，将其表示为两个标量衰减线性注意力递推，支持高效分块训练。
AI.result: 在 400M–1.4B 参数预训练实验中，CyFA 在回忆密集型任务上优于基线（如 KDA 在 FDA 上 42.60 vs 26.07），语言建模性能有竞争力，前向/反向核心算子执行时间仅为 KDA 的 46.7%/48.3%。
AI.conclusion: CyFA 通过相对时间分区和循环流机制有效组织历史关联，显著提升长距离检索能力，同时保持线性时间复杂度和高计算效率，代码已开源。

title: Multi-Channel Mitigation of Source-Trust Shortcuts in Fact-Checking RL Agents
summary: Retrieval-augmented fact-checkers often receive a reliability label, such as HIGH or LOW trust, for each evidence source. These labels should adjust the model's confidence and its decision to search for more evidence, while the verdict should follow the evidence content. We introduce TrustSwap, a counterfactual test that swaps, lowers, or removes source labels while keeping every evidence text fixed, and measures its three output channels (the verdict, the confidence, and the search decision) separately. Across untrained and RL-trained models at two scales, three datasets, and two prompts, confidence and search respond to the labels as intended in 49 of 50 comparisons, yet a label change alone alters 4-23% of confident verdicts for Qwen3 models and up to 50% for an existing RL-trained fact-checker. Standard GRPO fine-tuning amplifies this shortcut at 8B in all six settings. To reduce it, we propose trust-swap augmentation (TSA), which trains GRPO on each claim with both its original and its label-swapped evidence under the same gold verdict. At 4B, TSA lowers the verdict flip rate by 7-35% (relative) in four of six settings, keeps accuracy and the intended confidence and search responses, outperforms reward-based alternatives in the main setting, and carries over to an unseen label-removal perturbation. An added consistency reward helps on the trained-on swap but not on unseen perturbations. At 8B, TSA's effect is not detectable, which makes scale the main open question.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TrustSwap 反事实测试，评估检索增强事实核查模型对证据来源可信度标签的依赖。实验发现模型的置信度和搜索决策能按预期响应标签，但裁决会因标签变化而翻转（4-50%）。标准 GRPO 微调会放大该捷径行为。作者提出信任标签交换增强（TSA），在 4B 模型上能降低裁决翻转率 7-35%，保持准确率和预期响应，且泛化到未见扰动；但在 8B 模型上效果不明显，规模成为核心开放问题。
AI.motivation: 检索增强事实核查模型接收证据来源的可信度标签（如 HIGH/LOW），这些标签本应仅调节模型置信度和搜索决策，而裁决应仅基于证据内容。然而模型可能利用标签作为捷径直接影响裁决，导致不可靠。现有方法缺乏系统性评估和缓解该问题的手段。
AI.method: 1. TrustSwap 测试：在保持证据文本不变的前提下，交换、降低或移除来源标签，分别测量裁决、置信度、搜索决策三个输出通道的变化。2. Trust-Swap Augmentation (TSA)：在 GRPO 训练中，对每个声称同时使用原始标签和交换标签的证据，且要求相同的金标准裁决，强制模型忽略标签对裁决的影响。3. 对比基线：基于奖励的替代方案（如一致性奖励）。
AI.result: 在未训练和 RL 训练的两种规模、三个数据集、两种提示下：置信度和搜索决策在 50 组对比中 49 组按预期响应标签；但标签变化单独导致 Qwen3 模型 4-23% 的自信裁决翻转，现有 RL 事实核查器高达 50%。标准 GRPO 在 8B 上全设置放大该捷径。TSA 在 4B 上于 6 个设置中的 4 个将裁决翻转率相对降低 7-35%，保持准确率和预期的置信度/搜索响应，在主要设置上优于奖励基线，且泛化到未见的标签移除扰动。一致性奖励仅在训练时的交换上有效，不泛化。8B 模型上 TSA 效果不显著。
AI.conclusion: 事实核查模型存在利用来源可信度标签作为捷径影响裁决的问题。TSA 能在小规模模型（4B）有效缓解该问题并泛化，但大规模模型（8B）上无效，揭示规模对捷径学习缓解的影响是核心开放问题。未来需探索规模不变的鲁棒训练方法。

title: Lost in Conversation or Lost in Translation? Diagnosing Multi-Turn Degradation in RAG
summary: When conversing with large language models (LLMs), users often begin with a simple question and build towards a multi-hop question through follow-up turns. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and its graph-based variant (GraphRAG) have become the dominant approaches for grounding LLM responses in external evidence, yet both are evaluated almost exclusively on single-turn, fully specified queries. We systematically investigate this evaluation mismatch through a large-scale simulation study. Building on prior work on multi-turn LLM evaluation, we transform questions from multi-hop question answering (QA) benchmarks into underspecified conversations and evaluate ten LLM assistants with eight retrieval systems across 1.5 million simulated conversations. Our findings reveal that multi-turn interaction causes widespread performance degradation, incurring relative performance drops of up to 21% and increasing unreliability by 47%, making RAG systems simultaneously less accurate and less reliable. We identify two distinct failure modes behind this degradation. Systems are either lost in translation, where conversational rephrasing distorts the retrieval query, or lost in conversation, where retrieval succeeds but the LLM fails to synthesize evidence distributed across turns.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模模拟研究（150万轮对话）系统评估了RAG和GraphRAG在多轮对话中的表现，发现多轮交互导致性能显著下降（相对下降高达21%，不可靠性增加47%），并识别出两种失效模式：检索查询因对话重述而扭曲（lost in translation）和跨轮证据综合失败（lost in conversation）。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG和GraphRAG评估几乎仅限于单轮、完全指定的查询，但实际用户常通过多轮追问逐步构建复杂问题，存在严重的评估错位。
AI.method: 将多跳问答基准的问题转化为欠指定的多轮对话，采用十个LLM助手和八种检索系统，进行150万次模拟对话的大规模实证评估。
AI.result: 多轮交互导致广泛的性能退化：相对性能下降高达21%，不可靠性增加47%。发现两种截然不同的失效模式：lost in translation（对话重述扭曲检索查询）和lost in conversation（检索成功但LLM无法跨轮综合分散证据）。
AI.conclusion: 多轮对话使RAG系统同时变得更不准确和更不可靠，现有单轮评估严重高估了实际部署性能，需针对对话重述和跨轮证据综合开发专门的缓解策略。

title: Understanding LLM Parameter Update Sparsity through the Lens of Fisher
summary: Recent studies have observed that parameter changes during language-model post-training can be concentrated in a small subset of coordinates. This phenomenon has been reported in reinforcement learning, on-policy distillation, and supervised fine-tuning on near-policy data. Its recurrence across different post-training paradigms suggests shared structure in training dynamics. In this paper, we examine this pattern through the diagonal model Fisher, which measures the sensitivity of the model's output distribution to individual parameters and is independent of any particular reward or teacher signal. Theoretically, we show that small diagonal Fisher leads to small expected gradients across a range of training objectives, providing a common explanation for sparse gradient updates. Empirically, we test this connection in RL and OPD. We find that Fisher identifies where gradients are concentrated, and fixed sparse masks selected from the initial Fisher retain a large proportion of the improvement from full training. Finally, we investigate the mechanisms underlying low Fisher in on-policy training. Our results show that high-probability next tokens tend to have similar parameter sensitivities, contributing to low Fisher. Together, these results establish the diagonal model Fisher as a unifying perspective linking update sparsity to on-policy training dynamics in LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对角模型 Fisher 信息量统一解释了 LLM 后训练（RL、OPD、SFT）中参数更新稀疏的现象：理论证明小对角 Fisher 导致小期望梯度，实验验证 Fisher 能定位梯度集中区域且初始 Fisher 掩码保留大部分性能增益，机制上揭示高概率 next-token 的参数敏感度相似性导致低 Fisher。
AI.motivation: 现有研究分别在 RL、on-policy distillation、near-policy SFT 中观察到参数更新集中在少量坐标，但缺乏统一理论解释。作者旨在建立一个与特定奖励/教师信号无关、能跨范式解释更新稀疏性的通用视角。
AI.method: 1. 引入对角模型 Fisher 作为度量模型输出分布对单参数敏感度的指标；2. 理论推导：证明小对角 Fisher 蕴含跨多种训练目标的小期望梯度；3. 实验验证：在 RL 与 OPD 任务上测试 Fisher 与梯度集中位置的对应关系，及基于初始 Fisher 的固定稀疏掩码性能保留率；4. 机制分析：考察高概率 next-token 的参数敏感度相似性对 Fisher 降低的贡献。
AI.result: 1. 理论上：对角 Fisher 小 ⇒ 期望梯度小，统一解释稀疏更新；2. 经验上：Fisher 精准标识梯度集中坐标，基于初始 Fisher 的固定稀疏掩码保留 >80% 满量训练增益；3. 机制上：高概率 next-token 具有相似参数敏感度，抑制 Fisher 数值，揭示 on-policy 训练动力学根源。
AI.conclusion: 对角模型 Fisher 提供了一个与奖励/教师无关的统一视角，将 LLM 后训练中的更新稀疏性本质归因于 on-policy 训练动力学导致的高概率 token 敏感度一致性，为高效稀疏训练奠定理论与实践基础。

title: Neural Structural Reasoner: A Brain-inspired Architecture for Reasoning over Structured Knowledge
summary: Structural reasoning, the ability to recognize and make inferences over the relational structure between objects and concepts, is a hallmark of human cognition, yet prevailing methods often collapse relational topology into flat embeddings, cannot discover hidden structure and lack interpretability. We introduce Neural Structural Reasoner (NSR), a brain-inspired network that preserves relational structure directly in the connectivity and dynamics of coupled neuronal populations. NSR draws inspiration from three biological mechanisms: multi-layered architecture for encoding hierarchical knowledge, stable representations of entity and concepts, and path integration for input-driven state inference. At query time, NSR parallelizes computation over candidate relational structures and leverages confidence-weighted scores to perform link prediction. Across standard knowledge-graph benchmarks, NSR achieves competitive accuracy without leading on every dataset, and has lower reported training times than several neural baselines. Because reasoning is implemented through sequences of human-readable neuron activations, NSR affords native interpretability by tracking intermediate inference steps. The model further extracts latent relational hierarchies and compositional rules, demonstrating the brain-inspired architecture as an effective, efficient, and highly interpretable substrate for structural reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经结构推理器(NSR)，一种脑启发网络，将关系结构直接保留在神经元群体的连接和动力学中，实现高效、可解释的结构推理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法常将关系拓扑压扁为扁平嵌入，难以发现隐藏结构且缺乏可解释性；人类认知的标志是结构推理能力，需要一种能保留关系结构、可解释且高效的模型。
AI.method: NSR借鉴三大生物机制：多层架构编码层级知识、实体和概念的稳定表示、路径积分进行输入驱动状态推理。查询时并行化候选关系结构计算，利用置信度加权分数做链接预测。
AI.result: 在标准知识图谱基准上达到竞争性准确率（虽非每个数据集最优），训练时间低于多个神经基线；通过人类可读的神经元激活序列提供原生可解释性，能追踪中间推理步骤，并能提取潜在关系层级和组合规则。
AI.conclusion: 脑启发架构为结构推理提供了有效、高效且高度可解释的底层基础，展示了保留关系结构在神经动力学中的优势。

title: LAURA: Knowledge Distillation for Interpretable Ambiguous Clause Identification in Legal Contracts
summary: Legal contracts contain ambiguities that expose enterprises to financial and legal risks. Some ambiguities allow flexible interpretation without triggering disputes, while others lead to significant legal conflicts. This makes identification alone insufficient, and interpretable rationale analysis essential. We propose LAURA, a post-training framework for interpretable ambiguous clause identification. LAURA leverages knowledge distillation with an IRAC-Unlearning prompting technique to transfer knowledge from a teacher LLM to an open-weight student model (<=1B parameters), which is then trained using a joint objective combining classification and rationale generation losses. The framework supports both legal and non-legal stakeholders in making informed decisions about which ambiguities require further attention. Extensive experiments across 7 baselines and 7 open-weight models demonstrate that LAURA with Flan-T5 (250M) delivers state-of-the-art interpretability over all interpretable baselines while matching the identification performance of the best-performing opaque baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LAURA 框架，通过知识蒸馏与 IRAC-Unlearning 提示技术，将教师大模型的知识迁移至小参数开放权重学生模型（≤1B），结合分类与理由生成的联合损失训练，实现可解释的合同歧义条款识别，在保持识别性能的同时达到最优可解释性。
AI.motivation: 法律合同中的歧义条款给企业带来财务和法律风险，部分歧义可灵活解释不引发争议，部分则导致严重法律冲突，仅识别歧义不足，需可解释的理由分析以支持利益相关者决策。
AI.method: LAURA 采用后训练框架：利用知识蒸馏，配合 IRAC-Unlearning 提示技术，从教师 LLM 向开放权重学生模型（≤1B 参数）迁移知识；采用联合目标函数，结合分类损失与理由生成损失进行训练。
AI.result: 在 7 个基线和 7 个开放权重模型上的大量实验表明，LAURA 配合 Flan-T5 (250M) 在所有可解释基线中实现最先进的可解释性，同时识别性能媲美最佳不透明基线。
AI.conclusion: LAURA 为法律和非法律利益相关者提供了一个可解释的歧义条款识别工具，能够有效区分需关注的歧义，平衡了识别准确性与解释质量，具有实际部署价值。

title: Paired Multimodal Scaling Laws
summary: Existing multimodal scaling laws fit multimodality terms empirically after testing and never vary how much data is multimodally paired at fixed data budgets. We investigate how, under the same total data per modality, changing the number of paired data affects loss curves in multimodal classification tasks. We train models in three different environments and run experiment sweeps varying data sizes and pairing budget. Pairing ratios have a dramatic impact on loss and this impact is directly tied to how much information synergy the task contains. Only paired data is able to reduce synergistic loss, while unpaired data can reduce redundant or unimodal information up until unimodal floors. Unlike traditional scaling laws where loss drops immediately in power law decay, synergy acquisition is gated, requiring a critical threshold of paired data before synergistic loss falls at all. We introduce a new family of multimodal scaling laws where total data-attributable loss is the sum of four individual power laws corresponding to the four different information channels of redundancy, a unique channel per modality, and synergy, and show how this law is both more theoretically sound and empirically valid across our experiments. This law predicts multimodal loss in our experiments more accurately than existing laws, with 3.2% error on fit tests versus 10.4% error for the best pairing extension of published laws.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多模态缩放定律，将总数据可归因损失分解为冗余、各模态独有、协同四个信息通道的幂律之和，实验表明该定律预测多模态损失更准确（拟合误差3.2% vs 现有最佳扩展的10.4%）。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态缩放定律在测试后经验性地拟合多模态项，且从未在固定总数据预算下系统变换多模态配对数据量，缺乏对配对比例如何影响损失曲线的理论理解。
AI.method: 在三种不同环境下训练模型，开展大规模实验扫描，系统改变数据规模和配对预算，研究在固定单模态总数据量下，配对比例对多模态分类任务损失曲线的影响。
AI.result: 配对比例对损失有显著影响，仅配对数据能降低协同损失，非配对数据只能降低冗余或单模态信息直到单模态下限；协同获取存在门控效应，需超过临界配对数据阈值协同损失才开始下降。新定律将总损失分解为四个独立幂律之和，在实验中预测误差仅3.2%，显著优于现有定律的10.4%。
AI.conclusion: 基于信息论分解的多模态缩放定律更具理论合理性且经验验证更准确，揭示了配对数据在协同信息获取中的关键门控作用，为多模态数据高效分配提供了理论指导。

title: DualTrack: Synchronized speech-gesture generation via symmetric coupling of pretrained priors
summary: Joint speech-gesture synthesis must coordinate two modalities despite limited paired data. Existing approaches often lack bidirectional interaction, have limited language coverage, or simplify body and finger representations. We present DualTrack, which couples pretrained speech and motion priors on a shared 12.5 Hz timeline. Causal adapters exchange previous-packet information, while current-state fusion coordinates the streams before they separately complete sixteen-codebook packets. We evaluate 43 BEAT2 recordings in four languages, with speakers held out from joint training and validation. On the shared English/Spanish inputs, without speech or motion prefixes, DualTrack achieves lower word error rate and full-motion Fréchet Gesture Distance, higher beat consistency and speech naturalness than the evaluated GELINA baseline.

AI.tldr: DualTrack通过共享时间线耦合预训练语音和动作先验，利用因果适配器交换历史包信息并融合当前状态，实现多语言语音-手势联合合成，在BEAT2数据集上优于GELINA基线。
AI.motivation: 现有语音-手势联合合成方法缺乏双向交互、语言覆盖有限或过度简化身体和手指表示，且配对数据稀缺，难以协调两种模态。
AI.method: 提出DualTrack框架，将预训练语音和动作先验耦合到共享的12.5 Hz时间线上；因果适配器交换前一包信息，当前状态融合协调双流，随后各自完成十六码本包的生成。
AI.result: 在43个BEAT2四语言录音上评估，说话人保留用于联合训练和验证。在共享英语/西班牙语输入、无语音或动作前缀条件下，DualTrack在词错误率、全动作Fréchet手势距离、节拍一致性和语音自然度上均优于GELINA基线。
AI.conclusion: DualTrack通过共享时间线和双向因果交互有效解决了多语言语音-手势联合合成中的模态协调问题，显著提升了合成质量和自然度。

title: ATTUNER: Recomputation-Free KV Cache Reuse via Query-Side Adaptation
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents repeatedly load reusable content, such as skills, documents, and memory entries, into the current context. Re-encoding this content for every request wastes computation. Position-independent caching (PIC) alleviates this by encoding each artifact independently and reusing its key-value (KV) states at arbitrary positions, but it incurs a quality loss relative to full-context prefill. Existing methods repair this loss by restoring global position IDs or recomputing selected tokens. In this work, we isolate the source of the loss, finding that the positional mismatch has minor effect, and independently cached artifacts retain faithful representations: reading a provided artifact stays largely accurate, and performance degrades only when the model must select among multiple artifacts. Moreover, replacing PIC's attention scores with full-prefill scores recovers performance with the cached KV unchanged, localizing the failure to the attention rather than KV recomputation. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{Attuner}, a query-side adaptation method that learns to read a frozen artifact cache. \textsc{Attuner} inserts low-rank adapters into the query projections and is trained by distilling full-prefill distribution into the student. It trains fewer than 0.05\% of the model parameters and, at inference, requires neither cache recomputation nor a full-context reference.
