On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across seven benchmarks covering skills, documents, memory, and code, \textsc{Attuner} substantially outperforms prior PIC baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, matches full-context prefill quality while providing up to $3.73\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文深入分析了位置无关缓存（PIC）在LLM智能体中的质量损失来源，发现核心问题在于注意力计算而非KV状态退化，并提出Attuner——一种轻量级查询侧适配器方法，通过蒸馏全上下文预填充的注意力分布，以极小参数量（<0.05%）恢复性能，在Qwen3-4B/8B上实现媲美全上下文质量且最高3.73倍加速。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需反复将技能、文档、记忆等可复用内容加载进上下文，重复编码造成巨大计算浪费。位置无关缓存（PIC）虽能独立编码并复用KV状态，但相比全上下文预填充存在质量损失。现有修复方法（恢复全局位置ID、重新计算部分token）效果有限且增加开销，亟需从根源定位并解决质量损失。
AI.method: 1. 根因分析：通过控制实验隔离损失来源，发现位置错配影响微弱，独立缓存的制品保持忠实表征；性能下降仅发生在模型需从多制品中选择时。用全预填充注意力分数替换PIC分数即可恢复性能（KV不变），定位失败点在注意力而非KV重计算。2. Attuner方法：在查询投影层插入低秩适配器，冻结制品缓存，通过知识蒸馏让学生模型学习全预填充的注意力分布。仅训练<0.05%参数，推理时无需缓存重计算或全上下文参考。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，跨越技能、文档、记忆、代码七大基准测试，Attuner在域内和域外设置下大幅超越现有PIC基线，达到全上下文预填充质量，同时提供高达3.73倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: PIC的质量损失本质源于注意力计算的分布偏移，而非KV状态的信息丢失。Attuner通过查询侧轻量级适配蒸馏注意力分布，以极低训练成本彻底解决该问题，实现了缓存复用与全上下文质量的完美平衡，为LLM智能体的高效部署提供了实用范式。

title: In-Context Learning Amplifies a Latent Symbolic Circuit
comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Large language models can learn abstract rules from just a few in-context examples, but how their internal mechanisms activate as examples accumulate is not well understood. We trace a three-stage symbolic reasoning circuit (abstraction, induction, retrieval) across shot counts in three model families and find it is detectable and functional well before the model achieves high accuracy. Per-head causal contribution grows up to 8x from 1- to 10-shot, and cross-shot activation patching raises accuracy from 1% to 56% at 0-shot and 17% to 88% at 1-shot. Function vectors scaled and injected at 0-shot rescue accuracy up to 86%, largely substituting for the induction stage but depending critically on an intact downstream retrieval stage. The infrastructure for abstract rule-following is present in the weights before any demonstrations; in-context examples, function vectors, and related interventions appear to supply input to the same latent circuit.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在语境学习中通过三阶段符号推理电路（抽象、归纳、检索）实现抽象规则学习，该电路在模型达到高准确率前即已存在且功能完备，语境示例、函数向量等干预均作为同一潜在电路的输入。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在语境学习中随着示例数量增加，内部机制如何激活以实现抽象规则学习，目前对此理解尚浅。
AI.method: 在三个模型家族中追踪三阶段符号推理电路（抽象、归纳、检索）随 shot 数变化的表现；分析每头因果贡献随 shot 数增长；进行跨 shot 激活补丁实验；在 0-shot 下注入缩放后的函数向量以测试其对归纳阶段的替代作用及对下游检索阶段的依赖。
AI.result: 三阶段电路在模型达到高准确率前即可检测且功能完备；单头因果贡献从 1-shot 到 10-shot 增长高达 8 倍；跨 shot 激活补丁使 0-shot 准确率从 1% 提升至 56%，1-shot 从 17% 提升至 88%；0-shot 注入函数向量可将准确率挽救至 86%，主要替代归纳阶段但关键依赖完整的下游检索阶段。
AI.conclusion: 抽象规则遵循的基础设施预先存在于模型权重中，无需演示即可激活；语境示例、函数向量及相关干预均作为同一潜在电路的输入源，驱动该电路运行。

title: Semantic Projection for Continual Self-Evolution of Language Agents
summary: Language-model agents increasingly rely on persistent natural-language skills to adapt beyond their frozen model parameters. When a shared skill is repeatedly revised from a non-stationary, heterogeneous task stream, however, improvements for new tasks can overwrite procedures needed for earlier ones. In continual learning, Orthogonal Gradient Descent (OGD) addresses analogous interference by projecting a new-task gradient onto a subspace that locally preserves prior predictions. Natural-language skill revisions, however, have neither gradients nor a canonical vector space in which such a projection can be performed. We introduce \emph{Semantic-Scope Projected Evolution} (SSPE), which transfers the functional principle of gradient projection from parameter space to behavior space. SSPE treats an unconstrained skill revision as a proposed update, identifies acquired capabilities with which it may interfere, and uses the observed gains and regressions to construct a compatible revision rather than merely rejecting the update. This enables one shared skill to evolve across latent and recurring task contexts without exposing semantic domain identities to the evolution model. Across controlled synthetic streams and heterogeneous real-agent benchmarks, SSPE improves final cross-domain competence and mitigates forgetting relative to strong skill-evolution baselines. The evolved skill also retains the strongest average performance after transfer to a different executor model. These results establish semantic projection as a promising principle for stable and adaptive self evolution of language agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出语义范围投影演化（SSPE），将正交梯度下降的思想从参数空间迁移到行为空间，使语言模型代理能在非平稳异构任务流中持续演化共享技能而不发生灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 语言模型代理依赖持久自然语言技能适应新任务，但共享技能在非平稳异构任务流中反复修订时，新任务的改进会覆盖早期任务所需程序，导致灾难性遗忘。现有的持续学习方法如正交梯度下降（OGD）在参数空间投影梯度以保留旧知识，但自然语言技能修订没有梯度也没有规范向量空间，无法直接应用。
AI.method: 提出语义范围投影演化（SSPE），将梯度投影的功能原理从参数空间迁移到行为空间。SSPE 将无约束技能修订视为提议更新，识别可能干扰的已获取能力，利用观测到的增益和退化构建兼容修订，而非直接拒绝更新。这使得一个共享技能能在潜在和反复出现的任务上下文中演化，而无需向演化模型暴露语义领域身份。
AI.result: 在受控合成流和异构真实代理基准上，SSPE 相较于强技能演化基线，提升了最终跨领域能力并缓解了遗忘。演化后的技能在迁移到不同执行器模型后仍保持最强平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了语义投影作为语言代理稳定自适应自我演化的有前景原则。

title: Distilling What Matters: Confidence-Aware Selective Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge Distillation (KD) trains a smaller-capacity student model to imitate a larger-capacity teacher model by matching output distributions, implicitly assuming the teacher to be a reliable oracle. In large language models (LLMs), this assumption often fails: teacher predictions can exhibit high entropy and hallucinations, causing standard KD to degrade well-calibrated student priors. We propose CaRE-KD, a confidence-gated distillation framework that replaces static objectives with uncertainty-adaptive optimization. CaRE-KD has two components: a token-level loss (CaRE-Divergence) that adaptively switches between Forward and Reverse KL divergence based on teacher--student confidence, and a batch-level epistemic rejection mechanism (Revival) that suppresses updates when the teacher is more uncertain than the student. We provide a gradient-level analysis showing how this dual-granularity design induces a conditional calibration mechanism that prior static divergences cannot reproduce. Empirically, across eight teacher--student pairs and eleven benchmarks spanning instruction following, chat alignment, code generation, and mathematical reasoning, CaRE-KD delivers consistent gains over strong baselines (Skewed-KL, $α$--$β$ divergence). Highlights include up to $+3.2$ average ROUGE-L on instruction-following tasks, $+2.1$ pass@1 on MBPP, $+1.7$ accuracy on GSM8k, and $+1.8$ accuracy on CollegeMath over the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in LLM-as-a-judge factuality (up to $+2.5$ per task over Skewed-RKL). Revival further acts as a principled, loss-agnostic plug-in that systematically strengthens existing distillation objectives by filtering epistemically unreliable teacher supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CaRE-KD，一种置信度门控的知识蒸馏框架，通过自适应切换前向/反向 KL 散度（CaRE-Divergence）和批次级认知拒绝机制，解决大语言模型蒸馏中教师模型高熵与幻觉导致的学生模型退化问题。
AI.motivation: 标准知识蒸馏隐式假设教师模型为可靠的预言机，但在大语言模型中该假设常失效：教师预测可能呈现高熵与幻觉，导致标准蒸馏破坏已校准良好的学生先验。
AI.method: CaRE-KD 包含双粒度组件：1) 令牌级 CaRE-Divergence，依据教师-学生置信度自适应在前向与反向 KL 散度间切换；2) 批次级 Revival 机制，当教师不确定性高于学生时抑制梯度更新。梯度层面分析表明该双粒度设计诱导出静态散度无法复现的条件校准机制。
AI.result: 在 8 组教师-学生模型对与 11 个基准上，CaRE-KD 持续超越强基线：指令跟随任务平均 ROUGE-L 提升 +3.2，MBPP pass@1 提升 +2.1，GSM8k 准确率提升 +1.7，CollegeMath 提升 +1.8，LLM-as-a-judge 事实性评估每任务提升高达 +2.5。Revival 作为无损插件进一步强化现有蒸馏目标。
AI.conclusion: CaRE-KD 通过置信度自适应的散度切换与认知级拒绝机制，实现了对教师不确定性的条件校准，为大语言模型蒸馏提供了原理性、可插拔的可靠性增强方案。

title: Stochastic Optimization Under Power-Law Spectra: Tight Bounds and Shuffling Analysis
summary: Recent work has established that power-law spectral conditions on data enable tight convergence bounds for deterministic gradient descent, resolving the conflict between classical exponential bounds and observed power-law learning curves. In this work, we extend this result to the stochastic regime of high-dimensional machine learning. We provide two main contributions: (1) We generalize the power-law spectral theory to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), showing that the same spectral exponents govern stochastic dynamics; (2) For the fundamental case of isotropic Gaussian data, we provide a precise analysis of data shuffling, deriving exact constants that prove Single Shuffle is strictly superior to Flip-Flop and IID sampling. Our results bridge the gap between abstract spectral theory and practical stochastic training choices, offering a unified picture of how data geometry drives optimization speed.

AI.tldr: 本文将幂律谱理论推广到随机梯度下降(SGD)，证明相同谱指数控制随机动力学；针对各向同性高斯数据，精确分析数据打乱策略，证明单次打乱优于翻翻和IID采样。
AI.motivation: 解决经典指数收敛界与观察到的幂律学习曲线之间的冲突，将确定性梯度下降的幂律谱理论扩展到高维机器学习的随机训练 regime，连接抽象谱理论与实际随机训练选择。
AI.method: 推广幂律谱条件到SGD，利用谱指数分析随机动力学；针对各向同性高斯数据，推导精确常数比较不同数据打乱策略（Single Shuffle, Flip-Flop, IID采样）的收敛性能。
AI.result: 证明相同的谱指数支配SGD的随机动力学；推导出精确常数，表明Single Shuffle严格优于Flip-Flop和IID采样。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了数据几何与优化速度的统一图景，弥合了抽象谱理论与实际随机训练选择的鸿沟，为理解高维机器学习中的优化提供了理论基础。

title: Distilling Agentic Systems: A Roadmap across Models, Artifacts, and Harnesses
summary: Modern agents increasingly rely on memories, tools, and execution logic, so their competence extends beyond model parameters. This shift exposes a limitation of conventional knowledge distillation, which asks how a student model imitates a teacher model. We define Agent Distillation as the persistent transfer of task-solving knowledge from a teacher agent to a student agent. Our study organizes the field by where transferred knowledge is retained: within the model, as artifacts, through the execution harness, or across substrates. This perspective separates transfer evidence from its outcome and clarifies how knowledge moves between agent components. We develop an evaluation framework that relates retention to causal contribution and deployed utility. Together, these contributions establish a foundation for the reliable, maintainable, and safe development of increasingly complex agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了 Agent Distillation（智能体蒸馏）概念，将知识蒸馏从模型参数扩展到智能体的记忆、工具、执行逻辑等组件，提出了按知识保留位置分类的框架，并开发了评估框架，为复杂智能体系统的可靠开发奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体越来越依赖记忆、工具和执行逻辑，其能力超越了模型参数，传统知识蒸馏仅关注学生模型模仿教师模型，无法应对智能体层面的知识迁移需求。
AI.method: 定义 Agent Distillation 为从教师智能体到学生智能体的任务解决知识持久迁移；按知识保留位置组织领域：模型内部、作为制品、通过执行 harness、跨基质；提出将迁移证据与结果分离的视角；开发关联保留与因果贡献及部署效用的评估框架。
AI.result: 建立了智能体蒸馏的分类框架和评估框架，阐明了知识在智能体组件间如何流动，为可靠、可维护、安全的复杂智能体系统开发提供基础。
AI.conclusion: Agent Distillation 将知识蒸馏推广到智能体层面，通过系统化分类和评估，解决了传统蒸馏在智能体系统中的局限，为未来复杂智能体系统的工程化发展奠定理论基础。

title: VAA-CSEC: Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for Chinese Semantic Error Correction
summary: Chinese Semantic Error Correction (CSEC) targets semantic errors in Chinese text, which are typically more subtle and complex than spelling and grammatical errors but remain relatively underexplored. Existing LLM-based approaches face two recurring obstacles in this task: over-correction, and unclear interaction between Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and self-consistency decoding, such that the benefits brought by CoT cannot be reliably transferred to final corrections. We propose Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for CSEC (VAA-CSEC), a multi-stage framework that combines CoT distillation, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL) and self-consistency decoding. During RL, we design a task-specific reward function that directly aligned with the minimal-editing principle of CSEC. We further introduce Group-Level Relative Policy Optimization (GLPO), which reallocates GRPO advantages according to the margin between individual rollout rewards and the vote-aggregated group reward, aligning the RL training objective with the self-consistency objective used at inference time. Experiments on CSED-C and NaSGEC-Exam show that VAA-CSEC outperforms all LLM-based baselines on CSED-C with an F0.5 of 47.72%, achieves the highest recall of 42.15% among all methods, and establishes a new state of the art of 41.55% F0.5 on NaSGEC-Exam.

AI.tldr: 提出VAA-CSEC框架，结合CoT蒸馏、SFT、RL和自一致性解码，通过GLPO优化奖励分配，在中文语义纠错任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM方法在中文语义纠错(CSEC)中存在过度纠错问题，且CoT推理与自一致性解码的交互不明确，导致CoT收益难以可靠转移到最终纠错。
AI.method: VAA-CSEC多阶段框架：CoT蒸馏、监督微调(SFT)、强化学习(RL)和自一致性解码。RL阶段设计符合最小编辑原则的任务特定奖励函数，并提出组级相对策略优化(GLPO)，根据单个采样奖励与投票聚合组奖励的差距重新分配GRPO优势，使训练目标与推理时的自一致性目标对齐。
AI.result: 在CSED-C上F0.5达47.72%，超越所有LLM基线；召回率42.15%为所有方法最高；在NaSGEC-Exam上建立新SOTA，F0.5为41.55%。
AI.conclusion: VAA-CSEC通过整合CoT蒸馏、SFT、RL和自一致性解码，并引入GLPO协调训练与推理目标，有效解决了过度纠错和CoT收益转移难题，在中文语义纠错基准上取得最优性能。

title: GNA: Granular Neighbor Assembly for Retrieval-Augmented Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Deep forecasters predict from a fixed-length lookback window, and lengthening it gives diminishing returns at a growing cost. Retrieval augmentation instead shows the model how similar past situations continued. Retrieving a whole past window gives every variate the continuation of the same past moment. In multivariate series, however, the best past match differs from variate to variate. We present GNA (Granular Neighbor Assembly), a retrieval layer for forecasting backbones that assembles neighbors at two granularities: whole past windows, which keep the variates coherent, and per-variate neighbors, in which each variate takes its future from its own best-matching past. A learned gate decides, per forecast step and variate, how much to trust these futures against a persistence forecast, next to the backbone's own forecast. Candidates come from an embedding trained to predict each window's future, and retrieval is strictly causal: a past window is used only once its future has been observed. With the same lookback for every model and the same retrieval constants for all datasets, GNA improves two Transformer backbones in 85 of 96 dataset-horizon settings, gives the lowest MSE on 8 of 12 standard benchmarks and beats its backbone in every seed on 10 of them. Both granularities are needed, and neighbors of mismatched queries are worse than none. Retrieval helps most where the lookback says least: the gate shifts trust to retrieved futures further ahead. Where it fails, on hourly non-stationary series at long horizons, the loss is consistent with a drifting level of the retrieved futures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GNA（Granular Neighbor Assembly，粒度化邻居组装），一种用于预测骨干网络的检索层，通过双粒度检索（整窗口邻居保持变量相干性 + 逐变量邻居让每个变量取其最佳匹配过去的未来）并配合学习门控机制，显著提升多变量时间序列预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度预测器依赖固定长度回看窗口，延长窗口收益递减且成本增长。检索增强虽能展示相似过去情况的后续，但多变量序列中最佳历史匹配因变量而异：整窗口检索保持变量相干但可能非各变量最优；逐变量检索虽最优但破坏变量间相干性。需要一种方法同时利用两种粒度优势。
AI.method: GNA在两个粒度检索邻居：(1)整过去窗口，保持所有变量相干；(2)逐变量邻居，每个变量从自身最佳匹配过去获取未来。训练嵌入以预测各窗口未来，检索严格因果（仅当过去窗口的未来已观测时才使用）。学习门控按预测步长和变量决定信任检索未来、持久性预测还是骨干网络自有预测的权重。
AI.result: 统一回看长度和检索常数下，GNA在96个数据集-预测长度设置中85个提升两个Transformer骨干，12个标准基准中8个取得最低MSE，10个基准上在所有随机种子下均超越骨干。双粒度均不可或缺，错配查询的邻居比无检索更差。检索在回看窗口信息最少处帮助最大（门控向前推移更信任检索未来）。失败案例出现在小时级非平稳序列长预测，损失与检索未来的水平漂移一致。
AI.conclusion: GNA通过双粒度检索与学习门控有效融合历史模式，在回看窗口不足处显著增强预测，跨数据集和骨干网络鲁棒。但对长时程非平稳序列存在局限，检索未来的水平漂移导致性能下降。

title: RankBuffer: Efficient Ranking-Based Rewards for Open-Ended Generation
summary: Open-ended generation lacks canonical answers, making pointwise rewards difficult to calibrate for group-based reinforcement learning. Directly ranking same-query rollouts provides a more suitable relative reward signal, but existing ranking-based reward methods can incur substantial judging cost. We introduce RankBuffer, which maintains an ordered, query-specific buffer of previously judged responses as a reusable quality scale. Each rollout is first inserted into an anchor interval through an independent coarse judgment, after which only rollouts assigned to the same interval undergo local fine ranking. The resulting complete order is converted into bounded rank rewards, while boundary expansion, local refinement, and inactive-anchor pruning adapt the buffer as the policy evolves. Across four open-ended benchmarks, RankBuffer consistently outperforms all pointwise baselines. It also achieves nearly on-par performance with the strongest ranking-based reward baseline while substantially reducing judging cost. Ablations demonstrate the importance of both local fine ranking and anchor response content, while buffer analyses show that rollout-derived anchors progressively extend and refine the covered quality scale. These results establish response reuse as an effective approach to efficient relative reward construction.

AI.tldr: RankBuffer 是一种用于开放式生成任务的相对奖励构建方法，通过维护有序的、查询特定的已判断响应缓冲区作为可复用的质量刻度，结合粗判断与局部精排，显著降低判断成本且性能接近最强基线。
AI.motivation: 开放式生成缺乏标准答案，点wise 奖励难以校准；直接对同一查询的多个生成进行排序能提供更合适的相对奖励信号，但现有基于排序的奖励方法判断成本高昂。
AI.method: RankBuffer 维护一个有序的、查询特定的已判断响应缓冲区作为可复用的质量刻度。每个生成先通过独立的粗判断插入到锚点区间，再仅在同一区间内进行局部精排；完整排序转化为有界秩奖励。缓冲区通过边界扩展、局部细化和非活跃锚点剪枝随策略演进动态适应。
AI.result: 在四个开放式基准上，RankBuffer 持续优于所有点wise 基线，且性能与最强基于排序的奖励基线几乎持平，同时大幅降低判断成本。消融实验验证了局部精排和锚点响应内容的重要性；缓冲区分析显示生成源锚点逐步扩展并细化了覆盖的质量刻度。
AI.conclusion: 响应复用是构建高效相对奖励的有效途径，RankBuffer 通过缓冲区机制实现了低成本、高性能的相对奖励建模。

title: Rethinking Multimodal Fake News Detection in the Generative AI Era
summary: Generative content is increasingly entering the production and dissemination of news, transforming fake news from manually fabricated or simply manipulated material into complex forms in which native and generated content jointly participate. Existing multimodal fake news detection research primarily focuses on veracity assessment and rarely characterizes how generativity differences affect the reliability of evidence. In contrast, AIGC detection primarily determines whether content is generated or modified by generative models, but it does not by itself establish whether the underlying news event is true. To bridge the separation between these tasks in data and evaluation, we construct Weibo26, a multimodal fake news detection dataset for generative-content scenarios. On this basis, we propose the Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR) framework, which combines global judgment with local correction so that generativity information participates in news-veracity reasoning. Experiments on multiple existing fake news detection benchmarks and Weibo26 show that GAHR achieves competitive veracity-detection performance while effectively identifying generative content.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了首个面向生成式内容场景的多模态假新闻检测数据集Weibo26，并设计了生成性感知分层推理（GAHR）框架，将生成性信息融入真实性推理，实现了真实性检测与生成内容识别的联合优化。
AI.motivation: 生成式内容渗透新闻生产传播，使假新闻从人工捏造演变为原生与生成内容混杂的复杂形态。现有多模态假新闻检测仅关注真实性判断，忽视生成性差异对证据可靠性的影响；AIGC检测虽能识别生成内容，但无法判定新闻事件真伪。两类任务在数据与评估上割裂，亟需统一框架。
AI.method: 构建Weibo26数据集，包含真实/虚假新闻及生成/非生成内容标注。提出GAHR框架：全局判断模块进行粗粒度真实性预测，局部修正模块利用生成性信息细化证据可靠性，通过分层推理实现生成性感知的真实性验证。
AI.result: 在多个现有假新闻检测基准及Weibo26上实验表明，GAHR在真实性检测性能上具竞争力，同时能有效识别生成式内容，优于单独进行真实性检测或AIGC检测的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据集构建与框架设计，弥合了假新闻真实性检测与生成内容识别的鸿沟，证明生成性信息参与推理能显著提升多模态假新闻检测的鲁棒性与可解释性，为生成式时代的假新闻治理提供了新范式。

title: Representational and Functional Robustness to Electrode Montages in EEG Foundation Models
summary: EEG foundation models (EEG-FMs) are intended to generalize across different datasets by learning representations that, ideally, are invariant to dataset-specific EEG configurations such as electrode montages. However, EEG-FMs that accept different montages as input do not guarantee that representations and predictions remain stable across different electrode configurations, especially outside the training setting. In this work, we investigate the effects of different electrode montages through a joint functional and representational analysis of four EEG foundation models selected to span distinct montage-handling designs. We evaluate embeddings on cross-subject resting-state eyes-open/closed and within-subject motor-imagery classification under spatially informed channel reduction. Functional robustness is tested through the generalizability of linear probes across channel counts, while representational robustness is assessed through within-subject similarity and preservation of between-subject geometry. The four models show distinct robustness profiles, and the two axes dissociate: large changes in embedding similarity need not come with comparable probe degradation, and stable embeddings can still lose downstream performance. Comparing two readouts of the same encoder further shows that aggregation, not the encoder alone, determines functional robustness: pooling into anatomically aligned regions degrades less than a learned global readout, despite being montage-invariant by construction. Montage robustness is therefore a joint property of the encoder and its aggregation, and characterizing it requires both a representational and a functional axis. Input compatibility alone is evidence for neither.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了不同电极排布对EEG基础模型表示与预测稳定性的影响，揭示输入兼容性不足以保证鲁棒性，需从功能和表征两个维度联合评估，且聚合方式对功能鲁棒性起决定性作用。
AI.motivation: EEG基础模型旨在跨数据集泛化，理想情况下学习到的表示应不变于数据集特定的电极排布。然而，仅能接受不同排布输入并不保证表示和预测在不同电极配置下保持稳定，尤其是在训练分布外场景。因此需要深入探究电极排布对模型鲁棒性的具体影响。
AI.method: 选取四种具有不同电极排布处理设计的EEG基础模型，在跨受试者静息态睁闭眼分类和受试者内运动想象分类任务上，采用空间信息引导的通道减少策略。通过线性探针在不同通道数下的泛化性能评估功能鲁棒性，通过受试者内嵌入相似性和受试者间几何结构保持性评估表征鲁棒性。
AI.result: 四种模型呈现出差异化的鲁棒性画像，功能与表征鲁棒性相分离：嵌入相似性的大幅变化不一定伴随探针性能的同等下降，稳定的嵌入仍可能丢失下游任务性能。对比同一编码器的两种读出方式发现，聚合方式而非编码器本身决定功能鲁棒性：解剖对齐区域池化比学习的全局读出降解更小，尽管前者设计上即具备排布不变性。
AI.conclusion: 电极排布鲁棒性是编码器及其聚合机制的联合属性，全面刻画它需要功能和表征两个分析维度，仅有输入兼容性无法作为鲁棒性的证据。

title: FineSID: Scalable and Efficient Semantic Identifier Learning for Generative Recommendation
summary: A critical prerequisite of generative recommendation is designing semantic identifiers (SIDs) that are both scalable to large item sets and efficiently learnable. Existing SID learning methods fundamentally rely on Top-1 hard assignment during vector quantization. While heuristic strategies -- such as clustering-based initialization or forced post-hoc collision resolution -- can artificially inflate codebook coverage, they often disrupt end-to-end semantic alignment and fail to address the underlying optimization bottleneck: sparse gradient propagation. In standard Top-1 assignment, gradients concentrate on a narrow subset of frequently selected codewords, leaving the majority inherently under-trained and causing severe SID collisions. To overcome this limitation natively without relying on complex initialization priors, we propose FineSID, a unified quantization framework that moves beyond Top-1 assignment by enabling fine-grained gradient propagation across the entire codebook. Instead of updating only a single selected codeword, FineSID distributes learning signals to all codewords in a soft, differentiable manner. This design promotes globally balanced codebook optimization while strictly preserving semantic consistency, effectively alleviating SID collisions and stabilizing training in large, high-dimensional codebooks. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that FineSID is robust to initialization configurations and consistently improves both codebook utilization and recommendation accuracy. Our work provides a principled, initialization-agnostic solution for semantic identifier learning, advancing the practicality of generative recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FineSID，一种统一的量化框架，通过软性、可微分的方式将梯度传播到整个码本，解决生成式推荐中语义标识符（SID）学习依赖 Top-1 硬分配导致的梯度稀疏、码本利用率低和碰撞严重的问题，实现初始化无关的鲁棒 SID 学习。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐要求可扩展且高效可学的语义标识符。现有方法依赖向量量化中的 Top-1 硬分配，导致梯度仅集中在少数高频码字上，大部分码字训练不足，引发严重的 SID 碰撞。启发式初始化或事后冲突消除虽能人为提升覆盖率，但破坏端到端语义对齐，无法从根本解决优化瓶颈。
AI.method: FineSID 摒弃 Top-1 硬分配，采用细粒度的软量化机制：在前向传播中保持离散的语义 ID 分配，反向传播时将学习信号以可微分方式分配给所有码字。该设计实现全局均衡的码本优化，同时严格保持语义一致性，无需复杂的初始化先验即可原生缓解碰撞并稳定大规模高维码本的训练。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上的大量实验表明，FineSID 对初始化配置具有鲁棒性，持续提升码本利用率和推荐准确率，验证了其作为语义标识符学习的原则性、初始化无关解决方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: FineSID 通过软性、可微分的全码本梯度传播，从根本上解决了 Top-1 硬分配导致的稀疏梯度问题，为生成式推荐中的语义标识符学习提供了一个可扩展、稳定且不依赖特定初始化的统一框架，推动了生成式推荐的实用化进程。

title: Momentum-Coupled Rubric Adaptation for Detailed Image Captioning
comment: 28 pages, natural language processing, computer vision
summary: Detailed image captioning requires accurate and comprehensive descriptions of fine-grained visual content, yet caption quality spans factual accuracy, information coverage, and clarity. Compared with conventional methods that rely mainly on high-quality supervision or holistic rewards, rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes these requirements into explicit criteria and provides targeted, structured feedback. However, existing methods often use separate models for caption generation, rubric construction, and judging, which may lead to inconsistent interpretations across roles. Some dynamic rubric methods alternate updates between the caption policy and rubric generator while keeping the judge fixed, but staged optimization may still leave rubric construction and judging out of step with policy optimization. We propose MoCo Rubric, a two-stage framework that coordinates these roles. First, role-conditioned, shared-parameter multi-task supervised fine-tuning equips a single vision--language model to serve as the Caption Policy, Rubric Generator, and Rubric Judge. Then, the Generator constructs rubrics online from captions sampled by the current Policy, reference captions, and image evidence. The Judge provides rubric-based rewards, and only the Policy receives GRPO updates. As Policy updates change the candidates being evaluated, we use an exponential moving average of the Policy parameters to update one momentum model shared by the Generator and Judge. This gradual transfer lets both rubric roles track Policy updates without separate RL optimization while smoothing parameter changes that could disrupt their rubric capabilities under direct synchronization. Across five captioning benchmarks, MoCo Rubric achieves an average pairwise win rate of 72.83\%, the best mean rank in blind ranking, and the highest average score in caption-based question answering.

AI.tldr: MoCo Rubric 是一个两阶段框架，通过共享参数的多任务微调让单一视觉-语言模型同时担任字幕策略、评分标准生成器和评分标准判断器，并利用动量模型同步更新生成器和判断器，实现了评分标准构建与策略优化的协同，在五个基准上取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于评分标准的强化学习方法通常使用独立模型分别负责字幕生成、评分标准构建和判断，导致角色间理解不一致；动态评分标准方法虽交替更新策略和生成器但判断器固定，分阶段优化仍可能使评分标准构建与判断滞后于策略优化。
AI.method: 第一阶段：基于角色条件的共享参数多任务监督微调，使单一视觉-语言模型同时胜任字幕策略、评分标准生成器和判断器。第二阶段：生成器根据当前策略采样的字幕、参考字幕和图像证据在线构建评分标准，判断器给出基于评分标准的奖励，仅策略接受 GRPO 更新。为使生成器和判断器跟踪策略更新，采用策略参数的指数移动平均更新共享的动量模型，实现渐进式参数迁移，避免直接同步破坏评分标准能力。
AI.result: 在五个字幕基准上，MoCo Rubric 实现平均成对胜率 72.83%，盲测排名平均名次最优，基于字幕的问答平均得分最高。
AI.conclusion: MoCo Rubric 通过共享参数多任务微调和动量模型同步机制，有效协调了字幕生成、评分标准构建与判断三角色，解决了现有方法中角色不一致与优化不同步问题，显著提升了细粒度图像字幕的质量。

title: When Trees Are Not Enough: Learning Mixed-Topology Feature Graphs with Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose interpretable features in large language model activations, yet existing structured SAEs impose single-parent trees or forests, while post-hoc graphs permit multiple parents but neither guide feature learning nor ensure reliable relation recovery. We introduce the Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoder (AG-SAE), a structure-guided training paradigm that treats each feature's complete parent set as an atomic structural hypothesis and lets evidence select zero, one, or multiple parents. By competing complete parent sets against null, subset, and alternative explanations, AG-SAE identifies jointly necessary multi-parent relations while rejecting redundant or spurious alternatives and verifying that each child contributes beyond its parents. The induced topology over SAE features then defines a differentiable structural loss that guides SAE training, while topology-guided refinement mitigates feature absorption and uses persistent reconstruction gaps exposed by the learned structure to initialize new features. The entire graph is then induced again from the revised dictionary by reassessing every feature's complete parent set, closing the dictionary-graph self-consistency cycle. Experiments demonstrate exact mixed-topology recovery in a controlled toy model, greater relational reliability and semantic validity than structured and post-hoc baselines on real LLM activations, and stronger feature-level causal interventions than conventional SAE features. AG-SAE thereby turns recovered mixed-topology feature structure into an unsupervised training signal that improves the dictionary, enables reliable feature organization beyond the topological limitations of trees, and exhibits stronger causal control beyond reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自适应图稀疏自编码器（AG-SAE），一种结构引导训练范式，将每个特征的完整父集视为原子结构假设，通过证据选择零个、一个或多个父节点，实现混合拓扑的精确恢复，并利用诱导拓扑定义可微结构损失指导SAE训练，形成字典-图自一致性循环，显著提升特征关系可靠性、语义有效性及因果干预能力。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化SAE仅支持单父树或森林，事后构建的图虽允许多父但无法指导特征学习且关系恢复不可靠。需要一种能同时指导特征学习、可靠恢复混合拓扑（树、森林、多父图）并验证子特征对父特征的增量贡献的方法。
AI.method: AG-SAE将每个特征的完整父集作为原子结构假设，通过竞争机制（对比空假设、子集、替代解释）识别联合必要的多父关系，剔除冗余或虚假关系，验证子特征贡献。诱导拓扑定义可微结构损失指导SAE训练；拓扑引导细化缓解特征吸收，利用持久重建间隙初始化新特征；再从修订字典重新诱导图，闭合字典-图自一致性循环。
AI.result: 在受控玩具模型中实现精确混合拓扑恢复；在真实LLM激活上，关系可靠性和语义有效性优于结构化和事后基线；特征级因果干预效果强于传统SAE特征。
AI.conclusion: AG-SAE将恢复的混合拓扑特征结构转化为无监督训练信号，改进字典学习，突破树拓扑限制实现可靠特征组织，并在重建之外展现更强的因果控制能力。

title: FairDiff: Mitigating the Self-Reinforcing Matthew Effect in Diffusion Recommender Models
summary: While the "Matthew Effect" and filter bubbles are widely recognized outcome-level biases in recommender systems, we reveal that Diffusion Recommender Models (DRMs) uniquely compound this issue through their generative dynamics. Rather than merely inheriting data imbalances, DRMs trigger a self-reinforcing amplification of popularity bias. We identify that this phenomenon is driven by two compounding mechanisms. First, while optimization loss is universally dominated by high-frequency items across recommenders, DRMs suffer from a unique structural prior mismatch during generation. Because the forward terminal distribution of long-tailed data deviates significantly from the standard Gaussian prior, reverse sampling trajectories inherently collapse toward high-density popular items, fundamentally suppressing niche item generation. To dismantle this self-reinforcing loop, we propose FairDiff, a plug-and-play fairness-aware diffusion framework. To overcome the popularity-dominated loss, we introduce Popularity Condition Guidance (PCG). Rather than altering the training objective, PCG acts as an inference-time distributional reweighting mechanism, mathematically reshaping the score-based gradient field to penalize high-popularity regions and guide trajectories toward niche semantics. Furthermore, we design a Semantic Calibration (SC) Module to bridge the prior mismatch, aligning the forward and reverse distributions via one-step optimal transport. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that FairDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while effectively mitigating the self-reinforcing Matthew Effect, highlighting its value as a general framework for DRMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示扩散推荐模型（DRMs）通过生成动态放大流行度偏差，提出FairDiff框架，包含流行度条件引导（PCG）和语义校准（SC）模块，有效缓解自我强化的马太效应，达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统中马太效应和过滤气泡是公认的结果层面偏差，但扩散推荐模型（DRMs）通过其生成动态独特地复合放大了这一问题。DRMs不只是继承数据不平衡，而是触发流行度偏差的自我强化放大。作者识别出两个复合机制：一是优化损失普遍被高频项目主导，二是DRMs在生成过程中存在独特的结构先验不匹配——长尾数据的前向终止分布显著偏离标准高斯先验，导致反向采样轨迹必然坍缩向高密度流行项目，根本上抑制了小众项目的生成。
AI.method: 提出FairDiff即插即用公平感知扩散框架。针对流行度主导的损失，引入流行度条件引导（PCG），作为推理时的分布重加权机制，数学上重塑基于分数的梯度场，惩罚高流行度区域并引导轨迹走向小众语义。设计语义校准（SC）模块通过单步最优传输对齐前向和反向分布，弥合先验不匹配。
AI.result: 综合评估表明FairDiff在有效缓解自我强化马太效应的同时达到最先进性能，凸显其作为DRMs通用框架的价值。
AI.conclusion: FairDiff通过PCG和SC模块解决了DRMs特有的流行度偏差自我强化问题，为扩散推荐模型的公平性提供了通用解决方案。

title: RAEGNet: Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network for Harm-Aware Multimodal Fake News Detection
summary: Existing multimodal fake news detection methods often introduce external information to assist detection. However, most of them rely on entity-level retrieval and are therefore prone to introducing event-irrelevant noise. Meanwhile, existing methods mainly focus on improving overall performance and do not account for differences in the degree of harm posed by different instances of fake news. To address these limitations, we design an Event-Level Evidence Retrieval Framework (ELERF) and propose a Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network (RAEGNet). ELERF retrieves external evidence based on the complete event semantics of a news item. RAEGNet constructs a directed graph that incorporates news-evidence stance relations and evidence-evidence interaction relations, and introduces a conditional-harm branch to jointly model authenticity and potential harm. Experimental results demonstrate that RAEGNet outperforms multiple baseline methods across all evaluated metrics on Weibo-21, Fakeddit, and our self-constructed SSS dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于事件级证据检索框架（ELERF）和关系感知证据图网络（RAEGNet）用于多模态假新闻检测，解决实体级检索引入噪声及忽视假新闻危害度差异的问题，实验表明RAEGNet在多个数据集上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态假新闻检测方法依赖实体级外部信息检索，易引入事件无关噪声；且仅关注整体性能，忽略不同假新闻实例的危害程度差异。
AI.method: 设计事件级证据检索框架（ELERF）基于完整事件语义检索证据；提出关系感知证据图网络（RAEGNet），构建包含新闻-证据立场关系和证据-证据交互关系的有向图，并引入条件危害分支联合建模真实性与潜在危害。
AI.result: 在Weibo-21、Fakeddit和自建SSS数据集上，RAEGNet在所有评估指标上均优于多个基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ELERF和RAEGNet有效解决了实体级检索噪声和忽视危害度差异的问题，通过事件级证据检索和关系感知图建模实现了更准确的多模态假新闻检测与危害评估。

title: MoRE: Scaling mixture of experts with hardware-aware low-rank routing
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers are central to frontier language models, and recent architectures push toward more and smaller experts. In this regime, the standard linear router becomes a bottleneck: with $M$ experts and hidden dimension $h$, its per-token cost $Θ(Mh)$ dominates the MoE layer once $M$ is large. We introduce MoRE (Mixture of Rank-reduced-routed Experts), which factorizes the router weight matrix at rank $r$ and reduces the routing cost to $O((h + M)r)$. We prove that rank logarithmic in $M$ suffices for routing expressivity when the number of active experts is fixed, and is necessary up to precision factors. We also prove that logarithmic rank preserves load balance in a Gaussian memorization model, and training on a synthetic phonebook task shows that low rank does not hurt memorization. At matched active FLOPs, the factorization allows a factor of $Θ(h/r)$ more experts. To realize this gain in wall-clock time, we design a fused Triton kernel at inference that avoids expensive memory operations on HBM. Empirically, MoRE improves memorization on the phonebook task and performance on knowledge-intensive Q\&A benchmarks after pretraining, while matching reasoning ability. Code available at https://github.com/Matheart/MoRE_code.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MoRE（混合秩降低路由专家）架构，通过低秩分解路由器权重矩阵，将路由计算复杂度从 Θ(Mh) 降至 O((h+M)r)，实现专家数量扩展而不增加活跃 FLOPs，并在推理时通过融合 Triton 内核避免昂贵内存操作，显著提升记忆密集型任务性能。
AI.motivation: 随着 MoE 模型向更多、更小专家发展，标准线性路由器的 per-token 成本 Θ(Mh) 成为瓶颈，限制了专家数量的扩展。需要一种方法在保持路由表达能力和负载均衡的同时，大幅降低路由计算开销。
AI.method: 1. 将路由器权重矩阵分解为秩 r 的低秩因子，路由计算复杂度降为 O((h+M)r)。2. 理论证明：固定激活专家数时，秩 r = O(log M) 足以保证路由表达力，且在高斯记忆模型下保持负载均衡。3. 设计融合 Triton 内核，在推理时避免 HBM 昂贵内存操作，实现墙钟时间加速。
AI.result: 在合成电话簿任务上，低秩路由不损害记忆能力；在相同活跃 FLOPs 下，MoRE 可容纳 Θ(h/r) 倍更多专家。预训练后，MoRE 在知识密集型问答基准上显著提升性能，同时保持推理能力不变。
AI.conclusion: MoRE 通过低秩路由器分解有效解决了大规模 MoE 的路由瓶颈，理论与实验均证实其能以极低计算开销扩展专家数量，提升记忆密集型任务表现，为下一代稀疏模型架构提供了可行路径。

title: MLToolBench: Learning Tool-Augmented Agents for Machine Learning Development
summary: Machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made substantial progress, but learning through ML experimentation remains costly in time and computation. Synthetic environments reduce these costs while introducing variations in data and experimental settings that require task-specific diagnosis. Access to diagnostic tools alone does not ensure that agents learn when to use them or how to act on their findings. We introduce ToolMLBench, a suite of executable tools for data inspection, code verification, and experiment diagnosis, together with an SFT and RL pipeline for learning their use. Diagnostic calls acquire evidence whose value depends on subsequent decisions, so final outcomes provide limited guidance on which calls to reinforce. We address this challenge with SPICE, which measures how privileged context changes the likelihood of a sampled tool action and uses this difference as a turn-level reward alongside the final outcome. We train on 80 synthetic tasks and evaluate on 25 in-domain and 10 out-of-domain tasks. Providing tool interfaces and descriptions alone yields inconsistent gains across unadapted models. With the same diagnostic interface, our training pipeline raises in-domain success from 24.8% to 52.4% for Qwen3-8B and from 35.6% to 69.2% for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. The latter also improves from 31% to 48% out-of-domain, supporting learned diagnostic tool use on held-out sources and targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ToolMLBench 工具套件及 SFT+RL 训练管道，引入 SPICE 奖励机制，显著提升 MLE agents 在合成环境中使用诊断工具的能力，并在域内外任务上取得大幅性能提升。
AI.motivation: 机器学习工程（MLE）agents 虽有进步，但通过 ML 实验学习耗时耗算。合成环境虽降低成本，却引入数据和实验设置的变化，需任务特定诊断。仅提供诊断工具不足以保证 agents 学会何时使用及如何根据发现行动。
AI.method: 1. 构建 ToolMLBench：包含数据检查、代码验证、实验诊断的可执行工具套件。2. 设计 SFT 与 RL 训练管道学习工具使用。3. 提出 SPICE：测量特权上下文对采样工具动作概率的改变量，将其作为轮级奖励与最终结果奖励结合，解决诊断调用证据价值依赖后续决策、最终结果难以指导中间工具选择的问题。
AI.result: 在 80 个合成任务训练，25 个域内和 10 个域外任务评估。仅提供工具接口和描述对未适配模型增益不稳定。经训练管道后：Qwen3-8B 域内成功率从 24.8% 提升至 52.4%；Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 域内从 35.6% 提升至 69.2%，域外从 31% 提升至 48%。
AI.conclusion: 所提训练管道结合 SPICE 奖励能有效教会 agents 使用诊断工具，大模型更展现出对未见数据源和目标的泛化能力，验证了学习型诊断工具使用的可行性。

title: MultiTalk: Scaling Full-Duplex Speech Models to Long, Multi-Party, Bilingual Conversation
summary: End-to-end full-duplex speech models have brought open-source machine conversation closer to human-like interaction, yet existing systems remain limited in two intertwined dimensions: long-context robustness and multi-party interaction. Real-world scenarios such as meetings, group lessons, and social-robot reception require a single model to track, contextualize, and respond to multiple speakers over extended durations. Progress is constrained by both data and evaluation: open multi-party speech corpora remain small and are not designed for codec-frame-level full-duplex modeling, while existing long-audio benchmarks focus on passive listening and speech-to-speech benchmarks are mostly short and dyadic. We extend the Moshi paradigm jointly along the long-horizon and multi-party axes in English and Chinese. First, we release 57.6k hours of synthetic training data ($\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkPT}{MultiTalkPT}$ and $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkFT}{MultiTalkFT}$) for long-form, multi-party, English-Chinese full-duplex dialogue, with controllable length, participant count, turn-taking, overlap, backchannels, interruptions, addressee shifts, and long-range coreference. Second, we introduce $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkBench}{MultiTalkBench}$, built from real human recordings, for evaluating long-form, multi-party, bilingual full-duplex dialogue. Conversations average 32.6 minutes and include probes for long-range entity tracking, topic coherence, and addressee selection. Third, we train a bilingual Moshi-style model that sustains coherent multi-party English-Chinese conversations over extended durations and substantially outperforms open-source baselines including Moshi, MiniCPM-o-4.5, and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on MultiTalkBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MultiTalk框架，通过构建大规模合成训练数据集（57.6k小时）和真实基准测试集，训练出支持长时长、多轮次、中英双语的全双工语音对话模型，显著超越现有开源基线。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端全双工语音模型在长上下文鲁棒性和多方交互两个维度仍受限。真实场景（会议、团体课、社交机器人接待）要求单模型能在长时长内跟踪、语境化并响应多说话人。进展受限于数据与评估：开源多方语料库规模小且非为编码帧级全双工建模设计，长音频基准聚焦被动聆听，语音对话基准多为短时双向对话。
AI.method: 1. 发布57.6k小时合成训练数据（MultiTalkPT和MultiTalkFT），覆盖长程、多方、中英全双工对话，可控长度、参与者数量、轮流说话、重叠、回声、打断、受话人切换及长程共指。2. 引入MultiTalkBench真人录音基准，平均32.6分钟，含长程实体追踪、话题连贯性、受话人选择探针。3. 训练双语Moshi风格模型，支持长时长连贯多方中英对话。
AI.result: 训练的双语模型在MultiTalkBench上显著优于开源基线，包括Moshi、MiniCPM-o-4.5和Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合扩展长时域与多方轴，构建大规模合成数据与真实评测集，成功训练出首个支持长时长、多方、中英双语全双工对话的开源模型，为真实场景语音交互奠定基础。

title: The Universal Classifier for Graph Learning
summary: While foundation models have revolutionized natural language processing and computer vision by leveraging universal vocabularies, Graph Machine Learning (GML) remains fractured due to the absence of a unified feature and structural representation across diverse domains. Existing works claiming to be Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) are typically restricted to node-level predictions or require fixed feature dimensions, failing to provide a truly task-agnostic backbone for the full spectrum of graph learning applications. In this paper, we introduce the Universal Classifier (UC), which supports arbitrary feature and class cardinalities, unifying node-, edge-, and graph-level objectives under a single similarity-based classification objective. The UC reformulates all node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction tasks as maximizing similarity in the latent space: by lifting heterogeneous features and labels into 3D latent tensors, the model learns transferable features independent of specific input schemas. This architecture allows a single pre-trained model to generalize to node classification, node regression, and link prediction across unseen graphs with varying feature semantics. Experiments show strong zero-shot transfer performance across node-, link-, and graph-level tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用分类器（Universal Classifier, UC），一种任务无关的图基础模型，通过将异构特征与标签映射为三维潜在张量，统一节点、边、图级预测任务为相似度最大化目标，实现跨域零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有图基础模型（GFM）受限于固定特征维度或仅支持节点级任务，缺乏跨域统一的特征与结构表示，无法作为全谱系图学习的通用骨干网络。
AI.method: UC 将异构节点/边/图特征与标签提升为三维潜在张量，采用基于相似度的统一分类目标，将节点分类、节点回归、链路预测等任务重构为潜在空间中的相似度最大化，从而学习与输入模式无关的可迁移特征。
AI.result: 实验表明，单一预训练的 UC 模型在未见图上对节点分类、节点回归、链路预测及图级任务均展现出强零样本迁移性能，优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: UC 通过统一的相似度学习框架和张量化表示，打破了特征维度与任务类型的限制，为真正通用的图基础模型奠定了基础。

title: JudgeProfile: Understanding and Steering Subjectivity in LLM Judges
summary: LLM judges are inherently subjective, often favoring different responses in pairwise comparison when neither option is objectively wrong. To study this subjectivity, we introduce JudgeProfile, a framework that dissects LLM evaluation into perception (how a judge compares two responses across specific attributes like clarity, correctness, and detail) and prioritization (how much each attribute influences the final choice). We curate SubjectiveSet, a dataset of 50,013 response pairs from 17 public data sources, evaluated by 21 LLM judges across 87 attributes. We find a hidden consensus in perception: judges frequently agree on attribute judgments even when their overall choices diverge. Building on this separation, we first characterize each judge's prioritization using attribute weights estimated from its own overall choices. These weights differ across judges even when estimated from the same attribute judgments. We then learn new weights from reference labels to adapt their decisions to a target evaluation standard. Reweighting perceived attributes improves average held-out agreement with reference labels from 66.48% to 71.97%, outperforming fine-tuning and rubric prompting. Our findings show that understanding and steering the subjectivity of LLM judges requires attention not only to what they perceive, but also to how they prioritize it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 JudgeProfile 框架，将 LLM 评判拆解为感知与优先级两个维度，构建 SubjectiveSet 数据集，发现不同裁判在属性感知上存在隐性共识，但优先级权重差异导致最终选择分歧；通过从参考标签学习新权重重新加权感知属性，显著提升与参考标签的一致性，优于微调和提示词方法。
AI.motivation: LLM 裁判在成对比较中表现出固有主观性，即使两个回答都没有客观错误，不同裁判也会偏好不同回答。需要深入理解这种主观性的来源，以便更好地控制和适配评判标准。
AI.method: 1. 提出 JudgeProfile 框架，将评判过程分解为感知（跨 87 个属性比较两个回答）和优先级（各属性对最终选择的影响权重）。2. 构建 SubjectiveSet 数据集，包含 50,013 个回答对，来自 17 个公开数据源，由 21 个 LLM 裁判评估。3. 从裁判自身的整体选择中估计属性权重，刻画每个裁判的优先级。4. 利用参考标签学习新的权重，将裁判的决策适配到目标评价标准。
AI.result: 发现裁判在属性感知层面存在隐性共识（即使最终选择不同，属性判断常一致）。不同裁判的优先级权重存在显著差异。重新加权感知属性后，平均留出集与参考标签的一致性从 66.48% 提升至 71.97%，优于微调和评分标准提示词方法。
AI.conclusion: 理解和引导 LLM 裁判的主观性，不仅需要关注它们感知到了什么，还需要关注它们如何对感知内容进行优先级排序。通过分离感知与优先级，可以更有效地校准裁判行为以符合目标评价标准。

title: BaLEEN: Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities for Context-Aware ASR
summary: Transcribing domain-specific entities and rare proper nouns remains a major challenge in automatic speech recognition (ASR). In this paper, we propose BaLEEN (Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities), a lightweight, hypernetwork-based framework for dynamic contextual adaptation without fine-tuning the underlying ASR model. BaLEEN encodes variable-length contextual keywords using a pretrained language model, compresses them into a fixed sequence of latent vectors via a Perceiver bottleneck, and injects context-dependent bias vectors directly into the intermediate encoder representations of the ASR model. Because both the language model and the backbone ASR model remain entirely frozen during training, BaLEEN operates as a plug-and-play adapter that incurs zero computational overhead at inference time when context biases are precomputed. We evaluate our method on a CTC-based ASR model using a Wikipedia-derived corpus with annotated named entities and synthetic speech. Experimental results demonstrate that BaLEEN reduces keyword miss rate by 8.7% on the test set relative to the unbiased baseline while simultaneously improving overall word error rate by 21% and character error rate by 28%.

AI.tldr: BaLEEN 是一种轻量级、基于超网络的框架，用于 ASR 的动态上下文自适应，无需微调底层模型。它使用预训练语言模型编码上下文关键词，通过 Perceiver 瓶颈压缩为固定长度的潜在向量，并将上下文相关的偏置向量直接注入 ASR 编码器的中间表示。语言模型和 ASR 主干网络完全冻结，实现即插即用，预计算上下文偏置时推理零开销。在基于 CTC 的 ASR 模型上，BaLEEN 将关键词漏识率降低 8.7%，整体 WER 降低 21%，CER 降低 28%。
AI.motivation: 自动语音识别（ASR）在转写领域特定实体和罕见专有名词方面仍面临重大挑战。现有方法通常需要微调模型或引入额外推理开销，难以灵活适应动态变化的上下文关键词。因此需要一种免微调、零推理开销、可动态注入上下文偏置的轻量级适配方案。
AI.method: BaLEEN 采用预训练语言模型编码可变长度的上下文关键词，通过 Perceiver 瓶颈将其压缩为固定长度的潜在向量序列，再利用超网络生成上下文相关的偏置向量，直接注入到 ASR 编码器的中间层表示中。训练过程中语言模型和 ASR 主干网络完全冻结，仅训练超网络和 Perceiver 模块。推理时若预计算上下文偏置，则无额外计算开销。
AI.result: 在基于 CTC 的 ASR 模型上，使用维基百科衍生语料库（含标注命名实体）和合成语音进行评估。与无偏置基线相比，BaLEEN 将测试集关键词漏识率降低 8.7%，整体词错误率（WER）降低 21%，字符错误率（CER）降低 28%。
AI.conclusion: BaLEEN 证明了通过冻结预训练模型并仅训练轻量级适配模块，即可实现高效的动态上下文自适应，显著提升领域实体和罕见词的识别准确率，同时保持零推理开销，为即插即用的 ASR 上下文偏置提供了实用方案。

title: Cheap and Powerful Tests for Supervised Subspaces: Per-Component Inference for PLS
comment: 41 pages, 5 figures, 28 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004298
summary: Partial Least Squares (PLS) regression extracts a few outcome-aligned directions in a high-dimensional X and is widely used across applied science, but inference on the resulting fit is either expensive, biased and discouraged, or absent. We reduce inference to held-out OLS refits of the supervised subspace, a primitive shared by PLS, supervised PCA, and linear probes, and supply two tests using held-out correlations: a Nadeau-Bengio corrected asymptotic t-test as a fast approximation, and a permutation test with comparable power, finite-sample valid under outcome-predictor independence and iid rows. Held-out predictions are unchanged under any orthogonal rebasing of the supervised span, so an interpretable basis such as varimax inherits the joint claim but not a per-axis p-value; per-component claims come from a fixed-sequence test on the PLS extraction order. We validate on synthetic geometries, two NIR chemometric datasets, and cross-lingual word-embedding regressions; the exact test also transfers to supervised PCA and a ridge probe. The proposed tests have more power than CV-permutation-Q^2, at a fraction of its cost. A pre-run check on n and the spectrum of X says when the approximation is safe. We release a Rust library with Python, R, and Julia bindings, plus a Python text pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出针对偏最小二乘（PLS）回归及相关监督子空间方法的两种新推断检验：基于保留数据的Nadeau-Bengio校正渐近t检验（快速近似）和排列检验（有限样本有效），二者利用保留相关性，计算成本远低于交叉验证排列Q²且功效更高，并提供预运行检查判断近似安全性。同时指出正交变基下联合声明不变但逐轴p值需固定序列检验，代码已开源。
AI.motivation: PLS等监督降维方法广泛应用于高维数据，但现有推断手段要么昂贵（交叉验证排列），要么有偏/不被推荐，要么缺失。作者旨在将推断简化为保留数据上的OLS重拟合这一通用原语，提供计算高效、理论保证且可迁移至监督PCA、线性探针等方法的显著性检验。
AI.method: 1. 将推断归约为监督子空间在保留数据上的OLS重拟合；2. 提出两种基于保留相关性的检验：Nadeau-Bengio校正渐近t检验（快速近似）和排列检验（在结果-预测变量独立且行iid下有限样本有效）；3. 利用保留预测在正交变基下不变性，联合声明可继承至可解释基（如varimax），逐成分声明采用PLS提取顺序的固定序列检验；4. 提供基于n和X谱的预运行检查以判断近似安全性。
AI.result: 在合成几何、两个NIR化学计量数据集、跨语言词嵌入回归上验证：两种检验功效均高于CV排列Q²，计算成本仅为其很小分数；排列检验具精确有限样本有效性，渐近t检验在预检查通过时安全；方法无缝迁移至监督PCA和ridge探针。
AI.conclusion: 本文为PLS及监督子空间方法提供了首个兼具计算高效、理论严谨、可解释性友好的推断框架，配套Rust库（含Python/R/Julia绑定）及文本管道已开源，显著降低了应用科学家进行有效推断的门槛。

title: Can AI Scientists Change Their Minds? Prior-Evidence Conflict in Synthetic Universes
summary: Can a scientific agent distinguish a law it inferred from evidence from one it merely recognizes? We introduce Synthetic Universes, a controlled benchmark that pairs canonical famous worlds with matched twisted twins governed by nearby noncanonical mechanisms. We evaluate each reported law twice: by executing it on held-out continuations and transfer settings, and by independently checking whether it recovers the generating mechanism. In the current checkpoint of a pre-specified 60-cell study, 22 trials were graded and one additional run ended in infrastructure failure. Among 20 twin trials, 8 pass predictive verification while 5 recover the generator. The dissociation is bidirectional: six parsable outputs predict successfully while missing the mechanism, whereas three recover the mechanism but fail predictive rollout. Drag exhibits the first pattern (5/5 predictive pass, 1/5 mechanism recovery); Gravity exhibits the second (1/5 predictive pass, 4/5 mechanism recovery). Because matched famous controls, the corrected identifiability sweep, and the Evidence Ladder remain incomplete, we do not claim a confirmatory causal prior-conflict effect. Instead, the completed runs establish a narrower verification result: predictive adequacy and mechanism recovery are distinct scientific claims and require distinct tests.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“合成宇宙”基准，测试科学智能体区分推断定律与识别定律的能力，发现预测适用性与机制恢复是两种不同的科学主张，需要不同的测试。
AI.motivation: 探究科学智能体能否区分从证据中推断出的定律与仅识别出的定律，即预测准确性是否等同于机制恢复。
AI.method: 构建合成宇宙基准，包含经典著名世界及其扭曲孪生版本（由非典范机制控制）；对每个报告的定律进行两次评估：在保留外推和迁移设置下执行预测验证，并独立检查是否恢复生成机制。
AI.result: 在20个孪生试验中，8个通过预测验证，5个恢复生成机制；存在双向分离：6个可解析输出预测成功但未恢复机制，3个恢复机制但预测推演失败。阻力表现为前者模式（5/5预测通过，1/5机制恢复），重力表现为后者（1/5预测通过，4/5机制恢复）。
AI.conclusion: 由于配对著名对照、校正可识别性扫描和证据阶梯仍未完成，不声称确认性的因果先验冲突效应；已完成的运行确立了一个更狭窄的验证结果：预测适用性与机制恢复是截然不同的科学主张，需要截然不同的测试。

title: Can Language Models Learn to Forecast Stock Prices
summary: Post-training has been shown to significantly improve language models' performance on tasks with verifiable outcomes, including mathematical reasoning, software engineering, and computer use. However, whether the same approach can improve forecasting in financial markets is much less clear. Compared with tasks with verifiable outcomes, not only are realized returns noisy, but even what constitutes a relevant information set for making effective predictions is not obvious a priori: the model must decide which observations to gather and then commit to a numerical judgment before the outcome is known. We study this question in a chronological stock-price sandbox, where a language model gathers price, volume, relative-performance, and market-context evidence and predicts a future return. We post-train Qwen3-4B with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-use demonstrations, then proximal policy optimization (PPO) with a terminal reward given by the forecast score against the realized return. The resulting AURA-4B more than doubles the starting direction--magnitude score, from 20.94 to 43.31, and is comparable to frontier language models on this benchmark. Conditional magnitude agreement rises from 33.3 to 66.2, while directional accuracy changes from 62.9 to 65.4. SFT expands tool use, and PPO further increases the share of ranking and market-context queries. These results show that post-training can substantially improve financial forecasting performance, together with changes in how the model investigates the market, on this outcome-selected benchmark.

AI.tldr: 通过监督微调（SFT）和近端策略优化（PPO）对Qwen3-4B进行后训练，显著提升了语言模型在金融预测任务中的表现，方向-幅度评分从20.94提升至43.31，达到前沿模型水平。
AI.motivation: 后训练在数学推理、软件工程等可验证结果任务上效果显著，但在金融市场预测中，实际收益噪声大且相关信息集难以预先确定，模型需自主决定收集哪些观测并在结果未知前做出数值判断，因此该方法在金融预测中的有效性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建按时间顺序的股价沙盒环境，语言模型收集价格、成交量、相对表现和市场背景等证据预测未来收益。先用工具使用演示对Qwen3-4B进行SFT，再用基于预测评分与实现收益对比的终端奖励进行PPO训练，得到AURA-4B模型。
AI.result: AURA-4B将起始方向-幅度评分从20.94提升至43.31（翻倍以上），达到前沿模型水平。条件幅度一致性从33.3升至66.2，方向准确率从62.9升至65.4。SFT扩展了工具使用，PPO进一步增加了排名查询和市场背景查询的比例。
AI.conclusion: 后训练能显著提升金融预测性能，并改变模型探究市场的方式，在该结果导向的基准上验证了这一结论。

title: Learning Samples Importance: Parameterizing Dual Variables in Everywhere Learning
summary: Everywhere learning provides a principled framework for training AI models under constraints that must hold throughout the data distribution. In the dual domain, these pointwise constraints give rise to functional dual variables. In this work, we propose to learn these dual variables, motivated by the fact that their values encode useful information about the underlying constrained problem. By representing the dual variable as a parametric function of each sample, we enable the learned multiplier to be evaluated on new, unseen samples. This contrasts with standard empirical dual formulations, which assign an independent multiplier to each training sample. We characterize the error in the recovered primal solution induced by restricting the dual variable to a parametric function class and show that it is controlled by how well this class approximates the optimal statistical multiplier. Moreover, we show that the learned parametric multiplier retains the sensitivity interpretation of the optimal statistical multiplier, yielding approximate sensitivity guarantees that extend beyond the samples used for training. We empirically validate our theory across a variety of everywhere learning tasks, showing that the resulting constrained problems can be solved efficiently and that the learned dual variables provide meaningful representations of sample-level sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在Everywhere Learning框架下学习参数化对偶变量的方法，通过将对偶变量表示为样本的参数化函数，使其能在未见样本上泛化，并保留了灵敏度解释性，理论上证明了近似误差由函数类逼近最优统计乘子的能力控制，实验验证了方法的有效性和效率。
AI.motivation: 在Everywhere Learning中，逐点约束在对偶域产生函数对偶变量。标准经验对偶公式为每个训练样本分配独立乘子，无法泛化到新样本。作者旨在学习这些对偶变量，因为其值编码了约束问题的有用信息，并希望获得能在未见样本上评估的参数化对偶函数，同时保留灵敏度分析的解释性。
AI.method: 将对偶变量表示为每个样本的参数化函数（而非为每个训练样本分配独立乘子），通过优化学习该参数化函数。该方法使学习到的乘子能在新样本上评估，并表征了将对偶变量限制在参数化函数类中导致的原始解恢复误差。
AI.result: 理论上证明：恢复原始解的误差由参数化函数类逼近最优统计乘子的能力控制；学习到的参数化乘子保留了最优统计乘子的灵敏度解释，提供超越训练样本的近似灵敏度保证。实验上：在多种Everywhere Learning任务中验证，约束问题可高效求解，学习到的对偶变量提供有意义的样本级灵敏度表示。
AI.conclusion: 参数化对偶变量学习框架有效解决了标准经验对偶方法无法泛化和缺乏解释性的问题，在理论上提供了误差界和灵敏度保证，在实践中实现了高效求解和有意义的样本级灵敏度分析，为Everywhere Learning中的约束优化提供了新的实用范式。

title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/SprocketLab/librarydesignbench
summary: Agents increasingly build on code written by other agents, and they reimplement rather than reuse, growing the codebases later agents must work in. To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design. We evaluate the library through the correctness and simplicity of programs written by three user agents from different model families. The benchmark spans 242 expert-validated programming problems across 15 library-design tasks in four languages. On eleven of the fifteen tasks, agent designers reproduce the abstractions of the human-written production library. Downstream agents adopt agent- and human-written libraries alike but underuse them, reimplementing capabilities the library already provides. Our failure analysis finds that downstream agents write extra code mainly because agent-written libraries are rigid or hard to use, not because capabilities are missing. We also experiment with giving designers more prescriptive, agent-first guidance and having them test their library with subagents; this improves downstream scores and yields simpler programs. LibraryDesignBench provides both a testbed for evaluating library-design practices for agent users and an initial design baseline that improves downstream reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LibraryDesignBench，一个两阶段基准测试，用于评估智能体为其他智能体设计库的能力。实验发现：智能体设计的库在 11/15 任务中复现了人类库的抽象；下游智能体虽采用库但利用不足，倾向于重新实现库已有功能，主要因为库僵化或难用而非功能缺失；提供更具指导性的设计规范并引入子智能体测试可提升下游复用得分并简化程序。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体越来越多地构建在其他智能体编写的代码之上，且倾向于重新实现而非复用，导致代码库膨胀，后续智能体工作难度增加。现有基准缺乏对智能体面向智能体库设计能力的系统评估，亟需一种基准来衡量库设计对下游复用的影响。
AI.method: LibraryDesignBench 采用两阶段设计：第一阶段，设计者智能体根据规范（定义所需能力和潜在用例，不规定设计）实现完整库；第二阶段，来自三个不同模型家族的用户智能体基于该库编写程序解决 242 个专家验证的编程问题，跨越 15 个库设计任务和四种编程语言。评估指标为下游程序的正确性和简洁性。同时进行消融实验：给设计者提供更具指导性的“智能体优先”规范，并引入子智能体测试库。
AI.result: 1. 在 15 个任务中的 11 个上，智能体设计者复现了人类生产库的抽象。2. 下游智能体同等采用智能体和人类编写的库，但利用率低，大量重新实现库已提供的能力。3. 失败分析显示，额外代码主要源于智能体库的僵化或难用，而非功能缺失。4. 提供更具指导性的规范并引入子智能体测试，显著提升下游正确性得分，并生成更简洁的程序。
AI.conclusion: LibraryDesignBench 为评估面向智能体用户的库设计实践提供了测试平台，并建立了改善下游复用的初始设计基线。研究表明，当前智能体设计的库虽能复现人类抽象，但易用性不足导致复用不充分；引入更明确的设计指导和自测试机制能有效缓解该问题，为未来智能体协作代码生成指明了方向。

title: Benchmarking Automatic Speech Recognition Tools for Iberian Languages
summary: Comprehensive evaluations of automatic speech recognition (ASR) for Iberian languages remain limited, and low-resource languages, biases, and efficiency trade-offs are underexplored. We benchmark eleven systems, ten open-weight models and one commercial API, across five Iberian languages (Basque, Catalan, Galician, Portuguese, Spanish), with German and Turkish as controls. Evaluation uses an 85-hour dataset covering read speech, broadcast media, and audiobooks, assessing accuracy and efficiency via word error rate (WER) and real-time factors (RTF/RTFx). Results show no single model dominates: accuracy, efficiency, and language coverage present clear trade-offs. Low-resource languages, especially Basque, degrade significantly, highlighting the role of training coverage. We observe consistent sex disparities across most systems, highlighting fairness challenges in multilingual ASR. Overall, the benchmark provides practical guidance for real-world model selection.

AI.tldr: 本文对伊比利亚语言的自动语音识别(ASR)系统进行全面基准测试，评估11个模型在5种伊比利亚语言上的准确性、效率和公平性，揭示了低资源语言性能下降和性别偏见等关键问题。
AI.motivation: 现有针对伊比利亚语言的ASR评估有限，低资源语言、偏见及效率权衡研究不足，需要全面基准来指导实际模型选择。
AI.method: 基准测试11个系统(10个开放权重模型+1个商业API)，覆盖巴斯克语、加泰罗尼亚语、加利西亚语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语5种伊比利亚语言，以德语和土耳其语为对照。使用85小时数据集(朗读语音、广播媒体、有声书)，采用词错误率(WER)和实时因子(RTF/RTFx)评估准确性和效率。
AI.result: 无单一模型全面占优，准确性、效率、语言覆盖存在明显权衡。低资源语言(尤其是巴斯克语)性能显著下降，凸显训练覆盖的重要性。大多数系统存在一致的性别差异，揭示多语言ASR的公平性挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该基准测试为实际场景下的模型选择提供实用指导，强调需关注低资源语言支持和偏见缓解。

title: Fractional State Space Transition for Long Sequence Modeling
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) compress sequence history into a bounded recurrent state, making the resulting memory law a central architectural choice for long-context performance. Most modern SSMs rely on ODE-based dynamics that lead to exponential forgetting, limiting their ability to retain information over broad temporal ranges. We introduce FRAC, a selective SSM architecture derived from fractional dynamics that replaces this exponential decay with power-law long memory. To make fractional dynamics practical, FRAC approximates the heavy-tailed target kernel with a finite-state, log-spaced sum of exponential modes. This construction turns fractional memory into an efficient recurrent module with parallel training and prefill, while retaining bounded-state autoregressive decoding. Extensive experiments, including 1.3B-parameter language modeling, demonstrate that FRAC consistently improves long-context performance over state-of-the-art SSM baselines while staying competitive on short-context. These results show that fractional dynamics provide a practical and effective prior for long-context SSMs.

AI.tldr: FRAC 是一种基于分数阶动力学的选择性状态空间模型 (SSM)，通过用幂律长记忆替代传统 SSM 的指数衰减，显著提升长上下文建模能力，同时保持训练并行化和有界状态自回归解码的高效性。
AI.motivation: 现有 SSM 基于常微分方程 (ODE) 动力学，导致指数级遗忘，难以在宽时间范围内保留信息，限制了长上下文性能。需要一种能实现幂律长记忆的实用架构。
AI.method: FRAC 从分数阶动力学推导，用有限状态、对数间隔的指数模式加权和近似重尾目标核，将分数阶记忆转化为高效的循环模块，支持并行训练/预填充和有界状态自回归解码。
AI.result: 在 1.3B 参数语言建模等大量实验中，FRAC 在长上下文任务上持续优于最先进 SSM 基线，短上下文表现保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 分数阶动力学为长上下文 SSM 提供了实用且有效的先验，FRAC 验证了幂律记忆机制在大规模序列建模中的优势。

title: BiFE: Search-Efficient Discovery of CPU-Only Branching Policies via LLM-based Bi-Fidelity Evolution
summary: In branch-and-bound (B&B) for mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), branching variable selection critically impacts efficiency. Existing neural branching policies often require GPU inference, while CPU-efficient symbolic expressions lack the representational capacity for complex logic. Large Language Model (LLM)-generated code provides a flexible search space for designing lightweight branching rules with diverse algorithmic logic. To discover effective rules within LLM-based evolutionary frameworks, a core challenge arises: full B&B evaluation on real instances is prohibitively expensive, whereas offline imitation learning suffers from distribution shift. To address this, we introduce a Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary framework (BiFE). It employs low-fidelity imitation scores as a rapid pre-screener and selectively applies high-fidelity on-instance evaluation only to elite candidates, effectively balancing search efficiency with performance reliability. Experiments validate both the search efficiency of BiFE and the competitiveness of its discovered rules, which outperform the SCIP solver and other baselines on CPUs, and even surpass certain GPU-based neural policies.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种双保真度进化框架(BiFE)，用于在混合整数线性规划(MILP)的分支定界算法中发现高效的分支变量选择规则。通过结合低保真度模仿学习评分作为快速预筛选器和高保真度实例评估仅用于精英候选，BiFE在搜索效率和性能可靠性之间取得平衡。实验表明，BiFE发现的规则在CPU上优于SCIP求解器和其他基线，甚至超过某些基于GPU的神经网络策略。
AI.motivation: 在MILP的分支定界算法中，分支变量选择对求解效率至关重要。现有的神经分支策略通常需要GPU推理，而CPU高效的符号表达式缺乏表达复杂逻辑的能力。大语言模型(LLM)生成的代码提供了设计轻量级分支规则的灵活搜索空间，但在基于LLM的进化框架中发现有效规则面临核心挑战：在真实实例上进行完整的分支定界评估成本过高，而离线模仿学习则遭受分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 提出双保真度进化框架(BiFE)。该框架利用低保真度模仿学习评分作为快速预筛选器，对大量候选规则进行初步评估；然后仅对精英候选规则应用高保真度的实例上分支定界评估。这种选择性评估策略有效平衡了搜索效率与性能可靠性。搜索空间基于LLM生成的代码，包含多样化的算法逻辑。
AI.result: 实验验证了BiFE的搜索效率及其发现规则的竞争力。BiFE发现的分支规则在CPU上优于SCIP求解器和其他基线方法，甚至超越了某些基于GPU的神经网络分支策略。
AI.conclusion: BiFE通过双保真度评估机制，成功解决了在LLM代码空间中搜索高效分支规则的计算成本与分布偏移难题。该方法无需GPU即可生成高性能、可解释的轻量级分支规则，为MILP求解器的自动化算法设计提供了新范式。

title: Dating the Model: Hidden Dates in System Prompts Affect LLM Evaluation
summary: Reproducibility is essential for scientific research, yet prior work shows that LLM outputs vary with hardware and batching. We identify an overlooked factor: the hidden injection of the current date into system prompts, which users cannot control and which changes every day. Across 9 recent LLMs and 6 datasets spanning multiple-choice QA (MCQA), math reasoning, code generation, and machine translation, performance varies solely with the current date, with deltas of up to 6% on MCQA, 14% on math reasoning, 7% on code generation, and 2.84 BLEU on machine translation. Model rankings also shift, affecting leaderboards. This date effect exceeds other sources of non-determinism, such as batch size and numerical precision. Standard prompting techniques -- chain-of-thought and few-shot prompting -- do not reduce the sensitivity; chain-of-thought even amplifies it. Our findings underscore the need for careful evaluation protocols to ensure reproducibility and fair comparisons in LLM research.

AI.tldr: 本文发现隐藏注入系统提示中的当前日期会导致LLM性能显著波动，且该影响大于其他非确定性因素，标准提示技术无法缓解甚至加剧该问题，呼吁建立严格评估协议保证可复现性。
AI.motivation: 可复现性是科学研究的基础，但现有工作显示LLM输出随硬件和批处理变化，本文旨在揭示一个被忽视的因素——系统提示中隐藏注入的当前日期——对模型性能的影响。
AI.method: 在9个最新LLM和6个数据集上进行实验，涵盖多项选择问答、数学推理、代码生成和机器翻译任务，通过控制当前日期变量，测量性能随日期变化的差异，并对比批大小、数值精度等其他非确定性来源，同时测试思维链和少样本提示等标准技术对日期敏感性的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅当前日期变化即导致性能显著波动：MCQA高达6%、数学推理14%、代码生成7%、机器翻译2.84 BLEU；模型排名随之变动，影响排行榜；日期效应超过批大小和数值精度等其他非确定性来源；思维链提示不仅不能降低敏感性，反而放大它；少样本提示也无法缓解。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了在LLM评估中必须建立严谨的评估协议，以确保可复现性和公平比较，避免隐藏的日期注入导致的不可控性能波动。

title: PyroStack: A Multi-Band Spatio-Temporal Sub-Daily Dataset for Wildfires in the United States
summary: Wildfires are an increasing hazard to ecosystems, air quality, and human systems, creating a growing need for datasets that support systematic development and evaluation of models for predicting fire spread across diverse landscapes. Effective prediction requires integrating meteorological conditions, fuels, vegetation, and topography at spatial and temporal resolutions suitable for both physical simulation and data-driven approaches. However, existing datasets often lack the resolution and coverage needed to capture these interacting controls. The PyroStack dataset addresses this gap by providing a harmonized, event-based collection of wildfire and environmental data across the contiguous United States and Alaska. It integrates satellite-derived fire observations with atmospheric reanalysis, vegetation, fuel characteristics, and topographic information into a unified framework spanning 6994 wildfires that occurred between 2012 and 2024 across a wide range of ecosystems and climate conditions. PyroStack offers spatial resolutions ranging from 30 m to 9 km and hourly temporal resolution, along with fire progression data at 12-hour intervals to support model initialization and evaluation. By combining broad spatial coverage with fine spatial and temporal detail, the dataset enables systematic analysis of wildfire dynamics and supports both physics-based and machine learning approaches, providing a foundation for benchmarking and improving fire spread models, with future extensions aimed at incorporating additional regions and fire suppression data streams to further advance wildfire prediction.

AI.tldr: PyroStack数据集整合了卫星火灾观测、大气再分析、植被、燃料特征和地形数据，覆盖2012-2024年美国本土和阿拉斯加的6994起野火，提供30米至9公里空间分辨率、小时级时间分辨率及12小时间隔的火灾演进数据，支持物理模拟和机器学习模型的开发与评估。
AI.motivation: 现有野火数据集缺乏足够的时空分辨率和覆盖范围，无法捕捉气象、燃料、植被和地形等相互作用因素，阻碍了火灾蔓延模型的系统开发和评估。
AI.method: 构建了一个统一框架，整合多源数据：卫星火灾观测、大气再分析数据、植被和燃料特征数据、地形数据，覆盖6994起野火事件（2012-2024），提供30米至9公里多尺度空间分辨率、小时级时间分辨率和12小时间隔的火灾演进数据。
AI.result: PyroStack数据集实现了广泛空间覆盖与精细时空细节的结合，支持物理模拟和数据驱动方法，为火灾蔓延模型的基准测试和改进提供基础。
AI.conclusion: PyroStack填补了高分辨率、多源融合野火数据集的空白，未来将扩展至更多地区并纳入火灾抑制数据流，进一步推进野火预测研究。

title: Distinguish or Homogenize: Last-Chance Policy Identification and Risk-Budgeted Recovery under Irreversible Resource Depletion
summary: Under irreversible resource depletion, an agent can spend resources to distinguish among latent fault models, or to change the system state so that the remaining models admit a common acceptable continuation--at which point further diagnosis becomes unnecessary. This distinguish-or-homogenize principle identifies a path that existing frameworks for identification, planning, and diagnosis do not make explicit: prior formulations treat the mapping from fault models to acceptable policies as a given, whereas LCPI makes it a function of the agent's own actions. We formalize this principle through Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI), where correctness is evaluated at the state the agent reaches rather than at the initial state. The Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) marks the feasibility boundary between distinguishing and homogenizing. For deterministic diagnostic graphs we provide the Exact-LIM recursion; for noisy finite-horizon recovery we propose Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP), which searches a compatibility-aware frontier under a hard worst-case failure constraint. Across incident recovery on abstract microservice topologies and latent-damage navigation in MiniGrid, RBCP improves risk-feasible recovery while satisfying the failure budget. A sham control--cost-matched actions that preserve model incompatibility--eliminates the gain entirely, confirming that the benefit comes from changing which policies are acceptable for which models, not from extra search or additional budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI) 框架，解决了在不可逆资源耗尽条件下，智能体通过“区分故障模型”或“同质化系统状态”来实现故障恢复的决策问题。核心贡献包括：区分或同质化原则、Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) 可行性边界、确诊图的 Exact-LIM 递归算法、以及有噪有限时域下的 Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP) 算法。实验表明 RBCP 在微服务拓扑恢复和 MiniGrid 导航任务中显著提升风险可行恢复率，且对照实验确认收益源于改变模型-策略兼容性而非额外搜索或预算。
AI.motivation: 现有的识别、规划和诊断框架将故障模型到可接受策略的映射视为固定给定，未显式建模智能体如何通过主动动作改变这一映射。在资源不可逆耗尽的场景下，智能体面临两难：花费资源区分潜在故障模型，还是改变系统状态使剩余模型承认共同可接受的延续策略。需要一种形式化框架在终态而非初态评估正确性，并量化区分与同质化的可行边界。
AI.method: 1. 形式化 LCPI 原则：在智能体到达的终态而非初态评估策略正确性。2. 定义 Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) 作为区分与同质化的可行性边界。3. 针对确诊诊断图提供 Exact-LIM 递归算法精确计算边界。4. 针对有噪有限时域恢复提出 Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP)，在硬性最坏情况故障约束下搜索兼容性感知前沿。5. 设计对照实验：成本匹配但保持模型不兼容的 sham 动作，验证收益来源。
AI.result: 在抽象微服务拓扑的故障恢复和 MiniGrid 潜在损伤导航两个基准上，RBCP 在满足故障预算约束下显著提升风险可行恢复率。Sham 对照实验——使用成本相同但保持模型不兼容的动作——完全消除了性能增益，确认收益源于改变哪些策略对哪些模型可接受（即同质化机制），而非额外搜索深度或预算增加。
AI.conclusion: LCPI 通过将模型-策略兼容性建模为智能体动作的函数而非固定映射，揭示了诊断与规划的新交互范式。LIM 给出了理论可行边界，Exact-LIM 和 RBCP 分别解决了确定性和随机设置下的最优决策。实验验证了主动同质化系统状态以实现共同可接受延续的有效性，为资源受限下的故障恢复提供了原则性方法。

title: ER-JEPA: Experience Replay Improves Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at token-level generation but may learn undesirable abstract semantics and lack comprehensive perception. LLM-JEPA mitigates this by aligning different views of the same underlying knowledge via a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). However, strong alignment does not necessarily lead to accurate, stable predictions. To address this, we propose ER-JEPA, which adds an episodic replay path to LLM-JEPA. ER-JEPA stores training pairs in a memory. At each step, it stores and retrieves relevant data to provide additional supervision. This enables learning from both the current batch and stored training pairs, providing additional supervision for token prediction and representation alignment. Experiments across multiple datasets (NL-RX, GSM8K, Spider, and NQ-Open) demonstrate that ER-JEPA consistently outperforms LLM-JEPA.

AI.tldr: ER-JEPA通过引入情景回放机制增强LLM-JEPA，利用记忆存储和检索训练对提供额外监督，从而在多个基准数据集上持续超越LLM-JEPA。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）在token级生成上表现优异，但可能学到不良的抽象语义且缺乏综合感知。LLM-JEPA通过联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）对齐同一知识的不同视角来缓解此问题，但强对齐不一定能带来准确稳定的预测。
AI.method: ER-JEPA在LLM-JEPA基础上增加情景回放路径：维护一个记忆存储训练对，每步存储并检索相关数据以提供额外监督，使模型能同时从当前批次和存储的训练对学习，强化token预测和表征对齐。
AI.result: 在NL-RX、GSM8K、Spider和NQ-Open四个数据集上的实验表明，ER-JEPA性能持续优于LLM-JEPA。
AI.conclusion: 引入情景回放机制可有效补充JEPA的监督信号，提升模型对抽象语义的学习稳定性和预测准确性，为LLM的表征对齐提供了新思路。

title: Periodic Weak Spots: Phase Sensitivity from Chunked KV-Cache Compression
summary:
Chunked KV-cache compression reduces the memory and attention costs of long-context inference by compressing windows of consecutive tokens into fewer cache entries at a fixed stride. Such compression also introduces a new positional coordinate: a token's phase, or its position relative to compression-window boundaries. We uncover a systematic asymmetry in models using such compression: the same information can be easy to retrieve at one phase and difficult at another. We call this periodic variation in retrieval performance phase sensitivity. In large open-weight models with such compression, long-context retrieval accuracy can differ by up to 40 percentage points across phases, revealing periodic weak spots that average benchmark scores can conceal.
  To investigate this behavior, we pretrain a family of transformers from scratch across multiple KV-compression designs, reproducing phase sensitivity across the variants. Mechanistic analysis using causal interventions in these models reveals phase specialization: different attention components contribute asymmetrically to retrieving information at different source phases. We further analyze idealized retrieval models, showing how gradient flow dynamics may favor sharp phase specialization. Evaluating models with chunked KV-cache compression thus requires measuring across compression phases: high average accuracy can coexist with systematic positional failures.

AI.tldr: 本文发现分块KV缓存压缩引入的“相位敏感性”现象：同一信息在不同压缩窗口相对位置（相位）的检索难度差异高达40%，平均基准分数掩盖了周期性弱点。通过从头预训练多种压缩设计的Transformer并进行因果干预分析，揭示了注意力组件的相位专业化机制，并从梯度流动力学解释其成因，强调评估需覆盖所有压缩相位。
AI.motivation: 分块KV缓存压缩虽降低长上下文推理的内存和注意力开销，但引入了令牌相对压缩窗口边界的“相位”坐标。现有研究未系统探究该压缩对检索性能的周期性影响，平均基准分数可能掩盖特定相位的系统性失效，亟需量化相位敏感性并揭示其机制。
AI.method: 1) 从头预训练一系列采用不同KV压缩设计的Transformer模型，复现相位敏感性；2) 运用因果干预手段进行机制分析，剖析注意力组件在不同源相位检索中的不对称贡献；3) 构建理想化检索模型，从梯度流动力学角度解释相位专业化的形成。
AI.result: 在大规模开放权重模型中，长上下文检索准确率在不同相位间相差高达40个百分点；注意力组件表现出相位专业化，即不同组件对不同源相位信息的检索贡献不对称；梯度流动动力学倾向于产生尖锐的相位专业化。
AI.conclusion: 采用分块KV缓存压缩的模型评估必须跨越所有压缩相位进行测量，因为高平均准确率可能与系统性的位置相关失效并存。相位敏感性揭示了压缩带来的周期性弱点，需在设计和评估压缩方案时显式考虑相位因素。

title: SIPO: Unifying Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for improving large language models (LLMs) on various tasks, yet its sparse outcome rewards lack token-level credit assignment for intermediate steps. To address this, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a self-teacher with privileged context to provide additional dense learning signals. However, because the self-teacher is often overconfident and imposes excessive penalties on long reasoning trajectories, OPSD frequently struggles in practice. To mitigate this, we propose self-instructing policy optimization (SIPO) with a contrastive self-teacher to provide dense credit. At each iteration, SIPO samples multiple rollouts per prompt from the current policy, scores them with environment rewards, and constructs two teacher contexts for each rollout by pairing the reference answer with mistakes made within the group. The model then re-evaluates its own responses under both contexts, using the difference between the two teacher log-probabilities as token-level feedback, so that biases shared by both contexts are expected to largely cancel. The resulting objective yields a token-level advantage for every rollout: the reward still sets the main direction of each update while the self-teacher redistributes credit across tokens. Even in groups where every rollout fails and group-relative advantages vanish, SIPO still provides a learning signal. By preserving direct optimization of the task reward while providing dense, token-level feedback, this approach bridges reinforcement learning and on-policy self-distillation. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that SIPO outperforms both RLVR and OPSD baselines without an external teacher or additional generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Self-Instructing Policy Optimization (SIPO)，一种结合强化学习与在线自蒸馏的新方法，通过对比式自教师提供密集的 token 级反馈，解决 RLVR 稀疏奖励缺乏中间步骤信用分配以及 OPSD 自教师过度自信、过度惩罚长推理轨迹的问题，在多个推理与代码生成基准上超越基线。
AI.motivation: RLVR 虽已成标准范式，但其稀疏的结果奖励无法为中间推理步骤提供 token 级信用分配；OPSD 虽引入自教师提供密集信号，但自教师往往过度自信，对长推理轨迹施加过大惩罚，导致实际效果不佳。需要一种在保留任务奖励直接优化的同时，提供稳健、密集 token 级反馈的方法。
AI.method: SIPO 每轮对每个提示从当前策略采样多条 rollout，用环境奖励打分；为每条 rollout 构建两个教师上下文：一为参考答案，一为组内错误。模型在两个上下文下重新评估自身响应，取两者 log-prob 差值作为 token 级反馈，共享偏见相互抵消。目标函数为每条 rollout 产生 token 级优势：奖励决定更新主方向，自教师在 token 间重新分配信用。即使组内所有 rollout 全失败、群体相对优势消失，SIPO 仍能提供学习信号。无需外部教师或额外生成。
AI.result: 在多个推理与代码生成基准上的大量实验表明，SIPO 在无外部教师、无额外生成开销的情况下，性能均优于 RLVR 与 OPSD 基线。
AI.conclusion: SIPO 通过对比式自教师实现密集 token 级信用分配，成功弥合了基于可验证奖励的强化学习与在线自蒸馏之间的鸿沟，为长推理任务提供了更稳健、高效的训练范式。

title: Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks
summary: System One models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative language models for tasks that require decisions rather than open-ended responses. However, existing Jev models exhibit limited Chinese-language decision accuracy, restricting their utility in both general and specialized settings. In this paper, we introduce Chinese-Jev, a System One model that addresses this gap through a unified data processing and training pipeline. Our data processing protocol converts heterogeneous Chinese-language annotations into probability targets over candidate options, enabling a shared training formulation across domains and question formats. To enable efficient inference, Chinese-Jev adopts a lightweight encoder-only backbone for text encoding and learns to score candidate answers through decision-oriented training. To address the misalignment between the pre-training distribution and downstream Chinese-language scenarios, we first train the model on a general-purpose corpus of 10 million examples, then fine-tune it separately for the medical, legal, and financial domains. To evaluate decision accuracy and calibration in both general and domain-specific Chinese-language settings, we introduce Chinese-Jev Bench (CJ-Bench). After first-stage pre-training, Chinese-Jev exceeds the accuracy of the closed-source Jev model by 1.24% on general-domain tasks while achieving a 20.3x speedup. Subsequent domain-specific fine-tuning yields a 4.0% accuracy improvement over Jev in medicine and achieves 92% of Jev's average accuracy across specialized domains, with a 17x speedup and an average latency of only 15 ms per example. We further demonstrate on-device deployment of an INT8-quantized model on mobile devices, achieving an inference latency of approximately 1.0 second per decision. The project is available at https://gulucaptain.github.io/Chinese-Jev/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Chinese-Jev，一种面向中文决策任务的 System One 模型，通过统一数据处理流水线、轻量级仅编码器架构及两阶段训练（通用域预训练 10M 样本 + 医/法/财三垂直域微调），在通用与垂直领域均超越闭源 Jev 模型，并实现 17-20 倍推理加速，支持移动端 INT8 量化部署。
AI.motivation: 现有 Jev 类 System One 模型在中文决策准确率上表现不足，限制了其在通用及专业领域（医疗、法律、金融）的落地；且缺乏统一的中文评测基准。
AI.method: 1. 统一数据处理：将异构中文标注转换为候选选项上的概率目标，实现跨域/跨题型的共享训练公式。2. 轻量级仅编码器骨干网络编码文本，通过决策导向训练对候选答案打分。3. 两阶段训练：先在 1000 万通用样本上预训练，再分别在医、法、财三领域微调。4. 构建 Chinese-Jev Bench (CJ-Bench) 评测决策准确率与校准性。
AI.result: 预训练后通用任务准确率超闭源 Jev 1.24%，推理加速 20.3 倍；领域微调后医疗准确率提升 4.0%，三垂直域平均达 Jev 92% 准确率，加速 17 倍，平均延迟 15 ms；INT8 量化模型移动端推理约 1.0 秒/决策。
AI.conclusion: Chinese-Jev 以统一流水线、轻量架构与两阶段训练填补了中文 System One 决策模型的空白，在准确率、速度与部署灵活性上均达到实用水平，代码与基准已开源。

title: Reducing the Adaptation Gap Through Reachable Fisher Geometry
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) determines not only how many parameters are trained, but also which local directions a model can move in, so similar adapters can affect subgroup losses differently. Since curvature matrices are infeasible to form at adapter scale, scalar summaries such as the Fisher trace are often used instead. We study what the trace reveals and what it loses through the reachable Fisher: each subgroup's full-model Fisher pulled back through the adapter Jacobian. Under likelihood losses, it represents the Gauss-Newton curvature accessible to the adapter, and its trace can be computed from score-gradient norms without forming the full matrix. Under matched subgroup gradients, a positive-definite reachable-Fisher difference, with a margin exceeding the Hessian-Fisher defect, implies that every sufficiently small nonzero model-changing update increases the signed gap. In contrast, the restricted operator norm determines worst-case quadratic change, while a matrix-free Frobenius discrepancy bounds its reachable-Fisher component. Trace alone cannot certify definiteness or control matrix mismatch. Equal traces rule out a positive-definite difference but can still hide large operator discrepancies. Across 306 single-seed models, higher trace accompanies greater subgroup difficulty in 75.7 percent of 1,218 eligible evaluations, while trace matching reduces the best-worst subgroup gap in all 30 dataset-encoder-adapter combinations. However, held-out audits show that operator discrepancy decreases in 23 of 30 combinations, while the unbiased squared-Frobenius statistic decreases in only 16 of 30. Fisher trace is therefore a scalable diagnostic and training heuristic, but not a certificate of local gap behavior or matrix alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过可达费舍尔矩阵研究参数高效微调（PEFT）中费舍尔迹的诊断能力与局限，发现迹虽可作为可扩展的诊断工具和训练启发式，但无法认证局部间隙行为或矩阵对齐。
AI.motivation: PEFT 适配器不仅决定训练参数量，还限制模型可移动的局部方向，导致相似适配器对子群损失影响不同。由于适配器尺度下曲率矩阵难以构建，常用费舍尔迹等标量摘要代替，但迹究竟揭示了什么、丢失了什么尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出可达费舍尔矩阵：将各子群的全模型费舍尔矩阵通过适配器雅可比回拉。在似然损失下，它代表适配器可访问的高斯-牛顿曲率，其迹可通过分数梯度范数计算而无需构建完整矩阵。理论分析了迹、算子范数、弗罗贝尼乌斯差异与子群间隙的关系；在 306 个单种子模型、1,218 次评估及 30 个数据集-编码器-适配器组合上实证验证。
AI.result: 较高迹在 75.7% 的评估中伴随更大子群难度；迹匹配在所有 30 个组合中均缩小了最佳-最差子群间隙。然而，保留审计显示算子差异仅在 23/30 组合中下降，无偏平方弗罗贝尼乌斯统计量仅在 16/30 组合中下降。
AI.conclusion: 费舍尔迹是一种可扩展的诊断工具和训练启发式，但不能作为局部间隙行为或矩阵对齐的证明。迹无法认证正定性或控制矩阵失配，相等的迹只能排除正定差异，仍可能隐藏巨大的算子差异。

title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for self-evolving agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. However, existing learned skill curators typically optimize curation without explicitly modeling downstream executor behavior.
