We show that this can cause systematic cross-executor degradation: curators trained with different executors perform best when paired with their own training executor, indicating that effective skill curation is executor-dependent. We formulate behavior-adaptive skill curation and introduce EASE, a framework that learns a single curator that adapts its decisions to different executor behaviors. EASE maintains an online behavioral profile of recent execution patterns and conditions the curator on this profile, the current trajectory, and retrieved skills to add, modify, or remove skills from an evolving repository. We train the shared curator jointly across multiple frozen executors with reinforcement learning, using retrieval-aware and behavior-aware temporal attribution to focus optimization on curation actions with observable downstream influence. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, with executors ranging from Qwen3-8B/32B and GPT-OSS-120B to unseen Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, EASE outperforms strong skill- and memory-based baselines without per-executor finetuning. EASE also maintains 34.5--41.0% fewer skills, improves skill retrieval by 36.3--38.7% and measured edit utility by 51.8--60.0%, and reduces deployment-time inference tokens by 9.1--14.5%. These results establish behavior-adaptive skill curation as an effective principle for building self-evolving agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EASE框架，实现行为自适应技能策展，单一策展器可适应不同执行器行为，跨多个环境和执行器优于基线，且技能库更精简、检索更准、编辑效用更高、推理开销更低。
AI.motivation: 现有技能策展器在优化时未显式建模下游执行器行为，导致跨执行器性能下降：策展器与其训练执行器搭配最佳，表明有效策展依赖于执行器。
AI.method: EASE维护在线行为画像记录近期执行模式，将策展器条件化于行为画像、当前轨迹及检索技能，对技能库进行增删改。在多个冻结执行器上联合训练共享策展器，采用强化学习，引入检索感知和行为感知的时序归因，聚焦优化对下游有可观察影响的策展动作。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop上，涵盖Qwen3-8B/32B、GPT-OSS-120B及未见过的Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Gemini 3.5 Flash等执行器，EASE超越强基线，无需逐执行器微调。技能库规模减少34.5-41.0%，检索提升36.3-38.7%，编辑效用提升51.8-60.0%，部署时推理token减少9.1-14.5%。
AI.conclusion: 行为自适应技能策展是构建自我进化智能体的有效原则，EASE通过单一策展器适应多样执行器行为，实现了跨执行器的鲁棒性能提升与资源效率优化。

title: Repetition, Not Length: Isolating the Counting Failure in Neural Text-to-Speech
comment: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027. Code and data: https://github.com/lab260ru/tts-counting-failure
summary: Text-to-speech models loop, truncate and lose count on text that repeats a phrase many times. We show that repetition itself is what breaks them, not the length that comes with it. Every repeated sentence in our test set is paired with a control of matched sentence and word count in which no word ever repeats back-to-back. Six models from three architectures render the controls almost perfectly and fail the repeated twins: 94.3% against 18.2% exactly right at k >= 6. The gap survives greedy decoding, repetition-penalty sweeps, four independent speech recognisers and 420 analysis specifications without once reversing sign; a held-out fourth architecture lands within a point of its predicted gap, and one of two non-autoregressive baselines shows the same failure. Varying the period of the text shows the failure grows smoothly with periodicity, half of it surviving when no word is adjacent to itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了文本到语音（TTS）模型在处理重复文本时的系统性失效现象。实验表明，重复本身而非长度导致模型失效：六个模型在控制句上准确率94.3%，但在重复句上仅18.2%（k≥6）。该现象跨架构、解码策略、惩罚机制及识别器均稳健存在，且随文本周期性平滑增长，甚至非相邻重复也导致一半失效。
AI.motivation: 现有TTS模型在处理包含大量重复短语的文本时会出现循环、截断、计数错误等问题。以往常归因于序列长度过长，但作者假设是重复模式本身破坏了模型的生成机制，而非长度。旨在隔离重复因素，量化其对不同架构TTS模型的影响，并验证该现象的普遍性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建配对测试集：每个重复句子（同一短语重复k≥6次）配对一个控制句（词数、句数匹配，但无词语背靠背重复）。评估六个模型（三种架构）及一个保留的第四架构模型，涵盖自回归与非自回归基线。使用贪婪解码、重复惩罚扫描、四个独立语音识别器（ASR）及420种分析规格进行综合评测，并系统变化文本周期性以观察失效梯度。
AI.result: 控制句近乎完美合成（94.3%完全正确），重复句严重失效（18.2%完全正确），巨大差距在所有解码策略、惩罚设置、ASR及分析规格下均未反转。保留架构落入预测差距±1点内。两个非自回归基线中有一个表现出相同失效模式。失效率随文本周期性平滑上升，即使无相邻词重复，仍有约一半失效保留。
AI.conclusion: TTS模型的根本缺陷在于对重复模式的处理机制失效，而非序列长度限制。该现象具有跨架构、跨解码策略、跨评估条件的普适性，揭示了当前序列生成建模在处理周期性结构时的本质局限。非自回归模型虽部分缓解但未根治。未来需从注意力机制、位置编码或显式重复建模等层面改进。

title: Adapting Linear-Time Architectures for Tabular In-Context Learning
comment: 31 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Code available at https://github.com/schnurrd/ICL-Architectures
summary: Tabular foundation models achieve strong performance by conditioning on labelled examples in context, but softmax attention limits their use on large datasets. Existing linear-time alternatives, however, are mostly causal, and their potential for tabular in-context learning (ICL) remains underexplored. To address this, we (1) revisit causal training setups, (2) compare linear sequence mixers, and (3) investigate their ICL generalisation beyond the pretraining context length. First, we show that the best training setup for causal models resembles next-token prediction. Then, perhaps surprisingly, the most promising linear sequence mixer is causal: DeltaNet outperforms even non-causal linear attention. However, it degrades beyond $2$-$4\times$ the pretraining context length, and existing mitigation strategies such as bidirectionality defer the problem at best. A hidden-state oracle shows that this is not a capacity problem. Instead, our analysis points to an instability in the recurrent state, which drifts in deeper layers of causal models. Since DeltaNet's learned write rates overfit to the pretraining regime, we modulate them with a time-dependent decay schedule intervention to stabilise length generalisation. Finally, re-introducing non-causality by reading out from the final state allows us to closely match a controlled softmax attention baseline on OpenML-CC18 and TabArena.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究表格基础模型中线性注意力机制在上下文学习（ICL）中的泛化能力，发现因果线性混合器DeltaNet在预训练上下文长度内优于非因果线性注意力，但会在超出预训练长度2-4倍时性能下降，通过时间相关衰减调度稳定隐藏状态并引入非因果读出，最终达到与Softmax注意力相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型依赖Softmax注意力处理上下文学习，但在大规模数据集上受限于二次复杂度。现有线性时间替代方案多为因果结构，其在表格ICL任务中的潜力尚未充分探索，特别是长度泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 1) 重新审视因果训练设置，发现类似next-token prediction的设置最优。2) 对比多种线性序列混合器，确认DeltaNet为最有效的因果混合器。3) 分析长度泛化失效原因，定位到深层因果模型中隐藏状态的不稳定漂移。4) 提出时间相关衰减调度干预写入率以稳定状态，并通过最终状态的非因果读出恢复双向信息流。
AI.result: DeltaNet在预训练上下文长度内超越非因果线性注意力，但在超出2-4倍长度时性能急剧下降；隐状态预言实验表明非容量问题，而是深层隐状态漂移导致的不稳定。引入衰减调度和非因果读出后，在OpenML-CC18和TabArena基准上接近Softmax注意力基线性能。
AI.conclusion: 因果线性注意力可高效实现表格ICL，但需解决长度泛化中的隐状态不稳定性。通过显式衰减调度和最终状态的非因果读出，可兼顾线性复杂度与双向建模能力，为大规模表格基础模型提供可行路径。

title: Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing via Preference Optimization
summary: Knowledge editing enables rapid updates of specific factual knowledge in large language models (LLMs) without full retraining. However, more realistic scenarios call for a lifelong framework that handles continual updates rather than one-off modifications. In such settings, existing editing methods often overfit to target prompts, significantly degrading both the generalization of the edited knowledge and the model's general capabilities. To address this issue, we propose GLIME (Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing), which combines knowledge editing with preference optimization over generation behavior. GLIME further incorporates replay-based editing and a gradient constraint to preserve previously edited knowledge. Experimental results show that GLIME significantly improves knowledge generalization in lifelong editing settings while maintaining both editing performance and general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GLIME（通用终身模型编辑），解决现有知识编辑方法在终身编辑场景下过拟合目标提示词、导致泛化能力下降和通用能力受损的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑方法主要针对一次性修改，但在更现实的终身编辑场景（持续更新）中，这些方法往往过拟合目标提示词，严重降低编辑知识的泛化能力和模型的通用能力。
AI.method: GLIME结合知识编辑与生成行为的偏好优化，并引入基于重放的编辑机制和梯度约束，以保留先前编辑的知识。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GLIME在终身编辑设置下显著提升了知识泛化能力，同时保持了编辑性能和通用能力。
AI.conclusion: GLIME通过偏好优化、重放编辑和梯度约束，有效解决了终身知识编辑中的过拟合和灾难性遗忘问题，实现了更好的泛化和稳定性。

title: AMU:Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations---Structured Memory with SLM Guided Control
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures. Source code and implementation are available at: https://github.com/UnicusT11/AMU-memory
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become the foundation of personalized assistants, but maintaining persistent user memory across long-term interactions remains challenging. Existing memory systems often focus on storage, retrieval, or consolidation, while memory writing remains less controlled: transient requests, duplicate statements, and outdated user states may enter memory and later be retrieved for personalization. In this paper, we present AMU: Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations, an SLM-guided (Small language model guided) structured framework for writing-time memory control. AMU uses structured memory filtering to decide what should enter memory and SLM-guided storage management to determine whether an admitted record should be stored separately, discarded as a duplicate, or fused as an update. We evaluate AMU in a controlled memory writing and retrieval setting. Experimental results show that AMU maintains cleaner and more retrievable personalized memories.

AI.tldr: 提出AMU（Admission and Memory Update）框架，利用小语言模型（SLM）指导的结构化记忆写入控制，解决长期交互中个性化记忆维护的挑战，实现更清洁、可检索的记忆。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统主要关注存储、检索或巩固，而记忆写入环节控制不足：瞬态请求、重复陈述、过时用户状态等噪声数据易进入记忆，后续被检索用于个性化，降低记忆质量。
AI.method: AMU包含两大组件：1) 结构化记忆过滤——判断何种信息应进入记忆；2) SLM引导的存储管理——对通过过滤的记录决定单独存储、丢弃重复、或融合更新。整个框架在写入时刻即进行控制。
AI.result: 在受控的记忆写入与检索实验设置中，AMU能维护更清洁、更易检索的个性化记忆，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: AMU为写入阶段的记忆控制提供了有效的结构化框架，通过SLM指导的过滤与存储管理，显著提升长期交互中个性化记忆的质量与可用性。

title: Explainability from Training with Applications to TCR-Epitope Prediction
summary: Deep learning models have achieved strong performance in artificial intelligence for science, yet their black-box nature limits our understanding of how they learn scientific tasks. Existing methods for interpretability provide limited insight into how models organize evidence and evolve during learning. We introduce explainability from training (EFT), a model-agnostic paradigm that traces model interpretation during training to explain why models rely on specific features and how they organize these features as predictive evidence. We apply EFT to four state-of-the-art T cell receptor (TCR)-epitope prediction models, TCR-SRIM, TULIP, MixTCRpred, and NetTCR-2.2, spanning post-hoc and interpret-by-design approaches as well as transformers and CNNs. To investigate how structural information affects model explanations, we introduce a benchmark, TCR-XAI2, containing 388 unique experimentally resolved TCR-epitope structures, complemented by structures predicted using AlphaFold3, Boltz-2, TCRModel2, tFold-TCR, and OpenFold3. Using EFT with TCR-XAI2, we demonstrate that (1) CNN and transformer models exhibit distinct learning trajectories; (2) TCR $α$ and $β$ evidence can conflict during learning, limiting the benefits of jointly modeling both chains, while MHC information mitigates this; and (3) real versus predicted structural data for TCR-epitope prediction exhibits distinct TCR and peptide feature preferences as well as differing trajectories of model certainty.

AI.tldr: 论文提出解释性训练（EFT）范式，追踪模型训练过程中的解释演变，揭示特征依赖与组织方式。将其应用于四种TCR-表位预测模型，并构建包含388个实验结构及多种预测结构的TCR-XAI2基准。发现CNN与Transformer学习轨迹差异显著；TCR α/β链证据冲突限制联合建模收益，MHC信息可缓解；真实与预测结构数据在特征偏好与确定性演变上存在差异。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在科学AI中表现优异，但黑箱特性限制了对其学习机制的理解。现有解释性方法难以揭示模型如何组织证据及随训练演变。需一种模型无关的范式，从训练动态角度解释特征依赖与证据组织。
AI.method: 提出EFT（Explainability from Training）范式，追踪训练过程中的模型解释。应用于四种最先进TCR-表位预测模型（TCR-SRIM、TULIP、MixTCRpred、NetTCR-2.2），涵盖事后解释与设计时解释、Transformer与CNN架构。构建TCR-XAI2基准，包含388个实验解析的TCR-表位复合物结构，并辅以AlphaFold3、Boltz-2、TCRModel2、tFold-TCR、OpenFold3预测的结构。结合EFT与TCR-XAI2进行系统分析。
AI.result: 1. CNN与Transformer模型呈现明显不同的学习轨迹。2. TCR α链与β链的证据在训练中可能冲突，限制联合建模的收益，而MHC信息可缓解该冲突。3. 真实结构与预测结构数据在TCR与肽段特征偏好、模型确定性演变轨迹上存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: EFT范式结合TCR-XAI2基准，为深度学习模型在TCR-表位预测任务中的学习动态提供了细粒度解释，揭示了架构差异、链间证据冲突及结构数据来源对模型行为的影响，为提升模型可解释性与鲁棒性提供了新视角。

title: Emergent Specialization in Populations of Self-Supervised Collaborative Vision Experts Without a Shared Gate or Cross-Agent Gradients
summary: Can a population of neural networks develop a useful division of labor without a shared gate or gradients between agents? We study a setting where each network has its own weights, trains independently on the same heterogeneous data, and can ask another agent for help through a forward pass. Unlike mixtures of experts, where a jointly trained gate assigns inputs to experts, specialization here must emerge without central control. We test this in a small scale proxy for predictive visual pretraining. Initially identical agents are finetuned on an unlabeled mixture of six visual domains using masked prediction of frozen DINOv3 features. We measure specialization by asking whether the best agent for an input aligns with its latent domain, and utilization by asking whether responsibility is distributed across agents. We progressively remove central control, ending with DISCO (DIStributed COllaboration) where each agent locally selects a helper, reads its internal state through a gradient free channel, and rewards its router only for the improvement that help provides. Specialization emerges and is useful. Randomly routed populations underperform a single generalist, while semantically routed populations outperform it, showing that specialization rather than population size drives the gain. Specialization persists without a central router, and gradient free communication lets nonexperts exploit emergent expertise. In DISCO, a random agent helped by the expert matches the solo generalist, while experts surpass it, including on data outside the specialization mixture. Local routers select the emergent expert for 98% of inputs. These effects persist across population size, model capacity, data imbalance, and finetuning seeds, providing measurable evidence for the dynamics needed by decentralized predictive pretraining.

AI.tldr: 论文研究神经网络种群在无共享门控或梯度的情况下能否自发形成有用的分工，提出 DISCO（去中心化协作）框架，实验表明语义路由下的专业化分工优于单一通用模型，且无需中心控制即可涌现并持久化。
AI.motivation: 探究神经网络种群是否能在没有中心化门控机制或梯度共享的前提下，自发发展出有用的分工协作，即去中心化预测式预训练所需的动力学机制。
AI.method: 以小规模预测式视觉预训练为代理任务，初始相同的智能体在六个视觉领域的无标签混合数据上微调，采用冻结 DINOv3 特征的掩码预测目标。逐步移除中心控制，最终实现 DISCO：每个智能体局部选择助手，通过无梯度通道读取其内部状态，仅根据助力带来的性能提升奖励路由器。
AI.result: 专业化分工涌现且有效：随机路由种群逊于单一通用模型，语义路由种群超越通用模型，证明增益源于专业化而非种群规模。无中心路由时专业化依然持续，无梯度通信让非专家利用涌现的专业知识。DISCO 中随机智能体在专家协助下匹配单独通用模型，专家甚至超越通用模型（含域外数据）。局部路由器以 98% 准确率选择涌现专家。效果在种群规模、模型容量、数据不平衡、微调种子等变量下均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 实验提供了可度量的证据，证明去中心化预测式预训练所需的专业化分工动力学可在无中心控制、无梯度共享条件下自发涌现并稳定维持，DISCO 框架验证了这一可行路径。

title: SRJudge: Empowering Large Language Models with Selective Reasoning for Fine-Grained Knowledge Concept Tagging
summary: Knowledge concept tagging aims to assign specific concept or topic labels to educational content, which is essential for both educators and learners in traditional and online teaching practices. Recent work has explored large language models (LLMs) for this task, achieving promising performance. However, LLMs still struggle to select the correct concept from a large-scale candidate set due to the high dimensionality of the decision space. In this paper, we propose a novel three-stage Select-Reason-Judge (SRJudge) framework, which empowers LLMs with selective reasoning capability for fine-grained knowledge concept tagging. Specifically, the Selector in Stage 1 first narrows the candidate concepts to a top-K shortlist by fine-tuning a small language model (SLM), e.g., BERT, since the top-$K$ predictions hit the correct concept in most cases, thereby reducing the decision space of correct candidates. Next, the Stage 2 Reasoner employs a lightweight LLM for refined reasoning over the shortlisted candidates. It further integrates an improved reinforcement learning strategy with a dynamic task-specific reward function and a pruning mechanism to better align with human reasoning preferences. Finally, a larger LLM acts as a judger that evaluates the overall rationality of the reasoning process and its explanations to determine the final output. In addition, we construct two high-quality datasets for further validation, i.e., the biology dataset S_Bio and the physics dataset S_Phy. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across benchmark datasets, verifying its effectiveness and superiority. Resources are available at: https://github.com/Nicozwy/SRJudge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三阶段 SRJudge 框架（选择-推理-评判），利用小模型缩小候选概念集、轻量 LLM 进行强化学习增强推理、大模型评判最终结果，解决大规模知识概念标注中决策空间过大的问题，在生物和物理两个新构建数据集上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 知识概念标注需从大规模候选集中选出正确概念，现有大语言模型（LLM）因决策空间高维而难以准确选择，亟需一种能有效缩小候选空间并保证推理质量的方法。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：1) Selector 阶段微调小语言模型（如 BERT）输出 Top-K 候选，大幅降低决策空间；2) Reasoner 阶段使用轻量 LLM 对候选进行精细推理，引入动态任务特定奖励函数与剪枝机制的强化学习策略，使推理更符合人类偏好；3) Judger 阶段由更大 LLM 评估推理过程与解释的合理性，给出最终标签。另构建 S_Bio 和 S_Phy 两个高质量数据集用于验证。
AI.result: 实验表明 SRJudge 在基准数据集上持续优于最先进基线，验证了方法的有效性与优越性。
AI.conclusion: SRJudge 通过选择-推理-评判的协作范式，成功解决了大规模知识概念标注中的高维决策难题，且强化学习增强的推理阶段显著提升了与人类推理的一致性，为教育内容自动标注提供了可落地的解决方案。

title: AdaKerNet: Neural Kernel Decoding for Task-Adaptive Prediction with Multimodal Large Models
summary: Large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. Yet, under limited supervision, MLLMs, an important class of large foundation models, remain challenging to adapt to various downstream tasks. Adaptation typically relies either on MLLM parameter fine-tuning or on training neural-based decoders. Both approaches struggle under limited supervision, while fine-tuning additionally requires access to model parameters, which is often unavailable for closed-source models. We introduce AdaKerNet, a novel learnable task-adaptive neural kernel decoder. AdaKerNet is fully agnostic to the parameters of the underlying MLLM and operates solely on its (frozen) rich representations obtained from the diverse available modalities. AdaKerNet relies on (i) a set of learnable, Lipschitz-controlled multimodal features derived from these MLLM representations; (ii) a reference kernel that provides a soft structural prior on those features; and (iii) a lightweight nonlinear neural predictor that adaptively deforms that structure. Learning the kernel representation and the neural predictor jointly within a unified optimization framework allows AdaKerNet to capture features and geometric relationships relevant to the downstream task. Numerical tests across four MLLMs: BLIP-2, LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and Gemini Embedding 2, and multimodal inputs spanning text, audio, images, and tabular measurements demonstrate significant and consistent improvements over direct MLP, attention-, autoencoder- and kernel-based decoders, across a range of scarce-label budgets, with average error reduction of up to 41% across baselines. These results establish AdaKerNet as an effective approach for prediction from frozen multimodal representations in the scarce label regime. Additional structural ablations highlight the complementary contributions of AdaKerNet's components.

AI.tldr: 一种针对冻结多模态大模型的可学习任务自适应神经核解码器，在标签稀缺下显著提升下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型适配方法依赖参数微调或训练神经解码器，在有限监督下表现不佳，且微调需要模型参数访问权限（闭源模型不可用）。需要一种无需模型参数、仅利用冻结多模态表示、在稀疏标签下有效的适配方法。
AI.method: AdaKerNet包含三个核心组件：(1) 从MLLM冻结表示中提取的可学习、Lipschitz约束的多模态特征；(2) 提供软结构先验的参考核；(3) 轻量级非线性神经预测器，自适应变形核结构。联合优化核表示和神经预测器，捕捉任务相关特征和几何关系。
AI.result: 在四个MLLM（BLIP-2, LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, Gemini Embedding 2）和多模态输入（文本、音频、图像、表格）上实验，跨多种稀疏标签预算，平均误差较基线降低高达41%，持续优于MLP、注意力、自编码器和基于核的解码器。消融实验验证各组件互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: AdaKerNet是一种有效利用冻结多模态基础模型表示进行稀缺标签下预测的方法，无需模型参数访问，通过联合学习核表示和自适应预测器实现任务自适应，显著提升下游任务性能。

title: Code4Scene: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Constructing and Editing 3D Scenes
summary: Frontier coding agents can now write and execute code that authors 3D environments, but whether they reliably understand 3D structure and precisely control scene state remains unclear. The generated 3D scene is a persistent, executable artifact: a convincing render can hide incorrect spatial relations, intersecting objects, or unintended modifications. We introduce Code4Scene, a benchmark of 190 Unreal Engine cases built from human-assembled scenes that evaluates coding agents on two complementary settings under a shared execution interface. Construction tests scene-level spatial reasoning from open-ended language specifications, where many realizations are valid; editing tests precise control of scene state, where the agent must recover the target scene from reference images while preserving everything else. Rather than scoring code or rendered views, Code4Scene evaluates the generated engine-native scene for task fulfillment, artifact integrity, and static physical validity, with edits additionally compared against withheld ground truth. Across 14 coding-agent configurations on the 95-case public set, construction and editing performance are strongly correlated but not interchangeable (Spearman $ρ= 0.78$): Claude Fable 5.1 leads construction, Gemini 3.8 Flash leads editing, and GPT-6 Astra narrowly leads overall. Spatial Composition is the weakest construction category for every agent, while editing remains imprecise: the best Repair F1 is only 0.527, and 35.8% of edits that fully recover the target still introduce unintended changes elsewhere in the scene. These results expose a gap between plausible 3D generation and reliable spatial reasoning and state control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Code4Scene基准，基于190个人工组装的Unreal Engine场景，评估编码代理在3D场景构建（空间推理）和编辑（精确状态控制）两项任务上的表现。评估直接针对引擎原生场景，考察任务完成度、制品完整性和静态物理有效性。实验显示构建与编辑性能强相关（Spearman ρ=0.78）但不可互换：Claude Fable 5.1在构建最优，Gemini 3.8 Flash在编辑最优，GPT-6 Astra总体领先。所有代理在空间组合类别最弱；编辑仍不精确，最佳修复F1仅0.527，35.8%完全恢复目标的编辑仍会引入非预期变更。揭示了似是而非的3D生成与可靠空间推理/状态控制之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 前沿编码代理虽能编写并执行生成3D环境的代码，但其是否可靠理解3D结构、精确控制场景状态尚不清楚。渲染结果可能掩盖错误的空间关系、物体相交或非预期修改。因此需要一个基于可执行、持久化引擎原生场景的基准，直接评估空间推理与状态控制能力。
AI.method: 构建Code4Scene基准：190个Unreal Engine案例，源自人工组装场景。包含两个互补设置：Construction（构建）从开放语言规范进行场景级空间推理，允许多种有效实现；Editing（编辑）从参考图像恢复目标场景，同时保留其余部分不变。共享执行接口。评估指标：任务完成度、制品完整性、静态物理有效性；编辑额外与保留的真值对比。在95个公开案例上测试14种编码代理配置。
AI.result: 构建与编辑性能强相关（Spearman ρ=0.78）但不可互换。Claude Fable 5.1引领构建，Gemini 3.8 Flash引领编辑，GPT-6 Astra总体略微领先。空间组合是所有代理最弱的构建类别。编辑仍不精确：最佳修复F1仅0.527；35.8%完全恢复目标的编辑仍在场景其他处引入非预期变更。
AI.conclusion: 结果暴露了看似合理的3D生成与可靠的空间推理、精确状态控制之间的显著差距。当前代理在空间组合推理和编辑精度上均存在明显不足，未来工作需着重提升对3D结构的深层理解与精细控制能力。

title: CypherTurn: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Conversational Text-to-Cypher Evaluation and the Autonomy Divergence
comment: Accepted as an oral paper at EMNLP 2026
summary: Graph databases are increasingly queried through natural language, yet every existing benchmark evaluates isolated single-turn queries rather than the multi-turn sessions through which analysts actually work. We introduce CypherTurn, the first benchmark for conversational Text-to-Cypher evaluation, comprising 721 sessions and 5,927 turns across 7 knowledge graphs and 13 conversational phenomena. We evaluate 15 models under a guided oracle protocol and a fully autonomous agentic protocol, yielding four findings. First, the best model reaches only 64.7% execution accuracy, and session-level correctness remains below 5%. Second, despite strong overall rank correlation, frontier models exhibit a consequential reordering of the top of the leaderboard under autonomous operation, a phenomenon we term the Autonomy Divergence, which reveals error-management as a partially independent capability from raw generation skill. Third, scaling action budgets from x3 to x10 fails to close the autonomy gap, as the strongest frontier models self-limit to approximately two actions per turn regardless of available budget. Fourth, single-turn Cypher fine-tuning degrades multi-turn instruction following, while architecture-appropriate specialization outperforms several frontier models. These results establish CypherTurn as an open challenge for conversational graph database reasoning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/BarryQ/CypherTurn.

AI.tldr: CypherTurn 是首个面向对话式 Text-to-Cypher 的基准，包含 7 个知识图谱、721 个会话、5,927 轮对话及 13 种会话现象。在引导式预言协议与全自主智能体协议下评测 15 个模型，发现：最佳模型执行准确率仅 64.7%，会话级正确率不足 5%；前沿模型在自主运行下榜单顶端出现显著重排（自主性分歧），揭示错误管理能力与生成能力部分独立；扩大动作预算无法缩小自主性差距，强模型自我限制在每轮约两次动作；单轮 Cypher 微调损害多轮指令跟随，而架构适配的专业化模型超越多个前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅评估孤立的单轮查询，无法反映分析师实际工作中的多轮会话场景；缺乏对话式图数据库推理的系统性评测标准。
AI.method: 构建 CypherTurn 基准（7 知识图谱、721 会话、5,927 轮、13 种会话现象）；采用引导式预言协议与全自主智能体协议双轨评测 15 个模型；分析执行准确率、会话级正确率、自主性分歧、动作预算缩放效应及微调策略影响。
AI.result: 1) 最佳模型执行准确率 64.7%，会话级正确率 <5%。2) 自主运行下前沿模型榜单顶端重排（自主性分歧），错误管理能力与生成能力部分独立。3) 动作预算从 3 倍增至 10 倍无法缩小自主性差距，强模型自我限制约 2 次动作/轮。4) 单轮 Cypher 微调降低多轮指令跟随能力，架构适配专业化模型优于多个前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: CypherTurn 确立了对话式图数据库推理的开放挑战，揭示了当前模型在多轮交互、错误恢复、自主决策预算利用及专业化训练策略上的根本局限，为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。

title: Neural Succession: A Mesoscopic Theory of Invasion, Coexistence, and Stabilization in Continual Learning
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/shoaibdipu/Neural_Succession/
summary: Continual learning is usually studied through mechanisms that preserve old knowledge. We develop Successional Learning Theory (SLT), a mesoscopic account in which the current representation is a resident community, the incoming task is an invader, forgetting is resident displacement, joint retention is coexistence, replay is resident reinforcement, and training moves from establishment toward stabilization. Its empirical coordinate is directional pre-invasion compatibility, measured on the resident model before the incoming task is learned. Across eight experiments, compatibility orders later forgetting on the 20 directed Split-CIFAR-10 transitions (three-repeat r=-0.789, incoming-task cluster 95% CI [-0.90,-0.72], every repeat alone r<=-0.67), forecasts held-out forgetting with 24% lower error than a no-information baseline, and reproduces under controlled MNIST permutations and CIFAR-10 rotations (r=-0.804, -0.718). On an 84-transition suite, compatibility separates coexistence from exclusion at every retention threshold (AUC 0.93-0.97). Replay repairs every transition with at most 325 stored examples and is most efficient where displacement is largest. Compatibility reaches |r|=0.720, while activation, representation, Jacobian, and fixed-coefficient Lotka-Volterra specializations do not. Plasticity and feature turnover fall reliably from early to late training (15/15 and 14/15 runs). We formalize a minimum habitat-modification bound, a displacement floor, a sufficient coexistence condition, an identifiability law with a range-restriction corollary, successional stabilization, and local reinforcement. The identifiability law also predicts where the coordinate loses leverage, and the prediction matches three CIFAR-100 partitions and five optimizer regimes. SLT is a pre-adaptation diagnostic that complements replay, regularization, and projection methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了演替学习理论（SLT），一种用于持续学习的中观理论框架，将持续学习建模为生态演替过程：当前表示为居民群落，新任务为入侵者，遗忘为居民置换，联合保持为共存，重放为居民强化。核心贡献是提出了“定向入侵前兼容性”这一经验坐标，可在学习新任务前预测遗忘程度和共存可能性。
AI.motivation: 持续学习通常通过保留旧知识的机制来研究，但缺乏一个能在任务学习前预测遗忘和共存的统一理论框架。现有方法多为事后补救（如重放、正则化、投影），缺乏事前诊断工具来判断任务间的兼容性和潜在冲突。
AI.method: 开发演替学习理论（SLT），引入生态学隐喻建模持续学习动态。核心度量是定向入侵前兼容性，在居民模型上于新任务学习前测量。形式化了最小生境修改界、置换底线、充分共存条件、可识别性定律及其范围限制推论、演替稳定化和局部强化等理论结果。在Split-CIFAR-10、MNIST排列、CIFAR-10旋转、CIFAR-100分区及多种优化器制度下进行大规模实证验证。
AI.result: 跨8个实验，兼容性在20个有向Split-CIFAR-10转换上排序后续遗忘（三次重复r=-0.789，入侵任务聚类95% CI [-0.90,-0.72]，每次重复单独r≤-0.67）；预测保留遗忘比无信息基线误差降低24%；在受控MNIST排列和CIFAR-10旋转中复现（r=-0.804, -0.718）。在84转换套件上，兼容性在每个保留阈值下分离共存与排斥（AUC 0.93-0.97）。重放以最多325存储样本修复每个转换，在位移最大处最高效。兼容性达|r|=0.720，而激活、表示、雅可比和固定系数Lotka-Volterra特化版本均不达标。可塑性和特征周转率从早期到晚期训练可靠下降（15/15和14/15运行）。可识别性定律预测坐标失效区域，与三个CIFAR-100分区和五种优化器制度匹配。
AI.conclusion: SLT提供了一个持续学习的演替理论框架，兼容性作为预适应诊断工具，能在任务学习前预测遗忘和共存，补充了重放、正则化和投影等事后方法。理论形式化了关键定律并经实证验证，为持续学习提供了可解释的预测性理论基础。

title: Aperture: Merge-Consistent Rotary States for Compressed Tokens
summary: Token compression combines content from several positions, yet rotary position embeddings usually assign the merged token one coordinate. We ask what positional information must survive later merges. Aperture stores Fourier moments of the token's weighted support at the model's rotary frequencies. We prove that these moments have minimal real dimension among continuous states sufficient for the selected expected rotary interactions. Represented mass makes updates additive; attention normalisation remains a separate readout choice. Uniform intervals give a centre rotation times a sinc gain. We characterise when centres determine interval widths and construct matched examples where they do not. Numerical checks verify the weighted-support implementation. In trained temporal readers, compression transfer varies with gain calibration and feature placement. In a prespecified native video question-answering comparison, stored support reaches $65.63\%$ accuracy versus $67.12\%$ for the deployed merging rule. These results separate exact positional preservation under compression from downstream benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Aperture 方法，通过存储令牌加权支撑在旋转频率下的傅里叶矩来实现位置感知的令牌压缩，证明这些矩是在连续状态中保留期望旋转交互所需的最小实维度表示。实验表明，在视频问答任务中，该方法达到 65.63% 准确率，接近部署的合并规则 67.12%，揭示了精确位置保留与下游收益的分离。
AI.motivation: 现有令牌压缩方法在合并多个位置内容时，通常仅为合并后的令牌分配单一位置坐标，导致位置信息丢失。需要一种能在压缩过程中保留关键位置信息的方法，同时保持计算效率。
AI.method: Aperture 方法：在模型的旋转频率下计算令牌加权支撑的傅里叶矩作为位置状态；证明这些矩具有最小实维度且足以保留期望的旋转交互；质量表示使更新具有加法性；注意力归一化作为单独的读出选择。对于均匀区间，可分解为中心旋转乘以 sinc 增益；分析中心何时决定区间宽度并构造反例。
AI.result: 数值验证加权支撑实现的正确性。在训练的时间读取器中，压缩迁移性随增益校准和特征放置而变化。在预设的原生视频问答对比中，存储支撑法达到 65.63% 准确率，部署的合并规则为 67.12%。结果表明精确位置保留不直接等同于下游任务收益。
AI.conclusion: Aperture 通过傅里叶矩实现了理论最优的位置信息压缩，在保持位置交互精度的同时揭示了位置保真度与任务性能的非单调关系，为高效位置感知压缩提供了新范式。

title: LatCom: Cross-Agent Latent Compression for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly use latent collaboration to avoid the information loss and repeated encoding-decoding overhead of natural-language communication. However, directly forwarding all sender latents makes the receiver-side context scale with both the number of agents and the reasoning length, increasing computation, memory usage, and collaboration latency. A natural solution is latent compression. But we find that cross-agent redundancy remains unresolved in existing latent compression approaches, which typically compress each sender independently and then concatenate the results. We propose LatCom, a cross-agent latent compression framework for efficient multi-agent latent collaboration. LatCom maps multiple sender latents into a fixed number of receiver-readable and task-relevant slots. Rather than reconstructing all sender hidden states, it optimizes the compressed latents for receiver-side task utility. LatCom trains the compressor in two stages: single-sender readability learning first establishes a latent interface interpretable by the frozen receiver, and multi-sender fusion learning then trains the compressor to fuse complementary evidence and remove redundancy across agents. Experiments on multiple benchmarks with Qwen3-4B show that LatCom achieves an average 2.46x inference speed-up over LatentMAS and reduces output token usage by 70.3% while maintaining comparable average accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LatCom跨智能体潜在压缩框架，解决多智能体潜在协作中的跨智能体冗余问题，通过两阶段训练将多个发送者潜在态压缩为固定数量的接收者可读任务相关槽位，在Qwen3-4B上实现2.46倍推理加速和70.3%输出token减少且保持精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统采用潜在协作避免自然语言通信的信息损失和编解码开销，但直接转发所有发送者潜在态会导致接收端上下文随智能体数量和推理长度线性增长，增加计算、内存和延迟。现有潜在压缩方法独立压缩每个发送者再拼接，无法消除跨智能体冗余。
AI.method: LatCom框架包含两阶段训练：1) 单发送者可读性学习，建立冻结接收者可解释的潜在接口；2) 多发送者融合学习，训练压缩器融合互补证据并去除跨智能体冗余。将多发送者潜在态映射为固定数量的接收者可读任务相关槽位，直接优化压缩潜在态的接收端任务效用而非重建所有发送者隐状态。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上使用Qwen3-4B实验表明，LatCom相比LatentMAS实现平均2.46倍推理加速，输出token使用量减少70.3%，同时保持相当的平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: LatCom通过跨智能体联合压缩和任务导向优化，有效解决了多智能体潜在协作中的冗余和扩展性问题，为高效多智能体协作提供了实用的压缩方案。

title: Reward-rate Policy Gradient for Efficient Machine Learning Engineering Agents
summary: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) techniques focus on maximizing expected cumulative reward, where each action assumes to take a constant unit of time. However, this assumption does not hold for agentic RL tasks such as machine learning engineering (MLE) agents, where actions involve data loading, feature engineering, and model training that take variable durations. Efficiency matters in modern agentic RL where actions are costly. To address this limitation, we adapt from continuous-time RL and Semi-Markov Decision Process (SMDP) formulation and propose Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG), where we focus on optimizing the reward rate -- the long-term reward per unit of time. RPG estimates the reward rate from off-policy samples, then charges each action for the time it consumes at that rate. We first conduct theoretical analysis in the bandit setting to establish that RPG approximates the optimal reward rate and empirically demonstrate it outperforms baselines while avoiding enumeration over the policy space, a known issue for an existing method. We then further apply RPG on a small language model (Qwen3.5-4B) with self-improvement loops and empirically show it obtains higher rewards within a fixed time budget than vanilla RL on MLE-Bench and NanoGPT, with a 19.2% and 85.7% margin, respectively. Our method provides a practical solution for optimizing performance under wait time considerations in modern agentic RL tasks, where actions interact with external environments and cost time.

AI.tldr: 本文针对传统强化学习假设动作耗时恒定的局限，提出基于半马尔可夫决策过程(SMDP)的Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG)，优化长期单位时间奖励率，在MLE-Bench和NanoGPT基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体RL任务（如机器学习工程代理）中，动作涉及数据加载、特征工程、模型训练等外部环境交互，耗时可变且昂贵。传统RL最大化累积奖励而忽略时间成本，无法适应此类场景，亟需优化单位时间奖励率以提升效率。
AI.method: 借鉴连续时间RL与SMDP建模，提出RPG算法：利用离策略样本估计奖励率，按该费率为每个动作消耗的时间计费，从而直接优化奖励率目标。理论上在多臂老虎机设定下证明RPG能逼近最优奖励率，且避免了现有方法需枚举策略空间的问题。实验中将RPG应用于Qwen3.5-4B小语言模型并结合自我改进循环。
AI.result: 在固定时间预算下，RPG在MLE-Bench上比普通RL获得高19.2%的奖励，在NanoGPT上高85.7%。实证表明RPG优于基线方法，且不需要策略空间枚举。
AI.conclusion: RPG为考虑等待时间成本的现代智能体RL任务提供了一种实用且理论有保证的解决方案，能有效优化动作与外部环境交互时的时间-性能权衡。

title: AI as a Compiler: Compiling Triton kernels without the Triton compiler
summary: Compiler backends are expensive to build and maintain as programming models, workloads, and accelerators evolve. We investigate whether large language models can replace the conventional optimizing and lowering pipeline, a process that we call AI lowering. We study AI lowering from Triton to NVIDIA PTX: an LLM agent translates Triton kernels directly into PTX. We build an environment that evaluates candidate PTX, and an agentic harness in which an LLM translates Triton kernels into PTX. Across twelve common kernels on Ada, Hopper, and Blackwell GPUs and ten kernels from recent ML papers, AI lowering achieves 0.83x-3.34x the performance of autotuned Triton. The largest gains come from transformations that Triton's lowering pipeline does not perform, such as decoding packed binary weights directly into Tensor Core operands (3.34x on BitDelta), assigning each thread a complete softmax row in tensor memory (1.37x on FlashAttention), and reusing overlapping convolution windows (up to 2.23x). These results rely on a robust evaluation harness with comprehensive verification support. We build on Volta, an existing PTX verifier, and substantially extend it to support modern GPU architectures by introducing support for Blackwell's tcgen05 Tensor Core interface. This requires modeling three architectural features: managed tensor memory, descriptor-based operand layouts, and asynchronous execution coordinated through commits, waits, memory barriers, and proxy fences. We discuss the challenges involved in formalizing them, as well as the current limitations. Our results suggest an emerging future in which AI compilers replace custom-written intermediate representations and checkers, reducing the time and engineering effort required to bring up software for new general-purpose and custom chips.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）直接将Triton内核翻译为NVIDIA PTX汇编，替代传统编译器后端的优化与降级流程，并构建了评估与验证环境。实验显示在多种GPU架构和内核上，AI降级性能达到自动调优Triton的0.83-3.34倍，最大增益源于Triton流水线未执行的变换（如直接解码打包二进制权重到Tensor Core、每线程处理完整Softmax行、复用重叠卷积窗口）。同时扩展Volta验证器支持Blackwell的tcgen05接口，建模了托管张量内存、描述符操作数布局及异步执行协调机制。
AI.motivation: 传统编译器后端构建维护成本高，难以跟上编程模型、负载和加速器的快速演进。研究旨在探索LLM能否替代人工编写的中间表示与优化流水线，降低新芯片软件栈的工程投入。
AI.method: 构建AI降级代理：LLM将Triton内核直接翻译为PTX；建立评估环境验证候选PTX正确性与性能；在Ada、Hopper、Blackwell三代GPU上测试12个常用内核及10个近期ML论文内核。扩展Volta PTX验证器，引入对Blackwell tcgen05 Tensor Core接口的支持，形式化建模托管张量内存、基于描述符的操作数布局、以及通过commit/wait/内存屏障/proxy fence协调的异步执行。
AI.result: AI降级在测试内核上达到自动调优Triton性能的0.83x-3.34倍。最大加速来自Triton流水线缺失的变换：BitDelta内核直接解码打包二进制权重到Tensor Core操作数得3.34倍；FlashAttention中每线程分配完整Softmax行得1.37倍；卷积内核复用重叠窗口得最高2.23倍。验证器扩展成功支持Blackwell新架构特性。
AI.conclusion: 结果预示AI编译器有望替代定制中间表示与检查器，大幅减少通用及定制芯片软件栈的带起工程量。但仍存在形式化建模复杂性、验证覆盖率等局限，需进一步研究。

title: Selecting The Most Informative Tokens in Natural Language Autoencoders
summary: Natural language autoencoders translate a language model's internal activations into readable explanations. Explaining every token position is costly. Which positions should an auditor inspect to understand a potential threat? We study this question across $4.7$ million explanations on prompt injection and concealment. We compare signals from model computation with a ranker trained only on chat structure. Chat structure usually selects more relevant explanations than the computational signals, without requiring a model forward pass for position selection. On three of four datasets, explaining just $5\%$ of positions retains nearly all of the success rate from explaining every position, where success means obtaining an explanation about the threat. The benefit varies with the audit task. We also show that pretrained verbalizers recover words that models have learned to conceal through fine-tuning, without additional verbalizer training. These results identify where auditors can concentrate explanation generation and show that useful explanations can extend beyond the model a verbalizer was trained to describe.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自然语言自编码器中哪些token位置值得解释以检测威胁（提示词注入和隐藏）。发现基于聊天结构的排序器优于计算信号，仅解释5%位置即可保留近乎全部的成功率，且预训练的verbalizer无需额外训练即可恢复微调隐藏的词汇。
AI.motivation: 解释语言模型每个token位置的内部激活成本高昂，审计员需要确定哪些位置最相关以理解潜在威胁（如提示词注入和隐藏行为），从而降低解释生成的计算开销。
AI.method: 在470万条解释上对比模型计算信号与仅基于聊天结构训练的排序器，评估其在提示词注入和隐藏任务上的位置选择效果；测试不同比例位置解释的成功率保留情况；验证预训练verbalizer恢复微调隐藏词汇的能力。
AI.result: 聊天结构排序器通常比计算信号选择更相关的解释，且无需模型前向传播即可进行位置选择。在四个数据集中有三个上，仅解释5%的位置即可保留近乎解释所有位置的成功率。预训练verbalizer能在无额外训练下恢复模型通过微调学会隐藏的词汇。
AI.conclusion: 审计员可将解释生成集中在聊天结构选定的少量关键位置，大幅降低成本；verbalizer的有用解释能力可泛化到其训练目标模型之外，为可扩展的模型审计提供实用路径。

title: Longer Records, Broader Invariance: The Hidden Scaling Problem in Longitudinal Contrastive Learning
summary: Longitudinal data are valuable because people change. Yet the objectives used to learn from these data can inadvertently erase that change. In person-level contrastive learning, observations from the same person are treated as positives; as records grow, those positives can span increasingly distant---and increasingly different---behavioral states. More history can therefore produce not only more data, but broader invariance. We show that this distinction is fundamental. We separate \emph{record span}, how much history the learner sees, from \emph{supervision span}, how far across that history positive-pair supervision reaches. Across in-home sensing records spanning up to 2.7 years, broader supervision systematically suppresses recoverable changing-state information, even when the available history is held fixed. At the broadest span, less than 10\% of the information recoverable from an untrained encoder remains. Yet keeping positives local is not sufficient: as records grow, even distant states that are never paired become increasingly similar. Explicitly contrasting other observations from the same person reverses this loss without shortening the record, revealing a second route by which longitudinal scale can broaden invariance. Finally, we prospectively reproduce the supervision-span effect in 199 GLOBEM participants. Longitudinal scale therefore presents a choice: more history need not mean more invariance. By controlling what is held invariant as records grow, we can preserve the change that made the longitudinal data valuable in the first place.

AI.tldr: 论文研究纵向数据中对比学习的监督跨度对不变性学习的影响，指出记录跨度与监督跨度的区别，证明更宽的监督跨度会抑制可恢复的变化状态信息，提出通过显式对比同一人的其他观测来逆转这种损失。
AI.motivation: 纵向数据因人的变化而有价值，但对比学习的目标函数可能无意中抹除这种变化。人级对比学习将同一人的观测视为正样本，随着记录增长，正样本跨越越来越遥远且不同的行为状态，导致更多历史产生更宽的不变性，从而丢失有价值的变化信息。
AI.method: 区分记录跨度（学习者看到多少历史）与监督跨度（正样本监督跨越历史多远）。在长达2.7年的家庭感知记录上实验，控制监督跨度宽窄，对比不同跨度下可恢复的变化状态信息。并在199名GLOBEM参与者中前瞻性复现监督跨度效应。
AI.result: 更宽的监督跨度系统性抑制可恢复的变化状态信息，最宽跨度下不足10%的未训练编码器可恢复信息保留。仅保持正样本局部化不足够：即使从未配对的遥远状态也会变得越来越相似。显式对比同一人的其他观测可在不缩短记录的情况下逆转这种损失。
AI.conclusion: 纵向规模呈现选择：更多历史不必意味着更多不变性。通过控制记录增长时保持什么不变，可以保留使纵向数据有价值的变化。

title: UpliftMem: Learning Set-Level Uplift for Agent Memory Retrieval
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents reuse external memory to guide new tasks, but effective retrieval requires learning which memory sets improve execution. Such learning relies on costly outcome feedback: ordinary retrieval observes only executed sets, while evaluating alternatives requires additional rollouts. We introduce \textsc{UpliftMem}, which learns memory retrieval from set-level execution uplift relative to the same executor without memory. A theoretical analysis of how retrieval preferences restrict feedback coverage motivates targeted probing of alternative memory sets. Probe selection follows an expected value of sample information (EVSI) criterion, derived in closed form under a correlated Gaussian model, to allocate limited training rollouts according to their expected improvement in local retrieval decisions. The shared scorer is trained with a frozen executor and selects memory sets without test-time probes. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and BigCodeBench, \textsc{UpliftMem} achieves the best success rates among evaluated baselines on the main evaluation sets. Controlled fixed-store and matched probe budget evaluations further demonstrate improved memory-use decisions and more effective use of execution feedback.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了UpliftMem框架，通过学习记忆检索的集合级执行提升来优化LLM代理的外部记忆复用，利用EVSI准则指导有限探测预算的分配，在多个基准测试中取得最佳成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理复用外部记忆指导新任务，但有效检索需要学习哪些记忆集合能改善执行。这种学习依赖昂贵的结果反馈：普通检索只能观察已执行的集合，评估替代方案需要额外的rollout。现有方法缺乏理论指导来高效分配有限的探测预算。
AI.method: UpliftMem基于相关高斯模型推导闭式期望样本信息价值（EVSI）准则，量化每个候选记忆集合的探测价值，指导有限训练rollout的分配。共享评分器在冻结执行器下训练，测试时无需探测即可选择记忆集合。理论分析了检索偏好如何限制反馈覆盖，从而激励对替代记忆集合的针对性探测。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和BigCodeBench三个基准上，UpliftMem在主评估集上达到所有基线中的最佳成功率。受控的固定存储和匹配探测预算实验进一步证明了其改进了记忆使用决策，并更有效地利用了执行反馈。
AI.conclusion: UpliftMem通过理论指导的探测选择（EVSI）和集合级提升学习，解决了记忆检索中反馈稀疏和探测预算有限的核心问题，显著提升了LLM代理复用外部记忆的效果，为基于记忆的代理学习提供了 principled 的解决方案。

title: Learning from Think-Mode Advantage via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Explicit intermediate reasoning gives large language models (LLMs) a stronger problem-solving mode. We study learning from this think-mode advantage via on-policy distillation (OPD). OPD preserves student-generated trajectories and provides dense token-level teacher targets at student-visited prefixes. Privileged reasoning is used during distillation rather than student inference. Uniform ThinkOPD, a natural think-enabled OPD baseline, conditions a fixed teacher on one shared think trace and uniformly distills every sibling student response. Although its prefixes are on-policy, the trace need not follow a route compatible with every complete response: the same privileged trace can induce different teacher-student discrepancies even when responses reach the same outcome. We summarize this interaction with trace-response divergence (TRD) and introduce ThinkOPD, which routes supervision at the response level by combining group-relative reward gain with a TRD-based compatibility proxy. Final response weights are normalized within each rollout group. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation, ThinkOPD outperforms Uniform ThinkOPD in both same-model settings and both cross-model teacher-student pairs, and it exceeds representative rationale and self-distillation baselines in a controlled comparison. Controlled interventions show that outcome benefit and the TRD-based proxy provide complementary routing signals in this setting. Think-enabled OPD provides a controlled setting for studying how teacher advantage becomes transferable along student responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ThinkOPD，一种改进的在线策略蒸馏方法，利用教师模型的推理轨迹进行蒸馏，通过组相对奖励增益和基于轨迹-响应发散度（TRD）的兼容性代理，在响应级别路由监督信号，解决了统一 ThinkOPD 中固定教师轨迹与多样化学生响应不匹配的问题。在数学推理和代码生成任务上，ThinkOPD 优于统一 ThinkOPD、基本原理蒸馏和自我蒸馏基线，且在同模型和跨模型设置中均有效。
AI.motivation: 显式中间推理能增强大语言模型的问题解决能力。现有的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在蒸馏阶段使用教师的推理轨迹（即“思考模式”），但统一 ThinkOPD 对所有学生响应使用同一固定教师轨迹，导致该轨迹未必与每个完整响应兼容：相同的特权轨迹可能引发不同的师生差异，即使响应结果相同。这种轨迹-响应发散度（TRD）限制了蒸馏效果。
AI.method: ThinkOPD 在响应级别路由监督：结合组相对奖励增益（衡量结果收益）与基于 TRD 的兼容性代理（衡量教师轨迹与学生响应前缀的匹配度），计算每个响应的最终权重，并在每个 rollout 组内归一化。教师模型在蒸馏时条件于推理轨迹，学生推理时不使用轨迹。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准上，ThinkOPD 在同模型设置和两种跨模型教师-学生对中均显著优于统一 ThinkOPD，并超过代表性的基本原理蒸馏和自我蒸馏基线。消融实验表明结果收益与 TRD 代理提供互补的路由信号。
AI.conclusion: ThinkOPD 通过响应级监督路由，有效利用教师推理优势并解决轨迹-响应兼容性问题，为研究教师优势如何沿学生响应迁移提供了可控的实验范式。

title: Theory on Attention Dynamics for Out-of-Distribution In-Context Learning
summary: Transformers have demonstrated remarkable in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, enabling them to perform new tasks without additional fine-tuning. However, their performance often deteriorates when encountering out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs that deviate from the training distribution, and the underlying theory remains poorly understood. To fill this gap, we characterize the OOD error under the input distribution shift through the interplay between the dynamics of the so-called $α$-type and $β$-type attention weights, which represent the transformer's confidence in identifying the correct and incorrect features, respectively. Our results indicate that the OOD error for each feature depends on all pairwise interactions between the training features and OOD features, and under certain cases the transformer performs no better than random guessing. To improve the OOD generalization performance, we next investigate the impact of model finetuning with the OOD data, and particularly, characterize the model forgetting performance on the source domain. Interestingly, the performance on the source domain may not always degrade after finetuning, which highly depends on the nature of the feature shift: finetuning on OOD domain keeps enhancing the confidence of identifying correct features from the original distribution, while the interference from other incorrect features may either increase or decrease. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real data are conducted to corroborate the theoretical insights.

AI.tldr: 该论文理论分析了Transformer在分布外（OOD）输入下的上下文学习（ICL）泛化误差，揭示了注意力权重α型（正确特征置信度）与β型（错误特征置信度）的相互作用决定OOD误差；进一步研究微调OOD数据对源域遗忘的影响，发现源域性能不一定下降，取决于特征偏移性质。
AI.motivation: Transformer展现出强大的ICL能力，但在OOD输入下性能往往下降，且其理论机制尚不清楚。论文旨在填补这一理论空白，刻画分布偏移下的OOD误差，并探究微调OOD数据对源域性能的影响。
AI.method: 通过分析α型和β型注意力权重的动力学相互作用，理论刻画OOD误差；研究微调OOD数据后模型在源域的遗忘表现，分析特征偏移性质对源域性能的影响。
AI.result: OOD误差取决于所有训练特征与OOD特征的成对交互，某些情况下Transformer表现不优于随机猜测。微调OOD数据持续增强对原分布正确特征的识别置信度，但来自错误特征的干扰可能增加或减少，导致源域性能不一定下降。
AI.conclusion: 论文为Transformer的OOD泛化提供了理论解释，揭示了注意力机制中正确/错误特征置信度竞争的关键作用，并指出微调OOD数据不必然损害源域性能，取决于特征偏移的具体性质。

title: CAD-Native Transformer Operators for AI-Aided Engineering
summary: Modern engineering systems, from automobiles to aircraft, are designed by using precise, continuous parametric computer-aided design (CAD) models. Evaluating design changes through numerical simulation requires meshing the continuous geometry, a computationally expensive and often brittle process that can require manual intervention and replaces the continuous representation with a discrete approximation. Most neural surrogates accelerate the simulation, but inherit this representation gap by relying on meshes, point clouds, voxels, or other sampled approximations of geometry. We introduce CANTO, a transformer neural operator that maps directly from continuous CAD geometry to physical fields, without meshing the input geometry. We develop a theoretical framework for learning operators from geometric manifolds to function spaces of physical fields, representing geometry through sequences of parametric patches. CANTO instantiates this framework by directly tokenizing non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) patches from their control points, knot vectors, and weights, and predicts continuous surface and volume fields at arbitrary query locations. We evaluate CANTO on four automotive and aircraft aerodynamics industry benchmarks: AhmedML, WindsorML, DrivAerML, and HiLiftAeroML. CANTO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on most evaluated surface and volume prediction tasks, including a 19.8% reduction in surface-pressure relative $L_2$ error compared with AB-UPT on HiLiftAeroML. Differentiability with respect to CAD parameters further enables gradient-based inverse design of designs. On AhmedML, CANTO identifies designs with 4.4 to 20.4% lower drag than the best dataset designs satisfying the same volume and lift constraints, with the improvements verified using the same CFD setup used to generate the original dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CANTO，一种基于Transformer的神经算子，直接从连续CAD几何（NURBS补丁）预测物理场，无需网格划分。在四个汽车/航空气动基准测试中达到最先进精度，且支持基于梯度的逆向设计，在AhmedML上发现比数据集中最优设计阻力降低4.4%-20.4%的新设计。
AI.motivation: 现代工程系统使用连续参数化CAD模型设计，但数值模拟需要将连续几何离散化为网格，这一过程计算昂贵、脆弱且常需人工干预。现有神经代理模型虽能加速模拟，但仍依赖网格、点云、体素等几何离散近似，存在表征鸿沟。需要一种直接从连续CAD几何映射到物理场的方法，避免网格划分。
AI.method: 建立从几何流形到物理场函数空间的算子学习理论框架，将几何表示为参数化补丁序列。CANTO直接将非均匀有理B样条（NURBS）补丁的控制点、节点向量和权重进行token化，并作为Transformer的输入，在任意查询位置预测连续表面和体积物理场。该方法保持了对CAD参数的可微分性。
AI.result: 在AhmedML、WindsorML、DrivAerML、HiLiftAeroML四个工业气动基准测试中，CANTO在大多数表面和体积预测任务上达到最先进精度。在HiLiftAeroML上，表面压力相对L2误差比AB-UPT降低19.8%。利用可微分性进行梯度基逆向设计，在AhmedML上发现满足相同体积和升力约束的设计，阻力比数据集中最优设计降低4.4%-20.4%，且经相同CFD设置验证。
AI.conclusion: CANTO成功弥合了连续CAD几何与物理场预测之间的表征鸿沟，实现了无网格的高精度气动模拟代理。其可微分性使得基于梯度的逆向设计成为可能，能自动发现优于现有数据集的设计。该工作为工程设计中的端到端可微分仿真提供了新范式。

title: Traverse: Learning When to Remember, Reset, and Redirect for Long-Horizon Web Search
summary: Long-horizon information-seeking agents often accumulate noisy or misleading context, causing early mistakes to persist and making recovery increasingly difficult. We introduce an autonomous search harness in which the agent manages its own search process through three states: Rubric, Answer, and Verify. The agent first defines criteria for a valid answer, searches under these criteria, and then independently verifies the result before deciding whether to terminate or continue searching. It is further equipped with a Seal Memory tool that enables active context management. Training this behavior with reinforcement learning, however, can induce Seal Collapse, resulting in unstable training and preventing the agent from reliably learning when and how to use its memory tools. We solve this with a simple strategy that trains only the final segment after context management. Our 35B model achieves 72.83 on BrowseComp, outperforming comparable open-source systems, and consistently improves over the base model across BrowseComp-ZH, xbench, DeepSearchQA, WideSearch, financial investigation, and product search. Ablations show that autonomous compression outperforms automatic compaction and validate our RL design.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种自主搜索框架，通过 Rubric-Answer-Verify 三态循环和 Seal Memory 工具实现主动上下文管理，并通过仅训练上下文管理后的最终片段解决 RL 训练中的 Seal Collapse 问题，35B 模型在 BrowseComp 上达 72.83，超越同规模开源系统。
AI.motivation: 长时程信息搜索智能体易积累噪声或误导性上下文，导致早期错误持久化且难以恢复，现有方法缺乏有效的自主上下文管理与验证机制。
AI.method: 设计包含 Rubric（定义答案标准）、Answer（按标准搜索）、Verify（独立验证并决定是否继续）三个状态的自主搜索迭代流程，引入 Seal Memory 工具支持主动上下文压缩与管理；针对 RL 训练中出现的 Seal Collapse（记忆工具使用不稳定），采用仅训练上下文管理后最终片段的策略稳定训练。
AI.result: 35B 模型在 BrowseComp 上达到 72.83，优于同规模开源基线；在 BrowseComp-ZH、xbench、DeepSearchQA、WideSearch、金融调研、商品搜索等多个基准上持续超越基座模型；消融实验表明自主压缩优于自动压缩，验证了 RL 设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过三态自主搜索循环与可训练的上下文管理工具，配合针对性的 RL 训练策略，可有效缓解长时程搜索中的错误累积问题，显著提升信息检索智能体的鲁棒性与准确性。

title: Invariant Atoms: Sparse Coordinates of Local Semantic Geometry in Language Model Representations
summary: Large language models often preserve meaning despite substantial changes in wording, style, and syntax, while small semantic edits can systematically alter their hidden representations. This suggests that semantic variation may be organized along recurring local directions. We propose the Invariant Atom Hypothesis: local semantic motion admits preferred sparse coordinates along directions that remain stable under meaning-preserving transformations. We learn a shared semantic frame and sparse coordinates that reconstruct semantic displacements while suppressing nuisance variation, with anchor-dependent diagonal modulation adjusting atom strengths without sample-specific rotations. Empirically, the atoms exhibit strong semantic--nuisance separation, sparse reconstruction, reproducible directions, and causal effects on model predictions. The learned geometry generalizes to unseen semantic neighborhoods and nuisance families, while local reweighting improves semantic selectivity and preserves a consistent global-to-local structure. Atom signatures also remain stable under model modification. These findings support reusable invariant directions as a sparse coordinate system for local semantic geometry in language models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“不变原子假设”，认为大语言模型的局部语义运动存在稀疏坐标方向，这些方向在保持意义的变换下保持稳定。通过学习共享语义框架和稀疏坐标，重建语义位移并抑制噪声变化，实现了语义-噪声强分离、稀疏重建、可复现方向及因果效应，且几何结构能泛化到未见语义邻域和噪声家族，在模型修改下也保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在措辞、风格、句法大幅变化时仍保持意义，但微小语义编辑却系统性改变隐藏表示，提示语义变化可能沿循环局部方向组织。需要一种稀疏坐标系来捕捉局部语义几何，且在保持意义的变换下不变。
AI.method: 提出不变原子假设，学习共享语义框架和稀疏坐标，重建语义位移同时抑制噪声变化，使用锚点依赖的对角调制调整原子强度，无需样本特定旋转。
AI.result: 原子表现出强语义-噪声分离、稀疏重建、可复现方向、对模型预测的因果效应；学习到的几何泛化到未见语义邻域和噪声家族；局部重加权提高语义选择性并保持一致的全局到局部结构；原子特征在模型修改下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持可复用的不变方向作为语言模型局部语义几何的稀疏坐标系。

title: Geometry-Conditioned Fixed-Scaffold Encoders for Time-Warp Robust Sequence Retrieval
summary: Embedding-based retrieval is attractive for long sequence collections because each item can be encoded once and searched by nearest-neighbor ranking. The difficulty is that the objects being indexed are often observed under a noncanonical clock: cardiac cycles stretch with rate, speech changes with tempo, and sensor traces reach comparable states at different speeds. This paper studies a specific source of instability in patch-based encoders for this regime. If patch boundaries are chosen from signal geometry, then the tokenization can change under the same temporal deformation that the representation is expected to tolerate. We propose GeoPatch, a fixed-scaffold patch encoder that keeps token support independent of geometry and uses slope, curvature, acceleration, affine-residual, and confidence descriptors only as continuous conditioning variables. The design turns boundary variation into feature modulation: geometry can change the embedding through a controlled pathway, but it cannot change the number, order, or support of local tokens. We formalize this distinction through a mechanism-level stability analysis that separates boundary drift, affine timing variation, confidence-weighted geometry perturbation, and retrieval-margin effects. The same local tokens support global embedding retrieval and late-interaction scoring, so the scoring rule can be matched to the evaluation protocol. Across ECG, speech, and multivariate time-series retrieval tasks, GeoPatch improves early-rank retrieval under timing variation while exposing a clear trade-off between local surface matching and strict non-overlap retrieval.

AI.tldr: GeoPatch 是一种固定脚手架的补丁编码器，通过将几何特征作为连续条件变量而非离散边界，解决了基于补丁的编码器在时序变形下的不稳定性，提升了 ECG、语音和多变量时间序列检索任务中的早期排名性能。
AI.motivation: 在长序列集合的基于嵌入的检索中，被索引对象常在非标准时钟下观测（如心率变化导致的心跳周期拉伸、语速变化、传感器轨迹以不同速度达到相似状态）。现有基于补丁的编码器若从信号几何选择补丁边界，会导致分词随时序变形而改变，破坏了表示对时序变形的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出 GeoPatch 固定脚手架补丁编码器：保持令牌支持独立于几何，仅将坡度、曲率、加速度、仿射残差和置信度描述符作为连续条件变量。将边界变化转化为特征调制：几何可通过受控路径改变嵌入，但不能改变局部令牌的数量、顺序或支持。通过机制级稳定性分析形式化区分边界漂移、仿射时序变化、置信度加权几何扰动和检索边际效应。同一组局部令牌同时支持全局嵌入检索和晚期交互打分，使打分规则可匹配评估协议。
AI.result: 在 ECG、语音和多变量时间序列检索任务中，GeoPatch 在时序变化下提升了早期排名检索性能，同时揭示了局部表面匹配与严格非重叠检索之间的明确权衡。
AI.conclusion: GeoPatch 通过固定脚手架设计消除了补丁边界对时序变形的敏感性，将几何信息作为连续条件注入，实现了鲁棒的时序变形不变检索，并提供了可解释的稳定性分析框架。

title: What Does Post-Training Change in Multilingual Reasoning?
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, 21 tables. Main paper and supplementary material in one document
summary: Open-source reasoning models provide unequal access to reasoning capability across languages. When a model can solve a problem but cannot deliver a complete solution in the user's language, language becomes an access barrier rather than merely a source of performance variation. We audit Qwen3 checkpoints on competition-mathematics tasks in eleven languages. Across the ten non-English languages, only 15.4-17.9% of problems receive a correct, terminating solution with visible reasoning in the requested language in any of 16 samples, compared with 92.9% in English. To identify the source of this disparity, we evaluate thirteen endpoints from one model family, spanning released checkpoints, multilingual supervised fine-tuning (SFT) at two scales, controlled SFT ablations, and three reinforcement-learning (RL) reward formulations. We jointly track correctness, language adherence, termination, and delivery efficiency. The dominant bottleneck shifts across post-training stages. Released models often reason in English. Multilingual SFT restores target-language reasoning, but accuracy declines across multilingual, English-only, and single-language SFT runs, showing that this cost is not specific to multilingual mixing; non-English reasoning traces additionally become prone to non-terminating loops. RL restores termination in both arms at no cost in accuracy, but only the arm whose reward includes a language term delivers: rewarding correctness alone returns the model to English. Together, these stages establish a constructive post-training path from English-pivoted capability to multilingual reasoning that is reliably delivered.

AI.tldr: 论文审计了 Qwen3 在 11 种语言上的竞赛数学推理能力，发现非英语语言仅 15.4-17.9% 的问题能获得正确、终止且用目标语言推理的解，远低于英语的 92.9%。通过系统评估发布检查点、多语言 SFT 及三种 RL 奖励配方，揭示了推理语言偏移、准确率下降、非终止循环等瓶颈随后训练阶段转移，并证明仅当 RL 奖励包含语言项时才能同时恢复终止与目标语言输出，从而确立了从英语为枢纽能力走向可靠多语言推理的建设性后训练路径。
AI.motivation: 开源推理模型在不同语言间提供的推理能力不均等，语言成为获取能力的障碍而非单纯的性能差异来源。需要系统量化多语言推理的交付差距，并定位后训练各阶段的主导瓶颈，以指导构建可靠交付目标语言推理的训练流程。
AI.method: 在竞赛数学任务上审计 Qwen3 检查点，覆盖 11 种语言（含英语）。评估同一模型家族的 13 个端点：发布检查点、两种规模的多语言监督微调（SFT）、受控 SFT 消融实验、三种强化学习（RL）奖励配方（含/不含语言项）。联合追踪正确性、语言遵循、终止性、交付效率四个指标。
AI.result: 发布模型倾向用英语推理；多语言 SFT 恢复目标语言推理但准确率下降（无论多语言、纯英语或单语言 SFT），且非英语推理轨迹易陷入非终止循环；RL 能在不损失准确率下恢复两臂的终止性，但仅当奖励包含语言项时才能保持目标语言输出——仅奖励正确性会让模型退回英语推理。
AI.conclusion: 多语言推理的交付瓶颈随后训练阶段动态转移：SFT 解决语言遵循但引入准确率损失与非终止；RL 解决终止性，但需显式语言奖励项才能锁定目标语言。这确立了一条从英语为枢纽的推理能力出发、经由多语言 SFT 与带语言约束的 RL 逐步构建可靠多语言推理交付的建设性路径。

title: Channel-Dependent State Space Model for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) is critical across many real-world domains. Existing deep learning approaches fall into two paradigms with distinct limitations: channel-independent (CI) methods unconditionally ignore cross-variable dependencies and model only temporal dynamics, while channel-dependent (CD) methods consider both but typically rely on architectural compromises to mitigate overfitting and computational overhead. We therefore propose Chameleon, a specialized CD state space model (SSM) that enables data-dependent, fine-grained interactions across variables while scaling linearly with their number. By connecting selective SSMs with the Kalman filter, we leverage the missing measurement update in the former for cross-variable modeling while preserving the SSM backbone for robust temporal modeling. We further identify favorable inductive biases of GatedDeltaNet for time series, adapt it as our backbone, and improve generalization through additional techniques, including a previously unexplored stochastic perturbation of reversible instance normalization. On strongly dependent ODE and PEMS datasets, Chameleon achieves the best MSE and MAE across all settings, while its CI ablation and prior CD methods incur 61-178% higher MSE on average. Across 28 standard benchmark settings, Chameleon also achieves better MSE and MAE than each baseline in at least 27 and 22 cases, respectively. Training-time and peak-memory analyses on Traffic and ETT further demonstrate competitive efficiency and favorable memory scalability across different variable counts.

AI.tldr: Chameleon是一种专门的通道依赖状态空间模型，通过将选择性SSM与卡尔曼滤波器连接，实现变量间细粒度交互，同时保持线性缩放，在多个基准测试中达到最优预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多元时间序列预测方法分为通道独立(CI)和通道依赖(CD)两类，CI忽略变量间依赖，CD虽考虑依赖但需架构妥协导致过拟合和计算开销，需要一种能数据依赖、细粒度建模变量交互且计算高效的方法。
AI.method: 提出Chameleon，一种专用CD状态空间模型。将选择性SSM与卡尔曼滤波器连接，利用前者缺失的测量更新步骤进行跨变量建模，保留SSM骨干进行时间建模。采用GatedDeltaNet作为骨干网络，利用其对时间序列有利的归纳偏置。通过可逆实例归一化的随机扰动提高泛化能力。
AI.result: 在强依赖的ODE和PEMS数据集上，Chameleon在所有设置下达到最优MSE和MAE，CI消融和先前CD方法平均MSE高61-178%。在28个标准基准设置中，Chameleon在至少27个和22个设置上分别优于各基线的MSE和MAE。在Traffic和ETT数据集上的训练时间和峰值内存分析显示具有竞争力的效率和良好的内存可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: Chameleon通过创新的SSM-卡尔曼滤波器融合架构，成功解决了多元时间序列预测中变量依赖建模与计算效率的权衡，实现了最先进的预测精度和良好的可扩展性。

title: Calibrate the Decisions That Change the Future: On-Policy Post-Training Quantization for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) lowers deployment cost for multimodal large language models, but calibration typically reconstructs fixed sequences with local objectives. This overlooks autoregressive feedback: a quantization-induced token change redirects the prefix and changes future states. Yet on-policy coverage alone is insufficient because many decision mismatches barely affect future generation. We propose OnPTQ, an on-policy framework that calibrates on trajectories visited by the current quantized policy. On shared prefixes, OnPTQ identifies quantization-eroded boundaries, evaluates competing tokens through short counterfactual rollouts, and combines current discrepancy with branch consequence into a Decision--Consequence risk. The risk prioritizes critical states, while context anchoring and trajectory refresh preserve multimodal behavior and keep calibration aligned with the updated policy. We further derive a Decision--Consequence bound linking behavioral deviation to current policy discrepancy and action-conditioned future-value span. Across vision--language and omni-modal Qwen models under multiple low-bit settings, OnPTQ improves downstream performance and yields fewer correctness flips against the corresponding Dense/FP16 references, without changing the deployed inference graph.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OnPTQ，一种面向多模态大语言模型的在线策略训练后量化框架，通过决策-后果风险度量优先校准关键状态，显著提升低比特量化下的下游任务性能并减少正确性翻转。
AI.motivation: 现有 PTQ 校准通常基于固定序列的局部目标，忽视自回归反馈：量化导致的 token 变化会改变前缀并重定向未来状态。单纯的在线策略覆盖不足，因为许多决策失配对后续生成影响微小。
AI.method: OnPTQ 在量化策略访问的轨迹上校准。在共享前缀上识别量化侵蚀边界，通过短反事实回滚评估竞争 token，将当前差异与分支后果结合为决策-后果风险，优先处理关键状态。上下文锚定与轨迹刷新保持多模态行为并使校准与更新后的策略对齐。并推导决策-后果界，将行为偏差与当前策略差异及动作条件未来值跨度联系。
AI.result: 在视觉-语言与全模态 Qwen 模型的多种低比特设置下，OnPTQ 提升下游任务性能，相对 Dense/FP16 基线减少正确性翻转，且不改变部署推理图。
AI.conclusion: OnPTQ 通过在线策略校准与决策-后果风险机制，有效解决了多模态大模型 PTQ 中的自回归反馈问题，在保持推理图不变的前提下实现了更优的量化性能与鲁棒性。

title: Cross-Linguistic Effects in Bilingual Phoneme BabyLMs
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables; Accepted at the 2nd BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Cross-linguistic effects are a central topic in bilingual first-language acquisition. Artificial learners can help investigate L1-L2 interactions by enabling controlled comparisons across language combinations and learning conditions. Recent work explores this direction by training bilingual language models under developmentally plausible constraints. However, human and model learners still diverge in fundamental ways, with one major difference being input modality: children learn primarily from spoken input, whereas language models are typically trained on orthographic text. To reduce this gap, researchers have trained models on phonemic representations of speech. In this work, we combine these research directions to train bilingual BabyLMs with phonemic input. We keep English fixed as the L2 and vary the L1 across German, Swedish, Persian, and Basque, selected to represent contrasting combinations of syntactic and phoneme-inventory distance from English. Our results show stronger L1-related variation in grammatical learning trajectories under phonemic than orthographic input, while early lexical differences align with phoneme-inventory similarity.

AI.tldr: 该研究训练双语BabyLM模型，使用音素输入而非正字法文本，探究L1对L2习得的跨语言影响，发现音素输入下语法学习轨迹的L1相关差异更大，早期词汇差异与音素库存相似度一致。
AI.motivation: 现有双语语言模型通常基于正字法文本训练，与儿童主要从语音输入学习存在模态鸿沟；需通过音素表示缩小该差距，并系统考察L1-L2交互在语法与词汇习得中的作用。
AI.method: 固定英语为L2，L1分别选取德语、瑞典语、波斯语、巴斯克语（覆盖不同句法及音素库存距离），在发育合理约束下训练双语BabyLM，对比音素输入与正字法输入条件下的语法学习轨迹及早期词汇习得模式。
AI.result: 音素输入条件下，不同L1导致的语法学习轨迹差异显著大于正字法输入；早期词汇习得差异则主要与L1-L2音素库存相似度相关。
AI.conclusion: 音素建模能更真实地捕捉跨语言影响在语法习得中的体现，揭示输入模态调节L1迁移效应的机制，为双语习得计算建模提供更生态效度的范式。

title: Emergent phases of superposition: from partial to full representation
summary: Large language models are thought to represent features by vectors in a hidden space of dimension given by the model's width. Superposition, in which more features are represented than the width by letting representation vectors overlap, is a leading account of how representation vectors are organized. However, how model width and data statistics determine the configuration of representation vectors and the resulting loss when the number of features and the width are large remains less understood. Here we show, in Anthropic's toy model of superposition, that increasing the width drives a continuous phase transition from a partial-representation phase, where only a subset of features receives appreciable representation vectors while the rest vanish, to a full-representation phase, where every feature is represented. Our theory via a partial random projection approximation predicts, and experiments confirm, that the critical width grows linearly with the number of active features up to a logarithmic factor. The loss scaling changes across the transition: below the critical width, the loss grows linearly with the number of active features and depends weakly on the width in a form set by data statistics; above it, the loss grows approximately quadratically with the number of active features and decays inversely with the width. Non-uniform firing probabilities delay the transition and lower the loss, as more frequent features occupy more space. Our results provide an account of how model width and data statistics jointly shape representations and loss, a step toward understanding representation scaling in large models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究超位模型中模型宽度和数据统计如何联合决定特征表示配置和损失，发现随宽度增加存在从部分表示相（仅部分特征获表示）到完全表示相（所有特征获表示）的连续相变，临界宽度随活跃特征数线性增长（对数因子修正），相变两侧损失缩放规律截然不同，非均匀激活概率会延迟相变并降低损失。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被认为在隐藏空间中用向量表示特征，超位机制允许表示特征数超过模型宽度。但当特征数和宽度都很大时，模型宽度和数据统计如何共同决定表示向量的配置及由此产生的损失，目前理解较少。
AI.method: 基于Anthropic的超位玩具模型，采用部分随机投影近似进行理论分析，并通过实验验证理论预测。
AI.result: 发现随宽度增加存在连续相变：低于临界宽度为部分表示相（仅部分特征获得可观表示向量，其余消失），高于临界宽度为完全表示相（每个特征都被表示）。临界宽度随活跃特征数线性增长（至多对数因子）。损失缩放随相变改变：临界宽度以下，损失随活跃特征数线性增长、对宽度依赖弱（由数据统计决定形式）；临界宽度以上，损失随活跃特征数近似二次增长、随宽度逆比例衰减。非均匀激活概率延迟相变并降低损失，因为高频特征占据更多空间。
AI.conclusion: 结果阐明了模型宽度和数据统计如何联合塑造表示和损失，为理解大模型中的表示缩放规律迈出了一步。

title: The Default Trap: Rethinking Plan Evaluation in Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: An executor can respond strongly to a change in a supplied plan's priority while showing a small change in the same information-selection probability when a default-aligned whole plan is removed. We call the risk of interpreting the latter as weak responsiveness to alternative priorities the default trap. We compare paired plans that prioritize different information targets with a shared no-plan reference. An accounting identity relates these distinct behavioral contrasts. Across 3,200 decision windows on 160 selected Retail, Airline, and AgentDojo tasks, switching priorities strongly redirects two models' choices, while the two plan-versus-default contrasts differ. In 2,160 additional windows, reversing account-list order shifts default target selection by 63.3-98.3 percentage points; priority-switching effects remain 96.7-100.0 points in either order. A separate 3,240-window component study finds strong control under single priority sentences, with effects of additional text varying by group and direction. Finally, 1,080 full-task episodes yield observed success differences of -19.4 to +8.3 points relative to no plan. All Retail and Airline success intervals include zero; AgentDojo results describe four fixed application worlds. These findings support joint reporting of priority responsiveness, presentation-dependent defaults, and task success and cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了执行器对计划优先级变化的响应性，揭示了“默认陷阱”现象，并通过大规模实验验证了优先级切换对模型选择的强导向作用，同时指出展示顺序对默认目标选择的显著影响，主张联合报告优先级响应性、依赖呈现的默认值及任务成功与成本。
AI.motivation: 现有研究可能误将移除默认对齐计划时的小幅信息选择概率变化解读为对替代优先级的弱响应，即“默认陷阱”。作者旨在区分优先级响应性与默认依赖行为，建立统一的核算身份关联不同行为对比，并为多任务环境下的计划执行评估提供更全面的指标框架。
AI.method: 采用配对计划对比（不同信息目标优先级）与共享无计划基准，结合核算身份分析行为对比。实验包括：3,200个决策窗口（160个Retail、Airline、AgentDojo任务）测试优先级切换效果；2,160窗口测试账户列表顺序反转对默认目标选择的影响；3,240窗口组件研究单优先级句子控制及额外文本效应；1,080完整任务回合评估成功率差异。
AI.result: 优先级切换强烈重定向两模型选择（效应96.7-100.0百分点），而计划与默认对比差异显著。账户列表顺序反转使默认目标选择偏移63.3-98.3百分点。单优先级句子下控制力强，额外文本效应随群体和方向变化。完整任务成功率差异为-19.4至+8.3百分点，Retail和Airline区间含零，AgentDojo描述四固定应用世界。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实优先级响应性强且稳健，默认选择高度依赖呈现顺序，任务成功率变化不一。主张在评估执行器时联合报告优先级响应性、依赖呈现的默认行为及任务成功与成本，以避免默认陷阱并提供全面评估。

title: LLM unbranding: Erasing Commercial Identity while Preserving Generic Utility
summary:
Establishing unbranding as a critical practice to prevent visual logos from acquiring negative connotations is standard in image generation. Large Language Models (LLMs) now face a parallel and emerging challenge. These models frequently generate brand descriptions within diverse contexts. This frequency introduces significant risks, such as trademark dilution, false attribution, and brand defamation. In response, we formally define the novel task of LLM Unbranding. We specifically address the complex challenge of managing trade dress within textual outputs. This involves neutralizing characteristic language, slogans, and stylistic markers that define brand identity. Crucially, these elements are less evident than explicit visual logos. To benchmark this task, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation dataset incorporating prominent brands from multiple commercial domains. We rigorously evaluate existing state-of-the-art machine unlearning models using this benchmark. This evaluation identifies their limitations in selective textual unbranding. Finally, we propose MUTE, a novel inference-time method that effectively neutralizes textual trade dress while preserving the LLM's general capabilities and utility. By leveraging an iterative refinement loop, MUTE systematically optimizes system instructions to safely eliminate brand leakage without requiring fragile parameter updates.
  Code and dataset: The evaluation dataset and code for LLM Unbranding are available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/LLM_unbranding. The implementation of MUTE is available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/MUTE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了LLM Unbranding任务，旨在消除大语言模型生成文本中的品牌特征语言、口号和风格标记（即文本商业外观），并提出了推理时方法MUTE，通过迭代优化系统指令有效中和品牌泄露，同时保持模型通用能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在生成文本时频繁包含品牌描述，带来商标稀释、错误归因和品牌诽谤等法律与声誉风险。现有机器遗忘方法难以精准处理文本中的隐性商业外观（如特征语言、口号、风格标记），缺乏系统性评估基准。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义LLM Unbranding任务，聚焦文本商业外观的中和；2. 构建跨多个商业领域知名品牌的综合评估数据集；3. 提出MUTE（基于推理时迭代优化循环的方法），通过系统指令优化消除品牌泄露，无需修改模型参数。
AI.result: 在新基准上评估现有最先进机器遗忘模型，揭示其在选择性文本去品牌化上的局限性；MUTE方法有效中和文本商业外观，同时保持LLM通用能力和实用性，优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LLM Unbranding是应对品牌相关风险的关键实践。MUTE提供了一种无需脆弱参数更新、即插即用的推理时解决方案，为文本生成中的品牌安全提供了可行路径。代码与数据集已开源。

title: Fisher-IRG: Fisher-Induced Local Invariant Representation Geometry across Language and Vision Models
summary: Semantic-preserving transformations can induce substantial motion in learned representations, while small changes may strongly affect model predictions, raising a basic question: what local metric best captures semantically consequential variation? We propose Fisher-induced invariant representation geometry (Fisher-IRG), which measures local representation directions through their predictive sensitivity. Around each representation, we construct semantic-preserving and semantic-changing neighborhoods, aggregate their local Fisher information, and recover invariant directions through a contrastive generalized eigenvalue problem. Controlled displacement analyses first show that comparable Euclidean motion can have substantially different predictive consequences, supporting the need for a predictive geometry. Across language and vision models, Fisher-IRG yields stronger semantic-versus-nuisance predictive selectivity and generally more reproducible subspaces than covariance-based geometry, while recovering systematically distinct local directions. Representation interventions further localize semantic effects to the Fisher-derived subspace, and held-out separation and retrieval show that the recovered geometry generalizes beyond the discovery neighborhoods. These results support Fisher-IRG as a principled framework for characterizing local invariant representation geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Fisher-induced invariant representation geometry (Fisher-IRG)，一种基于 Fisher 信息的局部不变表示几何框架，通过对比语义保持和语义改变邻域的 Fisher 信息，解广义特征值问题恢复不变方向，实验表明其在语言和视觉模型中均优于协方差几何，能更准确捕捉语义相关的预测敏感方向，且泛化至未见邻域。
AI.motivation: 现有表示空间中，语义保持变换可能导致较大的欧氏距离位移，而微小扰动却可能剧烈改变模型预测，欧氏距离或协方差几何无法可靠反映语义后果；因此需要一种基于预测敏感度的局部度量来刻画语义相关的变化方向。
AI.method: 在每个表示点构建语义保持邻域（如数据增强）和语义改变邻域（如对抗扰动或类别变化），分别计算局部 Fisher 信息矩阵，通过对比广义特征值问题求解，提取在语义保持方向上不敏感、在语义改变方向上敏感的不变子空间。
AI.result: 受控位移实验显示相似欧氏位移的预测后果差异巨大，验证了预测几何的必要性。在语言和视觉模型上，Fisher-IRG 实现了更强的语义与干扰预测选择性、更可复现的子空间，且方向系统性区别于协方差几何。表示干预定位语义效应于 Fisher 子空间，保留分离与检索实验证实几何泛化至发现邻域之外。
AI.conclusion: Fisher-IRG 为表征局部不变表示几何提供了一个有原则的框架，能有效识别语义相关的预测敏感方向，优于传统协方差几何，且具备良好的泛化能力。

title: Where Does Staleness Accumulate? Pool Aware Effective Staleness Control for Asynchronous RL in LLM Post-Training
summary: Fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves resource utilization in large language model post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but it also introduces policy lag as trajectories are generated and queued while the trainer continues to update. We study how this lag accumulates over a trajectory's lifetime and how it can be controlled without sacrificing the wall-clock benefits of asynchronous execution. We decompose trajectory staleness into Generation Staleness, accumulated before rollout completion, and Waiting Staleness, accumulated after a completed trajectory enters the pool. Motivated by this decomposition, we introduce PACE (Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness). PACE converts excess pool occupancy into an adaptive rejection budget and ranks completed trajectories using an effective-staleness score that combines Waiting Staleness with prefix-aware Generation Staleness. This avoids penalizing long or interrupted rollouts solely because they span multiple policy versions. In single-turn mathematical reasoning, PACE improves the six-benchmark average validation accuracy by 18.7\% over unfiltered asynchronous RL at the same wall-clock budget and matches synchronous RL performance with 47.1\% less GPU time. PACE also improves validation performance in multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning, outperforming both synchronous and unfiltered asynchronous RL. Further experiments with the mixture-of-experts model and an alternative RL algorithm support its applicability across model architectures and training algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文针对全异步强化学习（RL）在大语言模型后训练中的策略滞后问题，提出了 PACE（Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness）方法。通过将轨迹陈旧度分解为生成阶段陈旧度和等待阶段陈旧度，PACE 自适应地拒绝过旧轨迹，在保持异步执行的时钟优势的同时显著提升训练效果。实验表明，PACE 在单轮数学推理和多轮工具集成推理任务上均优于同步 RL 和无过滤异步 RL，且在不同模型架构和 RL 算法下均有效。
AI.motivation: 全异步 RL 虽然通过重叠采样生成与策略优化提高了资源利用率，但会引入策略滞后：轨迹在生成和排队过程中策略不断更新，导致训练数据陈旧。现有方法未区分生成阶段和等待阶段的陈旧度，且倾向于惩罚跨越多个策略版本的长轨迹或中断轨迹，无法有效控制有效陈旧度。
AI.method: 提出 PACE 方法：1) 将轨迹陈旧度分解为生成陈旧度（生成完成前积累）和等待陈旧度（进入池后积累）；2) 根据池占用情况计算自适应拒绝预算；3) 结合前缀感知的生成陈旧度与等待陈旧度计算有效陈旧度得分，对已完成轨迹排序并拒绝过旧轨迹，避免单纯因跨越多个策略版本而惩罚长轨迹。
AI.result: 在单轮数学推理任务上，PACE 在相同时钟预算下将六基准平均验证准确率较无过滤异步 RL 提升 18.7%，且以 47.1% 更少的 GPU 时间达到同步 RL 性能。在多轮工具集成推理任务上，PACE 验证性能优于同步 RL 和无过滤异步 RL。混合专家模型和替代 RL 算法实验证实其跨架构、跨算法的适用性。
AI.conclusion: PACE 通过细粒度陈旧度分解与自适应池感知控制，有效解决了全异步 RL 中的策略滞后问题，在不牺牲异步执行时钟优势的前提下显著提升训练效率与模型性能，具有广泛的泛化能力。

title: Bridging Semantic Gaps in RAG through Generated Context Knowledge Fusion
comment: This paper is accepted by NLPCC 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation has established itself as a fundamental framework in natural language processing, seamlessly integrating information retrieval with the generative capabilities of large language models. However, this process is fundamentally constrained by a critical challenge: semantic space mismatch between queries and retrieved contexts. We propose Knowledge-Aware Semantic Bridging (KASB), a novel framework that improves passage selection quality through semantic space alignment between queries and retrieved documents through intelligent knowledge fusion. Our approach leverages the complementary strengths of generative and retrieval-based knowledge through a multistage process that enhances both relevance and accuracy. We evaluate KASB on three popular open-domain Question Answering datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识感知语义桥接（KASB）框架，解决检索增强生成（RAG）中查询与检索上下文的语义空间不匹配问题，通过多阶段知识融合实现语义对齐，提升段落选择质量。
AI.motivation: RAG虽整合了检索与生成，但存在查询与检索文档间的语义空间错位，导致段落选择质量下降，影响生成的相关性与准确性。
AI.method: 提出KASB框架，利用生成式与检索式知识的互补优势，通过多阶段智能知识融合实现查询与检索文档的语义空间对齐，优化段落选择。
AI.result: 在三个开放域问答数据集上评估，KASB显著提升段落选择质量，验证了方法在增强相关性与准确性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: KASB通过语义空间对齐和知识融合有效缓解了RAG中的语义不匹配问题，为开放域问答提供了更高质量的检索增强方案。

title: DisCoMBO: Steering Expert-in-the-Loop Black Box Optimization via Distributional Conformance
summary: Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO) traditionally relies on Bayesian or ensembling surrogates for uncertainty quantification. While historically treated as fully data-driven, SMBO increasingly integrates external domain expertise to accelerate discovery. To overcome the opaque guidance and diminished integration fidelity of standard acquisition re-weighting, Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) have emerged as a generative surrogate alternative, enabling direct knowledge injection via conditional sampling. However, these generative routines lack the formal exploration-exploitation semantics required for rigorous optimization. We introduce the Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo), a novel metric that unifies the flexibility and efficiency of PCs with a formal uncertainty framework. DisCo provides a bounded, $[0, 1]$-normalized measure of model "surprise" that (1) recovers properties comparable to kernel-based uncertainty known from, e.g., Gaussian Processes, while maintaining linear-time inference, and (2) enables accurate assessment of conformance of external knowledge w.r.t. model evidence. We then present DisCoMBO, a framework leveraging these properties for robust, knowledge-aware optimization. We prove that DisCoMBO is a zero-regret algorithm and demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse benchmarks from AutoML, material optimization, and wind park optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分布一致性得分，一种结合概率电路灵活性与形式化不确定性框架的新指标，并基于此构建DisCoMBO框架，实现了具备零遗憾保证的知识感知优化。
AI.motivation: 传统序列模型优化依赖贝叶斯或集成代理进行不确定性量化，引入领域知识时，标准获取函数重加权方法存在指导不透明和集成保真度下降问题；概率电路虽能通过条件采样注入知识，但缺乏严格优化所需的探索-利用形式语义。
AI.method: 提出分布一致性得分，一种有界[0,1]归一化的模型“惊讶度”度量，兼具核方法不确定性的性质与线性时间推理效率，并能准确评估外部知识与模型证据的一致性；基于此构建DisCoMBO框架，用于稳健的知识感知优化。
AI.result: 理论证明DisCoMBO为零遗憾算法；在AutoML、材料优化、风电场优化等多样基准上实验验证其有效性。
AI.conclusion: DisCo成功统一了概率电路的灵活高效与形式化不确定性框架，DisCoMBO为知识感知优化提供了兼具理论保证与实证性能的解决方案。

title: ARC-KV: Amortizing Anchor Search for Reconstruction-Based KV Cache Compaction
summary: Long-context large language model inference is bottlenecked by KV caches that grow linearly with sequence length. This burden is especially severe for long, reusable context prefixes, whose cache must serve many downstream queries. Reconstruction-based methods such as Attention Matching achieve strong downstream task performance with compact KV caches. However, iterative anchor search dominates the compaction cost of OMP-based Attention Matching. This motivates our selective amortization principle of learning a reusable anchor-selection policy across contexts while retaining context-specific reconstruction.
