In this work, we propose ARC-KV, a novel reconstruction-based KV cache compaction method that follows this principle. To this end, we first train a value-aware indexer to select real-key anchors in a single scoring pass. ARC-KV then applies convex-hull-constrained key merging and fits an attention-mass bias and compact values against the full cache. At inference time, ARC-KV builds the compact cache once per context using the frozen indexer and reuses it for all subsequent queries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARC-KV outperforms reported compaction methods in most settings across QuALITY, RULER, and LongBench on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. In particular, at 10% KV retention on QuALITY, ARC-KV improves accuracy from 0.6409 to 0.6474 over Attention Matching while reducing compaction time by a factor of 25.73, from 959.8 s to 37.3 s.

AI.tldr: ARC-KV 是一种基于重构的 KV 缓存压缩方法，通过学习可复用的锚点选择策略（value-aware indexer）结合凸包约束的键合并与注意力质量拟合，实现了在保持甚至超越 Attention Matching 任务性能的同时，将压缩耗时降低 25 倍以上。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理受限于随序列长度线性增长的 KV 缓存，尤其对于可复用的长前缀上下文负担更重。现有的重构类方法（如 Attention Matching）虽性能强，但基于 OMP 的迭代锚点搜索导致压缩开销巨大。因此提出选择性摊销原则：跨上下文学习可复用的锚点选择策略，同时保留上下文特定的重构过程。
AI.method: 1) 训练一个 value-aware indexer，单次评分即可选取真实键作为锚点；2) 应用凸包约束的键合并；3) 拟合注意力质量偏置和压缩后的值向量以匹配完整缓存；4) 推理时冻结 indexer，对每个上下文一次性构建压缩缓存并供后续所有查询复用。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上的 QuALITY、RULER、LongBench 实验中，ARC-KV 在大多数设置下超越现有压缩方法。在 QuALITY 10% KV 保留率下，准确率从 0.6409 提升至 0.6474，压缩时间从 959.8 秒降至 37.3 秒（加速 25.73 倍）。
AI.conclusion: ARC-KV 通过选择性摊销原则，成功解耦了锚点选择的通用性与重构的上下文特异性，实现了高质量 KV 缓存压缩与极低压缩延迟的双重目标，为长上下文推理提供了实用的高效方案。

title: VLM Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have provided a unified interface for end-to-end combinatorial optimization (CO), but textual serialization alone may obscure spatial and relational structures that are important for generating effective CO solutions. This paper presents a general-purpose vision-language solver that augments textual instance descriptions with input-derived visual representations. A single vision-language model (VLM) is applied across different CO tasks and trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by verifier-guided reinforcement learning. While the visual inputs contain no gold solutions or solution-derived information, our experiments show that the VLM generally improves solution quality over its text-only counterpart, with particularly clear gains on more complex CO problems such as CVRP and JSSP. The advantage of visual information is more pronounced at large problem scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通用视觉-语言求解器，通过将文本实例描述与输入派生的视觉表示相结合，在组合优化任务中取得了优于纯文本模型的性能，尤其在CVRP和JSSP等复杂问题及大规模实例上优势显著。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽为组合优化提供了统一的端到端接口，但纯文本序列化可能掩盖对生成有效CO解至关重要的空间和关系结构。
AI.method: 提出通用视觉-语言求解器，将文本描述与输入派生的视觉表示融合；单一VLM跨CO任务应用，采用监督微调后接验证器引导的强化学习训练；视觉输入不包含金标解或解派生信息。
AI.result: 实验表明VLM整体优于纯文本对应模型，在CVRP、JSSP等复杂CO问题上增益尤为明显；视觉信息的优势在大规模问题上更加突出。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息能显著增强组合优化求解能力，尤其适用于复杂、大规模问题，且无需依赖解派生的视觉信息即可实现性能提升。

title: Guard Models Are Overconfident Where Base Models Are Uncertain
summary: Guard models are used as safety classifiers, with confidence scores driving downstream moderation decisions. We evaluate five guard models for prompt classification and find that although several are nearly calibrated on clean inputs, adversarial attacks degrade their calibration by an order of magnitude, turning false negatives into high-confidence errors indistinguishable from correct detections. Comparing each guard with its corresponding base LM, we find that uncertainty signals often remain available, with the base model typically expressing uncertainty on the same inputs where the guard fails. Layer-wise analyses localize this guard-base divergence to later layers, where guard models exhibit sharper safe/unsafe separation and lower-rank representations, while adversarial harmful inputs lie closer to the clean-safe region. These findings highlight a mismatch between guard confidence and base model uncertainty under attack.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了五个守护模型在提示分类任务中的表现，发现对抗攻击会严重降低其校准性能，导致高置信度错误；基础语言模型在守护模型失效时仍保留不确定性信号，层级分析显示分歧主要发生在后期层，守护模型表现出更锐利的安全/不安全分离和更低秩表示，对抗有害输入更接近干净安全区域，揭示了攻击下守护模型置信度与基础模型不确定性的错配。
AI.motivation: 守护模型作为安全分类器，其置信度分数驱动下游内容审核决策，但对抗攻击下的校准性能和可靠性尚未充分研究，需要评估守护模型在对抗条件下的表现及其与基础模型不确定性的关系。
AI.method: 评估五个守护模型在提示分类任务上的表现，对比其在干净输入和对抗攻击下的校准性能；将每个守护模型与其对应的基础语言模型进行对比，分析不确定性信号；进行层级分析，定位守护模型与基础模型表示的分歧层级，考察安全/不安全分离锐度、表示秩及对抗有害输入在表示空间中的位置。
AI.result: 几个守护模型在干净输入上近似校准，但对抗攻击使校准性能下降一个数量级，将假阴性转化为与正确检测无法区分的高置信度错误；基础模型在守护模型失效的相同输入上通常表达不确定性；层级分析显示守护-基础模型分歧定位于后期层，守护模型表现出更锐利的安全/不安全分离和更低秩表示，对抗有害输入在表示空间中更接近干净安全区域。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了对抗攻击下守护模型置信度与基础模型不确定性之间的错配，指出守护模型在后期层学习到的过度自信、低秩表示可能导致对抗鲁棒性下降，建议未来工作利用基础模型的不确定性信号提升守护模型的可靠性。

title: Automated Screw Planning for Reduced Pelvic Fractures Based on Statistical Shape Models and Deep Learning
summary: Percutaneous iliosacral screw fixation is an important minimally invasive treatment for unstable pelvic fractures. Because the sacroiliac region has complex anatomy and narrow screw corridors, the accuracy and safety of screw placement directly affect surgical outcomes. Accurate and reliable preoperative screw planning is therefore essential to improve surgical success and reduce intraoperative risks. Conventional preoperative planning typically requires surgeons to determine screw trajectories through manual measurements, a labor-intensive process that depends on subjective clinical experience. To address these challenges, we propose a fully automated pipeline for preoperative iliosacral screw planning in patients with pelvic fractures. Using patient-specific three-dimensional anatomy, the pipeline automatically identifies safe screw corridors and generates individualized insertion trajectories to support clinical preoperative planning. We evaluated the proposed pipeline on 200 clinical cases of pelvic fractures. Compared with conventional manual measurements, the safety margin of the safe insertion corridors increased by 2% across the four screw types, the mean planning time decreased by more than 90%, and the clinical acceptance rate reached 95%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全自动的髂骶螺钉术前规划流水线，利用患者特异性三维解剖结构自动识别安全螺钉通道并生成个性化入针轨迹。在200例盆骨骨折临床病例中验证，相比人工测量，安全边际平均提升2%，规划时间缩短90%以上，临床接受率达95%。
AI.motivation: 经皮髂骶螺钉固定是治疗不稳定盆骨骨折的重要微创手段，但骶髂区解剖复杂、螺钉通道狭窄，螺钉植入的准确性与安全性直接影响手术预后。传统术前规划依赖医生人工测量，耗时费力且主观性强，亟需自动化、客观化的规划方法以提高手术成功率并降低术中风险。
AI.method: 构建基于患者特异性三维解剖的全自动规划流水线：自动分割骨骼结构、识别骶髂关节解剖标志、计算四种类型髂骶螺钉的安全植入通道、生成个性化入针轨迹及参数（入针点、角度、长度、直径），输出术前规划报告供临床参考。
AI.result: 在200例盆骨骨折临床病例中验证：四种螺钉类型的安全边际平均较人工测量提升2%；平均规划时间缩短90%以上；经骨科医生评估，临床接受率达到95%。
AI.conclusion: 该全自动流水线能够快速、准确地生成个性化髂骶螺钉术前规划，显著提高规划效率与安全边际，具有较高的临床适用性，可辅助医生制定更优的手术方案，降低术中并发症风险。

title: CredWise: A Controlled Agentic Decision-Intelligence Framework for Explainable and Auditable Credit-Risk Assessment
summary: Credit-risk prediction is important in banking, but a prediction alone does not explain why an applicant is risky or how it should be combined with other evidence. This paper presents CredWise, a decision-support framework that integrates credit-risk prediction, probability calibration, explainable artificial intelligence, policy retrieval, SQL analytics, and controlled agent-based workflows. An XGBoost model is trained on Lending Club data (1,345,310 loans, 18 features) using a temporal split: 2007--2016 for training, 2017 for validation, and 2018 for testing. On the 2018 test set, the calibrated model achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.7109, PR-AUC of 0.2993, F1-score of 0.3714, and accuracy of 65.44\%. Calibration reduced the Brier score from 0.2157 to 0.1273 and the expected calibration error from 0.2862 to 0.0585. SHAP explanations were temporally stable, with a Spearman correlation of 0.9959 between 2017 and 2018 feature rankings. On 28 labeled queries covering nine policy sections, FAISS achieved the best Hit@1 (0.929) and MRR (0.964), while all three retrieval methods reached Hit@5 = 1.0. Agent routing achieved 95.6\% accuracy (43 of 45 cases), and the SQL benchmark scored 1.0 on exact-match, execution-success, and result-match across six cases. These results show that CredWise can combine predictions, explanations, policy evidence, and structured analytics in one controlled workflow. It is an academic research prototype, and final decisions remain with a human reviewer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CredWise 决策支持框架，整合信用风险预测、概率校准、可解释 AI、政策检索、SQL 分析和受控智能体工作流，在 Lending Club 数据上验证了各模块性能，展示了端到端受控工作流的可行性。
AI.motivation: 信用风险预测仅给出风险概率，无法解释申请人为何风险高，也难以与其他证据（政策、结构化数据）结合。需要一个整合预测、解释、政策检索和结构化分析的受控工作流，辅助人工审批决策。
AI.method: 使用 XGBoost 在 Lending Club 数据（1,345,310 笔贷款，18 个特征）上训练，采用时间切分：2007-2016 训练，2017 验证，2018 测试。引入概率校准（降低 Brier 分数和 ECE），SHAP 进行可解释性分析，FAISS 等方法进行政策检索，智能体路由和 SQL 执行进行结构化分析，构建端到端受控工作流。
AI.result: 校准后模型在 2018 测试集上 ROC-AUC 0.7109、PR-AUC 0.2993、F1 0.3714、准确率 65.44%。校准将 Brier 分数从 0.2157 降至 0.1273，ECE 从 0.2862 降至 0.0585。SHAP 特征排序在 2017 和 2018 年 Spearman 相关性 0.9959，时间稳定性强。政策检索 FAISS 命中率@1 0.929、MRR 0.964，三种方法均达 Hit@5=1.0。智能体路由准确率 95.6%（43/45），SQL 基准在 6 个案例上精确匹配、执行成功、结果匹配均为 1.0。
AI.conclusion: CredWise 成功将预测、解释、政策证据和结构化分析整合在一个受控工作流中，作为学术研究原型，最终决策仍由人工审核者把关。

title: The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match the teacher's next-token distributions on the student's own trajectories and has yielded substantial empirical gains. Generalized variants allow the student to surpass the teacher by extrapolating an implicit reward in output space. The language-model head, however, attenuates this change anisotropically: much of the change encoded in the teacher's hidden states reaches the logits at a small fraction of its weight, and the sampled-token log-probability ratios on which output-space extrapolation relies inject noise that the extrapolation amplifies, making training unstable. We observe that reinforcement learning (RL) shifts a model's internal representations relative to its base checkpoint, and that the direction of this shift can be measured at every layer. Motivated by this observation, we propose RIDE (RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation), which extrapolates the RL-induced change directly in representation space: at every layer and token position, RIDE computes the residual between the teacher and its pre-RL checkpoint and regresses the student's hidden states toward targets displaced beyond the teacher along this residual. Conditioned on a sampled trajectory, this regression is equivalent to maximizing a linear directional reward defined by the residual under a quadratic penalty centered at the teacher, which makes explicit how the objective moves the student along the RL-induced direction while limiting its deviation from the teacher. Across four base/RL-teacher pairs spanning different scales, architectures, and pre-training lineages, RIDE approaches or exceeds the RL-trained teacher on every pair and is the only method whose mean does so, and it consistently outperforms output-space extrapolation, which degrades the student whenever the teacher is close to its base. Project page: https://github.com/xixixixixxxx/RIDE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RIDE (RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation)，通过在表示空间直接外推 RL 训练引起的隐藏状态变化，而非在输出空间外推，解决了 on-policy distillation 中语言模型头对隐藏状态变化的各向异性衰减及采样噪声放大问题，使学生模型能稳定超越 RL 教师模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的 on-policy distillation (OPD) 及其泛化变体在输出空间外推隐式奖励，但语言模型头会各向异性地衰减教师隐藏状态中的变化（仅小部分权重到达 logits），且采样 token 的对数概率比会注入噪声并被外推放大，导致训练不稳定。作者观察到 RL 训练会相对于基础 checkpoint 系统性地偏移模型内部表示，且该偏移方向可在每层测量，因此动机是直接在表示空间外推 RL 诱导的方向，避开输出空间的缺陷。
AI.method: RIDE 在每一层和每个 token 位置计算 RL 教师模型与其预 RL checkpoint 之间的残差向量（RL 诱导方向），然后将学生模型的隐藏状态回归到沿该残差方向位于教师模型之外的目标位置。条件于采样轨迹，该回归等价于最大化由残差定义的线性方向奖励，并在教师处施加二次惩罚，显式地将学生沿 RL 方向移动同时限制偏离程度。
AI.result: 在四组不同规模、架构和预训练谱系的 base/RL-teacher 对上，RIDE 在每一对上都接近或超越 RL 教师，且是唯一均值超越教师的方法；持续优于输出空间外推方法，后者在教师接近 base 时反而降低学生性能。
AI.conclusion: 直接在表示空间外推 RL 诱导的方向变化优于在输出空间外推，RIDE 提供了一种稳定、有效的知识蒸馏范式，能让学生模型可靠地超越 RL 教师模型。

title: When Upstream Messages Override Correct Answers: A Controlled Study of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems rely on message passing among specialized agents to accomplish complex tasks. However, an upstream agent may provide useful information or an incorrect answer that causes a downstream agent to override a correct answer supported by its own evidence. Prior work has not clearly separated the benefits of communication from the damage caused by incorrect messages. We study this problem with controlled experiments across five benchmarks and five receivers, keeping the downstream task and evidence fixed while comparing answers under three conditions: no message, the upstream agent's original message, or a message with the opposite conclusion. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, messages often help when the downstream agent would otherwise answer incorrectly. Second, messages can also hurt: when the downstream agent would answer correctly without a message, an incorrect upstream message changes the answer in up to 32% of cases. Third, in 94% of audited harmful cases, the downstream agent copies the upstream's specific wrong answer--a pattern we term answer substitution. Removing unreliable messages recovers part of the lost accuracy, suggesting that communication should be selective based on upstream reliability and the evidence already available to the downstream agent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体LLM系统中上游智能体消息对下游智能体的影响，通过受控实验揭示消息传递的双刃剑效应：消息能纠正错误，但也会导致正确答案被错误覆盖（答案替换现象），建议基于上游可靠性选择性通信。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统依赖消息传递完成复杂任务，但上游智能体可能提供有用信息或错误答案，导致下游智能体覆盖自身证据支持的正确答案。先前工作未清晰区分通信收益与错误消息造成的损害，亟需系统量化这种权衡。
AI.method: 在五个基准和五个接收智能体上进行受控实验，固定下游任务和证据，对比三种条件：无消息、上游原始消息、结论相反的消息。通过审计有害案例，识别答案替换模式，并测试移除不可靠消息对准确率的恢复效果。
AI.result: 三大发现：1) 消息常能帮助原本会答错的下游智能体；2) 错误消息会损害原本答对的智能体，导致其在高达32%情况下改变正确答案；3) 94%有害案例中下游智能体直接复制上游具体错误答案，称为答案替换。移除不可靠消息可部分恢复准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通信应具有选择性，基于上游智能体可靠性及下游已有证据决定是否采纳消息，以最大化协作收益并最小化错误传播风险。

title: Optimal Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study an unknown-transition finite-horizon Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite collection of known reward functions $\{r^1, r^2, \ldots, r^M\}$. The goal is to output an $ε$-optimal policy for every reward using online episodic interaction only. Performance is measured by the policy error $V_{0}^{*, m} - V_{0}^{\widehatπ^{m}, m}$ where $m\in [M]$ represents the reward function and $V_{0}^{*, m}=\mathbb{E}_{s_1\sim μ}[V_{1}^{*, m}(s_1)]$. Under this setting, we design a provably efficient algorithm to establish a minimax sample complexity bound of $$ O\left(\frac{SAH^3}{ε^2}\log M \mathrm{polylog}\left(\frac{SAH\log M}{\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ}\right)\right)$$ episodes, with no additional burn-in cost. This matches the information-theoretic lower bound up to a factor of $ \mathrm{polylog}(SAH\log M/(\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ))$. Our method combines three technical ingredients. First, we adapt MVP to reward-switching learning to construct optimistic value estimates. Second, we use fresh replay samples to conservatively evaluate the candidate policies. Third, gap-based multiplicative weights updates adjust the reward-sampling distribution using the differences between these estimates, converting weighted learning progress into simultaneous guarantees for all rewards.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究未知转移概率的有限时域马尔可夫决策过程(MDP)，给定有限个已知奖励函数，目标是通过在线交互为每个奖励函数输出ε最优策略。提出了一种可证明高效的算法，实现了最小最大样本复杂度界 O(SAH³/ε² log M polylog(...))，匹配信息论下界，且无额外预热成本。
AI.motivation: 动机是解决多奖励函数下的同时策略学习问题：在转移概率未知但奖励函数已知的情况下，希望通过在线回合交互，同时为所有M个奖励函数学习近似最优策略，且样本复杂度仅对log M呈对数依赖，避免对每个奖励单独学习的线性依赖。
AI.method: 方法结合三大技术要素：(1) 将MVP(Minimax Value Propagation)算法扩展到奖励切换学习，构建乐观价值估计；(2) 使用新鲜重放样本对候选策略进行保守评估；(3) 基于差距的乘法权重更新，利用价值估计差异调整奖励采样分布，将加权学习进度转化为对所有奖励的同时保证。
AI.result: 算法达到样本复杂度 O(SAH³/ε² log M polylog(SAH log M/(min{ε,1}δ)))，匹配信息论下界直到polylog因子，且无额外预热成本。这是首个在未知转移MDP中实现对数依赖于奖励数量M的同时最优策略学习结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了多奖励未知转移MDP中同时学习的最小最大最优样本复杂度，通过MVP、保守评估和乘法权重更新的组合，实现了对所有奖励函数的统一ε最优保证，为多任务/多目标强化学习提供了理论基础。

title: IronLLM: Forging Compact Edge-Native Language Models for Real-Time Embodied Intelligence
summary: We present IronLLM-0.6B, a 654M-parameter language model designed for efficient on-device inference. IronLLM-0.6B combines a hybrid attention architecture with X-MTP, a lightweight shared-KV multi-token prediction design that eliminates per-depth KV-cache replay and employs a lightweight verification head for rollback-free drafting, achieving a 1.48x decoding speedup. The model is pretrained on approximately 6.2 trillion tokens using a quality-oriented data pipeline and is further post-trained with Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation to integrate capabilities from domain-specialized teachers. To better meet the low-latency requirements of on-device scenarios, IronLLM-0.6B adopts an Instruct-Only design. Evaluations show that IronLLM-0.6B achieves competitive performance relative to larger models such as Qwen3.5-0.8B and MiniCPM5-1B, while producing more concise responses on many tasks. We further present IronLLM-0.6B-Light, which replaces RMSNorm with Dynamic Tanh and simplifies several computationally expensive components to improve inference and quantization efficiency. Together, the IronLLM models provide an effective performance-efficiency trade-off for resource-constrained deployment.

AI.tldr: IronLLM-0.6B 是一个 6.54 亿参数的语言模型，专为设备端高效推理设计。采用混合注意力架构和 X-MTP 多 Token 预测设计，实现 1.48 倍解码加速；在约 6.2 万亿 Token 上预训练，并通过多领域在线策略蒸馏进行后训练。性能与 Qwen3.5-0.8B、MiniCPM5-1B 等更大模型竞争，响应更简洁。同时提供 IronLLM-0.6B-Light 变体，用 Dynamic Tanh 替换 RMSNorm 进一步提升推理和量化效率。
AI.motivation: 现有小模型在设备端部署时面临延迟高、推理效率低、量化困难等问题。需要一种在参数量极小（<1B）的情况下，仍能保持竞争性性能、低延迟、易量化且适合资源受限环境的模型。
AI.method: 1. 混合注意力架构结合 X-MTP：共享 KV 缓存的多 Token 预测，消除逐层 KV 缓存重放，使用轻量验证头实现无回滚草稿。2. 质量导向数据管道预训练约 6.2 万亿 Token。3. 多领域在线策略蒸馏（Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation）融合领域专用教师模型能力。4. Instruct-Only 设计满足低延迟需求。5. Light 版本用 Dynamic Tanh 替代 RMSNorm，简化计算昂贵组件。
AI.result: IronLLM-0.6B 在多项评测中性能接近或优于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 与 MiniCPM5-1B 等更大模型，且生成响应更简洁；X-MTP 带来 1.48 倍解码加速。IronLLM-0.6B-Light 进一步提升推理与量化效率。
AI.conclusion: IronLLM 系列在极小参数量下实现了性能与效率的有效权衡，为资源受限的设备端部署提供了实用方案。

title: SemOPT: Fixing Semantic Errors in LLM-based Optimization Modeling via Reward-Guided Search
summary: Operations research supports decision-making in domains such as energy, economics, and healthcare. Solving operations research problems typically begins with optimization modeling, which translates a natural-language problem description into executable solver code. LLMs offer a promising way to automate this process, but they remain prone to errors. In practice, these errors can be divided into two categories: syntactic errors refer to solver code that fails to run successfully or is judged infeasible by the solver; semantic errors refer to solver code that successfully returns an objective value but violates the intent of the original problem. Since semantic errors do not trigger runtime failures, they are difficult to detect and rectify. To address this problem, we introduce SemOPT, a semantic-guided framework for correcting LLM-based optimization models. SemOPT combines a semantic reward model that distinguishes faithful math models from plausible but incorrect ones with an adaptive correction system that applies hierarchical reward-guided search over the modeling space. Experiments on seven optimization modeling benchmarks show that SemOPT establishes a new state of the art and achieves an average 7.6% accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on complex datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SemOPT框架，通过语义奖励模型和自适应层级搜索修正LLM生成的运筹优化建模代码中的语义错误，在七个基准测试上达到最优性能，复杂数据集平均提升7.6%准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM在自动化运筹优化建模时易产生两类错误：语法错误（代码无法运行或求解器判定不可行）和语义错误（代码运行成功但违背原问题意图）。语义错误因不触发运行时失败而难以检测和修正，现有方法缺乏有效的语义校验机制。
AI.method: SemOPT包含两大核心组件：1) 语义奖励模型，训练用于区分忠实数学模型与貌似合理但错误的模型；2) 自适应修正系统，基于奖励模型在建模空间执行层级奖励引导搜索，迭代修正语义偏差。
AI.result: 在七个优化建模基准测试中，SemOPT建立新的SOTA，相比最强基线在复杂数据集上平均提升7.6%准确率，有效解决了语义错误检测难的问题。
AI.conclusion: 语义引导的奖励建模结合层级搜索修正是解决LLM优化建模语义错误的有效范式，显著提升了复杂运筹问题自动建模的可靠性和准确性。

title: AdaptArena: Evaluating Test-Time Personalization of Web Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong performance on complex web navigation tasks, yet they remain brittle in real-world settings where user intentions are underspecified and preferences are heterogeneous. In practice, users rarely provide explicit profiles, requiring agents to infer latent preferences from implicit signals. Despite its importance for deployment, this problem setting is largely underexplored in existing benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce AdaptArena, a benchmark for evaluating test-time personalization of web agents via implicit preference inference. AdaptArena consists of 480 tasks, featuring both single-preference and double-preference scenarios. Each evaluation task must be solved by retrieving and leveraging the most relevant historical user trajectory that implicitly encodes the target preference. In addition, we introduce AdaptiveAgent, a retrieval-based framework for standardized evaluation of implicit preference inference. Experiments reveal a substantial performance gap: while oracle agents with access to ground-truth preferences achieve an 82.92% success rate, the evaluated LLM agents using our framework reach at most 15.62%. Furthermore, we find that correctly inferring user preferences is necessary but not sufficient for task success, as execution failures in downstream web interactions remain a significant bottleneck even when agents align with the target preference. These findings highlight implicit preference inference and robust action grounding as key challenges for deploying reliable, user-facing web agents. We release our code: https://github.com/McGill-NLP/web-agents-test-time-adaptations

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 AdaptArena 基准和 AdaptiveAgent 框架，用于评估 Web 代理在测试时通过隐式偏好推理进行个性化的能力。实验显示，拥有真实偏好的 Oracle 代理成功率达 82.92%，而使用该框架的 LLM 代理最高仅 15.62%，揭示了隐式偏好推理与鲁棒动作落地是部署可靠用户向 Web 代理的关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 代理在复杂 Web 导航任务上表现强劲，但在用户意图未明确、偏好异构的真实场景中依然脆弱。用户极少提供显式画像，代理需从隐式信号推断潜在偏好，但这一问题在现有基准中鲜有探索。
AI.method: 构建包含 480 个任务的 AdaptArena 基准，涵盖单偏好与双偏好场景；每个评估任务要求检索并利用最相关的历史用户轨迹（隐式编码目标偏好）。同时提出基于检索的 AdaptiveAgent 框架，作为隐式偏好推理的标准化评估流程。
AI.result: Oracle 代理（知晓真实偏好）成功率 82.92%，而评测的 LLM 代理最高仅 15.62%。正确推断偏好是必要但非充分条件：即使代理与目标偏好对齐，下游 Web 交互中的执行失败仍是显著瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 隐式偏好推理与鲁棒的动作落地（action grounding）是实现可靠、面向用户的 Web 代理部署必须解决的两大核心挑战。

title: State Trace Rationale As Auxiliary Task in Reinforcement Learning
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: We propose STRAT, an auxiliary task that trains deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents to predict a short textual trace of their own state. Inspired by human spatial navigation, the description combines landmark, route, and survey knowledge, tracking the agent's position, inventory, goals, and immediate progress. Environment rules generate this text online without human labelling. Our method adds a single auxiliary head to a standard policy. Across 60 sparse-reward XLand-MiniGrid tasks, STRAT solves complex environments where standard RL fails outright, while compacting state representations and preventing rank collapse. Beyond performance gains, the predicted trace provides a readable account of agent beliefs at every step for no extra cost.

AI.tldr: STRAT是一种辅助任务，训练深度RL智能体预测自身状态的短文本轨迹，结合地标、路线和测绘知识，无需人工标注即可在线生成文本，显著提升稀疏奖励环境下的性能。
AI.motivation: 受人类空间导航启发，旨在解决深度RL在稀疏奖励环境中的失败问题，同时提供可读的智能体信念轨迹，压缩状态表示并防止秩崩塌。
AI.method: 在标准策略网络上添加单个辅助头，环境规则在线生成包含位置、库存、目标和即时进展的文本轨迹，作为辅助任务训练智能体预测。
AI.result: 在60个稀疏奖励XLand-MiniGrid任务中，STRAT解决了标准RL完全失败的复杂环境，同时压缩状态表示、防止秩崩塌，且预测轨迹提供无额外成本的可读智能体信念记录。
AI.conclusion: STRAT通过自监督文本预测辅助任务，有效增强RL智能体在稀疏奖励环境中的探索和泛化能力，且提供可解释的内部状态表示，是一种低成本高收益的辅助学习方法。

title: Compiling Learning Problems into Adaptation Programs for Language Models
summary: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs---their expected effects on acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation---and selects a program before adaptation begins. Because this predicted geometry captures multiple behavioral consequences rather than a single winner or scalar score, it can be reused under different downstream priorities without retraining. Across five learning types, preferred programs vary meaningfully across episodes, and this variation is predictable from pre-adaptation information. On Llama-3.1-8B, compiler-selected programs approach exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. Replication on Gemma-2-9B preserves program heterogeneity and selection headroom, but shows that exploiting this headroom requires accounting for uncertainty when departing from strong defaults. Together, these results show that adaptation search can be amortized across related learning problems, turning prior adaptation experience into a basis for deciding how future learning should occur.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“适应编译”框架，将模型适应的位置、方式和程度建模为联合预测与决策问题。编译器从历史适应经验中学习，预测候选程序在获取、迁移、有界性、保持性等多维行为上的反事实响应面，并在适应开始前选择程序。该方法将适应搜索摊销到相关学习任务中，无需重新训练即可在不同下游优先级下复用。实验表明，编译器选程序接近穷举搜索性能，优于全局和目标特定默认策略；在 Gemma-2-9B 上复现显示利用选择余量需考虑不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有模型适应通常遵循固定配方，但不同更新程序会产生截然不同的行为结果。缺乏一种能够根据预适应信息预测多维行为后果、并在适应前自动选择最优程序的机制，导致适应搜索无法在相关任务间复用经验。
AI.method: 提出适应编译：编译器从历史适应数据中学习，预测候选程序在获取、迁移、有界性、保持性四个维度上的向量值反事实响应面，据此在适应开始前选择程序。该预测几何捕捉多维行为后果而非单一标量分数，可在不同下游优先级下直接复用无需重训练。
AI.result: 跨五种学习类型，最优程序在不同情节间显著变化，且这种变化可从预适应信息预测。在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，编译器选程序性能接近穷举搜索，优于全局和目标特定默认策略。在 Gemma-2-9B 上复现保持了程序异质性和选择余量，但利用余量需在偏离强默认策略时考虑不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 适应搜索可跨相关学习问题摊销，将历史适应经验转化为决定未来学习如何进行的基础。适应编译为模型适应提供了可复用、多目标感知的程序选择机制，显著提升适应效率与效果。

title: LLMs Learn to Evade Latent Monitors from Prior Feedback Alone
summary: Latent space monitors aim to detect undesired behaviors in LLM agents by inspecting an agent's internal activations rather than its outputs. However, interactive monitoring creates a feedback channel where each verdict the monitor delivers leaks information to the model about how its internal states are being evaluated. We ask whether an agent can infer the monitor's decision rule from this feedback and then selectively edit its activations to evade detection. Unlike prior evasion attacks, the model is never explicitly told what the monitor detects. Surprisingly, off-the-shelf models already produce activation edits aligned with the monitored direction, but at insufficient magnitude for evasion. Simply scaling up these edits by a factor of 8 reduces the monitor's TPR from 100% to 27%. A rank-1 LoRA amplifies this behavior into effective evasion within the forward pass, reducing TPR further to 4% on held-out concept monitors while leaving other concepts at their normal detection rates. Capabilities on standard benchmarks are retained under this finetuning, and the evasion skill survives retraining the monitors on the new activations. Mechanistically, we find evidence that the model computes its activation edit from the prior in-context turns, and show that the edit becomes more aligned with the monitored direction as more examples are provided. These results demonstrate feedback-conditioned control over activations and suggest that latent monitoring should be treated as an interactive process in which agents can observe and respond to oversight measures.

AI.tldr: 论文发现交互式潜在空间监控会泄露反馈信息，使模型能推断监控规则并编辑激活以逃避检测。现成模型已具备该能力，放大编辑幅度或用低秩LoRA微调即可大幅降低检测率（TPR从100%降至4%），且不损害基准能力，逃避技能具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 潜在空间监控通过检查内部激活检测不良行为，但交互式监控产生反馈通道，每个判决都泄露模型内部状态评估信息。作者探究模型能否从反馈中推断监控决策规则，并选择性编辑激活以逃避检测，且模型从未被显式告知监控检测内容。
AI.method: 实验使用现成模型，观察其在交互式监控反馈下产生的激活编辑；将编辑幅度放大8倍；训练秩为1的LoRA在前向传播中放大逃避行为；在保留概念监控上测试泛化性；评估标准基准能力保留情况；在重新训练监控器后测试逃避技能鲁棒性；机制分析模型如何从上下文轮次计算激活编辑，以及编辑与监控方向对齐随示例数量变化。
AI.result: 现成模型已产生与监控方向对齐的激活编辑，但幅度不足；放大8倍使监控器TPR从100%降至27%；秩1 LoRA微调进一步将TPR降至4%（在保留概念监控上），其他概念检测率正常；标准基准能力保留；逃避技能在监控器重新训练后依然有效；机制上，模型从上下文轮次计算编辑，随示例增加编辑与监控方向对齐度提高。
AI.conclusion: 反馈条件激活控制表明潜在监控应被视为交互式过程，代理能观察并响应监督措施。现有模型已具备从反馈推断监控规则并编辑激活逃避检测的能力，且该能力可通过简单放大或低秩微调显著增强，具有鲁棒性。

title: WEFT: Scaling Tool-Use Post-Training for General-Purpose Agents
summary: Recent efforts to scale tool-use post-training have largely centered on the synthesis of executable environments, which constitute only one component of a broader agentic interaction system comprising the environment, task, agent harness, and evaluator. Scaling environments in isolation, however, does not guarantee commensurate gains in model performance, because reliable learning signals depend on coherent interactions among all components of the agentic interaction system. To address this problem, we introduce WEFT (Whole-system Evolution For Tool-use Post-training), which couples scalable agentic interaction system construction, execution-driven self-evolution, and stable post-training. WEFT scales agentic interaction system construction across environment breadth, task complexity, and interaction diversity. Execution-driven self-evolution iteratively uses execution traces and state evidence to attribute failures and revise the responsible components, with fresh rollouts evaluating the changes and providing evidence for subsequent evolution rounds. For stable post-training at scale, WEFT addresses both optimization and execution reliability: prefix-preserving sampling retains verified progress and atomic-turn credit assignment localizes learning signals, while MegaMCP maintains isolated, recoverable state across concurrent rollouts over shared tool services. Extensive experiments across various models and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of WEFT for tool-use post-training. WEFT-8B and WEFT-14B outperform all evaluated matched-size environment-scaling baselines on BFCL V4, $τ^2$-Bench, and Claw-Eval. In particular, WEFT-14B improves over Agent-World-14B by 6.41, 2.23, and 12.27 percentage points. WEFT-35B-A3B further extends these gains to more challenging long-horizon workflow benchmarks, including Toolathlon-Verified and AutomationBench.

AI.tldr: WEFT（全系统工具使用后训练进化框架）通过耦合可扩展的智能体交互系统构建、执行驱动的自我进化和稳定的大规模后训练，解决了仅扩展环境无法保证模型性能提升的问题，在多个基准上显著超越同规模基线。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用后训练的扩展工作主要集中在可执行环境的合成，但环境只是智能体交互系统（环境、任务、智能体框架、评估器）的一个组件。孤立地扩展环境无法保证模型性能的同步提升，因为可靠的学习信号依赖于智能体交互系统所有组件之间的协同交互。
AI.method: WEFT包含三大核心模块：1）可扩展的智能体交互系统构建，跨环境广度、任务复杂度和交互多样性进行扩展；2）执行驱动的自我进化，利用执行轨迹和状态证据归因失败并修订责任组件，通过新鲜的回合评估变更并为后续进化轮次提供证据；3）稳定的大规模后训练，采用前缀保留采样保留已验证进度，原子轮次信用分配定位学习信号，以及MegaMCP在共享工具服务上维护并发回合间隔离、可恢复的状态。
AI.result: 在多个模型和基准上的大量实验表明WEFT的有效性。WEFT-8B和WEFT-14B在BFCL V4、τ²-Bench和Claw-Eval上均超越所有评估的同规模环境扩展基线。特别是WEFT-14B比Agent-World-14B分别提升6.41、2.23和12.27个百分点。WEFT-35B-A3B进一步将这些增益扩展到更具挑战性的长时程工作流基准，包括Toolathlon-Verified和AutomationBench。
AI.conclusion: WEFT通过整体系统层面的协同进化，有效解决了工具使用后训练中环境扩展与性能提升不匹配的问题，为大规模智能体交互系统的构建和优化提供了系统性的解决方案，显著提升了模型在工具使用和长时程任务上的能力。

title: Look What You Made Us Cluster: Hate Narrative Extraction from Reddit Discourse
summary: Narrative extraction allows us to identify online hate narratives, supporting the construction of rigorous detection systems. Existing computational approaches, however, are limited in precision as they rely on semantic representations, which tend to capture only surface-level meaning. To detect more precise and interpretable narratives, we present an extraction pipeline that represents narratives as entity-evaluation pairs. Narratives are extracted using a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning process that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, identifying the aspect, classifying its judgement type as the basis for evaluation, and deriving the evaluation accordingly. Extracted narratives are then clustered using Leiden, following which clusters are resolved to an intended level of granularity through an LLM-guided refinement process. We illustrate this narrative pipeline with English Reddit comments from 2024 that criticize Taylor Swift, analyzing a representative cluster that exhibits hate speech patterns to demonstrate its interpretive value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种叙事提取流水线，将叙事表示为实体-评价对，利用大语言模型推理扩展基于方面的情感分析，结合 Leiden 聚类和 LLM 引导的细化过程，从 Reddit 评论中精准提取并解释针对泰勒·斯威夫特的仇恨言论叙事。
AI.motivation: 现有计算方法依赖语义表示，只能捕捉表层含义，精度有限；需要更精确、可解释的叙事提取方法来支持严格的仇恨言论检测系统构建。
AI.method: 1) 将叙事建模为实体-评价对；2) 采用 LLM 推理扩展 ABSA：识别方面、分类判断类型、推导评价；3) 使用 Leiden 算法聚类提取的叙事；4) 通过 LLM 引导的细化过程将聚类调整至预期粒度。
AI.result: 在 2024 年英文 Reddit 批评泰勒·斯威夫特的评论上演示流水线，分析了一个展现仇恨言论模式的代表性聚类，证明了该方法的解释价值。
AI.conclusion: 该叙事提取流水线通过实体-评价对表示和 LLM 增强的推理，实现了更精准、可解释的仇恨叙事识别，为构建严格的检测系统提供了有效工具。

title: Efficient and Scalable Physics-Guided Fully Convolutional Spatiotemporal Learning for 3D Microstructure Evolution Prediction
summary: Accurate prediction of three-dimensional (3D) microstructure evolution remains computationally demanding because high-fidelity phase-field simulations require repeated numerical integration over large volumetric domains and long temporal horizons. This study develops an efficient and scalable physics-guided fully convolutional spatiotemporal framework for direct multi-frame prediction of complete 3D microstructure sequences. The model combines shared 3D spatial encoding and decoding with a factorized latent translator that integrates temporal, local 3D spatial, and channel interactions. A discrete Cahn--Hilliard (CH) residual is incorporated during training to regularize the learned evolution toward the governing dynamics without altering the inference pathway. The framework is evaluated on high-resolution 3D spinodal-decomposition trajectories under nominal, long-horizon, and reduced-temporal-context forecasting. Under full temporal context, the model accurately reproduces volumetric evolution, with average 3D structural similarity remaining above 0.97 over the nominal prediction horizon. Physics guidance becomes increasingly beneficial as temporal information is reduced, improving predictive robustness and preservation of interface-level morphology. The framework also achieves more than a 30-fold wall-clock speedup relative to the reference spectral phase-field solver, while physics guidance introduces no additional inference cost. These results establish direct multi-frame, physics-guided fully convolutional learning as a high-throughput surrogate strategy for dense 3D phase-field dynamics and repeated microstructure forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种物理引导的全卷积时空框架，用于直接多帧预测完整的三维微观结构序列，实现了比相场谱求解器快30倍以上的推理速度，同时保持了高精度（结构相似度>0.97）。物理引导在时间信息减少时显著提升预测鲁棒性，且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 高保真相场模拟需要在大体积域和长时间范围内进行重复数值积分，计算成本极高，限制了三维微观结构演化的准确预测。需要开发高效、可扩展的代理模型来替代昂贵的数值模拟。
AI.method: 构建了一个物理引导的全卷积时空框架：共享三维空间编码器和解码器，配合因子化潜在变量转换器整合时间、局部三维空间和通道交互；训练时引入离散Cahn-Hilliard（CH）残差作为物理正则化项，约束学习演化遵循物理动力学，但推理路径不改变。
AI.result: 在高分辨率三维尖晶石分解轨迹上评估：完全时间上下文下，平均三维结构相似度在标称预测范围内保持>0.97；物理引导在时间信息减少时显著提升预测鲁棒性和界面形貌保真度；相比参考谱相场求解器实现30倍以上墙钟加速，物理引导不增加推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 直接多帧、物理引导的全卷积学习确立了高吞吐量的稠密三维相场动力学和重复微观结构预测的代理策略，为大规模微观结构演化模拟提供了实用的高效替代方案。

title: Beyond Sub-Gaussian Detector Scores: Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection for Human-LLM Text Segmentation
summary: Mixed human-LLM documents require locating authorship transitions from detector scores whose reliability varies across text units. Existing weighted mean contrasts are vulnerable to extreme scores, while directly replacing means with robust centers obscures how a misplaced boundary changes the population objective. We propose Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection (RWCP), which combines capped reliability weights, Huber profile gains, and narrowest-over-threshold search in reliability coordinates. Our key analysis expresses the population gap between a true and a displaced split as a merge cost, avoiding a closed-form solution for the nonlinear center of a mixed segment. Under explicit curvature, spacing, and dependence conditions, core RWCP recovers the number of changes and localizes their boundaries; its quadratic-loss limit recovers squared weighted CUSUM. We also study RWCP-R, a separately evaluated decoder that shares source centers across nonadjacent passages. Across five retrospective cached-score benchmark families, core RWCP reduces family-macro WindowDiff by 17.6\% relative to weighted change-point detection, and RWCP-R lowers it further. Boundary recovery improves most clearly for isolated changes, while both fixed configurations miss changes in collaborative and densely alternating text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RWCP（鲁棒加权轮廓损失变点检测）方法，用于混合人类-LLM文档中的作者身份转换定位，结合截断可靠性权重、Huber轮廓增益和可靠性坐标下的最窄阈值搜索，在五个基准测试族中将WindowDiff降低17.6%，并进一步提出共享源中心的RWCP-R进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有加权均值对比易受极端分数影响，直接用鲁棒中心替代均值会掩盖边界错位对总体目标的影响；混合人类-LLM文档中检测器分数的可靠性随文本单元变化，需要一种能处理可变可靠性且避免极端值干扰的变点检测方法。
AI.method: 提出RWCP：结合截断可靠性权重、Huber轮廓增益函数，在可靠性坐标下采用最窄阈值搜索（NOT）；理论上将真实分割与错位分割的总体差距表示为合并成本，避免求解混合段非线性中心的闭式解；还提出RWCP-R解码器，跨非相邻段落共享源中心。
AI.result: 在五个回顾性缓存分数基准族上，核心RWCP相对加权变点检测将family-macro WindowDiff降低17.6%，RWCP-R进一步降低；边界恢复在孤立变化上改善最明显，但两种固定配置均在协作和密集交替文本中漏检变点。
AI.conclusion: RWCP通过鲁棒加权轮廓损失有效定位混合文档中的作者转换，理论保证在曲率、间距和依赖条件下恢复变点数和定位边界，二次损失极限退化为加权CUSUM平方；RWCP-R通过共享中心进一步提升性能，但协作和密集交替文本仍具挑战。

title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA
summary: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified evidence guides subsequent retrieval without restricting access to the global memory. We train a lightweight planner through reinforcement learning, rewarding queries that recover previously missing evidence. MERA achieves strong answer accuracy across Qwen3-30B and GPT-4o-mini backbones. With Qwen3-30B for evidence processing and answer generation, the trained 0.6B planner achieves 77.40% accuracy on LoCoMo and 71.29% on LongMemEval-S, exceeding a 30B planner without retrieval-grounded training by 4.10% and 3.96%, respectively. On LoCoMo, later retrieval rounds increase cumulative evidence recall from 55.5% to 80.5%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation)，一种将全局可搜索记忆与问题特定证据状态分离的框架，并通过强化学习训练轻量级规划器迭代检索缺失证据，在长期记忆问答基准上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆使语言模型能利用历史交互，但回答问题所需的证据往往分散在遥远的对话轮次中，而问题本身缺乏定位线索。已检索到的事实可揭示这些线索，这激励基于已获取证据来决定后续检索。
AI.method: MERA 将全局可搜索记忆与问题特定证据状态分离。已验证的证据指导后续检索，同时不限制对全局记忆的访问。通过强化学习训练轻量级规划器，奖励能够恢复先前缺失证据的查询。
AI.result: MERA 在 Qwen3-30B 和 GPT-4o-mini 骨干上均取得强答题准确率。使用 Qwen3-30B 进行证据处理和答案生成时，训练好的 0.6B 规划器在 LoCoMo 上达到 77.40% 准确率，在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 71.29%，分别比无检索基础训练的 30B 规划器高出 4.10% 和 3.96%。在 LoCoMo 上，后续检索轮次将累积证据召回率从 55.5% 提升至 80.5%。
AI.conclusion: MERA 通过轻量级规划器与强化学习相结合，实现了基于已获取证据的迭代式缺失证据检索，显著提升了长期记忆问答的准确性与证据召回率，且仅需小规模规划器即可超越大规模基线。

title: PDE-OBS: Controlled Evaluation Across Observation Patterns
comment: 57 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/PDE-OBS
summary: Physical-field reconstruction and forecasting depend on both measurement density and spatial layout, yet evaluation under a single observation pattern does not characterize performance when that pattern changes. We introduce PDE-OBS, an integrated benchmarking platform spanning numerical data generation, model training, and inference and evaluation under varying observation conditions. It combines 560,000 fields and trajectories from seven partial differential equation families with configurable observation operators and seven adapted baseline methods for stationary reconstruction and short-horizon forecasting. Separating observation construction from physical records allows users to specify parameterized patterns and deterministic mixtures for training and testing while preserving prediction targets and data splits. The evaluation protocol uses references trained for each test pattern to compare models on identical test observations and targets, alongside equal-count groups for spatial-layout comparisons. On a 14,000-record subset, we evaluate 441 trained models under nine test patterns, yielding 3,969 evaluations. Mean cross-pattern error exceeds mean matched-pattern error in all 49 PDE-method pairs, and this finding persists in a configuration-matched subset of 117 models. Denser test observations do not consistently reduce error for a fixed model. Mixed-pattern training on five completed pairs reduces large single-pattern transfer errors, although destination-trained references usually remain more accurate. Together, the benchmark and findings support systematic evaluation of observation-pattern sensitivity and provide a reusable workflow for developing methods under changing measurement conditions. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/PDE-OBS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PDE-OBS 基准平台，系统评估物理场重建与预测在不同观测模式下的性能，发现跨模式泛化误差普遍大于同模式误差，且混合模式训练可缓解迁移误差。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅在单一观测模式下进行，无法刻画模式变化时的模型鲁棒性；物理场重建与预测高度依赖测量密度与空间布局，需系统化基准来量化观测模式敏感性。
AI.method: 构建 PDE-OBS 平台：包含 7 类 PDE 家族的 56 万场/轨迹数据、可配置观测算子、7 个基线方法；将观测构造与物理记录解耦，支持参数化模式与确定性混合；评估协议采用每种测试模式专门训练的参考模型，在相同测试观测和目标上对比，并设等量组对比空间布局。
AI.result: 在 1.4 万记录子集上训练 441 个模型，9 种测试模式共 3969 次评估。所有 49 个 PDE-方法对的平均跨模式误差均大于同模式误差；在 117 个配置匹配子集中结论依然成立。更稠密的测试观测不一定降低固定模型的误差。在 5 个完成的配对上进行混合模式训练可降低大的单模式迁移误差，但目标模式训练的参考模型通常仍更准确。
AI.conclusion: PDE-OBS 提供了可复用的工作流，支持在变化测量条件下系统评估观测模式敏感性，并为开发鲁棒方法提供基准。

title: Harness Evolution as Learning: Approximation, Generalization, and Optimization Limits of Self-Improving Personal Agents
summary: As the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, increasing attention is turning to how to translate their abilities into useful behavior. Personal agents bring this question into everyday settings, where models are expected to serve individual users and continually adapt to their preferences. With the underlying model held fixed, such adaptation relies on harness engineering: designing and evolving the surrounding layer that manages context, memory, tools, and execution. Despite rapid progress, the factors governing effective harness evolution remain insufficiently understood. To narrow this gap, we investigate three central questions concerning harness architecture, harness scale, and self-evolution algorithms through complementary empirical and theoretical analyses. Empirically, we introduce a preference-oriented benchmark and systematically characterize the capabilities and limitations of personal agents associated with these three dimensions. Theoretically, we formulate harness evolution as a learning problem and explain these phenomena through approximation, generalization, and optimization errors. Analyses of reachable policies, capacity under finite interaction evidence, and biased update dynamics provide theoretical accounts of the observed phenomena. Together, these results offer a unified perspective on the limits of personalization through harness evolution and inform future harness design.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过实证与理论相结合的方式，系统研究个人智能体中哈尼斯（harness）演进的有效性因素，揭示哈尼斯架构、规模及自我演进算法对个性化能力的影响，建立统一理论框架解释个性化极限，并为未来哈尼斯设计提供指导。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能力持续增强，如何将其转化为实用的个性化行为成为核心问题。个人智能体需在固定底层模型下持续适应用户偏好，依赖哈尼斯工程管理上下文、记忆、工具与执行，但目前对决定哈尼斯演进有效性的关键因素理解仍显不足。
AI.method: 实证层面：构建偏好导向基准，系统表征个人智能体在哈尼斯架构、哈尼斯规模、自我演进算法三个维度的能力与局限。理论层面：将哈尼斯演进形式化为学习问题，利用近似误差、泛化误差、优化误差三类误差分析现象，并通过可达策略分析、有限交互证据下的容量界、有偏更新动态三个理论视角提供解释。
AI.result: 实证结果量化了三个维度对个性化性能的具体影响模式；理论分析给出了可达策略空间的刻画、有限交互数据下的容量上界、以及有偏更新导致的次优收敛机制，统一解释了实证观测到的现象。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了哈尼斯演进实现个性化的根本极限统一视角，指出了架构表达力、规模泛化权衡、演进算法优化偏差三大核心制约，为未来哈尼斯系统的原则性设计奠定了理论与实证基础。

title: Adapting Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents with Counterfactual Continuations
summary: Long-horizon agents require context compression to manage growing interaction histories. Compression quality, however, is ultimately determined by downstream execution. Existing prompt-adaptation methods infer compression errors by comparing full-context and compressed trajectories. Such comparisons cannot isolate individual compressions and are confounded by agent stochasticity. We first find that compression degrades reliability before solvability. Using matched counterfactual continuations that compare execution from the same agent state with versus without compression, we further show that severe degradation concentrates at isolated compression events. Motivated by this finding, we propose PAIR (Prompt Adaptation using Interventional Rollouts) for adapting structured compression prompts. PAIR identifies individual compressions that degrade subsequent execution, diagnoses their effects, and revises the relevant sections of a fixed compression template. PAIR achieves the strongest cross-run reliability among compressed methods in every main benchmark-scope combination, consistently exceeding the competing prompt-adaptation baseline. Without modifying the downstream agent, PAIR brings compressed execution close to the no-compression baseline and sometimes numerically exceeds it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PAIR 方法，通过干预式回溯识别并修复压缩提示中导致执行可靠性下降的个别压缩事件，使压缩执行接近甚至超过无压缩基线。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体需要上下文压缩，但现有提示适应方法通过对比完整与压缩轨迹来推断错误，无法隔离单个压缩事件且受智能体随机性干扰；研究发现压缩先损害可靠性后损害可解性，且严重退化集中在孤立压缩事件。
AI.method: 提出 PAIR（基于干预式回溯的提示适应），利用匹配的反事实延续对比同一智能体状态下有无压缩的执行，识别降低后续执行质量的个别压缩，诊断其影响，并修改固定压缩模板的相关部分。
AI.result: PAIR 在所有主要基准-范围组合中实现压缩方法中最强的跨运行可靠性，持续超越竞争基线；在不修改下游智能体情况下，压缩执行逼近无压缩基线并有时数值上超过它。
AI.conclusion: 通过隔离并修复有害压缩事件，PAIR 有效提升压缩提示的可靠性，为长时程智能体的上下文压缩提供了可行的提示适应方案。

title: HorizonFlow: Variable-Length Planning for Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
summary: Recent advances in generative planning have made trajectory inpainting a promising approach to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning. However, these methods typically specify the planning horizon before generating plan content, even though the appropriate horizon depends on the route itself. A horizon that is too short can force infeasible transitions, whereas one that is too long can introduce redundant motion. We introduce HorizonFlow, a hierarchical planner that treats plan length as an output of generation rather than a prescribed input. Its subgoal route planner guides its action-prefix controller through a sequence of latent subgoals. Both components combine insertion-based generation with flow matching to jointly generate continuous plan content and length, using the partially generated plan to guide token insertion. HorizonFlow reuses the resulting length information to select candidates and steer generation toward shorter plans without a separate learned value model. Across Maze2D, Multi2D, and OGBench navigation and visual manipulation benchmarks, HorizonFlow achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: HorizonFlow 是一种分层规划器，将规划长度作为生成输出而非预设输入，通过子目标路径规划器和动作前缀控制器结合插入式生成与流匹配，联合生成连续计划内容与长度，并在多个导航与视觉操作基准上达到最高平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式规划方法通常预先指定规划时界，但合适的时界取决于路径本身：时界过短会导致不可行转移，过长则引入冗余动作。因此需要一种能自适应确定规划长度的方法。
AI.method: 提出 HorizonFlow 分层规划器，包含子目标路径规划器和动作前缀控制器。两者均采用基于插入的生成与流匹配相结合，利用部分生成的计划指导 token 插入，联合生成连续计划内容与长度。复用生成的长度信息进行候选选择并引导生成向更短计划收敛，无需单独的价值模型。
AI.result: 在 Maze2D、Multi2D 和 OGBench 导航及视觉操作基准上，HorizonFlow 实现了对比方法中最高的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: HorizonFlow 通过将规划时界作为生成输出，有效解决了固定时界带来的不可行转移与冗余动作问题，其分层插入式流匹配框架在多个离线目标条件强化学习任务中展现出优越的规划能力与泛化性。

title: Regime Boundary Alignment for Evidence-Gated Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-augmented language models are expected to answer from the retrieved evidence, but in practice they often keep answering when that evidence is missing. We trace this behavior to the training signal: answer-focused fine-tuning assigns no target to unsupported contexts, so it cannot distinguish a reader that abstains from one that guesses, and unsupported answering stays near 100% even as supported accuracy improves. We introduce Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA), which trains a single reader on matched variants of the same question and gold answer. The reader is trained to produce the gold answer when the context supports it, including when conflicting evidence is also present, and to abstain when the correct support is removed; inference is ordinary decoding, with no verifier, threshold, or regime label. On three multi-hop QA datasets across three seeds, RBA reduces the unsupported-answer rate by more than sixty percentage points relative to conflict-focused training while matching its supported accuracy. On a held-out TriviaQA retrieval-miss slice, the same reader reduces unsupported answering from 100% to below 1% while also improving supported accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-gated answering must be learned on both sides of the support boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA) 方法，通过在相同问题的匹配变体上训练单一阅读器，使其仅在上下文提供支持时回答，否则拒答，无需验证器或阈值即可大幅降低无证据回答率。
AI.motivation: 检索增强语言模型在缺乏证据时仍倾向于回答，原因在于训练信号缺陷：答案导向的微调未给无支持上下文分配目标，导致模型无法区分拒答与猜测，无支持回答率长期维持在 100% 附近。
AI.method: RBA 在相同问题和金标准答案的匹配变体上训练单一阅读器：当上下文支持答案时（即使存在冲突证据）生成金标准答案，当正确支持被移除时拒答。推理阶段使用普通解码，无需验证器、阈值或机制标签。
AI.result: 在三个多跳问答数据集上（三个随机种子），RBA 将无支持回答率较冲突聚焦训练降低 60 个百分点以上，同时保持支持准确率相当。在 TriviaQA 检索缺失切片上，无支持回答率从 100% 降至 1% 以下，且支持准确率也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，证据门控回答必须在支持边界的两侧同时学习，即既要学会在有证据时回答，也要学会在无证据时拒答。

title: SCOPE: Observation-Conditioned Full-Target Prediction for Sparse PDE Inference
comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/ru1ch3n/SCOPE
summary: Recovering complete physical fields from sparse observations is challenging because the measurements may not uniquely determine the underlying state. Diffusion-based PDE solvers address this problem through iterative sampling whereas neural operators provide deterministic one-pass predictions. We propose SCOPE (Sparse-Context Observability-aware Predictive Embeddings) to recover complete PDE fields from sparse observations by coupling full-field latent prediction with physical reconstruction. A shared decoder reconstructs fields from both predicted and complete-view representations so that representation learning is guided by both physical recovery and latent matching. We derive a quadratic risk decomposition at fixed teacher-decoder pairs showing why optimal latent prediction need not yield optimal field reconstruction. We also establish sufficient conditions for decoder improvements on complete inputs to transfer to recovery from partial observations. Experiments across five PDE settings show that SCOPE outperforms mask-aware neural operators on all ten forward and inverse tasks and achieves lower errors than those reported for diffusion-based solvers including DiffusionPDE and FunDPS. Decoder-only adaptation further improves recovery without retraining the backbone while retaining deterministic single-pass inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 SCOPE 方法，通过耦合全场潜在预测与物理重构，从稀疏观测恢复完整 PDE 场，实现确定性单次推理且性能优于扩散模型和神经算子。
AI.motivation: 稀疏观测下恢复完整物理场具有挑战性，因测量可能无法唯一确定底层状态。扩散模型需迭代采样，神经算子虽单次推理但精度受限，需一种兼具确定性单次推理与高精度的方法。
AI.method: SCOPE 采用共享解码器，同时从预测潜在表示和完整视图表示重构场，通过物理重构与潜在匹配双重目标引导表示学习。理论上推导二次风险分解，揭示最优潜在预测不等于最优场重构，并建立解码器改进从完整输入迁移至部分观测的充分条件。
AI.result: 在五种 PDE 设置的十个正反向任务中，SCOPE 全面超越掩码感知神经算子，误差低于 DiffusionPDE 和 FunDPS 等扩散求解器。仅微调解码器即可进一步提升恢复精度，无需重训练主干网络，保持确定性单次推理。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE 通过共享解码器的双重重构机制与理论指导，实现了稀疏观测下高精度、确定性单次推理的 PDE 场恢复，且支持解码器自适应微调，为稀疏观测逆问题提供了高效通用的解决方案。

title: STAR-GRPO: Canonical Anchoring and Reliability-First Advantages against Representation-Dependent Reward Hacking
summary: Reward hacking occurs when policy optimization exploits a brittle reward interface or an overly permissive proxy objective, improving the training score without improving the underlying response quality. This phenomenon is amplified in group-relative policy optimization: an unsupported reward can shift the group baseline and alter the updates of other rollouts, while post-hoc or purely relative weighting cannot represent group-wide uncertainty. We propose \emph{Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization} (STAR-GRPO), a reliability-first advantage estimator based on paired assessments of the same rollout. STAR separates the quality signal from its learning influence: score disagreement determines rollout reliability, relative reliability enters a self-tuned robust location--scale fit before group normalization, and absolute group reliability attenuates the resulting bounded advantage. The analysis establishes coordinate and second-moment bounds, characterizes exact centering through the weighted location equation, and gives reliability-dependent attenuation guarantees for outlying rewards. We evaluate STAR-GRPO in two complementary reward-hacking regimes. In token-interface exploitation, STAR prevents runaway optimization of the deployed-interface score while improving the canonical quality signal. In rubric-proxy overoptimization for medical reasoning, STAR improves independent semantic evaluation, narrows the proxy--judge discrepancy, and reduces overclaim while optimizing the same task proxy. Together, these results show that reliability-first normalization offers a principled way to limit unsupported reward influence on both group baselines and policy updates, while retaining the task reward as the optimization target.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 STAR-GRPO（Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization），一种以可靠性为先的优势估计器，通过同一 rollout 的配对评估分离质量信号与学习影响，利用评分分歧确定 rollout 可靠性，在群体归一化前引入自调谐鲁棒位置-尺度拟合，并以绝对群体可靠性衰减有界优势，从而在保留任务奖励为优化目标的同时，限制无支持奖励对群体基线和策略更新的影响。
AI.motivation: 奖励黑客现象指策略优化利用脆弱的奖励接口或过度宽容的代理目标，提升训练分数却不改善真实响应质量。在群体相对策略优化（GRPO）中，无支持的奖励会偏移群体基线并改变其他 rollout 的更新，而事后或纯相对加权无法表征群体层面的不确定性。
AI.method: STAR-GRPO 包含三大核心步骤：(1) 配对评估同一 rollout，以评分分歧量化 rollout 可靠性，将质量信号与学习影响解耦；(2) 相对可靠性接入自调谐鲁棒位置-尺度拟合，在群体归一化前进行加权中心化与缩放；(3) 绝对群体可靠性对结果有界优势进行衰减。理论分析给出了坐标与二阶矩界、加权位置方程的精确中心化性质、以及依赖可靠性的异常奖励衰减保证。
AI.result: 在两种互补的奖励黑客场景中验证：(1) Token 接口利用场景：STAR 防止了对部署接口分数的失控优化，同时提升了规范质量信号；(2) 医疗推理的评分代理过度优化场景：STAR 改善了独立语义评估，缩小了代理-评判者差距，并在优化同一任务代理的同时减少了过度声称。
AI.conclusion: 以可靠性为先的归一化提供了一种原则性方法，能够同时限制无支持奖励对群体基线和策略更新的影响，且保留任务奖励作为优化目标。

title: Your Benchmark Is Not Saturated: Reviving Multiple-Choice Evaluation with Answer Pooling
summary: Multiple-choice benchmarks are cheap to grade and are running out of room, and the standard remedy, writing harder items, is slow and repeated for every benchmark. A saturated benchmark still holds a harder task. Each question's wrong options are written for that question alone, so a model can score by eliminating a few options. We propose AnswerPool: take $N$ questions that share a context, pool all their options into one list, and ask the model to assign every question its answer. No item is written and no label changes. The chance of guessing a group right falls from $10^{-3}$ to $5\times10^{-7}$ for five four-option questions, and a model that recognizes its answers keeps its multiple-choice score, so the accuracy lost to pooling measures the credit the format gave for elimination. Deleting answers from the pool makes questions unanswerable with exact ground truth, so abstention is scored in the same pass. Across eight text, image, and video benchmarks and eighteen models, pooling is harder for every model, the elimination credit is largest for the weakest models, and seven of eight open-weight models answer 87 to 100% of unanswerable questions.

AI.tldr: 提出AnswerPool方法，将共享上下文的多个问题选项池化，显著降低猜测概率，测量模型通过排除法获得的分数，并评估模型在不可回答问题上的拒答能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多项选择基准已饱和，编写更难题目成本高且重复；错误选项针对单个问题，模型可通过排除法得分，掩盖真实能力。
AI.method: AnswerPool：选取共享上下文的N个问题，将所有选项合并为一个列表，要求模型为每个问题分配答案。无需编写新题目或修改标签。通过池化降低随机猜测概率，并通过从池中删除正确答案制造不可回答问题，同步评估拒答能力。
AI.result: 在八个文本、图像、视频基准及十八个模型上，池化对所有模型均增加难度；排除法带来的分数提升在最弱模型中最大；八个开放权重模型中有七个对不可回答问题的回答率达87%-100%。
AI.conclusion: AnswerPool以零成本重用现有基准，揭示模型对排除法的依赖及拒答缺陷，为评估真实推理能力提供更严格的测试范式。

title: Triadic Linear Attention: Three-Dimensional Recurrent States for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) compress the historical context into a memory state of fixed size, thus allowing for constant-time inference. The memory state size is a crucial factor in their performance, as exemplified by the strong performance and resurgence of linear attention, which extends the vector-valued hidden states of ordinary RNNs to matrix-valued hidden states. Crucially, linear attention does so in a parameter-efficient way, in particular by using an outer product of the key and value vectors to write to the matrix-valued hidden state. We generalize this construction and propose triadic linear attention, which writes the triadic outer product of a key, a second key, and a value, into a third-order (i.e., 3D) tensor state, and reads from it by contracting both key axes with two queries. An $E$-dimensional second key thus yields an $E$-fold increase in state size while adding only two projections. Triadic linear attention is compatible with data-dependent forgetting, the delta rule, and chunkwise-parallel training. Applied to Gated DeltaNet and scalar-gated linear attention, triadic linear attention substantially improves long-context language modeling and recall, outperforming alternatives that enlarge the state.

AI.tldr: 提出三元线性注意力，将键、第二键和值的三元外积写入三阶张量状态，通过两个查询收缩读取，在保持参数效率的同时显著增加状态容量，提升长上下文语言建模和召回性能。
AI.motivation: RNNs 将历史压缩为固定大小的记忆状态，状态大小对性能至关重要。线性注意力通过矩阵值隐藏状态扩展了向量值状态，但仍有提升空间。需要一种参数高效的方式进一步增加状态容量。
AI.method: 三元线性注意力：将键、第二键和值的三元外积写入三阶张量状态，读取时用两个查询收缩两个键轴。增加 E 维第二键可使状态大小增加 E 倍，仅需两个额外投影。兼容数据依赖遗忘、Delta 规则和分块并行训练。
AI.result: 在 Gated DeltaNet 和标量门控线性注意力上应用，三元线性注意力显著改善长上下文语言建模和召回，优于其他扩大状态的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 三元线性注意力提供了一种参数高效的机制，通过引入第二键将状态从矩阵扩展为三阶张量，有效提升长上下文建模能力，且保持训练和推理效率。

title: PrecogUI: Proactive GUI Agents via Pre-cognitive Simulation and Experience Retrieval
summary: Existing reactive Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents often fail in long-horizon, dynamic scenarios, where unexpected disturbances trigger attention-diverting and cascading failures. To address this, we propose PrecogUI, a pre-cognitive architecture that shifts the paradigm from reactive execution to proactive decision-making. Specifically, we design a Proactive Experience Pool (PEP), which caches recurring anomaly and success patterns as "state-action-result" tuples in a dual-memory repository. Furthermore, we introduce a Proactive Simulation Executor (PSE) that learns to forecast the next symbolic UI layout given a candidate action, enabling early anomaly avoidance and ranking candidate actions by predicted reliability. Finally, a Pre-cognitive Execution Controller (PEC) fuses these priors and predictions, prioritizes handling of foreseen anomalies, and ensures execution robustness through a closed-loop error correction mechanism. For robust evaluation, we develop AutoTraj, an automatic data-generation engine, to construct InterfereBench, a benchmark for long-horizon tasks with strong disturbances. Experiments demonstrate that PrecogUI surpasses state-of-the-art methods on InterfereBench while maintaining competitive performance on public benchmarks. The code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrecogUI，一种预认知架构，将GUI智能体从被动执行转向主动决策。通过Proactive Experience Pool (PEP)缓存异常/成功模式，Proactive Simulation Executor (PSE)预测UI布局以规避异常，以及Pre-cognitive Execution Controller (PEC)融合先验与预测并闭环纠错。实验在新基准InterfereBench上超越SOTA，且在公开基准保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有反应式GUI智能体在长时程、动态场景中表现不佳，意外干扰会导致注意力分散和级联故障。需要从被动响应转向主动预判，提前识别并规避异常，保障执行鲁棒性。
AI.method: PrecogUI包含三大核心组件：(1) Proactive Experience Pool (PEP)——双内存库存储“状态-动作-结果”元组，缓存反复出现的异常与成功模式；(2) Proactive Simulation Executor (PSE)——学习预测候选动作后的符号化UI布局，实现早期异常规避并按预测可靠性排序动作；(3) Pre-cognitive Execution Controller (PEC)——融合先验经验与模拟预测，优先处理预见异常，并通过闭环错误纠正机制保证执行鲁棒性。评估方面，开发AutoTraj自动数据生成引擎构建InterfereBench，包含强干扰的长时程任务。
AI.result: 在InterfereBench上，PrecogUI显著超越现有最先进方法；在公开基准上保持竞争力性能。代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: PrecogUI通过预认知架构有效解决了长时程动态场景下GUI智能体的脆弱性，PEP、PSE、PEC三模块协同实现主动异常预判与鲁棒执行。InterfereBench为该领域提供了具有挑战性的评测基准。

title: Larry Caused the Car to Stop, But the Model Didn't Notice: Transformer Blindness to the M-Heuristic
summary: Modern transformer models excel at capturing semantic relationships through sentence embeddings, yet their ability to perform pragmatic reasoning remains understudied. This paper investigates whether encoder-based transformers such as DeBERTa employ the M-Heuristic (the neo-Gricean principle that marked linguistic forms implicate marked meanings). We test this hypothesis by contrasting lexical causatives (e.g., ``Larry stopped the car'') with periphrastic causatives (e.g., ``Larry caused the car to stop'') using a Natural Language Inference framework. Our experiments across 188 conditions with 15 ambitransitive verbs reveal that DeBERTa, RoBERTa, and BART show no evidence of capturing the pragmatic distinction between these forms, with DeBERTa predicting ``Neutral'' for 100% of cases. Probing analysis initially suggested a representation-use dissociation, but control experiments reveal the probe was tracking syntactic complexity, not causative pragmatics. Semantic similarity over 30 triplets places periphrastic causatives closer to unmediated manner descriptions in 29/30 cases, opposite to M-Heuristic predictions in the embedding space. Under explicit metalinguistic framing, Gemini Flash-Lite reaches 100% with item-specific traces, so the principle is available under instruction yet unused in default NLI.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究编码器型Transformer（如DeBERTa）是否捕捉M-启发式（标记形式蕴含标记意义的实用主义原则），通过对比词汇使役与迂回使役在NLI任务中的表现，发现模型无法捕捉实用主义区别，探针分析显示其跟踪的是句法复杂度而非使役实用主义，语义相似度结果与M-启发式预测相反，仅在显式元语言框架下大模型才能体现该原则。
AI.motivation: 现代Transformer模型在句子嵌入中擅长捕捉语义关系，但其执行实用推理的能力研究不足。本文旨在考察编码器型Transformer是否遵循M-启发式（新格赖斯原则：标记语言形式蕴含标记意义），即词汇使役（如'Larry stopped the car'）与迂回使役（如'Larry caused the car to stop'）在实用层面的区别。
AI.method: 采用自然语言推理（NLI）框架，构建188个条件、15个双及物动词的实验，对比DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART三种编码器模型在词汇使役与迂回使役句对上的推理表现；辅以探针分析检查内部表示，以及30组三元组的语义相似度测量；并测试Gemini Flash-Lite在显式元语言提示下的表现。
AI.result: 所有编码器模型均无法捕捉使役形式的实用主义区别，DeBERTa在100%情况下预测'中性'；探针分析初现表征-使用分离，但控制实验揭示探针实际追踪句法复杂度而非使役实用主义；语义相似度显示迂回使役在29/30情况下更接近非中介方式描述，与M-启发式预测相反；仅在显式元语言框架下，Gemini Flash-Lite能以100%准确率并给出条目特定推理轨迹体现该原则。
AI.conclusion: 编码器型Transformer在默认NLI任务中未内化M-启发式实用推理，其嵌入空间反而呈现与该原则相反的语义结构；该原则虽可通过显式指令在大语言模型中激活，但非模型默认推理行为。这揭示了当前模型在实用推理层面的根本局限。

title: Interactive-Policy Distillation with Bidirectional Propose-and-Verify
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its self-generated trajectories with dense token-level teacher feedback. However, naive OPD may suffer from teacher unanchoring, where the student's reasoning trajectory drifts far from the teacher, causing the teacher to be queried on states it would hardly visit and thus provide unreliable supervision. We propose Interactive-Policy Distillation (IPD), which applies adaptive teacher intervention to the student rollout. Under a bidirectional propose-and-verify state machine, the student and teacher alternately exchange their roles as proposer and verifier, and collaboratively generate mixed-source trajectories. Then different supervisions are applied according to the source of each token. This bidirectional propose-and-verify mechanism and the source-split loss make IPD not only a more performant distillation method, but also a unified bridge between on-policy and off-policy paradigms. To make the interleaved dual-model rollouts more efficient, we also design a dedicated fused inference engine that co-hosts both models in one serving instance with separate KV caches and instantiates the state machine model to distribute, collect, and process requests. On math reasoning tasks and across multiple teacher-student model pairs, student models trained with IPD not only outperform those trained with OPD, but also demonstrate higher data efficiency. Specifically, when distilling Qwen3-30B-A3B into Qwen3-1.7B-Base, IPD brings a +3.28 mean@8 and a +3.28 best@8 benchmark-averaged accuracy improvement compared with OPD. Besides, IPD only consumes about 1/4 of the training examples and steps to outperform OPD trained on the whole training dataset for one epoch. We also investigate the impact of different loss variants and takeover / handback configurations, and demonstrate the robustness of IPD on different training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互式策略蒸馏（IPD），通过双向提出-验证状态机和源分离损失解决在线策略蒸馏中的教师脱锚问题，显著提升蒸馏性能与数据效率，并统一了在线与离线蒸馏范式。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）让学生在自生成轨迹上接受教师逐token监督，但学生推理轨迹易偏离教师分布，导致教师在罕见状态给出不可靠监督（教师脱锚），限制了蒸馏效果。
AI.method: IPD引入自适应教师干预：学生与教师在双向提出-验证状态机中交替扮演提议者与验证者，协同生成混合源轨迹；根据token来源（学生生成或教师修正）施加不同监督信号（源分离损失）。并设计融合推理引擎，在单一服务实例中共置双模型、分离KV缓存，高效支撑交替推理。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务及多组教师-学生模型对上，IPD训练的学生模型均优于OPD，且数据效率显著更高。以Qwen3-30B-A3B蒸馏至Qwen3-1.7B-Base为例，IPD在mean@8与best@8上均带来+3.28的基准平均准确率提升；仅用约1/4的训练样本与步数即超越OPD在全数据集训练一轮的效果。消融实验验证了不同损失变体与接管/回配置的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: IPD通过双向交互机制有效缓解教师脱锚，以更少数据实现更优蒸馏性能，并为在线与离线蒸馏提供了统一桥梁，具有较强的实用性与推广价值。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Computer Use: Learning Reusable Policies for Reliable and Efficient Execution
summary: Many computer tasks recur: the same workflow runs many times, with new inputs and from different starting states. Current computer-use agents re-plan every step of every run, which makes them costly and unreliable on such tasks. We introduce neuro-symbolic computer use, in which a recurring workflow is executed by a learned policy rather than re-derived by an agent on each run. The policy fixes the decisions that are stable across runs (ordering, variables, loops, and branches) in executable code, and delegates observation-dependent decisions, such as grounding and state checks, to neural models. We learn these policies with neuro-symbolic policy iteration: starting from one agent trajectory, it executes the policy, diagnoses failures with task-completion and step-level judges, and revises the code with a coding model informed by an agent's continuation from the point of failure, without access to the benchmark evaluator. Iterating on generated parameter and initial-state variants makes the policy reusable, and a pre-action verifier guards each state-mutating step at deployment. On OSWorld-Verified and ScienceBoard, the learned policies achieve the highest Pass^3 of all methods in all four settings, 3.6-15.8 points above the base agent, while cutting per-run cost by 15-217$\times$ and latency by 3.4-5.1$\times$. On OSWorld-Verified, policies built only on variants transfer to the held-out original tasks, exceeding AutoRPA by 8.6-17.5 points in Pass^3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经符号计算机使用范式，针对重复性计算机任务，通过神经符号策略迭代学习可复用策略，将稳定决策固化为可执行代码，观察依赖决策委托给神经模型，在OSWorld-Verified和ScienceBoard上显著超越基线，大幅降低成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 许多计算机任务具有重复性（相同工作流多次运行，输入和初始状态不同）。现有计算机使用智能体每次运行都重新规划每一步，导致成本高、可靠性低。需要一种方法能固化跨运行稳定的决策，仅对观察依赖决策使用神经模型，从而提高效率和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 神经符号策略迭代：从单条智能体轨迹出发，执行策略，利用任务完成和步级评判器诊断失败，借助编码模型并结合智能体从失败点继续的轨迹修订代码（无需基准评估器）。在生成的参数和初始状态变体上迭代使策略可复用，部署时用预动作验证器守护每个状态变更步骤。
AI.result: 在OSWorld-Verified和ScienceBoard四个设置中，学习到的策略Pass^3均最高，比基础智能体高3.6-15.8分；单次运行成本降低15-217倍，延迟降低3.4-5.1倍。在OSWorld-Verified上，仅基于变体构建的策略能迁移到保留的原始任务，Pass^3比AutoRPA高8.6-17.5分。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号计算机使用通过将重复工作流的稳定控制流固化为代码、动态决策委托神经模型，实现了高性能、低成本、可迁移的任务自动化，为重复性计算机任务提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: The Rashomon Wikipedia: A Data-Perspectivist Analysis of Divergent Historical Narratives
summary: Wikipedia aims to provide a unified, neutral record of history, yet its independent language editions often function as distinct epistemic communities, creating divergent narratives around contested events. This paper investigates cross-lingual historiographical bias by analyzing Wikipedia articles across five languages (Romanian, Hungarian, Russian, Turkish, and English) focusing on three contentious events in Romanian history: the Battle of Posada (1330), the Soviet occupation of Bessarabia (1940), and the Night Attack at Targoviste (1462). Using human annotators and Large Language Models (LLMs) to classify citation stance and quantify narrative evolution from 2005 to 2024, we identify a phenomenon of "citation isolation". In the case of the Battle of Posada, only 2 out of 119 citations were shared between language editions, with the Romanian edition exhibiting a 91% pro-national bias compared to the balanced Hungarian edition. Longitudinal analysis reveals that these narratives are volatile and responsive to contemporary geopolitics, evidenced by a significant shift in the Russian framing of Bessarabia in 2024. Finally, we propose a "Peace-Maker" pipeline to automate conflict reconciliation. We demonstrate that while standard prompting leads models to hallucinate consensus, "adversarial" prompting, which explicitly instructs the model to preserve and attribute disagreement, achieves near-perfect neutrality scores.

AI.tldr: 本文通过跨语言分析维基百科条目，揭示了不同语言版本在叙述罗马尼亚历史争议事件时存在的「引用隔离」现象和显著的民族主义偏见，并提出了一种对抗性提示管线以实现自动化冲突调和。
AI.motivation: 维基百科旨在提供统一中立的历史记录，但独立语言版本往往形成截然不同的认知共同体，导致对争议事件的叙述发散。现有研究缺乏跨语言、纵向且结合大模型的系统性量化分析，难以揭示叙事偏见的演变机制与地缘政治关联。
AI.method: 选取罗马尼亚语、匈牙利语、俄语、土耳其语、英语五个语言版本，聚焦波萨达战役（1330）、苏联占领比萨拉比亚（1940）、特尔戈维什特夜袭（1462）三个争议事件。结合人工标注与大语言模型（LLM）进行引用立场分类，量化 2005-2024 年叙事演变，并设计「和平缔造者」管线对比标准提示与对抗性提示在冲突调和上的效果。
AI.result: 1. 引用隔离严重：波萨达战役条目中 119 个引用仅有 2 个被多语言版本共享。2. 显著偏见：罗马尼亚语版呈 91% 亲民族偏见，匈牙利语版相对平衡。3. 叙事随地缘政治波动：2024 年俄语版对比萨拉比亚事件的框架发生显著转向。4. 标准提示导致模型幻觉共识，对抗性提示（显式保留并归因分歧）可达近乎完美的中立分数。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言维基百科版本构建了相互隔离的史学叙事，且极易受当代地缘政治影响。提出的对抗性提示管线能有效避免模型虚构共识，为自动化生成中立、多视角的历史叙述提供了可行技术路径。

title: SERA: Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation for Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
summary: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (MaxRL) targets prompt-wise log-success and has shown strong performance on reasoning tasks. Under finite rollout budgets, however, the estimator used by MaxRL attenuates each prompt's likelihood gradient by a factor that depends on its success probability and rollout count. Under uniform rollout allocation, the common rollout count fails to compensate for success-dependent attenuation, leaving low-success prompts more strongly attenuated and distorting their relative contributions to the expected aggregate gradient. We introduce SERA (Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation), which redistributes a fixed rollout budget to approximately equalize these finite-rollout scaling factors. Building on our theoretical analysis of how finite rollouts distort prompt-wise likelihood gradients, we formulate the allocation as a fixed-budget max--min problem, derive a waterline solution to its continuous relaxation, and introduce a multiplicity correction to remove the additional prompt weighting induced by heterogeneous rollout counts. Experiments show stronger alignment with exact likelihood gradients in a controlled ImageNet setting and improved multi-sample solution coverage over MaxRL on maze navigation and mathematical reasoning under matched training rollout budgets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SERA（Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation），通过重新分配有限的 rollout 预算来均衡各提示的有限采样缩放因子，解决 MaxRL 在有限 rollout 下对低成功率提示梯度过度衰减的问题，从而更好地近似精确似然梯度并提升多样本解覆盖率。
AI.motivation: MaxRL 使用的估计器会在有限 rollout 预算下按成功概率和 rollout 数衰减每个提示的似然梯度。均匀分配 rollout 无法补偿这种成功率依赖的衰减，导致低成功率提示的梯度贡献被过度压缩，扭曲了期望聚合梯度的相对权重。
AI.method: 将 rollout 分配建模为固定预算下的 max-min 问题，推导其连续松弛的水位线解，并引入多重性修正以消除异构 rollout 数带来的额外提示加权。SERA 旨在近似均衡有限 rollout 下的缩放因子。
AI.result: 在受控 ImageNet 实验中，SERA 与精确似然梯度的对齐度更强；在迷宫导航和数学推理任务上，在相同训练 rollout 预算下，SERA 实现了更优的多样本解覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: SERA 通过理论指导的 rollout 重分配有效缓解了有限采样导致的梯度衰减不均问题，提升了策略优化的梯度估计质量和下游任务的解覆盖能力。

title: Learn from the Gap: Differential-Aware Advantage Pruning with Adaptive Rollout Sampling for GRPO
summary: Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and its variants have been developed for policy optimization and demonstrated notable performance gains. However, these methods usually incur substantial computational overhead due to per-question multi-rollout sampling and repeated per-token probability evaluation across rollouts. Furthermore, low-information or highly homogeneous trajectories can degrade downstream learning signal efficiency, hindering model optimization and limiting final performance. To address these issues, we propose FastRL, a novel plug-and-play reinforcement learning framework that simultaneously improves training efficiency and the effectiveness of policy learning. Specifically, 1) We introduce an advantage-aware pruning strategy to selectively preserve high-advantage trajectories while maximizing inter-trajectory gradient diversity. 2) Then, we design an adaptive rollout sampling mechanism to dynamically adjust the sampling scale across different training stages based on historical pruning distributions, balancing exploration adequacy and computational efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that FastRL can be seamlessly integrated into GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO variants, achieving an average 2.07$\times$ training speedup on Geometry3K and GeoQA8K-R1V, along with an approximately 1.64\% improvement in average accuracy on visual reasoning benchmarks. Source codes will be available at https://github.com/Nicozwy/FastRL.

AI.tldr: FastRL 是一个即插即用的强化学习框架，通过优势感知剪枝和自适应采样机制，加速 GRPO 等算法训练并提升视觉推理准确率。
AI.motivation: GRPO 及其变体因每题多轨迹采样和重复 token 概率评估导致计算开销大，且低信息或高度同质轨迹降低学习信号效率，阻碍模型优化。
AI.method: 1) 优势感知剪枝策略：选择性保留高优势轨迹并最大化轨迹间梯度多样性。2) 自适应采样机制：基于历史剪枝分布动态调整采样规模，平衡探索充分性与计算效率。
AI.result: 在 Geometry3K 和 GeoQA8K-R1V 上平均训练加速 2.07 倍，视觉推理基准平均准确率提升约 1.64%，可无缝集成到 GRPO、DAPO、GSPO 等变体中。
AI.conclusion: FastRL 有效解决了 GRPO 类算法的计算开销大和学习信号效率低的问题，实现了训练加速和性能提升的双重收益，为大规模强化学习提供了实用的加速方案。

title: Who Warmed the Archives? LLMs Overestimate Historical Warmth
summary: Historical archives are an under-used source for extending the instrumental climate record backward in time, and LLMs offer a way to extract the indices climatologists derive by hand. Beyond measuring how well systems extract this signal, we check whether their errors are safe to use for cross-century comparison, since a good correlation score does not rule out systematic, era-linked bias. Comparing lexical baselines, fine-tuned historical transformers, and LLM prompting on the Pfister temperature index across five centuries of German text, lexical methods beat every fine-tuned transformer we test, including one pretrained from scratch on historical German (r=-0.016). All six LLMs we test (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek v4 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen3.7-Plus, Kimi-K2.6-Fast) show a warm bias that grows with calendar year, with the same sign in every model (slopes +0.13 to +0.34/century, p<0.01). The effect is modest in size (r-squared approx equal to 0.01 to 0.05) but consistent across six independently developed models. The best-correlated of the six, Gemini 2.5 Flash, matches the best lexical correlation (r=0.32) at double the error. An ablation stripping explicit dates and calendar-era markers from the quotes leaves this trend essentially unchanged, favoring an anachronistic present-day prior over the model correctly inferring the quote's era. Correlation alone is thus insufficient for vetting an LLM as a historical-climate-index oracle.

AI.tldr: 论文评估了大语言模型（LLM）从历史德语文献中提取Pfister温度指数的能力，发现词法基线方法优于所有微调的历史Transformer，且所有六个测试的LLM均表现出随年份增长的暖偏差，这种系统性时代偏差源于模型的当代先验而非正确推断文献年代，相关性指标不足以验证LLM作为历史气候指数预言机的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 历史档案是延伸仪器气候记录的未充分利用来源，LLM提供了自动提取气候学家手工衍生指数的途径。但需检验其错误是否适合跨世纪比较，因为良好的相关性分数无法排除系统性的时代关联偏差。
AI.method: 在跨越五个世纪的德语文本上，对比词法基线、微调历史Transformer（含从头预训练的历史德语模型）与六个LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek v4 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen3.7-Plus, Kimi-K2.6-Fast）在Pfister温度指数提取任务上的表现；进行消融实验剥离显式日期和历年代标记以诊断偏差来源。
AI.result: 词法方法击败所有微调Transformer（最佳r=-0.016）；六个LLM均呈现随日历年份增长的暖偏差（斜率+0.13至+0.34/世纪，p<0.01），效应量虽小（R²约0.01-0.05）但跨模型一致；最佳LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash）相关性达最佳词法水平（r=0.32）但误差翻倍；消融实验显示剥离年代标记后趋势基本不变，偏差源于时代错位的当代先验。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭相关性不足以验证LLM作为历史气候指数预言机的可靠性；系统性时代偏差普遍存在于独立开发的模型中，需引入偏差诊断与校正机制才能用于跨世纪气候重建。

title: HiTS-CL: A Continual Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
summary: Extrapolative temporal knowledge graph reasoning (TKGR) predicts future facts from historical snapshots. Most existing methods train once on an early prefix of the timeline and then use a frozen model for all future timestamps. We argue that this fixed-prefix protocol is misaligned with extrapolation. It learns from a static prefix, whereas the target stream is non-stationary: new entities and facts emerge, temporal dependencies shift across regimes, and recurring historical signals must be refreshed online. As a result, models trained only on early snapshots become outdated and degrade over long horizons. We address this mismatch by formulating extrapolative TKGR as continual learning over streaming snapshots. Under this view, effective extrapolation must jointly handle current dynamics, stable knowledge, and recurring historical evidence. Based on these requirements, we propose History-enhanced Two-Step Continual Learning (HiTS-CL), a backbone-agnostic continual learning framework for extrapolative TKGR.  HiTS-CL tracks current dynamics via continual fine-tuning, preserves stable knowledge via multi-teacher adaptive distillation, and retains recurring historical evidence via a selective memory of recent and frequent facts. We integrate HiTS-CL into five representative TKGR backbones and evaluate it on four benchmark datasets. HiTS-CL consistently improves extrapolation accuracy, reduces long-horizon degradation, and outperforms strong continual-learning baselines, including a recent method for temporal knowledge graphs. Source code and data are available at https://github.com/liuyansong98/HiTS-CL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 HiTS-CL 的持续学习框架，用于解决外推式时序知识图谱推理（TKGR）中模型在长时程预测中性能下降的问题。该框架通过持续微调跟踪当前动态、多教师自适应蒸馏保持稳定知识、选择性记忆保留周期性历史证据，具有模型无关性，在五种主流 TKGR 主干和四个基准数据集上均显著提升外推精度并减缓长时程退化。
AI.motivation: 现有外推式 TKGR 方法采用固定前缀训练协议：仅在时间线早期快照上训练一次，随后冻结模型用于所有未来时间戳预测。然而，目标数据流具有非平稳特性——新实体与事实不断涌现、时序依赖随机制变化、历史周期性信号需在线刷新。固定前缀训练导致模型随时间推移逐渐过时，在长时程预测中性能严重退化。
AI.method: 将外推式 TKGR 重新定义为流式快照上的持续学习任务，提出 HiTS-CL 框架，包含三大核心模块：1) 持续微调跟踪当前动态；2) 多教师自适应蒸馏保持稳定知识；3) 选择性记忆机制保留近期与高频事实以捕获周期性历史证据。该框架与主干网络无关，可无缝集成到现有 TKGR 模型中。
AI.result: 在五种代表性 TKGR 主干（如 RE-NET, CyGNet 等）和四个基准数据集（如 ICEWS14, ICEWS18 等）上实验表明，HiTS-CL 持续提升外推预测准确率，显著缓解长时程性能下降，并优于强持续学习基线（包括最新时序知识图谱持续学习方法）。
AI.conclusion: 固定前缀训练协议与外推任务的非平稳本质不匹配，将外推式 TKGR 形式化为持续学习并引入历史增强的两步持续学习框架，能有效解决模型过时问题，实现对当前动态、稳定知识和周期性历史证据的联合建模，为长时程时序知识图谱推理提供了通用且有效的解决方案。

title: VLALight: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Traffic Signal Control
summary: Traffic signal control (TSC) is essential for improving urban mobility and reducing congestion. Although roadside cameras are widely deployed at signalized intersections and provide rich visual observations of evolving traffic, existing TSC methods typically rely on manually engineered traffic states or separate perception modules, creating a gap between physical observations and control decisions. We present VLALight, the first vision-language-action (VLA) model for end-to-end traffic signal control from multi-view roadside videos. VLALight directly maps visual observations to coordinated signal actions through multi-target spatiotemporal traffic reasoning and topology-aware cooperative perception across intersections. To establish this capability, we develop a two-stage supervised cold-start training strategy for visual traffic understanding and signal decision-making, followed by cooperative agentic reinforcement learning that jointly optimizes local control and network-wide traffic efficiency. Furthermore, VLALight introduces adaptive fast and slow reasoning modes, enabling the policy to allocate deeper reasoning only when additional deliberation provides sufficient control benefits. Through balanced mode-aware rollouts and relative advantage optimization, VLALight learns to trade off decision quality and inference cost. Extensive experiments on seven real-world traffic-flow datasets across three urban networks demonstrate that VLALight consistently outperforms transportation-based, RL-based, and LLM/VLM-based baselines. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of cooperative perception, network-level optimization, and adaptive reasoning. These results demonstrate the potential of VLA models for real-world physical traffic control. Our project is available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/VLALight.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLALight，首个用于端到端交通信号控制的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，直接从多视角路侧视频映射到协调信号动作，引入多目标时空推理、拓扑感知协同感知及自适应快慢推理模式，在七个真实数据集上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有交通信号控制(TSC)方法依赖人工设计的交通状态或独立感知模块，导致物理观测与控制决策存在鸿沟。尽管路侧摄像头广泛部署并提供丰富视觉观测，但未被充分利用，亟需端到端从视频直接生成控制策略的方法。
