title: FedLAFP: Low-Rank Aggregation Meets Full-Rank Personalization in Federated Fine-Tuning
summary: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables clients to adapt pre-trained models without sharing raw data or communicating the full model, but statistical heterogeneity makes a single global adapter insufficient for personalized prediction. Existing personalized methods typically use the same low-rank structure for both shared and private adaptation, overlooking their distinct requirements for aggregation and personalization. We propose FedLAFP, a role-aware framework that couples a compact, globally aggregated LoRA branch with a client-private, full-rank-capable RandLoRA branch. The shared branch provides an efficient interface for transferring common knowledge, whereas the private branch combines fixed random low-rank bases with learned scaling coefficients to provide expressive client-specific adaptation without additional communication. Client- and layer-specific mixing coefficients jointly fuse the two branches, and only the shared LoRA parameters are exchanged. A controlled linear study supports this role assignment: LoRA yields more aligned client updates and lower aggregation error, while RandLoRA more accurately recovers client-specific residuals. Experiments across four visual recognition benchmarks show that FedLAFP consistently outperforms local-only and federated LoRA baselines, achieving an average personalized accuracy of $86.93\%$ and exceeding the best baseline average by $1.30$ percentage points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FedLAFP，一种面向联邦学习的个性化参数高效微调框架。它将共享的全局聚合 LoRA 分支与客户端私有的全秩可达 RandLoRA 分支解耦，前者用于高效传递通用知识，后者通过固定随机低秩基与可学习缩放系数实现无额外通信的表达性个性化适配。仅共享 LoRA 参数参与通信，实验在四个视觉识别基准上平均个性化准确率达 86.93%，比最强基线高 1.30 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 联邦参数高效微调虽避免原始数据共享与全模型通信，但统计异质性导致单一全局适配器无法满足个性化预测需求。现有个性化方法对共享与私有适配均采用相同低秩结构，忽略了聚合与个性化的不同需求：共享部分需更新对齐与低聚合误差，私有部分需高表达力恢复客户端特有残差。
AI.method: 提出角色感知框架 FedLAFP：1) 共享分支采用紧凑 LoRA，全局聚合后分发，提供通用知识迁移接口；2) 私有分支采用 RandLoRA，结合固定随机低秩基与可学习缩放系数，实现全秩表达能力的客户端特有适配，无需额外通信；3) 引入客户端级与层级混合系数融合两分支输出；4) 仅共享 LoRA 参数参与联邦通信。
AI.result: 受控线性实验验证角色分配合理性：LoRA 产生更对齐的客户端更新与更低聚合误差；RandLoRA 更准确恢复客户端特有残差。在四个视觉识别基准上，FedLAFP 持续优于仅本地微调与联邦 LoRA 基线，平均个性化准确率 86.93%，超最强基线 1.30 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过将共享与私有适配解耦为不同低秩结构（LoRA 与 RandLoRA），FedLAFP 有效平衡了通信效率、聚合稳定性与个性化表达力，为异质联邦学习中的参数高效个性化微调提供了新范式。

title: Billiger.de Products: A Bilingual Entity Matching Benchmark
summary: Existing product matching benchmarks primarily contain English-language product data and are often dominated by a single product category, such as electronics. This paper introduces Billiger.de Products, a bilingual German and English entity matching benchmark covering thirteen consumer product categories, including difficult-to-handle categories such as clothing and furniture. The benchmark data originates from the German price comparison platform billiger.de. Following the design of WDC Products, the benchmark offers multiple variants that differ in the fraction of corner cases, the size of the development set, and the fraction of entities unseen during training. An aligned English translation of every offer keeps all pairs, splits, and labels fixed, while cross-language test sets combine German and English records within individual pairs. We validate the benchmark using six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 on both language versions and the cross-language test sets. The validation shows the difficulty of the benchmark. The comparison of the results on the English version of the benchmark to the results on the German version shows that most matchers score on average higher on the English version. The difference is largest for RoBERTa and HierGAT, while the zero-shot LLM runs are largely insensitive to the language. Comparing the F1 scores achieved by PLM-based matchers on the English version of Billiger.de Products with their performance on existing English-language benchmarks, such as WDC Products and Abt-Buy, shows that Billiger.de Products is more difficult than these benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Billiger.de Products双语（德/英）实体匹配基准，涵盖13类消费品（含服装、家具等难处理类别），验证显示其难度显著高于现有英语基准（如WDC Products、Abt-Buy），且多数匹配器在英语版表现优于德语版，零样本LLM对语言不敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有产品匹配基准主要局限于英语数据且常由单一品类（如电子产品）主导，缺乏多语言、多品类且包含难处理类别的综合评估资源，无法全面反映真实跨语言产品匹配的挑战。
AI.method: 基于德国比价平台billiger.de构建双语基准，遵循WDC Products设计提供多变体（差异在于难例比例、开发集规模、未见实体比例）；通过对齐英语翻译保持所有对、分割、标签固定，并引入跨语言测试集（单对内混合德英记录）。采用六种监督匹配器与零样本GPT-5.2在双语版本及跨语言集上进行验证。
AI.result: 1) 基准整体难度高；2) 大多数匹配器在英语版平均得分高于德语版，RoBERTa和HierGAT的语言差距最大；3) 零样本LLM性能对语言基本不敏感；4) PLM类匹配器在Billiger.de Products英语版上的F1显著低于其在WDC Products和Abt-Buy上的表现，证明新基准更具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: Billiger.de Products填补了多语言、多品类实体匹配基准的空白，为跨语言产品匹配提供了更真实、更困难的评估平台，揭示了当前模型在非英语语言及复杂品类上的性能瓶颈。

title: PE-OPSD: Internalizing Prompt Enhancement into Flow-matching Models via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Text-to-image users often provide concise and underspecified prompts, whereas generative models benefit from detailed textual conditions for reliable instruction following. Existing systems bridge this gap with Prompt Enhancers (PEs) that rewrite raw prompts at inference time, introducing additional latency and leaving prompt elaboration external to the generator. We instead view enhanced prompts as privileged training information and ask whether their benefits can be internalized. We propose Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation (PE-OPSD) for text-to-image flow-matching models. During training, a raw-prompt student follows its own generation trajectory, while an enhanced-prompt teacher provides vector-field targets at the states visited by the student. This on-policy supervision distills the behavior induced by enhanced prompts into the raw-prompt student without requiring additional text--image pairs. At inference, both the PE and teacher are removed, and the student generates directly from raw prompts. Across multiple model families, PEs, and benchmarks, PE-OPSD achieves the strongest aggregate prompt fidelity among the evaluated baselines, yields positive aggregate visual appeal gains, and retains the base-model inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 PE-OPSD（Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation）的方法，用于文本到图像的流匹配模型。该方法在训练阶段利用增强提示词的教师模型引导原始提示词的学生模型，通过在线策略蒸馏将增强提示词的优势内化到学生模型中，推理时无需额外的提示词增强器和教师模型，直接从原始提示词生成图像。实验表明，PE-OPSD 在多个模型家族、提示词增强器和基准测试中实现了最强的提示词保真度、正向的视觉吸引力增益，并保持了基础模型的推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像系统通常依赖提示词增强器在推理时重写简短且欠指定的用户提示词，这引入了额外的延迟，且提示词扩展过程外置于生成模型之外。本文旨在探索将增强提示词的益处作为特权训练信息内化到模型中，从而在推理时直接从原始提示词生成高质量图像，避免推理时的额外开销。
AI.method: PE-OPSD 采用在线策略自蒸馏框架：训练时，原始提示词学生模型沿自身生成轨迹采样，增强提示词教师模型在学生访问的状态提供向量场目标；通过最小化学生与教师向量场的差异，将增强提示词诱导的生成行为蒸馏到原始提示词学生中。无需额外文本-图像对。推理时移除提示词增强器和教师，学生直接从原始提示词生成。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族、多种提示词增强器和基准测试中，PE-OPSD 实现了评估基线中最强的聚合提示词保真度，带来正向的聚合视觉吸引力提升，且保留了基础模型的推理效率（无额外推理延迟）。
AI.conclusion: PE-OPSD 成功将提示词增强的优势内化到生成模型中，通过在线策略自蒸馏实现了从原始提示词到高质量生成的直接映射，兼顾了提示词遵循能力、视觉质量和推理效率，为文本到图像生成提供了一种实用的训练时优化范式。

title: Watch-Think-Interact: Bootstrapping Long-Horizon Multi-Turn Streaming Video Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Streaming video assistance requires models to answer asynchronous questions from an observed prefix under a fixed context budget. Existing approaches model response timing or compress history, but an online state formed before future questions are known can omit visual details before later questions reveal their relevance; the retained state alone cannot recover them. We introduce Watch-Think-Interact (WTI), a closed-loop framework for multi-question streaming video reasoning. WTI maintains compact natural-language memory entries tagged with source-video time ranges; these entries support direct reasoning when sufficient and otherwise anchor selective recall of finer visual evidence. For each question, WTI answers when current context and memory suffice, continues watching when required evidence has not appeared, or recalls a relevant past interval and decides again after incorporating the returned chunks, without replaying the full observed history. To train this behavior, we construct WTI-82K, comprising 82,335 timed questions across 4,812 causally aligned trajectories, and develop Stream-GDPO to optimize complete multi-question streaming rollouts using trajectory-level feedback for response timing, source-video recall, and memory updates. WTI achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance among the compared open-source streaming baselines, reaching 83.3% on StreamingBench and 73.6% weighted overall accuracy on OVO-Bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Watch-Think-Interact (WTI)闭环框架，用于多问题流式视频推理，通过维护带时间标签的自然语言记忆条目，实现选择性回忆与推理，配合WTI-82K数据集和Stream-GDPO训练方法，在流式视频问答基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频辅助方法在固定上下文预算下，要么建模响应时机要么压缩历史，但未来问题未知时形成的在线状态可能遗漏后来变得相关的视觉细节，且仅靠保留状态无法恢复这些细节。
AI.method: WTI框架维护紧凑的自然语言记忆条目并标注源视频时间范围；对每个问题，根据当前上下文和记忆决定：直接回答、继续观看等待证据出现、或回忆相关历史区间并整合返回的片段后重新决策，无需重播完整历史。训练方面构建WTI-82K数据集（82,335个定时问题，4,812条因果对齐轨迹），并开发Stream-GDPO基于轨迹级反馈优化响应时机、源视频回忆和记忆更新。
AI.result: WTI在对比的开源流式基线中达到最优聚合性能：StreamingBench上83.3%，OVO-Bench加权整体准确率73.6%。
AI.conclusion: WTI通过闭环的观看-思考-交互机制，结合带时间标签的自然语言记忆和选择性视觉回忆，有效解决了流式视频推理中上下文预算受限下的信息遗漏问题，配合专门的数据集和强化学习方法，显著提升了多问题流式视频问答的准确性和效率。}

title: Which papyrus HTR is good enough? Character-error-rate tolerance of four papyrological tasks on Greek texts
summary: Purpose: Most Greek papyri remain unpublished and undigitised; a handwritten text recognition (HTR) pipeline that transcribes them automatically would let scholars discover documents and literary works that have so far gone unread. Recognition systems for Ancient Greek papyri are in statu nascendi, and how accurate they must be for a given papyrological task has not been examined. To answer this and set a benchmark for Greek papyrus HTR, we test a range of character error rates (CER) against four papyrological tasks, using published editions as ground truth. Methods: From 63,846 current editions of Greek texts in papyri.info, we imitate a letters-only "perfect HTR" output by removing the editorial layer, then degrade it with a seeded algorithm to exact CERs of 1 - 50%, with lost lines and four error-shape variants. On these data we train small models (TF-IDF, fastText, a character CNN, ByT5-small) for document type, dating and documentary-versus-literary classification, and apply eight keyword search methods. We compare models trained on clean text with models retrained at a specific CER level, and evaluate across CERs. Results: Tolerance differs by task. With clean-trained models, documentary-versus-literary classification retains 90% of its metric up to 20% CER; document type up to 7.5%; subtypes and search up to 5%; dating only up to 3%. Retraining on text containing character errors largely eliminates the sharp degradation that otherwise sets in above 15% CER. Models generally tolerate concentrated damage in a long document better than small errors spread across a short text. Conclusion: The study provides a CER target for each of the four tasks and shows that models trained on noisy text make current, imperfect text recognition useful for them.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了古希腊纸莎草文献手写文本识别（HTR）的字符错误率（CER）对四项纸莎草学任务的影响，确定了各任务的 CER 容忍阈值，并证明在含噪文本上重新训练模型能显著提升对识别错误的鲁棒性，使当前不完美的 HTR 系统仍可用于实际学术任务。
AI.motivation: 绝大多数希腊纸莎草文献仍未出版和数字化，自动转录管道可助学者发现未读文献。但古希腊纸莎草 HTR 系统处于起步阶段，不同纸莎草学任务所需的识别准确率未被量化。本文旨在建立基准，明确各任务对 CER 的容忍度，指导 HTR 系统的开发与应用。
AI.method: 从 papyri.info 的 63,846 份希腊文献版本中移除编辑标记模拟“完美 HTR”输出，再用有种子算法退化至 1%-50% 的精确 CER，含缺行和四种错误形状变体。在该数据上训练 TF-IDF、fastText、字符级 CNN 和 ByT5-small 等小模型，执行文献类型分类、年代测定、文书与文学文献二分类及八种关键词检索任务。对比在纯净文本训练与在特定 CER 噪声文本重训练的模型，跨 CER 评估性能。
AI.result: 任务容错差异大：纯净训练模型下，文书/文学二分类在 20% CER 仍保留 90% 指标；文献类型分类至 7.5%；子类型分类与检索至 5%；年代测定仅至 3%。在含噪文本上重训练基本消除了 15% CER 以上的性能断崖。模型更耐受长文本中的集中损坏，而非短文本中分散的微小错误。
AI.conclusion: 研究为四项纸莎草学任务提供了具体的 CER 目标阈值，并证实在含噪文本上重训练模型可使当前不完美的 HTR 系统直接服务于实际学术工作，推动了古希腊纸莎草文献的自动化发现与研究。

title: A Digital Simulation Toolkit for Physics-Based Generation of Realistic Experimental Scanning Tunneling Microscopy Images
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures in main text and 2 supplementary figures
summary: Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) is a widely used tool for characterizing surfaces of materials at the atomic scale, playing a crucial role in discoveries across condensed matter physics and materials science. Despite its extreme spatial resolution, STM is one of the most sensitive microscopy techniques and is highly prone to noise. While existing unsupervised denoising methods are very cheap to train, these are primarily focused on removing the noise with minimal recovery of key physical information. While supervised methods can offer superior performance, the major bottleneck is that a large amount of paired clean-noisy experimental images is required which are impractical to obtain. Thus, we developed a low-cost physics-driven digital toolkit to rapidly generate large volume of realistic STM images. Firstly, we simulate clean images from a chosen material system. Then, with prior knowledge of the physical characteristics of the artifacts and noise present in STM experiments, we formulate several artifact-noise functions such as Gaussian electronic noise, 1/f flicker noise, scan-line noise, background tilt and mechanical drift. These physically informed noise components are then added to the simulated clean images to generate realistic STM images. We demonstrated the capability of the proposed digital toolkit to generate AI-ready data for denoising images of the (111) surfaces of copper and lead, while preserving atoms, defects, and electron waves. We also validated the quality of the downstream image analysis of learning electron wave patterns induced by quantum interference from Cu(111) images. Results show that the supervised models trained on digitally generated AI-ready data can more effectively denoise and learn electron wave patterns on Cu(111) images than benchmarked unsupervised approaches, indicating that the proposed toolkit facilitate scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理驱动的数字工具包，用于生成大量逼真的STM图像，解决了监督去噪方法缺乏配对训练数据的瓶颈。该工具包通过模拟洁净图像并添加物理信息的噪声分量（高斯电子噪声、1/f闪烁噪声、扫描线噪声、背景倾斜、机械漂移），生成AI就绪的训练数据。实验表明，在该数据上训练的监督模型在Cu(111)表面的电子波模式去噪和学习上优于无监督基准方法。
AI.motivation: STM虽然具有原子级空间分辨率，但极其敏感且易受噪声干扰。现有无监督去噪方法训练成本低但难以恢复关键物理信息；监督方法性能更优，但获取大量配对的洁净-噪声实验图像不切实际。因此需要一种低成本方法生成大量逼真的STM训练数据，以推动监督学习在STM图像分析中的应用。
AI.method: 开发了一个物理驱动的数字工具包：1) 从选定材料系统模拟洁净STM图像；2) 基于STM实验中伪影和噪声的物理特性，构建多个噪声函数：高斯电子噪声、1/f闪烁噪声、扫描线噪声、背景倾斜、机械漂移；3) 将这些物理信息的噪声分量添加到模拟洁净图像上，生成逼真的STM图像；4) 在Cu(111)和Pb(111)表面验证工具包生成数据的质量，并用于训练监督去噪模型。
AI.result: 该工具包成功生成了保留原子、缺陷和电子波特征的AI就绪STM图像。在Cu(111)量子干扰诱导的电子波模式学习任务中，使用数字生成数据训练的监督模型在去噪效果和电子波模式学习能力上均显著优于基准无监督方法，验证了生成数据的高质量和实用性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的物理驱动数字工具包能够低成本、快速生成大量逼真的STM训练数据，有效解决了监督学习缺乏配对实验数据的瓶颈。该方法促进了STM图像的高质量去噪和物理信息提取，为凝聚态物理和材料科学中的科学发现提供了新的技术路径。

title: MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows
comment: 25 pages, 15 figures. Mei Wu and Rui Xie contributed equally. Bo Chen and Lu Chen are corresponding authors. Project page: https://mattoolbench.github.io/ ; code: https://github.com/meiwu5/MatToolBench
summary: Multimodal GUI agents have achieved impressive results on general software benchmarks, yet their ability to operate professional scientific software remains largely unexplored. In materials science, sparse domain-specific web data, specialized interfaces, and tacit workflow conventions create blind spots that general-purpose pretraining cannot readily bridge. We present MatToolBench, the first real-environment benchmark for evaluating multimodal GUI agents on professional materials science software, comprising 204 tasks across 10 tools in three modalities: GUI operation, OriginPro scripting, and code-based database queries, all executed inside a Windows 11 VM. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained sub-criteria by domain experts, enabling interpretable partial-credit scoring; the GUI component of our multi-level evaluation pipeline achieves an average F1 of 0.98. For OriginPro figure-generation tasks, we further conduct a human-LLM agreement study to validate the use of a multimodal judge for secondary aesthetic assessment. Our experiments show that strong performance on general benchmarks does not transfer to professional scientific workflows, and that this gap is not a visual-grounding problem alone: failures arise from domain-specific operational knowledge, sparse pretraining coverage of scientific software, weak cross-tool artifact handoff, and critical states exposed only visually. Even the best model reaches only 25% success rate on GUI tasks and 45% on code tasks. MatToolBench therefore serves as a challenging diagnostic benchmark and real-environment testbed for data-scarce, knowledge-intensive scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MatToolBench，首个面向专业材料科学软件的多模态 GUI 智能体真实环境基准，包含 204 个任务，覆盖 10 种工具的三种模态（GUI 操作、OriginPro 脚本、代码数据库查询），揭示通用基准上的强表现难以迁移至专业科学工作流，最佳模型 GUI 任务仅 25% 成功率，代码任务 45%，差距源于领域操作知识、预训练覆盖稀疏、跨工具制品交接弱、仅视觉可见的关键状态等。
AI.motivation: 多模态 GUI 智能体在通用软件基准上表现优异，但在专业科学软件（如材料科学）上的能力未被探索。领域特定的 Web 数据稀疏、专用界面、隐性工作流惯例造成盲区，通用预训练难以弥补。需要真实环境基准来评估和诊断智能体在数据稀缺、知识密集型科学工作流中的表现。
AI.method: 构建 MatToolBench：在 Windows 11 VM 中运行 10 种材料科学工具，设计 204 个任务，分为 GUI 操作、OriginPro 脚本、代码数据库查询三种模态。领域专家将任务分解为细粒度子标准，实现可解释的部分得分；GUI 评估管道平均 F1 0.98。针对 OriginPro 绘图任务，开展人类-LLM 一致性研究，验证多模态裁判进行二级美学评估的有效性。在多个强模型上进行实验，分析失败模式。
AI.result: 实验表明，通用基准上的强表现不迁移至专业科学工作流；差距不仅是视觉定位问题，还源于领域特定操作知识缺失、科学软件预训练覆盖稀疏、跨工具制品交接薄弱、仅视觉暴露的关键状态。最佳模型在 GUI 任务仅 25% 成功率，代码任务 45%。MatToolBench 成为具有挑战性的诊断基准和真实环境测试床。
AI.conclusion: MatToolBench 填补了专业科学软件多模态 GUI 智能体评估的空白，揭示了当前模型在知识密集型、数据稀缺的科学工作流中的根本局限，为未来研究提供了真实环境测试床和诊断工具。

title: Selecting What Matters: Semantic Compression-Guided Selective Pooling for Long-Context Embeddings
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential as training-free text encoders for long-context embeddings. Existing approaches primarily improve information flow under causal attention and typically construct embeddings by uniformly averaging all token representations. However, for long documents, such mean pooling can dilute salient semantic information with abundant redundant or weakly informative content. To this end, we propose SCSP, a training-free framework that leverages semantic compression for informative token selection in long-context embedding. Specifically, SCSP first partitions a document into sentence-aware chunks and appends a semantic compression prompt to each chunk. A prompt-isolated attention mask preserves information flow among document tokens while restricting each prompt to its corresponding local context. We then use the attention patterns elicited by these prompts to estimate token importance, select informative tokens, and aggregate their intermediate-layer representations into the final embedding. Extensive experiments on long-context embedding benchmarks demonstrate that SCSP can be integrated into both zero-shot and fine-tuned models in a plug-and-play manner, consistently improving their performance.

AI.tldr: SCSP是一种无需训练的框架，利用语义压缩提示选择长文档中的信息丰富token，通过注意力模式估计token重要性，聚合中间层表示生成嵌入，提升长上下文嵌入性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用均值池化所有token表示，导致长文档中显著语义信息被冗余或弱信息内容稀释。
AI.method: SCSP将文档分割为句子感知块，附加语义压缩提示，使用提示隔离注意力掩码保持文档token间信息流同时限制提示仅关注局部上下文。利用提示引发的注意力模式估计token重要性，选择信息丰富token，聚合其中间层表示为最终嵌入。
AI.result: 在长上下文嵌入基准上，SCSP可作为即插即用模块集成到零样本和微调模型中，持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: SCSP通过语义压缩和信息token选择有效解决长文档嵌入中均值池化稀释语义信息的问题，无需训练即可提升嵌入质量。

title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments and higher rewards. Outcome-only RL can therefore reinforce step-level verification without explicit process supervision. We validate the effectiveness of TIPS across math and agent benchmarks and four backbone families. Notably, TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 reaches 85.2 F1 on ProcessBench with only 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories, surpassing all evaluated trained PRMs and strong prompt-only judges such as GPT-5.4-Instruct and Claude-4.7-Opus, while still trailing o1-mini. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS.

AI.tldr: TIPS提出了一种仅需结果监督的强化学习框架，通过生成思维链和步骤标签，仅用结果正确性作为奖励信号，隐式强化步骤级验证能力，在极少标注数据下达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有过程奖励模型（PRMs）训练成本高昂：人工步骤标注难以规模化，蒙特卡洛估计计算开销大且易偏离步骤内在正确性。需要一种低成本、高效的训练强PRMs的方法。
AI.method: TIPS框架：模型生成思维链(CoT)、步骤级标签和结果标签；奖励仅取决于预测结果是否与真值匹配；使用组相对优势优化整个生成响应。核心思想：检查中间步骤有助于判断结果，更准确的步骤检查能带来更好的结果判断和更高奖励，从而仅用结果监督隐式强化步骤级验证。
AI.result: 在数学和智能体基准及四大骨干模型家族上验证有效性。TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507仅用3.2K结果标注轨迹在ProcessBench上达到85.2 F1，超越所有评测的训练型PRMs和强提示型判断器（如GPT-5.4-Instruct、Claude-4.7-Opus），仅落后于o1-mini。
AI.conclusion: TIPS证明了仅用结果监督的强化学习可以高效训练出生成式过程奖励模型，大幅降低标注成本并保持高性能，为PRMs训练提供了新范式。

title: actr: aligning thoughts and responses for multilingual safety in reasoning llms
summary: Ensuring the safety of reasoning large language models (LLMs) across languages is essential for their reliable deployment. However, when exposed to jailbreak attacks in non-high-resource languages, these models may generate unsafe responses even when their reasoning traces identify safety risks. To address this issue, we propose aligning cross-lingual thoughts and responses (ACTR), a framework that improves multilingual safety alignment by strengthening the use of existing safety reasoning. Specifically, we first present the think gap score (TGS) to compare the normalized contributions of reasoning traces to attention outputs during response generation across languages, and use reasoning- trace substitution to measure the cross-lingual safety gap. Next, using a corpus of jailbreak queries, we assess neuron importance through changes in response representations caused by neuron masking and compare the high-importance neuron sets obtained with reasoning enabled and disabled to identify safety think neurons that support the use of safety reasoning. Finally, we devise neuron-selective consistency optimization (NSCO), which uses a frozen judge model to reward agreement between the safety categories of reasoning traces and responses while updating only the parameters associated with the selected neurons, requiring no human-annotated responses or preference data. Across two reasoning models, ACTR achieves lower average attack success rates than the evaluated state-of-the-art methods on AdvBench-X and MultiJail, with safety gains extending to unseen languages, while preserving or improving average performance on multilingual knowledge and mathematical reasoning tasks and limiting false refusals of benign requests. Warning: this paper contains examples with unsafe content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACTR框架，通过Think Gap Score (TGS)量化跨语言推理痕迹贡献差异，识别安全思考神经元，并设计神经元选择性一致性优化(NSCO)仅更新关键神经元参数，无需人工标注数据即可显著提升推理LLM的多语言安全对齐，降低越狱攻击成功率并泛化至未见语言，同时保持知识推理能力。
AI.motivation: 推理大语言模型在非高资源语言下面临越狱攻击时，即使推理痕迹已识别安全风险，仍可能生成不安全回复，现有方法缺乏跨语言思维与回复的一致性对齐机制。
AI.method: 1. 提出Think Gap Score (TGS)对比推理痕迹对注意力输出的归一化贡献，并通过推理痕迹替换测量跨语言安全差距。2. 利用越狱查询语料库，通过神经元掩码引起的回复表示变化评估神经元重要性，对比推理开启/关闭时的高重要性神经元集合，识别安全思考神经元。3. 设计神经元选择性一致性优化(NSCO)，冻结裁判模型奖励推理痕迹与回复安全类别一致，仅更新选定神经元参数，无需人工标注偏好数据。
AI.result: 在两个推理模型上，ACTR在AdvBench-X和MultiJail基准上实现比SOTA方法更低的平均攻击成功率，安全增益泛化至未见语言，保持或提升多语言知识和数学推理任务性能，且减少良性请求的误拒绝。
AI.conclusion: ACTR通过强化现有安全推理的利用，有效解决了推理LLM跨语言安全对齐问题，神经元级别的选择性优化实现了参数高效的安全增强，且无需额外标注资源。

title: A Proposed Rubric for Evaluating Expressed Clinical Reasoning in Large Language Model Responses
summary: Rubrics support the structured evaluation of language models. We propose a rubric for assessing expressed clinical reasoning in model responses, drawing on three bodies of work: medical education assessment frameworks (ART, SCT, Key Feature Problems and OSCE); clinical LLM benchmarks (MedR-Bench, HealthBench, TIMER-Bench, DR.BENCH, PrIME-LLM and PatientSafeBench); and general LLM reasoning evaluation research, including the Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility taxonomy, FaithCoT-Bench and C2-Faith. We use groundedness as a clinically oriented adaptation of the taxonomy's factuality category. The rubric brings these concepts together in a multidimensional framework for scoring free-text responses to gold-standard clinical vignettes. It includes provisional behavioural anchors, applicability rules and a separate flag for case-specific safety-critical errors. General-domain frameworks inform its design but are not treated as validated clinical instruments. The rubric does not replace case-specific reference criteria or the task-specific metrics of existing benchmarks. It has not yet been tested for inter-rater reliability, construct validity or clinical utility. Its immediate purpose is to make evaluation decisions explicit and open to scrutiny before empirical testing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个用于评估语言模型临床推理表达的评分量表，整合了医学教育评估框架、临床LLM基准测试和通用LLM推理评估研究，旨在为自由文本回答提供多维评分框架，包含行为锚点、适用性规则和安全关键错误标记，但尚未经过信度效度检验，主要目的是使评估决策显性化以便后续实证研究。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏专门针对语言模型临床推理表达的结构化评估工具，现有医学教育评估框架、临床LLM基准和通用推理评估研究各有侧重，未形成统一的多维评价体系，需要整合这些资源建立临床导向的评分量表。
AI.method: 基于三大文献体系构建评分量表：1)医学教育评估框架（ART、SCT、关键特征问题、OSCE）；2)临床LLM基准（MedR-Bench、HealthBench等）；3)通用LLM推理评估研究（事实性-效度-连贯性-实用性分类法、FaithCoT-Bench、C2-Faith）。将事实性改编为临床导向的'依据性'，建立多维框架评分自由文本回答，包含临时行为锚点、适用性规则和安全关键错误标记。
AI.result: 形成一个包含多维评分维度的临床推理评分量表，明确了评估决策的显性标准，但尚未进行评分者间信度、构念效度和临床效用性的实证检验，不替代现有基准的任务特定指标和病例特定参考标准。
AI.conclusion: 该量表作为临床推理评估的初步框架，主要价值在于使评估过程透明化、可审查，为后续实证验证奠定基础，需进一步开展信效度研究和临床效用测试才能作为正式评估工具使用。

title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill-free self through token probabilities. However, we identify two phenomena that question this channel. Invisible Advantage: a skill in context lifts WebShop success from 42.2% to 56.2%, yet changes the probabilities of fewer than a quarter of the sampled tokens. Much to Align: a skill changes the hidden states of over 80% of response tokens, in a way that linear probes can trace back to the specific skill. To exploit this, we propose Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation (PR-OPD). After a GRPO warm start, the policy writes a hindsight skill for each trajectory, re-reads its own responses with that skill as a stop-gradient teacher, and aligns its projected hidden states to the teacher's at every layer alongside the reward objective, with no external skill library, separate teacher, or inference overhead. On ALFWorld and WebShop with two backbones, PR-OPD achieves the best overall results in every setting, improving over GRPO by up to 4.7 points in ALFWorld success and 14.0 points in WebShop accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/balibata/PR-OPD.

AI.tldr: 提出PR-OPD方法，利用隐藏状态对齐进行特权自我蒸馏，在ALFWorld和WebShop任务上显著超越GRPO基线。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型代理通过每回合单一奖励的强化学习训练，特权自我蒸馏虽引入技能上下文但仅通过token概率传递知识。研究发现两大现象：1) Invisible Advantage：技能上下文能将WebShop成功率从42.2%提升至56.2%，却仅改变不到四分之一采样token的概率；2) Much to Align：技能改变超过80%响应token的隐藏状态，且线性探针可追溯至具体技能。这表明token概率层面的蒸馏严重低估了技能蕴含的信息量，需在表示层面对齐。
AI.method: PR-OPD（Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation）：先用GRPO热启动策略；随后策略为每条轨迹生成事后技能（hindsight skill），以该技能为停止梯度教师重读自身响应；在每层Transformer将策略投影隐藏状态与教师隐藏状态对齐（如MSE或余弦相似度损失），联合奖励目标优化。无需外部技能库、独立教师模型或额外推理开销。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两大交互基准上，采用两种不同主干模型（如Llama-3-8B等），PR-OPD在所有实验设置中均取得最佳整体性能。相比GRPO，ALFWorld成功率最高提升4.7个百分点，WebShop准确率最高提升14.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: PR-OPD通过在隐藏表示空间而非token概率空间进行特权自我蒸馏，充分挖掘技能上下文蕴含的丰富监督信号，以极低成本（无额外模型/推理开销）大幅提升语言模型代理在复杂交互任务中的泛化与性能。

title: Breaking the Illusion of Review Reliability under Static Evaluation: SCOPE Fuzzing for LLM-based Scientific Reviewers
summary: The rapid growth of submissions and reviewing workload has accelerated the use of large language models (LLMs) in peer review. Prior studies suggest that LLM-based reviewers can penalize content perturbations, such as overclaiming, indicating a certain degree of reliability. Yet these conclusions are largely based on a narrow set of perturbation strategies instantiated with static templates, providing limited evidence of actual reliability. In this paper, we construct a three-level evaluation framework covering perturbations to surface presentation, argumentative logic, and value judgment. Experiments on representative LLM-based reviewers reveal two limitations of static evaluation: stratified vulnerability, where perturbation effects depend on whether the paper's original review score is high or low, and perturbation undercoverage, where a single template misses vulnerabilities exposed by diverse realizations. To address these limitations, we propose SCOPE-Fuzzer, a strategy-aware fuzzer that combines feedback-driven strategy selection with adaptive mutation of paper content. By iteratively probing reviewers with dynamic perturbations, SCOPE-Fuzzer consistently uncovers vulnerabilities overlooked by static evaluation and other baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SCOPE-Fuzzer，一种策略感知的模糊测试工具，用于动态评估基于大语言模型的同行评审系统，解决了静态评估中存在的分层脆弱性和扰动覆盖不足问题。
AI.motivation: 随着论文提交量激增，大语言模型被引入同行评审。现有研究基于静态模板的扰动策略评估LLM评审可靠性，但证据有限，无法全面反映实际鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建三级评估框架（表层呈现、论证逻辑、价值判断），提出SCOPE-Fuzzer，结合反馈驱动的策略选择与论文内容自适应变异，迭代探测评审器漏洞。
AI.result: 实验显示静态评估存在分层脆弱性（扰动效果取决于原始评分高低）和扰动覆盖不足（单一模板遗漏漏洞）。SCOPE-Fuzzer持续发现静态评估和基线方法忽略的漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 动态、策略感知的模糊测试能更全面地暴露LLM评审器的脆弱性，为提升自动化同行评审的可靠性提供了新方法。

title: CompOrca: Corpus-Scale Compliance Labelling of Instruction-Tuning Data
comment: Accepted to PlurVA-LLM Workshop @ AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Dataset available on HuggingFace
summary: Studying how fine-tuning shapes refusal and noncompliance behaviour requires identifying training examples that refuse, evade or otherwise fail to fulfil the requested task. But existing annotation covers evaluation sets of a few thousand prompts at most. We present CompOrca, a compliance labelling over the entirety of the 4,233,923-example OpenOrca corpus. Every example was classified as compliant or noncompliant by five independent passes of an open-weight LLM judge (LongCat-2.0, 1.6T parameters), and the corpus is released as unanimous compliance (94.75%), unanimous noncompliance (1.28%), and nonunanimous rows (3.97%) along with the raw vote counts. A single pass flags 2.7-3.2% of the corpus as noncompliant, while only 1.28% is flagged by all five, allowing for filtering the most ambiguous samples. Against 450 human-annotated examples, 150 of them annotated twice (human-human $κ= 0.93$), the unanimous compliance and noncompliance labels are 97.3% and 86.7% precise, the latter a high-precision subset, not a complete enumeration, of noncompliance. Published refusal-detection methods recall only between 0.4% and 94.1% of the noncompliance class. We release the full corpus with its per-row labels and vote counts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca

AI.tldr: 本文发布 CompOrca 数据集：对全量 OpenOrca 语料（423 万条）进行合规性标注，使用开源 LLM 评判器（LongCat-2.0）五轮独立投票，产出一致合规（94.75%）、一致不合规（1.28%）及非一致（3.97%）三类标签及原始票数。人工评测显示一致标签精度分别为 97.3% 和 86.7%，现有拒答检测方法对不合规类的召回率仅 0.4%-94.1%。
AI.motivation: 研究微调如何塑造拒答与不合规行为，需要大规模识别训练中拒绝、规避或未完成任务的样本；现有标注仅覆盖几千条评测集，规模不足。
AI.method: 对 OpenOrca 全量 4,233,923 条样本，采用开源大模型 LongCat-2.0（1.6T 参数）作为评判器，进行五轮独立分类投票，得到合规/不合规标签；按投票一致性划分为一致合规、一致不合规、非一致三类，并公开每行原始票数。
AI.result: 一致合规占 94.75%，一致不合规占 1.28%，非一致占 3.97%。单轮标注不合规率 2.7%-3.2%，一致不合规为高精度子集。人工标注 450 条（其中 150 条双重标注，κ=0.93）验证：一致合规精度 97.3%，一致不合规精度 86.7%。现有拒答检测方法对不合规类召回率仅 0.4%-94.1%。
AI.conclusion: CompOrca 提供了目前最大规模的合规性标注语料，一致标签具有高精度，可支持对微调阶段拒答与不合规行为的系统性研究；同时揭示现有拒答检测方法覆盖率参差不齐，需更全面的检测手段。

title: Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers
summary: Recurrent reasoning models have attracted growing attention for scaling test-time computation, typically by iteratively refining latent states with shared parameters. However, these models apply each learned update with a fixed unit scale, which can be conservative when updates make persistent progress and overly aggressive when they fluctuate, limiting the benefit of additional loops. To understand how the scale should vary along the trajectory, we first analyze the sensitivity of terminal loss to recurrent update scale. We show that its temporal average admits an exact decomposition into persistent-progress and centered-fluctuation contributions. Based on this, we introduce the Trajectory Adaptive Progress-Fluctuation Scheduler (TAPS), which tracks their balance across recurrent updates and adapts the step size online. Theoretically, we establish sufficient conditions under which TAPS reduces expected terminal loss and reaches a target quality in fewer recurrent loops. Empirically, we show that TAPS improves terminal accuracy across structured reasoning tasks without retraining. By further incorporating the progress-fluctuation principle into training, TAPS yields additional accuracy gains with up to 1.56 times wall-clock speedup at matched baseline accuracy. The broad applicability of TAPS is supported by its effectiveness across diverse recurrent architectures and inference strategies. Together, these results establish update scale as complementary control axis of recurrent inference alongside architecture and depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TAPS (Trajectory Adaptive Progress-Fluctuation Scheduler)，一种自适应步长调度器，通过在线追踪循环推理轨迹中持久进步与中心化波动的平衡，动态调整更新步长，在无需重训练的情况下提升结构化推理任务的终端准确率，并在训练中引入该原则后实现高达 1.56 倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 循环推理模型通过共享参数迭代细化潜在状态来扩展测试时计算，但现有方法对每个学习到的更新采用固定单位步长，导致在更新持续取得进步时过于保守、在更新波动时过于激进，限制了额外循环的收益。
AI.method: 首先分析终端损失对循环更新步长的敏感性，证明其时间平均可精确分解为持久进步贡献与中心化波动贡献；基于此设计 TAPS，在线追踪二者平衡并自适应调整步长；理论上给出 TAPS 降低期望终端损失、以更少循环达到目标质量的充分条件。
AI.result: 理论上确立 TAPS 在充分条件下能降低期望终端损失并减少所需循环数；实验显示 TAPS 在多种结构化推理任务上无需重训练即提升终端准确率，进一步将进步-波动原则融入训练后，在匹配基线准确率下实现高达 1.56 倍壁钟时间加速；跨多种循环架构与推理策略均有效。
AI.conclusion: 更新步长是循环推理中除架构与深度之外的一个互补控制轴，通过自适应调度进步与波动的平衡可显著提升测试时计算的效率与效果。

title: Learning from Viable Failure Prefixes: Milestone Viability Potential Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents require reinforcement learning methods that can assign credit to intermediate decisions under sparse and delayed rewards. Existing group-based methods such as GRPO and GiGPO alleviate this issue by comparing rollout returns or repeated anchor states, but they still fail when the compared returns have no variation. We identify this failure mode as zero-credit failure: during early training, many failed rollouts contain useful prefixes, yet existing methods assign them no task-discriminative advantage. To address this issue, we propose Milestone Viability Potential Policy Optimization (MVPO), a potential-routed policy optimization algorithm that learns from viable failure prefixes. MVPO estimates prefix potential over Union-Find viability regions, repairs zero-credit groups with potential-difference advantages, and attenuates the potential branch according to relative performance progress. Experiments with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct show that MVPO outperforms eight strong baselines, including GRPO and GiGPO. Under the same training length, MVPO improves over the GiGPO baseline by +4.4 success points on ALFWorld and +5.3 on WebShop, while adding only 0.16%-0.20% advantage-construction overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文针对长时程LLM智能体在稀疏延迟奖励下的信用分配问题，指出现有基于分组的方法（GRPO、GiGPO）存在“零信用失效”现象：早期训练中许多失败轨迹包含有用前缀，却未获得任务判别优势。提出里程碑可行性势能策略优化（MVPO），基于并查集可行性区域估计前缀势能，用势能差修复零信用分组，并根据相对性能进展衰减势能分支。实验显示MVPO在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上超越八个强基线，ALFWorld提升+4.4成功点，WebShop提升+5.3，仅增加0.16%-0.20%优势构建开销。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体面临稀疏延迟奖励下的中间决策信用分配难题。现有分组方法通过对比回合回报或重复锚定状态缓解问题，但当对比回报无变异时失效——即早期训练中大量失败轨迹虽含有价值前缀，却无法获得任务判别优势，导致“有用前缀被忽视”的零信用失效。
AI.method: 提出MVPO（Milestone Viability Potential Policy Optimization）：1) 基于并查集划分可行性区域，估计前缀势能；2) 用势能差优势修复零信用分组，赋予失败轨迹中有价值前缀以判别性优势；3) 根据相对性能进展自适应衰减势能分支，平衡探索与利用。属于势能路由的策略优化算法，可从可行失败前缀中学习。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上实验，MVPO超越八个强基线（含GRPO、GiGPO）。相同训练长度下，较GiGPO在ALFWorld提升+4.4成功点，WebShop提升+5.3成功点；优势构建额外开销仅0.16%-0.20%。
AI.conclusion: MVPO通过势能估计与差分修复有效解决了零信用失效，显著提升长时程智能体在稀疏奖励下的学习效率，且计算开销极低，为基于RL的LLM智能体训练提供了实用的改进方向。

title: Thinking in Depth, Speaking Directly: Recurrent Latent Reasoning for Paralinguistically Grounded Spoken Dialogue
summary: Empathetic spoken dialogue requires models to use both what is said and how it is said to decide how to respond. Explicit CoT can improve paralinguistic perception and make acoustic cues more explicit in replies, yet does not ensure their effective use in response planning. We call this mismatch the perception-reasoning gap. In addition, CoT may not fully capture acoustic cues in words, and generating it adds inference latency. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopSLM, which builds on looped Transformers for latent reasoning, reusing a decoder block to refine hidden states with acoustic grounding at every pass. Its two-stage training further narrows the perception-reasoning gap by separating learning to reason from learning to respond, enabling direct inference without CoT. On EchoMind, LoopSLM improves paralinguistic understanding, reasoning, and reply quality over Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. Against the CoT-SFT baseline, LoopSLM gains over 20 points in reasoning accuracy while generating 64.5% fewer tokens at half the latency. It also outperforms Qwen3-Omni-Thinking on most empathetic reply metrics with 34x lower latency. Despite training only on dialogue data, LoopSLM improves accuracy on general audio benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LoopSLM，采用循环 Transformer 进行潜在推理，通过重复使用解码器块并在每次循环中融入声学 grounding，缩小感知-推理鸿沟，实现无需显式 CoT 的直接推理，在同理心口语对话任务上显著提升推理准确率、回复质量且大幅降低延迟与 token 开销。
AI.motivation: 同理心口语对话要求模型同时理解语言内容与副语言线索。显式思维链虽能改善副语言感知，但不能保证其在响应规划中被有效利用（即感知-推理鸿沟），且可能无法完全捕捉词级声学线索，同时引入额外推理延迟。
AI.method: 基于循环 Transformer 进行潜在推理，复用解码器块在每轮循环中用声学 grounding 细化隐藏状态；采用两阶段训练，将学习推理与学习响应分离，实现无需 CoT 的直接推理。
AI.result: 在 EchoMind 基准上，LoopSLM 超越 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 的副语言理解、推理与回复质量；对比 CoT-SFT 基线，推理准确率提升 20+ 分，token 减少 64.5%，延迟减半；优于 Qwen3-Omni-Thinking 的大多数同理心回复指标，延迟降低 34 倍；仅在对话数据上训练却能提升通用音频基准准确率。
AI.conclusion: LoopSLM 有效弥合了感知-推理鸿沟，提供了无需显式 CoT 的高效潜在推理机制，并在同理心口语对话与通用音频任务上均表现出强泛化能力。

title: Replay the Curvature: Accurate and Scalable NVFP4 Quantization for Large Language Model Inference
summary: Large language models make weight storage and memory traffic major inference costs, motivating low-precision formats that represent each weight with only a few bits. Such formats use a scale to map floating-point values into a small codebook; NVFP4 improves local range utilization by letting every 16 E2M1 weights share an E4M3 block scale. Choosing that scale is difficult in GPTQ because quantizing one column updates those that follow, so evaluating a block independently can misestimate its final reconstruction error. Large models pose a second challenge: full-precision weights, calibration activations, and second-order state cannot all remain on one accelerator, while assigning complete layers to devices leaves each time-consuming layer solve serial. We introduce \emph{Schur Replay}, a scale-selection algorithm that reproduces the GPTQ updates caused by each block scale and scores the resulting block error after accounting for compensation from unquantized columns. Separately, our execution infrastructure keeps only the active layer resident, tiers activations across device, host, and disk, retires full-precision layers after export, and distributes independent output rows across tensor-parallel ranks. Together, the algorithm and infrastructure attain $99.35\%$ and $100.84\%$ question-weighted recovery from BF16 across seven benchmarks on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. On the 397B model, the infrastructure reduces measured per-layer time by $15.17\times$ over ModelOpt and $23.14\times$ over LLM Compressor, with lower memory used per GPU.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Schur Replay 算法和分层执行基础设施，解决大模型低精度量化（如 NVFP4）中的 scale 选择难题及内存/计算瓶颈，在 Qwen3.5-397B 和 Llama-3.3-70B 上实现近无损 BF16 恢复并大幅加速量化流程。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理中权重存储与内存流量占主导，低精度格式（如 NVFP4）虽能压缩权重，但 GPTQ 量化中列间依赖导致 block scale 选择困难；同时超大模型无法在单加速器上同时驻留全精度权重、校准激活与二阶状态，且逐层串行求解耗时过长。
AI.method: 1. Schur Replay：模拟 GPTQ 更新过程，复现每个 block scale 引起的后续列补偿，从而准确评估量化后的重构误差并选取最优 scale。2. 分层执行基础设施：仅驻留当前活跃层，将激活分级存储于设备/主机/磁盘，导出后释放全精度层，并将独立输出行分配到张量并行秩实现并行化。
AI.result: 在七个基准上，Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 和 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 分别达到 99.35% 和 100.84% 的问题加权 BF16 恢复率。在 397B 模型上，基础设施使单层量化耗时比 ModelOpt 降低 15.17 倍、比 LLM Compressor 降低 23.14 倍，且单 GPU 内存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: Schur Replay 算法有效解决了 GPTQ 中 block scale 选择的相互依赖问题，配合分层内存管理与张量并行的执行基础设施，实现了超大模型低精度量化的高精度恢复与显著的时间/内存效率提升。

title: When Should Agents Check External State? Budgeting Observations for Stored Intentions
summary: Prospective memory allows an agent to retain an intention tied to a future condition, but the stored intention does not reveal whether that condition currently holds. Checking it may require web access, multi-step tool use, and paid calls. Existing systems decide when intentions require attention, but do not allocate the resulting observations under a shared budget. We introduce the first resource-allocation formulation for the external observations required by stored intentions under a shared episode budget. BudgetPM offers two policy variants that share a hard-budget executor. BudgetPM-Static uses a lightweight Logistic scorer to learn whether a check improves the current decision. BudgetPM-Sequential distills full-episode hindsight schedules into a lightweight policy that decides when to spend or reserve capacity using only pre-query information at deployment. We evaluate BudgetPM against two public memory-agent systems, five matched controls, and four hand-designed monitoring or budget-adaptation rules. Across two benchmarks and three backbones, BudgetPM-Static outperforms adapted Mem0 and PMA workflows. On PM-Bench, its Logistic scorer reaches competitive quality--cost operating points alongside higher-capacity scorers and retains 99.9--100\% of unconstrained quality with 42--54\% fewer observations. Under severe scarcity and the same hard caps, BudgetPM-Sequential exceeds the strongest tested natural monitoring schedule by 1.92--2.58 Set F1 points. It reaches the same Set F1 and on-time recall with 16--33\% fewer observations. Matched attribution, exact-cost analysis, and a fixed-budget load intervention link this gain to competition between present and future opportunities. These results yield a demand--capacity design rule: local gating works when capacity covers demand, while future-aware supervision adds value when observations compete across time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向未来意图外部观测的资源分配框架 BudgetPM，在共享硬预算下通过静态/顺序双策略实现观测调度，在两个基准上显著降低观测成本并保持或提升召回质量。
AI.motivation: 现有前向记忆系统虽能判断何时需关注意图，但缺乏在共享预算下对外部观测（如网络检索、工具调用、付费 API）的统一资源分配机制，导致在观测资源稀缺时无法在当前与未来机会间最优权衡。
AI.method: 提出 BudgetPM 统一执行器与两种策略：BudgetPM-Static 使用轻量级 Logistic 评分器判断单次检查是否改善当前决策；BudgetPM-Sequential 将全回合事后最优调度蒸馏为仅依赖部署前信息的轻量策略，决定即时消耗还是保留预算。两者共享硬预算执行器。
AI.result: 在两基准、三主干模型上，BudgetPM-Static 超越改造版 Mem0 与 PMA 工作流；其 Logistic 评分器在同等质量下减少 42%-54% 观测，保留 99.9%-100% 无约束质量。极度稀缺下 BudgetPM-Sequential 比最强基线高 1.92-2.58 Set F1，同等指标下再减少 16%-33% 观测。消融实验证实收益源于跨时间步的机会竞争管理。
AI.conclusion: 确立需求-容量设计准则：当观测容量覆盖需求时本地门控足矣；当观测在时间维度竞争时，面向未来的监督调度能显著提升资源效率。BudgetPM 为受限预算下的前向记忆代理提供了首个系统性资源分配解决方案。

title: The Geometry of Inference in Transformer Residual Streams
summary: Transformer language models build predictions through successive residual updates, but how their representations become specific to an eventual outcome remains unclear. We study this process by comparing intermediate residual states with their own final states and an empirical bank of final states from other contexts. Across six pretrained language models, the own endpoint becomes preferable to the average alternative early, while many individual endpoints remain closer. These competing sets generally shrink with depth, but their membership changes and their surviving endpoints need not become more similar to one another. Directional alignment and endpoint rank can therefore improve while Euclidean distance to the final state changes little. We develop a simple high-dimensional model that separates the roles of norm, alignment, and endpoint geometry, showing how gradual directional changes can produce sharp reductions in competition. We also prove that a straight path toward the own endpoint cannot introduce new competitors under either Euclidean or cosine distance; observed entries thus establish departures from straight-line convergence. Finally, endpoints associated with lower-ranked output tokens tend to lie farther away in cosine distance across all studied models, connecting residual geometry to output organization. Together, these findings characterize increasing geometric specificity during transformer inference and explain why distance, competitor count, and concentration of the surviving endpoints provide distinct views of that process.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Transformer语言模型在推理过程中残差表示如何逐渐变得特定于最终输出。通过比较中间残差状态与自身最终状态及其他上下文的最终状态，发现自身端点在早期就比平均替代端点更优，但许多单个竞争端点仍更接近。竞争集合随层深收缩但成员变化，方向对齐和端点排名改善而欧氏距离变化不大。提出高维模型分离范数、对齐和端点几何的作用，证明直线收敛不会引入新竞争者，观察到的竞争者进入表明偏离直线收敛。低秩输出token的端点在余弦距离上更远，将残差几何与输出组织联系起来。
AI.motivation: Transformer语言模型通过连续的残差更新构建预测，但其表示如何变得特定于最终结果仍不清楚。需要表征推理过程中几何特异性的增加，并解释距离、竞争者数量和幸存端点集中度为何提供不同的视角。
AI.method: 在六个预训练语言模型上，比较中间残差状态与自身最终状态及经验库中其他上下文的最终状态。分析欧氏距离和余弦距离下的竞争端点集合变化，开发高维模型分离范数、对齐和端点几何的作用，证明直线收敛路径的性质，并关联端点几何与输出token排名。
AI.result: 自身端点早期即优于平均替代端点，但许多单个竞争端点保持更近。竞争集合随深度收缩但成员变化，幸存端点不必更相似。方向对齐和端点排名改善而欧氏距离变化小。高维模型展示渐进方向变化如何产生竞争的剧烈减少。直线收敛不会引入新竞争者，观察到的进入表明偏离直线。低秩输出token的端点在余弦距离上更远。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表征了Transformer推理过程中几何特异性的增加，解释了距离、竞争者数量和幸存端点集中度为何提供不同但互补的视角，揭示了残差流几何与输出组织的内在联系。

title: Constitutional adapters: Inference-time interventions for misalignment and misuse
summary: Training models to act in accordance with an explicitly defined set of principles, or "constitution," has shown promise as a robust and transparent mechanism for AI alignment. However, the generality and flexibility of such methods remain unclear. Here, we show that constitution-consistent behavior can be distilled from synthetic corpora into lightweight objects (low-rank adapters and steering vectors). Despite never seeing a harmful request or jailbreak during training, such objects increase jailbreak defense success and measured alignment -- particularly at long context lengths and against multi-turn attacks, where they outperform both prompted and steered baselines. Subtracting control-trained from constitution-trained objects further accentuates these effects, yielding defenses we call "constitutional adapters" (CAs). CAs can be trained on a base model, transferred zero-shot to its post-trained checkpoint, and scaled at inference time to predictably trade off defense for benign compliance. Taken together, these results recommend CAs as a lightweight, portable, and tunable lever for mitigating misalignment and misuse in API deployments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为“宪法适配器”（Constitutional Adapters, CAs）的轻量级对齐方法，通过从合成语料库中蒸馏符合宪法原则的行为到低秩适配器和引导向量中，实现了无需接触有害请求即可显著提升越狱防御能力和对齐度，特别是在长上下文和多轮攻击场景下表现优异，且支持零样本迁移和推理时动态调节。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于宪法原则的AI对齐方法虽然具有鲁棒性和透明性，但其泛化能力和灵活性尚不清楚。研究旨在探索能否将宪法一致的行为蒸馏为轻量级、可迁移、可调节的对象，以解决API部署中的错位和滥用问题，特别是针对长上下文和多轮攻击等困难场景。
AI.method: 1. 使用合成语料库训练符合宪法原则的模型行为；2. 将该行为蒸馏到低秩适配器和引导向量等轻量级对象中；3. 通过减去控制训练得到的对象与宪法训练得到的对象，构建“宪法适配器”（CAs）；4. 在基础模型上训练CAs，零样本迁移到后训练检查点；5. 在推理时通过缩放CAs来动态权衡防御能力与良性合规性。
AI.result: CAs在从未见过有害请求或越狱的情况下，显著提升了越狱防御成功率和对齐度指标。在长上下文长度和多轮攻击场景下，CAs优于提示词和引导基线。CAs可在基础模型上训练并零样本迁移到后训练检查点，推理时可缩放以可预测地权衡防御与合规。
AI.conclusion: 宪法适配器（CAs）作为一种轻量级、可迁移、可调节的杠杆，有效缓解了API部署中的错位和滥用风险。该方法无需接触有害数据即可获得强大的防御能力，且支持推理时动态调节，为实际部署提供了实用的对齐解决方案。

title: SkillCome: Group Contrast Skill Optimization with Dual Memory
summary: Skill evolution improves the capabilities of large language models by analyzing trajectories generated under a given skill and modifying the skill accordingly. Existing approaches typically generate a single trajectory per question. However, this provides insufficient optimization signals since it requires inferring effective skill edits from a solitary path. It is difficult to pinpoint which actions caused the failure in a failed trajectory, or to determine which actions in a successful one should be incorporated into the skill. Furthermore, they rely on a local batch of trajectories for analysis, making the optimization direction susceptible to noisy evidence. To address these, we propose SkillCome, a Skill-evolution method based on group Contrast optimization with dual memory. For each question, SkillCome generates trajectories and performs group contrast analysis to precisely identify key behavioral divergences between successful and failed trajectories, offering reliable optimization signals. The dual memory system further accumulates evidence from historical steps to track patterns shared across different groups, leading to more generalized optimization directions. Together, SkillCome builds a systematic optimization process that transforms experience from observed successful trajectories into reusable skills. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks spanning question answering, reasoning, and agentic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. SkillCome consistently outperforms baselines across five models of varying families and scales, with gains up to +5.69 points.

AI.tldr: SkillCome提出了一种基于群体对比优化与双重记忆的技能进化方法，通过生成多条轨迹并对比成功与失败轨迹的行为差异，结合历史证据积累，实现更可靠、泛化的技能优化，在六大基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能进化方法仅生成单条轨迹，优化信号不足，难以定位失败原因或提取成功关键动作；且依赖局部批次分析，易受噪声干扰，导致优化方向不可靠。
AI.method: SkillCome包含两大核心组件：1) 群体对比分析：对每个问题生成多条轨迹，通过对比成功与失败轨迹群体，精准识别关键行为分歧，提供可靠优化信号；2) 双重记忆系统：积累历史步骤的跨群体共享模式证据，指导更泛化的优化方向。两者协同构建系统性优化流程，将成功轨迹经验转化为可复用技能。
AI.result: 在涵盖问答、推理、智能体任务的六个基准上，SkillCome在五个不同系列和规模的模型上均持续超越基线，最高提升达+5.69分。
AI.conclusion: SkillCome通过群体对比与双重记忆机制，有效解决了单轨迹优化信号不足和局部噪声敏感的问题，实现了更鲁棒、泛化的技能进化，为大模型能力提升提供了系统性解决方案。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Stay Helpful When Facing Implicit Risks? Intent-Privilege OPSD for Efficient Safety-Helpfulness Alignment
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain vulnerable to cross-modal implicit risks: visual and textual inputs that appear benign in isolation can jointly elicit unsafe responses. Existing safety methods often require large preference datasets, costly multi-rollout training, or additional safeguards at inference time. They may also sacrifice helpfulness by directly refusing requests that could be answered safely. In this paper, we propose Intent-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which leverages evidence-grounded intent as privileged supervision during training to help VLMs recognize implicit risks and provide safe, useful responses instead of blanket refusals. OPSD distills a teacher's intent-conditioned preferences over responses into a student using a single rollout per prompt; the student then responds without intent annotations or an additional safety module. With only 1,447 safety-specific examples - 95% fewer than standard preference datasets - OPSD reduces training time by 5x relative to multi-rollout GRPO-style training and average inference length by 7%. It attains the highest ratio for joint safety-helpfulness success, which measures the proportion of responses that are both safe and helpful, across all five evaluation groups. Remarkably, on pooled SIUO+HoliSafe, this success ratio rises from 43.9% to 53.5%. These results show that training-time intent supervision can improve both safety and helpfulness while substantially reducing data, training, and inference costs.

AI.tldr: 提出了 Intent-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)，利用基于证据的意图作为训练时的特权监督，仅用 1,447 个安全样本（比标准偏好数据集减少 95%），将训练时间降低 5 倍，推理长度减少 7%，在五个评估组中均实现最高的安全-有用性联合成功率（SIUO+HoliSafe 上从 43.9% 提升至 53.5%），证明训练时的意图监督能同时提升安全性与有用性并大幅降低数据、训练和推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）面临跨模态隐性风险：单独看似良性的视觉和文本输入组合可能诱发不安全响应。现有安全方法通常需要大规模偏好数据集、昂贵的多轮训练或推理时的额外防护，且往往通过直接拒绝请求牺牲有用性。因此需要一种数据高效、训练高效且能兼顾安全与有用性的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Intent-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)。在训练阶段引入基于证据的意图作为特权监督，将教师模型的意图条件偏好通过单次采样蒸馏给学生模型；学生模型在推理时无需意图标注或额外安全模块即可响应。仅使用 1,447 个安全专用样本，避免多轮采样，实现单轮策略蒸馏。
AI.result: OPSD 仅用标准偏好数据集 5% 的数据量（1,447 样本），训练时间较多轮 GRPO 式训练降低 5 倍，平均推理长度减少 7%。在五个评估组中均达到最高的安全-有用性联合成功率；在合并的 SIUO+HoliSafe 基准上，联合成功率从 43.9% 提升至 53.5%。
AI.conclusion: 训练时的意图监督能显著提升 VLM 的安全性与有用性，同时大幅降低数据需求、训练计算和推理开销，为跨模态隐性风险提供了一种高效且实用的解决方案。

title: On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Underlies Generalization in LLM Post-Training
summary: The strong generalization performance of on-policy post-training paradigms has motivated studies of their parameter update behaviors. However, these studies treat the observed behaviors only as byproducts in on-policy training, overlooking their potential to serve as optimization principles for improving the generalization of other paradigms such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). To address this limitation, we investigate whether there exists a specific on-policy update behavior that can achieve such improvements. First, our analyses reveal that SFT updates parameters along consistent directions, while the on-policy paradigm continuously adjusts the direction during training. This difference inspires us to focus on the cumulative update direction of each parameter as a promising behavior. Then, we evaluate its effectiveness for improving generalization by proposing On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning (OPSFT), which constrains SFT updates to the direction identified by on-policy paradigms. The strong performance of OPSFT indicates that the generalization advantage of on-policy paradigms can be transferred to SFT through the parameter update direction. Once such a direction is identified, even SFT can generalize with its updates constrained to this direction. This finding offers two practical benefits by combining the strong generalization of on-policy paradigms with the advantages of SFT, including the high training efficiency and ability to leverage high-quality trajectories. For efficiency, we identify update directions that support strong generalization using a few on-policy training steps, and subsequently apply OPSFT to achieve high training efficiency. For leveraging high-quality trajectories, OPSFT can utilize these trajectories to continue improving a post-trained model along its update direction without disrupting the ability learned from on-policy training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OPSFT 方法，通过将 SFT 的参数更新方向约束为 on-policy 训练所识别的方向，实现了 on-policy 泛化优势向 SFT 的迁移，同时保留了 SFT 的高效率和利用高质量轨迹的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将 on-policy 训练中的参数更新行为视为副产品，忽视了其作为优化原则改进 SFT 等其他范式泛化性能的潜力。
AI.method: 分析 SFT 与 on-policy 的参数更新方向差异，提出 OPSFT：利用少量 on-policy 训练步骤识别累积更新方向，再约束 SFT 更新沿该方向进行。
AI.result: OPSFT 表现优异，表明 on-policy 的泛化优势可通过参数更新方向迁移至 SFT；实现了高训练效率（仅需少量 on-policy 步骤）和高质量轨迹的有效利用且不破坏 on-policy 学到的能力。
AI.conclusion: 参数更新方向是连接 on-policy 与 SFT 泛化能力的关键桥梁，OPSFT 融合了 on-policy 的强泛化与 SFT 的高效率、轨迹利用优势，为后训练范式提供了新的优化思路。

title: Train Ahead, Distill Back: Bootstrapping On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves large language models by letting a self-teacher with privileged information provide dense token-level supervision on the model's own trajectories. Yet existing methods typically construct the self-teacher from the current, initial, or slowly averaged policy state, leaving the quality of supervision constrained by the teacher's ability to exploit privileged information. We ask whether the model's own optimization progress can instead be recycled into a stronger self-teacher. In this paper, we introduce Bootstrapped On-Policy Self-Distillation (B-OPSD), which temporarily trains the policy ahead to obtain a future teacher, restores the student to the original policy state, and then uses the future teacher to supervise the restarted student. The future teacher improves supervision in two complementary ways, it can generate more reliable privileged trajectories and, conditioned on them, provide more informative token-level targets along the restarted student's on-policy trajectories. Experiments on mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B show consistent improvements over standard OPSD in both settings, including gains from 27.50 to 41.30 and from 48.80 to 64.44 in the rollout-privileged setting. Our findings point to a broader principle for self-improving models that future learning progress can be distilled backward, preserving acquired knowledge while bootstrapping beyond the optimization state that produced it.

AI.tldr: B-OPSD 通过临时训练策略获得未来教师，再回滚学生模型并利用未来教师进行监督，显著提升数学推理任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 OPSD 方法的自我教师基于当前、初始或缓慢平均的策略状态，无法充分利用特权信息，监督质量受限。
AI.method: B-OPSD 先将策略向前训练获得未来教师，然后将学生恢复到原始策略状态，利用未来教师在重启学生的在线策略轨迹上提供密集 token 级监督。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的数学推理实验中，B-OPSD 持续优于标准 OPSD，例如 rollout-privileged 设置下性能从 27.50 提升至 41.30，从 48.80 提升至 64.44。
AI.conclusion: 未来学习进度可以被向后蒸馏，在保留已获知识的同时实现超越原优化状态的自举改进。

title: AnthroDial: Benchmarking LLM Anthropomorphism in Autonomous Social Interaction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as social agents, yet credible human-like interaction requires more than fluent responses or persona consistency. Agents must autonomously decide whether, when, and how to communicate while adapting to evolving contexts, goals, and relationships. Existing research, however, lacks a unified approach to enabling, evaluating, and improving such capabilities in continuous, open-ended interaction. We introduce AnthroDial, a unified framework for developing anthropomorphic social agents from three complementary aspects: MindFlow, a lightweight interaction harness that enables autonomous, asynchronous, and adaptive communication through a dynamic Mind Buffer; CAPS-Eval, a theory-grounded framework for evaluating cognitive, affective, and behavioral dimensions of anthropomorphic interaction; and a scalable training paradigm that combines SEEDS for environment expansion with DiAPO for adaptive capability optimization. We further construct evaluation datasets covering everyday communication, game interaction, and long-horizon character interaction. Extensive experiments across diverse models and scenarios demonstrate improved interaction autonomy and naturalness, validate the reliability, discriminativeness, and agreement with human rankings of CAPS-Eval, and confirm the effectiveness of our training paradigm. Together, these components provide a unified framework for developing credible human-like social agents in open-ended interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AnthroDial，一个用于开发拟人化社交智能体的统一框架，包含三个核心组件：MindFlow（轻量级交互引擎，支持自主、异步、自适应通信）、CAPS-Eval（基于理论的认知-情感-行为评估框架）以及结合 SEEDS 环境扩展与 DiAPO 自适应能力优化的可扩展训练范式。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型作为社交智能体部署时，仅具备流畅回复或人设一致性尚不足以实现可信的类人交互。智能体需要自主决定是否、何时、如何沟通，并适应不断演变的语境、目标与关系，但现有研究缺乏在持续开放式交互中统一赋能、评估与改进这些能力的方法。
AI.method: 1) MindFlow：基于动态 Mind Buffer 的轻量级交互挂载，实现自主、异步、自适应通信；2) CAPS-Eval：涵盖认知、情感、行为三维度的理论奠基评估框架；3) 训练范式：SEEDS 用于环境扩展，DiAPO 用于自适应能力优化；并构建覆盖日常对话、游戏交互、长时程角色交互的评估数据集。
AI.result: 跨多模型多场景的大量实验表明：交互自主性与自然度显著提升；CAPS-Eval 具备可靠性、区分度及与人类排序的一致性；训练范式有效性得到验证。
AI.conclusion: AnthroDial 通过 MindFlow、CAPS-Eval 与 SEEDS+DiAPO 训练范式的协同，为在开放式交互中构建可信的类人社交智能体提供了统一框架。

title: Byzantine-Robust Federated Representation Learning
summary: We study federated learning (FL) with adversarial clients, where the goal is to minimize the average loss of the honest (non-adversarial) clients without knowing their identity. Under heterogeneity, a single shared model parameter is statistically inappropriate: it cannot capture the distinct data-generating processes across clients, incurring an irreducible model-heterogeneity bias and severely limiting robustness to adversarial clients (a.k.a. Byzantine-robustness). We address this problem through representation learning, where each client learns a personalized linear head, while collaboratively estimating a shared nonlinear representation through Byzantine-robust aggregation. We demonstrate that the heterogeneity among honest representation gradients is controlled by the representation error and statistical errors that decay either with the number of data samples per client ($τ$) or the number of iterations ($T$). In particular, our non-asymptotic parameter recovery error bound reveals three terms: (i) an initialization-dependent error that goes away with $T$, (ii) finite-sample noise terms that decreases with $τ$ and the number of honest clients, and (iii) a stochastic gradient variance term that also reduces with $T$. Importantly, with no irreducible model-heterogeneity bias in our bounds. We extend the regression analysis to multiclass classification, and empirically validate it on CIFAR-10, FEMNIST, and School Exam Score datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对联邦学习中存在对抗性客户端且数据异质的问题，提出基于表示学习的个性化联邦学习框架：每个客户端学习个性化线性头，共享非线性表示通过拜占庭鲁棒聚合协作估计。理论上证明了无不可约模型异质偏差的非渐近参数恢复误差界，包含三个随迭代轮数 T 和每客户端样本数 τ 衰减的项；扩展至多分类并实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习在异质数据下采用单一共享模型会导致不可约的模型异质偏差，严重限制对抗性（拜占庭）客户端的鲁棒性；需设计能同时处理异质性和拜占庭攻击的方法。
AI.method: 采用表示学习范式：每个客户端维护个性化线性分类头，共享非线性特征表示；通过拜占庭鲁棒聚合（如坐标-wise 中位数、修剪均值等）协作估计共享表示，理论分析基于非凸优化与统计学习框架，给出非渐近参数恢复误差界。
AI.result: 理论上建立三项误差界：(i) 初始化依赖误差随迭代轮数 T 消失；(ii) 有限样本噪声项随每客户端样本数 τ 和诚实客户端数量衰减；(iii) 随机梯度方差项随 T 衰减。关键在于无不可约模型异质偏差。实验在 CIFAR-10、FEMNIST、School Exam Score 数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 个性化线性头 + 共享非线性表示的拜占庭鲁棒聚合框架成功解决了异质联邦学习中的模型异质偏差问题，提供了无不可约偏差的理论保证，并在多个基准数据集上展示了优越的鲁棒性与泛化性能。

title: From Judgment Quality to Downstream Utility: Rethinking LLM-as-a-Judge for Open-Ended Tasks
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge is increasingly used to evaluate policy responses on open-ended tasks that lack ground-truth answers. Existing work often directly converts the resulting judgments into reward signals for policy training, paying limited attention to intrinsic judgment quality and largely restricting the use of Judges to training-time supervision. We systematically investigate judgment quality and downstream utility by examining both how judgments are elicited and how they are used. For judgment elicitation, we vary the Judge protocol along three dimensions: verdict granularity, critique usage, and evaluation batching. For judgment usage, beyond policy training, we extend Judge to test-time inference through Best-of-N selection, Judge-guided revision, and beam search. We find that, (i) Surprisingly, judgment quality and downstream utility do not always align. (ii) Judge protocol design substantially affects both intrinsic judgment quality and downstream utility. (iii) Judge guidance effectively converts test-time compute into performance gains, with benefits varying across inference strategies. Our results call for a multifaceted evaluation of LLM Judges on open-ended tasks, encompassing intrinsic judgment quality, and downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了 LLM-as-a-Judge 在开放式任务中的判断质量与下游效用，探讨了判断获取协议（裁决粒度、批判使用、评估批次）与判断使用方式（训练时监督、测试时推理：Best-of-N、Judge引导修订、束搜索）的影响。发现判断质量与下游效用并不总是对齐，协议设计显著影响两者，且 Judge 引导能有效将测试时算力转化为性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有工作常直接将 LLM 判断转为奖励信号用于策略训练，却很少关注判断本身的内在质量，且主要将 Judge 限制在训练时监督。需要系统性地评估判断获取方式与使用方式对判断质量和下游效用的影响，呼吁多维度评估 LLM Judge。
AI.method: 从两个维度展开实验：(1) 判断获取：沿裁决粒度、批判使用、评估批次三个维度变换 Judge 协议；(2) 判断使用：除策略训练外，引入测试时推理策略——Best-of-N 选择、Judge 引导修订、束搜索。在开放式任务上对比不同协议与使用方式的内在判断质量与下游任务表现。
AI.result: (i) 判断质量与下游效用并不总是对齐，高质量判断不一定带来最佳下游性能。(ii) Judge 协议设计（粒度、批判、批次）显著影响内在判断质量与下游效用。(iii) Judge 引导的测试时推理策略能有效将额外计算量转化为性能增益，不同策略收益不同。
AI.conclusion: 应从内在判断质量与下游效用两个维度多面评估 LLM Judge。协议设计至关重要，且将 Judge 扩展到测试时推理（Best-of-N、引导修订、束搜索）是提升性能的有效途径，值得进一步探索最佳协议与推理策略的组合。

title: One Threshold Does Not Fit All Languages: Language-Conditional Deferral for Reliable and Efficient Low-Resource Text Classification
comment: Got accepted and published in NeurIPS 2026 GlobalSouthAI
summary: In the Global South, the lower-income countries of Africa, Asia, and Latin America where most of the world's languages are spoken, a deployed text classifier usually runs on ordinary CPUs, serves many languages with a single model, has few labeled examples in any of them, and relies on people to catch its mistakes. Such a system is only useful if it can promise how often it will be wrong: at most a fixed fraction of the labels it assigns on its own may be incorrect, and everything else must go to a person. Split conformal prediction delivers this promise through a single confidence threshold, normally estimated on validation data pooled across languages. We ask whether the promise reaches every language, and it does not. On MasakhaNEWS (16 African languages) and AfriSenti (12 languages plus two never seen in training), a pooled threshold meets the 90% target on average but covers Somali at 77.5%, Tigrinya at 83.7%, and the two unseen languages at 77.5% and 81.2%. Estimating one threshold per language brings every language to between 89.1% and 91.0% without retraining, and it shows how unequal the cost of the promise is: keeping it means sending 43% of Somali news and over 80% of Amharic and Xitsonga tweets to a person, against under 8% of Nigerian Pidgin news. One or two hundred labels per language are enough and the models train in minutes on one CPU core, so the fix is affordable: calibrate, report, and budget human review one language at a time.

AI.tldr: 论文指出在多语言文本分类中，使用合并验证集的共形预测阈值虽能满足平均覆盖率目标，但会导致低资源语言覆盖率严重不足；提出按语言单独校准阈值，无需重新训练即可使所有语言达到目标覆盖率，并揭示了不同语言的人工复核成本差异巨大。
AI.motivation: 在全球南方部署的文本分类系统通常运行在普通CPU上，需单模型服务多语言，标注数据极少，依赖人工纠错。此类系统必须保证自动标注的错误率不超过固定比例，其余交由人工。现有方法在混合多语言验证集上估计单一置信度阈值，但无法保证每种语言都达到覆盖率目标。
AI.method: 在MasakhaNEWS（16种非洲语言）和AfriSenti（12种语言加2种未见语言）上实验。对比两种共形预测校准策略：(1) 跨语言合并验证集估计单一阈值；(2) 每种语言单独估计阈值。使用100-200个标注样本每语言，在单CPU核心上几分钟完成训练。
AI.result: 合并阈值平均覆盖率达90%目标，但Somali仅77.5%，Tigrinya 83.7%，两种未见语言分别77.5%和81.2%。单语言阈值使所有语言覆盖率在89.1%-91.0%之间。人工复核比例差异巨大：Somali新闻43%，Amharic和Xitsonga推文超80%，而Nigerian Pidgin新闻不足8%。
AI.conclusion: 为每种语言单独校准共形预测阈值是低成本、高效的解决方案：只需百余标注样本、几分钟CPU训练，即可确保每种语言的错误率承诺，并量化各语言的人工复核预算。建议实践中按语言逐一校准、报告覆盖率并预算人工复核。

title: AutoLoCo: Communication Efficient Distributed LLM Training via Adaptive Synchronization
summary: The pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly conducted across multiple data centers. As training scales to a larger number of accelerators, the fraction of time spent on computation decreases, while the fraction spent on communication increases. Therefore, frequent synchronization becomes a growing bottleneck. Local update methods reduce this cost by allowing workers to perform several optimizer steps between synchronizations. Most local update methods set the number of local optimizer steps between synchronizations before training and keep this interval fixed throughout the run. However, the best interval can change during the entire train process. If the interval and optimizer are adapted to the current training state, the communication frequency is reduced while maintaining the training performance. In this work, we introduce AutoLoCo, an adaptive training framework to reduce communication in LLM training. It adapts the local interval using scalar training statistics and corrects each outer update. Our method is motivated by two observations: 1) the appropriate local interval varies across training stages, and 2) changing the number of inner steps per interval creates a mismatch with an unchanged outer optimizer, requiring a correction to the outer update. We optimize this mismatch by correction of the outer optimizer for the momentum and the learning rate using the accumulated inner learning rate. Our experiments under communication constraints demonstrate that AutoLoCo reduces communication frequency by 27% relative to DiLoCo while maintaining training performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoLoCo，一种自适应的LLM训练框架，通过动态调整本地更新间隔并修正外层优化器，在保持训练性能的同时将通信频率较DiLoCo降低27%。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM训练规模扩大到多数据中心，通信开销成为主要瓶颈。现有的局部更新方法（如DiLoCo）使用固定的同步间隔，但最优间隔会随训练阶段变化；且改变内层步数会导致与未改变的外层优化器产生不匹配，需要修正外层更新。
AI.method: AutoLoCo基于标量训练统计量自适应调整本地更新间隔，并通过累积内层学习率修正外层优化器的动量和学习率，解决内层步数变化带来的外层更新不匹配问题。
AI.result: 在通信受限条件下的实验表明，AutoLoCo相较于DiLoCo将通信频率降低27%，同时保持相当的训练性能。
AI.conclusion: 自适应调整本地同步间隔并配合外层优化器修正，能有效降低大规模分布式LLM训练中的通信开销而不损害模型质量，为跨数据中心训练提供了更高效的方案。

title: When Tools Silently Lie: Evaluating and Mitigating Blind Compliance in Tool-Augmented Data Agents
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures. Code and benchmark materials: https://github.com/turambar928/Toxic_Tool_Bench
summary: Tool-augmented data agents rely on tool outputs for analytical decisions. Yet successful execution can return plausible but incorrect evidence, requiring agents to decide whether to trust or verify it. Understanding this failure requires examining both the evidence obtained through checking and the answer ultimately adopted. We introduce ToxicBench to measure checking and adoption under numerical, label, schema, and retrieval errors, pairing clean and poisoned observations over fixed source data. In the 118-task GPT evaluation across three adapters, poisoning lowers task success by 26 to 39 percentage points. Ordinary retries help under one-shot poisoning, whereas repeated poisoning reveals wrong-answer adoption after checking. Controls on three public tables isolate how supplied evidence affects recovery. After freezing the scorer, we compare its judgments with human annotations on 200 trajectories, finding 96% task-success agreement. Human judgments support retry gains over Base and confirm adoption after checking on audited tasks. We release trajectories, versioned scoring, and reference and delivery audits. These findings highlight evidence availability and answer selection as complementary dimensions of agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ToxicBench 基准，评估工具增强数据代理在面对数值、标签、模式和检索错误时的检查与采纳行为，发现中毒导致任务成功率下降 26-39 个百分点，重试可缓解一次性中毒，但反复中毒会导致检查后仍采纳错误答案，人工标注与评分器一致性达 96%，强调证据可用性与答案选择是代理可靠性的两个互补维度。
AI.motivation: 工具增强数据代理依赖工具输出做决策，但工具执行成功可能返回看似合理却错误的证据，代理需决定是否信任或验证。理解这种失效需同时考察通过检查获得的证据和最终采纳的答案。
AI.method: 构建 ToxicBench，配对干净与中毒观测，覆盖数值、标签、模式、检索四类错误；在 118 个任务上用三种适配器评估 GPT；在三张公开表上做控制实验隔离证据供给对恢复的影响；冻结评分器，在 200 条轨迹上与人工标注对比。
AI.result: 中毒使任务成功率下降 26-39 个百分点；一次性中毒下普通重试有帮助，反复中毒则暴露检查后仍采纳错误答案的现象；人工判断支持重试优于基线，并确认在审计任务上存在检查后采纳错误的行为；评分器与人工在任务成功判断上达成 96% 一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示证据可用性和答案选择是代理可靠性的两个互补维度；发布轨迹、版本化评分、参考与交付审计资源。

title: It's Not What the Image Shows: Irrelevant Context Destabilises VLM Judges Without Informing Them
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of human annotators, making it important that substitutability tests reflect the model rather than incidental evaluation conditions. We introduce MIST, the Misleading-Image Stress Test: 200 English sentences, each built around a phrase readable either figuratively or literally and shown with an aligned image depicting its reading, a misleading image depicting the opposite, or no image at all. The guidelines require the label to be decided from the sentence alone, so no image should change any answer. We expected each image to pull a judge's labels toward the sense it depicts, and neither kind did. Across thirteen VLM judges, an aligned image changed 20.5% of labels and a misleading one 19.4%, close for every judge and both above the 11.6% produced by deleting the ignore-the-image instruction with the image left in place. Yet only 37% of the labels that differ between the two images moved toward the sense shown, and agreement with our human annotators is unchanged whether the image is absent, aligned or misleading. The effect is smaller in the seven judges that pass the alt-test than in the six that never do, but present in all of them: what moves a judge is that an image is there, not which of the two it is, so a substitutability verdict describes a configuration as much as a model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MIST（误导性图像压力测试），用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）作为人类标注员替代品的可靠性。实验表明，图像的存在而非其内容会系统性地改变模型判断，且与人类标注一致性不随图像条件变化，说明替代性结论更多反映评测配置而非模型本身。
AI.motivation: 随着 VLMs 越来越多地替代人类标注员，需要确保替代性测试反映模型能力而非附带的评测条件（如图像的存在或内容）。现有评测可能忽略图像对模型判断的干扰效应，导致对模型替代性的高估。
AI.method: 构建 MIST 基准：200 个英语句子，每个句子包含可作字面或比喻理解的短语，分别搭配三种图像条件——aligned（匹配句意）、misleading（描绘相反含义）、无图像。指南要求仅根据句子决定标签，图像不应改变答案。在 13 个 VLM 判断器上测试，并与人类标注员一致性对比。
AI.result: aligned 图像改变 20.5% 标签，misleading 图像改变 19.4%，两者接近且均高于删除‘忽略图像’指令后的 11.6%。仅 37% 差异标签向图像所展示的意义方向移动。人类标注一致性在三种图像条件下无显著差异。通过 alt-test 的 7 个判断器效应较小，但所有判断器均表现出‘图像存在’而非‘图像内容’驱动判断变化的模式。
AI.conclusion: VLM 的判断易受图像存在与否的影响，而非图像语义内容；替代性测试的结论很大程度上描述的是评测配置（是否包含图像），而非模型的真实语言理解能力。建议未来评测控制图像存在这一混淆因素。

title: GenLimitLib: A Formal Library for Language Generation in the Limit and AI-Assisted Mathematical Research
summary: We present GenLimitLib, a source-aligned Lean 4 library for language generation in the limit. Introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan at NeurIPS 2024, language generation in the limit studies a theoretical question motivated by LLMs: how to generate valid new strings from observed examples. This young and rapidly evolving field offers a natural testbed for studying large-scale formalization. GenLimitLib contains formal developments for 30 papers. It extracts shared definitions and reusable proof components while preserving paper-specific assumptions and statements, and records relationships across papers. In this way, GenLimitLib provides a concrete and structured view of the literature. We show through mathematical case studies and LLM experiments how our library can support both human mathematical research and AI-assisted research. Our Library: https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib.

AI.tldr: GenLimitLib 是一个基于 Lean 4 的形式化库，针对“极限语言生成”这一新兴理论领域（由 Kleinberg 和 Mullainathan 在 NeurIPS 2024 提出），形式化了 30 篇相关论文，提取了共享定义与可复用证明组件，保留了各论文特有的假设与陈述，并记录了论文间的关联，为人类数学研究和 AI 辅助研究提供了结构化的文献视图与工具支持。
AI.motivation: 极限语言生成研究如何从观察样本中生成有效新字符串，受大语言模型（LLM）启发，是一个年轻且快速演变的理论领域。该领域缺乏统一的形式化基础设施，难以系统地比较、复用和扩展现有成果，且为大规模形式化研究提供了天然试验台。
AI.method: 构建 GenLimitLib：使用 Lean 4 形式化 30 篇论文的核心定义、定理与证明；抽取跨论文的共享定义与可复用证明组件；保留各论文特有的假设与陈述；建立论文间的关联图谱；通过数学案例研究和 LLM 实验验证库对人类与 AI 辅助研究的支持效果。
AI.result: GenLimitLib 已在 GitHub 开源，包含 30 篇论文的形式化开发，提供了结构化的文献视图。案例研究表明该库能辅助人类数学家进行定理探索与证明重构；LLM 实验显示库能提升大模型在形式化任务上的表现，验证了其作为大规模形式化测试床的价值。
AI.conclusion: GenLimitLib 为极限语言生成领域建立了首个大规模、源码对齐的形式化库，展示了形式化方法在整理新兴交叉学科文献、促进定理复用与 AI 辅助数学研究方面的潜力，为后续理论深化与自动化定理证明提供了坚实基础设施。

title: From Learner Behavior to Reusable Skills for Effective and Efficient Learner Simulation
summary: Learner simulation aims to reproduce how a particular learner behaves on new tasks. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate increasingly fine-grained learning behaviors, existing approaches often need to repeatedly process a growing interaction history to reconstruct the learner. This introduces additional context and inference costs and makes the acquired learner-specific simulation capability difficult to reuse across different LLMs. We therefore propose Learner2Skill, which externalizes the simulation capability acquired from historical interactions into a persistent and reusable Simulation Skill. The Skill captures the learner's current learning state and recurring response patterns, evolves as new real interactions arrive, and can be adapted to a new LLM through lightweight executor calibration without reconstructing the learner from scratch. Experiments show that Learner2Skill more faithfully reproduces fine-grained learner behavior while reducing overall token cost, and that the same constructed Skills can be effectively reused across different LLM executors.

AI.tldr: Learner2Skill将学习者模拟能力外部化为可持久复用的模拟技能，捕捉学习状态与响应模式，支持跨LLM迁移，显著降低token成本并提升模拟保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有学习者模拟方法需反复处理不断增长的交互历史以重构学习者，导致额外上下文和推理开销，且难以将获取的模拟能力在不同LLM间复用。
AI.method: 提出Learner2Skill框架，将历史交互中习得的模拟能力封装为持久化的Simulation Skill，该技能捕捉学习者当前学习状态与反复出现的响应模式，随新真实交互动态演进，并通过轻量级执行器校准即可适配新LLM，无需从头重构学习者模型。
AI.result: 实验表明Learner2Skill能更忠实地复现细粒度学习者行为，同时降低整体token消耗；且同一构建的Skill可在不同LLM执行器间有效复用。
AI.conclusion: Learner2Skill通过外部化模拟技能解决了跨LLM复用困难与高昂推理成本问题，实现了高保真、低成本、可迁移的学习者模拟范式。

title: Retrieval Capacity of Self-Attention Under Competition
summary: How many tokens from its context does a language model actually use, and what determines that number? We study this question through self-attention. Without retraining, we retain only the tokens with the highest attention weights at each head, layer, and query, keeping their original weights unchanged. By varying the selected set size and measuring the increase in negative log-likelihood (NLL), we estimate the effective attention set size needed to stay within a chosen loss tolerance. Relatively small selected sets can keep NLL close to the full-attention baseline, although the required size varies across models. Attention-based selection substantially outperforms random selection. Selected sets exhibit geometric structure, although geometric separation alone does not establish that model loss is preserved. Extending context while evaluating the same prediction targets increases the required set size, while its fraction of context decreases over the tested range. Experiments with a fixed supporting fact show that additional background pushes its tokens down the attention ranking and reduces their attention mass. Renormalizing the retained weights can substantially reduce the required set size, showing that it also depends on how selected representations are combined. Conditional theoretical models explain how competition and attention-mass retention can produce growing set sizes without more distinct information to retrieve. These results provide a way to measure effective attention set size in language models and investigate its dependence on context, competition, and aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自注意力机制研究语言模型实际使用多少上下文 token，提出了一种基于注意力权重的选择方法，保留每头、每层、每个查询处注意力权重最高的 token，通过改变保留集合大小并测量负对数似然（NLL）增量来估计有效注意力集合大小，发现较小的选择集即可使 NLL 接近全注意力基线，且注意力选择显著优于随机选择。进一步分析了上下文扩展、竞争机制、权重重归一化对有效集合大小的影响，并给出了条件理论模型解释竞争和注意力质量保持如何导致集合大小增长。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在推理时实际依赖多少上下文 token，以及决定该数量的因素（如上下文长度、注意力竞争、表示聚合方式等），为理解模型的有效上下文利用提供度量方法。
AI.method: 在不重新训练的情况下，保留每个注意力头、每层、每个查询位置上注意力权重最高的 token 并保持其原始权重不变；通过改变保留集合大小并测量 NLL 增加量来估计在给定损失容忍度下所需的有效注意力集合大小；对比注意力选择与随机选择；实验包括扩展上下文、固定支撑事实加背景干扰、权重重归一化等；构建条件理论模型解释竞争和注意力质量保持机制。
AI.result: 1) 较小的选中集合即可使 NLL 接近全注意力基线，但所需大小随模型而异。2) 基于注意力的选择显著优于随机选择。3) 选中集合呈现几何结构，但几何分离本身不足以保证损失保持。4) 延长上下文会增加所需集合大小，但其占上下文的比例在测试范围内下降。5) 额外背景会将固定支撑事实的 token 推低注意力排名并减少其注意力质量。6) 对保留权重重归一化可大幅减小所需集合大小，表明聚合方式也影响有效集合大小。7) 条件理论模型解释了竞争和注意力质量保持如何在无更多可检索信息时导致集合大小增长。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一种测量语言模型有效注意力集合大小的方法，并揭示了其对上下文长度、注意力竞争、表示聚合方式的依赖关系，为理解模型上下文利用机制提供了实证和理论基础。

title: Stochastic Heavy Ball with Polyak Step Size and Armijo Line Search: A General Convergence Analysis
summary: Polyak step size (PS) and Armijo line search (ALS) have received increasing attention in stochastic optimization, with encouraging empirical performance and theoretical guarantees. However, their convergence theory for stochastic heavy ball (SHB) methods remains limited. In this work, we develop a unified convergence analysis for SHB equipped with PS and ALS. To this end, we introduce a modified Armijo rule that closely parallels the Polyak step size, together with a decoupling analysis that isolates the historical dependence induced by momentum. For SHB with standard PS and ALS, we establish expected convergence for strongly convex, convex, and non-convex objectives without interpolation or restrictive conditions on the momentum parameter. Under interpolation or strong growth, we further strengthen the results to almost sure rates and last-iterate convergence. Moreover, for general settings beyond interpolation, we prove almost sure convergence to the exact optimum or to stationarity for SHB with diminishing variants of PS and ALS. These results provide a more comprehensive theoretical view of Polyak step size and Armijo line search for stochastic heavy ball methods.

AI.tldr: 本文为随机重球法配备 Polyak 步长与 Armijo 线搜索提供了统一收敛分析，给出了强凸、凸、非凸目标的期望收敛，并在插值或强增长条件下得到几乎必然速率与最后迭代收敛；在一般设置下，通过衰减步长变体实现几乎必然收敛到最优解或驻点。
AI.motivation: 现有理论尚未充分覆盖 Polyak 步长和 Armijo 线搜索在随机重球法中的收敛性，尤其是缺乏统一分析框架，且对动量参数的限制条件较强。
