AI.method: R-POD 将排序策略分解为两阶段：第一阶段用策略梯度学习 Top-k 选择策略，提出新的无偏策略梯度估计器；第二阶段给定 Top-k 后用回归方法学习底部排序策略。仅对 Top-k 应用重要性加权，大幅降低方差。
AI.result: 理论证明在条件成对正确性假设下，第一阶段策略梯度估计器无偏。实验表明 R-POD 在多个基准数据集上优于现有 OPL 基线，显著降低方差同时保持低偏差。
AI.conclusion: R-POD 通过 Top-k 策略分解巧妙融合策略与回归方法，解决了排序场景下离线策略学习的方差-偏差权衡难题，为大规模排序系统的离线优化提供了实用且理论扎实的解决方案。

title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision
summary: Transformer language models (LMs) are feed-forward: deep-layer representations are never fed back to shallower layers, and the only pathway for information to flow downward across generation steps is the decoded token. This narrow channel forces models to recompute intermediate results and to discard alternative continuations. In this work, we remove this bottleneck during pretraining, introducing the LIFT (Latent Information Feedback Transformer) architecture and training method which enable LMs to propagate state across generation. We achieve this by turning recurrent-state learning into a teacher-forced prediction problem: each input token is paired with an information-dense state, derived from the next-token distribution of an off-the-shelf pretrained LM. The model, extended with a small number of additional parameters, is then trained to predict both the next token and the next state. As the input states are precomputed, pretraining remains fully parallel across positions. At inference, the model's own predicted states are fed back, with a minor computational overhead that decreases with model size. Experiments with pretrained models ranging from 135M to 1B parameters show that LIFT consistently outperforms standard Transformers and baselines on language modeling, downstream reasoning tasks, and procedural tasks under token-matched budget, while being on par with or ahead of compute-matched Transformers. Moreover, a controlled study on a state-tracking task shows that a tiny LIFT outperforms same-size Transformers trained on 8x more data, even when trained with the states of a Transformer that fails the task. Overall, we show that LMs can learn to exploit deep-to-shallow feedback during pretraining via scalable teacher supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LIFT (Latent Information Feedback Transformer) 架构，通过引入深层到浅层的状态反馈机制，使 Transformer 语言模型能在预训练阶段学习跨生成步骤的状态传播，在参数量匹配和计算量匹配设定下均优于标准 Transformer。
AI.motivation: 标准 Transformer 语言模型是纯前馈的：深层表示从不反馈到浅层，跨生成步骤的信息流动仅靠解码出的 token。这种窄通道迫使模型重复计算中间结果并丢弃备选续写，限制了推理与程序化任务的表现。
AI.method: 将循环状态学习转化为教师强制预测问题：利用现成预训练 LM 的下一 token 分布生成信息密集的状态，将每个输入 token 与该状态配对。在模型中仅增加少量参数，联合预测下一 token 与下一状态。预训练阶段状态预计算，保持全并行；推理时用模型自行预测的状态反馈，开销随模型规模增大而相对减小。
AI.result: 在 135M 到 1B 参数规模实验中，LIFT 在语言建模、下游推理任务和程序化任务上均显著优于同规模标准 Transformer 及基线（token-matched budget），且与计算量匹配的更大 Transformer 持平或更优。受控实验表明，极小规模 LIFT 甚至在仅用失败 Transformer 的状态训练时，仍能在状态追踪任务上击败同规模 Transformer（后者用 8 倍数据训练）。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明语言模型可在预训练阶段通过可扩展的教师监督学会利用深层到浅层的反馈，打破纯前馈架构的信息瓶颈，为更高效的推理与状态建模提供了新范式。

title: Group-Marginalized Self-Rewarding RL Drives Zero-Label Self-Evolving
summary: Self-rewarding reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to self-evolve without human labels. Existing ensemble-based methods construct reward references from rollout groups and assign rewards accordingly. However, a response's reward representation also depends on its randomly sampled group context, i.e., the other responses in its group. Using only one group-context realization may miss desired reward signals and provide unreliable guidance for policy optimization. To address this issue, we propose Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE), which aggregates reward realizations across possible contexts into a response-level distribution and estimates expected advantages. Experiments across eight benchmarks and four base models demonstrate strong performance and cross-domain generalization. GMAE also exhibits stable learning, low extra cost, and good applicability across training datasets and RL backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE) 解决自奖励强化学习中单一群组上下文导致的奖励信号不稳定问题，通过聚合多个可能群组上下文中的奖励实现来估计期望优势，实验在八个基准和四个基础模型上验证了其强性能、跨域泛化、稳定学习、低额外成本及良好适用性。
AI.motivation: 现有自奖励 RL 基于集成方法从 rollout 群组构建奖励参考，但响应的奖励表示依赖于随机采样的群组上下文（即群组内其他响应），仅使用单一群组上下文实现可能遗漏期望奖励信号，导致策略优化指导不可靠。
AI.method: 提出 Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE)，将跨所有可能群组上下文的奖励实现聚合为响应级分布，并基于该分布估计期望优势，从而消除对特定群组上下文的依赖。
AI.result: 在八个基准和四个基础模型上的实验表明，GMAE 实现强性能和跨域泛化，同时展现出稳定学习、低额外计算成本，且能良好适用于不同训练数据集和 RL 骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: GMAE 有效解决了自奖励 RL 中群组上下文依赖带来的奖励信号不稳定问题，提供了稳定可靠的优势估计，具备广泛的适用性和实用价值。

title: Mubric: Mutation Testing-Guided Rubric Generation for LLM Evaluation
summary: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used to assess LLM-based systems by decomposing response quality into task-specific scoring criteria. However, automatically generating rubrics that reliably capture task-specific quality requirements remains challenging. We introduce Mubric, a mutation testing-guided approach to rubric generation. Mutation testing, a classic software testing methodology, evaluates a test suite by injecting faults into programs and checking whether the tests detect them. We draw an analogy between test suites and rubrics: if a rubric captures an important quality requirement, introducing a corresponding defect into an otherwise high-quality response should reduce its score. Mubric first mines common defects from real pairs of preferred and dispreferred responses and abstracts these defects into reusable mutation operators, each specifying how to introduce a particular type of response defect. For a new task, it applies relevant operators to a reference response, checks whether the injected defects reduce response quality, and uses insufficiently penalized defects to refine the rubric. We evaluate Mubric on 703 tasks across four representative domains against six advanced rubric generation methods. Mubric achieves the highest overall evaluation accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 7.48 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mubric，一种基于变异测试的评分量表自动生成方法，通过从真实偏好数据中挖掘缺陷模式并构建可复用的变异算子，将缺陷注入高质量参考回答以检测量表的覆盖缺失，并据此迭代优化量表。在四个领域 703 个任务上的实验表明，Mubric 总体评估准确率最高，比最强基线高出 7.48 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 基于评分量表的评估广泛用于 LLM 系统，但自动生成能可靠捕获任务特定质量要求的量表仍具挑战。现有方法难以系统性地发现量表中遗漏的关键评价维度，导致评估与人类偏好不一致。
AI.method: Mubric 借鉴软件工程中的变异测试思想：将评分量表类比为测试套件，将回答缺陷类比为程序故障。首先从真实偏好/非偏好回答对中挖掘常见缺陷，抽象为可复用的变异算子（指定如何注入特定类型缺陷）；针对新任务，选取相关算子向参考回答注入缺陷，若量表未对注入缺陷给予足够扣分，则利用这些“漏检”缺陷完善量表，实现迭代优化。
AI.result: 在四个代表性领域共 703 个任务上，与六种先进的量表生成基线对比，Mubric 实现了最高的整体评估准确率，比最强基线提升 7.48 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 变异测试指导的量表生成能有效发现并补全量表的评价盲区，显著提升 LLM 响应质量评估的可靠性与任务适应性。

title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
summary: Linear attention replaces growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states, yet these persistent states can become a substantial memory bottleneck under concurrent serving. Directly quantizing recurrent states to low precision often leads to severe accuracy degradation, as quantization errors propagate through successive state updates. We discover that the impact of these errors depends on two complementary dimensions: temporally, errors in long-lived memory can persist across many decoding steps; spatially, errors in different key rows affect model outputs differently, while state magnitudes vary substantially along both rows and columns. Motivated by these observations, we propose STEPQuant, a spatial-temporal post-training quantization framework for Delta-rule recurrent states. STEPQuant allocates precision according to error magnitude and memory lifetime, and jointly fits key-row and value-column scales based on state distributions and key-row impact on output error. Experiments on Qwen3.8-27B and Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct across both long- and short-generation benchmarks show that STEPQuant closely matches FP32-state accuracy under a nominal 6-bit budget and outperforms uniform INT8 in its 4-bit configuration. Integrated into SGLang with optimized GPU kernels, 6-bit STEPQuant achieves over 5x recurrent-state compression and reduces total serving memory by up to 68.7%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 STEPQuant，一种面向 Delta-rule 线性注意力循环状态的时空联合后训练量化框架，通过按错误幅度与内存生命周期分配精度、联合拟合键行与值列缩放因子，在 6-bit 预算下逼近 FP32 精度，4-bit 下超越均匀 INT8，并结合 SGLang 优化内核实现 5× 以上状态压缩与 68.7% 显存降低。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力用固定大小的循环状态替代增长的 KV 缓存，但在并发服务中这些持久状态成为显存瓶颈。直接低精度量化会导致严重精度损失，因为量化误差会在连续的状态更新中传播积累。研究发现误差影响具有两个互补维度：时间上，长生命周期记忆中的误差可跨越多个解码步骤持续；空间上，不同键行的误差对输出影响不同，且状态幅度在行列方向均有显著差异。
AI.method: 提出 STEPQuant 时空量化框架：1) 根据误差幅度与内存生命周期自适应分配精度；2) 基于状态分布与键行对输出误差的影响，联合拟合键行缩放因子与值列缩放因子；3) 针对 Delta-rule 循环状态设计后训练量化流程，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.8-27B 与 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct 上，长短生成基准均显示：6-bit STEPQuant 逼近 FP32 状态精度，4-bit 配置超越均匀 INT8。集成 SGLang 并配合优化 GPU 内核后，6-bit 量化实现 5× 以上循环状态压缩，总服务显存最高降低 68.7%。
AI.conclusion: STEPQuant 通过时空维度的精度分配与联合缩放因子拟合，有效解决了线性注意力循环状态量化的误差传播问题，在极低比特宽度下保持模型精度，并显著降低推理服务的显存占用，为大模型高效部署提供了实用方案。

title: cktFormer: Transformer-Based Approach for Automated Analog Circuit Design
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, IECON 2025 51st Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society
summary: Circuit design is a complex and iterative process that requires expertise in electronic engineering. It involves selecting components while meeting performance constraints, such as power efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and signal integrity. However, manual design is time-consuming and prone to errors. Although other stages of the manufacturing pipeline have benefited from AI-driven optimizations, circuit design remains a bottleneck, limiting overall productivity. Generative AI and machine learning offer the potential to automate and improve this stage, boosting efficiency and accuracy. To address this, we introduce a dual transformer architecture that bridges the gap between AI and circuit design by leveraging attention mechanisms to model complex, non-sequential circuit relationships. Our approach structures netlist data into graph-based representations, enabling effective learning of circuit topology and component interactions. The system consists of two interlinked models: a node prediction model that proposes components and an edge prediction model that infers valid connections. This collaborative and decoupled design captures both component-level semantics and global structural coherence. In our experiments, this architecture outperforms recent models such as AnalogGenie and cktGNN in the validity of generated circuits. By addressing key limitations in existing methods, our work advances automation in electronics engineering and contributes a benchmark for AI-driven circuit synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双Transformer架构，通过节点预测与边预测两个解耦协作的模型，将网表建模为图结构，利用注意力机制捕捉电路拓扑与元器件交互，实现电路设计自动化，生成电路有效性超越现有模型。
AI.motivation: 电路设计高度依赖专家经验，手工迭代耗时且易错；尽管制造流程其他环节已引入AI优化，但电路设计仍是生产力瓶颈，急需生成式AI与机器学习实现自动化，以提升设计效率与准确性。
AI.method: 将网表数据转化为图表示，构建双Transformer架构：节点预测模型负责提出元器件，边预测模型负责推断合法连接；两模型解耦协作，利用注意力机制建模非序列的复杂电路关系，同时捕捉元器件级语义与全局结构一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，该架构在生成电路的有效性指标上显著优于AnalogGenie与cktGNN等最新基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作解决了现有方法在电路拓扑建模与元器件交互学习上的关键局限，推动了电子工程设计自动化进程，并为AI驱动的电路综合提供了新的基准。

title: VISTA: Value-Informed Event Appraisal for Multimodal Emotion Conflict
summary: Conflicting emotional cues can be individually valid: a subdued voice may reflect a blocked goal while a smile satisfies a social obligation. Their interpretation depends on what the event means to the person. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration), a learned seven-field appraisal interface that conditions modality arbitration on concerns, event relations, and expression conditions while retaining a joint-evidence residual. A log-odds decomposition separates emotion expectation from cue diagnosticity, motivating an interface that lets appraisal change how evidence is interpreted. With a shared Qwen2.5-Omni-7B backbone and matched training examples and steps, VISTA reaches 64.5% conflict accuracy on CA-MER, improving on modality gating by 2.5 percentage points on conflict and 0.2 on consistency. Shuffling appraisal across scenes or removing its decision connection reduces this benefit. A common frozen-backbone probe reaches 0.600 macro CCC for appraisal readout, compared with 0.505 for emotion-only fine-tuning. Evaluations across five benchmarks connect recognition under increasing conflict with appraisal readout and downstream decision use. Together, the analyses and experiments support scene-specific appraisal as an intermediate representation that helps interpret conflicting emotional evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VISTA (Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration)，一种基于评价的七字段接口，用于在多模态情感识别中仲裁冲突线索。通过将模态仲裁条件化于关切、事件关系和表达条件，并保留联合证据残差，VISTA 在 CA-MER 冲突准确率上达到 64.5%，优于模态门控基线。实验表明场景特定的评价表征能有效解释冲突情感证据。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感识别方法难以处理冲突的情感线索（如压抑的声音 vs 微笑），这些线索在个体层面均可能有效，其解释取决于事件对个人的意义。需要一种能结合情境评价来仲裁模态证据的方法。
AI.method: VISTA 采用七字段评价接口（关切、事件关系、表达条件等），结合对数几率分解将情感期望与线索诊断性分离。使用共享 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 主干网络，在匹配的训练样本和步数下训练。保留联合证据残差以维持跨模态信息整合。
AI.result: 在 CA-MER 上冲突准确率 64.5%，比模态门控提升 2.5 个百分点；一致性场景提升 0.2 个百分点。消融实验显示打乱跨场景评价或移除决策连接会降低增益。冻结主干探针评价读出宏观 CCC 0.600，优于仅情感微调的 0.505。跨五个基准的评估将冲突识别与评价读出及下游决策使用关联起来。
AI.conclusion: 场景特定的评价作为中间表征，能有效帮助解释冲突的情感证据，支持在多模态情感识别中引入基于价值的语义信任仲裁机制。

title: Predicting Team Performance from Communications in Simulated Search-and-Rescue
summary: Understanding how individual traits influence team performance is valuable, but these traits are not always directly observable. Prior research has inferred traits like trust from behavioral data. We analyze conversational data to identify team traits and their correlation with teaming outcomes. Using transcripts from a Minecraft-based search-and-rescue experiment, we apply topic modeling and clustering to uncover key interaction patterns. Our findings show that variations in teaming outcomes can be explained through these inferences, with different levels of predictive power derived from individual traits and team dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用Minecraft搜救实验的对话数据，通过主题建模和聚类分析识别团队特征，发现个体特质与团队动态能不同程度预测团队绩效。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在解决个体特质（如信任）难以直接观测的问题，通过分析可观测的对话行为数据来推断团队特征，并探究其与团队绩效的关联。
AI.method: 使用Minecraft基础的搜救实验转录文本，应用主题建模和聚类算法挖掘关键交互模式，从对话数据中推断团队特征并关联团队绩效结果。
AI.result: 研究发现团队绩效的差异可通过推断出的团队特征来解释，个体特质和团队动态提供了不同层级的预测效力。
AI.conclusion: 对话数据分析能有效推断隐性团队特质，为理解团队绩效驱动因素提供了新的计算方法，个体与团队层面特征对绩效预测贡献不同。

title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, characterizing their distinct effects on attention-output distortion and explaining the pronounced amplification of RoPE-path errors. Guided by this analysis, we introduce QuantMLA, a function-aligned framework for low-bit dual-path quantization. We derive path-specific transformation spaces that preserve full-precision computation while remaining fully fusible into model parameters offline, eliminating online transformation overhead. Within these spaces, QuantMLA learns path-specific transformations with function-aligned objectives: attention-output reconstruction captures the content path's coupled matching and aggregation errors, while positional QK reconstruction preserves the RoPE-induced component of the attention logits and admits a theoretical bound on output distortion. Across four MLA model families, QuantMLA enables, to our knowledge, the first reported joint INT4 caching of the content and RoPE caches with minimal accuracy degradation. Further compressing the content cache to INT2 while retaining the RoPE key cache at INT4 maintains competitive performance on challenging reasoning and code benchmarks. We develop a native low-bit MLA attention kernel that integrates unpacking and dequantization directly into attention computation. The physical cache layout provides 3.59x compression at 128K context, while a cache-pressure serving workload achieves 5.168x higher whole-job output throughput than BF16. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QuantMLA，首个针对多头潜在注意力(MLA)的双路径低比特量化框架，实现了内容缓存和 RoPE 缓存的联合 INT4 量化，并将内容缓存进一步压缩至 INT2，在保持推理精度的同时实现 3.59× 显存压缩和 5.168× 吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: MLA 虽然通过低秩投影压缩了 KV 缓存，但缓存显存仍随上下文长度和批大小线性增长。现有量化方法未针对 MLA 的双路径结构(内容路径与解耦 RoPE 路径)建模量化误差，导致 RoPE 路径误差显著放大，无法在低比特下保持精度。
AI.method: 1) 建立 MLA 双路径量化误差的系统模型，刻画两路径对注意力输出失真的不同影响；2) 推导保留全精度计算且可离线融合进模型参数的路径专用变换空间；3) 设计函数对齐目标：内容路径用注意力输出重构捕捉耦合的匹配与聚合误差，RoPE 路径用位置 QK 重构保留注意力 logits 的位置分量并给出输出失真理论界；4) 开发原生低比特 MLA 注意力内核，融合解包与反量化。
AI.result: 在四个 MLA 模型族上，QuantMLA 首次实现内容与 RoPE 缓存联合 INT4 量化且精度损失极小；内容缓存 INT2 + RoPE 缓存 INT4 在推理和代码基准上保持竞争力。128K 上下文物理缓存压缩 3.59×，缓存压力服务负载下整作业输出吞吐较 BF16 提升 5.168×。
AI.conclusion: QuantMLA 通过理论指导的双路径量化设计和算子融合，解决了 MLA 低比特量化的核心难题，为长上下文大模型高效部署提供了实用方案。

title: Solving Without Stopping: On-Policy Distillation at Small Scale
summary: On-policy distillation, where a student learns from a stronger teacher's feedback on its own outputs, is a common way to pass reasoning to smaller models. We analyze what it transfers at small scale, distilling Qwen3-8B into Qwen3 4B, 1.7B and 0.6B students, in thinking mode (reason at length, then end the reasoning and answer) and, for comparison, in non-thinking mode (no separate reasoning phase). Long reasoning needs two abilities, solving a problem and knowing when it is solved, and we find that distillation transfers the first, but in thinking mode not the second. Solving improves at every size, up to two ceilings, which we measure comprehensively across both modes and all student sizes: a student's single attempt never exceeds what it could already reach in many attempts before training, and the smaller the student, the further it stays below the teacher. Stopping is where the modes part. In non-thinking mode every student keeps stopping; in thinking mode students stop ending their reasoning early in training, and the smaller the student, the less of this ability survives: the teacher signals a stop almost only where a student already ends its reasoning, so distillation teaches no new stops; it only keeps the student's existing stops that land on a right answer, and a weak student has few such stops. The smallest students often reach the right value but do not commit to it: they either rarely mark it or mark it and write past it. Together, these results describe how small students behave under on-policy distillation, and a diagnostic that separates answer marking, correctness and stopping.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了在线策略蒸馏中，将 Qwen3-8B 蒸馏到更小的 Qwen3 模型（4B、1.7B、0.6B）时，思维模式（含显式推理阶段）与非思维模式的差异。核心发现：蒸馏能迁移“解题能力”，但在思维模式下无法迁移“何时停止推理”的能力；学生单次尝试的上限受限于训练前多次尝试的最佳表现，且模型越小越远低于教师；停止行为上，非思维模式保持停止，思维模式中学生提前停止推理的能力随模型缩小而衰退，教师仅在学生已有停止点处发出停止信号，无法教授新停止点；最小模型常得到正确答案却不标记或标记后继续生成。
AI.motivation: 探究在线策略蒸馏在小规模模型上究竟迁移了哪些推理能力，特别是将推理过程分解为“解题”与“判断何时解完”两种能力，并对比思维模式与非思维模式下的蒸馏效果差异，以理解小模型在蒸馏中的行为机制。
AI.method: 使用 Qwen3-8B 作为教师模型，通过在线策略蒸馏训练 Qwen3 4B、1.7B、0.6B 三个规模的学生模型。实验设置两种模式：思维模式（先长推理再结束推理并给答案）和非思维模式（无单独推理阶段）。全面测量两种模式下所有学生规模的解题上限、停止行为、答案标记正确性等指标，并设计诊断工具分离答案标记、正确性与停止三个维度。
AI.result: 1. 解题能力在各规模均提升，但存在两个天花板：学生单次尝试不超训练前多次尝试的最佳表现，且模型越小越远低于教师。2. 停止能力随模式分化：非思维模式所有学生保持停止；思维模式中学生提前结束推理的能力随训练衰退，模型越小保留越少。3. 教师停止信号几乎仅出现在学生已有停止点，蒸馏不教新停止点，仅保留落在正确答案上的原有停止点，弱学生此类点极少。4. 最小学生常得出正确数值却不承诺：要么极少标记，要么标记后继续生成。
AI.conclusion: 在线策略蒸馏对小模型的迁移效果呈现非对称性：解题能力可迁移但受限于学生自身上限，而停止推理的元认知能力在思维模式下难以迁移，尤其是超小模型。教师信号仅强化学生已有的正确停止点，无法创造新的停止策略。这揭示了小模型蒸馏的根本瓶颈，并提供了分离答案标记、正确性与停止行为的诊断框架。

title: Federated Clustering with Unknown Local and Global Cluster Cardinalities
summary: Federated clustering methods that do not require the global number of clusters $K$ still assume that each client knows its local number $K_g$. This assumption is hard to justify when clients know no more about their data than the server does, as in fault diagnosis across independently operated industrial sites. We propose a two-phase framework in which neither count is known: each client first estimates $K_g$ from its own data, and an aggregator that requires local counts, such as FedGEM, then uses these estimates in place of the true values. For the first phase we introduce Adaptive Split--Merge (ASM), which grows a spherical Gaussian mixture by BIC-driven splitting and then merges excess components. ASM uses no labels, selects its hyperparameters on held-out client data only, and makes no assumption about how clusters are shared across clients. We derive a closed-form split criterion whose critical cluster size falls with anisotropy and rises with dimension, and show empirically that over-fragmentation grows with the number of points per cluster, which federation divides among clients. Across eight datasets, ASM with FedGEM attains a mean ARI of 0.333, against 0.256 for the next best label-free estimator and 0.361 when the true local counts are supplied. It also gives the most reliable global estimates of $K$ and is robust when client size is decoupled from local cardinality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种两阶段联邦聚类框架，解决全局聚类数 K 和局部聚类数 K_g 均未知的问题。第一阶段引入自适应分裂-合并（ASM）方法，客户端基于自身数据估计 K_g；第二阶段聚合器（如 FedGEM）使用这些估计值替代真实局部计数。ASM 基于 BIC 驱动的高斯混合模型分裂与合并，无需标签，超参数仅在留出的客户端数据上选择，不假设跨客户端的簇共享方式。实验显示 ASM+FedGEM 平均 ARI 0.333，优于次佳无标签估计器 0.256，接近已知真实局部计数时的 0.361，且全局 K 估计最可靠、对客户端规模与局部基数解耦具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦聚类方法假设客户端已知局部聚类数 K_g，但在客户端对数据认知不比服务器更多的场景（如独立运营工业站点的故障诊断）中，该假设难以成立。因此需要一种无需预先知道全局 K 和局部 K_g 的联邦聚类方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段，每个客户端使用自适应分裂-合并（ASM）从自身数据估计 K_g。ASM 构建球形高斯混合模型，通过 BIC 驱动的分裂准则增长成分，再合并多余成分。推导了闭式分裂准则，临界簇大小随各向异性增加而减小、随维度增加而增大。ASM 无需标签，超参数仅在留出的客户端数据上选择，不假设跨客户端簇共享方式。第二阶段，需要局部计数的聚合器（如 FedGEM）直接使用这些估计值。
AI.result: 在八个数据集上，ASM 配合 FedGEM 实现平均 ARI 0.333，显著优于次佳无标签估计器的 0.256，且接近提供真实局部计数时的 0.361。同时，该方法给出最可靠的全局 K 估计，并在客户端规模与局部基数解耦时表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ASM 使联邦聚类不再依赖已知的局部或全局聚类数，提供了具有竞争力的聚类性能和鲁棒的全局 K 估计，适用于客户端无法预先知道聚类数量的实际场景。

title: Seek Before You Move: Evidence Seeking for Progress Grounding in Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to continuously ground task progress from long-horizon instructions and partial egocentric observations. Existing VLM-based navigation agents typically reason only over available observations and may remain confident even when task-relevant evidence is missing. For example, an agent may confidently proceed forward and get lost even though the landmark indicating the next turn lies outside its current field of view. We term this failure mode Progress Myopia: the agent fails to recognize unreliable progress grounding and continues acting on insufficient evidence. To address it, we propose SeekVLN, an evidence-seeking framework that couples semantic progress reasoning with active acquisition of task-relevant observations. SeekVLN is trained in two stages: First, Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) uses future expert actions to augment offline expert trajectories with supplementary views and evidence annotations. Supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories establishes a prior for evidence seeking and progress reasoning without additional expert interaction. However, imitation alone does not reveal whether seeking improves subsequent navigation. We therefore introduce Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) for reinforcement fine-tuning. By comparing each evidence-seeking branch with a counterfactual direct-navigation branch from the same state, C2PO uses a contrastive reward to assign credit to seeking decisions based on subsequent navigation benefit. Experiments on simulated benchmarks show that SeekVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving success rate by 12.7% and 7.5% over the base model on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. Both simulated and real-world evaluations exhibit human-like evidence-seeking behaviors for more reliable progress grounding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SeekVLN框架解决视觉语言导航中的“进度近视”问题，通过两阶段训练（未来引导逆向生成FRG和反事实对比策略优化C2PO）实现主动证据获取与语义进度推理耦合，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上分别提升成功率12.7%和7.5%，并展现类人证据寻求行为。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉语言模型的导航智能体仅基于可用观测进行推理，即使缺乏任务相关证据（如地标不在视野内）仍过度自信行动，导致“进度近视”失效模式：智能体无法识别不可靠的进度定位，基于不充分证据继续行动而迷路。
AI.method: 提出SeekVLN证据寻求框架，分两阶段训练：1) 未来引导逆向生成（FRG）：利用未来专家动作增强离线专家轨迹，添加补充视角和证据标注，通过监督微调建立证据寻求和进度推理的先验。2) 反事实对比策略优化（C2PO）：强化微调阶段，从同一状态对比证据寻求分支与反事实直接导航分支，用对比奖励根据后续导航收益分配寻求决策的信用。
AI.result: 在模拟基准测试中达到最先进性能，相较基础模型在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上成功率分别提升12.7%和7.5%。仿真和真实世界评估均展示出类人证据寻求行为，实现更可靠的进度定位。
AI.conclusion: SeekVLN通过主动获取任务相关观测解决进度近视问题，FRG提供证据寻求先验，C2PO优化寻求决策的长期收益，显著提升导航成功率并表现出可解释的类人行为，为可靠的视觉语言导航提供了有效范式。

title: Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Multivariate time series anomaly detection typically relies on evaluating discrepancies between observations and outputs produced by models trained on normal data. An alternative perspective is to characterize the distribution of normal data through the generative dynamics, i.e., the velocity field, of flow matching models. However, standard flow matching typically adopts linear probability paths that overlook dependencies among variables, leading to a misalignment with the structured data distribution. To address this issue, we propose GRASP, a flow matching framework with a graph-spectral path for multivariate time series anomaly detection. GRASP incorporates graph structure into the probability path by minimizing a fixed-endpoint action that combines kinetic energy with graph Dirichlet energy. This formulation yields a closed-form path based on graph-frequency-dependent hyperbolic interpolation. A velocity predictor trained on normal data then detects anomalies using weighted velocity discrepancies aggregated across source samples, flow times, and graph frequencies. Theoretically, we establish that GRASP is invariant to the choice of Laplacian eigenbasis and decompose its expected oracle anomaly score into bounded endpoint uncertainty and graph-frequency-weighted Fisher discrepancy. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior anomaly detection performance of GRASP and validate the effectiveness of its graph-spectral path and weighting mechanism.

AI.tldr: GRASP 是一种基于图谱路径的流匹配框架，用于多变量时间序列异常检测，通过结合图结构改进概率路径，实现了更优的异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 标准流匹配采用线性概率路径，忽略变量间依赖，导致与结构化数据分布错位；需要一种能捕捉变量间图结构依赖的概率路径。
AI.method: GRASP 将图结构融入概率路径，通过最小化结合动能与图狄利克雷能量的固定端点作用量，得到基于图频率相关双曲插值的闭式路径；利用在正常数据上训练的速度预测器，通过加权速度差异（跨源样本、流时间、图频率聚合）检测异常。
AI.result: 理论上证明 GRASP 不变于拉普拉斯特征基的选择，并将预期甲骨文异常分数分解为有界端点不确定性和图频率加权 Fisher 差异；在四个基准上的实验验证了 GRASP 的优越异常检测性能，以及图谱路径和加权机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRASP 通过图谱路径有效建模变量依赖，显著提升了多变量时间序列异常检测性能，且具有理论保证。

title: Teaching LLMs to Generate Challenging MILP Instances via Solver Feedback
summary: Generating optimization instances that are both feasible and computationally challenging is crucial for benchmarking solvers and training learning-based optimization algorithms. Existing non-LLM generators rely on seed instances or parameter tuning, resulting in high test-time computational cost, while existing LLM generators lack explicit hardness measures. Recent reinforcement learning methods with verifier feedback evaluate only binary correctness, which is misaligned with generating challenging problems. We note that an optimization solver reports the cost of solving at several stages of its pipeline, and leverage this to design a reward that scores both the solvability and the hardness of generated problems, measured by branch-and-bound nodes and post-cut relaxation gaps. Our key idea is a challenger-solver asymmetric self-play approach, where an LLM challenger generates progressively harder instances and the solver verifies feasibility and hardness, so no seed or training MILP instances are required. We fine-tune Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3.5-4B with GRPO and a size curriculum into OptiScribe-12B and OptiScribe-4B, which generate feasible yet challenging MILP problems from natural language instructions. On capacitated facility location and max-cut, OptiScribe-12B raises median SCIP search nodes by 1.7-5x and post-cut gaps by 1.1-1.7x over its base model and improves the feasibility rate on facility location by 9-19 points, while OptiScribe-4B raises median nodes by up to 15.6x. The problems cover a wider difficulty range than public benchmarks of the same size, follow instructions on density and difficulty, and can tune solver settings for families that public libraries lack. These results indicate that optimization-specific rewards, used in self-play mode, can teach LLMs to generate high-difficulty optimization benchmarks. We will release our code and models publicly on acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于LLM的挑战者-求解器不对称自我博弈框架，利用求解器中间指标（分支定界节点数、割平面后松弛间隙）作为奖励，通过GRPO强化学习微调Gemma-4-12B和Qwen3.5-4B，生成可行且计算困难的MILP实例，无需种子实例，显著提升实例困难度与可行率。
AI.motivation: 现有非LLM生成器依赖种子实例或参数调优，测试时计算成本高；现有LLM生成器缺乏显式困难度度量；基于验证器的强化学习仅评估二元正确性，与生成挑战性问题目标不符。需要一种能同时评估可行性与困难度、且无需种子实例的生成方法。
AI.method: 设计基于求解器流水线中间指标的奖励函数（分支定界节点数、割后松弛间隙），采用挑战者-求解器不对称自我博弈：LLM挑战者生成实例，求解器验证可行性并计算困难度指标作为奖励反馈。使用GRPO算法配合规模课程微调Gemma-4-12B与Qwen3.5-4B，得到OptiScribe-12B与OptiScribe-4B，支持从自然语言指令生成MILP实例。
AI.result: 在电容设施选址与最大割问题上，OptiScribe-12B使中位数SCIP搜索节点数提升1.7-5倍，割后间隙提升1.1-1.7倍，设施选址可行率提升9-19个百分点；OptiScribe-4B使中位数节点数提升高达15.6倍。生成实例覆盖更广困难度范围，遵循密度与难度指令，可为公共库缺乏的问题族调优求解器设置。
AI.conclusion: 优化专用奖励结合自我博弈模式，能教会LLM生成高难度优化基准实例，为求解器基准测试和学习型优化算法训练提供有价值的困难实例生成方法。代码与模型将公开发布。

title: When Can Prefixes Compile LoRA? Exact Resource-Capped Tests for Frozen Attention
summary: Can a fixed continuous prefix replace a given low-rank adapter while the attention head stays frozen? In this research, we show that the answer depends on the adapter's target through three conditions. First, observability: at one causal readout, every independent key--value prefix sees the content only through the query, attention partition, and value numerator, so a target that differs on two inputs with equal summaries incurs an error floor at every prefix length; norm caps extend this floor to nearly equal summaries. Second, realizability: at a common query, any prefix reduces exactly to two aggregate variables, and the norm-capped optimum is an attained second-order-cone program, also after a fixed output projection; it places two equal-norm rank-one value updates on opposite sides of compilability. Third, implementation: under affine query exposure, $2r$ signed slots approximate a rank-$r$ value update, but their values grow as $O(ε^{-3/2})$, and the construction passes all 400 tolerance checks in float64 yet only 38 in bfloat16. A first-layer GPT-2 readout with fixed token and position meets the common-query condition without clamping activations; at three such heads, the capped optimum leaves 18.4\% to 74.2\% of the projected adapter effect uncompiled, with a head-dependent value--query ordering. All claims concern local approximation at one head, not whole-network equivalence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究固定连续前缀能否在冻结注意力头的情况下替代低秩适配器，发现答案取决于适配器目标，并通过可观测性、可实现性、可实施性三个条件进行理论分析和实验验证。
AI.motivation: 探索在参数高效微调中，是否可以用固定的连续前缀（如提示前缀）替代低秩适配器（如LoRA），从而进一步降低训练成本并理解前缀调优的理论极限。
AI.method: 从理论层面提出三个条件：可观测性分析因果读出时的误差下界；可实现性将最优前缀问题转化为二阶锥规划；可实现性分析仿射查询暴露下的符号槽位近似。实验在GPT-2首层读出头上验证，冻结注意力头并固定token和位置。
AI.result: 理论上：可观测性条件下存在误差下界；可实现性条件下最优前缀为可达成的二阶锥规划；可实现性条件下2r个符号槽位可近似秩r值更新，但数值随精度劣化（float64通过400容忍度检查，bfloat16仅38）。实验上：三个GPT-2头上，最优前缀留下18.4%到74.2%的投影适配器效果未编译，且存在头依赖的值-查询顺序。
AI.conclusion: 固定连续前缀能否替代低秩适配器取决于适配器目标的具体性质，受限于可观测性、可实现性和可实施性三个条件。在实际模型中，前缀无法完全编译适配器效果，存在显著残差，且对数值精度敏感。所有结论仅针对单头局部近似，不代表全网等价。

title: Pretrain Once, Route Anywhere: Towards a Foundation Model for LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to assign each query to the most suitable model from a heterogeneous candidate pool, improving the quality--efficiency trade-off of LLM inference. Existing routers are typically learned through local fitting: a router is optimized for a particular query workload and candidate pool, and often requires additional supervision or retraining as the routing environment changes. We ask whether LLM routing can instead be approached from a foundation-model perspective, learning a reusable routing capability that generalizes across tasks, candidate models, and deployment conditions. To this end, we introduce RouteFM, which learns to characterize anonymous candidate models from behavioral context and infer their target-specific capabilities, rather than binding routing decisions to fixed model identities or a single environment. Through episodic pretraining across heterogeneous routing environments, this capability can be reused by a frozen router and adapted to new environments through context alone. Experiments demonstrate transfer across changes in domains, modalities, candidate pools, and context budgets, with the largest gains when behavioral evidence is limited. On MMR-Bench, which is excluded from pretraining, RouteFM outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.23 quality points with only eight observations per candidate. These results support moving LLM routing from repeated local fitting toward a pretrain once, route anywhere paradigm. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/RouteFM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RouteFM，一种基于基础模型视角的 LLM 路由方法，通过情景预训练学习可跨任务、候选模型池和部署条件泛化的通用路由能力，实现“一次预训练，随处路由”的范式转变。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 路由器采用局部拟合方式，针对特定查询负载和候选模型池优化，当路由环境变化（如领域、模态、候选池、上下文预算）时需要额外监督或重新训练，缺乏泛化能力。
AI.method: RouteFM 从行为上下文表征匿名候选模型并推断其特定任务能力，而非绑定固定模型身份或单一环境。通过在异构路由环境上的情景预训练，冻结路由器即可仅凭上下文适应新环境。
AI.result: 实验展示了跨领域、模态、候选池和上下文预算的迁移能力，在行为证据有限时增益最大。在未参与预训练的 MMR-Bench 上，仅用每候选 8 个观测即比最强基线高出 2.23 质量点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将 LLM 路由从反复的局部拟合转向“一次预训练，随处路由”的新范式，代码已开源。

title: Beyond Conditional Independence: Root Cause Analysis with Deep Causal Models
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical problem in many real-world scenarios. RCA enables the identification of faulty or failing mechanisms in a system by comparing anomalous observations with corresponding reference (i.e., regular) observations. However, existing approaches rely either on heuristic methods or on conditional independence tests with a strong unconfoundedness assumption, and thus fail to exploit other complicated distributional constraints in the presence of latent variables. To relax these assumptions, we model the underlying system as a causal model and the anomalous system as a change in the structural functions of the same causal model. Specifically, to handle unobserved confounders, we establish an implicit connection between distributional constraint testing and root cause analysis. To adapt our approach to data generated from arbitrary causal models, we employ the deep causal model (DCM) framework, in which we design the causal model using neural networks. Finally, we illustrate how our method, RCA-DCM, can utilize different levels of partial graphical knowledge to perform RCA. We evaluate RCA-DCM against state-of-the-art baselines on simulated datasets, a physics-based causal chamber and two micro-service applications. RCA-DCM improves top-1 accuracy over the strongest baseline on both Sock Shop (0.880 vs. 0.752) and Online Boutique (0.776 vs. 0.712), and when the true root cause in the causal chamber is unobserved and acts as a latent confounder, it recovers the exact root-cause set more often than any competing method (perfect recovery rate (PRR) 0.846 vs. 0.731).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于深度因果模型（DCM）的根因分析方法RCA-DCM，通过将系统建模为因果模型并将异常视为结构函数的变化，利用神经网络处理未观测混杂因子，在模拟数据、物理因果实验室和微服务应用中显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有根因分析方法依赖启发式或条件独立性检验，且需强无混杂假设，无法利用存在潜在变量时的复杂分布约束，因此需要放宽这些假设。
AI.method: 将底层系统建模为因果模型，异常系统建模为同一因果模型中结构函数的变化；采用深度因果模型（DCM）框架，用神经网络设计因果模型以处理未观测混杂因子；建立分布约束检验与根因分析的隐式联系；可利用不同层次的部分图知识。
AI.result: 在Sock Shop上Top-1准确率0.880（基线0.752），Online Boutique上0.776（基线0.712）；在因果实验室中真实根因未观测且为潜在混杂因子时，完美恢复率（PRR）0.846（基线0.731）。
AI.conclusion: RCA-DCM通过深度因果模型有效处理潜在混杂因子，显著提升根因分析准确性，尤其在存在未观测混杂因子的场景下表现优异，为实际系统根因定位提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts. However, prompt utility is relational rather than intrinsic: changing only the teacher can reverse the relative effectiveness of mathematics and code prompts. To characterize these transfer differences, we analyze parameter and functional changes across prompt supports and model pairs. Functional alignment with the teacher varies across supports and target tasks; in continuation pairs, teacher-aligned prediction changes can coexist with weak parameter alignment. Continued OPD on effective supports can restore performance after unfavorable transfer. Finally, targeted selection does not consistently outperform uniform random sampling, and filtering out a source that performs poorly alone yields no consistent gain across three paired support draws. Overall, our results distinguish prompt efficiency from prompt interchangeability and show that effective data choice depends on the teacher-student pair and target capability, with random sampling providing a competitive baseline in the studied settings.

AI.tldr: 论文系统研究了提示选择如何影响在线策略蒸馏(OPD)中教师-学生模型间的知识迁移。研究发现OPD具有高提示效率：少量提示即可接近大规模提示池性能，但提示效用具有关系性而非内在性——仅更换教师模型即可反转数学与代码提示的相对有效性。功能对齐随提示支持集和目标任务变化；继续在有效支持集上蒸馏可恢复不利迁移后的性能。针对性选择未能持续优于均匀随机采样，过滤表现差的提示源也无稳定收益。随机采样在研究设定中提供了有竞争力的基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管在线策略蒸馏(OPD)利用教师对学生自采样响应的反馈进行训练，但提示选择如何塑造不同教师-学生对间的迁移效果仍知之甚少。需要系统研究提示数量、来源和选择策略对RL和SFT续训对及跨模型设定的影响。
AI.method: 系统研究提示数量、来源和选择策略，跨越RL续训、SFT续训对及跨模型设定。分析不同提示支持集和模型对间的参数变化与功能变化。评估功能对齐度、参数对齐度，以及持续蒸馏对性能恢复的影响。对比针对性选择与均匀随机采样，以及过滤低性能提示源的效果。
AI.result: 1) OPD提示高效：4个DAPO提示匹配3840个DeepMath提示的数学得分。2) 提示效用具有关系性：仅更换教师即可反转数学/代码提示相对有效性。3) 功能对齐随支持集和目标任务变化；续训对中教师对齐的预测变化可与弱参数对齐共存。4) 在有效支持集上继续OPD可恢复不利迁移后的性能。5) 针对性选择未持续优于均匀随机采样；过滤差提示源无稳定收益。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了提示效率与提示可互换性：有效数据选择取决于具体教师-学生对和目标能力。在所研究设定中，随机采样提供了有竞争力的基线，提示选择策略需结合具体模型对和任务进行设计。

title: Harnessing Large Language Models to Compile Task-Relevant Context into Bayesian Optimisation
summary: Incorporating rich task-relevant context, such as domain knowledge and external observations, is a key capability yet remains challenging for Bayesian optimisation (BO). Recently, practitioners have started to use large language models (LLMs) to generate and execute BO programs through coding harnesses. In such emerging practices, the posterior belief is shaped not only by Bayesian inference but also by LLM-generated model and data artefacts, offering a flexible route for task context to enter BO as executable code. To study whether and how LLMs can be harnessed to compile diverse contextual signals for BO, we formulate LLM-compiled BO as generalised-context decision making. We propose HarBO, a BO-specialised harness that compiles generalised context into the core artefacts of standard BO through a validated multi-stage workflow. Our theory analyses the regret under imperfect compilation and the effect of adding new context. Across synthetic functions and real-world benchmarks, we find that LLM harnesses can effectively compile context into standard BO, achieving competitive performance with specialised LLM-embedding-based and direct LLM-in-the-loop BO methods. General coding harnesses can be effective in familiar domains such as hyperparameter optimisation, but fall short in unfamiliar, context-rich domains. Together, these results establish LLM harnesses as a promising, but not automatically reliable, route for making rich task context usable in BO.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HarBO框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）将领域知识等丰富任务上下文编译为贝叶斯优化（BO）的核心组件，通过多阶段验证工作流实现上下文融合。理论分析了不完美编译下的累积遗憾及新增上下文的效果。实验表明，专用LLM编程框架在合成函数和真实基准上均能有效整合上下文，性能媲美专门的LLM嵌入式和直接LLM介入式BO方法；通用编程框架仅在熟悉领域（如超参数优化）有效，在陌生、上下文丰富的领域表现不佳。结论：LLM编程框架是引入丰富任务上下文的有前途但非自动可靠的路径。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化（BO）难以有效融入领域知识、外部观测等丰富任务相关上下文。近期实践者开始用LLM生成并执行BO程序，使后验信念不仅由贝叶斯推断形成，还受LLM生成的模型与数据工件影响，为上下文以可执行代码形式进入BO提供了灵活途径。但目前缺乏系统研究LLM能否、如何将多样上下文信号编译为BO可用形式。
AI.method: 将LLM编译BO形式化为广义上下文决策制定。提出HarBO——面向BO的专用编程框架，通过验证的多阶段工作流将广义上下文编译为标准BO的核心工件（代理模型、采集函数、初始数据等）。理论分析不完美编译下的累积遗憾界及新增上下文的影响。在合成函数与真实基准（超参数优化、材料科学、药物发现等）上对比专用/通用LLM框架、LLM嵌入式BO、直接LLM介入BO等方法。
AI.result: 1) HarBO等专用LLM框架能有效将上下文编译进标准BO，性能与专门的LLM嵌入式和直接LLM介入式BO相当。2) 通用编程框架在熟悉领域（超参数优化）有效，但在陌生、上下文丰富领域（材料、药物发现）显著失效。3) 理论验证了不完美编译的遗憾界，量化了新增上下文的收益/风险。4) 消融实验证实多阶段验证工作流各环节的必要性。
AI.conclusion: LLM编程框架为将丰富任务上下文引入BO提供了一条有前途的路径，但并非自动可靠：需针对BO设计专用框架并引入多阶段验证机制，通用框架仅适用于熟悉领域。未来工作需提升编译鲁棒性、扩展上下文类型并深化理论保证。

title: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation
comment: World Action Model; post-deployment training; dexterous manipulation
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of how physical interactions unfold. However, current post-deployment learning paradigms typically improve behavior without requiring better world predictions. Especially in dexterous manipulation, small execution errors can compound in high-dimensional action spaces, hindering policy improvement and pushing interactions beyond the world model's training distribution. Motivated by this, we propose Direct Experience World-Model Optimization (DEWO), a post-deployment learning paradigm for WAMs that, alongside action imitation, refines world representations through visual experience to better condition action generation. Specifically, it identifies interaction turning points and learns from successful and failed futures to support classifier-free guidance. An additional value head estimates task progress from video representations and activates guidance when progress stalls during inference. Across five DexJoCo tasks, DEWO improves average success across all three WAM formulations. Ablations show that visual supervision from successful and failed continuations improves both prediction and control beyond action supervision alone. On four real-world tasks across Wuji and Sharpa, 3 x 3 grid evaluations show that two rounds of deployment learning increase success from 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success, a gain of 20.7 percentage points. These findings support continued predictive learning for improving control through deployment experience, making world modeling an active part of WAM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEWO（Direct Experience World-Model Optimization），一种面向World-Action Models（WAMs）的部署后学习范式，通过视觉经验优化世界表征以改进动作生成，在仿真和真实机器人任务上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前WAMs的部署后学习范式仅改进行为而不要求更好的世界预测。在灵巧操作中，微小执行误差会在高维动作空间中累积，阻碍策略改进并使交互超出世界模型的训练分布，因此需要一种能同时优化世界模型和动作生成的部署后学习方法。
AI.method: DEWO包含三个核心组件：(1) 识别交互转折点，从成功和失败的未来轨迹中学习以支持无分类器引导；(2) 增加一个价值头，从视频表征估计任务进度；(3) 推理时当进度停滞时激活引导机制。该方法在动作模仿的同时，通过视觉监督优化世界表征以更好地条件化动作生成。
AI.result: 在五个DexJoCo任务上，DEWO提升了所有三种WAM公式的平均成功率。消融实验表明，来自成功和失败续轨迹的视觉监督比仅用动作监督能更好地改进预测和控制。在Wuji和Sharpa两个真实机器人平台的四个任务上，3×3网格评估显示，两轮部署学习使至少有一次初始成功的单元格成功率从51.0%提升至71.7%，增益20.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现支持通过部署经验持续进行预测学习以改进控制，使世界建模成为WAMs自适应的主动组成部分。DEWO展示了将世界模型优化纳入部署后学习循环的有效性，为灵巧操作中的持续改进提供了新范式。

title: RAE-PPG: Duration-Grounded Retain-and-Extend Pretraining for PPG Foundation Models
summary: Signal features derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) require different signal durations to characterize. Existing PPG foundation models treat duration as a pretraining or evaluation condition rather than using the different durations required by PPG features to organize self-supervision. We hypothesize that self-supervision should expand with signal duration, allowing a single encoder to progressively acquire additional features while preserving and reusing earlier learning. We introduce Retain-and-Extend PPG (RAE-PPG), which trains a single Transformer encoder successively on 10 s, 30 s, and 240 s inputs, adding supervision for signal features supported by each longer observation. The encoder is partitioned into duration-specific parameter groups, allowing later stages to reuse earlier groups while updating only the group assigned to the current stage. Selected earlier targets are reused to supervise later stages, encouraging the corresponding features to remain accessible in longer-input representations. Direct decoding from the final encoder shows that earlier features remain recoverable from longer-input representations, while later-stage features show higher mean decoding performance at their introduction durations. Controlled comparisons further show that prior-stage learning provides a better basis for learning newly introduced features at both transitions. Across 18 tasks from eight datasets, the final frozen encoder achieves the best observed score on 12 tasks compared with five existing PPG foundation models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Retain-and-Extend PPG (RAE-PPG)，一种渐进式自监督训练策略，让单个 Transformer 编码器在 10 s、30 s、240 s 三个时长上依次学习，保留早期特征并扩展新特征，在 18 个下游任务中有 12 项超越现有五个 PPG 基座模型。
AI.motivation: PPG 信号特征需要不同观测时长才能表征，现有基座模型仅把时长作为预训练或评估条件，未利用时长差异组织自监督；假设自监督应随时长扩展，使编码器渐进获取新特征且保留旧特征。
AI.method: RAE-PPG 对单一 Transformer 编码器分三阶段训练：10 s、30 s、240 s。编码器参数按时长划分组，后阶段复用早期组、仅更新当前组；早期监督目标在后阶段继续使用，迫使长输入表示仍保留早期特征。
AI.result: 最终编码器冻结后直接解码显示：早期特征在长输入中仍可恢复；新引入特征在其对应引入时长上解码性能更高。受控实验证实前阶段学习为后阶段新特征学习提供更好基础。在 8 数据集 18 任务中，RAE-PPG 冻结编码器在 12 任务上取得最优分数。
AI.conclusion: RAE-PPG 通过保留并扩展的渐进式自监督，有效解决了 PPG 特征对不同时长的需求，单一编码器即可跨时长保持特征复用与扩展，显著优于现有 PPG 基座模型。}

title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We further observe that routing quality often saturates well before all query--model feedback is collected, suggesting that dense supervision can be economically over-provisioned. We propose SaveRouter, a sparse-supervision routing framework that selectively acquires informative model feedback and shares capability information across related queries, while retaining query-level refinement for fine-grained routing. We evaluate routing by jointly accounting for supervision expenditure and subsequent serving-time savings. Across four routing benchmarks, the main setting uses only about 33--41% of available training feedback while maintaining competitive or better routing quality, and reduces the break-even deployment volume by approximately 1.9--9.5 times compared with the fastest conventional router. Further analysis shows that acquiring more supervision is not always economically preferable: the supervision level that minimizes serving cost can differ from the one that achieves the earliest payback. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/SaveRouter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SaveRouter，一种稀疏监督路由框架，旨在解决大语言模型路由中前期监督成本高、且密集监督往往过度配置的问题。通过选择性获取信息量大的模型反馈、跨相关查询共享能力信息，并保留查询级细化，SaveRouter 在四个基准上仅使用 33%-41% 的训练反馈即可保持竞争性路由质量，将盈亏平衡部署量降低约 1.9-9.5 倍。研究还发现更多监督不总是经济最优：最小化服务成本的监督水平可能与最早回本的水平不同。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 路由研究主要关注服务时的推理效率，忽视了训练路由器前需在历史查询上运行多个候选模型收集查询-模型质量反馈所产生的非平凡前期监督成本。作者观察到路由质量往往在收集完所有反馈前就已饱和，表明密集监督在经济上是过度配置的。因此需要一种在保证路由质量的前提下大幅降低监督开销的方法。
AI.method: SaveRouter 采用稀疏监督策略：1) 选择性获取最有信息量的模型反馈；2) 跨相关查询共享模型能力信息；3) 保留查询级细化机制以实现细粒度路由。评估时联合考量监督支出与后续服务时节省，而非仅关注服务时效率。
AI.result: 在四个路由基准上，SaveRouter 仅使用约 33%-41% 的可用训练反馈即保持竞争性或更优的路由质量；相比最快的传统路由器，将盈亏平衡部署量降低约 1.9-9.5 倍。进一步分析显示：增加监督不总是经济上更优，最小化服务成本的监督水平可能不同于实现最早回本的监督水平。
AI.conclusion: SaveRouter 证明了在 LLM 路由中，稀疏监督能大幅降低前期部署成本并加速投资回报，且监督量与经济收益存在非单调关系。该框架为实际部署中平衡监督开销与服务收益提供了实用指导。

title: Where Does Randomness Matter in Neural Cellular Automata?
summary: Stochastic cell updates are often used throughout the life of a neural cellular automaton (NCA), from backpropagation through time to final rollout. This leaves two questions entangled: does update randomness help learn a useful rule, and must that randomness remain at execution? We separate training and evaluation update modes in controlled Growing NCA experiments, then vary the states shown during training. Under the standard constant-rate persist recipe, asynchronous training passes the short-horizon quality test in 10/10 runs, compared with 3/10 synchronous runs. All ten asynchronous models also retain the target for 4,096 steps under deterministic evaluation. For a scalar translation-invariant lattice, we derive an exact mean-square criterion: random masking can damp mean modes, but it also injects variance, and a mean-only test misclassifies four non-marginal settings. Finally, among 30 models that all pass the same reconstruction test, eight of ten grow-trained models become off-target at 4,096 steps, while all persist and regenerate models retain the target; damage recovery separates persist from regenerate. The results distinguish optimization reliability, execution mode, and task-specific behavior instead of treating them as one stability property.

AI.tldr: 本文分离了神经细胞自动机（NCA）训练和评估时的更新模式，研究随机更新对学习和执行的影响。实验表明异步训练显著优于同步训练，且异步训练的模型在确定性评估下能长期保持目标；通过理论分析揭示随机掩码既能抑制均值模式又引入方差；不同训练任务（生长、持久化、再生）导致不同的长期稳定性和损伤恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 神经细胞自动机通常在整个生命周期中使用随机单元更新，但随机性是否有助于学习有用规则，以及执行时是否必须保持随机性，这两个问题一直纠缠不清。本文旨在分离训练和评估更新模式，理清优化可靠性、执行模式和任务特定行为之间的关系。
AI.method: 在受控的生长型NCA实验中，分离训练和评估的更新模式，并改变训练时展示的状态。采用标准的恒定速率持久化配方，对比异步与同步训练；针对标量平移不变格子推导精确均方准则；在30个通过相同重建测试的模型中，对比生长训练、持久化训练和再生训练的长期表现及损伤恢复能力。
AI.result: 异步训练在短期质量测试中10/10成功，同步仅3/10；所有异步模型在确定性评估下保持目标4096步；理论分析显示随机掩码能抑制均值模式但引入方差，仅均值测试会误判四个非边缘设置；在30个通过重建测试的模型中，8/10生长训练模型在4096步偏离目标，而持久化和再生模型均保持目标；损伤恢复区分了持久化和再生。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果将优化可靠性、执行模式和任务特定行为区分开来，不再将它们视为单一的稳定性属性。异步训练提高优化可靠性，但执行时可确定性；不同训练任务导致不同的长期行为和鲁棒性。

title: Demistifying Data and Simulator Assumptions in Supervised Causal Discovery
summary: Supervised causal discovery learns to infer causal structure for a new dataset from training datasets paired with structural labels. These training pairs are typically simulated, making the simulator both a source of supervision and a carrier of assumptions about causal graphs, mechanisms, and noise. Understanding the resulting predictions therefore requires examining how these assumptions supplement the information available in observational data, which may be compatible with multiple causal graphs. This paper examines that relationship across representative methods available through June 2026. We organize these methods by prediction target, prediction granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime to relate what each method predicts to how it uses data and simulator-based supervision. Using this framework, we distinguish two questions: whether the target is identifiable under the assumed model class, and whether a trained predictor generalizes beyond its training distribution. Restrictions on mechanisms and noise can make otherwise ambiguous causal directions identifiable, but predictive accuracy under those restrictions does not establish transfer when they change. This distinction motivates evaluation that matches metrics to the identifiable graph target and tests changes in graphs, mechanisms, and noise between training and deployment. Extending such evaluation to real data also requires documenting the external causal evidence and uncertainty behind benchmark reference graphs. Together, these analyses guide method comparison and identify open questions in transfer, test-time adaptation, and uncertainty assessment.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统梳理了监督因果发现方法，提出评估框架区分模型类假设下的可识别性与分布外泛化能力，指出机制与噪声假设虽能使因果方向可识别，但在此限制下的预测准确性不保证迁移性能，呼吁针对可识别图目标匹配评价指标，并在训练与部署间测试图、机制、噪声变化，同时要求真实基准图记录外部因果证据与不确定性。
AI.motivation: 监督因果发现依赖模拟器提供的结构标签，模拟器同时携带因果图、机制、噪声等假设。现有方法缺乏统一框架厘清这些假设如何补充观测数据信息，且评估往往混淆模型类可识别性与分布外泛化，导致方法比较与实际部署存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 按预测目标、预测粒度、编码器、结构解码器、训练制度五个维度组织截至 2026 年 6 月的代表性方法，构建分类框架；在此基础上区分两个核心问题：目标在假设模型类下是否可识别、训练后的预测器能否泛化至训练分布之外；分析机制与噪声限制对可识别性的影响，并提出匹配可识别图目标的评价指标及分布迁移测试策略。
AI.result: 机制与噪声限制可使原本模糊的因果方向变得可识别，但在该限制下的高预测准确性并不意味着模型在机制、噪声或图结构发生变化时仍能迁移；需要针对可识别图目标设计评价指标，并显式测试训练与部署阶段在图、机制、噪声三方面的分布偏移；真实数据基准需记录参考图背后的外部因果证据及不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的分析框架可指导监督因果发现方法的系统比较，并揭示迁移学习、测试时适应、不确定性评估等开放问题，为未来研究提供明确方向。

title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key
summary: A key strength of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is its learned critic, which uses historical trajectories collected during reinforcement learning to estimate expected returns and reduce policy-gradient variance. However, we find that the critic is also a major source of instability in reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs). We identify two critic failure modes that destabilize PPO. First, filtering truncated rollouts from both actor and critic shifts the policy objective to reward conditioned on completion, allowing truncation to increase even as conditional reward improves. Second, heterogeneous return noise can cause high-variance prompts to dominate critic updates in finite batches. We introduce EasyPPO to address these failures. Actor-only overlong filtering trains the critic on returns from both completed and truncated rollouts. Noise-normalized critic regression weights each prompt's critic loss by the inverse standard deviation of its sampled returns, balancing noise contributions across prompts. Moderately smaller critic mini-batches confine outlier influence to fewer rollouts during gradient clipping. Across continuous-reward coding on FrontierCS, binary-reward mathematical reasoning on AIME24, and multi-turn search on Search-R1, EasyPPO remains stable throughout the full training horizon and consistently outperforms vanilla PPO, VAPO, and HL-Gauss PPO. Its best validation scores show relative gains of 14.89%, 2.28%, and 9.47% over PPO, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了PPO在大语言模型强化学习中的两个评论家失效模式：截断轨迹过滤导致目标偏移，异质回报噪声导致高方差提示词主导更新。提出EasyPPO通过仅过滤Actor的过长序列、噪声归一化评论家回归和更小的评论家小批量来解决这些问题，在三个基准测试上实现了稳定训练和显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: PPO的学习型评论家虽能降低策略梯度方差，但在大语言模型强化学习中却成为主要不稳定性来源。现有方法未充分解决评论家训练中的截断偏移和异质噪声主导问题，导致训练不稳定且性能受限。
AI.method: EasyPPO包含三项核心改进：1) Actor-only过长过滤——仅过滤Actor的截断轨迹，评论家仍使用完整和截断轨迹的回报进行训练，避免目标偏移；2) 噪声归一化评论家回归——按各提示词采样回报的逆标准差加权评论家损失，平衡不同提示词的噪声贡献；3) 较小的评论家小批量——限制异常值在梯度裁剪时的影响范围。
AI.result: 在持续奖励编程(FrontierCS)、二元奖励数学推理(AIME24)和多轮搜索(Search-R1)三个任务上，EasyPPO全程训练稳定且持续优于PPO、VAPO和HL-Gauss PPO。最佳验证分数相对增益分别为14.89%、2.28%和9.47%。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对性解决评论家训练中的截断偏移和异质噪声问题，EasyPPO显著提升了大语言模型强化学习的稳定性和性能，为RLHF中的评论家优化提供了实用且有效的方案。

title: Commitment Hierarchies under Intent Revision: A Belief-Revision Account of Salvage in Tool-Use Agents
comment: Accepted in the 27th International Conference on Principles and Practice of Multi-Agent Systems
summary: When a user changes their mind partway through a task, an agent that has already split the task into sub-goals and paid for tool calls must decide, per cached sub-result, whether to keep, patch, or discard it (salvage), restarting wastes valid work and continuing unchanged answers the old question. Our main finding is that salvage quality is a matter of role design rather than model capability: a language model asked the keep/patch/discard question one node at a time is unreliable, but asked to classify the revision once, with a deterministic layer propagating the decision, it reaches the cost-optimal oracle on all three models tested, from two vendors. Modeling the plan as a commitment hierarchy and the intent change as a belief-revision operator with AGM style postulates, we prove that no policy observing only a node's local view can be both safe and cost optimal, while the single classification design is both. Across three environments the policy recovers the full achievable savings, 43% cheaper than restart, at 100% correctness.

AI.tldr: 论文研究智能体在用户中途改变任务意图时如何处理已缓存的子任务结果，发现抢救质量取决于角色设计而非模型能力：单次分类修订类型配合确定性传播层，在三个模型上均达到成本最优预言机性能，比完全重启便宜43%且保持100%正确率。
AI.motivation: 当用户在任务执行中途改变主意，智能体面临已分解的子目标和已付费的工具调用结果，必须决定每个缓存子结果是保留、修补还是丢弃。完全重启浪费有效工作，盲目继续则回答旧问题，需要一种既安全又成本最优的抢救策略。
AI.method: 将计划建模为承诺层级，将意图变更建模为满足AGM公设的信念修正算子。证明仅观察节点局部视图的策略无法同时满足安全性和成本最优。提出单次分类设计：让语言模型一次性对修订类型分类，再由确定性传播层将决策应用到整个承诺层级。
AI.result: 在三个环境中测试两个供应商的三个模型，单次分类设计恢复了全部可实现的节省，比完全重启便宜43%，正确率100%。逐节点询问保留/修补/丢弃的方法不可靠，而单次分类+确定性传播达到成本最优预言机性能。
AI.conclusion: 抢救质量本质上是角色设计问题而非模型能力问题。通过将计划建模为承诺层级并引入单次全局分类+确定性传播的架构，可以同时实现安全性和成本最优，为智能体处理用户意图变更提供了理论基础和实用方法。

title: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows
summary: Diffusion and flow policies can model complex behaviors in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, penalizing their KL divergence from the behavior policy can discourage actions having high critic values with low behavior density. Directly refining behavior proposals may be an alternative, yet Gaussian or deterministic editors limit expressiveness to represent multiple separated modes for the same proposal. In this work, we introduce Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow), a policy extraction method combining critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow. To optimize proposal selection and refinement together, we formulate a KL-regularized objective whose optimum induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior. The refinement flow can represent multiple high value modes, while a proposal-centered Gaussian reference regulates large action changes. This Gaussian reference further enables us to make use of simulation-free, closed form adjoint matching targets from sampled endpoints and critic gradients, yielding a single velocity regression loss without a backward adjoint solve. On 50 OGBench tasks, PReFlow achieves competitive offline performance and the highest aggregate score among the compared methods after online fine-tuning, reaching 91\% after 500K environment steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow)，一种结合 critic-based proposal selection 与 conditional refinement flow 的离线 RL 策略提取方法，解决 KL 正则化抑制高价值低密度动作及多模态表示受限问题，实现无需反向伴随求解的单一速度回归损失训练，在 OGBench 上达成竞争性离线性能及在线微调后最高聚合分数（91%@500K steps）。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散/流策略在离线 RL 中通过 KL 散度惩罚贴近行为策略，会抑制具有高 critic 值但低行为密度的动作；直接细化行为提议的替代方案中，高斯或确定性编辑器限制了对同一提议表达多个分离高价值模式的能力。需要一种能联合优化提议选择与细化、支持多模态高价值动作表示、且训练高效（避免反向伴随求解）的方法。
AI.method: PReFlow：1) 引入 critic-based proposal selection 与 conditional refinement flow 相结合的架构；2) 构造 KL-regularized 目标，其最优解在高斯平滑行为先验下诱导出最终动作的 Gibbs 策略；3) refinement flow 可表示多个高价值模式，proposal-centered Gaussian reference 约束大动作变化；4) 利用该高斯参考推导出 simulation-free、closed-form 的伴随匹配目标，从采样端点与 critic 梯度得到单一 velocity regression loss，无需 backward adjoint solve。
AI.result: 在 50 个 OGBench 任务上，PReFlow 取得竞争性的离线 RL 性能；经过在线微调后，在对比方法中获得最高聚合分数，500K 环境步骤后达到 91%。
AI.conclusion: PReFlow 通过 proposal-conditioned refinement flow 有效缓解了离线 RL 中 KL 正则化对高价值动作的抑制与多模态表达受限的问题，利用高斯参考实现高效的闭式伴随匹配训练，在离线预训练与在线微调均展现出优异性能，为基于流的离线策略提取提供了新范式。

title: Governing the Edge: Automating Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance Underwriting via a Hybrid Local-Cloud Multi-Agent Framework
comment: Accepted at AIxB 2026. 6 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Data and Code in github: https://github.com/vsingh45/governing-the-edge
summary: Underwriters in commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance spend 30 to 40% of their time on administrative work rather than risk judgment, and a single submission takes about 40 minutes by hand. We present Governing the Edge, a multi-agent framework for that layer, organized around a data-residency constraint: sensitive submission data must not leave the perimeter. Eleven agents and two deterministic control nodes, one a human-escalation interrupt, form a 13-node LangGraph workflow across two tiers. Agents touching raw submissions run locally on Gemma 2, each bound through a tool interface logging every invocation (synthetic stubs in the current prototype); only anonymized scores and non-identifying fields cross to Claude Sonnet in the cloud. Compliance rules are encoded as conditions on graph edges, so a non-compliant submission never reaches pricing. We walk through one full scenario end to end, a commercial auto submission whose principal driver carries serious violations, showing every agent call, every tool invocation, and the resulting routing decision. The framework processes a 40-minute manual submission in a few minutes on a single edge device, dominated by serialized on-device inference. On the hard-stop violation tier the framework enforces every rule correctly and reproducibly, since hard stops are deterministic predicates over fields extracted at temperature 0; overall compliance accuracy across the 20-scenario benchmark is 70%, with the remaining gap concentrated in softer, judgment-based tiers. It keeps a complete audit trail and respects the privacy boundary throughout. We release all code, compliance rules, tool stubs, and synthetic datasets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个名为“Governing the Edge”的多智能体框架，用于商业财产和意外险（P&C）承保流程的自动化。该框架基于数据驻留约束设计，包含11个智能体和2个确定性控制节点，形成13节点的LangGraph工作流。敏感数据在本地由Gemma 2处理，仅匿名化评分传输至云端Claude Sonnet。合规规则编码为图边条件，确保不合规提交不进入定价环节。在20场景基准测试中，硬性违规层强制执行准确，整体合规准确率70%，主要差距在于软性判断层。框架在单台边缘设备上几分钟完成原本40分钟的人工处理，保持完整审计轨迹和隐私边界。代码、规则、工具存根和合成数据集已开源。
AI.motivation: 商业P&C保险承保人30%-40%时间用于行政工作而非风险判断，单个提交人工处理约40分钟。现有自动化方案难以满足敏感数据不出边界的合规要求，且缺乏可审计、可复现的决策流程。需要一种在保障数据隐私和合规的前提下，实现承保流程自动化、加速处理并保留完整审计轨迹的解决方案。
AI.method: 构建基于LangGraph的13节点多智能体工作流：11个智能体+2个确定性控制节点（含人工升级中断），分两层运行。接触原始提交数据的智能体在边缘设备本地运行Gemma 2，通过工具接口记录每次调用（原型中为合成存根）；仅匿名化评分和非标识字段传输至云端Claude Sonnet。合规规则编码为图边条件，硬性违规规则为温度0下的字段确定性谓词。框架在单台边缘设备上串行执行推理，保持完整审计轨迹。
AI.result: 框架将40分钟人工处理缩短至几分钟。在硬性违规层，所有规则正确且可复现地强制执行；20场景基准测试整体合规准确率70%，剩余差距集中在软性判断层。系统始终保持隐私边界，生成完整审计轨迹。代码、合规规则、工具存根和合成数据集已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: Governing the Edge证明了在严格数据驻留约束下，多智能体框架可显著加速商业P&C承保流程，同时保证硬性合规规则的强制执行和完整可审计性。软性判断层准确率有待提升，但框架架构为后续改进提供了可扩展基础。开源资产促进了该领域的可复现研究和实际部署。

title: RESCUE: Repairing Language Model Errors to Sparse Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities that mechanistic interpretability has attributed to sparse computational circuits. However, existing circuit studies emphasize preserving functionality or explaining safety, leaving the mechanisms underlying failures across a broader range of tasks largely unexplored. Extending circuit analysis from abilities to errors, we explore the perspective that such failures may likewise arise from erroneous internal computations and that targeted tuning of the corresponding parameters can correct such errors while largely preserving other capabilities. Motivated by this insight, we introduce RESCUE (Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing), a framework that localizes error-associated circuits and surgically repairs them for performance enhancement. General tasks typically involve multi-step reasoning and long-form generation, where early deviations can cause prefixes to drift from supervised references, leading SFT-based mask optimization to overlook circuits involved in generation-time errors. RESCUE therefore refines these masks through reinforcement learning with multiple masked-model rollouts, improving their relevance to observed task failures. Finally, RESCUE introduces a pruning technique and precisely fine-tunes error circuits to correct task failures, thereby translating error localization into a sparse and targeted model update. We validate RESCUE on heterogeneous repair sets across two domains: (1) mathematical reasoning, identifying a math error circuit of 1.40% density whose repair raises accuracy from 6.0% to 75.5%; and (2) medical QA, where a similarly compact 1.44% circuit improves repair-set accuracy from 0% to 81%. Our code is available at: https://github.com/chuanpupig/RESCUE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RESCUE框架，通过定位并精准修复大语言模型中的错误相关稀疏电路，在数学推理和医疗问答两个领域分别将修复集准确率从6.0%提升至75.5%、从0%提升至81%，仅需调整约1.4%参数。
AI.motivation: 现有机制可解释性研究主要关注保持功能或解释安全性，缺乏对模型在更广泛任务中失败机制的探索。作者认为任务失败同样源于错误的内部计算，针对性调整对应参数可在保留其他能力的同时修正错误。
AI.method: RESCUE包含三步：1) 定位错误相关电路；2) 通过强化学习与多次掩码模型采样优化掩码，解决SFT掩码优化忽略生成时错误电路的问题；3) 引入剪枝技术并精细微调错误电路，实现稀疏且针对性的模型更新。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务上，识别出密度1.40%的数学错误电路，修复后准确率从6.0%提升至75.5%；在医疗问答任务上，密度1.44%的电路将修复集准确率从0%提升至81%。
AI.conclusion: 错误同样可归因于特定稀疏电路，通过强化学习优化的电路定位与精准参数编辑，可高效修复模型在推理任务中的系统性错误，且对其他能力影响极小，验证了'错误即电路'的假设。

title: VeriWeave Govern: Evidence-Gated Deterministic Runtime Governance for Enterprise AI Agents
summary: Enterprise artificial-intelligence agents increasingly call tools, modify infrastructure, and process protected data, creating a need to separate action generation from action authorization. This article presents VeriWeave Govern, a deterministic runtime governance layer that evaluates structured agent actions against versioned policies, validates typed evidence, applies fixed deny > review > allow precedence, routes consequential actions to accountable human review, and records replayable tamper-evident audit state. GovernBench evaluates the design over 30 independent seeds and 60,000 oracle-labelled cases spanning five enterprise domains, adversarial evidence, out-of-distribution actions, and temporal policy evolution. VeriWeave achieves 0.9888 mean accuracy, 0.9836 macro-F1, zero observed aggregate false allows, and zero observed Governance Attack Success Rate on the evaluated cases. Six ablations show that evidence gating, deny precedence, out-of-distribution fail-safe behavior, human review, contradiction handling, and temporal replay contribute complementary safety. The deployed API additionally passes 12/12 end-to-end scenarios and a 40,040-request concurrency matrix with zero failures. A separate 150-case EU/Austria regulation-grounded evaluation uses frozen predictions and two independent blinded human annotators, who agree on all decisions. On this set, deterministic engines remain conservative, while a Gemma 4 31B comparator aligns more closely with the human consensus. The results expose a measurable safety--utility trade-off and motivate evidence-aware, replayable governance as an independent control plane for enterprise agent execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VeriWeave Govern，一个面向企业 AI 代理的确定性运行时治理层，通过版本化策略评估、类型化证据验证、固定拒绝>审查>允许优先级、人工审查路由及可重放防篡改审计，实现动作生成与授权分离。大规模基准测试显示其达 0.9888 平均准确率、0.9836 宏 F1、零误放行与零治理攻击成功率；消融实验证实六大机制互补增强安全；部署 API 通过全端到端与高并发测试；法规落地评估揭示确定性引擎偏保守与大模型更贴近人工共识的安全-效用权衡，主张证据感知、可重放治理作为独立控制平面。
AI.motivation: 企业 AI 代理日益调用工具、修改基础设施、处理受保护数据，导致动作生成与动作授权必须分离，以防止未经授权的操作、数据泄露及合规风险，亟需一个可审计、可重放、策略版本化的确定性治理层。
AI.method: VeriWeave Govern 为确定性运行时治理层：对结构化代理动作按版本化策略评估，验证类型化证据，应用固定‘拒绝 > 审查 > 允许’优先级，将后果性动作路由至可问责人工审查，并记录可重放、防篡改的审计状态。评估使用 GovernBench（30 独立种子、60,000 预言机标注案例，覆盖五大企业领域、对抗证据、分布外动作、策略时间演化）、六项消融实验、部署 API 端到端与 40,040 请求并发测试，以及 150 例 EU/奥地利法规落地评估（冻结预测、双盲人工标注）。
AI.result: VeriWeave 实现 0.9888 平均准确率、0.9836 宏 F1、零观测聚合误放行、零治理攻击成功率。消融实验表明证据门控、拒绝优先级、分布外失效保护、人工审查、矛盾处理、时间重放六机制互补提升安全。部署 API 通过 12/12 端到端场景及 40,040 请求并发矩阵零故障。法规评估中确定性引擎偏保守，Gemma 4 31B 更贴近双盲人工共识，量化揭示安全-效用权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究量化了确定性治理的安全-效用权衡，证明证据感知、可重放的治理层可作为企业代理执行的独立控制平面，为合规、可审计的 AI 代理部署提供了可落地的技术范式。

title: Towards Better Training Signal: Advantage Clipped Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), but the need for on-policy data substantially limits training efficiency. Reusing off-policy data through importance sampling (IS) can improve efficiency but introduce considerable instability. Hence, algorithms such as PPO and GRPO widely adopt IS-ratio clipping to stabilize training. However, training stability and gradient estimate are mainly determined by the product of IS ratio and advantage. To further stabilize training, we propose ACPO, which clips the product of the IS ratio and the advantage, leading to more stable gradient estimates. We also establish a connection between ACPO and gradient clipping in policy mirror descent (PMD), which is a standard technique to stabilize optimization process, and prove the convergence of clipped-PMD under the standard RL setting. Experiments on widely used mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that ACPO consistently outperforms PPO and GRPO in both accuracy and training efficiency, delivering 4-6 percentage points gains on standard math benchmarks, with Qwen3-8B+PPO. Hence, ACPO is a practical and effective alternative to conventional IS-ratio clipping for RL post-training of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ACPO（Advantage-Clipped Policy Optimization），通过裁剪重要性采样比率与优势函数的乘积，而非传统仅裁剪 IS 比率，从而获得更稳定的梯度估计，在数学推理基准上比 PPO 和 GRPO 提升 4-6 个百分点，是 LLM 后训练 RL 的实用高效替代方案。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已成大语言模型推理能力提升的基石，但在线策略数据需求严重限制训练效率；离线策略数据复用虽可提效，却引入显著不稳定性。PPO 和 GRPO 广泛采用 IS 比率裁剪稳定训练，但训练稳定性和梯度估计主要取决于 IS 比率与优势函数的乘积，单纯裁剪比率不足。
AI.method: 提出 ACPO，直接裁剪 IS 比率与优势函数的乘积，得到更稳定的梯度估计；建立 ACPO 与策略镜像下降（PMD）中梯度裁剪的联系，并证明裁剪 PMD 在标准 RL 设定下的收敛性。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的数学推理基准实验中，ACPO 在准确率和训练效率上持续优于 PPO 和 GRPO，配合 Qwen3-8B 在标准数学基准上获得 4-6 个百分点的增益。
AI.conclusion: ACPO 是一种实用且有效的替代方案，可取代传统 IS 比率裁剪，用于大语言模型的 RL 后训练阶段。

title: CRASM-Gate: Deterministic-First Constraint- and Role-Aware Semantic Mapping with Selective Model Assistance Across Heterogeneous Industrial Standards
summary: Industrial standards often encode the same engineering concept through incompatible hierarchies, identifiers, roles, and structural constraints, so the nearest lexical or embedding match can still be technically inadmissible. This article presents CRASM, a deterministic constraint- and role-aware semantic mapping method, and CRASM-Gate, its selectively model-assisted extension. The framework separates standard-specific canonicalization, bounded retrieval, deterministic rules, destination-versus-origin role interpretation, semantic and structural ranking, ambiguity refusal, and target validation. CRASM-Gate adds a confidence/disagreement gate that may invoke a candidate-constrained large language model, while final authority remains with deterministic validation. A controlled artifact covers six directed industrial-standard pairs, three difficulty levels, and ten configurations, yielding 14,400 sample-level decisions. With a fixed local model endpoint, CRASM-Gate reaches mean F1 0.9938 and an implemented structural-validity rate of 1.0000; deterministic CRASM reaches 0.9931 without generative-model calls; and the model-only baseline reaches 0.5347. Relative to the model-only baseline, CRASM reduces top-1 errors from 670 to 10 while exhibiting 0.0688 s/sample rather than 24.5263 s/sample observed latency. CRASM-Gate improves CRASM by one additional correct decision out of 1,440, with observed latency increasing to 15.7666 s/sample. The results support a deterministic-first interoperability architecture in which model assistance is optional, measurable, candidate-bounded, and unable to bypass structural validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRASM和CRASM-Gate，一种确定性优先的工业标准语义映射方法，通过规则驱动的约束感知映射实现高精度、低延迟的互操作性，模型辅助为可选且受限。
AI.motivation: 工业标准常以不兼容的层级、标识符、角色和结构约束编码相同工程概念，导致词汇或嵌入匹配在技术上不可接受，需要一种确定性、约束感知且可选模型辅助的映射方法。
AI.method: CRASM框架包含标准特定规范化、有界检索、确定性规则、目标与源角色解释、语义和结构排序、歧义拒绝、目标验证；CRASM-Gate增加置信度/分歧门控，可调用候选约束的大语言模型，但最终权威仍为确定性验证。
AI.result: 在六个工业标准对、三个难度级别、十个配置的14400样本实验中，CRASM-Gate达F1 0.9938，结构有效率1.0000；确定性CRASM达0.9931，无生成模型调用；仅模型基线0.5347。CRASM将top-1错误从670降至10，延迟0.0688s/样本 vs 24.5263s/样本；CRASM-Gate额外修正1/1440，延迟15.7666s/样本。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持确定性优先的互操作架构，模型辅助为可选、可度量、候选受限且无法绕过结构验证。

title: CorrGRPO: Correlation-Normalized GRPO for Multi-Reward Learning
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used to train reasoning language models, where it computes advantages by centering and normalizing rewards across rollouts of the same prompt. For multiple rewards, GRPO sums the reward components and normalizes the total reward by its within-group standard deviation. The corresponding variance equals the sum of all pairwise reward covariances. For a fixed centered reward, larger aggregate covariance produces smaller advantages, and vice versa, allowing update magnitudes to adapt to reward dependence. However, correlated rewards with large scales can dominate this normalization and suppress signals from smaller-scale rewards. We propose Correlation-Normalized GRPO (CorrGRPO), which normalizes pairwise covariances into Pearson correlation coefficients. CorrGRPO keeps the centered total reward unchanged while balancing the influence of differently scaled rewards on the correlation-based normalization. This allows advantage magnitudes to adapt to reward correlations without the normalization being dominated by large-scale reward components. We compare CorrGRPO with GRPO and other variants on code generation, tool calling, and agent security, using models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters. These tasks all involve multiple rewards that can improve together or present tradeoffs. Results show improvements across three domains, including code generation, tool calling, and agent security. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CorrGRPO.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CorrGRPO改进GRPO，通过将成对协方差归一化为皮尔逊相关系数，解决多奖励训练中大尺度奖励主导归一化抑制小尺度奖励信号的问题，在代码生成、工具调用和智能体安全三个任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: GRPO在多奖励场景下将奖励求和后按组内标准差归一化，方差等于所有成对奖励协方差之和。相关且大尺度的奖励会主导归一化，抑制小尺度奖励的信号，导致优势估计不准确。
AI.method: 提出Correlation-Normalized GRPO (CorrGRPO)，将成对协方差归一化为皮尔逊相关系数，保持中心化总奖励不变，平衡不同尺度奖励对基于相关性归一化的影响，使优势幅度能适应奖励相关性而不被大尺度奖励主导。
AI.result: 在代码生成、工具调用、智能体安全三个领域，使用0.5B到8B参数的模型进行实验，CorrGRPO优于GRPO和其他变体，展示了跨领域的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CorrGRPO通过相关性归一化有效解决了多奖励训练中奖励尺度不平衡导致的优势估计偏差，在多个推理任务上表现优于基线方法，代码已开源。

title: Authority Before Utility: Non-Compensatory Control for Persistent LLM Memory
summary:
Persistent memory creates a control problem that retrieval relevance alone does not solve: a memory can remain highly useful after an update, deletion, or revocation makes it inadmissible for the current answer. We formalize this as a separation between utility and authority. A fixed finite penalty applied to an unnormalized utility score cannot guarantee exclusion under arbitrary positive-affine reparameterization of that score; by contrast, rank-normalized compensation is scale-invariant and therefore forms a stronger empirical comparator.
  Our prospectively frozen TIDE/LongMemEval primary was quarantined before a valid HELDOUT comparison because the materialized TIDE adapter conflated historical age with query-relative inadmissibility and the aligned LongMemEval split left no DEV set for the predeclared penalty selection. We therefore report a post-primary replacement diagnostic on Memora Remembering, where update/delete operations provide item-level forgetting state.
  On Qwen3-8B, DEV selected lambda = 0.6 from a ten-point normalized SOFT family. Across 185 HELDOUT units in 28 dependency clusters, HARD exclusion yields 4.04% balanced construct error versus 19.66% for locked SOFT, a paired difference of 15.61 points with a 20,000-replicate cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of [13.07, 18.76].
  The effect is driven primarily by forgotten-value leakage while current-value recall is preserved. This is same-Q operator-comparison evidence, not a universal claim that scalar control fails, not an evaluation of learned authority inference, and not an independent downstream-harm endpoint.

AI.tldr: 本文研究持久化记忆中的控制问题：记忆在更新、删除或撤销后仍可能因效用高而被检索，但此时已不具备权威性。作者形式化了效用与权威的分离，指出固定惩罚在未归一化效用分上不具尺度不变性，而秩序归一化补偿具有尺度不变性。在Qwen3-8B上，HARD排除法将平衡构造误差从19.66%降至4.04%（差异15.61点，95% CI [13.07, 18.76]），主要通过防止遗忘值泄露同时保持当前值召回。这是同查询算子对比证据，非普适性结论。
AI.motivation: 持久化记忆系统中，记忆条目在被更新、删除或撤销后，若仅依据检索相关性（效用）仍可能被高度排序并用于回答，但此时该记忆已失去权威性。现有方法用固定有限惩罚抑制此类记忆，但在效用分数的任意正仿射重参数化下无法保证排除；需要一种尺度不变的控制机制来分离效用与权威。
AI.method: 提出秩序归一化补偿作为尺度不变的强对比基线。在Memora Remembering基准上进行事后替代诊断实验，利用更新/删除操作提供条目级遗忘状态。在Qwen3-8B上，开发集从十点归一化SOFT族中选lambda=0.6。在185个HELDOUT单元（28个依赖簇）上，对比HARD排除与锁定SOFT惩罚，采用配对差异和20,000次簇引导自举估计95%置信区间。
AI.result: HARD排除实现4.04%平衡构造误差，锁定SOFT为19.66%，配对差异15.61个百分点，95%簇引导置信区间[13.07, 18.76]。效应主要由防止遗忘值泄露驱动，同时保持当前值召回。原定TIDE/LongMemEval主实验因适配器混淆历史年龄与查询相对不可采性、且无开发集供预声明惩罚选择而被隔离。
AI.conclusion: 秩序归一化的HARD排除在同一查询下显著优于固定标量惩罚的SOFT方法，证明了尺度不变控制在防止遗忘记忆泄露方面的有效性。但结论仅限于同查询算子对比证据，不构成标量控制普遍失效的普适性主张，也不涉及学习型权威推断评估或独立下游危害端点。

title: RolloutFaith: Auditing Persistent Internal Interventions in Visual World Model
summary: Interpretability methods such as probes, activation patches and learned editors are designed to reveal or modify a model's current computation. World models pose a harder requirement: because their predictions become inputs to later predictions, a useful internal correction must survive after editing stops. We therefore propose RolloutFaith, a framework that measures semantic improvement both in the prediction produced at intervention time and over later autonomous predictions under fixed events, actions, noise, and information budgets. We evaluate ten fitted editors on three world models across Crafter, Cartpole, and CoinRun. We also use Reference Activation Patching, which replaces a model activation with the paired activation computed from the real observation, to measure the correction available at the chosen interface. This reference intervention improves later predictions in all nine model and task combinations and outperforms the best fitted editor in eight, yet its sustained gain decreases with horizon in five of nine combinations. Current fitted editors recover only limited and inconsistent long term effects. By restoring individual state components to their untouched values, we find that persistent effects travel through the newest generated frame in DIAMOND, recurrent memory in DreamerV3, and both in STORM. These findings suggest that training should reward future consequences. To test this hypothesis, we propose Delayed LoReFT, which optimizes the same low rank intervention through four frozen future transitions and improves sustained intervention effects to some extent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RolloutFaith 框架评估世界模型中干预的长期效果，发现参考激活修补虽优于拟合编辑器但长期增益随时域衰减，持久效应通过不同路径传播（如 DIAMOND 的最新帧、DreamerV3 的循环记忆、STORM 的两者），提出 Delayed LoReFT 通过优化未来冻结转移提升持续干预效果。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法（探针、激活修补、学习编辑器）仅关注当前计算的揭示或修改，但世界模型要求内部修正在编辑停止后仍能持久生效，因为预测会作为后续预测的输入；因此需要衡量干预在自主滚动预测中的语义改进。
AI.method: 提出 RolloutFaith 框架，在固定事件、动作、噪声和信息预算下，衡量干预时刻预测及后续自主预测的语义改进；引入参考激活修补（Reference Activation Patching），用真实观测计算的配对激活替换模型激活，量化接口处的可用修正；在 Crafter、Cartpole、CoinRun 三个任务上评估十个拟合编辑器；通过将状态组件恢复为未修改值，追踪持久效应的传播路径；提出 Delayed LoReFT，通过四步冻结未来转移优化低秩干预。
AI.result: 参考激活修补在所有九个模型-任务组合中均改进后续预测，在八个组合中优于最佳拟合编辑器，但持续增益在五个组合中随时域衰减；当前拟合编辑器仅恢复有限且不一致的长期效果；持久效应在 DIAMOND 通过最新生成帧传播，在 DreamerV3 通过循环记忆传播，在 STORM 通过两者传播；Delayed LoReFT 在一定程度上提升了持续干预效果。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明世界模型训练应奖励未来后果；当前编辑器难以实现持久修正，需设计面向长时域的干预优化方法（如 Delayed LoReFT），并需深入理解不同架构中状态传播机制以实现可持久的内部修正。

title: Boundary-State Control for Tool-Using Language-Model Agents: Commit-Time Consistency under State Drift
summary: Tool-using language-model agents can decide that an action is permissible and execute it only after security-relevant state has changed. We study this proposal-to-commit gap and introduce BSC-R, a deterministic effect-boundary mechanism that binds a single-use commit authorization to the exact action and to a semantic projection of the authorization state that justified it. On 2,847 attacked AgentDojo episodes, the boundary kernel preserves the unprotected agent's behavior exactly (80.576% utility; 1.616% attack success). On 10,302 frozen proposals, it accepts every unchanged commit and rejects every instance of ten prospectively specified changed or replayed classes. In an independently generated boundary-drift experiment, full joint binding commits 0/4,403 invalid contexts while retaining 5,899/5,899 valid contexts. A prospective external evaluation on the 3,460-scenario CONTINUITY suite retains all 700 benign cases, prevents 1,200/1,200 represented non-replay invalid effects, handles 160/160 replay lifecycles correctly, and withholds 200/200 ambiguous no-release cases. The broader external suite also exposes the method's limit: across all 2,560 attacks, BSC-R has a 25% invalid-effect commit rate versus 0% for CONTINUITY. The result is therefore a scoped commit-time consistency mechanism, not a universal agent-safety claim.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BSC-R，一种确定性的效果边界机制，用于解决工具使用语言模型代理中的“提议-提交间隙”问题。该机制将单次使用的提交授权绑定到确切动作及其所依赖的授权状态语义投影。实验显示在AgentDojo和CONTINUITY基准上表现优异，但在更广泛的攻击套件中存在25%的无效效果提交率，表明这是一种范围限定的提交时一致性机制，而非通用的代理安全方案。
AI.motivation: 工具使用的语言模型代理在判断动作许可后执行前，安全相关状态可能发生变化，形成“提议-提交间隙”，导致授权决策与实际执行环境不一致，引发安全风险。现有方法缺乏将授权精确绑定到动作及其依赖状态的机制。
