AI.method: 提出BSC-R（边界语义承诺-撤销）机制：一种确定性的效果边界内核，将单次使用的提交授权同时绑定到（1）确切的待执行动作，以及（2）证明该动作合理的授权状态的语义投影。通过在提交时强制检查这两个绑定条件，确保授权上下文未发生漂移。
AI.result: 在2,847个受攻击的AgentDojo回合中，边界内核完全保持非受保护代理行为（80.576%效用；1.616%攻击成功率）。在10,302个冻结提议上，接受所有未变更提交，拒绝所有十类预定义的变更或重放实例。边界漂移实验中，完整联合绑定拒绝所有4,403个无效上下文，保留所有5,899个有效上下文。CONTINUITY套件（3,460场景）中：保留全部700个良性案例，阻止全部1,200个非重放无效效果，正确处理全部160个重发生命周期，扣留全部200个模糊不释放案例。但在更广泛的2,560攻击套件中，BSC-R表现出25%的无效效果提交率，而CONTINUITY为0%。
AI.conclusion: BSC-R实现了范围限定的提交时一致性保证，能有效防止授权状态漂移导致的无效提交，但在面对更广泛、更复杂的攻击场景时存在局限性。研究结果表明这是一种具体的提交时一致性机制，而非通用的代理安全完整解决方案。

title: An Effective, Reliable, and Robust Framework for Human Activity Recognition Using Wearable Sensors
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) through wearable sensors greatly improves the quality of human life through its multiple applications. For HAR, multi-sensor channel information is vital for optimal performance. Current work states that applying an attention neural network to prioritize discriminatory sensor channels helps the model classify activity more precisely. However, obtaining discriminatory information from multisensory channels is not always trivial, such as when collecting data from older hospitalized patients. In this context, existing HAR methods struggle to classify activities, particularly activities with similar natures. Moreover, HAR models predominantly suffer from overfitting due to the small size of available datasets, which leads to poor performance. Data augmentation (DA) is a viable solution to this problem. However, available DA methods have various drawbacks, including the possibility of being domain-dependent, resulting in distorted models for test sequences. To address these HAR problems, we propose a novel framework, ALAE-TAE-CutMix+, which focuses on two aspects. First, it enhances the latent information across each sensor channel and learns to exploit the relation among multiple latent features and the ongoing activity. Consequently, the discriminatory feature representations of each activity is enriched. Second, a new augmentation strategy is introduced to address the shortcomings of existing multi-sensor channel data augmentation. We then extend the framework to create a further enhanced version, namely ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+, which learns to capture the interactions between the features of each pair of sensor channels. We find that although the first framework performs slightly better than the latter, the latter is nonetheless more reliable and robust. Both frameworks significantly outperform SOTA approaches on the four HAR datasets from diverse domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ALAE-TAE-CutMix+和ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+两个框架，通过增强传感器通道潜在信息和改进数据增强策略，解决人体活动识别（HAR）中多传感器通道判别性特征提取困难和小样本过拟合问题，在四个跨域数据集上显著超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有HAR方法难以从多传感器通道获取判别性信息，特别是针对住院老年患者等特殊群体；相似活动分类困难；小数据集导致过拟合；现有数据增强方法存在领域依赖性、测试序列模型失真等缺陷。
AI.method: 1) ALAE-TAE-CutMix+：增强各传感器通道潜在信息，学习多潜在特征与活动间关系，丰富判别性特征表示；引入新增强策略解决多通道数据增强不足。2) ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+：在首个框架基础上增加通道交互利用模块（CIE），捕捉每对传感器通道特征间交互。
AI.result: 两个框架在四个不同领域HAR数据集上均显著优于SOTA方法。第一个框架性能略优，第二个框架更可靠鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架有效解决了HAR中传感器通道判别性特征提取和数据增强两大核心挑战，通过潜在特征增强、通道关系建模和改进增强策略，实现了跨域数据集上的卓越性能。

title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation
summary: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, then keeps those whose workflows can run reproducibly offline. A builder-reviewer pipeline is used to construct difficulty-controlled tasks, spanning four task types, each with a reference solution and an executable verifier. With this pipeline, we build 6.8k environments and collect 19k verified successful trajectories for supervised finetuning. Finetuning on these trajectories improves LLMs of different families and sizes, from 2B to 122B parameters across four skill-use benchmarks; Our Qwen3.5-9B SFT model outperforms the 397B untrained model on two of them. Further analysis shows that training teaches agents to invoke skills, raising the rate of reading the relevant skill from 28% to 96%, and that the gains hold across reasoning structures, extending to task types that form a minority of the training data and to skills held out from training

AI.tldr: SkillGym 是一个自动化管道，用于构建可验证环境、收集轨迹并训练技能使用智能体。它从互联网爬取大量技能，保留可离线复现工作流的技能，采用构建者-评审者管道生成四类难度可控的任务（含参考解决方案和可执行验证器），构建了 6.8k 环境并收集 19k 验证成功的轨迹用于监督微调。在多个模型家族和规模（2B-122B）上微调后，在四个技能使用基准上均有提升；Qwen3.5-9B 微调模型在两个基准上超越 397B 未训练模型。训练使智能体学会调用技能，相关技能阅读率从 28% 提升至 96%，增益泛化至推理结构、少数训练任务类型及未见技能。
AI.motivation: 技能为 LLM 智能体提供专业知识和指导以完成长时程复杂任务。尽管技能已被广泛采用，但如何合成可靠训练数据以及如何训练智能体使用技能仍缺乏深入探索。
AI.method: SkillGym 管道包括三步：1) 从互联网爬取大量技能，仅保留工作流可离线可复现运行的技能；2) 采用构建者-评审者管道构建难度可控的任务，涵盖四种任务类型，每类配备参考解决方案和可执行验证器；3) 基于此构建 6.8k 环境，收集 19k 经验证的成功轨迹用于监督微调。
AI.result: 在该数据上微调可提升不同家族和规模（2B 至 122B）的 LLM 在四个技能使用基准上的表现；Qwen3.5-9B 微调模型在两个基准上超越 397B 未训练模型。训练教会智能体调用技能，相关技能阅读率从 28% 跃升至 96%。增益在推理结构间保持，并泛化至训练数据中占比较少的任务类型及训练中未见的技能。
AI.conclusion: SkillGym 提供了一个有效的自动化管道，用于构建可验证环境和训练技能使用智能体，显著提升了技能调用能力，并在模型规模、任务类型和未见技能上展现出强泛化性。

title: Markovian Nonconvex ADMM for Reinforcement Learning: Bellman-Resolvent Stability Beyond Smooth Blocks
summary: We identify and study a structural mechanism for Markovian nonconvex ADMM in reinforcement learning. Using finite discounted MDPs as a canonical proving ground, we show that the discounted Bellman resolvent $(I-γP_π)^{-1}$ can provide the multiplier stability that classical nonconvex ADMM analyses often obtain from a designated smooth block. Starting from this mechanism, we establish convergence under controlled Markov sampling and then under stochastic observations using an empirical Bellman surrogate that jointly represents the random residual and its Jacobian. Markov mixing, initialization drift, observation noise, and decaying bias enter as one operator perturbation, avoiding unbiased product and double sampling requirements. When the perturbations are square summable, the true KKT residual converges almost surely to zero. Under a finite conditional fourth moment condition, a companion iterate satisfies $ \mathbb{E}[\widetilde G_{K+1}] \le A/T+(B/T)\sum_{k<T}m_k^{-1}, $ which becomes $O(T^{-1}+T/N)$ for total Markov sample budget $N$, giving $O(ε^{-1})$ iteration complexity and $O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity for squared KKT accuracy $ε$. Beyond stationarity, discounted occupancy coverage yields $J^\star-J(π)=O(\sqrt G)$ for direct tabular policies, so covered exact KKT points are globally optimal, while a statewise quadratic Bellman-improvement condition sharpens the relation to $O(G)$. Finally, nonlinear policy, projected Bellman, and explicit occupancy formulations exhibit the same chain of operator invertibility, dual representation, and multiplier stability. This supports discounted operator invertibility as a reusable structural principle for primal-dual reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文针对强化学习中的非凸 ADMM，发现折扣 Bellman 逆算子 (I-γP_π)^{-1} 能提供乘子稳定性，避免了传统非凸 ADMM 依赖的光滑块假设；建立了受控马尔可夫采样与随机观测下的收敛性，给出了迭代复杂度 O(ε^{-1}) 和样本复杂度 O(ε^{-2})，并证明了折扣占用覆盖下的全局最优性。
AI.motivation: 解决非凸 ADMM 在马尔可夫决策过程中的收敛性分析难题，传统分析依赖光滑块假设，但在强化学习中缺乏此结构；本文旨在寻找一种可复用的结构性原理（折扣算子可逆性）来替代光滑块，实现乘子稳定性并避免无偏乘积与双重采样要求。
AI.method: 以有限折扣 MDP 为分析平台，利用折扣 Bellman 逆算子 (I-γP_π)^{-1} 作为乘子稳定性的来源；构造经验 Bellman 代理同时表示随机残差及其雅可比；将马尔可夫混合、初始化漂移、观测噪声、衰减偏置统一为一个算子扰动；在受控马尔可夫采样与随机观测两种设定下建立收敛性。
AI.result: 当扰动平方可求和时，真实 KKT 残差几乎必然收敛到零；伴随迭代满足 𝔼[G̃_{K+1}] ≤ A/T + (B/T)∑_{k<T} m_k^{-1}，总马尔可夫样本预算 N 下变为 O(T^{-1}+T/N)，得到平方 KKT 精度 ε 的迭代复杂度 O(ε^{-1}) 和样本复杂度 O(ε^{-2})；折扣占用覆盖下 J^*-J(π)=O(√G)，覆盖的精确 KKT 点全局最优；状态级二次 Bellman 改进条件可锐化为 O(G)；非线性策略、投影 Bellman 与显式占用公式表现出相同的算子可逆性、对偶表示与乘子稳定性链条。
AI.conclusion: 折扣算子可逆性是一个可复用的结构性原理，可支撑强化学习中的原始-对偶算法设计与分析，摆脱了光滑块假设、无偏乘积与双重采样等强假设，为非凸马尔可夫 ADMM 提供了统一的收敛理论框架。

title: How Can Recommendation Feedback Evolve Agent Memory?
summary: Content-generation agents continuously receive impressions, clicks, conversions, and negative feedback from recommendation systems, providing real-world outcome signals for memory evolution. However, these signals are delayed and noisy, confounded by audience composition, placement, and recommendation policies, and may result from the combined influence of multiple memories, making accurate attribution difficult. Existing methods rely primarily on immediate feedback or semantic retrieval and therefore struggle to reliably translate recommendation outcomes into memory fitness. To address this challenge, we propose TIDE (Trajectory-Informed Directed Memory Evolution), an external memory evolution framework driven by delayed recommendation feedback. We further introduce Memory Evolution Gain (MEG), which measures the utility improvement of evolved memory over a no memory baseline on strictly future tasks. TIDE treats memory as a capacity-constrained population of experiences: temporal and semantic credit assignment estimates contextual fitness, while responsibility credit distributes outcome signals according to the memories referenced during generation. These signals are then used to reinforce, crossover, mutate, or evict memories. On an e-commerce membership marketing content-generation agent, TIDE achieves a +7.75-percentage-point MEG in offline temporal replay and significantly improves both unique click-through rate (UCTR) and activation rate in an online A/B test. On a delayed-label benchmark, TIDE achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) and the highest MEG among the compared methods, demonstrating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出 TIDE 框架，利用延迟推荐反馈驱动外部记忆演化，引入 MEG 指标衡量记忆演化效用，在电商营销内容生成和延迟标签基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 内容生成智能体接收推荐系统的展示、点击、转化、负反馈等真实世界结果信号，但这些信号具有延迟、噪声大、受受众构成、投放位置、推荐策略混淆，且可能由多个记忆共同影响，导致准确归因困难。现有方法主要依赖即时反馈或语义检索，难以可靠地将推荐结果转化为记忆适应度。
AI.method: TIDE 将记忆视为容量受限的经验种群：时序和语义信用分配估计情境适应度，责任信用根据生成时引用的记忆分配结果信号，然后利用这些信号强化、交叉、变异或淘汰记忆。引入 Memory Evolution Gain (MEG) 指标，衡量演化记忆相对于无记忆基线在严格未来任务上的效用提升。
AI.result: 在电商会员营销内容生成智能体上，离线时序回放中 MEG 提升 +7.75 个百分点，在线 A/B 测试中独特点击率 (UCTR) 和激活率显著提升。在延迟标签基准上，TIDE 实现最低 MAE 和 RMSE，以及最高 MEG，优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: TIDE 有效解决了延迟、噪声、混淆反馈下的记忆演化问题，通过轨迹感知的信用分配和进化操作，显著提升了内容生成智能体在真实推荐环境中的长期效用。

title: Where the Model Changes Its Mind: Hindsight-Divergence Localization for Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Group-relative methods for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) learn from differences in rollout outcomes. Independently sampling complete trajectories is costly and does not explicitly explore the decision space at critical positions. Feedback on a completed trajectory can reveal which earlier choices the policy reconsiders, suggesting where to sample alternative continuations. We introduce Hindsight-Divergence Localization (HDL), which uses hindsight-induced changes in token log-likelihoods to select branch points. HDL generates a small number of complete root trajectories and fills each training group with continuations from the selected positions under the original task context. Each continuation reuses its root prefix and contributes policy updates only through its newly generated suffix, reducing generation cost while focusing additional exploration and learning on decisions after branching. Experiments with three models across math, code, and agent tasks show gains in both rollout efficiency and task performance. Compared with GRPO at matched group sizes and training steps, HDL yields up to a 2.5$\times$ reduction in generated tokens and a 1.8$\times$ speedup in rollout wall-clock time. Despite this reduced generation budget, HDL improves performance across all three domains, with gains of up to 12.5 points on agent tasks.

AI.tldr: HDL 是一种面向可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的组相对方法，通过事后分歧定位选择分支点，复用根轨迹前缀并仅生成后缀进行策略更新，大幅降低生成成本并聚焦关键决策点探索。实验显示其在数学、代码和智能体任务上均优于 GRPO，生成 token 减少 2.5 倍、推理加速 1.8 倍，性能最高提升 12.5 分。
AI.motivation: 现有组相对方法需独立采样完整轨迹，成本高且未显式探索关键决策位置。事后反馈可揭示策略重新考虑的早期选择，提示在何处采样替代续写以提升探索效率。
AI.method: 提出 Hindsight-Divergence Localization (HDL)：利用事后导致的 token 对数似然变化选取分支点；生成少量完整根轨迹，每个训练组填充从分支点继续的续写，复用根前缀，仅通过新生成后缀贡献策略更新，降低生成开销并聚焦分支后的探索与学习。
AI.result: 三模型在数学、代码、智能体任务上实验：同组大小与训练步数下，HDL 生成 token 减少 2.5×，推理墙钟时间加速 1.8×，且全域性能提升，智能体任务最高增 12.5 分。
AI.conclusion: HDL 通过事后分歧定位高效聚焦关键决策点，在大幅削减生成预算的同时提升任务性能，为 RLVR 提供了更高效的训练范式。

title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
summary: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 REVOIR（基于信息价值推理的理性探询），一种在推理时通过计算提问的信息价值来决定是否澄清用户模糊请求的方法，无需训练即可在两个辅助任务上以更少的提问获得更高的成功率，且能自适应地根据用户事后纠正的成本调整提问策略。
AI.motivation: 现有的澄清策略通常基于不确定性阈值提问，忽略了不确定性减少对下游任务奖励的实际影响、提问与直接行动的成本权衡，以及用户可能在未被询问时主动纠正的可能性，导致提问效率低且缺乏自适应性。
AI.method: REVOIR 在推理阶段对每个候选澄清问题计算其信息价值（Value-of-Information, VoI），即预期答案带来的任务奖励提升，并将其与直接行动的预期奖励及提问成本比较，从而决定是否提问、提问什么；无需微调，仅利用大模型的推理能力即可部署。
AI.result: 在模糊问答（CondAmbigQA）和偏好对齐家庭任务规划（ADAPT）两个基准上，REVOIR 优于提示工程、思维链、微调策略及基于信息增益的方法：ADAPT 上偏好满足率提升 13-15%，提问数量减少 5 倍；当用户事后纠正成本低时，REVOIR 自动减少提问，展现出自适应性；相比之下，普通推理代理随推理深度增加反而减少澄清请求。
AI.conclusion: 基于信息价值的推理时决策能有效平衡澄清收益与成本，实现零训练、少提问、高成功率的自适应澄清，为语言助手处理模糊指令提供了一个通用且可部署的框架。

title: Seeing Time: Visual-Temporal Representation Learning for Interpretable Time Series Clustering
summary: Multivariate Time Series (MTS) clustering is an important tool in temporal data mining, aiming to discover latent group structures from complex observations without supervision. Although existing deep clustering methods can learn discriminative temporal representations, the resulting latent clusters are often difficult to relate back to waveform characteristics that practitioners can directly inspect and compare, limiting their ability to assess whether the discovered patterns reflect meaningful temporal behaviors. This paper, therefore, proposes WAVE (Waveform Aligned Visual-temporal Embedding), which treats time series and their deterministically rendered waveform plots as complementary views of the same observations. To produce discriminative representations whose cluster structures can be traced to observable waveform characteristics, WAVE aligns and integrates fine-grained temporal variations with holistic visual patterns, while associating each discovered cluster with its centroid-nearest authentic sample. Accordingly, interpretability in this work specifically refers to waveform-level traceability rather than a general explanation of model decisions. Extensive evaluations across 10 real-world public datasets show that WAVE achieves the highest macro-averaged clustering performance and the best average rank among the compared methods, while qualitative case studies illustrate how the discovered clusters can be inspected through authentic waveform records. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zheng-Zhu1/WAVE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WAVE方法，将多变量时间序列及其波形图作为互补视图，通过对齐时序细粒度变化与整体视觉模式，实现可解释的聚类，聚类中心关联真实样本，在10个真实数据集上达到最优宏平均聚类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度聚类方法虽能学习判别性时序表示，但潜在聚类难以关联到从业者可直接检查比较的波形特征，限制了对发现模式是否反映有意义时序行为的评估。
AI.method: WAVE将时间序列及其确定性渲染的波形图视为同一观测的互补视图，对齐并整合细粒度时序变化与整体视觉模式，将每个发现的聚类与其质心最近的真实样本关联，实现波形级可追溯的可解释性。
AI.result: 在10个真实公开数据集上，WAVE获得最高的宏平均聚类性能和最优平均排名，定性案例研究展示了如何通过真实波形记录检查发现的聚类。
AI.conclusion: WAVE通过波形对齐的视觉-时序嵌入，实现了可追溯到波形特征的可解释聚类，在多个基准上达到最优性能，代码已开源。

title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FOCUS，一种无需训练、即插即用的测试时上下文压缩框架，将压缩问题重构为因果决策保留，显著降低上下文长度并提升智能体任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体的交互历史随任务长度线性增长，导致二次推理成本和注意力稀释性能下降。现有压缩方法需离线学习压缩策略，成本高且无法动态适应测试时轨迹。
AI.method: 将上下文压缩重构为离散交互单元上的因果决策保留问题，提出 FOCUS：无需离线数据收集或微调，架构无关，作为模块化压缩层接入任意闭源前沿模型，仅在测试时运行。
AI.result: 在 API/工具调用、问答、网页域和多轮对话等多个智能体基准上建立新 SOTA：峰值上下文减少高达 48%，依赖减少 73%，任务成功率较未压缩执行提升高达 8.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS 通过因果决策保留实现免训练、测试时动态上下文压缩，兼具通用性和高效性，为长上下文智能体部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: What You Observe Determines How You Identify Causal Effects: Evaluating Causal Models across Observational Views
summary: Causal foundation models (CFMs) pre-trained on data generated from various structural causal models (SCMs) have been proposed for estimating causal effects from observational data. However, differences in pre-training environments and evaluation protocols make it difficult to assess how their performance depends on the information available for causal identification. To enable controlled comparisons, we introduce CausalIDView, a multi-view benchmark that holds fixed SCM realization and target estimand while varying only the observational view available to the estimator. Each observational view corresponds to a distinct identification regime under the benchmark's maintained causal assumptions. Across these matched views, no CFM consistently performs best and model rankings vary substantially. Under controlled structural changes, CFMs exhibit model-specific failures to maintain stable estimates when true effects are unchanged and to track genuine effect changes. We also examine whether combining explicit identification with strong predictive estimation is effective. A modular approach that pairs a predictive tabular foundation model with regime-specific identification procedures is competitive with CFMs and outperforms several of them. These findings motivate cross-regime comparisons to assess the empirical value of CFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CausalIDView基准，通过固定SCM实现和目标估计量而仅改变观测视角，系统评估因果基础模型（CFMs）在不同识别机制下的表现。实验发现：没有单一CFM在所有视角下持续最优，模型排名差异大；在受控结构变化下，CFMs表现出模型特定的失效模式；将表格基础模型与特定机制的识别程序结合的模块化方法具有竞争力并优于多个CFMs，表明显式识别与强预测估计的结合是有效的。
AI.motivation: 现有CFMs在不同预训练环境和评估协议下训练，难以评估其性能对因果识别所需信息的依赖。需要一个受控基准，固定数据生成过程和目标估计量，仅改变观测视角（即识别机制），从而实现跨机制的公平比较，揭示CFMs的真实经验价值。
AI.method: 构建CausalIDView多视角基准：固定结构因果模型（SCM）实现和目标因果估计量，系统变换可用的观测变量集合（观测视角），每个视角对应不同的识别机制（如后门调整、前门调整、工具变量等）。在匹配的视角上评估多个CFMs，并引入模块化基线：将预测性表格基础模型与针对各识别机制的显式识别程序配对。
AI.result: 1) 无CFM在所有识别机制下持续最优，模型排名随视角显著变化。2) 在真因果效应不变的受控结构变化下，CFMs表现出模型特定的估计不稳定；在真效应变化时，CFMs也难以准确追踪变化。3) 模块化方法（表格基础模型+机制特定识别）整体性能与CFMs相当，且优于多个CFMs。
AI.conclusion: 跨识别机制的比较对于评估CFMs的经验价值至关重要。CFMs在不同识别机制下表现不稳定，且难以适应结构变化。结合显式因果识别与强预测建模的模块化方法是一个有竞争力的替代方案，未来工作应关注如何在CFMs中整合显式识别逻辑以提高鲁棒性。

title: XU-RS: Explaining Credal Width in Random-Set Language Models
summary: Uncertainty estimates tell us how unsure a model is, but not why. Without knowing which parts of an input influences a model's uncertainty, we cannot tell whether that uncertainty score depends on input features that are relevant for the task. We study this problem in randomset classifiers built using pretrained language models. These classifiers assign probability to individual answers and to groups of answers, producing lower and upper probabilities for each answer; The difference between these probabilities, called credal width, is used to represent epistemic uncertainty about an answer arising from limited training data. We propose XU-RS, a framework that attributes an answer's credal width to the input tokens (words or word pieces) supplied to a language model. XU-RS uses Expected Gradients (a standard feature attribution method) to estimate how input tokens contribute to credal width. The proposed framework is evaluated on a MedQA dataset using SmolLM3-3B and Llama-2-7B models, demonstrating that setting the embedding of a token ranked highly by XU-RS to zero (zero-masking) causes larger changes in credal width than zero-masking randomly selected tokens. In addition, we show that normalisation can cause other answer groups to influence an answer's width, reveal how token attribution can mask numerical errors, and provide diagnostic checks to verify whether a token ranked highly by XU-RS meaningfully explains model uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 XU-RS 框架，用于将基于预训练语言模型的随机集分类器中的认知不确定性（信度宽度）归因到输入标记，利用期望梯度估计标记对不确定性的贡献，并在 MedQA 数据集上通过零掩码实验验证了归因的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的不确定性估计只能量化模型有多不确定，却无法解释为什么不确定。若不知哪些输入部分驱动了不确定性，就无法判断不确定性分数是否依赖于与任务相关的特征，这限制了不确定性在实际部署中的可信度与可解释性。
AI.method: 针对随机集分类器，利用其输出的下概率和上概率之差（信度宽度）表示认知不确定性。提出 XU-RS 框架，采用期望梯度这一标准特征归因方法，计算各输入标记对信度宽度的贡献。在 MedQA 数据集上，使用 SmolLM3-3B 与 Llama-2-7B 进行实验，通过将高归因标记的嵌入置零（零掩码）并观察信度宽度的变化量，与随机掩码基线对比，验证归因质量；同时分析归一化对答案组间影响的传递、标记归因可能掩盖数值误差的问题，并提供诊断检查以确认高排名标记是否真正解释了模型不确定性。
AI.result: 零掩码 XU-RS 高排名标记导致的信度宽度变化显著大于随机掩码，证明该框架能有效识别驱动不确定性的关键输入标记。另发现：归一化操作会使其他答案组影响目标答案的宽度；标记级归因可能掩盖数值计算误差；提出的诊断检查可验证高排名标记是否具有实质解释力。
AI.conclusion: XU-RS 为基于预训练语言模型的随机集分类器提供了一个可解释的不确定性归因工具，能够将认知不确定性追溯到具体输入标记，并通过消融实验与诊断机制保证归因的可靠性，为提升模型不确定性的透明度与可信度奠定了基础。

title: Architecture Alignment With Sparse Priors in Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly popular because they deliver strong predictions on new datasets through in-context learning, without task-specific training or extensive tuning. Yet released TFMs differ simultaneously in their pretraining priors, architectures, and objectives, obscuring their respective inductive biases. We therefore examine one concrete capability: irrelevant-feature suppression. Across synthetic tasks and real-world datasets, adding null features causes substantially greater predictive degradation in the row-token model TabDPT, whereas the cell-token alternating-axis model TabPFN v2 and other TFMs remain comparatively stable. This gap motivates us to ask whether architecture contributes to irrelevant-feature suppression. Because released TFMs remain confounded by other design choices, we train streamlined row-token and alternating-axis transformers under identical sparse-to-dense linear priors. Exact Bayes analysis shows that sparse prediction requires context-dependent feature gating, whereas the dense endpoint requires only uniform feature weighting. Consistent with this distinction, the alternating-axis model is substantially closer to the Bayesian optimal predictor on sparse tasks, while the architecture gap becomes negligible on dense tasks; almost all of the sparse gap arises from linear coefficient-estimation error. Finally, in both the controlled model and frozen TabPFN v2, we examine the effect of interventions on the feature-attention outputs on the linear coefficients, finding evidence of task-dependent selective routing of computation through feature-indexed pathways. Together, these results support architecture-prior alignment: preserving an addressable feature axis provides an inductive bias for task-adaptive relevance inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Tianqi-Zhao/ArchitecturePriorTFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表格基础模型（TFM）中架构对无关特征抑制能力的影响。通过对比行级Token模型（TabDPT）与交替轴模型（TabPFN v2），发现后者在稀疏任务上显著优于前者，且该差距主要源于线性系数估计误差。控制实验与贝叶斯分析表明：保留可寻址特征轴为任务自适应相关性推断提供了归纳偏置，即架构与先验对齐至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有TFM在预训练先验、架构和目标上同时存在差异，导致各自的归纳偏置不清晰。作者聚焦于一个具体能力——无关特征抑制，旨在揭示架构本身是否对此能力有贡献，并理解架构与先验对齐的机制。
AI.method: 1. 在合成任务和真实数据集上对比TabDPT（行Token）与TabPFN v2（单元格Token交替轴）在添加空特征时的性能下降。2. 在相同稀疏到稠密线性先验下训练简化的行Token和交替轴Transformer。3. 进行精确贝叶斯分析，对比稀疏与稠密任务的最优预测器。4. 对冻结的TabPFN v2和受控模型进行干预实验，观察特征注意力输出对线性系数的影响。
AI.result: 行Token模型TabDPT在添加无关特征时性能下降显著大于交替轴模型TabPFN v2。受控实验显示：交替轴模型在稀疏任务上显著接近贝叶斯最优预测器，而在稠密任务上架构差距可忽略；稀疏任务上的差距几乎完全源于线性系数估计误差。干预实验发现特征注意力输出存在任务依赖的选择性路由，通过特征索引通路进行计算。
AI.conclusion: 保留可寻址的特征轴（即交替轴架构）为任务自适应的相关性推断提供了归纳偏置。这支持了架构与先验对齐的观点：架构设计应与数据先验（如稀疏性）相匹配，以实现有效的无关特征抑制。

title: Flattening the Connectome Spectrum: A Spectral Filter for FC Induces a Pretraining Target for fMRI Encoders
summary: Self-supervised pretraining reshaped prediction in language and vision, and brain foundation models (BFMs) inherited its promise. Representations learned from large unlabelled corpora should capture individual functional dynamics and generalise across cohorts. However, kernel ridge regression (KRR) fitted on functional connectivity (FC) matrices still predicts individual phenotypes more accurately than any BFM we tested. In this paper, we show that KRR is weighted by the eigenvalues of the FC which are miscalibrated for phenotype prediction. We apply an efficient spectral filter to recalibrate the eigenvalues of each subject's FC matrix, enabling the model to exploit more inter-individual variance. Across the 5 datasets, 11 parcellations and 6 prediction targets we tested, we match or exceed the KRR baseline. Based on this finding, we then pretrain a small encoder model on about 4,000 hours of fMRI from 162 open datasets, whereby we align the pairwise similarities between the embeddings of recording snippets with those between the recalibrated connectomes. Our model performs on par with the best of the 6 published BFMs we tested while having an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Our encoder performs better than FC on short scans and in smaller cohorts, especially in fingerprinting. We release the pretrained model weights, the code and the pretraining data, preprocessed and parcellated.

AI.tldr: 论文发现核岭回归(KRR)在功能连接(FC)矩阵上的预测优于脑基础模型(BFM)，原因在于FC特征值对表型预测存在误校准。通过谱滤波器重新校准特征值，并在此基础上预训练小型编码器模型，在参数量少一个数量级的情况下达到最优BFM性能，且在短扫描和小样本队列中表现更优。
AI.motivation: 自监督预训练在语言和视觉领域取得成功，脑基础模型(BFM)承袭了这一范式，期望从大规模无标签fMRI数据中学习既能捕捉个体功能动态又能跨队列泛化的表征。然而现有BFM在表型预测任务上仍不如基于功能连接矩阵的核岭回归(KRR)，需要揭示原因并改进。
AI.method: 1) 分析发现KRR隐式地以FC矩阵特征值为权重，而这些特征值对表型预测存在误校准；2) 提出高效谱滤波器重新校准每个受试者FC矩阵的特征值，使模型能利用更多个体间差异；3) 基于重校准连接矩阵，在约4000小时、162个开放数据集的fMRI数据上预训练小型编码器，通过对齐嵌入片段与重校准连接矩阵的成对相似度进行训练。
AI.result: 在5个数据集、11个脑区划分、6个预测目标上，谱滤波方法匹配或超越KRR基线。预训练编码器性能与测试的6个已发布BFM中最优者持平，但参数量少一个数量级。在短扫描和小样本队列中编码器优于FC，指纹识别任务表现尤为突出。已开源模型权重、代码及预处理分区数据。
AI.conclusion: FC矩阵特征值的误校准是KRR优于BFM的关键原因，谱重校准能显著提升表型预测性能。基于重校准连接矩阵预训练的小型编码器可达到大型BFM水平，且在数据受限场景下更具优势，为高效脑基础模型构建提供了新范式。

title: SINO: Scale-Invariant Neural Operator
summary: In scientific machine learning, physical fields governed by partial differential equations exhibit low-rank structure and scale invariance. When solving equations on coarse grids, missing information leads to the closure problem: modeling unresolved physics to recover lost dynamics. Although closure terms depend on grid resolution, they represent scale-invariant physical laws. A model truly learning physics should capture these mechanisms with low-rank parameterization rather than memorizing grid-specific patterns. Inspired by this, we propose the Scale-Invariant Neural Operator (SINO), which learns on normalized physical scales via a dual-branch architecture operating in spectral and spatial domains. SINO uses bottleneck MLPs to generate continuous convolution kernels, embedding an explicit low-rank inductive bias that concentrates more than 95 percent of variance in 2-3 modes, as validated by PCA across benchmarks, while drastically reducing parameters. This principled design yields 38 times steeper scaling law exponents than FNO, demonstrating superior parameter efficiency. We compare SINO with traditional models (U-Net, DeepONet), Transformer models (Transolver, Oformer, GK-Transformer), and frequency-domain models (FNO, AMFNO, UFNO) on closure problems spanning externally forced Burgers turbulence, decaying Burgers turbulence, KS turbulence, Kolmogorov-forced NS turbulence, and decaying NS turbulence. Experiments show SINO achieves 1.5-38 times error reduction and 2-23 times parameter efficiency over baselines, with superior scaling laws reflecting exceptional data efficiency from principled low-rank design. Code is available at https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/SINO.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度不变神经算子(SINO)，通过双分支架构在谱域和空域学习归一化物理尺度，嵌入显式低秩归纳偏置，实现参数高效、数据高效的闭合建模，在多个湍流基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 物理场由偏微分方程控制，具有低秩结构和尺度不变性。粗网格求解导致闭合问题：需建模未解析物理以恢复丢失动力学。闭合项虽依赖网格分辨率，但代表尺度不变物理定律。真正学习物理的模型应用低秩参数化捕获这些机制，而非记忆网格特定模式。
AI.method: 提出尺度不变神经算子(SINO)，采用双分支架构在谱域和空域操作，通过瓶颈MLP生成连续卷积核，嵌入显式低秩归纳偏置。在归一化物理尺度上学习，PCA验证超95%方差集中在2-3模态，大幅减少参数量。
AI.result: 在外部强迫Burgers湍流、衰减Burgers湍流、KS湍流、Kolmogorov强迫NS湍流、衰减NS湍流等闭合问题上，与U-Net、DeepONet、Transformer模型(Transolver、Oformer、GK-Transformer)、频域模型(FNO、AMFNO、UFNO)对比，SINO实现1.5-38倍误差降低、2-23倍参数效率提升，缩放定律指数比FNO陡峭38倍，展现卓越数据效率。
AI.conclusion: SINO通过 principled 低秩设计和尺度不变学习，有效解决闭合问题，实现参数高效、数据高效的物理建模，为科学机器学习提供了新范式。

title: Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning
comment: 31 pages, 22 figures, 9 tables. Main text: 9 pages
summary: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official.

AI.tldr: Dual-WM 通过分离低层执行和高层规划的潜在状态表示与动态模型，结合加权滚动训练，显著提升了长视野视觉控制任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型在短期预测准确但长期规划困难，主要受限于递归展开导致的误差累积以及高维潜在空间中距离集中削弱目标辨别能力。
AI.method: 提出 Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM) 和 Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe)。Dual-WM 包含低层模型（预测动作条件转移）和高层模型（使用学习的宏动作进行长时规划），分别对应不同时间尺度。LoRe 通过指数衰减的加权滚动监督两层自生成预测，设置独立的衰减率。规划阶段高层生成潜在子目标，低层将其细化为具体动作执行。
AI.result: 在五个目标条件视觉控制任务上从头训练，目标偏移50和100步时平均成功率分别从75.9%提升至84.4%和从61.4%提升至69.5%。偏移100时在所有五个任务上均超越最强基线，比 LeWM 提升30.8个百分点。消融实验表明表示对目标评估更具判别力，递归预测下表现更一致。
AI.conclusion: 将不同时间尺度的角色分离（局部执行与长程规划）并跨多视野进行训练，能显著增强潜在规划的可靠性与长时任务表现。

title: Variational Mixtures and Multi-Marginal Flow Matching: Advancing Statistical Inference with Biological Applications
summary: In this thesis I develop methods for statistical inference when the distributions arising from complex biological systems are multi-modal, geometrically structured, and sometimes only defined up to a normalizing constant. I start from variational inference and, when analytic update equations are unavailable, move to black-box variational inference. To build intuition regarding inference challenges and the proposed methodologies, I introduce a novel unnormalized target density (the CoLN distribution) and reuse it as a controlled test case in the kappa. I then trace a trajectory of increasingly expressive approximations: ensembles evaluated with the multiple importance sampling ELBO (Paper A) and variational mixtures that automate component cooperation and exploration (Paper B). Because expressivity comes at a cost, I develop efficient mixture learning ideas, including Monte Carlo objective estimators to scale mixture learning more efficiently (Paper C). As a new result in the kappa, I overturn a three decades long misconception regarding the potential performance benefits of using mixtures in variational inference. Finally, I move from variational inference to flow matching, where I address the need for specialized treatment of interpolant learning in multi-marginal settings (Paper D). By combining insights from Papers A-D, I derive in Section 5.5 a new method: multi-marginal flow matching with mixtures of variational interpolants. I connect these methodological developments to biological applications, with special emphasis on three-dimensional spatial transcriptomics, where stacked tissue slices induce multi-modal dynamics across space.

AI.tldr: 本论文针对复杂生物系统中出现的多模态、几何结构化且仅定义至归一化常数的分布，开发了一系列统计推断方法。从变分推断出发，进展至黑盒变分推断，引入CoLN分布作为受控测试案例，依次提出多重重要性采样ELBO集成（论文A）、自动化组件协作与探索的变分混合模型（论文B）、用于高效扩展混合学习的蒙特卡洛目标估计器（论文C），并推翻了关于混合模型在变分推断中性能优势的三十年误解。最后转向流匹配，解决多边际设置下插值学习的特殊处理需求（论文D），并综合提出多边际流匹配与变分插值混合模型，应用于三维空间转录组学。
AI.motivation: 复杂生物系统（如三维空间转录组学）产生的分布具有多模态、几何结构化特点，且往往仅定义至归一化常数，传统变分推断难以处理。需要开发表达力更强、计算更高效且理论上有保障的推断方法，同时解决多边际流匹配中的插值学习问题。
AI.method: 1. 提出CoLN分布作为新型非归一化目标密度用于受控测试。2. 论文A：基于多重重要性采样ELBO的集成方法。3. 论文B：自动化组件协作与探索的变分混合模型。4. 论文C：用于高效扩展混合学习的蒙特卡洛目标估计器。5. 论文D：针对多边际设置的流匹配插值学习方法。6. 综合提出多边际流匹配与变分插值混合模型。
AI.result: 成功开发了一系列表达力递增的近似推断方法，推翻了使用混合模型在变分推断中无性能优势的三十年误解，提出了高效的混合学习扩展技术，并建立了多边际流匹配新框架。这些方法在三维空间转录组学等生物应用中展现出处理跨空间多模态动力学的能力。
AI.conclusion: 论文构建了从变分推断到流匹配的完整方法学轨迹，解决了复杂生物系统分布推断的核心挑战。通过理论创新（推翻长期误解）与方法整合（多边际流匹配混合模型），为三维空间转录组学等领域提供了强有力的统计推断工具，推动了几何结构化多模态分布建模的发展。

title: EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making
summary: LLM agents are increasingly expected to support enterprise workflows, where tasks often involve missing information, uncertainty, feedback, and long-term trade-offs. However, existing enterprise and financial benchmarks mainly test static capabilities such as information extraction, numerical calculation, domain knowledge, and financial QA, leaving interactive and long-horizon decision-making underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnterpriseBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents across this spectrum, from static question answering to dynamic decision-making. Specifically, EnterpriseBench reorganizes existing enterprise and financial QA datasets into a unified foundational suite annotated by capability and difficulty, and introduces three professional interactive settings: Consulting, based on management-consulting-style business cases for client problem diagnosis through multi-turn information seeking; the Beer Game, adapted from a classic supply-chain management simulation for inventory control under delayed feedback; and Enterprise Digital Twin, a project-based business simulator for workforce, risk, and project planning. Experiments with nine agent methods under four backbone models show that current agents have not yet achieved stable, comprehensive, and cross-task reliability in enterprise scenarios. These results show that EnterpriseBench provides a practical benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in realistic enterprise strategic reasoning and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EnterpriseBench基准，评估LLM代理在企业场景下从静态问答到动态决策的全谱系能力，包含三个交互式设置（咨询、啤酒游戏、企业数字孪生），实验显示当前代理尚未达到稳定、全面、跨任务的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有企业和金融基准主要测试静态能力（信息抽取、数值计算、领域知识、金融问答），缺乏对交互式和长期决策的评估，而企业工作流常涉及缺失信息、不确定性、反馈和长期权衡，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建EnterpriseBench基准：重组现有企业和金融QA数据集为统一基础套件并标注能力与难度；引入三个专业交互式设置——咨询（基于管理咨询案例的多轮信息寻求诊断）、啤酒游戏（改编自供应链管理模拟的延迟反馈库存控制）、企业数字孪生（基于项目的业务模拟器，涵盖人员、风险、项目规划）；使用四种骨干模型测试九种代理方法。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前代理在企业场景下尚未实现稳定、全面和跨任务的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: EnterpriseBench为评估LLM代理在真实企业战略推理和决策中的表现提供了实用基准。

title: State Transport Routing for Short-horizon Adaptation in Multi-horizon Photovoltaic Forecasting
summary: Recent power measurements provide valuable information for photovoltaic(PV) power forecasting, but directly extrapolating short-term trends can introduce substantial errors over longer forecast horizons. To address this challenge, we propose state transport routing (STR), a lightweight adapter that refines the predictions of a frozen forecasting model. STR combines the original forecast with two complementary trajectories derived from the latest measured power level and its recent trend. A horizon-conditioned router adjusts their contributions over the first 120 min, while leaving subsequent predictions unchanged. Experiments on four public PV datasets show that STR consistently outperforms a parameter-matched residual adapter. On PVDAQ, the same approach improves five neural forecasting backbones, reducing all-horizon normalized mean absolute error by 0.0201-0.2364 percentage points, with paired 95% confidence intervals excluding zero. No reliable improvement is observed for LightGBM. These findings demonstrate the potential of structured state adaptation to improve short-term forecasting across different neural architectures without retraining the underlying models or altering their longer-horizon predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出状态传输路由（STR），一种轻量级适配器，用于在不重新训练基础模型的情况下改进光伏功率短期预测，通过结合最新实测功率水平及其近期趋势的互补轨迹，利用地平线条件路由器在前120分钟调整贡献，实验表明STR在四个公开数据集上优于参数匹配的残差适配器，并在PVDAQ上改进五种神经预测骨干网络，显著降低全地平线归一化平均绝对误差，但对LightGBM无显著提升。
AI.motivation: 光伏功率预测中，直接外推短期趋势会导致长预测时段的大量误差，需要一种方法在不重新训练模型的情况下利用最新实测数据改进短期预测。
AI.method: 提出状态传输路由（STR），一种轻量级适配器，冻结基础预测模型，结合原始预测与两条互补轨迹（基于最新实测功率水平及其近期趋势），利用地平线条件路由器在前120分钟动态调整权重，之后保持原预测不变。
AI.result: 在四个公开光伏数据集上，STR持续优于参数匹配的残差适配器；在PVDAQ数据集上，STR改进了五种神经预测骨干网络，将全地平线归一化平均绝对误差降低0.0201-0.2364个百分点，配对95%置信区间不包含零；对LightGBM无可靠改进。
AI.conclusion: 结构化状态适应有潜力在不重新训练基础模型、不改变长时段预测的情况下，跨不同神经网络架构改进短期光伏功率预测。

title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
summary: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.

AI.tldr: MeanFlowAdvantage 是一种针对平均速度生成器的有符号优势加权最小二乘目标，解决了 MeanFlow 在奖励微调中的表征不匹配问题，保留了原生少步采样器，并在 SD3.5-Medium 和 DNA 启动子设计任务上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: MeanFlow 通过预测区间平均速度实现高效少步生成，但现有基于优势的奖励目标定义在瞬时速度或等价 x0 空间预测上，与推理时直接使用的平均速度映射存在不匹配，阻碍了奖励微调的有效性。
AI.method: 提出 MeanFlowAdvantage：利用共享、分离的 MeanFlow 导数修正，将奖励目标表达在预测空间，使回滚和参考正则化成为部署时平均速度网络的精确惩罚，从而保留原生少步采样器并实现奖励改进直接迁移到部署流映射。
AI.result: 在 SD3.5-Medium 上，MeanFlowAdvantage 在所有八项指标上均超越四步 MeanFlowNFT 基线；仅用四次 NFE 即在六项指标上匹配或超过 40 步 DiffusionNFT 基线。在 DNA 启动子设计中，支持无教师在线策略 RL 和教师引导奖励分级蒸馏，后者在一步 Sei 概况 MSE 上达到最低。
AI.conclusion: MeanFlowAdvantage 成功弥合了平均速度表征与奖励微调目标的差距，实现了高效少步生成与奖励优化的统一，并在图像生成和生物序列设计任务上展现出优越的泛化能力与实用价值。

title: Safe-by-Design Learning via Energy-based Neural Networks
summary: Learning neural-network models of dynamical systems with safety guarantees is a fundamental requirement for their deployment in safety-critical settings. Safety is commonly established by proving the invariance of a desired subset in state-space, ensuring that every trajectory initialized in this subset remains confined to it for all time under admissible inputs. Existing frameworks, however, either rely on computationally expensive post-hoc verification or employ safety-enforcing mechanisms without formal correctness guarantees. In this paper, we introduce a novel neural architecture grounded in energy-based modern Hopfield networks to guarantee safety-by-design while retaining sufficient expressiveness to model complex nonlinear dynamics. Specifically, we integrate modern Hopfield networks with a port-Hamiltonian neural ODE, enabling by design the construction of barrier functions yielding explicit admissible-input sets and quantitative robustness radii. Across several benchmarks, including an 12-dimensional nanodrone model, our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing certified invariant sets that are more robust to external solicitations than comparable existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于能量的现代Hopfield网络与端口哈密顿神经ODE相结合的神经架构，实现安全保证的动力学系统建模，设计时即构造势垒函数，获得显式可容许输入集和定量鲁棒半径，在12维纳米无人机等基准上达到最优性能并产出更鲁棒的认证不变集。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键场景部署神经网络动力学模型需要形式化安全保证。现有方法要么依赖计算昂贵的事后验证，要么采用无形式正确性保证的安全强制机制，缺乏设计时即安全的框架。
AI.method: 将现代Hopfield网络与端口哈密顿神经ODE集成，利用能量基础的Hopfield网络特性，设计时构造势垒函数，从而显式给出可容许输入集和定量鲁棒半径，实现安全保证的神经动力学建模。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试（含12维纳米无人机模型）上，该框架达到最先进性能，且生成的认证不变集对外部扰动的鲁棒性优于现有可比方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于能量的现代Hopfield网络与端口哈密顿神经ODE融合架构，实现了安全保证的动力学建模，兼具表达能力与形式化不变性证明，为安全关键系统的神经网络控制提供了可认证的解决方案。

title: KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora
comment: Technical Report. Official website: https://lsf.kupasai.com/ Report homepage: https://tongjiai4e.github.io/KUPAS-MASTER-Report/
summary: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 KUPAS MASTER 经验工程平台，通过九层认知语料库构建，将异构工作记录和专家访谈转化为可追溯、可复用的经验语料，构建六大资产库（规则、约束、最佳实践、反面案例、边界案例、技能），并封装为可调用技能，实现从个体隐性经验到组织知识及智能体能力的转化。实验显示在多个专业领域任务上，KUPAS MASTER 智能体得分 89.58，显著优于基础模型（70.63）和原始语料 RAG（79.75）。
AI.motivation: 资深专业人士拥有的不仅是事实和结论，还包括关键线索识别、判断合理性依据及行动选择等隐性知识。常规工作记录往往遗漏这些隐性知识，导致大语言模型智能体难以有效利用专业经验。因此需要一种系统化方法将隐性经验显性化、结构化，并转化为智能体可调用的技能资产。
AI.method: 1. 六要素案例模型：用情境、线索、判断、行动、边界、结果六要素保留任务全过程。2. 九层认知语料库构建：沿九个提取维度组织隐性经验，存入规则库、约束库、最佳实践库、反面案例库、边界案例库、技能库六大资产库。3. 语义对齐、个体经验蒸馏、组织层面巩固、交叉复核四阶段流程，保留来源证据、适用条件及未解决分歧。4. 将资产封装为具备显式输入、步骤、依赖、停止条件的可调用技能，连接经验采集与任务执行及评估反馈。
AI.result: 使用 20 名随机抽取从业者的授权样本，处理 1,576 个源文件，生成 23,024 条个体经验记录和 13,113 项组织级资产。在多个专业领域、相同任务输入与评分标准下，基础模型、原始语料 RAG、KUPAS MASTER 智能体得分分别为 70.63、79.75、89.58。KUPAS MASTER 在全部七个评分维度上均优于原始语料 RAG。
AI.conclusion: KUPAS MASTER 平台提供了一条从个体隐性经验到组织知识再到智能体能力的实用路径。通过结构化的认知语料库构建与资产封装，显著提升了大语言模型智能体在专业任务上的表现，验证了经验工程方法在知识密集型领域的有效性。

title: Fine-Tuning on Self-Generated and Reward-Weighted Data: Learning Dynamics, Convergence Rates, and Benefits of Off-Policyness
summary: We study the learning dynamics of fine-tuning a policy model on self-generated and reward-weighted data, with particular focus on a generalized version of REINFORCE -- referred to as RE(S) -- that updates the rollout distribution once every $S \ge 1$ gradient steps. Prior work in bandits and reinforcement learning has developed rich theory for policy gradient methods, and on-policy sampling (i.e., a small $S$, ideally $1$) is often viewed as crucial to their success; yet in prominent application like post-training large language models, reward-guided self-training has proved to be effective even when the rollout distribution is updated infrequently, but theoretical understanding remains limited for the convergence properties of these off-policy methods. To bridge these gaps, we develop a unified theory for RE(S) that covers the full spectrum of $S \ge 1$: it can be interpreted as a stage-wise optimization process, where each stage takes $S$ gradient steps for minimizing the Kullback-Leibler distance to a fixed reward-weighted rollout distribution. For multi-arm bandits with softmax policies, our in-depth analysis and numerical experiments reveal three key findings: (1) for any fixed $S$, RE(S) enjoys global convergence to the optimal policy as the number of rollout distribution updates $B = \lfloor T / S \rfloor \rightarrow \infty$, where $T$ denotes the number of gradient steps; (2) we prove tight two-sided bounds showing that the suboptimality gap of RE(S) achieves an asymptotic $Θ(1 / T)$ convergence rate, while $S$ only affects the length of a burn-in phase; (3) when initialized at a weak policy with a small optimal-action probability, RE(1) gets trapped around suboptimal policies for a long period, whereas RE(S) with a suitable $S$ avoids the detour and achieves significantly faster convergence to the global optimum, highlighting the benefits of off-policyness in this case.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了RE(S)算法（一种广义REINFORCE）在多臂老虎机中的学习动态，证明了对于任意固定S，随着rollout分布更新次数B→∞，算法全局收敛到最优策略；亚最优差距达到Θ(1/T)收敛率，S仅影响burn-in阶段长度；当从弱策略初始化时，RE(1)会长期陷入次优策略，而适当S的RE(S)能避免绕路更快收敛，揭示了off-policy的优势。
AI.motivation: 现有策略梯度理论主要关注on-policy采样（小S，理想S=1），但在大语言模型后训练等实际应用中，奖励引导的自训练即使在rollout分布更新不频繁（大S）时也有效，但缺乏对这些off-policy方法收敛性质的理论理解。
AI.method: 建立统一理论框架分析RE(S)全谱系S≥1，将其解释为分阶段优化过程：每阶段固定rollout分布进行S步梯度下降，最小化到奖励加权rollout分布的KL距离。在softmax策略的多臂老虎机设置下，进行深入理论分析和数值实验。
AI.result: 三大发现：(1) 任意固定S下，RE(S)随B=⌊T/S⌋→∞全局收敛到最优策略；(2) 证明紧致双侧界，亚最优差距渐近达到Θ(1/T)收敛率，S仅影响burn-in阶段长度；(3) 弱策略初始化下，RE(1)长期陷入次优策略，而适当S的RE(S)避免绕路显著加速收敛。
AI.conclusion: RE(S)为策略梯度方法提供了统一视角，理论上证实了off-policy更新（S>1）在某些情况下优于on-policy（S=1）的收敛行为，特别是在弱策略初始化时能避免次优陷阱，为大模型后训练等实际应用提供了理论支撑。

title: Learning from Shared-Control Overrides: Context-Driven Acceleration Profile Prediction for Personalized Overtaking
summary: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) systems are typically calibrated for an average driver, often resulting in a mismatch between vehicle behavior and individual expectations during time-critical maneuvers such as highway overtaking. When the ACC is perceived as too conservative and inconsistent, drivers intervene through throttle overrides, providing implicit feedback on the system's behavior. This paper reframes these override actions as human-in-theloop supervisory signals and proposes a data-driven framework for personalized vehicle adaptation, termed Context-driven Personalized ACC (CoP-ACC). Rather than relying solely on end-to-end regression, which tends to over-smooth dynamic responses, we introduce a hybrid pipeline combining: (i) unsupervised hierarchical clustering to extract representative acceleration profiles from override events; (ii) a context classifier that maps pre-maneuver driving conditions to the appropriate profile; and (iii) a residual regressor that refines the selected profile into a smooth, personalized acceleration profile tailored to the immediate context. Evaluated on real-world public-road data against a withheld forced-ACC baseline, the approach demonstrates high reconstruction fidelity and generates acceleration profiles that tend toward the driver's expected behavior in potential override contexts. The results highlight the potential of learning from shared-control overrides to enable anticipatory, personalized ACC behavior, reducing manual interventions and improving ride comfort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CoP-ACC的个性化自适应巡航控制框架，利用驾驶员在共享控制中的油门覆盖行为作为隐式监督信号，通过无监督层次聚类、情境分类器和残差回归器组成的混合流水线，从真实路况数据中学习个性化的加速度剖面，实现了高保真的行为重构并减少了人工干预。
AI.motivation: 现有的ACC系统通常针对平均驾驶员进行标定，导致在超车等时空关键操作中车辆行为与个体预期不匹配。驾驶员通过油门覆盖进行干预，提供了隐式反馈，但现有方法未充分利用这些共享控制信号实现个性化自适应。
AI.method: 提出混合数据驱动流水线：(i) 无监督层次聚类从覆盖事件中提取代表性加速度剖面；(ii) 情境分类器将操作前驾驶条件映射到相应剖面；(iii) 残差回归器细化选定剖面，生成平滑、即时情境下的个性化加速度剖面。避免了端到端回归过度平滑动态响应的问题。
AI.result: 在真实公开道路数据上评估，对比保留的强制ACC基线，方法展现出高重构保真度，生成的加速度剖面在潜在覆盖情境下趋向于驾驶员预期行为，显著减少人工干预并提升乘坐舒适性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，从共享控制覆盖行为中学习可实现预见性、个性化的ACC行为，为减少驾驶员干预、提升用户体验提供了有效途径。该框架展示了利用人机交互隐式信号进行车辆行为自适应的潜力。

title: Scalable Diffusion SBI for Compositional Inference under Simulator Misspecification
summary: Simulation-based inference is challenging when many heterogeneous observations must be composed, hierarchical latent structure must be preserved, and the simulator is misspecified relative to observed data. We develop sampling and fine-tuning methods for diffusion-based inference in design-conditional settings, where the same simulator is queried across different experimental conditions $ξ$. We extend compositional score-based inference with a continuous-time diffusion coefficient that accounts for the number of observations, avoiding Jacobian and auxiliary-covariance corrections. We introduce Hierarchical Blockwise Diffusion Sampling (HBDS), which infers shared parameters and group-specific latent states using a single pretrained model, with the hierarchy specified only at sampling time. Together, these methods support variable observation sets and groupings without retraining. To address misspecification, we introduce path-regularized fine-tuning that adapts the learned likelihood to observations and transfers corrections to posterior inference. Using Girsanov's theorem, we quantify path divergence between pretrained and fine-tuned models across experimental designs and interpret it alongside predictive errors to distinguish candidate misspecification correction from unnecessary adaptation. We evaluate compositional sampling on exact-score Gaussian and Simple Likelihood, Complex Posterior benchmarks, HBDS with analytic and learned scores on a controlled hierarchical model, and fine-tuning and localization on a separate analytic model with known design-dependent discrepancy. Finally, we apply the framework to 940 measurements across four cell lines in a mechanistic Bone Morphogenetic Protein signaling model, where fine-tuning improves posterior-predictive accuracy relative to the pretrained model and shifts posterior marginals toward the least-squares reference while retaining spread.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套基于扩散模型的仿真推理框架，解决异构观测组合、层级潜变量结构保持及模拟器错误指定三大挑战。核心贡献包括：设计条件下的组合式得分推理扩展、层级分块扩散采样（HBDS）以及基于Girsanov定理的路径正则化微调方法。实验验证了在基准测试和骨形态发生蛋白信号模型真实数据上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 仿真推理在处理多异质观测组合、保持层级潜变量结构以及应对模拟器与观测数据错配时面临困难。现有方法难以在不重新训练的情况下支持可变观测集和分组，且缺乏量化和校正模型错误指定的机制。
AI.method: 1. 扩展组合式基于得分的推理，引入连续时间扩散系数以适应观测数量，避免雅可比和辅助协方差校正。2. 提出层级分块扩散采样（HBDS），仅在采样时指定层级结构，用单一预训练模型推断共享参数和组特定潜状态。3. 引入路径正则化微调，利用Girsanov定理量化预训练与微调模型间的路径散度，结合预测误差区分必要的错误指定校正与过度适应。
AI.result: 在精确得分高斯基准、SLCP基准、受控层级模型及已知设计依赖差异的解析模型上验证了组合采样、HBDS及微调定位的有效性。应用于4条细胞系940测量值的BMP信号机制模型中，微调提升了后验预测精度，使后验边缘向最小二乘参考值偏移同时保持分布分散度。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了灵活的设计条件扩散推理，通过HBDS支持层级结构且无需重训练，路径正则化微调有效应对模拟器错误指定。在真实生物信号模型中展示了实际效用，为复杂仿真推理提供了统一且可扩展的解决方案。

title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
summary: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model achieves an EngiScore of only 44.3, and just 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed. EngiWorld provides the first rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.

AI.tldr: EngiWorld 是首个面向专业工程软件全流程自动化的基准测试，包含 1301 个专家策划任务，覆盖 6 大工程领域、26 个专业软件平台，并引入基于工件的评估方法，测试显示当前最强模型得分仅 44.3，多软件协作成功率仅 3.6%。
AI.motivation: 通用计算机使用代理虽取得快速进展，但可靠自动化专业工业工程仍遥不可及，因为工程工作流要求跨软件和设计阶段推理几何与物理约束及依赖关系，现有基准缺乏对完整设计闭环的覆盖与严格验证。
AI.method: 构建 EngiWorld 基准：1,301 个专家策划任务，涵盖 CAD、CAE、CAM、BIM、EDA、3D 可视化 6 大领域及 26 个专业软件平台，支持 GUI/CLI 界面，含 6 种任务类型；提出工件中心评估方法，基于统一领域验证套件程序化检查几何有效性、物理可行性、规则合规性，并对定量设计任务按规格达成度连续打分而非二元成功。
AI.result: 对 7 个前沿模型评测显示巨大能力差距：最强模型 EngiScore 仅 44.3，多软件协作尝试成功率仅 3.6%，揭示当前代理在专业工程软件端到端操作上的严重不足。
AI.conclusion: EngiWorld 为衡量面向专业工程软件全流程自动化代理的进展提供了首个严格基础，填补了工程领域端到端基准的空白。

title: Cool the Sampler, Not the Learner: Sampling Temperature Moves the Staleness Cliff of Importance-Corrected GRPO
summary: Production RL for language models lets the sampler fall behind the learner and repairs the resulting mismatch with a truncated importance weight. We ask how long the sampler can go without a refresh under that correction, and find a cliff: on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and GSM8K, importance-corrected GRPO refreshed every 192 updates learns well for 180 steps and then degrades severely in all three data seeds before the refresh arrives. Published remedies for staleness act on the update; we act on the sampler instead. Decoupled cooling draws samples at temperature 0.8 while the learner, the reference model and the importance weights stay at temperature 1, with the behaviour probability recorded from the tempered distribution, so the learner's objective is unchanged. All corresponding cooled runs are stable, and the longer interval keeps what the short one delivered: at the same update budget, a cooled sampler refreshed every 192 steps matches an uncooled sampler refreshed every 96 at the end of training (0.857 for both) and averaged over it (0.79), whereas lowering the learning rate to a safe value ends 3-7 points lower. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B the degradation points at interval 192 predict that an interval of 144 is fatal without cooling and survivable with it; on two data seeds the uncooled runs degrade before their first refresh and the cooled runs pass it and end at 92-93% against 68-81%, with one cooled run degrading transiently late in the second cycle. The benefit has a window: at three times the safe interval and in a high-mismatch MATH setting cooling delays degradation without preventing it, stronger cooling is not better, and cooling without the correction collapses. Sampling temperature is a control on staleness tolerance, and temperature and refresh interval should be chosen together.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了语言模型生产级强化学习中采样器落后于学习器的问题，提出了“解耦冷却”方法：在采样时使用较低温度（0.8）而学习器、参考模型和重要性权重保持温度 1，从而大幅提升采样器的陈旧容忍度，使刷新间隔从 96 步延长至 192 步而不损失性能，且优于降低学习率等现有补救措施。
AI.motivation: 现有的重要性权重修正方法在采样器长时间不刷新时会出现性能断崖式下降（cliff），现有针对陈旧性的补救措施作用于更新端，作者希望从采样端解决问题，探索采样温度对陈旧容忍度的控制作用，实现更长的刷新间隔而不牺牲性能。
AI.method: 提出解耦冷却：采样器使用温度 0.8 生成样本，记录行为策略概率；学习器、参考模型及重要性权重计算均保持温度 1，保证学习目标不变。在 GRPO 框架下，结合截断重要性权重修正，对比不同刷新间隔（96、144、192 步）及不同数据种子下的表现，并在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B 上进行 GSM8K 和 MATH 任务实验。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B+GSM8K 上，冷却采样器每 192 步刷新可匹配未冷却每 96 步刷新的最终性能（0.857）和平均性能（0.79），显著优于降低学习率（低 3-7 分）。在 7B 模型上，未冷却在 144 步间隔即在首次刷新前崩溃（68-81%），冷却后通过首次刷新并达 92-93%。极端间隔（3×安全值）和高失配 MATH 任务中冷却仅能延缓而非避免退化；过强冷却无益，无重要性修正的冷却会崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 采样温度是控制陈旧容忍度的有效旋钮，温度与刷新间隔应联合选择。解耦冷却以极小改动显著提升采样器陈旧鲁棒性，使生产级 RL 系统能以更低刷新频率维持性能，为大规模语言模型强化学习提供了实用的工程手段。

title: WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Active test-time adaptation (ATTA) improves robustness under distribution shift by updating a deployed model during inference while selectively querying supervision. However, most existing ATTA methods implicitly assume that supervision can be requested for every incoming test batch, which can incur substantial annotation cost over long test streams. In this work, we introduce \emph{budgeted ATTA} in which labels are available for only a fraction of test batches. This formulation shifts the central challenge from deciding \emph{what} to label within a batch to deciding \emph{when} supervision should be applied over time. To address this challenge, we propose a budget-aware approach \emph{WISE-ATTA} that allocates supervision over the test stream based on lightweight signals computed online, prioritizing periods where supervision is likely to be most useful. When a batch is selected for supervision, we further employ a drift-based sample selection criterion that targets samples exhibiting ongoing, unconverged adaptation dynamics, enabling effective updates from a single labeled example. We evaluate this approach on synthetic corruptions (ImageNet-C) and natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-R/K/A). Across settings, WISE-ATTA achieves competitive or improved performance compared to recent ATTA methods while requiring substantially fewer labels. Overall, we find that the timing of supervision is a key, yet underexplored, aspect of active test-time adaptation. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifaa/WISE-ATTA

AI.tldr: 论文提出预算感知的主动测试时自适应 (WISE-ATTA)，通过在线轻量信号决定何时请求标签，并采用基于漂移的样本选择标准，在极少标签下实现媲美甚至优于现有 ATTA 方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 ATTA 方法隐含假设每个测试批次都可获取监督，导致长序列测试中标注成本过高；实际场景中标签仅对少数批次可用，核心挑战从“批内选什么样本”转移为“跨时间决定何时请求监督”。
AI.method: WISE-ATTA 两阶段策略：(1) 预算分配阶段：利用在线计算的轻量信号（如模型不确定性、分布偏移指标）评估各批次监督价值，优先在适应动态未收敛、监督收益最大的时刻请求标签；(2) 批内样本选择阶段：基于适应动态漂移程度选择表现出持续、未收敛适应行为的样本，单标签即可实现有效更新。
AI.result: 在合成腐败 (ImageNet-C) 与自然分布偏移 (ImageNet-R/K/A) 上实验，WISE-ATTA 在大幅减少标签数量（仅需少数批次标签）的前提下，性能达到或超越近期 ATTA 基线。
AI.conclusion: 监督时机是主动测试时自适应中关键却未被充分探索的因素；通过预算感知的时序分配与漂移驱动的样本选择，可在极低标注成本下保持甚至提升自适应鲁棒性。

title: VStress: Correlation-Aware Auditing and Adaptive Budget Allocation for Repeated Verifiers
summary: Repeated verifier calls are useful only when they contribute conditional information. We introduce VStress, an auditable replay contract, and VStress-CA, a correlation-aware allocation policy that estimates the conditional marginal information of an unqueried verifier on a sealed calibration split, discounts uncertainty, normalizes by call cost, and stops or abstains when the next call is not informative. The controller freezes its decision and cost ledger before joining the clean oracle; a dependence-shift alarm disables channel preference and falls back to exact-stop. The controlled audit gives the mechanism boundary: at 35% symmetric corruption, majority-5 improves balanced accuracy from 0.6578 to 0.7739, whereas at 65% it loses 0.1226 points. In the matched fixed-budget comparison, breadth, redundancy, and adaptive allocation obtain balanced accuracies 0.6048, 0.6375, and 0.6538, with 3.4216 calls per item and an RLVR score of 0.6417 for VStress-CA. Dependence diagnostics also increase from same-model repeats to cross-family channels, with conditional marginal gains of 0.0126, 0.0462, and 0.0913. These measurements turn correlation from a post-hoc warning into an auditable allocation decision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VStress可审计重放契约和VStress-CA相关性感知分配策略，通过估计未查询验证器在密封校准分割上的条件边际信息、折扣不确定性、按调用成本归一化，并在下一调用无信息量时停止或弃权。实验表明：在35%对称损坏下，majority-5将平衡准确率从0.6578提升至0.7739；在65%损坏下损失0.1226点。固定预算对比中，广度/冗余/自适应分配的平衡准确率分别为0.6048/0.6375/0.6538，VStress-CA以3.4216次调用/项达到RLVR分数0.6417。依赖诊断显示从同模型重复到跨家族通道的条件边际增益分别为0.0126/0.0462/0.0913，将相关性从事后警告转化为可审计的分配决策。
AI.motivation: 现有多验证器调用策略忽略验证器间的相关性，导致重复调用无法提供条件信息，浪费预算且缺乏可审计性。需要一种能量化条件边际信息、动态停止并提供可审计决策边界的分配机制。
AI.method: 1) VStress：可审计重放契约，控制器在加入洁净预言机前冻结决策与成本账本。2) VStress-CA：相关性感知分配策略，在密封校准分割上估计未查询验证器的条件边际信息，折扣不确定性，按调用成本归一化，若下一调用无信息量则停止或弃权。3) 依赖偏移告警：检测到分布偏移时禁用通道偏好，回退至精确停止规则。4) 依赖诊断：量化从同模型重复到跨家族通道的条件边际增益。
AI.result: 在35%对称损坏下，majority-5将平衡准确率从0.6578提升至0.7739（+0.1161）；65%损坏下下降0.1226点。固定预算（3.4216调用/项）对比：广度策略0.6048、冗余策略0.6375、自适应分配0.6538，VStress-CA达RLVR分数0.6417。依赖诊断显示条件边际增益随通道多样性增加：同模型重复0.0126、跨家族通道0.0913，中间值0.0462。
AI.conclusion: VStress-CA通过将相关性量化为可审计的分配决策，在不同损坏水平下实现自适应验证器选择，证明条件边际信息估计优于盲目冗余或固定广度策略，为多验证器系统提供了理论与实践兼备的预算感知分配框架。

title: Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models
summary: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctness is readable, which internal signal families carry it, and how they should be combined. We search over hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream features, attention, and their fusion, treating the selected readouts as a predictive measurement rather than a mechanistic localization. We run this analysis separately in closed-book and with-context settings, since context can change which readouts are informative. A consistent anatomy emerges: correctness concentrates in the answer span, recovered from the answer tokens even under retrieval, and the families carry it complementarily, so fusing them helps most out of distribution, where a single signal is weakest. The protocol is effective across two backbones and gates a retrieval controller as one downstream use.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型内部信号对答案正确性的预测能力，发现正确性集中在答案跨度中，多种信号家族（隐藏状态、token概率、残差流特征、注意力）互补，融合它们在分布外场景下效果最好，该方法在两个主干模型上有效并可用于检索控制器。
AI.motivation: 现有探针通常依赖单一信号家族或层，在分布偏移下脆弱；检索增强场景下，专用检测器常针对段落忠实度，但忠实度可能因检索证据无帮助或冲突而与正确性偏离。因此需要系统探究答案正确性在何处可读、哪些内部信号家族携带正确性信息、以及如何最佳融合它们。
AI.method: 在冻结模型的单次前向传播中，搜索隐藏状态、token概率、残差流特征、注意力及其融合作为预测度量（而非机制定位）。分别在闭卷和带上下文两种设置下运行分析，因为上下文可能改变哪些读出信息量大。
AI.result: 一致的解剖结构显现：正确性集中在答案跨度，即使在检索设置下也能从答案token恢复；各信号家族互补携带正确性信息，融合它们在分布外场景下帮助最大（单一信号最弱时）。该协议在两个主干模型上有效，并可作为下游用例门控检索控制器。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确性可从模型内部单次前向传播的多种互补信号家族中读取，融合这些信号能显著提升分布外泛化能力，为可靠的正确性预测和检索增强决策提供了实用协议。

title: JudgeCast: Time Series Forecasting with Experience-Informed Covariate Judgements
summary: Covariate effects vary across contexts and shift over time, requiring forecasters to assess how to use them for each forecasting context. As forecasting proceeds, observations for earlier forecasts become available, providing feedback on past covariate use for subsequent forecasts. However, when multiple covariates act together, the forecast error reveals the numerical discrepancy from the observation but not how the covariates should have been used. We introduce JudgeCast, an experience-based framework for time series forecasting with covariates. Following the judgmental adjustment practice, a frozen TSFM provides the base forecast, while a frozen LLM uses the current context and relevant experience to adjust it. Within the adjustment, assessing covariate effects and determining the numerical adjustment serve distinct roles, so JudgeCast first forms explicit covariate-wise judgments and then determines the adjustment. After observation, JudgeCast uses the observed residual of the base forecast to reconstruct alternative judgments and evaluates the original and alternatives through their resulting adjustments. The best-performing decision is selected and retained as validated experience for subsequent forecasts. Across diverse real-world datasets, JudgeCast outperforms strong baselines. Ablations show that explicit covariate-wise judgment can improve forecast-time adjustment, while residual-guided experience construction yields more reliable forecasting gains than retaining raw decisions as experience.

AI.tldr: JudgeCast 是一种基于经验的时序预测框架，结合冻结的时序基础模型（TSFM）和大语言模型（LLM），通过显式协变量判断与残差引导的经验构建，实现协变量效应的动态调整与持续学习，在多个真实数据集上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 协变量效应随情境变化且随时间漂移，预测者需针对各预测情境评估协变量用法。历史观测虽提供反馈，但多协变量共同作用时，预测误差仅揭示数值偏差，无法指示协变量应如何被使用，因此需要一种能显式判断协变量效应并从残差中学习的机制。
AI.method: 1. 冻结的 TSFM 生成基础预测；2. 冻结的 LLM 结合当前情境与过往经验，先形成逐协变量的显式判断，再决定数值调整量；3. 观测到真实值后，利用基础预测的残差重构替代判断，评估原判断与替代判断产生的调整效果；4. 选取表现最好的决策作为验证经验保留，供下一轮预测使用。
AI.result: 在多样化的真实数据集上，JudgeCast 优于强基线。消融实验表明：显式协变量判断能改进预测时调整；残差引导的经验构建比直接保留原始决策作为经验能带来更可靠的预测增益。
AI.conclusion: JudgeCast 通过显式协变量判断与残差引导的经验验证循环，有效解决了协变量效应动态评估与从聚合误差中归因学习的难题，为带协变量的时序预测提供了一个可解释且持续改进的框架。

title: Generative Interactions: Weaving Multiparty Human Motion with Bilevel Latent Dynamics
summary: Human social behaviour is not a collection of independent motions, but a jointly organised process in which group dynamics and individual variation continuously shape one another. Yet existing social motion models often prioritise plausible trajectories while leaving interaction state implicit, limiting their ability to transfer across groups, tasks, and partial-observation regimes. To address this gap, we introduce Bilevel Representations for Agent Interaction Dynamics (BRAID), a hierarchical sequential latent-variable model for generative multi-person interaction. BRAID explicitly formulates social motion generation as a meta-transfer learning problem: shared interaction priors are learned across datasets and adapted through arbitrary context sets of observed people and joints. The model represents each scene through a group-level latent state that captures shared interaction dynamics and person-level latent states that capture individual behaviour conditioned on the evolving group context. This modelling choice enables coherent generation under full, sparse, or partial observations while exposing compact social-state vectors that can serve as an interface for downstream embodied-agent systems. We evaluate BRAID under a unified SMPL-based representation on social forecasting, tracking and in-filling, and response generation, using metrics that assess not only reconstruction accuracy but also realism, diversity, temporal alignment, and interpersonal coordination. We further analyse the hierarchical latent space, showing that it captures separable group- and individual-level structure.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 BRAID，一种分层序列潜变量模型，用于生成多人的交互动作。它将社交动作生成形式化为元迁移学习问题，学习跨数据集的共享交互先验，并通过观察到的人和关节的任意上下文集进行适应。模型包含群体级潜在状态（捕捉共享交互动态）和个体级潜在状态（捕捉条件于群体上下文的个体行为），支持全观测、稀疏或部分观测下的连贯生成，并提供紧凑的社交状态向量供下游具身智能体系统使用。在统一的 SMPL 表示下评估了社交预测、跟踪与补全、响应生成等任务，指标涵盖重建精度、真实感、多样性、时间对齐和人际协调。潜在空间分析显示其能分离群体级和个体级结构。
AI.motivation: 现有的社交动作模型往往优先生成合理的轨迹，但将交互状态隐式化，限制了其在不同群体、任务和部分观测条件下的迁移能力。人类社交行为是群体动态与个体变异相互塑造的联合组织过程，而非独立动作的集合。因此需要一种能显式建模交互状态、支持跨数据集迁移和部分观测下生成的层次化模型。
AI.method: 提出 Bilevel Representations for Agent Interaction Dynamics (BRAID) —— 一种分层序列潜变量模型。将社交动作生成形式化为元迁移学习：跨数据集学习共享交互先验，通过任意上下文集（观察到的人和关节）进行适应。模型包含两层潜在状态：群体级潜在状态捕捉共享交互动态；个体级潜在状态捕捉条件于演化群体上下文的个体行为。采用统一的 SMPL 表示，支持全观测、稀疏观测和部分观测下的连贯生成，并输出紧凑的社交状态向量作为下游具身智能体系统的接口。
AI.result: 在社交预测、跟踪与补全、响应生成任务上评估，使用重建精度、真实感、多样性、时间对齐和人际协调等指标。BRAID 在多种观测条件下均能生成连贯动作，且优于基线方法。层次化潜在空间分析表明，模型成功捕捉了可分离的群体级和个体级结构。
AI.conclusion: BRAID 通过显式的分层潜在状态建模，实现了跨群体、任务和观测条件的社交动作生成与迁移。其群体级与个体级潜在状态的分离设计，不仅提供了可解释的社交状态表示，还为下游具身智能体系统提供了紧凑的接口。该工作填补了现有模型在交互状态显式建模和迁移能力上的空白。

title: TaskBridge: Bridging Unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection and In-Context Learning via Virtual Tasks
summary: Unsupervised tabular anomaly detection (TAD) aims to identify anomalous rows in tabular data using normal training samples. While conventional methods rely on dataset-specific training and configuration search, recent tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable zero-shot anomaly detection on unseen datasets via in-context learning. Most TFM-based approaches, however, require anomaly-specific pretraining from scratch, making detection inherently dependent on synthetic TAD-specific priors and costly to update. Some approaches instead repurpose pretrained general-purpose TFMs for TAD to avoid this burden, but rely on computationally expensive formulations with restrictive anomaly inductive biases. In this work, we introduce TaskBridge, a new framework that efficiently repurposes pretrained general-purpose TFMs for unsupervised TAD by constructing virtual supervised tasks that directly recast anomaly detection as supervised in-context inference of TFMs. The resulting virtual tasks induce predictive structures under which normal queries and their target pairs receive high support, whereas anomalies tend to violate the induced structures and receive lower support, providing direct anomaly evidence. Across 790 real-world datasets, TaskBridge consistently outperforms 30 baselines, including state-of-the-art TFM-based approaches, without anomaly-specific TFM pretraining or dataset-specific model optimization.

AI.tldr: TaskBridge 是一个新框架，通过构建虚拟监督任务，将无监督表格异常检测重构为预训练通用表格基础模型（TFM）的监督上下文学习推理，无需异常特定预训练或数据集特定优化，在 790 个真实数据集上持续超越 30 个基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 TFM 的无监督表格异常检测方法要么需要从头进行异常特定的预训练（成本高、依赖合成先验），要么复用通用预训练 TFM 但依赖计算昂贵且具有限制性异常归纳偏置的方法。需要一种高效复用通用 TFM 且无需额外预训练的方案。
AI.method: 提出 TaskBridge 框架：构建虚拟监督任务，将异常检测重构为 TFM 的监督上下文学习推理。虚拟任务诱导预测结构，使得正常查询及其目标对获得高支持度，而异常倾向于违反这些结构并获得较低支持度，从而直接提供异常证据。
AI.result: 在 790 个真实世界数据集上，TaskBridge 持续优于 30 个基线（包括最先进的基于 TFM 的方法），且无需异常特定的 TFM 预训练或数据集特定的模型优化。
AI.conclusion: TaskBridge 通过虚拟任务构建高效复用通用预训练 TFM 进行无监督表格异常检测，消除了对昂贵异常特定预训练和数据集特定调优的需求，实现了强泛化性能和实际部署价值。

title: Context Language Models
summary: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evolved through a standard skill-optimization loop, improving held-out accuracy by up to 35.9 points on a context-management task while reducing compute. We also introduce an online reinforcement learning method for CLMs, improving Qwen3.5-9B performance on BrowseComp-Plus by 47.6% while using 12% fewer FLOPs. Finally, we co-design Suffix Cache Reuse for CLM serving, further reducing server-side compute by 35% relative to standard SGLang at matched performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文语言模型（CLMs），通过将上下文视为可自由编辑的文件，让模型原生管理自身上下文，在多任务上显著超越现有上下文管理策略，并支持指令引导与在线强化学习进一步优化，同时设计了后缀缓存复用机制降低推理算力。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型依赖外部工程化手段（如检索、截断、摘要）管理上下文，不仅僵化且计算开销大，难以自适应地保留关键信息，也难以在多智能体场景中自然共存。需要一种模型内生的上下文管理机制，使模型能自主决定保留什么、丢弃什么，并支持上下文学习与参数化学习相结合的策略演化。
AI.method: 1. 将上下文建模为可读写文件，赋予模型无限制的编辑权限（插入、删除、替换），实现原生上下文管理。2. 零样本直接部署现有模型为 CLMs。3. 引入自然语言指令引导上下文管理行为，并通过技能优化循环自动进化指令。4. 提出面向 CLMs 的在线强化学习方法，直接优化上下文编辑策略。5. 协同设计后缀缓存复用，利用上下文编辑的局部性特征在服务端复用 KV 缓存。
AI.result: 零样本 CLMs 在 BrowseComp-Plus 准确率 +11.4% 且 FLOPs -21.5%，在 12 小时 EdgeBench 得分 +5% 且 FLOPs -59%，在 24 小时多仓库智能体群任务中同算力提升 65%。指令引导使保留任务准确率最高 +35.9 点并降低算力。在线 RL 让 Qwen3.5-9B 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上性能 +47.6% 且 FLOPs -12%。后缀缓存复用在同性能下服务端算力再降 35%（相对 SGLang）。
AI.conclusion: CLMs 通过将上下文管理内化为模型固有能力，实现了更高效、自适应且可进化的长上下文处理，兼容指令引导与强化学习两条优化路径，并通过系统级缓存协同进一步释放推理效率，为长周期、多智能体、大规模代码库等复杂场景提供了通用且可落地的解决方案。

title: Equally Good, Yet Different: Benchmarking Rashomon sets in AutoML packages
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Automated Machine Learning 2026, ABCD Track
summary: The Rashomon effect describes the existence of multiple near-optimal models that achieve comparable performance while offering fundamentally different explanations. This creates a critical vulnerability in AutoML: x-hacking, the selective post-hoc choice of a model based on its explanation rather than predictive merit. No existing AutoML framework exposes this risk. We introduce ARSA ML, an open-source Python framework that quantifies Rashomon set structure and predictive multiplicity within AutoML pipelines. Using ARSA ML, we benchmark AutoGluon and H2O across 28 binary classification datasets, and conduct a post-hoc x-hacking analysis revealing a consistent structural asymmetry: AutoGluon produces larger, diverse sets with stable explanations, while H2O generates compact sets with markedly higher prediction divergence and explanation instability -- making H2O users considerably more exposed to x-hacking. This gap persists across all evaluated metrics and epsilon thresholds, pointing to a fundamental difference in each framework's model-building strategy. ARSA ML is available at https://pypi.org/project/arsa-ml/ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源框架 ARSA ML，量化 AutoML 流程中的 Rashomon 集合结构与预测多重性，在 28 个二分类数据集上对比 AutoGluon 与 H2O，发现 AutoGluon 生成的模型集合更大、解释更稳定，而 H2O 的集合更紧凑但预测发散度与解释不稳定性显著更高，导致 H2O 用户更易受事后解释选择攻击。
AI.motivation: Rashomon 效应导致多个近似最优模型存在本质不同的解释，这在 AutoML 中引入了 x-hacking 风险（基于解释而非预测性能事后选择模型），现有 AutoML 框架均未暴露或量化该风险，亟需一种工具来度量 Rashomon 集合结构并评估不同框架的脆弱性。
AI.method: 开发 ARSA ML Python 框架，计算 AutoML 流程产生的模型集合在不同 ε 阈值下的 Rashomon 集合大小、预测多样性与解释稳定性指标；以此在 28 个二分类数据集上对 AutoGluon 与 H2O 进行基准测试并进行事后 x-hacking 分析。
AI.result: 跨所有指标与 ε 阈值均观察到一致的结构不对称：AutoGluon 产出更大、更多样且解释稳定的模型集合；H2O 产出紧凑但预测发散度高、解释极不稳定的集合，使其用户显著更易遭受 x-hacking。
AI.conclusion: ARSA ML 成功量化了 AutoML 中的 Rashomon 集合结构与预测多重性，揭示了不同框架建模策略的根本差异导致的 x-hacking 暴露度差异，为 AutoML 的鲁棒性评估提供了新工具与实证基础。

title: Spatiotemporal Hyperedges for EEG Seizure Detection and Prediction
summary: Seizure detection and prediction from EEG are clinically important but challenging because seizures are rare, temporally localized, and propagate as coordinated events across multiple channels. Recent dynamic graph neural networks model this by running a temporal model over a sequence of per-time-step pairwise channel edges. However, this pairwise construction misses the spatiotemporal coupling that constitutes a seizure, at substantial training cost. We propose HyBrain, which summarizes spatiotemporal EEG evidence through a small set of soft hyperedges rather than pairwise edges. A per-channel Mamba backbone produces one token per (channel, second), and a spatiotemporal hyperedge block pools these tokens into E_h shared group embeddings through soft memberships and broadcasts them back. The same encoder serves three downstream tasks: window-based detection, one-second point-wise detection, and preictal seizure prediction. On TUSZ and CHB-MIT, HyBrain achieves the best AUROC on every reported setting against ten baselines, with the largest gap on long-clip preictal prediction. It also matches the most efficient baselines in training time and peak GPU memory. A qualitative analysis shows that even a single learned hyperedge cleanly captures the preictal -> ictal -> postictal trajectory on a real seizure clip.

AI.tldr: HyBrain 提出了一种基于超边的动态图神经网络，用于 EEG 癫痫发作检测与预测。它用少量软超边替代成对边，通过 Mamba 主干网络提取通道级 token，再经时空超边块池化为共享组嵌入，统一服务于窗口检测、逐秒检测和癫痫前期预测三大任务。在 TUSZ 和 CHB-MIT 数据集上，HyBrain 在所有报告设置中均取得最佳 AUROC，尤其在长片段癫痫前期预测上优势最大，同时训练时间和显存占用与最高效基线持平。定性分析显示单个学习到的超边即可清晰捕捉癫痫前期-发作期-发作后期轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有动态图神经网络通过逐时间步的成对通道边建模 EEG，但这种成对构造忽略了构成癫痫发作的时空耦合，且训练成本高昂。需要一种能显式捕捉多通道时空协同模式、降低计算开销并统一多任务的方法。
AI.method: 1. 每通道 Mamba 主干网络：为每个 (通道, 秒) 生成一个 token。2. 时空超边块：通过软隶属度将 token 池化为 E_h 个共享组嵌入（超边），再广播回各通道。3. 统一编码器：同一编码器同时服务于窗口级检测、逐秒点级检测和癫痫前期预测三个下游任务。
AI.result: 在 TUSZ 和 CHB-MIT 两个公开数据集上，HyBrain 对比十个基线方法，在所有报告设置中均获得最高 AUROC，长片段癫痫前期预测提升最显著。训练时间和峰值 GPU 显存占用与最高效基线相当。定性可视化表明，单个超边即可清晰描绘真实癫痫片段的癫痫前期→发作期→发作后期演化轨迹。
AI.conclusion: HyBrain 通过软超边建模多通道 EEG 的时空耦合，显著提升了癫痫检测与预测性能，尤其在长程预测任务上优势明显，同时保持了高计算效率。该方法为多通道生理信号的时空建模提供了新范式，且单超边的可解释性强，具有临床应用潜力。

title: Abductive World Modeling via Causal Representation Learning
summary: The central challenge of world modeling is to learn representations that capture how the world evolves. However, existing world models predominantly represent future states without explicitly capturing the latent causes underlying their evolution, limiting their ability to reason about why and how the world changes. To address this limitation, we propose Abductive World Modeling (AWM), a framework that learns structured causal representations by abductively inferring latent causes from predicted futures.
