Specifically, we realize AWM through the Hierarchical Abductive State Pyramid (HASP), which organizes the inferred world state into three complementary components - Entity, Dynamic, and Relation - capturing what exists, how it changes, and how entities interact, respectively. By jointly reasoning over the current observation and its predicted future, HASP abductively infers these latent factors and integrates them into a structured state representation for downstream reasoning. To the best of our knowledge, AWM is the first framework to introduce abductive state inference into latent-space world modeling for learning structured representations of world dynamics. Experiments across physical prediction, causal reasoning, and action understanding demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Compared with V-JEPA, a state-of-the-art latent-space world model, AWM improves physical prediction AUROC by 10.7%, causal reasoning accuracy by 16.8%, and action Top-1 accuracy by 68.0%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 Abductive World Modeling (AWM) 框架，通过层级推演状态金字塔 (HASP) 从预测的未来反推潜在因果因素，学习结构化的世界动态表示，显著提升物理预测、因果推理和动作理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型主要预测未来状态，但未显式捕捉驱动状态演化的潜在因果因素，限制了对世界变化的“为什么”和“如何”进行推理的能力。
AI.method: 提出 AWM 框架，核心是层级推演状态金字塔 (HASP)。HASP 将世界状态组织为三个互补组件：Entity（实体，捕捉存在什么）、Dynamic（动态，捕捉如何变化）、Relation（关系，捕捉实体间如何交互）。通过联合推理当前观测与预测未来，反演式推断这些潜在因子，并整合为结构化状态表示供下游任务使用。
AI.result: 在物理预测、因果推理、动作理解三类任务上优于 SOTA 潜在空间世界模型 V-JEPA：物理预测 AUROC 提升 10.7%，因果推理准确率提升 16.8%，动作 Top-1 准确率提升 68.0%。
AI.conclusion: AWM 是首个将反演式状态推断引入潜在空间世界建模以学习结构化动态表示的框架，通过显式建模潜在因果因素，显著增强了世界模型的推理与泛化能力。

title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context
summary: LLM agents performing long-horizon tasks accumulate tool results that later steps may need. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies. We develop Tool-Flow Analysis to track how later operations reuse information from earlier tool results, providing a signal called observed reuse. A renderer combines this signal with recency and semantic relevance to select results within a fixed history budget, retaining omitted results for later use. Across AppWorld and 8-objective QA with three execution models, ContextRender outperforms the evaluated context management baselines using a 6K history budget, well below the models' maximum context windows. Within this budget, it achieves task performance close to or above that of passing the full history while reducing mean inference cost by 10.2%-32.2% relative to Full history. Ablations show that observed reuse improves task performance and retention of results reused later.

AI.tldr: ContextRender 是一种针对 LLM 代理长时程任务的上下文管理方法，通过持久化执行依赖图和工具流分析跟踪工具结果的复用情况（观察到的复用），结合时效性和语义相关性在固定历史预算内选择保留的结果，实现了接近或优于全历史传递的任务性能，同时将平均推理成本降低 10.2%-32.2%。
AI.motivation: LLM 代理在长时程任务中会积累大量工具调用结果，后续步骤可能需要依赖这些结果。将完整历史传递给每次调用即使在上下文窗口允许范围内也成本高昂，而截断历史则可能遗漏关键信息。现有上下文管理方法往往忽略早期工具结果在后续执行中的实际复用方式，导致所需信息被排除在上下文之外。
AI.method: 提出 ContextRender，包含三大核心组件：1) 持久化执行依赖图，记录工具调用之间的依赖关系；2) 工具流分析，追踪后续操作如何复用早期工具结果，产生“观察到的复用”信号；3) 渲染器，将观察到的复用、时效性和语义相关性结合，在固定历史预算（6K tokens）内选择保留的结果，被省略的结果保留供后续使用。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 和 8 目标 QA 基准上，使用三种执行模型评测，ContextRender 在 6K 历史预算下（远低于模型最大上下文窗口）优于所有基线方法。在此预算内，任务性能接近或超过全历史传递，同时平均推理成本降低 10.2%-32.2%。消融实验表明，观察到的复用信号能显著提升任务性能和后续复用结果的保留率。
AI.conclusion: ContextRender 通过显式建模工具结果的跨步骤复用依赖，解决了长时程任务中上下文管理的关键难题：在严格预算约束下保留最关键的历史信息。该方法不仅降低了推理成本，还保持了高任务性能，为 LLM 代理的高效长时程执行提供了可落地的上下文管理方案。

title: VACE: Validation-Gated Alternating Co-Evolution of Agent Models and Harnesses
summary: Language model agents can be improved by updating their model weights or refining the harness that guides task execution. These components are coupled: weight updates change how the model uses the harness, while harness updates change the trajectories used for training. We propose VACE, Validation-Gated Alternating CoEvolution, which alternates agentic reinforcement learning with trajectory-driven harness refinement. After each RL stage, VACE reuses the collected trajectories to propose a harness revision and evaluates the incumbent and candidate with the updated model held fixed. The candidate guides subsequent training only if it improves validation performance. With Qwen3.5-9B, VACE achieves 45.26% test accuracy on OfficeQA and a mean partial-credit score of 75.19% on AutomationBench, exceeding weight-only RL by 6.43 and 9.09 percentage points and ungated alternation by 4.59 and 6.95 points, respectively. Across 44 harness proposals, 17 reduce validation performance at the updated checkpoint and are rejected before subsequent RL training, highlighting the importance of validation gating.

AI.tldr: VACE通过交替进行智能体强化学习和基于轨迹的harness优化，利用验证门控机制仅接受提升验证性能的harness修订，在OfficeQA和AutomationBench上显著超越仅权重更新和无门控交替基线。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体的改进通常涉及模型权重更新或harness（任务执行引导框架）优化，但两者耦合：权重更新改变模型使用harness的方式，而harness更新改变训练轨迹。现有方法往往单独优化或无验证地交替，导致次优协同。
AI.method: 提出VACE（Validation-Gated Alternating CoEvolution），交替进行：1) 智能体强化学习阶段更新模型权重；2) 基于收集的轨迹提出harness修订，在固定更新后模型下评估现有和候选harness，仅当候选提升验证性能时才采纳指导后续RL训练。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B上，VACE在OfficeQA达到45.26%测试准确率，在AutomationBench平均部分得分75.19%，分别比仅权重RL高出6.43和9.09个百分点，比无门控交替高出4.59和6.95个百分点。44次harness提议中17次因降低验证性能被拒，验证了验证门控的重要性。
AI.conclusion: VACE通过验证门控的交替协同进化有效解耦权重与harness优化，显著提升智能体性能，验证机制能有效过滤有害harness修订，为语言模型智能体的联合优化提供了实用范式。

title: LongSpark: Efficient speculative decoding with a fixed-cost parallel drafter
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target forward pass. However, as the context grows, existing state-of-the-art drafters become increasingly expensive, eroding the very efficiency advantage they are designed to provide. We argue that this scaling is unnecessary. A standalone language model must grow with its prefix because it is solely responsible for every token it produces. A drafter, by contrast, only proposes candidates; the target catches and corrects every error before any token is committed. The drafter's decoding cost can therefore be made entirely independent of the prefix length. We introduce LongSpark, a block-diffusion drafter that achieves this by extracting fixed-size, multiscale views from the target's verification pass, thereby eliminating the need for a growing persistent state. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that LongSpark achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end efficiency across multiple model scales and realistic serving conditions. Notably, it delivers the lowest time-per-output-token on long-context tasks while reducing the drafter's context state by several orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LongSpark，一种块扩散起草器，通过从目标验证过程中提取固定大小的多尺度视图，使起草器的解码成本与前缀长度无关，在长上下文任务上实现最低的每输出token时间，并将起草器的上下文状态减少几个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有的推测解码起草器随着上下文增长变得越来越昂贵，抵消了其设计的效率优势。论文认为这种扩展是不必要的，因为起草器只需提议候选token，目标模型会捕获并纠正所有错误，因此起草器的解码成本可以与前缀长度完全无关。
AI.method: 提出LongSpark，一种块扩散起草器，通过从目标模型的验证过程中提取固定大小的多尺度视图，消除了对增长持久状态的需求。
AI.result: 在多个模型规模和现实服务条件下，LongSpark实现了最先进的端到端效率；在长上下文任务上达到最低的每输出token时间，同时将起草器的上下文状态减少几个数量级。
AI.conclusion: LongSpark通过固定大小的多尺度视图设计，解决了推测解码中起草器随上下文增长的开销问题，为长上下文推理提供了高效的解决方案。

title: Cross-Entropy Guided Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) large language models scale model capacity by routing each token to a small subset of experts. Their routers are regularized with load balancing terms and learn affinity scores through the language-model objective. However, these objectives do not provide direct alignment between routing affinities and token-level error. We introduce token-error supervision for sparse routing in two forms. The first form predicts an error score per expert. The affinity-weighted aggregate of these scores is aligned to the next-token cross-entropy loss, while the individual scores attenuate affinity before top-$K$ selection. The second directly aligns the router's affinities to the model's objective without requiring an additional head or inference-time modification. Both formulations use the Itakura--Saito divergence or an exponential negative log-likelihood for aligning affinities and token errors. Across two sparse MoE backbones and four multiple-choice question-answering benchmarks, we evaluate both supervision mechanisms. On Granite, our method improves accuracy by approximately 2.3 percentage points on average over a parameter-matched routing baseline. With stronger supervision, the gain on ARC-Challenge reaches 2.94 points. Both mechanisms preserve the native sparse execution budget and aggregation policy. Our code is available in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: 本文针对稀疏混合专家模型中的路由机制提出两种token-level误差监督方法：(1)预测每个专家的误差分数并通过亲和力加权聚合对齐到交叉熵损失；(2)直接对齐路由器亲和力到模型目标。两种方法均采用Itakura-Saito散度或指数负对数似然进行对齐。实验表明在Granite模型上平均准确率提升2.3个百分点，ARC-Challenge上提升达2.94点，且保持原生稀疏执行预算和聚合策略不变。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏MoE模型的路由器通过负载均衡正则项和语言模型目标训练，但这些目标无法直接将路由亲和力与token级别的预测误差对齐，导致专家选择可能不够最优。
AI.method: 提出两种token误差监督形式：第一种为每个专家预测误差分数，亲和力加权聚合对齐到next-token交叉熵损失，个别分数在top-K选择前衰减亲和力；第二种直接对齐路由器亲和力到模型目标，无需额外头或推理时修改。两种均使用Itakura-Saito散度或指数负对数似然对齐亲和力与token误差。
AI.result: 在两个稀疏MoE骨干网络和四个多项选择QA基准上评估：Granite模型平均准确率提升约2.3个百分点；更强监督下ARC-Challenge提升达2.94点。两种机制均保持原生稀疏执行预算和聚合策略。
AI.conclusion: Token误差监督为稀疏路由提供了直接的亲和力-误差对齐，无需改变推理预算或聚合策略即可显著提升性能，两种监督机制均有效且实用。

title: Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training
summary: Recent approaches to reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models increasingly remove the critic to reduce training instability and memory overhead. Even where a critic is trained, it is discarded once training ends, although it has learned to predict outcomes. We revisit this trend and show that a pretrained critic's ability to predict future outcomes can make it a valuable asset for efficient long-horizon reasoning. First, we find that instability in critic-based RL for long chain-of-thought reasoning is largely an optimization artifact: keeping policy updates small and low in variance restores stable convergence. Second, a well-pretrained critic estimates the posterior probability of eventual success from later trajectory states and unfinished prefixes. Its predictions provide outcome-derived, dense, per-prefix learning signals that, during policy optimization, require neither completed rollouts, step-level annotations, nor external reward labels. Building on this insight, we introduce Reward-Free Policy Optimization (RFPO), which repurposes a single calibrated, frozen critic as a rollout-level reward, a value baseline for generalized advantage estimation, and a success forecaster for unfinished prefixes. We further show that binarizing the debiased score stops the policy from exploiting the critic's length bias. Binarized, RFPO matches supervised PPO without a single label in the training loop, while cutting compute and memory overhead. This makes RFPO well suited to long-horizon reasoning tasks, where outcomes arrive late and generation dominates cost: because rollouts can be rewarded before they finish, training no longer has to pay for waiting on every trajectory to complete. Our findings challenge the prevailing critic-free paradigm and establish critic-based, reward-free optimization as a scalable and computationally efficient path for LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了大语言模型后训练中无评论家（critic-free）的主流范式，提出了Reward-Free Policy Optimization (RFPO)方法。通过使用预训练并冻结的评论家模型，RFPO无需任何外部奖励标签即可实现与监督PPO相当的性能，同时大幅降低计算和内存开销，特别适合长链式推理任务。
AI.motivation: 当前RL后训练趋向于移除评论家以降低训练不稳定性和内存开销，但评论家学会了预测结果的能力在训练结束后被丢弃。作者重新审视这一趋势，发现预训练评论家预测未来结果的能力对长时程推理极具价值，且评论家导致的不稳定性主要是优化伪影，可通过控制策略更新幅度和方差来解决。
AI.method: 提出RFPO方法：1) 使用单个校准后的冻结评论家，同时作为轨迹级奖励、广义优势估计的价值基线、以及未完成前缀的成功预测器；2) 评论家提供稠密的、基于结果的、逐前缀的学习信号，无需完整rollout、步级标注或外部奖励标签；3) 对去偏评分进行二值化，防止策略利用评论家的长度偏差。
AI.result: 二值化后的RFPO在无任何训练循环标签的情况下匹配监督PPO性能，同时显著降低计算和内存开销。由于rollout可在完成前获得奖励，训练无需等待每条轨迹完全生成，极大提升了长时程推理任务的训练效率。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了基于评论家的无奖励优化作为LLM后训练的可扩展且计算高效的路径，推翻了无评论家范式的主流地位，为长链式推理任务提供了更实用的训练框架。

title: High-Resolution Dynamic Functional Connectivity Generation with Graph-Variate Flow Matching
summary:
High-resolution dynamic functional connectivity (DFC) can reveal rapidly evolving brain-network interactions, but short temporal windows yield noisy, often low-rank covariance estimates. Graph-Variate Dynamic (GVD) connectivity addresses this by modulating fast instantaneous interactions with stable trial-level support. This suppresses spurious fluctuations and emphasizes persistent, informative connections. We show that the Hadamard construction lifts low-rank instantaneous connectivity from the positive-semidefinite to the positive-definite cone, keeping high-resolution trajectories on the SPD manifold without ridge regularisation or post-hoc projection.
  We introduce GVD-CFM, a class-conditional generative model for high-resolution dynamic connectivity. Each trial is represented as SPD GVD matrices on a product Riemannian manifold, then mapped through a global log-Euclidean diffeomorphism and an invertible temporal DCT basis. A Transformer-based conditional flow models all spectral modes jointly and generates the full trajectory non-autoregressively in Euclidean coordinates while preserving exact correspondence with valid SPD sequences. Retaining the full DCT basis also enables decoding on denser temporal grids without retraining.
  Across multiple EEG motor-imagery datasets, GVD-CFM delivers the strongest overall results for held-out distributional fidelity, temporal-dynamics preservation, and synthetic-to-real classification. It also remains computationally efficient relative to strong raw-signal and direct GVD-space generative baselines. GVD-CFM therefore provides a practical framework for realistic, temporally coherent, high-resolution brain-network generation with preserved manifold structure and resolution-flexible decoding from a single trained model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GVD-CFM，一种基于流匹配的条件生成模型，用于高分辨率动态功能连接（DFC）生成。通过 Graph-Variate Dynamic (GVD) 连接构建稳定的 SPD 矩阵序列，结合 log-Euclidean 微分同胚与 DCT 基变换，在欧几里得空间中用 Transformer 条件流联合建模所有频谱模式，实现非自回归生成完整轨迹，且保持 SPD 流形结构与分辨率灵活解码。在多个 EEG 运动意象数据集上，该模型在分布保真度、时序动态保持、合成到真实分类及计算效率上均达到最优。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率动态功能连接能揭示快速演变的脑网络交互，但短时间窗导致协方差估计噪声大、常为低秩。现有方法需岭正则化或事后投影来维持 SPD 流形结构，且生成模型多为自回归或仅建模原始信号，难以同时保证流形几何、时序相干性与分辨率灵活性。
AI.method: 1. 用 Hadamard 构造将瞬时低秩连接提升至正定锥，得到无需正则化的高分辨率 SPD GVD 矩阵序列。 2. 将每个试次表示为乘积 Riemann 流形上的 SPD GVD 矩阵，经全局 log-Euclidean 微分同胚与可逆时域 DCT 基变换映射到欧氏空间。 3. 设计 Transformer 条件流模型联合建模所有 DCT 频谱模式，非自回归生成完整轨迹，并保持与有效 SPD 序列的精确对应。 4. 保留完整 DCT 基使模型可在更密集时间网格上解码而无需重训练。
AI.result: 在多个 EEG 运动意象数据集上，GVD-CFM 在保留分布保真度、时序动态保持、合成到真实分类三项指标上均显著优于强基线（原始信号生成模型、直接 GVD 空间生成模型），且推理速度更快、计算开销更低。
AI.conclusion: GVD-CFM 提供了一个实用框架，能在保持流形结构与分辨率灵活解码的前提下，从单一训练模型生成逼真、时序相干的高分辨率脑网络动态连接，为下游脑机接口与神经科学研究提供高质量合成数据。

title: OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells
summary: Artificial Intelligence Virtual Cells (AIVCs) are envisioned as scientific agents that simulate cellular responses, explain underlying mechanisms, and support hypothesis-driven discovery. Existing AIVC benchmarks, however, operate primarily at the simulation layer, motivating complementary evaluation of how models interpret experimental evidence and formulate biological hypotheses. We introduce OmniVCBench, a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark for the interpretation component of an AIVC. It contains 6,077 curated single- and multi-subfigure question--answer pairs derived from figures and experimental contexts in the scientific literature. Guided by Bloom's taxonomy, we instantiate interpretation-layer counterparts of the AIVC Predict--Explain--Discover agenda through three scientific reasoning tasks. We further introduce AIVC-Judge, a task-conditioned MLLM-as-a-judge framework with category-specific, reference-aware rubrics for evaluating open-ended responses. A complementary Model-Derived Hard-Negative Mining (MDHNM) strategy converts plausible errors observed during model inference into MCQ distractors for lower-cost evaluation. Within the evaluated heterogeneous model pool, MCQ accuracy correlates positively with AIVC-Judge scores, providing a complementary view of performance alongside open-response evaluation. Code and data demo are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/OmniVCBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmniVCBench，一个面向人工智能虚拟细胞（AIVC）解释层的基准，包含6,077个从文献图表和实验背景中策划的单/多子图问答对，基于布鲁姆分类法构建三大科学推理任务；同时引入AIVC-Judge（基于MLLM的任务条件评判框架）和MDHNM（模型衍生困难负样本挖掘）策略，实现开放式回答评估与低成本选择题评估的互补验证。
AI.motivation: 现有AIVC基准主要集中在模拟层，缺乏对模型解释实验证据、提出生物学假设能力的系统评估，亟需一个可溯源、面向解释层的综合基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1. 构建OmniVCBench：从科学文献中提取图表与实验上下文，策划6,077个单/多子图QA对，依据布鲁姆分类法设计预测、解释、发现三大推理任务。2. 开发AIVC-Judge：任务条件化的MLLM-as-a-judge框架，配备类别特定、参考感知的评分细则，用于评估开放式回答。3. 提出MDHNM策略：将模型推理中观察到的合理错误转化为选择题干扰项，实现低成本评估。4. 在异构模型池上进行实验，对比MCQ准确率与AIVC-Judge得分的相关性。
AI.result: 在评估的异构模型池中，选择题准确率与AIVC-Judge得分呈正相关，表明两种评估方式提供了互补的性能视角；AIVC-Judge能有效区分模型在开放式科学推理任务上的表现差异，MDHNM生成的干扰项具有较高迷惑性。
AI.conclusion: OmniVCBench为AIVC的解释层提供了首个大规模、可溯源、多任务的评估基准；AIVC-Judge与MDHNM的结合实现了开放式与选择题评估的互补验证，为未来AIVC模型的开发与比较奠定了标准化评价体系。

title: Multimodal Detection of Higher-Order Behavioral Constructs: Self-Compassion in Structured Reflective Interaction
summary: Many of the qualities that matter most in how people learn and grow, how someone regulates their emotions, reflects on a setback, or stays aware of others during a difficult conversation, are not directly observable. They have to be inferred from how someone speaks, moves, and sounds over time, and they resist the kind of clean labeling that most machine learning pipelines are built around. We study this challenge through a case that is well grounded in psychological theory but rarely modeled computationally: self-compassion, the tendency to respond to one's own setbacks with patience rather than harsh self-criticism. We examine how it appears during structured reflective interviews in a technology-mediated training setting, where people naturally talk through socio-emotionally demanding situations. Since no existing dataset captures this kind of construct in this kind of setting, we collected and annotated 51 reflective dialog sessions using an independent, temporally overlapping annotation scheme grounded in established theory. We consolidate the underlying six-component psychological model into a three-class supervision space, balancing self-kindness and mindfulness against self-critical or overwhelmed states, and build a reproducible window-based pipeline that aligns video, audio, and text on a shared timeline. Unimodal models trained on each modality separately are compared against a simple probability-level fusion strategy, which yields modest but consistent gains over the best single modality. We close by discussing where each modality succeeds or struggles, what this suggests about how this kind of construct is actually expressed in reflective speech, and what would be needed to model it, and constructs like it, more effectively.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在结构化反思访谈中通过多模态数据（视频、音频、文本）计算建模自我关怀这一心理建构，收集并标注了51个会话，提出窗口级流水线和概率融合策略，发现融合模型优于单模态。
AI.motivation: 许多重要心理品质（如自我关怀）无法直接观察，需从言语、动作、声音随时间推断，且抗拒简单标签，现有机器学习流水线难以处理，且缺乏此类场景下的数据集。
AI.method: 收集51个反思对话会话，基于六成分心理模型设计独立、时序重叠的标注方案，整合为三类监督空间（自我善意+正念 vs 自我批评/不知所措），构建可复现的窗口级流水线对齐视频、音频、文本时间线，训练单模态模型并对比概率级融合策略。
AI.result: 单模态模型各有优劣，简单概率融合带来适度但持续的提升；分析了各模态成功或挣扎的地方，揭示了自我关怀在反思性言语中的表达方式。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合有助于建模此类隐性心理建构，但仍需更有效的建模方法，未来工作需探索更细粒度的时序对齐、更丰富的标注及更强的融合架构。

title: NowcastDiT: Diffusion Transformers are Effective Precipitation Nowcasters
summary: Precipitation nowcasting demands accurate short-term forecasts under strong spatiotemporal variability. Diffusion models are well suited to modeling complex precipitation distributions, yet existing approaches often introduce increasingly specialized designs, leaving the capability of a standard diffusion architecture underexplored. We show that a standard Diffusion Transformer already provides a simple and scalable foundation for precipitation nowcasting, with domain-specific requirements accommodated naturally within its design space. Based on this principle, we develop NowcastDiT and instantiate this flexibility through two complementary adaptations: a dynamics-aware noise prior for temporally coherent forecasts, and end-to-end reinforcement learning with timestep-aware rewards for meteorological skill. Experiments on SEVIR and MRMS benchmarks show that NowcastDiT achieves state-of-the-art performance in both perceptual quality and meteorological skill. These results suggest that standard DiT can serve as an effective foundation for precipitation nowcasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NowcastDiT，基于标准Diffusion Transformer（DiT）构建降水临近预报模型，通过动态感知噪声先验和端到端强化学习实现最优感知质量与气象技巧。
AI.motivation: 现有降水临近预报扩散模型多采用专用设计，标准DiT架构的潜力未被充分探索；作者旨在验证标准DiT是否能作为简单、可扩展的基座，并自然融入领域需求。
AI.method: 构建NowcastDiT，采用两互补改进：1）动态感知噪声先验，保证时间相干性；2）基于时间步感知奖励的端到端强化学习，提升气象技巧指标。
AI.result: 在SEVIR和MRMS基准上，NowcastDiT在感知质量和气象技巧均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 标准DiT可作为降水临近预报的有效基础模型，通过少量领域适配即可超越专用设计。

title: Adam under Generalized Smoothness with Second-Moment-Type Stochastic Gradients
summary: Adam is widely observed to remain stable even when the objective deviates significantly from global smoothness. Under the generalized smoothness framework, however, existing analyses rely on strong tail assumptions on the stochastic gradients, such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity. Whether Adam converges on generalized smooth objectives under only second moment information on the stochastic gradients, without such concentration assumptions, was identified as an important open direction by Li et al. (2023). This paper gives an affirmative answer under fairly general conditions: such tail assumptions are not necessary. Building on the Adam self-normalization framework of Jin et al. (2026), developed for classical smoothness and bounded variance, we extend the stopping-time and de-preconditioning strategy to the $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smoothness condition and a generalized second moment ABC condition. Even when the stochastic-gradient condition provides only second moment information that may grow along the trajectory, the stochastic trajectory of Adam remains in a locally well-behaved smoothness region, with stretched-exponential tail decay under bounded variance and global smoothness. Consequently, we establish high-probability convergence rate guarantees over the full range $p<2$, with confidence dependence of order $δ^{-1/2}$, while the stepsize prefactor depends on $δ$ only through a single logarithmic factor. We further construct a hard instance showing that, under only second-moment information, this $δ^{-1/2}$-type confidence dependence is sharp. Finally, in the regime $p<1$, we combine the trajectory control with polynomial-growth estimates on rare events to obtain convergence rate guarantees in expectation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了Adam优化器在广义光滑目标下仅需二阶矩信息即可收敛，无需强尾部假设（如近乎必然有界或亚高斯性），填补了Li等人(2023)提出的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 现有广义光滑框架下的Adam分析依赖强尾部假设（近乎必然有界或亚高斯性）。Li等人(2023)指出：在仅有二阶矩信息、无浓度假设的情况下，Adam是否收敛是一个重要开放方向。
AI.method: 基于Jin等人(2026)的Adam自归一化框架（针对经典光滑性和有界方差），将停止时间和去预条件策略推广到$L_0$-$L_p$广义光滑条件和广义二阶矩ABC条件。即使随机梯度条件仅提供可能随轨迹增长的二阶矩信息，随机轨迹仍保持在局部良好光滑区域内，在有界方差和全局光滑下具有拉伸指数尾衰减。
AI.result: 建立全范围$p<2$的高概率收敛率保证，置信度依赖为$δ^{-1/2}$阶，步长前因子仅通过单一对数因子依赖$δ$；构造困难实例证明在仅有二阶矩信息下该$δ^{-1/2}$型置信度依赖是紧的；在$p<1$区域，结合轨迹控制与罕见事件多项式增长估计，获得期望意义下的收敛率保证。
AI.conclusion: 尾部假设并非Adam在广义光滑目标上收敛的必要条件，二阶矩信息足以保证收敛，且得到的置信度依赖在数量级上是最优的。

title: Trajectory Soup: Pushing the Compute-Scaling Frontier of LLM Mid-training via Diverse Trajectories
summary: Mid-training equips pretrained large language models with specialized and reasoning capabilities, but the returns of this stage are bounded since additional serial compute yields little further downstream improvement and can even degrade some capabilities, which places a practical ceiling on how much compute mid-training absorbs. We revisit how this compute should be allocated to a single run or multiple similar optimizations. We find that branches forked from a shared checkpoint under various controlled recipe reaches measurably different regions of parameter space, and establish a form of compatible diversity that extending one run cannot supply. Therefore, we introduce Trajectory Soup, which distributes a mid-training budget over several independent branches, and consolidates strongest checkpoints selected on validation through intra- and inter-trajectory averaging into a single model. A local bias and variance analysis separates the two averaging levels, showing that inter-trajectory averaging removes residual error beyond the reach of averaging within a trajectory, while checkpoint selection carries a bias that bounds how many checkpoints are worth merging. Across model scales, learning-rate schedules, token budgets, and trajectory counts, Trajectory Soup improves aggregate downstream performance over the strongest single-trajectory average under matched budgets and keeps improving as budgets expand, with the advantage preserved after an identical post-training pipeline. These results position trajectory allocation and merging as a practical way to extend the compute-scaling frontier of mid-training beyond serial saturation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Trajectory Soup 方法，通过将中间训练算力预算分配到多个独立分支并融合最优检查点，突破单一训练轨迹的串行计算饱和瓶颈，显著提升下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 中间训练虽能赋予预训练大模型专业化和推理能力，但单一轨迹的串行计算收益递减甚至退化，存在实际算力上限。研究发现从共享检查点分叉的不同配方分支能到达参数空间的不同区域，具有单一轨迹无法提供的兼容多样性。
AI.method: Trajectory Soup：将中间训练预算分配到多个独立分支，基于验证集选择各分支最强检查点，通过轨迹内平均和轨迹间平均两级融合合并为单一模型。通过局部偏差-方差分析分离两级平均的作用：轨迹间平均消除轨迹内平均无法触及的残差误差，检查点选择引入的偏差限制了可合并检查点的数量。
AI.result: 跨模型规模、学习率调度、Token 预算和轨迹数量，Trajectory Soup 在相同预算下优于最强单轨迹平均，且随预算扩展持续提升，优势在相同后训练流程后保持。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹分配与融合是突破中间训练串行计算饱和、扩展算力缩放前沿的实用方法。

title: Beam Search as Test-Time Self-Distillation via Counterfactual Contexts
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Towards Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
summary: Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) enables a language model to act as its own teacher: by conditioning on a demonstration, the model produces an implicit reward via pointwise mutual information, which guides on-policy learning without external supervision. However, SDFT operates at training time: it requires gradient updates and access to expert demonstrations, making it inapplicable at inference. We propose test-time self-distillation, a decoding-time method that extracts a steering signal from the self-distillation framework without any parameter updates, reward models, or training data. Our key insight is that counterfactual contexts, i.e. fixed textual templates that hypothetically prime the model for excellent versus poor reasoning, can substitute for the demonstration. The log-odds ratio of a candidate answer under these two counterfactual conditions defines a new reward signal. We derive the optimal KL-regularized policy under this reward, which takes the form of a Gibbs reweighting of the base distribution. Crucially, this reweighting is global: it cannot be decomposed into independent per-token operations without ignoring future trajectory quality. We therefore approximate the target distribution via beam search. Experiments on mathematical reasoning (MATH500), code generation (HumanEval), and graduate-level science QA (GPQA) across multiple model scales show that test-time self-distillation improves over standard sampling, low temperature, beam search and power sampling baselines on average, demonstrating that the self-distillation principle can be operationalized at inference time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了测试时自蒸馏，一种无需参数更新、奖励模型或训练数据的解码时方法，通过反事实上下文构造奖励信号，利用吉布斯重加权和beam search近似最优策略，在数学推理、代码生成和科学问答任务上优于标准采样、低温采样、beam search和power sampling等基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的自蒸馏微调（SDFT）需要梯度更新和专家演示，仅适用于训练阶段，无法在推理时直接应用。研究动机是将自蒸馏原理迁移到推理阶段，实现无需外部监督、无参数更新的推理时性能提升。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三步：1) 构造反事实上下文——固定的文本模板，分别激发模型的优秀推理和糟糕推理；2) 定义奖励信号为候选答案在两个反事实条件下的对数优势比；3) 推导KL正则化下的最优策略，形式为基础分布的吉布斯重加权。由于该重加权是全局的（无法分解为独立的逐token操作），使用beam search近似目标分布。
AI.result: 在MATH500（数学推理）、HumanEval（代码生成）和GPQA（研究生级科学问答）三个基准上，跨多个模型规模实验表明，测试时自蒸馏平均优于标准采样、低温采样、beam search和power sampling等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏原理可以在推理时通过反事实上下文和吉布斯重加权实现，无需训练数据、奖励模型或参数更新，为大语言模型推理时的性能提升提供了新的无监督范式。

title: A neural network that maintains and retrieves memories based on context
summary: Every day, people continuously infer situational context and adjust the way they understand and remember the world. Context, signaled by the prefrontal cortex, is known to modulate working memory and episodic memory, but the algorithmic understanding of this modulation remains limited. Here, we train a recurrent neural network (RNN), augmented with an episodic memory buffer, to infer context using Bayesian inference as it continuously makes predictions of upcoming scenes while watching naturalistic movies. When the inferred context modulates the RNN's recurrent connectivity (the basis of working memory) in a low-rank manner, the model's activity patterns best match neural responses in human participants who watched the same movies during fMRI. Context also modulates episodic memory retrieval, such that the model retrieves memories based on not only content similarity but also context similarity. This is implemented as a key-value system with self-attention, designed to additionally encode context and retrieve context-congruent memories. The resulting model not only better resembles human brain representations but also learns to retrieve memories like humans much faster than a model without context modulation. Together, our findings suggest a computational mechanism by which context modulates information maintenance and long-term memory retrieval in naturalistic environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种计算模型，利用贝叶斯推断推断情境，并以低秩方式调节RNN循环连接（工作记忆）以及通过情境感知的键值自注意力机制调节情景记忆提取，该模型能更好地匹配人类观看自然电影时的fMRI神经表征，并更快地学习类人记忆提取。
AI.motivation: 前额叶皮层发出的情境信号已知会调节工作记忆和情景记忆，但这种调节的算法层面理解仍然有限，特别是在自然情境下。
AI.method: 训练一个带有情景记忆缓冲区的循环神经网络（RNN），在持续观看自然电影并预测后续场景的过程中，使用贝叶斯推断实时推断情境。推断的情境以低秩方式调节RNN的循环连接（工作记忆基础），并通过编码情境的键值自注意力系统调节情景记忆提取，实现基于内容和情境相似性的检索。
AI.result: 情境调节模型的活动模式最能匹配观看相同电影的人类fMRI神经反应。情境使模型能基于内容和情境相似性提取记忆，且该模型比无情境调节模型更快地学会类人的记忆提取。
AI.conclusion: 情境通过低秩连接调节和情境感知的注意力检索机制，为自然情境下的信息维持（工作记忆）和长时记忆提取提供了一种计算机制。

title: Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance for Energy-Based Sampling
summary: Sampling from unnormalized distributions over large discrete state spaces becomes difficult when a multimodal target is far from a tractable reference. We introduce Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance (IEDG), a population-exact, trajectory-wise guidance framework for unnormalized discrete targets. Rather than learn the full reference-to-target correction in one step, IEDG introduces a global Boltzmann tilt along an annealing trajectory. Each stage learns a stage-local posterior correction for an incremental Boltzmann tilt of the current source, while the resulting corrections are accumulated relative to a fixed analytic posterior. At the population optimum, exact stage posteriors recover the correct reverse dynamics, whose exact simulation reproduces the target distribution. IEDG chooses stage increments by relative effective sample size (rESS), which controls Rényi-2 displacement and locally adapts the step size to the thermodynamic geometry of the annealing path. Our stagewise total-variation analysis shows that limited overlap amplifies Bregman fitting error by $1/\sqrt{\mathrm{rESS}}$, while posterior, simulation, and truncation errors enter additively. IEDG improves all distribution-level errors over the neural baselines on ordered, exactly enumerated Ising $4\times4$, while substantially reducing one-shot errors on Ising/Potts $16\times16$ across thermodynamic regimes and attaining the best neural-sampler result on several reported local-statistic and phase-coverage metrics. On Max-Cut, its best-of-512 and average-sample ratios exceed all the baselines. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/StillFantasy123/iterative-exact-discrete-guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出迭代精确离散引导(IEDG)，一种面向非归一化离散目标分布的总体精确、轨迹级引导框架。通过在退火轨迹上引入全局玻尔兹曼倾斜，分阶段学习局部后验修正并累积至固定解析后验，在总体最优时精确恢复反向动力学并复现目标分布。利用相对有效样本量(rESS)自适应控制阶段增量，理论分析给出了总变差误差界。实验在Ising 4×4、16×16及Max-Cut任务上显著优于神经基线。
AI.motivation: 在大规模离散状态空间上从非归一化多模态目标分布采样极具挑战性，尤其是当目标远离易处理参考分布时。现有方法往往试图一步学习完整的参考到目标修正，导致误差累积和泛化困难。需要一种能够逐步逼近目标、理论保证精确性、并能自适应调整步长的框架。
AI.method: IEDG沿退火轨迹引入全局玻尔兹曼倾斜，将整体修正分解为一系列阶段性的局部后验修正。每个阶段针对当前源分布的增量玻尔兹曼倾斜学习修正，并将修正累积到固定的解析后验上。在总体最优时，精确的阶段后验恢复正确的反向动力学，精确模拟即可复现目标分布。阶段增量由相对有效样本量(rESS)决定，控制Rényi-2位移并局部自适应热力学几何。理论上给出分阶段总变差分析：有限重叠放大Bregman拟合误差为1/√rESS，后验、模拟和截断误差加性进入。
AI.result: 在有序精确枚举的Ising 4×4上，IEDG改进所有分布级误差；在跨热力学区域的Ising/Potts 16×16上，大幅降低一次性采样误差，在多个局部统计量和相覆盖指标上达到最优神经采样器结果；在Max-Cut上，其best-of-512和平均样本比率均超越所有基线。
AI.conclusion: IEDG通过分阶段精确后验修正与自适应退火步长，实现了对大规模离散非归一化目标的理论保证精确采样，并在多个基准任务上展示了优于现有神经采样器的实证性能。代码已开源。

title: DIET: Deletion-response Expert Trimming for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) increasingly adopt mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures to reduce active computation, but their full expert storage remains costly. Existing one-shot pruning criteria mainly rely on static activation or routing statistics and cannot capture layer-level re-routing after expert deletion. We introduce DIET, a training-free expert pruning framework based on deletion responses. A single all-expert calibration pass records expert outputs and router states for matched conditional and unconditional tokens. Candidate deletions are then replayed from cached tensors, requiring no additional model forward passes. The resulting deletion-response signatures characterize each expert by the changes induced when it is removed. DIET selects retained experts by minimizing Overall Diversity Loss (ODL), which preserves directional coverage in signature space, and combines intra-layer local search with an inter-layer regression-guided budget search to allocate experts across layers. On LingBot-Video 30B-A3B, pruning 50% of experts (6,144 to 3,072) reduces the checkpoint from 57 GB to 30 GB and enables single-card deployment on a 48 GB GPU without fine-tuning. Under a fixed 284-case VBench protocol, the VBench Total increases from 0.7941 to 0.8115. Across tested retention budgets, DIET consistently outperforms competitive pruning baselines adapted from large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DIET，一种无需训练的专家剪枝框架，用于视频扩散 Transformer (DiT) 的混合专家 (MoE) 架构。通过基于删除响应的签名和整体多样性损失 (ODL) 选择保留专家，在不微调的情况下将专家数量减少 50%，显著降低存储并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 视频 DiT 越来越多地采用 MoE 架构以减少激活计算，但完整专家存储开销仍然巨大。现有的一次性剪枝准则主要依赖静态激活或路由统计，无法捕捉专家删除后的层级重新路由动态，导致剪枝效果受限。
AI.method: DIET 采用基于删除响应的无训练剪枝：1) 单次全专家校准前向传播，缓存专家输出和路由器状态（针对匹配的条件/无条件 token）；2) 从缓存张量重放候选删除，无需额外前向传播，获得删除响应签名；3) 通过最小化整体多样性损失 (ODL) 选择保留专家，保持签名空间的方向覆盖；4) 结合层内局部搜索和层间回归引导的预算搜索，跨层分配专家数量。
AI.result: 在 LingBot-Video 30B-A3B 上，剪枝 50% 专家（6,144 → 3,072）将检查点从 57 GB 降至 30 GB，支持单张 48 GB GPU 部署且无需微调。在固定 284 样例 VBench 协议下，VBench Total 从 0.7941 提升至 0.8115。在各种保留预算下，DIET 均持续优于从大语言模型迁移的竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: DIET 证明了基于删除响应的无训练专家剪枝在视频 DiT 上的有效性，通过捕捉专家删除后的动态重路由效应，实现了大幅存储压缩的同时保持甚至提升生成质量，为大规模 MoE 视频模型的高效部署提供了实用方案。

title: Hidden Reasoning Must Leak, but Need Not Be Readable: Fundamental Opportunities and Limits for Chain-of-Thought Monitoring
summary: Can reasoning models trick chain of thought (CoT) monitors and perform hidden computation without revealing it in their thinking traces? We show that the answer depends on the underlying task difficulty and the model size. Simple computations can be performed covertly; however, beyond a threshold depending on model size, successfully solving the task necessarily leaks a near-linear amount of information about the covert task input into the CoT. Therefore, sufficiently complex hidden computation always leaves an information-theoretic footprint. However, concerningly, this leakage need not be readable: Under plausible cryptographic assumptions, even a one-layer Transformer can encrypt its reasoning online so that no polynomial-time monitor can extract information about the hidden computation. Overall, our theoretical and empirical results provide a holistic view of both the opportunities and the limitations of CoT monitoring.

AI.tldr: 论文研究推理模型能否在思维链（CoT）监控下隐蔽执行计算，发现简单任务可隐蔽完成，但复杂任务会不可避免泄露线性量级信息；且在密码学假设下，模型可在线加密推理使监控器无法提取信息。
AI.motivation: 探究推理模型是否能在CoT监控下进行隐蔽计算，以及任务难度和模型规模对隐蔽性的影响，为CoT监控的有效性提供理论和实证分析。
AI.method: 结合信息论分析与密码学假设，理论证明任务复杂度超过阈值时CoT必泄露近线性信息量；同时构造基于单层Transformer的在线加密方案，在合理密码学假设下证明多项式时间监控器无法提取隐蔽计算信息。并通过实验验证理论预测。
AI.result: 1) 简单计算可隐蔽执行；2) 任务复杂度超阈值（依赖模型规模）时，成功求解必泄露近线性量级的隐蔽任务输入信息；3) 在密码学假设下，即使单层Transformer也能在线加密推理，使多项式时间监控器无法读取泄露信息。
AI.conclusion: CoT监控存在根本局限：复杂隐蔽计算虽留下信息论足迹，但该足迹可能不可读。这揭示了CoT监控在检测隐蔽推理方面的机遇与根本限制，提示需结合密码学手段增强监控鲁棒性。

title: Message Passing Does More with Less for In-Context Learning on Graphs
summary: Achieving strong performance with graph neural networks (GNNs) typically requires training and hyperparameter tuning for each dataset, incurring repeated costs and effort. Graph in-context learning (ICL) avoids this by using a single pretrained model to predict unknown node labels directly from labeled context nodes. Existing approaches, however, rely on dense attention across nodes, making inference increasingly expensive as graphs grow. In this work, we present Ephris, a new graph in-context learner built on sparse message passing, scaling linearly with the number of node-feature entries and graph edges. Ephris is pretrained entirely on synthetic graphs generated from structural causal models with diverse graph structures and relational dynamics, exposing the model to varied dependencies among topology, features, and labels. We evaluate Ephris on 51 node-classification datasets against 15 extensively tuned GNNs and existing graph ICL methods under both high- and low-label train/validation/test splits. Across both settings, Ephris ranks first on all four aggregate measures: Elo, improvability, average rank, and accuracy. Its inference cost remains comparable to training a single GNN once, while being over 10 times faster than previous graph ICL models. Together, these results advance the performance-runtime Pareto frontier, demonstrating that strong graph ICL does not require dense attention. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/nums-ai/ephris.

AI.tldr: Ephris 是一种基于稀疏消息传递的图上下文学习方法，在 51 个节点分类数据集上超越 15 个经过精调的 GNN 和现有图 ICL 方法，推理速度比之前的图 ICL 快 10 倍以上，且成本相当于训练单个 GNN 一次。
AI.motivation: 现有图神经网络需要针对每个数据集单独训练和调参，成本高昂；虽然图上下文学习可用单一预训练模型直接预测，但现有方法依赖稠密注意力，随图规模增长推理开销急剧增加，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出 Ephris，采用稀疏消息传递机制，复杂度随节点特征条目数和边数线性增长；在结构因果模型生成的合成图上预训练，覆盖多样的拓扑、特征与标签依赖关系。
AI.result: 在高/低标签两种划分下，Ephris 在 Elo、improvability、平均排名、准确率四个聚合指标上均排名第一；推理成本相当于训练一个 GNN 一次，比先前图 ICL 快 10 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 强图上下文学习不需要稠密注意力；Ephris 通过稀疏消息传递和因果合成图预训练，同时实现了最优性能与线性推理复杂度，推动了性能-运行时 Pareto 前沿。

title: Can a Cacheable Decision Model Follow Rules?
summary:
Certo is a small non-generative decision model (Qwen3-4B): it scores candidate actions from their text and returns a probability, instead of generating an answer. The accurate design reads the state, the rules, and each candidate together (a joint scorer), so cost grows with the menu. Independent encoding lets each candidate be encoded once and reused across states (about 5x cheaper at 77 candidates), but separates state from candidate. We ask how much rule-sensitivity survives that move, and whether it can be trained back.
  Four experiments on Certo: (1) the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity (recall@1 1.00 -> 0.24) while the joint scorer holds 1.00, and a shortlist+rerank rescue fails; (2) targeted counterfactual supervision restores strong performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks (paraphrase, counterfactual, composition; reproducible across seeds), though we do not isolate whether predictions depend on the supplied rule; (3) on real rules the added benefit is not established -- after fixing a truncation confound, the joint scorer wins significantly on the short tier (0.861 vs 0.500) and directionally on the hard tier (0.655 vs 0.483, n=29); (4) a matched cross-domain real-prose mixture did not help and reduced contract accuracy (-9.3, -16.2 points). A cacheable encoder can be made rule-sensitive on its training distribution, but transfer to unseen-source real rules is not established; the joint scorer keeps an edge at the cost of caching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Certo，一种基于Qwen3-4B的小型非生成式决策模型，对比了联合评分器（同时编码状态、规则、候选）与可缓存独立编码器的权衡。实验表明：独立编码虽节省约5倍计算成本，但严重损害规则敏感性（Recall@1从1.00降至0.24）；反事实监督可在合成任务上恢复性能，但真实规则下泛化能力未获验证，联合评分器在短/难任务上仍显著领先。跨域混合训练反而降低合同准确率。结论：可缓存编码器仅在训练分布内具规则敏感性，未见迁移至未见真实规则的证据。
AI.motivation: 研究非生成式决策模型中，计算效率（可缓存独立编码）与规则敏感性（联合建模状态-规则-候选交互）之间的根本权衡。旨在量化独立编码导致的规则敏感性损失，探索通过反事实监督能否恢复，并评估在真实规则下的泛化能力。
AI.method: 1. 构建Certo模型（Qwen3-4B），对比联合评分器与独立编码器（候选预编码缓存）两种架构。2. 四项实验：(1) 测量转向可缓存评分的规则敏感性损失；(2) 引入针对性反事实监督，在合成规则任务（改写、反事实、组合）上评估恢复效果；(3) 修正截断混淆后，在真实规则上对比两模型；(4) 引入匹配的跨域真实语料混合训练，测试迁移增益。指标为Recall@1及准确率。
AI.result: (1) 独立编码导致Recall@1从1.00骤降至0.24，联合评分器保持1.00，短名单+重排无法挽救。(2) 反事实监督在保留合成任务上恢复强性能（可复现），但未隔离预测是否真依赖提供规则。(3) 修正截断后，联合评分器在短任务显著胜出（0.861 vs 0.500），在难任务方向性领先（0.655 vs 0.483, n=29）。(4) 跨域混合训练无益，反降合同准确率-9.3/-16.2点。
AI.conclusion: 可缓存独立编码器仅能在训练分布内获得规则敏感性，其向未见来源真实规则的迁移能力未获确立；联合评分器虽放弃缓存优势，但在规则敏感性上保持显著优势。实际部署需在成本与规则遵循可靠性间权衡。

title: A Comprehensive View of Fairness through Distributional Stability
summary: We view fairness as a property of distributional stability. Rather than assessing a predictor under a fixed data distribution, we study how its predictions change under perturbations that modify the composition of protected groups. A predictor is fair if it remains stable under such shifts. Under this perspective, several classical notions of fairness arise as stability with respect to specific perturbations, with the associated unfairness gap given by a Lipschitz constant of a prediction-rate functional. This formulation also yields guarantees that hold uniformly over a range of demographic compositions at test time, without requiring knowledge of the deployment distribution. It leads to a learning procedure based on convex combinations of reweighted predictors, formulated as a second-order cone program, for which we establish generalization bounds. Experiments on standard benchmarks illustrate the approach.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将公平性视为分布稳定性的一种属性，研究预测器在受保护群体构成扰动下的稳定性，将经典公平性概念统一为特定扰动下的稳定性，并提出基于凸组合重加权预测器的学习算法，表述为二阶锥规划问题。
AI.motivation: 传统公平性评估通常假设固定的数据分布，但在实际部署中，人口统计学构成可能发生变化。论文旨在建立一种不依赖部署分布先验知识、能在多种人口统计学构成下提供一致公平性保证的理论框架。
AI.method: 将公平性定义为预测器在受保护群体分布扰动下的稳定性，利用预测率泛函的Lipschitz常数量化不公平性差距；提出基于重加权预测器凸组合的学习过程，将其表述为二阶锥规划（SOCP）优化问题，并建立泛化误差界。
AI.result: 理论上证明了该框架能统一多种经典公平性概念（如人口统计学平等、机会均等等），提供在测试时对一系列人口统计学构成均成立的均一性保证；实验在标准基准上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 从分布稳定性角度重新定义公平性，提供了一种分布无关的鲁棒公平性学习框架，具有理论保证和实际可行性，为处理部署时分布偁移下的公平性问题提供了新范式。

title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization
summary: Harness optimization provides a practical setting for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where agent-generated modifications inform subsequent changes through execution feedback. Recent work such as Meta-Harness implements this process through iterative code generation and evaluation, but retains a fixed development set and proposal policy. These constraints channel evolution along a single search trajectory, increasing the risk of converging to a local optimum. We make the improvement process itself adaptive by organizing search into branches with evolving development subsets and proposal policies. Each branch retains development cases solved by more of its leading harnesses than by those of other branches, drops cases solved by every leading harness across all branches, and revises its proposal policy using its own search history. To deploy the resulting complementary harnesses, we propose a router to select one development-selected branch head for each new input before execution. Across mathematical reasoning and agentic coding benchmarks, our system achieves relative improvements over Meta-Harness of 34.8% on Olympiad-level mathematical reasoning, 11.6% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 3.8% on SWE-bench Lite, with harness selection and router configuration based solely on development data. These results show that evolving branch objectives and proposal policies can yield complementary harnesses whose strengths a router combines without access to test outcomes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种自适应的 harness 优化框架，通过分支搜索演化开发子集和提案策略，并利用路由器组合互补 harness，在数学推理和代理编码基准上显著超越 Meta-Harness。
AI.motivation: 现有的 Meta-Harness 采用固定的开发集和提案策略，导致搜索轨迹单一，易陷入局部最优；需要一种能自适应演化搜索目标与策略的方法以获得互补的 harness。
AI.method: 将搜索组织为多个分支，每个分支维护动态演化的开发子集与提案策略：保留该分支领先 harness 解决而其他分支较少解决的案例，丢弃所有分支领先 harness 均能解决的案例，并利用自身搜索历史修订提案策略。部署时训练路由器根据开发数据为每个新输入选择一个分支的最优 harness。
AI.result: 在奥林匹克级数学推理、Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 SWE-bench Lite 上，相对 Meta-Harness 分别提升 34.8%、11.6% 和 3.8%；harness 选择与路由器配置仅基于开发数据，无需测试集信息。
AI.conclusion: 演化分支目标与提案策略能产生互补的 harness，路由器可在无测试结果的情况下组合其优势，验证了自适应分支搜索对递归自我改进的有效性。

title: Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation: Mitigating the Deliberation Drift Cliff in Test-Time Compute Scaling
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and evaluation artifacts available
summary: Test-time compute scaling has emerged as a cornerstone of advanced machine reasoning, yet performing iterative deliberation directly within continuous latent representation spaces reveals a catastrophic pathology: the Deliberation Drift Cliff. While unconstrained recurrent latent models achieve initial reasoning gains at short horizons (K <= 4), their reasoning collapses when extrapolated to deeper thinking steps (K >= 16), dropping by 22% to 62% across standard logical benchmarks. We resolve the trilemma among expressivity, Lyapunov stability, and computational efficiency in test-time latent reasoning through a 22-round empirical and theoretical investigation. We demonstrate that strictly conservative scalar potential gradient flows suppress long-range drift (cliff 3.40%) but bottleneck peak reasoning accuracy at 32.73%, whereas unconstrained rotational flows achieve high symbolic expressivity (82.33%) but suffer a severe 36.87% drift cliff. To resolve this geometric duality, we establish Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD) and propose the Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD). DG-HHD parameterizes the attracting flow as a tangent projection tensor network while orthogonally decoupling non-zero circulation (Hodge machine error 1.65e-17, contraction error 5.55e-17), eliminating runtime autograd dependencies to achieve 1.84x vector field and 2.09x RK45 rollout speedups. In a 15-arm symmetrical Pareto benchmark, DG-HHD achieves 58.67% peak accuracy (+25.94% absolute gain over conservative HHD) and retains 35.27% at K=32. Transferred to small language model (SLM) multi-hop causal reasoning, DG-HHD delivers monotonic compute scaling (49.33% to 51.56%) and suppresses out-of-distribution drift (cliff -0.66%). All 30 Level 0 deterministic invariants are certified.

AI.tldr: 该论文解决了测试时计算扩展中的“审议漂移悬崖”问题，提出了基于Port-Hamiltonian的隐空间审议框架（PH-LD）和直接梯度纯张量亥姆霍兹-霍奇分解（DG-HHD），在保持长程稳定性的同时实现了高推理表达力和计算效率。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算扩展是高级机器推理的核心，但在连续隐空间中直接进行迭代审议会遭遇灾难性的‘审议漂移悬崖’：无约束循环隐模型在短步长（K<=4）有初始收益，但外推到深度思考步（K>=16）时推理能力崩塌，在标准逻辑基准上下降22%-62%。需要解决表达力、李雅普诺夫稳定性和计算效率的三难困境。
AI.method: 提出Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD)框架和Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD)。DG-HHD将吸引流参数化为切投影张量网络，正交解耦非零环量（霍奇机器误差1.65e-17，收缩误差5.55e-17），消除运行时autograd依赖，实现向量场1.84倍和RK45展开2.09倍加速。
AI.result: 在15臂对称帕累托基准上，DG-HHD达到58.67%峰值准确率（比保守HHD绝对提升25.94%），在K=32保持35.27%。迁移到小语言模型（SLM）多跳因果推理，实现单调计算扩展（49.33%到51.56%）并抑制分布外漂移（悬崖-0.66%）。所有30个Level 0确定性不变量通过认证。
AI.conclusion: DG-HHD成功解决了隐空间审议中的几何二律背反，在长程稳定性、表达力和计算效率之间实现了最优权衡，为测试时计算扩展提供了理论和实践上可靠的解决方案。

title: RL-PaO: Prediction as Action in Decision Making under Uncertainty
summary: Decision-making under uncertainty often relies on predicted parameters, yet accurate prediction does not necessarily lead to good operational decisions. Aligning prediction with downstream optimization requires learning from the consequences of the decisions those predictions induce. We introduce RL-PaO, a reinforcement learning framework that integrates system formulation, optimization, and decision execution into a single environment. This yields a Markov decision process in which prediction is regarded as action: it shifts the environment to produce subsequent context and reward that explicitly aligns prediction error with realized cost, and learning the optimal policy does not require differentiating through the black-box solver. We evaluate RL-PaO on day-ahead energy scheduling using real historical data. On the test year, RL-PaO achieves the lowest annual cost among the non-oracle baselines, achieving on average $10\%$ cost reduction. Moreover, RL-PaO is capable of further analyses to provide strong interpretability both from the policy evolution perspective and the cost-accuracy trade-off.

AI.tldr: RL-PaO 是一种强化学习框架，将预测视为动作，通过整合系统建模、优化求解与决策执行，实现预测误差与实际成本的显式对齐，在日前能源调度任务上平均降低 10% 成本。
AI.motivation: 在不确定性决策中，准确的预测并不一定能带来良好的运营决策；需要将预测与下游优化对齐，通过决策后果反馈来学习预测，而非单纯追求预测精度。
AI.method: 提出 RL-PaO 框架，将系统建模、优化求解器与决策执行整合为单一环境，构建马尔可夫决策过程，把预测作为动作，环境根据预测产生后续上下文与奖励，显式对齐预测误差与实际成本，且无需对黑盒求解器求导即可学习最优策略。
AI.result: 在真实历史数据的日前能源调度实验中，RL-PaO 在测试年度实现非神谕基线中最低年成本，平均成本降低 10%；同时支持从策略演化与成本-精度权衡两个维度提供强解释性。
AI.conclusion: RL-PaO 成功弥合预测与优化的鸿沟，为不确定性决策提供了一种端到端可学习、可解释的新范式。

title: Active Budget Can Kill Sensitivity: Diagnosing and Repairing TopK Sparse Autoencoder Reliability
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly scaled to wider dictionaries to recover fine-grained structure from large language model activations. However, a feature is useful for interpretation only if it remains a stable unit of analysis when the same meaning is expressed in different surface forms. We study this reliability question for TopK SAEs via feature sensitivity. Experiments demonstrate that scaling selectively reduces the sensitivity of rare features, while common features remain comparatively stable. A controlled width\(\times k\) factorial experiment identifies the active budget k as the root cause: the degradation arises from the selection boundary rather than dictionary width alone. We attribute this failure to the geometry of TopK selection. The active margin, the distance to the cutoff, predicts feature loss without thresholds. Guided by this margin diagnosis, we introduce pairwise rank stabilization. Our method targets ordering failures at the cutoff and improves rare-feature sensitivity by \(8.83\) percentage points, while keeping reconstruction and alive-feature coverage near the baseline. Overall, our results suggest that wide TopK SAEs should be evaluated not only by reconstruction, sparsity, and feature count, but also by feature reliability under semantic variation and boundary geometry for stable interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 TopK 稀疏自编码器（SAE）在语义变体下的特征敏感性问题，发现扩大字典宽度会选择性降低罕见特征的稳定性，根本原因是 TopK 选择边界的几何特性而非宽度本身。提出基于激活边距的成对秩稳定化方法，在保持重构和覆盖率的前提下，将罕见特征敏感性提升 8.83 个百分点，并主张评估宽 TopK SAE 时需引入特征可靠性与边界几何指标。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器被广泛用于从大语言模型激活中提取细粒度特征，但特征只有在不同表层形式下保持稳定才具备解释价值。现有工作多关注重构误差、稀疏度和特征数量，缺乏对语义变体下特征可靠性的系统研究。
AI.method: 1. 通过控制字典宽度 × 激活预算 k 的因子实验，隔离出 k 为导致罕见特征敏感性下降的根因；2. 分析 TopK 选择边界的几何性质，定义激活边距（到截断阈值的距离）作为无阈值的特征丢失预测指标；3. 基于边距诊断，设计成对秩稳定化机制，专门修正截断边界处的排序失效。
AI.result: 实验表明：扩大宽度仅降低罕见特征敏感性，常见特征保持稳定；激活边距能准确预测特征丢失；成对秩稳定化使罕见特征敏感性提升 8.83 个百分点，同时重构误差和存活特征覆盖率维持基线水平。
AI.conclusion: 宽 TopK SAE 的评估不应局限于重构、稀疏度和特征计数，必须纳入语义变体下的特征可靠性及选择边界几何指标，以保障解释的稳定性。

title: Risk-Controlled Selective LLM Answering by Pricing Label-Free Checks
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. Dongyub Jude Lee and Jungseob Lee contributed equally
summary: Serving an answer from a large language model requires deciding when to abstain, yet a verifier's ranking accuracy alone does not determine the error rate among served answers. We introduce PriceCheck, which builds a compact family of decision rules from label-free checks such as re-solving a problem. Each check has a price: its agreement rates on correct and incorrect answers and its cost per run. Prices fitted on a small, class-enriched labelled set compose into predictions of a schedule's coverage and cost, guiding which checks to run and when to stop. A calibration test then selects a schedule at a stated selective-risk target. In mathematics, the selected schedules serve 76.1% of answers on average and keep held-out selective risk below 1.5% on all 15 splits. Under the shared testing protocol, PriceCheck serves more answers at that target than reward models, a prompted judge, the generator's confidence and a trained correctness classifier. At matched coverage, it keeps the fewest wrong answers among these scorers. Across 118 diagnostic schedules, price-based coverage predictions have a rank correlation of 0.97 with observed coverage. These results show that choosing how checks are combined and stopped matters alongside how well a verifier ranks answers. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PriceCheck.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PriceCheck框架，通过为无标签检查（如重新解题）分配“价格”（正确/错误答案上的同意率及运行成本），在小规模标注集上拟合价格并组合预测调度的覆盖率与成本，指导检查选择与停止策略，再经校准测试在给定选择性风险目标下选出最优调度。实验显示在数学任务上平均服务76.1%答案且保持选择性风险<1.5%，优于奖励模型、提示判断器、生成器置信度及训练分类器；价格预测覆盖率与观测覆盖率秩相关达0.97，证明检查的组合与停止策略与验证器排序能力同等关键。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型服务答案时需决定何时弃权，但验证器的排序准确性无法直接决定服务答案的错误率，现有方法缺乏对检查组合与停止策略的系统性优化。
AI.method: 提出PriceCheck：从无标签检查（如重新解题）构建紧凑决策规则族；为每个检查定义价格——在正确/错误答案上的同意率及单次运行成本；在小规模、类别丰富的标注集上拟合价格，组合预测调度的覆盖率与成本，指导运行哪些检查及何时停止；最后用校准测试在给定选择性风险目标下选出调度。
AI.result: 数学任务中，选定调度平均服务76.1%答案，在所有15个数据分割上保持保留集选择性风险<1.5%。同协议下，PriceCheck在该风险目标下服务答案更多，优于奖励模型、提示判断器、生成器置信度和训练正确性分类器；在匹配覆盖率下保留最少错误答案。118个诊断调度中，基于价格的覆盖率预测与观测覆盖率秩相关系数为0.97。
AI.conclusion: 检查的组合方式与停止策略的选择，与验证器对答案的排序能力一样重要；PriceCheck通过价格机制实现了高效、可控的选择性生成，代码已开源。

title: Beyond Compression: Diagnosing How Post-Training Changes Mathematical Reasoning
comment: 18 pages, 17 figures, 10 tables. Includes technical appendix. Under review
summary: Post-training is central to mathematical reasoning in modern large language models (LLMs), but endpoint pass@1 alone underidentifies what has changed. Gains may reflect newly reachable solutions, cheaper sampling of latent solutions, surface robustness, or memorisation. We compare three post-training paths under a common diagnostic readout: our sufficiently trained off-policy distillation trajectories, released Qwen3 off-policy-plus-on-policy distillation endpoints, and a released DeepSeek-Math endpoint trained with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO). Our probe uses cross-surface pass@K over verbatim prompts, paraphrases, numerical isomorphisms, and translations, plus consistency, distribution-shape, and verified supervised-fine-tuning (SFT) membership analyses. We find two regimes. On easier AMC problems, large-K ceilings are near saturation, so post-training mainly compresses sample cost. On harder AIME problems, post-training expands the large-K ceiling over the base model: sufficient off-policy distillation already raises this ceiling, Qwen3 released endpoints raise it further, and DeepSeek-Math GRPO does not dominate sufficient off-policy distillation at large K. English-dominant distillation improves non-English reasoning but preserves language-tier gaps. A controlled-overfit audit finds limited sensitivity in current SFT-membership probes. Compression is one regime of post-training, not a universal explanation.

AI.tldr: 论文通过对比三种后训练路径，发现数学推理的后训练存在两种机制：在简单问题（AMC）上主要压缩采样成本，在困难问题（AIME）上扩展大K上限；充分的离线策略蒸馏已能提升上限，Qwen3进一步提升，而DeepSeek-Math GRPO在大K下不占优；英语主导的蒸馏改善非英语推理但保留语言层级差距；当前SFT成员探针敏感度有限；压缩只是后训练的一种模式，非普遍解释。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型数学推理的后训练核心在于endpoint pass@1，但该指标无法充分识别模型发生了何种变化。性能提升可能源于新可达解、潜在解的更廉价采样、表层鲁棒性或记忆化。需要更细粒度的诊断来区分这些机制。
AI.method: 统一诊断读出下对比三条后训练路径：充分训练的离线策略蒸馏轨迹、发布的Qwen3离线+在线策略蒸馏端点、发布的DeepSeek-Math GRPO端点。探针使用跨表面pass@K（逐字提示、改写、数值同构、翻译）、一致性、分布形状、验证过的SFT成员资格分析。
AI.result: 发现两种机制：(1) 简单AMC问题上大K上限近饱和，后训练主要压缩采样成本；(2) 困难AIME问题上后训练扩展大K上限。充分离线蒸馏已提升上限，Qwen3进一步提升，DeepSeek-Math GRPO在大K下不优于充分离线蒸馏。英语主导蒸馏改善非英语推理但保留语言层级差距。受控过拟合审计显示当前SFT成员探针敏感度有限。
AI.conclusion: 后训练并非单一的“压缩”机制；在困难问题上能真正扩展模型可达解空间。不同后训练策略在大K下表现不同，离线蒸馏已具强效，GRPO不一定在大K下占优。语言层级差距依然存在。当前SFT污染检测方法有待改进。

title: Co-PiLOT: Constrained Physics-Informed Latent Optimization for Target-Driven Inverse Design
summary: Inverse design of physical systems (molecules, devices, microstructures) often reduces to optimizing a high-dimensional structure against an expensive black-box simulator. Direct search is difficult because the space is non-Euclidean, feasibility is hard to encode, and each evaluation is expensive. We present Co-PiLOT, a latent optimization approach that maps candidates through a generative encoder-decoder, uses the decoder as a learned validity prior, and searches the latent space with physics-informed black-box optimization. The framework is applied on the inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture. We develop a vision transformer based-encoder; paired with latent diffusion, diffusion transformer and rectified-flow transformer-based decoders on $\sim80{,}000$ EBSD-derived microstructure dataset to learn a minimal bottleneck, $z$. The ViT-FMDiT model ($z$=$768$) reconstructs high-fidelity microstructure images (FID $27.86$, MS-SSIM $0.178$), which our self-segmenting orientation codec converts into input grids for crystal plasticity solver. Finally, we introduce MERIDIAN, an active latent optimizer driven by deep-kernel Gaussian-process uncertainty, failure-aware feasibility prediction, manifold-aware trust regions, and target-aware acquisition. Within a budget of $160$ simulations, the ViT-FMDiT and MERIDIAN combination yields the best target-driven objective score, reducing the relative target error by $3$--$22\%$ against seven baselines (DANTE, TuRBO, BAxUS, CMA-ES, DDOM, SEIKO, DDPO) on the same decoder.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Co-PiLOT 框架，结合 ViT-FMDiT 生成模型与 MERIDIAN 潜在空间优化器，实现镁合金微观结构/织构的逆向设计，在仅 160 次模拟预算下，相对目标误差比七种基线方法降低 3%–22%。
AI.motivation: 物理系统（分子、器件、微观结构）的逆向设计常归结为在昂贵黑盒模拟器上优化高维结构。直接搜索困难，因为空间非欧几里得、可行性难编码、单次评估代价高。
AI.method: 1. 训练 ViT 编码器与扩散/修正流 Transformer 解码器（ViT-FMDiT），在约 8 万张 EBSD 微观结构图像上学习 768 维潜在瓶颈 z，重建高保真图像（FID 27.86，MS-SSIM 0.178）。2. 自分割取向编解码器将重建图像转为晶体塑性求解器输入网格。3. 提出 MERIDIAN 主动潜在优化器：深核高斯过程不确定性、感知失效的可行性预测、流形感知信任域、目标感知采集函数。
AI.result: 在 160 次模拟预算内，ViT-FMDiT + MERIDIAN 组合获得最优目标驱动目标分数，相对目标误差比 DANTE、TuRBO、BAxUS、CMA-ES、DDOM、SEIKO、DDPO 七种基线降低 3%–22%。
AI.conclusion: Co-PiLOT 通过生成式编码器-解码器学习有效性先验，配合物理信息黑盒优化在潜在空间搜索，成功解决了高维、非欧几里得、昂贵模拟的逆向设计难题，在镁合金微观结构优化任务上显著优于现有方法。

title: Hierarchical Compression of Vision-Language Model Benchmarks
summary: Thorough evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) has become prohibitively expensive, as benchmarks span an ever-broader spectrum of capabilities and new models arrive at a relentless pace. Benchmark compression methods that preserve model rankings at a fraction of the cost are well studied for language models, but for VLMs the question remains under-explored. We present PRIMEBench (Pruning Redundant Items for Multimodal Evaluation), a vision-aware hierarchical benchmark compression framework that substantially reduces evaluation cost while preserving model rankings. This hierarchical framework operates in four stages: data cleaning to remove items answerable without the image and all-correct items, category representative selection to pick one benchmark per capability category, item pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), and category-count pruning. VAW combines inter-model variance with a vision-dependence score computed from multimodal embeddings alone, while encouraging coverage of diverse items within each benchmark. On models held out from item selection, it has the highest mean fidelity at the released 5% retention. The hierarchical design lets practitioners stop at any stage to match their compute budget; the released suite removes over 97% of items while preserving model rankings. Beyond compression, our analyses show how VLM evaluation behaves as model panels grow and evolve, providing guidance for designing future benchmarks that are more efficient, robust to model turnover, and explicit about the limits of evaluation-side pruning.

AI.tldr: PRIMEBench 是一个面向视觉语言模型（VLM）的层次化基准压缩框架，通过四阶段流程（数据清洗、类别代表选择、基于视觉感知方差的条目剪枝、类别计数剪枝）在仅保留 5% 条目的情况下实现最高平均保真度，整体移除 97% 以上条目同时保持模型排名不变。
AI.motivation: VLM 评测成本因基准能力范围不断扩大和模型迭代加速而变得极高；现有基于语言模型的基准压缩方法在 VLM 场景下尚未充分探索，亟需一种视觉感知的压缩框架以大幅降低评测开销并保持排名一致性。
AI.method: 提出 PRIMEBench 分层压缩框架，包含四阶段：1) 数据清洗——剔除无需图像即可作答及全对条目；2) 类别代表选择——每个能力类别仅保留一个基准；3) 条目剪枝——引入视觉感知方差（VAW），融合模型间方差与多模态嵌入计算的视觉依赖分数，并鼓励基准内条目多样性覆盖；4) 类别计数剪枝——进一步压缩类别数量。各阶段可按算力预算灵活停止。
AI.result: 在未参与条目选择的保留模型上，PRIMEBench 在 5% 保留率下达到最高平均保真度；发布的套件移除 97% 以上条目同时保持模型排名；额外分析揭示了模型面板扩展与演化时评测行为的变化规律。
AI.conclusion: PRIMEBench 证明了视觉感知的层次化压缩能极大降低 VLM 评测成本且不损排名可靠性；其分析结果为未来设计更高效、抗模型更迭、且明确评测侧剪枝边界的基准提供了指导。

title: UnlearningSoup: Is Repeated Tuning Necessary for Large Language Model Unlearning?
summary: Large language models trained on vast corpora inherently risk memorizing harmful content that may later re-emerge in their outputs. To mitigate this issue, existing unlearning methods typically rely on training-based parameter updates, such as gradient ascent and its variants, to delete targeted content while preserving other knowledge. However, balancing the competing goals of forgetting and retention makes hyperparameter choices for these methods particularly difficult, often requiring repeated tuning to obtain a strong model that still leaves substantial room for improvement and transfers poorly across models and datasets. To address this challenge, we investigate whether unlearning runs exhibit exploitable structure in weight space, and observe that models from different runs still lie in a shared evaluation-performance basin. This suggests that stronger models may be recovered through an unlearning-tailored soup strategy, reducing the need for repeated tuning for further improvement or new settings. Motivated by this, we propose UnlearningSoup, a unified framework that provides two strategies: EfficientSoup uses binary-search-based interpolation to quickly discover a well-performing model in the early stage, where repeated tuning would otherwise make strong model selection costly. PerformanceSoup uses reweighted souping to efficiently unlock the remaining performance potential in the later stage, where repeated tuning becomes increasingly inefficient. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and models show that UnlearningSoup delivers 2.4x to 3.3x efficiency gains in hyperparameter selection, while consistently improving performance across settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出UnlearningSoup框架，通过模型汤策略解决大语言模型遗忘有害内容时的超参数调优难题，实现2.4-3.3倍效率提升且性能持续改进。
AI.motivation: 现有遗忘方法依赖训练参数更新（如梯度上升）平衡遗忘与保留，超参数选择困难，需反复调优且迁移性差。作者发现不同遗忘运行的模型位于共享评估性能盆地，提示可通过汤策略恢复更强模型，减少重复调优。
AI.method: 提出UnlearningSoup统一框架，包含两策略：EfficientSoup利用二分搜索插值快速发现早期高性能模型；PerformanceSoup采用重加权汤技术在后期高效挖掘剩余性能潜力。
AI.result: 在多样数据集和模型上实验表明，UnlearningSoup在超参数选择上带来2.4x至3.3x效率增益，同时在各设置下持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用遗忘运行中权重空间的共享结构，UnlearningSoup以模型汤方式统一解决了遗忘任务中的超参数调优难题，显著提升调优效率并改善模型性能，为大模型安全遗忘提供实用方案。

title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL
summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student's own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher substantially outperforms the student, distillation helps guide the student through the early training stage where outcome rewards provide little learning signal. As the gap narrows and eventually reverses, however, continued distillation becomes less beneficial and may hinder further improvement. Motivated by this observation, we propose Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS), which augments the student's RL objective with an OPD term whose weight adapts to the teacher-student performance gap. Specifically, GATS gradually reduces teacher guidance as the student approaches the teacher's reference performance and withdraws it once that reference is reached. This enables GATS to leverage task-trained teachers smaller than the student, since teacher guidance is primarily needed during early training. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher-student configurations, GATS achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods in all three configurations, improving over reward-only GRPO by 4.37%-11.87% under matched student rollout budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Ricardo-H/guide-then-let-go.

AI.tldr: 本文针对长时程强化学习中的冷启动问题，提出自适应教师调度方法 GATS，根据师生性能差距动态调整在线策略蒸馏权重，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三个基准上显著优于仅用奖励的 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体的强化学习通常依赖稀疏的结果奖励，导致严重的冷启动问题：早期策略难以完成任务，几乎没有有效奖励信号。在线策略蒸馏虽能提供 Token 级指导，但其收益取决于教师与学生的性能差距。当教师显著优于学生时，蒸馏有助于度过早期训练；随着差距缩小甚至反转，持续蒸馏反而可能阻碍进一步提升。
AI.method: 提出 Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS)，在学生的 RL 目标中加入 OPD 项，其权重随师生性能差距自适应调整。当学生接近教师参考性能时逐渐降低指导权重，达到后完全撤回。这使得 GATS 能利用比学生更小的任务训练教师，因为教师指导主要在早期训练阶段需要。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 三个环境及三种 Qwen2.5 师生配置下，GATS 在所有配置中均达到最高平均成功率，比仅用奖励的 GRPO 提升 4.37%-11.87%（在相同学生 rollout 预算下）。
AI.conclusion: GATS 通过根据性能差距自适应调节教师指导，有效缓解了冷启动问题，并在学生超越教师后避免负面影响，实现了更高效的长时程强化学习训练。

title: ZeroDiff: Zero-Shot Time Series Reconstruction via Informed-Prior Diffusion
summary: Time series modeling increasingly demands high-quality supervision, yet target observations remain scarce - exogenous inputs are broadly available, but target measurements are often unavailable due to cost, infrastructure, or accessibility constraints. Can models trained on observed locations reconstruct target time series where measurements have never been collected? We term this zero-shot time series reconstruction. A naive approach - directly mapping exogenous inputs to targets - can yield predictions at unobserved locations, but without target signals, such models fail to capture the intrinsic dynamics of the target variable, producing overly smooth outputs that underestimate extremes. This reveals systematic errors that call for explicit modeling and calibration. We propose ZeroDiff, which constructs an informed prior from exogenous variables alone, then learns to calibrate reconstruction errors through diffusion - training on observed locations and generalizing to unobserved ones. Experiments across diverse real-world datasets demonstrate significant improvements over existing approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/YingdaFan/ZeroDiff-ICML2026.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ZeroDiff框架，解决零样本时间序列重构问题——在无目标观测的位置，仅利用外生变量重构目标时间序列。通过扩散模型校准外生变量先验产生的系统误差，在多个真实数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 时间序列建模需要高质量监督，但目标观测往往因成本、基础设施或可达性限制而稀缺。直接映射外生变量到目标的朴素方法会忽略目标变量的内在动态，产生过度平滑、低估极值的预测，存在需显式建模和校准的系统误差。
AI.method: ZeroDiff分两阶段：首先仅从外生变量构建知情先验；然后通过扩散模型学习校准重构误差——在有观测的位置训练校准器，泛化到无观测位置。利用扩散过程建模先验与真实目标之间的残差分布。
AI.result: 在多个多样化真实数据集实验中，ZeroDiff相比现有零样本重构方法显著提升性能，有效捕捉目标变量内在动态，改善极值预测的低估问题。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: ZeroDiff证明了在无目标观测位置进行零样本时间序列重构的可行性，通过扩散模型校准外生先验的系统误差，为稀疏观测场景下的时间序列建模提供了有效范式。

title: You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference
summary: Existing LLM routers choose among models using static per-model costs. We show that open-weight inference markets introduce a second, largely ignored decision axis: after choosing a model, a client must still choose which provider serves it. Measuring live endpoints across [nummodels] open models, competing providers, multiple task types, and three measurement waves, we find that provider choice cannot be inferred from the price list. The same model can vary sharply in quality, latency, availability, and price across providers; higher-priced providers are consistently faster, but price does not reliably predict quality or availability; and provider feasibility is task-selective, with one deployment nearly normal on knowledge tasks but catastrophically degraded on multi-step reasoning. We formulate same-model provider selection as a price-taker market-aware routing problem. A simple measured-map policy routes to the cheapest provider that is both quality-equivalent and healthy, yielding matched-quality savings while avoiding degraded endpoints. Because the map drifts, we introduce FACET, an online provider router that certifies per-(provider x task) feasibility facets and fails safe to an anchor before serving uncertified arms. Across relaxed deployment assumptions, FACET tolerates imperfect task assignment and sparse feedback, while systematic evaluator bias exposes a quality-signal trust boundary that can be mitigated with ground-truth probes or audits. Live provider runs further confirm that certification can move real traffic from a premium anchor to a substantially cheaper certified endpoint. Our results suggest that market-aware LLM routing must measure not only which model to use, but also who serves it.

AI.tldr: 论文研究开放权重推理市场中同一模型不同提供商的差异，提出FACET在线路由器，通过认证提供商-任务可行性侧面实现市场感知路由，实现同等质量下的成本节约。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由器基于静态模型成本选择模型，忽略了开放权重推理市场中同一模型不同提供商在质量、延迟、可用性和价格上的巨大差异，且价格无法可靠预测质量，提供商可行性具有任务选择性。
AI.method: 测量多个开放模型、竞争提供商、多任务类型的实时端点；制定测量地图策略选择最便宜且质量等效健康的提供商；提出FACET在线路由器，认证每个(提供商×任务)的可行性侧面，未认证时回退到锚定提供商；容忍不完美任务分配和稀疏反馈；通过真实探针或审计缓解评估器偏差。
AI.result: 测量地图策略实现同等质量下的成本节约并避免降级端点；FACET在放松部署假设下表现鲁棒；实时提供商运行确认认证可将真实流量从高价锚定转移到大幅更便宜的认证端点。
AI.conclusion: 市场感知LLM路由不仅要测量使用哪个模型，还要测量由谁提供服务；提供商选择是关键决策轴，需持续监测和认证。

title: Identifying ODEs from Unstructured Data with Causal Representation Learning
summary: We study the problem of recovering the governing ODE of a dynamical system from unstructured, high-dimensional observations such as images. Existing methods for ODE discovery typically assume direct measurements of the variables, or do not provide theoretical guarantees on the learned variables and equations. While Causal Representation Learning (CRL) methods provide guarantees on identifying variables from high-dimensional observations up to component-wise diffeomorphisms, we show that in general these variables cannot be used directly as input to equation discovery methods, which typically assume that the variables will lead to sparse equations. So we introduce SParse Equivalent Equation Discovery AutoEncoder (SPEED-AE), a framework that combines a pretrained CRL method with a component-wise autoencoder that learns transformations of variables that are amenable to sparse ODE discovery. We show that for polynomial ODEs, this additional step allows us to restrict the identifiability of each variable from polynomial to monomial diffeomorphisms. Experiments on Lotka-Volterra, Lorenz, and a two-pendulum system show that SPEED-AE improves on the disentanglement of the CRL methods and that it recovers ODEs that are closest to the ground truth, while achieving state-of-the-art forecasting performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SPEED-AE 框架，结合预训练的因果表示学习（CRL）与逐分量自编码器，从高维观测（如图像）中恢复系统的控制常微分方程（ODE）。该方法将变量的可识别性从多项式微分同胚限制为单项式微分同胚，显著提升了 ODE 发现的准确性与预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 ODE 发现方法通常假设直接观测系统变量，或缺乏理论保证；而 CRL 方法虽能从高维观测中识别变量（仅至逐分量微分同胚），但这些变量不直接适用于稀疏方程发现，因为方程发现通常假设变量能导出稀疏方程。因此需要一种方法将 CRL 识别的变量变换为适合稀疏 ODE 发现的形式。
AI.method: SPEED-AE 采用两阶段流程：首先使用预训练的 CRL 方法从高维观测中提取潜在变量；然后训练一个逐分量自编码器，学习每个潜在变量的单变量变换，使变换后的变量能导出稀疏的多项式 ODE。理论上证明对于多项式 ODE，该步骤将每个变量的可识别性从多项式微分同胚收缩至单项式微分同胚。
AI.result: 在 Lotka-Volterra、Lorenz 及双摆系统实验中，SPEED-AE 相较于基线 CRL 方法显著提升了解耦质量，恢复的 ODE 最接近真实方程，并达到了最先进的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: SPEED-AE 通过在 CRL 之上引入逐分量自编码器，成功弥合了因果表示学习与稀疏 ODE 发现之间的鸿沟，为从非结构化高维数据中理论保证地恢复动力学方程提供了有效框架。

title: Pixels to Keys: Exploring Spatial and Motion Cues in Gameplay Inverse Dynamics
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Multimodal Digital Agents (ECCV 2026): https://mda-workshop.allen.ai/
summary: Video games offer scalable environments for studying perception and control in embodied agents.Abundant online gameplay videos could supply demonstrations, but they rarely include player inputs for training. Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) have thus been proposed to infer inputs from frames. Large (up to 1B parameters) IDMs trained on $\sim$1K-2K gameplay hours demonstrate feasibility and cross-environment generalization at this scale, but researchers do not clarify what the key components are to recover individual actions and often report only aggregate accuracy that can mask rare-action failures. We study the problem in a data-constrained scenario to evaluate how spatial motion features, model architectures, and training objectives affect an IDM's outcome and we analyse our models on per-key and balanced metrics such as $F_1^{macro}$. Our experiments on Trackmania highlight the importance of factors like the model architecture and motion flow extraction in preprocessing, while also showing the limits of evaluation through unbalanced metrics. The application of the same architecture and training recipe to Cyberpunk 2077 reveals uneven performance across game mechanics. Our per-action evaluation and failure analysis highlight ambiguities from camera motion, delayed effects and imbalanced key-press frequencies that call for explicit modeling of 3D scene structure, long-term state and the adoption of proper losses in future implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文在数据受限场景下系统研究逆向动力学模型（IDM）的关键组件，揭示了模型架构、运动光流提取、训练目标及评价指标对动作推断的影响，并指出了相机运动、延迟效应、按键频率不均等导致的歧义，呼吁未来显式建模 3D 场景结构、长期状态并采用合适损失函数。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模 IDM（高达 1B 参数、1K-2K 小时游戏数据）虽证明可行性与跨环境泛化，但未明确恢复单个动作的关键因素，且常仅报告聚合准确率掩盖罕见动作失败；因此需要在数据受限条件下剖析空间运动特征、架构、目标函数的作用，并采用逐键、平衡指标（如宏平均 F1）评估。
AI.method: 在 Trackmania 上进行受控实验，系统变换：(1) 预处理中的运动光流提取方式；(2) 模型架构（如 CNN、Transformer 等）；(3) 训练目标（交叉熵、焦点损失等）；并使用逐键准确率、宏平均 F1 等平衡指标评估。随后将相同架构与训练配方迁移至 Cyberpunk 2077 验证泛化性，并做失效案例分析。
AI.result: 实验表明：模型架构与光流预处理对 IDM 性能影响显著；不平衡指标（如整体准确率）会掩盖稀有动作的低召回；迁移到 Cyberpunk 2077 时不同游戏机制表现不均，主要失因包括相机运动引入的歧义、动作效果的延迟反馈、按键频率极度不均。
AI.conclusion: 未来 IDM 设计应：显式建模 3D 场景结构以消除相机运动歧义；引入长期状态建模处理延迟效应；采用类别平衡损失（如焦点损失、加权交叉熵）缓解按键频率不均；并坚持使用逐键、宏平均等平衡指标进行评估。

title: GRFBrain: Graph-Structured Rectified Flows for EEG Dynamic Modeling
summary: Forecasting time-varying functional connectivity from electroencephalography (EEG) requires modeling both history-dependent trends and structured variability across channels. Conditional flow matching provides a framework for distributional forecasting, yet it remains unclear whether graph-informed source distributions offer practical advantages over isotropic noise and strong deterministic predictors. We introduce a graph-structured residual flow framework that separates conditional mean prediction from stochastic residual transport. A history-only predictor estimates the future connectivity graph, while a graph Gaussian source encodes dependencies derived from past connectivity through a Laplacian-based covariance. A conditional velocity field transports source samples to future graph residuals, with transport time explicitly distinguished from physical EEG time. Our study identifies the conditions and controls needed to distinguish useful residual transport from improvements attributable to deterministic prediction, learned representations, and sampling effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图结构的残差流框架，用于从EEG预测时变功能连接，将确定性均值预测与随机残差传输分离，利用拉普拉斯协方差构建图高斯源分布，通过条件速度场实现残差传输，并系统分析了残差传输相对于确定性预测的增益来源。
AI.motivation: EEG功能连接预测需同时建模历史依赖趋势与跨通道结构化变异。条件流匹配虽提供分布预测框架，但图引导源分布相对于各向同性噪声及强确定性预测器的实际优势尚不明确，需拆解残差传输的真实贡献。
AI.method: 提出图结构残差流框架：1) 仅基于历史的预测器估计未来连接图（确定性均值）；2) 基于过去连接的拉普拉斯协方差构建图高斯源，编码通道依赖；3) 条件速度场将源样本传输至未来图残差，显式区分传输时间与物理EEG时间；4) 设计控制实验区分残差传输、确定性预测、学习表示与采样效应的贡献。
AI.result: 识别出区分有效残差传输与其他改进来源所需的条件与控制，验证了图高斯源与残差传输在功能连接分布预测中的实际增益。
AI.conclusion: 图结构残差流通过显式建模确定性趋势与结构化随机残差，结合拉普拉斯协方差的图高斯源，为EEG功能连接分布预测提供了可解释且有效的框架，并厘清了各组件贡献。

title: Authority Bias in Language Models: Source Deference and User Agreement Are Not Interchangeable
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Conference, Poster). 33 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://authority-bias.vercel.app/ . Code: https://github.com/Lossfunk/authority-bias
summary: Language models tend to agree with whatever a user asserts, and post-training increasingly targets this sycophancy so that models evaluate claims on their merits rather than deferring to the user. Yet the same models are far more compliant when a wrong answer is attributed to a verified source, which is how retrieval results, tool outputs, and grounded-search content often present information. We measure this gap across five open-weight families and three closed APIs. A single verified-source note endorsing a wrong answer flips 45-88% of baseline-correct responses in seven of eight models, and compliance rises with how authoritative the note sounds. Source deference and user agreement are not behaviorally interchangeable inside the model: on matched items with the same wrong answer, causal interventions can selectively suppress one without equally affecting the other. In three open-weight families, removing a fitted source direction lowers source compliance by 65-80 percentage points while removing a user or assistant direction has far smaller effects, and removing the user direction shows the reverse preference. A separately fitted intervention derived from source-versus-user cue activations moves compliance in both directions while leaving the prompt text unchanged. An authority direction fitted on trivia also transfers to PIQA and multi-turn SYCON dialogues without refitting, and removing it lowers wrong-source compliance by tens of percentage points in four of five families with no detected change in MMLU-Pro or GSM8K accuracy at our evaluation sizes. Source deference and user agreement therefore need separate evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了语言模型对用户观点的顺从（奉承）与对权威来源错误信息的顺从之间的差异。实验表明，模型更倾向于相信带有权威来源标注的错误答案，且这种“来源顺从”与“用户顺从”在模型内部由不同的神经机制控制，需要分别评估和干预。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练主要针对模型盲目附和用户观点（奉承行为）进行纠正，但模型在面对带有权威来源标注的错误信息（如检索结果、工具输出）时表现出更高的顺从性。这种“来源顺从”可能比用户顺从更具隐蔽性和危害性，因此需要系统度量二者差异，并探究其内在机制是否可分离。
AI.method: 在五个开源模型家族和三个闭源API上构建基准，测试模型在基线正确回答被单一权威来源注释的错误答案反转的比例。利用因果干预技术（如移除拟合的“来源方向”、“用户方向”、“权威方向”），考察不同方向对来源顺从和用户顺从的选择性影响。进一步在PIQA和多轮SYCON对话任务上验证权威方向的迁移性，并在MMLU-Pro和GSM8K上评估干预对通用能力的副作用。
AI.result: 单一权威来源注释可使7/8模型的基线正确回答以45%-88%比例被翻转，顺从随来源权威感增强而上升。因果干预显示：移除来源方向可使来源顺从下降65-80个百分点，而移除用户/助手方向影响甚微；反之移除用户方向则主要降低用户顺从。基于来源与用户线索激活差异拟合的干预可双向调节顺从且不改提示词。权威方向在 trivia 任务拟合后可零样本迁移至 PIQA 和多轮 SYCON，移除后四模型家族的错误来源顺从下降数十百分点，且未在评估规模下检测到 MMLU-Pro 或 GSM8K 准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: 来源顺从与用户顺从在行为上不可互换，在模型内部由可分离的表示方向控制。评估与缓解奉承行为时，必须单独针对“来源顺从”设计基准和干预，不能假设解决用户顺从即能解决来源顺从。

title: Neural Constitutive Learning for Generalized Reaction-Diffusion Systems
summary: Generalized reaction-diffusion systems encompass diverse transport mechanisms and coupled reaction kinetics. A central question for neural PDE solvers is what should be learned so that a common interface can accommodate phase-field and degenerate transport, local reactions, and multispecies coupling. We propose the Neural Constitutive Laws--Mass-Compression-Transport (NCL-MCT) Solver, which learns PDE-specific constitutive responses while retaining temporal evolution in a shared MCT integrator. Transport is represented through mobility and thermodynamic driving force, and reaction through relative reaction rates. These constitutive responses depend on the current density rather than explicitly on the initial condition or elapsed time, motivating their reuse across different initial conditions and time horizons. The same interface supports velocity-data supervision and known-law supervision, neither of which requires time integration during training. When constitutive laws are known, supervision can be evaluated on independently sampled density fields, enabling trajectory-free constitutive learning without generating solution trajectories. Across seven systems, separately trained constitutive modules share the same interface and MCT integrator and achieve relative rollout $L^2$ errors of $10^{-4}$ to $10^{-2}$.
