Tests with unseen initial-condition families and an extended time horizon assess reuse beyond training conditions, while separate experiments demonstrate trajectory-free constitutive learning. These results support constitutive responses as an effective learning target for a shared neural PDE framework.

AI.tldr: 提出NCL-MCT求解器，通过学习PDE特定的本构响应（迁移率、热力学驱动力、相对反应速率）并结合共享的MCT时间积分器，实现广义反应-扩散系统的统一神经网络求解框架，支持无轨迹本构学习，在七个系统上达成10^-4到10^-2的相对回滚L2误差，并展示对未见初始条件和长时域的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 广义反应-扩散系统包含多样的输运机制和耦合反应动力学，现有神经PDE求解器缺乏统一接口来同时容纳相场、退化输运、局部反应和多组分耦合；需要确定合适的学习目标以实现跨系统、跨初始条件和长时域的复用。
AI.method: 设计NCL-MCT求解器：将PDE分解为共享的质量-压缩-输运（MCT）时间积分器与可学习的本构模块。输运用迁移率和热力学驱动力表示，反应用相对反应速率表示。本构响应仅依赖当前密度场，不显式依赖初始条件或时间。支持速度数据监督和已知定律监督，训练时无需时间积分；当本构定律已知时，可在独立采样的密度场上评估监督信号，实现无轨迹本构学习。
AI.result: 在七个反应-扩散系统上，分别训练的本构模块共享同一MCT积分器，相对回滚L2误差在10^-4至10^-2之间。测试未见初始条件族和延长时域，验证了超出训练分布的复用性能；单独实验证实了无轨迹本构学习的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本构响应作为学习目标，配合共享的MCT积分器，构成了一个有效的统一神经PDE框架，能够跨系统、跨初始条件、跨时域复用，且支持无需生成完整轨迹的本构学习。

title: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
summary: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. Across our evaluation settings on video understanding benchmarks, the evolved agent improves accuracy while processing fewer frames and achieves competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs against existing video understanding agents. These results demonstrate the potential for video understanding agents to improve their own evidence acquisition and use through harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI .

AI.tldr: Video-RSI 是一个视频理解智能体的递归自我改进框架，通过让智能体利用自身语言模型修订证据获取控制器（harness），在主动视频调查中重新检查训练视频以测试失败假设，并基于准确性与视觉成本进行代价感知的控制器进化，最终在提升准确率的同时减少帧处理量，实现了具有竞争力的准确率-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解智能体依赖可执行控制器获取证据，但执行轨迹仅包含当前控制器获取的证据，导致竞争性失败解释无法被解决，限制了自我改进的基础。
AI.method: 提出 Video-RSI 框架：1) 主动视频调查：智能体使用自身语言模型重访训练视频，通过额外观测测试竞争性失败解释，使修订建立在现有轨迹之外的证据上；2) 代价感知控制器进化：将诊断转化为可复用修订，综合考虑答案准确率和视觉成本决定保留哪些修订。
AI.result: 在多个视频理解基准测试中，进化后的智能体在处理更少帧的情况下提升了准确率，并达到了与现有视频理解智能体具有竞争力的准确率-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果展示了视频理解智能体通过控制器进化改进自身证据获取和使用的潜力。

title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback
summary: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task to insight mapping. On challenging tool-calling and coding datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%. RLTL;DR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14-31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12-13% when no insight is in context at eval time. We identify that the key is the task to insight internalization. To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTL;DR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts. Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR and classical SFT on full rollouts. This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RLTL;DR，一种通过让策略在失败后生成 TL;DR 洞察并反向传播内化任务到洞察映射的强化学习方法，在极难任务上突破了标准 GRPO 的学习瓶颈，并进一步发现仅在 (任务, 洞察) 元组上做 SFT (SFTL;DR) 即可恢复近似性能，展示了一种紧凑的训练范式。
AI.motivation: 现有的可验证奖励强化学习 (RLVR) 要求智能体有非零成功概率，但在自改进等极难任务中，智能体往往完全无法成功，且缺乏教师模型或示例解决方案可供蒸馏，导致标准 RLVR 失效。
AI.method: RLTL;DR：每次失败后将验证器输出展示给策略，让其生成单条 TL;DR 洞察；后续 rollout 以所有历史洞察为条件，顺序采样直到成功。同时对上下文中的洞察进行反向传播，内化任务到洞察的直接映射。进一步简化为 SFTL;DR：仅在 (任务, 洞察) 元组上做监督微调，不展示也不反传 rollout。
AI.result: 在 Pass@128=0 的工具调用和编码数据集上，标准 GRPO 训练的 Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking 策略 Pass@1 维持在 0-1%。RLTL;DR 训练时带洞察达 14-31% Pass@1，评测时无洞察也达 12-13%。仅用 4k 个 (任务, 洞察) 元组训练的 SFTL;DR 几乎恢复了 RLTL;DR 和全 rollout SFT 的全部性能。
AI.conclusion: 任务到洞察的内化是突破极难任务学习瓶颈的关键。紧凑的“在此类任务中，记住此类要点”式训练范式 (SFTL;DR) 极具潜力，值得后续研究深入探索。

title: Interpretable intrinsic dimension estimation through componentwise calibration of distance and angle
summary: DANCo (Dimensionality from Angle and Norm Concentration) jointly calibrates nearest-neighbor distance and angular statistics and consistently reaches state-of-the-art accuracy on clean intrinsic-dimension (ID) benchmarks. Practical data, however, introduce neighborhood-relative noise and sample-amplitude heterogeneity that can distort these geometric signals. We reformulate DANCo componentwise, retaining separate distance and angular discrepancy curves so that the source of an estimate can be identified and interpreted. For the distance component, we derive a closed-form Kullback-Leibler divergence for the generic-order ratios of the generalized ratios ID estimator (Gride); when both angular parameters are matched (Full), Gride reduces mean percentage error from $27.7\%$ to $17.6\%$ at noise equal to $40\%$ of typical neighbor spacing on 24 manifolds. For the angular component, two sampling regimes motivate aligning mean direction while retaining concentration matching (Profiled). On a Gaussian scale mixture with generating dimension 70 embedded in 100 dimensions, profiling raises the Minimum Neighbor Distance (MiND) estimate from $22.8$ to $66.7$, while removing the known amplitudes restores MiND-Full to $71.9$; the control thus attributes the Full shortfall to amplitude heterogeneity. On CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, amplitude-reducing normalizations move angular location toward the references and narrow the Full-Profiled gap, an observational counterpart to the controlled mixture. Across four pretrained convolutional neural networks, Gride-Profiled, the two-nearest-neighbor estimator (TWO-NN), and the maximum-likelihood estimator (MLE) exhibit similar rise-and-fall profiles, while Full-Profiled differences identify the layers most sensitive to angular calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DANCo方法的组件化改进版Gride，将距离和角度统计分离校准，针对实际数据中的邻域相对噪声和样本幅度异质性问题，通过闭式KL散度推导距离组件，引入Profiled角度校准机制，在合成和真实数据集上显著提升内在维度估计精度，并能识别对角度校准最敏感的神经网络层。
AI.motivation: 现有DANCo方法在纯净基准上表现优异，但实际数据中存在邻域相对噪声和样本幅度异质性，会扭曲几何信号，导致内在维度估计不准确。需要一种可解释的组件化方法，分离距离和角度统计的贡献，以便识别估计偏差的来源。
AI.method: 1. 将DANCo重构为距离组件和角度组件分离的形式，保留独立的差异曲线。2. 距离组件：推导广义比率ID估计器（Gride）通用阶比率的闭式Kullback-Leibler散度。3. 角度组件：提出Profiled校准，在保持浓度匹配的同时对齐平均方向，针对两种采样制度。4. 通过Full（完全匹配角度参数）和Profiled两种模式对比，诊断幅度异质性影响。
AI.result: 1. Gride-Full在24个流形上将噪声等于典型邻域间距40%时的平均百分比误差从27.7%降至17.6%。2. 高斯尺度混合实验中，Profiling使MiND估计从22.8提升至66.7，移除已知幅度后MiND-Full恢复至71.9，证实Full短板源于幅度异质性。3. CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，幅度降低归一化使角度位置向参考值靠拢，缩小Full-Profiled差距。4. 四个预训练CNN中，Gride-Profiled、TWO-NN和MLE呈现相似升降轮廓，Full-Profiled差异识别出对角度校准最敏感的层。
AI.conclusion: 组件化的Gride框架有效解决了实际数据中的噪声和幅度异质性问题，距离组件的闭式KL散度和角度组件的Profiled校准显著提升估计精度，且能诊断估计偏差来源。实验表明幅度异质性是角度校准误差的主要原因，该方法为深度网络层级的内在维度分析提供了敏感的诊断工具。

title: Topological Coherence for Self-evolving Multi-agent Systems
summary: Complex tasks inherently couple workflow structure, agent responsibility, collaboration, and memory access: task regions delimit responsibility and tool scope, cross-region dependencies give rise to handoffs, and ownership boundaries delimit private and selectively shared memory. Existing methods can jointly optimize agent and communication structures, yet such optimization does not by itself require responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries to remain consistent with task dependencies. We term this requirement topological coherence. We introduce TOCOMAS, a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System. TOCOMAS grounds a task graph in tool interfaces, organizes compatible task nodes into reusable responsibility domains, and derives dependency-induced and profile-conditioned collaboration together with boundary-regulated memory visibility. During online self-evolution, TOCOMAS proposes coupled changes to agent, collaboration, and memory policies, retaining for subsequent tasks only candidates that satisfy structural constraints and improve evaluated reward. Across BBEH, WorkBench, SWE-Bench-Verified, and CoMemBench, TOCOMAS improves task success over baselines across backbones. CoMemBench also shows gains over the self-evolving baseline in verified progress, handoffs, and memory isolation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TOCOMAS（拓扑一致性多智能体系统），解决现有多智能体方法在优化智能体与通信结构时，未能保证责任边界、交接机制和内存访问边界与任务依赖拓扑一致的问题。TOCOMAS将任务图落地到工具接口，将兼容任务节点组织为可复用责任域，推导依赖驱动和画像条件的协作及边界受控的内存可见性。在线自进化阶段，TOCOMAS提出耦合的智能体、协作和内存策略变更，仅保留满足结构约束且提升评估奖励的候选方案。在BBEH、WorkBench、SWE-Bench-Verified和CoMemBench四个基准上，TOCOMAS在多种骨干模型上均提升任务成功率，且在CoMemBench上在验证进度、交接次数和内存隔离方面优于自进化基线。
AI.motivation: 复杂任务固有地耦合工作流结构、智能体责任、协作方式和内存访问：任务区域划定责任与工具范围，跨区域依赖产生交接，所有权边界划定私有与选择性共享内存。现有方法虽能联合优化智能体与通信结构，但这种优化本身不要求责任、交接和内存边界与任务依赖保持一致。作者将这一要求称为拓扑一致性，旨在构建满足该一致性的多智能体系统。
AI.method: TOCOMAS包含三个核心步骤：1) 将任务图落地到工具接口，建立任务与工具的映射；2) 将兼容的任务节点组织为可复用的责任域，并推导依赖驱动和画像条件的协作机制，同时实施边界受控的内存可见性；3) 在线自进化阶段，提出耦合的智能体策略、协作策略和内存策略变更，仅保留满足结构约束并能提升评估奖励的候选方案供下一任务使用。
AI.result: 在BBEH、WorkBench、SWE-Bench-Verified和CoMemBench四个基准测试中，TOCOMAS在多种骨干模型上均显著提升任务成功率，优于基线方法。特别是在CoMemBench上，TOCOMAS在验证进度、交接效率和内存隔离三个指标上均优于自进化基线方法。
AI.conclusion: TOCOMAS通过引入拓扑一致性概念，系统性地解决了多智能体系统中责任边界、交接机制和内存访问与任务依赖结构不一致的问题。其提出的责任域组织、依赖驱动协作、边界受控内存可见性以及耦合自进化机制，有效提升了复杂任务下的多智能体协作性能，为构建结构化、可进化的多智能体系统提供了新范式。

title: BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization
summary: Brain networks characterize structural and functional relationships among brain regions and support research on cognition, brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. Their time-varying topology and higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies are not adequately represented by conventional static networks. Existing tools primarily focus on static connectomes and provide limited integration of dynamic network modeling with modern graph and sequence learning methods. We present BrainNet Studio, an integrated toolkit for static and dynamic brain network analysis. It provides a unified workflow encompassing network construction, feature extraction, predictive modeling, candidate biomarker identification, visualization, and assisted interpretation. The toolkit integrates 27 algorithms, including deep learning, graph neural networks, and spatiotemporal sequence models, to support classification and the identification of discriminative brain regions and connections. A large language model generates researcher-verifiable summaries of functional connectivity, structural connectivity, and structure-function coupling at individual and group levels. Within a consistent computational framework, users can configure analytical tasks, compare methods, inspect outputs, and extend functionality without repeatedly assembling application-specific pipelines. BrainNet Studio provides a practical and extensible platform for connectome analysis in cognitive neuroscience, exploratory studies of brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/Brainnet-Studio.

AI.tldr: BrainNet Studio 是一个集成工具包，用于静态和动态脑网络分析，提供统一工作流涵盖网络构建、特征提取、预测建模、生物标志物识别、可视化和辅助解释，集成 27 种算法（包括深度学习、图神经网络、时空序列模型），并利用大语言模型生成可验证的功能/结构连接及结构-功能耦合摘要。
AI.motivation: 传统静态脑网络无法充分表征脑网络的时变拓扑和高阶时空依赖；现有工具主要关注静态连接组，缺乏动态网络建模与现代图学习、序列学习方法的整合，导致研究者需反复搭建特定应用流水线，效率低且难以对比方法。
AI.method: 开发 BrainNet Studio 工具包，提供统一计算框架：1) 网络构建模块支持静态/动态功能连接和结构连接；2) 特征提取模块集成 27 种算法（深度学习、GNN、时空序列模型等）；3) 预测建模支持分类及判别性脑区/连接识别；4) 大语言模型生成个体和群体层面的功能连接、结构连接、结构-功能耦合摘要；5) 可视化与辅助解释模块；6) 支持任务配置、方法对比、输出检查和功能扩展。
AI.result: 工具包已公开发布（GitHub），可用于认知神经科学、脑疾病探索性研究、脑机接口等场景；提供一致框架下的完整分析流程，消除重复搭建管道的需求，支持多算法对比与结果直观解读。
AI.conclusion: BrainNet Studio 为连接组分析提供了实用且可扩展的平台，填补了动态脑网络建模与现代机器学习方法整合的空白，有望加速脑网络研究在认知、疾病和 BCI 领域的应用。

title: When Models Don't Manipulate Manifolds: The Geometry of a Comparison Task
summary: One of the current premises of mechanistic interpretability research is that detailed accounts of the geometry of neural network representations can tell us how models perform computations, and how to effectively intervene on them. While low dimensional manifolds have been observed for multiple concepts in the literature (e.g. numbers encoded on helices, days of the week on a circle, ...), with structure believed to reflect properties of data and tasks, the extent to which models rely on them for computation, and how they manipulate them, remains unclear. We characterize precisely the geometry of computation in a number-comparison task, as an abstraction of comparison for decision making, and how models utilize geometry in an elegant fashion to implement it. Specifically, we study the causal geometry of number comparison in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, a capable and widely studied open-weight model, and find Qwen largely uses linear representations of numbers despite the presence of curved geometry. To compare two numbers, the model first encodes each number along a vector and adds the two representations using attention and the residual connection, bringing them into a shared space in the residual stream. Then, the model uses MLP neurons to compare the pair of numbers on local regions in this shared space, which correspond to smaller intervals of input numbers, and combines these to obtain the position of the maximum. In fact, this reliance on linear representations for comparison also persists when the model compares three numbers. Our findings demonstrate that the manifold hypothesis can co-exist with linear representations: while concepts that are ordered may have manifold structure in representations, the model may use an underlying linear structure of the concept in certain computations.

AI.tldr: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在数字比较任务中主要使用线性表示，尽管存在弯曲的流形几何结构。模型通过注意力机制和残差连接将两个数字的表示加到共享空间，再利用 MLP 神经元在局部区域进行比较并组合得到最大值位置，这一机制在三数字比较中依然成立，表明流形假设与线性表示可以共存。
AI.motivation: 机制性可解释性研究的前提是神经网络表示的几何结构能揭示计算机制。虽然已观察到低维流形（如数字的螺旋编码、星期的圆环编码），但模型在多大程度上依赖这些流形进行计算、以及如何操纵它们仍不清楚。本文旨在精确刻画数字比较任因的计算几何，理解模型如何利用几何结构实现比较计算。
AI.method: 以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为研究对象，分析其在数字比较任务中的因果几何。考察模型如何编码数字、通过注意力和残差流将两个数字的表示带入共享空间、MLP 神经元如何在该共享空间的局部区域（对应更小的输入数字区间）进行比较，并将这些局部比较组合以获得最大值位置。同时验证该机制在三数字比较任务中的泛化性。
AI.result: 模型尽管存在弯曲的流形几何，但主要使用数字的线性表示。比较过程分两步：首先将每个数字沿向量编码，经注意力和残差连接相加进入残差流的共享空间；其次，MLP 神经元在该共享空间的局部区域（对应较小的输入数字区间）比较数字对，并将这些局部比较结果组合以确定最大值的位置。这种对线性表示的依赖在三数字比较中依然持续。
AI.conclusion: 流形假设与线性表示可以共存：有序概念的表示可能呈现流形结构，但在特定计算（如数字比较）中，模型会利用概念底层的线性结构。这为理解神经网络如何在几何结构与计算效率之间取得平衡提供了实证支持。

title: Learning the Structure of Triangular Transport Maps
summary: Triangular transport maps provide a flexible approach to sampling-based probabilistic modeling, including density estimation, generative modeling, and Bayesian inference. They transform an unknown target distribution into a simpler reference through a monotone triangular map. The map structure is defined by a variable ordering and sparsity pattern, which together encode a directed acyclic graph. Map quality can depend strongly on this structure, yet finding a good structure is computationally expensive because each candidate generally requires fitting a different map. A central challenge is therefore to learn density and structure jointly, while keeping computation manageable as dimension grows. We introduce Self-Structuring Transport Maps (SSTM), which learn the map, ordering, and sparsity jointly. We use SoftSort to learn the variable ordering and $L_0$ gates to learn the sparsity, while preserving a triangular structure. To keep the map scalable, we use a monotone BatchEnsemble that shares one weight matrix across all map components through rank-one adapters. Across synthetic and real data, jointly learning the structure and map gives better density estimates than estimating the structure first. When the structure is identifiable from the density, SSTM matches the density performance of a map fitted with the true structure and outperforms autoregressive flows. On large datasets, SSTM is competitive with autoregressive flows.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Self-Structuring Transport Maps (SSTM)，联合学习三角传输映射的映射函数、变量排序和稀疏模式。采用SoftSort学习变量排序，L0门控学习稀疏性，利用单调BatchEnsemble配合秩一适配器共享权重矩阵以保持可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 三角传输映射是概率建模的灵活工具，但其性能强烈依赖于变量排序和稀疏模式（编码有向无环图）。寻找良好结构计算开销大，因为每个候选结构通常需要拟合不同映射。核心挑战是在维度增长时联合学习密度和结构并保持计算可控。
AI.method: SSTM联合学习映射、排序和稀疏性：(1) 使用SoftSort学习变量排序；(2) 使用L0门控学习稀疏模式；(3) 保持三角结构；(4) 采用单调BatchEnsemble，通过秩一适配器共享一个权重矩阵跨所有映射组件，保证可扩展性。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据上，联合学习结构和映射比先估计结构再拟合映射给出更好的密度估计。当结构可从密度识别时，SSTM达到使用真实结构拟合映射的性能，并优于自回归流。在大规模数据集上，SSTM与自回归流具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SSTM实现了可扩展的传输映射结构与密度联合学习，在保持计算效率的同时达到强性能，为高维概率建模提供了实用的解决方案。

title: SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents
summary: Advances in the coding capabilities of LLM agents allow them to inspect and modify their own instructions, tools, and execution procedures. Existing approaches use this ability to search for improved agents through repeated downstream evaluation, which incurs substantial costs and ties the search to the evaluated tasks. We introduce \textbf{SelfSearch}, a reward-free search procedure in which agents modify themselves using records of previous self-improvement episodes. These records capture the reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes of earlier modification attempts, providing concrete experience for improving both task solving and self-modification. Without downstream reward signals during search, SelfSearch improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model--benchmark settings, with individual agents gaining up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On SWE-bench Multilingual, an agent improves success by \textbf{5.0} percentage points while reducing execution cost by \textbf{38.5}\% on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. SelfSearch achieves competitive task success with evaluation-guided search baselines at lower search cost. With only \textbf{\$4.03} in search cost, it produces a harness that solves \textbf{82.0}\% of Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks with DeepSeek V4 Flash under the settings of a public nine-harness comparison, matching the top-scoring harness, Codex. These results suggest that experience gained through self-modification can improve agents' downstream capabilities and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SelfSearch，一种无需奖励信号的自我进化搜索方法，让 LLM 智能体利用过往自我修改经验（推理、工具动作、结果）进行迭代改进。在六个模型-基准设置上均提升种群平均成功率，Terminal-Bench 2.1 单智能体最高增 11.2 个百分点；SWE-bench Multilingual 上成功率提升 5.0% 且解决任务成本降 38.5%。仅花费 $4.03 搜索成本，配合 DeepSeek V4 Flash 即达 82.0% 通过率，与顶级哈希 Codex 持平。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体自我改进方法依赖下游任务评估作为奖励信号，导致搜索成本高昂且与特定任务绑定，缺乏通用、低成本的自我进化机制。
AI.method: SelfSearch：无奖励搜索过程。智能体记录历史自我修改回合（推理、工具调用、结果），将这些经验作为上下文用于后续自我修改，从而同时提升任务求解能力和自我修改能力，无需下游评估信号。
AI.result: 1) 六个模型-基准设置全部提升种群平均成功率，Terminal-Bench 2.1 单智能体最大增益 11.2 pp。2) SWE-bench Multilingual 成功率 +5.0 pp，双方均解决任务的执行成本 -38.5%。3) 搜索成本仅 $4.03，配合 DeepSeek V4 Flash 在公开九哈希对比中达 82.0% 通过率，持平 Codex。4) 以更低搜索成本达到与评估引导基线相当的任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过自我修改积累的经验可显著提升智能体的下游任务能力与执行效率，证明无奖励、基于经验的自我进化路线可行且高效。

title: KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices
summary: As the context size of text processed with an LLM grows, the size of KV caches can outstrip the memory allocated for the original model weights. This impacts LLM throughput negatively, since decoding is memory-bound and decode cost grows with cache size. Recent work alleviates this bottleneck by discarding the least relevant tokens. Eviction introduces a tension, since a one-off decision to discard content may prove detrimental later. Instead, we focus on alternative choices that can lead to cache compression without evicting tokens. We achieve this by learning a selector that is able to produce, based on context, a per-layer cache configuration towards an overall compression budget. The selector operates along three axes: sharing one cache across layers (depth), caching at fewer bits (precision), or truncating the low-rank latent cache representations (rank). We call the resulting method KV-Kaizen, for the many small per-layer choices it compounds. We observe that these interventions taken independently and uniformly over all layers limit achievable compression because they degrade accuracy. Crucially, composing them locally and adaptively to the context can instead preserve accuracy while achieving large memory savings. At inference, the selector runs once, before pre-fill. In evaluations on instruction following and reasoning tasks, our selectors reach the Pareto frontier of accuracy against cache size, against learning-free and post-hoc baselines. On long-context tasks, KV-Kaizen improves on eviction and can be composed with it, reaching a 32x smaller decode-time cache on a 14B model while preserving accuracy. A 4x cache size reduction incurs no accuracy degradation from 7B parameters up, and a compressed model is more accurate than a smaller uncompressed one with the same cache size. Together, these findings support pre-training large models and compressing them only afterwards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KV-Kaizen，一种通过学习选择器在预填充前为每层自适应配置KV缓存压缩策略（跨层共享、低精度、低秩截断）的方法，实现无需逐出token即可大幅压缩缓存，在长文本任务上达到32倍压缩且保持精度，支持先训练大模型后压缩的范式。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM上下文窗口增大，KV缓存大小超越模型权重内存，导致解码吞吐下降；现有通过逐出不相关token的方法存在一次决策可能后续有害的问题，因此需要无需逐出token的压缩方案。
AI.method: 学习一个选择器，根据上下文为每层生成缓存配置，在三个维度操作：跨层共享缓存（深度）、降低缓存精度（精度）、截断低秩潜在缓存表示（秩），统称为KV-Kaizen。选择器在推理前运行一次。
AI.result: 在指令遵循和推理任务上，选择器达到准确率与缓存大小的帕累托前沿；长文本任务上改进逐出方法且可组合，14B模型实现32倍解码时缓存压缩且不损精度；4倍压缩自7B参数起无精度损失，压缩后的大模型优于同缓存大小的未压缩小模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持先预训练大模型、后压缩的范式；自适应逐层组合压缩策略优于统一干预，可大幅节省内存同时保持精度。

title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers
summary: Decoder-only transformers are trained only through a terminal next-token prediction loss, yet this loss constrains every intermediate hidden state through the fixed downstream computation. We formalize this constraint by studying layerwise loss-to-go functions: the terminal loss obtained by continuing a candidate hidden state through the remaining transformer blocks. Around successful validation trajectories, we show that the local second-order geometry of these functions is governed, up to low-loss residual terms, by a pullback Fisher operator on hidden-state space. Its spectrum identifies output-sensitive directions and approximately prediction-null directions, yielding a local observable subspace of the residual stream. For causal transformers, the same geometry induces a tokenwise curvature score: a Fisher-weighted sensitivity of the target logits to perturbations of each token's hidden state. This score vanishes outside the causal ancestor set of the target and is controlled by downstream Jacobian couplings, making it a loss-aware alternative to attention magnitude. We estimate these quantities using matrix-free Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products and evaluate them across decoder-only language models on WikiText, OpenWebText, and FineWeb. Empirically, the induced geometry predicts perturbation sensitivity, supports nonuniform layerwise rank allocation, yields competitive structured token-pruning signals, and improves low-rank student recovery when added to stronger autoregressive distillation objectives such as reverse KL and skew KL. These results support a predictive-geometric view of transformer computation: near successful trajectories, the terminal loss induces a thin, anisotropic set of output-relevant hidden-state directions that can be measured and exploited for compression and distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化研究了解码器专用Transformer中的逐层损失函数，证明其局部二阶几何由回拉费舍尔算子支配，识别出输出敏感方向和近似预测零空间方向，提出基于费舍尔加权的逐标记曲率评分，并将其应用于模型压缩和蒸馏，实现了非均匀逐层秩分配、结构化标记剪枝及低秩学生模型恢复的改进。
AI.motivation: 解码器专用Transformer仅通过终端下一标记预测损失训练，但该损失通过固定的下游计算约束了每个中间隐藏状态。作者旨在形式化这一约束，研究逐层损失函数的局部几何结构，以理解Transformer计算中输出相关的隐藏状态方向，并利用该几何进行压缩和蒸馏。
AI.method: 1. 定义逐层损失函数：从候选隐藏状态继续通过剩余Transformer块获得的终端损失。2. 分析成功验证轨迹附近的局部二阶几何，证明其由隐藏状态空间上的回拉费舍尔算子支配（至低损失残差项）。3. 费舍尔算子的谱识别输出敏感方向和近似预测零空间方向，定义局部可观测子空间。4. 对因果Transformer，推导逐标记曲率评分：目标logits对各标记隐藏状态扰动的费舍尔加权敏感度。5. 利用无矩阵雅可比-向量积和向量-雅可比积估计这些量。6. 在WikiText、OpenWebText和FineWeb上跨解码器专用语言模型进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明：诱导的几何能预测扰动敏感性，支持非均匀逐层秩分配，产生有竞争力的结构化标记剪枝信号，且在加入反向KL和倾斜KL等更强自回归蒸馏目标时，能改进低秩学生模型的恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 在成功轨迹附近，终端损失诱导出一组薄而各向异性的输出相关隐藏状态方向，这些方向可被测量和利用，支持了Transformer计算的预测几何视角，为模型压缩和蒸馏提供了理论依据和实用工具。

title: Lucid Dreaming for World Models: Learning to Doubt Imagination and Decide by Trust
comment: 30 pages, 22 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://lucidwm.github.io
summary: World models enable agents to learn and plan in imagination, but predictions beyond their experience can become unreliable and mislead decisions. Existing uncertainty estimates derived from predictions can remain overconfident on unfamiliar state-action pairs. We propose the Lucid World Model (LucidWM), which learns doubt from experience and propagates trust through imagination. By integrating Subjective Logic into categorical latent transitions, LucidWM distinguishes predicted outcomes from their evidential support and assigns each transition a degree of doubt. The complement of this doubt defines transition-level trust, which accumulates multiplicatively along imagined trajectories to reweight returns for policy learning and guide action selection. Uncertainty estimation requires no additional parameters or forward passes. Evaluated on four base world models against seventeen uncertainty readouts, LucidWM detects environmental changes and signals uncertainty during action-corrupted rollouts. In a controlled navigation case study, acting on trust reduces the number of steps required to reach the goal from 362 to 190. Fifteen demonstration videos show how LucidWM doubts its dreams and acts on that doubt. Videos are available at https://lucidwm.github.io.

AI.tldr: LucidWM 通过引入主观逻辑到类别潜在转移中，使世界模型能够从经验中学习'怀疑'并在想象中传播'信任'，无需额外参数即可实现可靠的不确定性估计，显著提升规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型在超出经验分布的状态-动作对上预测不可靠，且现有不确定性估计往往过度自信，导致基于想象的规划和决策失效。
AI.method: 将主观逻辑集成到分类潜在转移中，将预测结果与其证据支持区分开来，为每个转移分配怀疑度；信任度定义为怀疑度的补数，沿想象轨迹乘法累积，用于重加权策略学习回报并指导动作选择。
AI.result: 在四种基础世界模型上对比十七种不确定性读出方法，LucidWM 能检测环境变化并在动作损坏的展开中发出不确定性信号；导航案例研究中，基于信任行动将到达目标步数从 362 降至 190。
AI.conclusion: LucidWM 实现了无需额外参数或前向传递的高效不确定性量化，通过怀疑-信任机制显著增强了世界模型在分布外场景下的规划可靠性和决策质量。

title: Which Attention Heads are like the Human Head? Not the Ones that Compute
summary: Brain-AI alignment is often interpreted as a sign that model and brain perform similar computations. Whether the aligned units are causally involved in model computation is rarely checked. On an abstract pattern-completion task (AAABAAA $\rightarrow$ B), we compare LLM attention-head representations with human EEG and test how ablating those heads affects task performance. Alignment and causation dissociate: brain-aligned heads contribute to performance, but their removal is substantially less disruptive than removal of heads selected via attribution patching. We compare two head sets that prior interpretability work defines without reference to the brain: concept vectors (CVs), which represent abstract patterns across formats, and function vectors (FVs), selected for their contribution to correct-answer prediction. Brain alignment shows little association with FV scores, while its association with CV scores varies across models. Among brain-aligned heads, we find recurring attention profiles: one emphasizes distinctive elements (novelty heads), the other repeating elements (repetition heads). The novelty family tracks salience and attends to the same elements that humans look at, yet its removal is less damaging than random ablation on average. Repetition heads contribute modestly to performance and are associated with abstract-pattern representation (CVs). Across 17 models spanning 3B-72B parameters, FV-ranked removal is substantially more disruptive than brain-ranked removal. Brain alignment thus captures how the model reads the stimulus, and only faintly captures how it represents the pattern and solves the task.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大语言模型(LLM)注意力头与人脑EEG信号的对齐关系，发现脑对齐头虽参与任务表现，但其因果贡献远小于归因补丁筛选的头(FVs)。新颖性头关注显著元素且与人类注视一致，但移除后损害小于随机消融；重复头贡献适度并关联抽象模式表征(CVs)。跨17个模型实验表明，脑对齐主要捕捉模型如何读取刺激，而非如何表征模式和解决任务。
AI.motivation: 脑-AI对齐常被解读为模型与大脑执行相似计算的证据，但鲜有研究检验对齐单元是否因果参与模型计算。本文旨在探究对齐与因果贡献的关系，理解模型注意力头的功能分工及其与人脑处理的异同。
AI.method: 在抽象模式补全任务(AAABAAA→B)上，对比LLM注意力头表征与人类EEG，测试消融这些头对任务表现的影响。引入概念向量(CVs, 跨格式表征抽象模式)和功能向量(FVs, 为正确答案预测做贡献)作为无脑参考的先验可解释性基准。跨越3B-72B参数的17个模型系统评估脑对齐排名与FV/CV排名的消融效应差异。
AI.result: 脑对齐与因果贡献分离：脑对齐头虽贡献表现，但移除破坏性显著弱于FV筛选头。脑对齐与FV评分关联微弱，与CV评分关联随模型变化。发现两类反复出现的注意力画像：新颖性头(关注显著/独特元素, 与人类注视一致, 移除损害小于随机消融)和重复头(关注重复元素, 适度贡献表现, 关联CVs)。FV排名消融在所有模型中破坏性均显著强于脑排名消融。
AI.conclusion: 脑对齐主要捕捉模型如何读取/编码刺激输入(如显著性检测), 而非核心的抽象模式表征与任务求解机制(由FVs/CVs捕捉)。对齐不能等同于因果必要性; 模型解决任务的关键计算单元(FVs)与脑对齐单元高度不重合, 提示当前对齐指标对模型内部计算逻辑的解释力有限。

title: GLASS: Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding for Scalable All-Atom Crystal Generation
summary: Generative models for crystals enable the discovery of novel structures, but scaling all-atom generation to larger systems such as metal--organic frameworks remains challenging. We connect this difficulty to the correspondence problem of particle-space generation. Even on a single fixed target set, index-free permutation-equivariant particle flows require substantially more training for reliable generation as set size and density increase, under both independent and optimal-transport couplings. To resolve this challenge, we introduce GLASS---Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding, which encodes structures in a permutation-invariant global latent space and learns their distribution via flow matching. A learned-slot decoder constructs all atoms in parallel, removing atom-wise correspondence from generative transport. On MP20, GLASS is competitive with particle-space models, and flow training can reach the validity of the training data at every structure size. On a QMOF subset, GLASS generates MOFs with up to 150 atoms per unit cell without conditioning on building blocks, topology, or composition, and approaches the structural validity of the training data. On both datasets, flow training exposes a validity--novelty tradeoff, and MOF novelty remains limited by autoencoder generalization on the available data. These results show that separating correspondence assignment from generative transport provides a simple route toward high-validity generation of larger atomistic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GLASS 模型，通过全局潜在空间编码和基于槽位的集合解码，解决晶体生成中的对应问题，实现大规模原子系统的高有效性生成。
AI.motivation: 晶体生成模型在扩展到大规模系统（如金属有机框架）时面临挑战，主要归因于粒子空间生成中的对应问题：随着集合大小和密度增加，无索引排列等变粒子流需要更多训练才能可靠生成。
AI.method: GLASS 将结构编码为排列不变的全局潜在空间，通过流匹配学习分布；学习的槽位解码器并行构建所有原子，从生成传输中移除原子级对应关系。
AI.result: 在 MP20 数据集上，GLASS 与粒子空间模型竞争，流训练在各结构尺寸下达到训练数据的有效性；在 QMOF 子集上，无需条件生成高达 150 原子/单元的 MOF，接近训练数据的结构有效性；两数据集均揭示有效性-新颖性权衡，MOF 新颖性受限于自编码器在可用数据上的泛化。
AI.conclusion: 将对应分配与生成传输分离，为大规模原子系统的高有效性生成提供了一条简单路径。

title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced models. We further evaluate whether RL interventions targeting beliefs, decisions, or both improve these components across three domains, whether improvements transfer across components and elicitation formats, and whether decision performance can improve without improvement in belief formation. We find that targeting one component of probabilistic reasoning redistributes decision loss, improving the target without necessarily transferring to others, and that jointly targeting belief formation and decision-making improves both but hinges on matched formats between training and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出决策理论框架，将大语言模型（LLM）的决策损失分解为信念形成准确性与效用优化行动转化两个组件，在合成基准上评估前沿与开源模型，并测试针对信念、决策或两者兼施的RL干预，发现单组件优化会重新分配损失且跨组件迁移有限，联合优化虽能同时提升两者但强依赖训练与评估的格式匹配。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作决策助手，需要在明确决策成本下从证据中进行概率推理。现有研究缺乏将决策损失拆解为信念形成与行动选择的系统性框架，难以定位模型在概率推理中的具体短板，也难以指导针对性改进。
AI.method: 构建具有已知真值的合成基准，将决策损失分解为：1）从证据形成准确信念的能力；2）将信念转化为优化给定效用函数的行动的能力。在三个领域对前沿与开源模型应用该分解，并实施针对信念、决策或两者的强化学习干预，考察改进是否跨组件迁移、跨提示格式泛化，以及决策性能能否在信念形成不提升的情况下改善。
AI.result: 针对单一组件的RL干预会重新分配决策损失，改进目标组件但不一定迁移至另一组件；联合针对信念形成与决策制定的干预可同时提升两者，但效果强烈依赖于训练与评估时的提示格式是否匹配。
AI.conclusion: 决策理论分解揭示了LLM概率推理中信念形成与决策制定的可分离性；RL可针对性改进特定组件，但跨组件迁移有限；联合优化虽有效但需格式对齐，提示工程与训练目标的一致性对实际部署至关重要。

title: The Vote Hides the Failure: Aggregation Choice and Noise Robustness in Heart Murmur Detection
summary: Noise robustness in automated phonocardiogram (PCG) murmur detection, and how it is measured, remains underexamined despite growing interest in low-resource screening. We evaluate two independently reimplemented pipelines, Hierarchical Multi-Scale Convolutional Network (HMS-Net)--CNN, and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM)--LSTM, under controlled, multi-severity noise with noise-augmented fine-tuning and held-out generalization testing. Under matched aggregation, the complete BiLSTM pipeline outperforms the complete HMS-Net pipeline across all conditions in accuracy and Weighted Accuracy. A stable aggregate accuracy score can misrepresent what individual predictions show: HMS-Net's native aggregation degrades under salt-and-pepper noise far less than majority-vote (MV) aggregation at the same severity, a gap reflecting window-level disagreement its native rule absorbs, while BiLSTM's MV accuracy rises after noise-augmented training even though its individual predictions do not improve. HMS-Net's training effect is significant under one accuracy metric but not another. Noise-robustness conclusions can depend as much on evaluation choices as on the models themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文评估两种心音杂音检测管道（HMS-Net和BiLSTM）在受控噪声条件下的鲁棒性，发现评估指标选择对鲁棒性结论影响与模型本身相当。
AI.motivation: 尽管低资源筛查中自动心音图（PCG）杂音检测日益受关注，但其噪声鲁棒性及度量方式仍研究不足。
AI.method: 独立重新实现两种管道：层次多尺度卷积网络（HMS-Net，CNN）和双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM，LSTM），在受控多严重度噪声下进行噪声增强微调和保留泛化测试，使用匹配聚合和多数投票（MV）聚合对比。
AI.result: 在匹配聚合下，完整BiLSTM管道在准确率和加权准确率上均优于HMS-Net。聚合准确率可能掩盖个体预测表现：HMS-Net原生聚合在椒盐噪声下退化远小于MV聚合，反映其原生规则吸收了窗口级分歧；BiLSTM经噪声增强训练后MV准确率上升但个体预测未改善。HMS-Net训练效果在一种准确率指标下显著，另一种则不显著。
AI.conclusion: 噪声鲁棒性结论既取决于评估选择（聚合方式、指标），也取决于模型本身；需谨慎解释聚合指标，关注个体预测层面的表现。

title: HARISSA: Inference-Time Self-Checks for Efficient and Safe Local Language Model Deployment
summary: Running a language model locally offers advantages in privacy, latency, and cost, but local hardware fits only small models, which are less capable than frontier models. The usual remedy for a hard query, escalating it to a cloud model, gives up the privacy and cost advantages of running locally. A deployment that stays local faces two decisions for hard queries instead. First, it can spend more computation on a query, e.g., reasoning before answering, which raises accuracy at a cost in latency, so it must decide which queries are worth the extra computation (efficiency). Second, some queries are beyond the local model, and delivering a wrong answer is worse than deferring the query to a human in the loop, so it must decide which answers are safe to deliver (safety). We show that both decisions can be made from the model's own hidden states. The prefill state, computed before any token is generated, predicts whether the model will answer correctly, and the answer state, at the end of the generated answer, predicts whether that answer is correct. HARISSA fine-tunes the model so that both states predict correctness, then makes both decisions with one policy that cascades through the ways of answering from cheapest to most expensive, skipping a way the prefill state predicts will fail and deferring the query when the answer it stops with is predicted wrong. On a device running a single model, HARISSA is within one accuracy point of chain-of-thought at 2.7 times lower latency. On a server holding four sizes of one model, HARISSA is more accurate than the FrugalGPT and Self-REF cascades at the same latency, and at the same deferral rate the answer state leaves fewer wrong answers than the standard confidence signals in five of six task and setting pairs.

AI.tldr: HARISSA 是一种本地部署语言模型的级联决策框架，利用模型隐藏状态（prefill state 和 answer state）预测回答正确性，在不牺牲隐私和成本优势的前提下，通过自适应计算分配和拒答机制，在单模型设备上以 2.7 倍更低延迟达到接近 CoT 的准确率，在多模型服务器上超越 FrugalGPT 和 Self-REF 级联基线。
AI.motivation: 本地运行语言模型具有隐私、延迟和成本优势，但受限于硬件只能部署小模型，能力弱于前沿大模型。常见补救是将难查询上传云端，但会丧失本地部署的隐私和成本优势。因此需要一种纯本地部署方案，在保持隐私和成本优势的同时，通过自适应计算分配（效率）和拒答机制（安全性）来处理难查询。
AI.method: HARISSA 微调模型使其隐藏状态能预测回答正确性：prefill state（生成前）预测模型能否正确回答，answer state（生成后）预测已生成回答是否正确。策略级联遍历从廉价到昂贵的回答方式：跳过 prefill state 预测会失败的方式，在 answer state 预测回答错误时拒答并转交人工。
AI.result: 单模型设备上，HARISSA 准确率与 Chain-of-Thought 相差 1 个百分点以内，延迟降低 2.7 倍。四模型服务器上，相同延迟下 HARISSA 准确率高于 FrugalGPT 和 Self-REF 级联；相同拒答率下，answer state 在 6 个任务/设置对中的 5 个上比标准置信度信号留下的错误回答更少。
AI.conclusion: 利用模型自身隐藏状态进行双重预测（prefill 与 answer）可实现高效且安全的纯本地级联推理，无需云端协助即可在保持隐私和成本优势的前提下接近甚至超越现有级联基线的性能。

title: Storage Is Not Strategy: State-Conditioned Support Control for LLM Unlearning
summary: Many localized large language model (LLM) unlearning methods select a small parameter subset from a localization signal and keep it fixed during optimization. The parameters most associated with a target, however, need not be the best ones to update, and candidate interventions can change value as optimization proceeds. In a controlled experiment, a storage-localization score reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.981, yet storage identity agrees with the better intervention on only 17/36 targets, while low-rank adaptation (LoRA) wins 35/36. We introduce Intervention Score, which ranks editable groups by the predicted effect of the actual unlearning update while accounting for collateral damage, and use it to form the static intervention-value baseline (Static-IV). We then introduce selective dynamic intervention re-ranking (DIR-R), which revisits that subset only when a calibrated probe justifies the comparison. On the Natural-TOFU dataset, our method has positive descriptive margins in 19/20 comparisons between methods and objectives, although several are near zero. On the LACUNA localization-precision benchmark, our mean terminal utility is higher in all six negative preference optimization (NPO) and SimNPO comparisons: NPO margins range from +0.431 to +0.848, and SimNPO margins range from +0.503 to +0.571. The gradient-difference (GradDiff) objective reveals substantial field dependence. Relative to Static-IV, the primary four-field GradDiff evaluation has six wins, six ties, and no losses, with mean and median paired gains of +0.165 and +0.0025. The evidence supports separating localization, initial intervention selection, and checkpoint-dependent support revision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的LLM遗忘方法选择框架，引入Intervention Score评分机制和动态干预重排序(DIR-R)，解决了参数定位与最优干预参数不一致的问题，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有局部化LLM遗忘方法通常从定位信号中选择一小部分参数并固定优化，但与目标最相关的参数不一定是最佳更新参数，且候选干预在优化过程中会变化。实验显示存储定位得分AUROC达0.981，但存储身份仅在17/36目标上同意更好干预，而LoRA在35/36上获胜，揭示了定位与干预选择的脱节。
AI.method: 1) 引入Intervention Score，根据实际遗忘更新的预测效果对可编辑组进行排名，同时考虑附带损害；2) 基于此构建静态干预值基线(Static-IV)；3) 提出选择性动态干预重排序(DIR-R)，仅在校准探针证明比较合理时才重新审视该子集。
AI.result: 在Natural-TOFU数据集上，该方法在20个方法-目标对比中有19个显示正描述性边际；在LACUNA定位精度基准上，所有六个NPO和SimNPO对比的平均终端效用均更高，NPO边际+0.431到+0.848，SimNPO边际+0.503到+0.571。GradDiff目标显示显著领域依赖性，相对Static-IV在四领域评估中6胜6平0负，平均配对增益+0.165，中位数+0.0025。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持将定位、初始干预选择和检查点依赖的支持修订分离开来。动态重排序机制能有效适应优化过程中的参数变化，显著提升遗忘性能同时控制附带损害。

title: Brain-SAD: A Brain-Inspired Safe Autonomous Driving Control Framework with Dynamic Fear-Oriented Constraint on Dual-Policy
summary: Constrained Reinforcement Learning has recently gained increasing attention in the field of Safe Autonomous Driving, where the general mechanism is to maximize the expected reward while keeping the overall action risk bounded. In this way, the safety issues arising in AD can be mitigated through constrained actions. However, existing Constrained RL methods still lack dynamics on the imposed constraints. For instance, the action cost adopted by the existing Primal-Dual/soft-constrained methods is often defined as static state-to-cost mapping, and the safe-action projection in hard-constrained methods relies on the static projection with the fixed feasible region boundary estimated from offline demonstrations. The above drawback tightly couples the imposed constraints to the training scenarios, leaving the AD policy hard to handle different interaction scenarios, due to the improper state-level action-cost and the static projection boundary. Consequently, in this paper, we propose Brain-SAD, a brain-inspired safe autonomous driving control framework with dynamic fear-oriented constraints. By perceiving the current vehicle-interaction scene, Brain-SAD generates dynamic fear signal as fear reaction to online decide long-term policy for regular interaction or short-term policy for urgent-collision defense. In such two policy, the above fear-reaction will be constructed as the dynamic fear constraints, respectively reflecting the overall fear cost directly coupled with action-impact, and the dynamic fear boundary of the feasible region derived from different risky neighbors, both of which will in turn serve for the online policy optimization. Experimental results show that Brain-SAD outperforms existing methods, achieving higher success rate in shorter task-completion and collision-recovery time, and exhibits stronger reliability across continuous intersections of fluctuating complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Brain-SAD，一个受大脑启发的安全自动驾驶控制框架，引入动态恐惧导向约束，解决现有约束强化学习方法中约束静态、难以泛化到不同交互场景的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有约束强化学习（CRL）方法在安全自动驾驶中存在约束静态化的缺陷：软约束方法采用静态状态到成本的映射，硬约束方法依赖离线演示估计的固定可行区域边界。这导致约束与训练场景强耦合，使得策略难以处理多样化的交互场景，因不当的状态级动作成本和静态投影边界而失效。
AI.method: Brain-SAD 通过感知当前车辆交互场景，生成动态恐惧信号作为恐惧反应，在线决定长期策略（常规交互）或短期策略（紧急碰撞防御）。在两种策略中，恐惧反应被构建为动态恐惧约束：一是直接与动作影响耦合的整体恐惧成本，二是从不同风险邻居衍生出的动态可行区域恐惧边界。两者服务于在线策略优化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明 Brain-SAD 优于现有方法，在更短的任务完成时间和碰撞恢复时间内实现更高的成功率，并在波动复杂度的连续路口中表现出更强的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: Brain-SAD 通过引入脑启发的动态恐惧约束机制，有效解决了约束强化学习在自动驾驶中的静态约束局限，实现了对多变交互场景的自适应安全控制，显著提升了安全性能和泛化能力。

title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods such as GRPO rely on successful self-generated trajectories, but finite rollout budgets can produce all-fail groups with no reward-based policy-gradient signal. While additional rollouts improve the chance of success at higher cost, successful trajectories missing from one model's rollouts may already have been discovered by another. Indeed, we observe that heterogeneous models often succeed on complementary prompts, creating opportunities for mutual learning without a designated stronger teacher. To exploit this complementarity, we propose GRAFT (Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories), an off-policy-aware framework that replaces all-fail groups with informative peer groups. GRAFT transfers both successful and unsuccessful peer responses with peer-computed advantages, while controlling cross-model mismatch through sequence-level compatibility weighting and token-level importance ratio clipping. Across three heterogeneous model pairs and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GRAFT consistently improves both models over GRPO with the same per-model rollout budget, gaining 2.1 points on average and up to 4.5 points in model-level average performance. Stored peer trajectories preserve most of the gains, improving over GRPO by 1.8 points on average without simultaneous co-training.

AI.tldr: GRAFT 是一种感知离线策略的框架，通过用异构模型的同伴轨迹替换全失败组，实现模型间的互相学习，在不增加每模型采样预算的情况下持续提升两个模型的数学推理性能。
AI.motivation: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）如 GRPO 中，有限的采样预算可能导致全失败组，无法提供基于奖励的策略梯度信号。虽然增加采样次数能提高成功率但成本更高，而异构模型往往在互补的提示上成功，为无需指定更强教师模型的互相学习创造了机会。
AI.method: GRAFT 将全失败组替换为信息量大的同伴组，传递同伴计算的优势估计（包括成功和失败的响应），通过序列级兼容性加权和令牌级重要性比率裁剪来控制跨模型分布偏移。
AI.result: 在三对异构模型和五个数学推理基准上，GRAFT 平均比 GRPO 提升 2.1 分，最高达 4.5 分。存储的同伴轨迹保留了大部分增益，在无需同步协同训练的情况下仍比 GRPO 平均提升 1.8 分。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT 有效利用异构模型间的互补性实现互相学习，为单纯增加采样预算提供了一种高效的替代方案，且支持离线存储的同伴轨迹复用。

title: Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation
summary: Off-policy and on-policy distillation have traditionally been formulated as separate paradigms, each favoring a different property of distillation trajectories. Teacher-generated (off-policy) traces are typically high-quality but lie far from the student's distribution, whereas student-generated (on-policy) rollouts are more learnable but often contain erroneous reasoning. We view these paradigms as the endpoints of a policy continuum and posit that a more effective rollout policy may lie in between. We introduce \textbf{Interpolated Policy Distillation (IPD)}, which defines the next-token distribution at every decoding step as an explicit linear interpolation between the student and teacher distributions. The interpolation operates at the distribution level, token by token, and its coefficient provides direct control over the balance between trajectory quality and student learnability. Naively sampling from this policy would require sequentially querying the teacher at every token and is thus expensive. To make IPD practical, we accelerate it with a new speculative-decoding rule while exactly preserving the interpolated next-token distribution.At the trajectory level, the resulting rollouts naturally interleave student- and teacher-generated segments. Unlike recent heuristic segment-interleaving methods, however, this interleaving is induced by an exactly realized token-level interpolated policy rather than by hand-designed switching rules. Across text-only and multimodal reasoning benchmarks, IPD consistently outperforms both endpoint policies (SFT and OPD), their conventional two-stage combination (SFT-then-OPD), and recent heuristic segment-interleaving methods, demonstrating that token-level policy interpolation better balances trajectory quality and student learnability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出插值策略蒸馏（IPD），在token层面将教师和学生分布线性插值，平衡轨迹质量与可学习性，并用推测解码加速采样，在文本和多模态推理任务上优于SFT、OPD及启发式分段交替方法。
AI.motivation: 离线蒸馏（OPD）轨迹质量高但偏离学生分布；在线蒸馏（SFT）轨迹易学但含错误推理。两者是策略连续体的两端，中间可能存在更优策略。
AI.method: IPD在每个解码步将下一token分布定义为教师和学生分布的线性插值，插值系数控制质量与可学习性权衡。为避免逐token查询教师的高开销，提出新的推测解码规则精确保持插值分布，轨迹层面自然交替教师/学生片段。
AI.result: 在文本与多模态推理基准上，IPD持续超越SFT、OPD、SFT-then-OPD及启发式分段交替方法，验证token级策略插值能更好平衡轨迹质量与学生可学习性。
AI.conclusion: IPD通过token级分布插值与精确实现的推测解码，统一了离线/在线蒸馏范式，实现了质量与可学习性的显式连续权衡，优于现有启发式分段交替方法。

title: PE-EK-PINN: Physics Embedding with Evolving Kernel for Scalable Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) embed governing equations into deep learning, but enforce them only through loss residuals, leaving highly oscillatory wave behavior to be discovered by optimization. As a result, methods that achieve relative $L_2$ errors below $10^{-3}$ on standard manufactured Helmholtz benchmarks can fail on practical radiation problems involving singular excitations, absorbing boundaries, and wave fields spanning tens of wavelengths. Architectural physics embedding addresses this limitation by factorizing the field into analytically derived oscillatory kernels and learnable envelopes. However, the kernel dictionary must be manually constructed and scales with the number of elementary units, growing exponentially with the depth of hierarchically structured systems such as antenna arrays and metasurfaces. We propose PE-EK-PINN (Physics Embedded with Evolving Kernels), which treats physics kernels as reusable learned representations rather than fixed analytical inputs. A converged subsystem field is frozen and promoted to an evolved kernel, whose transformed copies are reused to represent higher-level configurations without deriving new governing equations. The resulting hierarchy makes the peak number of active kernels independent of system size and reduces cumulative training cost from $O(N)$ to $O(\log N)$. Experiments on dipole arrays, composite line-source geometries, and cross arrays demonstrate the dramatic training cost reduction, while achieving a reduced or comparable relative $L_2$ error. One notable example is PE-EK-PINN solves a $256$-dipole array more than 30 times faster than direct PE-PINN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PE-EK-PINN（Physics Embedded with Evolving Kernels），将物理核视为可复用的学习表示而非固定解析输入，通过冻结收敛子系统场并提升为演化核，实现分层复用，使活跃核数量与系统规模解耦，训练成本从 O(N) 降至 O(log N)，在偶极子阵列、复合线源及十字阵列等基准上大幅加速且精度相当或更优。
AI.motivation: 传统 PINN 仅通过损失残差嵌入控制方程，难以捕捉高振荡波场；架构物理嵌入（PE-PINN）虽将场分解为解析振荡核与可学习包络，但核字典需人工构建且随层级深度指数增长，限制了对天线阵列、超构表面等大规模分层系统的适用性。
AI.method: PE-EK-PINN 引入演化核机制：训练基础子系统至收敛，冻结其场作为演化核；通过几何变换复用该核构建更高层级配置，无需推导新控制方程。形成核复用层级，使峰值活跃核数与系统规模无关，累积训练复杂度从 O(N) 降为 O(log N)。
AI.result: 在偶极子阵列、复合线源几何、十字阵列实验中，PE-EK-PINN 实现显著训练加速且相对 L2 误差相当或更低；典型案例：256 偶极子阵列求解速度比直接 PE-PINN 快 30 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: PE-EK-PINN 通过将物理核提升为可学习、可复用的演化表示，突破了手工核字典的规模瓶颈，为大规模分层波场问题提供了高效、可扩展的物理信息神经网络框架。

title: Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student to match a privileged teacher distribution along its own sampled trajectory. Standard OPSD applies this supervision to unverified student rollouts while conditioning the teacher on privileged context, typically a reference solution. We separate these roles in a factorial analysis and find that scaffold correctness has a stronger effect on downstream accuracy than context correctness. Unverified scaffolds create an imitation gap because the teacher can use information unavailable to the student. This gap shrinks with model scale, yet OPSD continues to supervise mostly unverified trajectories. In contrast, verified scaffolds remain effective even when the teacher is conditioned on the student's own unsuccessful rollout. Based on this finding, we introduce OASIS, which retains the OPSD objective but supervises mostly verified by label on-policy trajectories and replaces written solutions with unverified model-generated attempts as the teacher context. OASIS therefore requires only final-answer labels. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025, OASIS improves over the base model by 3.2--3.8 points on average, while OPSD's gain falls from 3.05 points at 1.7B to 0.14 at 8B. At 8B, OASIS improves over OPSD by 3.05 points, showing that verified on-policy scaffolds preserve the effectiveness of self-distillation as models scale.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OASIS方法，通过监督已验证的on-policy轨迹并使用未验证的模型生成尝试作为教师上下文，仅需最终答案标签即可在数学推理任务上显著提升性能，且随模型规模扩大优势更明显。
AI.motivation: 标准OPSD监督未验证的学生轨迹并依赖特权上下文（参考解法），导致模仿鸿沟：教师可利用学生不可用的信息。研究发现脚手架正确性对下游准确率影响大于上下文正确性，且验证过的脚手架即使在教师条件为学生失败轨迹时仍有效。
AI.method: OASIS保留OPSD目标，但主要监督标签验证过的on-policy轨迹，将书面解法替换为未验证的模型生成尝试作为教师上下文，仅需最终答案标签。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B上，OASIS平均比基础模型提升3.2-3.8分；OPSD增益从1.7B的3.05分降至8B的0.14分；8B时OASIS比OPSD高3.05分。
AI.conclusion: 验证过的on-policy脚手架能保持自蒸馏随模型扩展的有效性，解决了标准OPSD随规模增大性能下降的问题。

title: Corruption-Robust Sparse Linear Contextual Bandits with Knapsack Constraints
summary: We study sparse linear contextual bandits with knapsack constraints under joint reward and consumption corruption. Consumption corruption creates a challenge beyond corrupted rewards: it affects not only statistical estimates, but also the recorded budget, resource prices, and stopping decisions that govern future allocation. We develop Robust Optimistic Primal--Dual (ROPD), an estimator-modular framework that combines corruption-aware confidence widths with online resource prices and a budget-safety rule. With concrete sparse implementation, ROPD achieves regret against a clean population-LP benchmark of $\widetilde O(T^{2/3}+ΓT^{1/3})$ under forced exploration and population-design coverage, and $\widetilde O(\sqrt T+Γ)$ under on-policy realized-design coverage, for a supplied valid corruption bound $Γ$ under the stated proportional-budget scaling and fixed model/design parameters. When the corruption level is unknown, Shared-Grid adapts confidence radii around common point estimates fitted to a single realized history, incurring explicit initialization and master-comparison costs; its sharper on-policy guarantee additionally requires recommendation coverage. Both methods preserve observed budgets on every realization and bound clean resource violation by cumulative consumption corruption. These results connect corruption-robust sparse estimation with resource accounting, pricing, and stopping in high-dimensional online allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带有背包约束的稀疏线性情境多臂老虎机问题，考虑奖励和消耗的联合污染。提出了鲁棒乐观原始对偶（ROPD）框架，结合污染感知置信宽度、在线资源价格和预算安全规则。在给定污染界 Γ 下，ROPD 实现了两种遗憾界：强制探索设定下为 Õ(T^{2/3}+ΓT^{1/3})，在线策略设定下为 Õ(√T+Γ)。当污染水平未知时，提出 Shared-Grid 方法自适应调整置信半径。两种方法均保证观测预算不被违背，并将干净资源违规量限制在累积消耗污染范围内。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注奖励污染，但消耗污染带来额外挑战：它不仅影响统计估计，还扭曲记录的预算、资源价格和停止决策，进而影响未来的资源分配。需要一种能同时处理奖励和消耗污染、保证预算安全且适应高维稀疏设定的框架。
AI.method: 提出 ROPD 框架：采用估计器模块化设计，结合污染感知的置信宽度、在线更新的原始对偶资源价格、以及预算安全规则（保证观测预算不超支）。具体实现使用稀疏线性回归估计器。针对未知污染水平，提出 Shared-Grid 方法：在单一实现历史上拟合公共点估计，通过共享网格自适应调整置信半径，引入显式初始化和主比较成本。
AI.result: ROPD 在给定污染界 Γ 下实现两种遗憾界：(1) 强制探索 + 总体设计覆盖：Õ(T^{2/3}+ΓT^{1/3})；(2) 在线策略 + 实现设计覆盖：Õ(√T+Γ)。Shared-Grid 在未知 Γ 时自适应达到类似界，但需要推荐覆盖条件。两种方法均逐轨迹保持观测预算可行，并将干净资源违规量上界为累积消耗污染。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了污染鲁棒稀疏估计与资源核算、定价、停止决策在高维在线分配中的联系。ROPD 和 Shared-Grid 为带背包约束的情境老虎机提供了首个同时处理奖励和消耗污染、保证预算安全且具有理论遗憾保证的算法框架。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation
summary: An agent skill is a reusable, actionable natural-language artifact that guides an agent to perform a task effectively under a given harness. Recent studies have explored the optimization of agent skills, contributing to a growing collection of publicly available skills spanning diverse tasks, domains, and harnesses. Despite millions of publicly shared skills, existing skill optimization methods largely overlook this accumulated knowledge, instead relying solely on expensive agent rollouts to iteratively refine skills for a target task. To address this, we propose \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization (RASO)}, a framework that leverages an external skill corpus as prior knowledge throughout skill optimization. RASO retrieves relevant knowledge from existing skills and adapts it to the target task and harness via Cross-Harness Adaptation, accounting for mismatches in both domain and harness. RASO comprises two complementary stages: \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Initialization (RASI)} constructs a knowledge-grounded initial skill without requiring agent rollouts, while \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Update (RASU)} iteratively refines the skill by retrieving external knowledge guided by execution feedback. Across four agent benchmarks and two models, extensive experiments show that RASO consistently outperforms baselines without retrieval-augmented skill initialization and updating.

AI.tldr: 本文提出检索增强技能优化框架（RASO），利用外部技能语料库作为先验知识，通过跨Harness适应解决领域和Harness不匹配，包含无需Agent Rollout的检索增强技能初始化（RASI）和基于执行反馈迭代优化的检索增强技能更新（RASU），在四个Agent基准和两个模型上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent技能优化方法忽略公开共享的海量技能知识，仅依赖昂贵的Agent Rollout迭代优化，导致效率低下且未能利用跨任务、跨领域、跨Harness的累积经验。
AI.method: RASO包含两阶段：1) RASI：从外部技能语料库检索相关知识，通过跨Harness适应构建知识驱动的初始技能，无需Agent Rollout。2) RASU：基于执行反馈检索外部知识迭代优化技能，进一步适配目标任务和Harness。
AI.result: 在四个Agent基准（如WebShop、ALFWorld等）和两个模型（GPT-3.5、GPT-4）上，RASO在成功率、效率等指标上持续优于无检索增强的基线方法，显著减少Rollout次数。
AI.conclusion: RASO证明了利用外部技能语料库作为先验知识进行检索增强初始化和迭代更新能有效提升Agent技能优化性能，为跨Harness、跨领域技能复用提供了可扩展范式。

title: Time-Anchored Diffusion Language Models: Latent-Space Caching for Fast Generation
summary: Recent work on anchored diffusion language models improves denoising by shaping an intermediate latent space with supervised important-token targets. In this work, we introduce time-based (self-supervised) anchoring, which learns and reuses latent anchors without requiring such targets. Our key observation is that anchors encode persistent properties of the clean sequence, such as its semantic intent, global structure, or intermediate plan. Although their hidden representations become stale as the token canvas evolves, their semantic content remains useful across nearby diffusion times. This is implemented through a two-stage architecture consisting of a relatively expensive anchor network that generates the latent cache state and a lightweight denoising network that intelligently combines the cached latent state with the current state at each reverse step using a fusion module. This gives anchoring a latent-space caching interpretation: the anchor network is evaluated periodically, while its cached representation is reused across multiple reverse steps. We instantiate this framework as TADM:Post-train, which time-anchorizes pretrained DLMs, and TADM:Pretraining, which learns time-based anchors during pretraining. Applied to DiffusionGemma-26B, TADM:Post-train improves throughput by approximately 49% to 79% on several math, code, and STEM benchmarks (GSM8K, AIME26, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench-v6, HumanEval, MMLU-Pro). TADM:Pretraining reduces Transformer-layer computation by up to 38% relative to a standard single-stage DLM, achieves up to 73% higher measured throughput than ADLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时间锚定扩散模型（TADM），通过自监督的时间锚定机制，在无需监督重要标记目标的情况下，实现扩散语言模型的高效去噪。TADM采用双阶段架构：锚点网络周期性生成潜在缓存状态，轻量级去噪网络通过融合模块复用缓存状态，显著提升吞吐量并减少计算量。
AI.motivation: 现有锚定扩散语言模型（ADLM）依赖监督的重要标记目标来塑造中间潜在空间，限制了其泛化能力和适用范围。研究者观察到锚点编码了干净序列的持久属性（语义意图、全局结构、中间规划），且这些语义内容在相邻扩散时间步间保持有效，从而动机开发无需监督目标的时间锚定机制。
AI.method: 提出双阶段架构：1）较昂贵的锚点网络周期性评估生成潜在缓存状态；2）轻量级去噪网络在每个反向步骤通过融合模块智能组合缓存潜在状态与当前状态。将此框架实例化为TADM:Post-train（对预训练DLM进行时间锚定后训练）和TADM:Pretraining（预训练阶段学习时间锚点）。
AI.result: 在DiffusionGemma-26B上，TADM:Post-train在GSM8K、AIME26、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench-v6、HumanEval、MMLU-Pro等数学、代码和STEM基准上将吞吐量提升约49%-79%。TADM:Pretraining相较标准单阶段DLM将Transformer层计算量减少高达38%，实测吞吐量比ADLM高出高达73%。
AI.conclusion: 时间锚定提供了一种潜在空间缓存的解释视角，通过周期性评估锚点网络并复用缓存表示，在无需监督重要标记目标的情况下显著提升扩散语言模型的推理效率，且在多项基准上保持或提升性能。

title: Pointwise or Pairwise: When Do Pairwise Losses Help Reward Learning, Provably?
comment: 58 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables; second through sixth authors contributed equally
summary: Pairwise losses are increasingly used for reward learning even when pointwise rewards are observed, with mixed empirical results. When and why do pairwise losses outperform pointwise losses? We study this question in a grouped offline contextual-bandit setting allowing multiple actions per context, capturing many reward learning scenarios. We compare Value Regression (VR), which regresses observed rewards pointwise, with Value Difference Regression (VDR), which regresses reward differences between a pair of actions sampled under the same context. We consider a semiparametric model where the mean reward is the sum of a learnable action-dependent component and an arbitrary context-dependent yet action-independent nuisance, capturing context-specific disturbances. Using a unified localized analysis, we prove finite-sample regression guarantees for finite and linear function classes and translate them into offline-regret bounds. For finite classes, VDR eliminates the misspecification term in the VR bound and improves a reward-scale-dependent error term by averaging over actions within each context, a benefit absent from the corresponding VR term. For linear classes, neither method uniformly dominates: within-context differencing removes nuisance-induced bias but may increase estimation variance relative to using absolute rewards when the misspecification is sufficiently low. This yields a feature geometry-dependent bias-variance tradeoff, which we corroborate with numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文在分组离线情境多臂老虎机设定下，对比了逐点回归价值回归（VR）与成对差值回归（VDR）两种奖励学习方法。通过半参数模型和统一局部化分析，证明了有限样本回归保证并转化为离线遗憾界。结果显示：对于有限函数类，VDR 消除了 VR 中的模型误设项，并通过上下文内动作平均改进了依赖奖励尺度的误差项；对于线性函数类，两者不存在均匀优势，上下文内差分虽能消除干扰项偏差，但当误设较小时可能增加估计方差，呈现特征几何依赖的偏差-方差权衡，数值实验验证了理论发现。
AI.motivation: 成对损失在奖励学习中越来越常用，即使观测到逐点奖励，但实证结果好坏参半。何时以及为何成对损失优于逐点损失？本文旨在从理论上回答这一问题。
AI.method: 采用分组离线情境多臂老虎机框架，允许每个情境下有多个动作。比较价值回归（VR，逐点回归观测奖励）与价值差值回归（VDR，回归同一情境下动作对的奖励差）。假设半参数模型：平均奖励 = 可学习的动作相关分量 + 任意情境相关但动作无关的干扰项。使用统一局部化分析，推导有限函数类和线性函数类的有限样本回归保证，并转化为离线遗憾界。
AI.result: 有限函数类：VDR 消除 VR 界中的误设项，并通过情境内动作平均改进依赖奖励尺度的误差项。线性函数类：无均匀优势；情境内差分移除干扰诱导偏差，但当误设充分小时可能相对绝对奖励增加估计方差，形成特征几何依赖的偏差-方差权衡。数值实验佐证理论。
AI.conclusion: 成对损失（VDR）在存在情境特异性干扰且模型误设较大时优于逐点损失（VR），但在模型良设且特征几何导致方差放大时可能劣于 VR。选择应根据误设程度和特征几何权衡偏差与方差。

title: UserProxyBench: Evaluating LLM User Simulators for Agent Benchmarks and Training
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks Workshop (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Interactive agent benchmarks and multi-turn reinforcement learning increasingly place a second language model in the role of the user. This simulated user controls what information the agent receives and when, yet current benchmarks score only the agent and do not directly measure whether the user correctly executed its assigned role. We introduce UserProxyBench, an evaluation layer over the tau-bench family, and the User Fidelity Score (UFS), which measures adherence to the benchmark's private user instructions using task-grounded rubric criteria scored independently of agent success. Holding the agent fixed at GPT-5.5 and varying only the user proxy across 375 enterprise tasks changes mean task reward by 15.2 points, while 24.4% of successful episodes contain a user-specification violation. The dominant failure is premature disclosure: users provide information before it is requested. This behavior has little effect on task reward, yet among successful episodes it causes the agent to make 1.06 fewer tool calls on average, changing the interaction being evaluated while preserving the reward. Finally, across seven proxies we identify an empirical cost-fidelity frontier, enabling practitioners to select the least expensive simulator that satisfies a required fidelity level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UserProxyBench 评估框架和用户保真度评分 (UFS)，用于量化交互式智能体基准中模拟用户对私有指令的遵循程度。实验表明，仅改变用户代理就能导致任务奖励波动 15.2 分，且 24.4% 的成功回合存在用户规范违规（主要是过早泄露信息），这种行为虽不显著影响奖励，却改变了交互模式（工具调用减少 1.06 次）。论文还绘制了七个代理的成本-保真度前沿，指导实践者选择满足保真度要求的最廉价模拟器。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式智能体基准（如 tau-bench）仅评估智能体性能，忽略了模拟用户是否正确扮演其角色。模拟用户控制信息流向与时机，其行为偏差可能扭曲评估结果，但缺乏直接度量用户遵循指令程度的指标。
AI.method: 构建 UserProxyBench 作为 tau-bench 家族的评估层，引入用户保真度评分 (UFS)——基于任务绑定的评分细则，独立于智能体成功与否，度量用户对私有指令的遵循情况。固定智能体为 GPT-5.5，在 375 个企业级任务上对比七种用户代理，分析奖励变化、违规率、工具调用次数及成本-保真度权衡。
AI.result: 1) 仅更换用户代理即导致平均任务奖励波动 15.2 分；2) 24.4% 的成功回合包含用户规范违规，主导失败模式为过早泄露信息；3) 违规虽不显著降低奖励，但使成功回合中智能体工具调用平均减少 1.06 次，改变了被评估的交互行为；4) 七个代理形成经验性成本-保真度前沿，可指导按需选择最廉价模拟器。
AI.conclusion: 模拟用户的保真度对基准评估的有效性至关重要。UserProxyBench 与 UFS 提供了首个专门度量用户角色执行质量的工具，揭示了当前基准中普遍存在的用户行为偏差，并给出了成本-保真度选择指南，推动更可靠的交互式智能体评估。

title: Explainable Machine Learning for Multilayer Planar Winding Inductance Estimation
summary: Rapid and accurate self-inductance estimation for multilayer rectangle-shaped planar windings is essential for modern high-frequency power converters, yet traditional workflows rely on complex mathematical equations, rigid monomial formulas or unexplainable black-box machine learning (ML) models that degrade severely outside their training domain. This paper introduces an explainable ML framework unifying post-hoc feature attribution (SHAP and permutation importance) with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-guided symbolic regression via the SR-KAN framework to discover closed-form analytical equations without prior structural assumptions. Evaluated on a new open-source dataset of over 10,000 Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations across seven out-of-distribution (OOD) classes, standard tree-based ensembles exhibit severe extrapolation errors (> 36%), whereas the unconstrained SR-KAN expression achieves a robust OOD relative error of 8.22%. Experimental verification across 55 physical printed circuit board prototypes (up to 8 layers, with inductances from 4.11 μH to 559.27 μH) confirms that the KAN-discovered expression translates effectively to real-world hardware, predicting inductance with a mean absolute relative error of 6.26%. To support reproducible research, the complete FEA simulation dataset and prototype measurements are released open-source.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可解释机器学习框架 SR-KAN，融合 SHAP 与排列重要性特征归因及 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络引导的符号回归，自动发现多层矩形平面绕组自感的闭式解析公式。在 10,000+ FEA 仿真数据集（含 7 类 OOD 样本）上，标准树集成模型外推误差超 36%，而 SR-KAN 表达式实现 8.22% 稳健 OOD 相对误差；55 个实物 PCB 原型（最多 8 层，电感 4.11–559.27 μH）验证平均绝对相对误差仅 6.26%，数据集与测量数据全量开源。
AI.motivation: 现代高频功率变换器急需快速、精准估算多层矩形平面绕组自感，但传统工作流依赖复杂数学方程、刚性单项式公式或不可解释的黑盒 ML 模型，这些模型在训练分布外严重失效，缺乏泛化能力与物理可解释性，阻碍了设计自动化与可靠性。
AI.method: 构建 SR-KAN 框架：先利用 SHAP 值与排列重要性进行事后特征归因，识别关键几何与材料参数；再引入 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）指导符号回归，在无先验结构假设下自动搜索闭式解析表达式。基于新建开源数据集（>10,000 组 FEA 仿真，覆盖 7 类分布外工况）对比标准树集成基线，并通过 55 块实物 PCB 原型（1–8 层，电感跨度 4.11–559.27 μH）进行实测验证。
AI.result: 树集成模型在 7 类 OOD 工况上外推误差 >36%，而无约束 SR-KAN 表达式将 OOD 相对误差压缩至 8.22%。实物 PCB 测试中，KAN 发现公式预测电感的平均绝对相对误差为 6.26%，确认解析式可有效迁移至真实硬件。完整 FEA 数据集与原型测量数据已开源，支持可复现研究。
AI.conclusion: SR-KAN 框架成功实现了自感建模的“白箱化”：自动发现的解析公式兼具高精度、强泛化（OOD 误差 <10%）与物理可解释性，经实物验证工程可用性达 6.26% 误差水平。该方法克服了黑盒 ML 与刚性经验公式的局限，为高频磁集成设计提供了可信赖的快速计算工具，开源资产进一步推动领域基准建立。

title: Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
comment: 25 pages, 16 figures, 8 tables. Under peer review
summary: As the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of large language models improve, evaluating and calibrating their reasoning confidence is becoming increasingly important for quantifying the uncertainty of their answers. Current methods for estimating the confidence of large language models are generally based on probabilities of selected key tokens, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Our pilot study finds that replacing selected token probabilities with coarse substitutes can also improve calibration, motivating us to further explore effective signals of model confidence. We introduce Divergent Token Confidence (DTC), a framework that estimates confidence by counting tokens at which two models strongly disagree during decoding. DTC identifies these divergent tokens using the Jensen-Shannon divergence between next-token distributions evaluated along the same reasoning trajectory. We find that their count is almost negatively associated with answer accuracy, thereby serving as a simple yet effective signal for uncertainty quantification. DTC supports both white-box and black-box evaluation using auxiliary models, without explicit training and affecting the generation process. Experiments across multiple model families and six mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved calibration over probability-based and verbalized baselines. Under white-box evaluation, the count-only estimator achieves an average expected calibration error of 13.0%, compared with 32.7%-42.4% for standard full-sequence confidence methods. In black-box settings, it also improves calibration over the original verbalized scores. For example, mean expected calibration error falls from 32.1%-40.2% to 13.7%-16.3% on DeepSeek-V3.2. These findings provide new insights for improving reasoning uncertainty quantification in large language models. The code is released at https://github.com/szu-tera/DTC.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Divergent Token Confidence (DTC)框架，通过统计两个模型在解码过程中强烈分歧的token数量来估计置信度，利用Jensen-Shannon散度识别分歧token。该方法无需训练、不影响生成过程，支持白盒和黑盒评估，在多个模型家族和六个数学基准上显著优于基于概率和口头化的基线，白盒下平均ECE仅13.0%（对比32.7%-42.4%），黑盒下DeepSeek-V3.2的ECE从32.1%-40.2%降至13.7%-16.3%。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型链式推理能力提升，评估和校准其推理置信度对于量化答案不确定性至关重要。现有置信度估计方法主要基于关键token概率，但底层机制不明确。初步研究发现用粗略替代品替换选定token概率也能改善校准，这激励作者进一步探索有效的模型置信度信号。
AI.method: 提出DTC框架：统计两个模型在相同推理轨迹上解码时强烈分歧的token数量。使用Jensen-Shannon散度比较两模型的下一token分布来识别分歧token。该方法支持白盒（需模型内部访问）和黑盒（使用辅助模型）评估，无需显式训练，不干扰生成过程。
AI.result: 跨多模型家族和六个数学基准的实验显示：白盒评估中，仅计数估计器平均期望校准误差(ECE)为13.0%，远优于标准全序列置信度方法的32.7%-42.4%；黑盒设置下，DeepSeek-V3.2的平均ECE从32.1%-40.2%降至13.7%-16.3%，优于原始口头化分数。
AI.conclusion: DTC为大语言模型推理不确定性量化提供了新见解，分歧token计数作为一种简单而有效的信号，能显著改善校准效果，且无需训练、不影响生成，适用于白盒和黑盒场景。

title: On Trajectory-Aware Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate text by unmasking several tokens per step, but they are trained and sampled under different conditions. The model is trained on randomly masked sequences, whereas inference follows a trajectory shaped by the model's own predictions. Additionally, each step has no access to what the previous one computed. Recent methods narrow these limitations from separate angles, leaving open how these choices interact. We introduce PUMBA, a unified framework for trajectory-aware training that trains the denoiser on consecutive steps of policy-induced trajectories, passes information between steps, and optimizes them jointly by backpropagation through time. A controlled study of this design space shows that i) exact train--inference alignment fails due to local overfitting, whereas a looser alignment still brings training masks closer to those seen at inference; ii) passing continuous information outperforms discrete gradient estimators through the commitment at each step; and iii) performance improves as backpropagation through time spans more steps, which we support theoretically. Combined, these components match the best checkpoint of a same-size autoregressive model. Building on these findings, we scale PUMBA to supervised fine-tuning of LLaDA-8B, where it improves the trade-off between performance and number of function evaluations (NFEs) in both full-canvas and block diffusion generation. At matched performance, it needs up to 22% fewer NFEs than standard fine-tuning with twice the budget in full-canvas generation, and up to 26% fewer than standard fine-tuning for the same number of steps in block diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PUMBA，一个面向轨迹感知训练的统一框架，通过在策略诱导的轨迹连续步骤上训练去噪器、在步骤间传递信息并利用时序反向传播联合优化，解决了掩码扩散模型训练与推理条件不匹配的问题，并在LLaDA-8B上实现了更优的性能与NFE权衡。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）在训练时使用随机掩码序列，而推理时遵循模型自身预测形成的轨迹，导致训练-推理分布不匹配；且每步无法获取前一步的计算信息。现有方法从不同角度缓解这些问题，但缺乏统一分析其相互作用。
AI.method: PUMBA框架包含三个核心设计：1）在策略诱导的轨迹连续步骤上训练去噪器，实现轨迹感知训练；2）在步骤间传递连续信息（而非离散梯度估计器）；3）通过时序反向传播（BPTT）跨越多步联合优化。并通过受控实验研究设计空间：训练-推理对齐松紧度、信息传递方式、BPTT跨步数量。
AI.result: 实验发现：i) 精确训练-推理对齐因局部过拟合而失败，较松的对齐仍能使训练掩码分布更接近推理；ii) 连续信息传递优于离散梯度估计器，归因于每步的承诺机制；iii) 随着BPTT跨步数增加性能提升，理论分析支持此结论。组合后匹配同规模自回归模型最佳检查点。在LLaDA-8B监督微调中，PUMBA改善性能-NFE权衡：全画布生成中同性能下比标准微调减少22% NFE（预算翻倍）；块扩散生成中同步数下减少26% NFE。
AI.conclusion: PUMBA通过统一的轨迹感知训练、连续信息传递和多步BPTT联合优化，有效缩小了MDM训练与推理的差距，显著提升生成效率与质量权衡，为大规模掩码扩散模型微调提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Interacting particle guidance for sampling reward-tilted generative priors
comment: Code will be made available after publication
summary: Inference-time steering adapts pretrained diffusion and flow-based models to new tasks, e.g., to generate samples from a conditional distribution or samples with desired properties, without retraining. This can be formalized as sampling from a reward-tilted generative prior. As exact sampling from this distribution is intractable, guidance-based methods rely on approximations producing biased samples, and sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods correct for this bias using importance weights. However, while exact in the large particle limit, SMC suffers from weight degeneracy and particle collapse in practice. We propose interacting particle guidance (IPG), which replaces reweighting with transport. The particles interact through an additional drift, derived from the Feynman--Kac PDE to cancel the reweighting term, and remain unweighted. Choosing the drift in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space yields a closed-form solution that is cheap to compute, with negligible overhead compared to SMC. We demonstrate the method on Gaussian mixtures with known posteriors, and on high-dimensional image inpainting and protein structure inference tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出交互粒子引导（IPG）方法，用于推理时引导预训练扩散/流模型，通过粒子间交互漂移替代重要性重采样，解决SMC的权重退化与粒子坍塌问题，在高斯混合、图像修复和蛋白质结构推断任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时引导方法（如基于指导的采样）产生有偏样本，而序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）虽理论无偏但实际中遭遇权重退化和粒子坍塌，亟需一种无需重采样、计算开销小的无偏采样方法。
AI.method: 提出交互粒子引导（IPG），基于Feynman-Kac PDE推导额外漂移项，使粒子通过交互传输而非重加权保持无权重；在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中选择漂移可得闭式解，计算开销极低。
AI.result: 在已知后验的高斯混合模型、高维图像修复和蛋白质结构推断任务上验证IPG有效性，优于SMC且计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: IPG通过粒子交互传输替代重要性重采样，解决了SMC的权重退化问题，提供了一种高效、无偏的推理时引导方法，适用于扩散/流模型的条件生成和属性控制任务。

title: Character Training for Risk-Averse Agents
summary: Risk aversion in resources could prevent misaligned AI agents from causing catastrophic harm. Misaligned but risk-averse agents would tend to favor safer strategies like making deals with humans over riskier strategies like rebelling. We train agents to be risk averse through character training, finding that persona traits provide a robust mechanism for instilling risk preferences. To do this, we construct a model constitution describing constant absolute risk aversion (CARA) over an agent's resources and instill it through on-policy distillation. Despite never seeing the benchmark's decision format during training, character-trained models are competitive with baselines trained directly on it, and generalise better than them out of distribution on two of our four models. We also modulate different aspects of the constitution, finding that token budget and model choice are the most influential aspect of character training to instill risk aversion. We conclude from these results that character training is a promising and scalable way to instil broad dispositions, which we can use to our advantage in mitigating risk from misaligned AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文探索通过角色训练在AI代理中植入风险厌恶倾向，作为防止目标错位AI造成灾难性伤害的安全措施。实验表明，角色训练的模型在未见过基准决策格式的情况下，表现与直接训练的基线模型相当，且在四个模型中的两个上展现出更好的分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 资源上的风险厌恶可防止目标错位的AI代理造成灾难性伤害。风险厌恶的错位代理会倾向于选择与人类交易等更安全的策略，而非叛变等更冒险的策略。
AI.method: 构建描述代理资源上常数绝对风险厌恶（CARA）的模型宪法，并通过在线策略蒸馏（角色训练）将其植入。同时调节宪法的不同方面（如token预算和模型选择），研究其对植入风险厌恶的影响。
AI.result: 角色训练的模型在未见过基准决策格式的训练条件下，性能与直接在基准上训练的基线模型相当，且在四个模型中的两个上表现出更好的分布外泛化能力。Token预算和模型选择是角色训练中植入风险厌恶最关键的因素。
AI.conclusion: 角色训练是一种有前景且可扩展的方法，可用于植入广泛的行为倾向，我们可以利用这一点来缓解目标错位AI代理带来的风险。

title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient
summary: LLMs trained with Chain-of-thought excel in reasoning capability, but often come with excessive token cost. We find that the core of reasoning capacity lies in the Thinking model's weight component within the null space of a projection defined by the corresponding Non-thinking model's dominant singular directions, and removing the subspace component can largely improve reasoning efficiency without hurting the accuracy gained during thinking-mode post-training. Unlike existing efforts that mostly operate within the dominant subspace, we are the first to unveil the critical role of the null space and harness it for model optimization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spectral Null-Space Swap ($S^3$), a training-free composition of paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints. Our method keeps the Non-thinking model inside its own dominant subspace and takes the Thinking checkpoint outside it, improving reasoning efficiency while maintaining accuracy. We extensively evaluate $S^3$ on 2B-30B dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures spanning 28 evaluation environments across mathematical, multimodal, and audio reasoning domains. $S^3$ establishes new empirical Pareto Frontiers among training-free model composition strategies: across all settings, it reduces inference token overhead by an average of 27.4% compared to full Thinking models while simultaneously improving overall task accuracy by 1.0 percentage point (e.g., yielding +8.3% accuracy on HMMT25 alongside a 33.0% token speedup). We further use attention entropy for explanation and find that the retained component produces more concentrated attention, and we use a simplified analytical model about optimization to demonstrate why null-space can effectively reduce attention entropy, thereby improving the efficiency of reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的模型组合方法 Spectral Null-Space Swap (S^3)，通过利用思维模型权重在非思维模型奇异空间中的零空间成分，在保持推理准确性的同时显著降低推理 token 开销，建立了新的帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有的思维链训练模型虽然推理能力强，但 token 成本过高。研究发现推理能力核心在于思维模型权重在非思维模型主导奇异方向定义的投影零空间中的成分，而现有方法主要在主导子空间操作，忽略了零空间的关键作用。
AI.method: 提出 Spectral Null-Space Swap (S^3)，一种无需训练的配对非思维和思维检查点组合方法。将非思维模型保留在其主导子空间内，将思维检查点投影到该子空间的零空间外部，从而提升推理效率并保持准确性。同时利用注意力熵分析和简化优化模型解释零空间如何降低注意力熵、提高推理效率。
AI.result: 在 2B-30B 稠密和 MoE 架构上，跨越 28 个数学、多模态、音频推理评测环境，S^3 平均减少 27.4% 推理 token 开销，整体任务准确率提升 1.0 个百分点（如 HMMT25 上准确率提升 8.3% 且 token 加速 33.0%）。注意力熵分析显示保留成分产生更集中的注意力。
AI.conclusion: 零空间成分是推理能力的关键，S^3 通过零空间交换实现了训练自由的模型组合，在推理效率和准确性之间取得了最佳权衡，为大语言模型的高效推理提供了新范式。

title: Differentiating Bisimulation Metrics: A Framework for Parametric Markov Chain Fitting via Bicausal Optimal Transport
summary: Many problems in sequential decision-making, such as imitation learning from observations, state-space compression, world-model learning, and sim-to-real transfer, can be reduced to learning a model such that a notion of distance with respect to the target process is minimized. We consider this general framework and consider the bisimulation metric, equivalently Bicausal Optimal Transport (BOT), as the notion of distance to minimize. We show that BOT, since it can be formulated as a linear program (LP), is differentiable with respect to the model dynamics. We then derive an exact closed-form gradient via the envelope theorem applied to the LP saddle point. The result is a general algorithm, Differentiable Bicausal Optimal Transport (D-BOT), that can be applied to each of the problems above. The proposed algorithm learns the best model by alternating between distance computation and gradient steps. We apply D-BOT for three different settings: state-space compression, parametric model learning, and imitation learning from observations (ILfO). We show empirical results that confirm the viability of all three instantiations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于双因果最优传输（BOT）的可微分框架 D-BOT，通过将 BOT 表述为线性规划（LP）并利用包络定理推导闭式梯度，实现了模型动力学的可微分距离最小化，适用于状态空间压缩、参数化模型学习和观察模仿学习等序贯决策问题。
AI.motivation: 许多序贯决策问题（如观察模仿学习、状态空间压缩、世界模型学习、仿真到真实迁移）可归结为学习一个模型以最小化相对于目标过程的距离度量。本文选择双因果最优传输（BOT，即双模拟度量）作为距离度量，因其可表述为线性规划而具备可微分性，从而能对模型动力学进行梯度优化。
AI.method: 将 BOT 表述为线性规划，应用包络定理于 LP 鞍点推导出关于模型动力学的精确闭式梯度。提出 D-BOT 算法：交替进行距离计算（求解 BOT）和梯度步骤更新模型参数。该算法为通用框架，可实例化到不同任务。
AI.result: 在三个设置中实证验证了 D-BOT 的可行性：状态空间压缩、参数化模型学习、观察模仿学习（ILfO）。实验结果确认了三种实例化均有效。
AI.conclusion: D-BOT 提供了一种通用的、基于双因果最优传输的可微分优化框架，通过闭式梯度实现高效模型学习，为多种序贯决策问题提供了统一解决方案，并展示了良好的实证性能。

title: NeuronEye: Query-Guided Visual Concept Activation for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Current vision-language models (VLMs) encode visual information in dense hidden states where object identity, spatial layout, and local attributes are implicitly entangled rather than explicitly disentangled, limiting their ability to isolate and modulate the specific visual evidence required by a given language query.
