Inspired by sparse population coding and top-down modulation in biological vision, we introduce NeuronEye, a plug-in framework that constructs a sparse, concept-level neuron vocabulary from intermediate VLM representations and selectively activates query-relevant visual concepts during inference. NeuronEye decomposes vision-token states into an overcomplete sparse basis organized by concept-level clusters, uses the language query to activate relevant clusters and localize the patches where selected concepts are expressed, and injects the focused evidence back into vision tokens. A complementary suppression mechanism attenuates dominant perceptual directions to preserve weaker but relevant cues. All operations run in a single forward pass over a frozen VLM backbone. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, NeuronEye raises CV-Bench overall accuracy by +3.1 with gains of +9.5 on Distance, and improves BLINK Multi-view by +8.3, with similar trends on LLaVA-1.6-7B. These results suggest that sparse neuron vocabularies can serve not only as post-hoc interpretability tools but also as active interfaces for concept-level visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: NeuronEye 是一个即插即用框架，通过稀疏神经元词汇表实现视觉-语言模型的概念级推理，显著提升空间与多视图任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 将视觉信息编码为纠缠的稠密隐状态，难以分离和调制特定语言查询所需的视觉证据。
AI.method: 从冻结 VLM 中间层提取视觉 token，构建过完备稀疏基并按概念聚类；利用语言查询激活相关概念簇、定位表达该概念的图像补丁，并将聚焦证据注回视觉 token；同时引入抑制机制衰减主导感知方向以保留弱但相关的线索；全流程单次前向传播。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，CV-Bench 整体准确率提升 +3.1，Distance 任务提升 +9.5，BLINK Multi-view 提升 +8.3；LLaVA-1.6-7B 显示相似趋势。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏神经元词汇表不仅可作为事后可解释性工具，更可作为概念级视觉推理的主动接口。

title: Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using dense, token-level supervision from a stronger teacher. Vanilla OPD treats all teacher signals equally, assuming that the teacher's supervision is equally important for every token. However, teacher signals at different tokens may have very different effects on the student's performance: some correct important reasoning errors, while others have little effect on the final answer. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Dr. OPD (OPD Done Right), which defines the optimal weighted OPD to maximize the student's performance. We formulate Dr. OPD as a bilevel optimization problem in which the student learns from weighted teacher supervision, while the weights are selected to maximize the expected reward of the resulting student. To solve Dr. OPD, we develop an efficient iterative solver that updates the token weights and student policy alternatively. At each round, it updates weights in closed form and then takes one gradient step on the resulting weighted OPD objective. Under regularity conditions, we show that this weighted update achieves a higher expected reward than a vanilla OPD update. Empirically, across strong-to-weak and same-size distillation on math and code, Dr. OPD consistently outperforms all evaluated baselines. In particular, in the strong-to-weak distillation setting, Dr. OPD improves average math performance by $9.7$ points over vanilla OPD, and enables the smaller student to surpass its larger teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Dr. OPD（OPD Done Right），一种通过双层优化动态加权教师 Token 级监督信号的在线策略蒸馏方法，旨在最大化学生模型的期望奖励，并在数学和代码任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 标准 OPD 将所有教师 Token 信号等权重处理，假设其对学生性能贡献相同。然而不同 Token 的监督效果差异巨大：部分 Token 修正关键推理错误，另一些则对最终答案影响微弱。因此需要一种机制自适应地加权教师信号。
AI.method: 将加权 OPD 形式化为双层优化问题：内层学生在加权教师监督下学习，外层优化 Token 权重以最大化学生期望奖励。开发高效迭代求解器：每轮先闭式更新权重，再对加权 OPD 目标做一步梯度下降。在正则条件下证明该加权更新比普通 OPD 能获得更高期望奖励。
AI.result: 在强到弱及同规模蒸馏的数学、代码任务上，Dr. OPD 持续超越所有基线。强到弱设置下，数学平均性能比普通 OPD 提升 9.7 分，并使更小学生模型超越更大教师模型。
AI.conclusion: Dr. OPD 为在线策略蒸馏提供了原则性的加权框架，通过双层优化自适应分配 Token 级监督权重，显著提升学生模型性能，尤其在强到弱蒸馏场景下效果突出。

title: Trident: Unifying Guarded Dispatch and Host Execution for PyTorch Triton Workloads
summary: User-written Triton kernels enable high-performance GPU computation within PyTorch, but their end-to-end latency can remain dominated by host-side orchestration, especially when device execution is short. Although torch.compile can generate native host wrappers for captured graphs, each invocation still passes through runtime-managed specialization lookup, guard evaluation, and preparation before reaching the wrapper. We present Trident, a compiler backend that removes this recurring overhead from the specialization cache-hit path. Trident introduces the Specialization Cache Module (SCM), which compiles guarded specialization selection, argument and execution-environment preparation, and host execution for multiple specializations into a single executable module. An invocation enters the SCM once, remains in compiled code when a specialization matches, and returns to Python only when a new specialization must be compiled. Built on Torch-MLIR, Trident lowers guards and host-side orchestration to native code while retaining calls to optimized runtime implementations of supported ATen operators. Our evalu- ation on two LLMs shows that Trident achieves up to a 1.47x speedup in model-level end-to-end latency over eager execution and up to 1.68x over torch.compile.

AI.tldr: Trident 是一个编译器后端，通过引入特化缓存模块（SCM）将守卫评估、参数准备和主机执行编译为单一可执行模块，消除 torch.compile 在缓存命中路径上的反复开销，在两个 LLM 上实现高达 1.47 倍（相对于 eager）和 1.68 倍（相对于 torch.compile）的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 用户编写的 Triton 内核虽能实现高性能 GPU 计算，但端到端延迟常受主机侧编排主导，特别是设备执行时间短时。torch.compile 虽能生成原生主机包装器，但每次调用仍需经过运行时管理的特化查找、守卫评估和准备阶段，造成反复开销。
AI.method: Trident 基于 Torch-MLIR 构建，引入特化缓存模块（SCM），将受保护的特化选择、参数与执行环境准备、多特化的主机执行编译为单一原生可执行模块。调用仅进入 SCM 一次，命中特化时保持在编译代码中，仅在需编译新特化时返回 Python。同时保留对受支持 ATen 算子优化运行时实现的调用。
AI.result: 在两个大语言模型上评估，Trident 相比 eager 执行实现高达 1.47 倍的模型级端到端加速，相比 torch.compile 实现高达 1.68 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: Trident 通过将主机侧编排逻辑下沉至编译模块，有效消除了特化缓存命中路径上的运行时开销，显著降低了基于 Triton 内核的 PyTorch 程序的端到端延迟，为短内核执行场景提供了更高效的部署方案。

title: Do LLM Agents Execute the Plans They Declare? From Planning-Mode Declaration to Pattern-Specific Execution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) enable agents to solve long-horizon tasks by generating a plan and then executing it in an environment. However, successful planning requires two distinct capabilities: selecting an appropriate plan for the task and executing it faithfully. Existing planner--executor systems can fail at either stage, while final task success alone cannot distinguish selection from execution failures. We therefore study the Plan Declaration--Execution Gap and introduce Planning-as-Routing, where an LLM declares one of four planning modes: Predefined, Sequential, Hierarchical, or Search, and a deterministic router dispatches the task to the corresponding pattern-specific executor. Across four benchmarks and three LLMs, we find three consistent patterns. First, generic Plan+ReAct often fails to preserve declared planning structure, especially for longer plans: across three benchmarks, only (22)--(45%) of trajectories preserve it, whereas pattern-specific executors enforce the intended structure. Second, planning-mode effectiveness varies across environments and models: Search performs best on ALFWorld, Hierarchical on SWE-bench, and the strongest pattern can vary across models within the same benchmark. Third, the largest gains come from execution: pattern-specific executors improve task success from (0.48) to (0.92) on ALFWorld and from (0.36) to (0.44) on SWE-bench Verified over Plan+ReAct. Current LLMs, however, do not reliably select the strongest mode for each task, although few-shot examples improve selection in some benchmark--model combinations. Overall, reliable agent planning requires both effective mode selection and faithful execution: routing substantially closes the execution gap, while task-specific mode selection remains open.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Planning-as-Routing 框架，让 LLM 声明四种规划模式之一，再由确定性路由器分派给对应的模式专用执行器，实验表明该方法能大幅缩小执行差距，但任务级的模式选择仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有 planner–executor 系统在规划选择与执行两个阶段均可能失败，且仅凭最终任务成功率无法区分二者；因此需要研究 Plan Declaration–Execution Gap，并寻找能同时保证结构忠实执行与模式自适应选择的方法。
AI.method: 引入 Planning-as-Routing：LLM 先声明规划模式（Predefined、Sequential、Hierarchical、Search），再由确定性路由器将任务分发给对应的模式专用执行器；在四个基准（ALFWorld、SWE-bench 等）上对比三种 LLM，评估结构保持率、任务成功率及模式选择准确性。
AI.result: 1) 通用 Plan+ReAct 仅在 22%–45% 的轨迹中保持声明结构，而模式专用执行器强制保持结构；2) 最优规划模式随环境和模型变化（ALFWorld 上 Search 最优，SWE-bench 上 Hierarchical 最优）；3) 执行层面增益最大：ALFWorld 成功率从 0.48 提升至 0.92，SWE-bench Verified 从 0.36 提升至 0.44；4) 当前 LLM 难以可靠选择最强模式，few-shot 能在部分配置下改善选择。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的智能体规划需要兼顾有效的模式选择与忠实的执行；路由机制显著缩小了执行差距，但面向具体任务的模式选择问题仍待解决。

title: Loss-Guided Pretraining Data Selection for Time-Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are pretrained on heterogeneous collections containing billions of observations, yet their training windows are typically sampled without estimating whether they provide useful learning signal. We introduce a static data-selection framework that scores each window with a reference forecaster and retains an intermediate interval within every source dataset. Specifically, we connect forecasting loss to optimization difficulty by showing that normalized squared loss controls the per-sample gradient norm under a local Jacobian condition. We then define a reference loss score and apply dataset-stratified selection to preserve the diversity of samples. Across various TSFM architectures, our method outperforms random selection by an absolute margin and even improves both relative MASE and CRPS over full-data pretraining by retaining fewer candidate pretraining windows. Further analyses show strong cross-scale and cross-architecture score correlations, indicating that a small reference model can often select data for larger targets, provided that the reference and target share compatible difficulty orderings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种静态数据选择框架，用于时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的预训练。通过参考预测器对训练窗口进行评分，保留每个源数据集中的中等难度区间，优于随机选择甚至全数据预训练，且小模型可为大模型选择数据。
AI.motivation: 现有TSFM预训练通常从包含数十亿观测值的异构数据集中随机采样训练窗口，未评估其是否提供有效学习信号，导致预训练效率低下。
AI.method: 1. 建立静态数据选择框架，使用参考预测器对每个窗口评分；2. 证明归一化平方损失在局部雅可比条件下控制逐样本梯度范数，将预测损失与优化难度关联；3. 定义参考损失评分；4. 应用数据集分层选择策略以保持样本多样性。
AI.result: 在多种TSFM架构上，该方法以绝对优势超越随机选择，且在保留更少预训练窗口的情况下，相对MASE和CRPS指标均优于全数据预训练。分析显示跨尺度和跨架构的评分强相关性。
AI.conclusion: 小型参考模型往往能为大型目标模型选择数据，前提是两者共享兼容的难度排序。该框架为TSFM高效预训练提供了理论支持和实用方法。

title: Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems
summary: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. On an emergency braking benchmark with a GAN surrogate, our procedure resolves the entire state space, 38% of which the state-of-the-art verifier left unresolved. On the RGB version of the benchmark, where no verification results have previously been reported, our procedure resolves over 80% of the state space with a world model surrogate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用带有物理基础潜在变量的随机世界模型作为视觉感知替代模型，结合综合验证程序（伪造、自适应细化、符号和反向分析），在紧急制动基准测试中实现了对整个状态空间的完整验证，显著优于现有GAN替代模型和最先进验证器。
AI.motivation: 视觉神经反馈系统的验证需要能够捕捉传感器变化且易于闭环分析的感知替代模型。现有的GAN替代模型参数量大、复杂场景重现差且难以验证，因此需要更丰富、更易验证的感知替代模型。
AI.method: 1. 训练具有物理基础潜在变量的随机世界模型，其操作可被标准验证器界定。2. 开发综合验证程序，结合伪造、自适应细化、符号分析和反向分析。3. 在紧急制动基准测试上评估GAN替代模型和RGB版本上的世界模型替代模型。
AI.result: 世界模型以最多130倍少的参数比GAN替代模型更忠实地重现保留帧。在GAN替代模型上，验证程序解决了整个状态空间，其中38%是最先进验证器未解决的。在RGB版本上，世界模型替代模型解决了超过80%的状态空间，这是首次报告的验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 带有物理基础潜在变量的随机世界模型是比GAN更有效的感知替代模型，结合提出的综合验证程序，能够实现视觉神经反馈系统的大规模状态空间验证，为安全关键系统的形式化验证提供了可行路径。

title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
summary: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice less strongly than those of other corrections. Keeping them less often than the rest improves the model's eventual performance compared to learning from every correction. Motivated by this, our method, Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD), pairs outcome-based reinforcement learning with self-distillation from a feedback-conditioned copy of the advisor selectively. Reflection proposes corrections, and the advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without its issued advice, using the magnitude of the difference to select decisions for supervision. This approach does not require executor likelihoods or additional executor rollouts. Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler. The trained advisors generalize to out-of-domain tasks and transfer across different executor versions and model families. AdviSD also beats matched-count random selection, supporting the value of its selection rule.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD)方法，让小型可训练的advisor通过自然语言建议引导冻结的大语言模型executor。核心洞察是：并非所有基于反馈的修正都有利于学习，选择性地从有价值的修正中进行自蒸馏能显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法让advisor从所有交互反馈中学习，但理论分析表明：若某些修正的目标对有用建议的偏好较弱，则学习这些修正反而会限制整体学习效果。需要一种机制筛选高价值修正进行监督。
AI.method: AdviSD结合基于结果的强化学习（GRPO）与选择性自蒸馏：1) Reflection模块基于反馈提出修正建议；2) Advisor对同一executor响应分别在有/无建议下打分；3) 利用分差幅度作为选择指标，仅保留分差大的决策进行蒸馏监督。无需executor似然或额外rollouts。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B advisor引导Gemini/Claude executor实验中：BFCL-v3基准超越advisor-GRPO 4.2-6.4个百分点；EnvScaler基准超越3.9-5.1分。训练后的advisor泛化到域外任务，并能迁移至不同版本executor及模型家族。优于同数量随机选择，验证选择规则有效性。
AI.conclusion: 选择性自蒸馏能有效过滤低价值修正，显著提升advisor引导能力。该方法无需访问executor内部，具有良好泛化性和迁移性，为冻结大模型的高效引导提供了实用范式。

title: Efficiently Approximating Attention Is Hard
summary: Softmax attention is ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but its quadratic scaling with sequence length makes it costly. To reduce this cost, attention is often approximated with fast algorithms, which incur error but can still perform well in practice and on some inputs. At the same time, the growing diversity of attention applications makes approximation guarantees that do not depend on particular input structure a compelling target. For such uniform guarantees over all inputs, known runtime lower bounds rule out fast algorithms for near-exact attention, but leave open the practically important regime: is there an efficient algorithm with even a modest uniform approximation guarantee? We answer this question negatively. Under standard complexity-theoretic assumptions, no truly subquadratic algorithm can approximate attention with any nontrivial additive or relative guarantee uniformly over all inputs. This impossibility holds in the mildest parameter regime for which known algorithms do not already achieve strong approximation guarantees in near-linear time, and extends to practically relevant relaxations: even after polynomial preprocessing of the KV cache, no efficient algorithm can obtain a nontrivial uniform approximation guarantee, or identify a small set of keys receiving substantial attention under sparsity. Overall, our results settle the computational limits of uniform attention approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在标准复杂度假设下，不存在真正亚二次算法能在所有输入上均匀近似Softmax注意力，即使是非平凡的加性或相对误差保证也不可能；即使允许多项式预处理KV缓存也无法突破这一限制。
AI.motivation: Softmax注意力广泛应用但二次复杂度成本高，现有快速近似算法虽实用但缺乏均匀保证；随着注意力应用多样化，需要不依赖输入结构的均匀近似保证，但已知下界仅排除近似精确计算，实际重要的适度均匀近似是否存在仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 采用复杂度理论降维方法，在标准假设（如SETH或OV假设）下证明下界；分析最温和参数范围，且扩展到多项式预处理KV缓存和稀疏注意力识别等实际场景。
AI.result: 证明了不存在真正亚二次算法能实现任何非平凡的均匀加性或相对近似保证；即使允许多项式预处理KV缓存，也无法获得非平凡均匀近似或高效识别获得显著注意力的键集合。
AI.conclusion: 研究确定了均匀注意力近似的计算极限，表明在最宽松条件下均匀近似本质上需要二次时间，为注意力机制的理论基础提供了根本性限制。

title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
summary: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究测试时 AI-for-AI 范式，提出 Meta-Skill 机制：Builder 从 Target 的执行反馈中学习可复用的构建原则，冻结技能库后为未见任务构建执行环境，显著提升 Agent 性能。
AI.motivation: Agent 性能同时取决于推理能力和执行环境。现有方法多关注模型权重更新，忽视了在测试阶段通过构建更好的执行环境来提升性能的可能性。需要一种机制让 Builder 从经验中学习如何为 Target 构建支持性环境，且无需更新模型权重。
AI.method: 引入 Meta-Skill（元技能）概念：Builder 从 Target 在开发集上的执行反馈中学习何时需要支持以及提供何种资源的原则，形成冻结的技能库。在推理阶段，Builder 使用该技能库为未见任务构建执行 harness。实验在 Harness-Bench 和 NewtonBench 上进行对比。
AI.result: 完整技能库的 Meta-Skill 使宏平均性能比无技能构建提升 8.95 个百分点，比直接将同一技能库交付给 Target 提升 12.02 个百分点。当同一模型同时扮演 Builder 和 Target 角色时也能获得增益。
AI.conclusion: 将经验转化为可执行的环境支持比直接提供知识更有效。该范式展示了系统级自我改进的路径：模型通过学习构建更好的执行环境来提升自身性能，无需更新权重。

title: Scaling Full Conformal Image Classifiers
summary: Conformal prediction provides set-valued predictions with distribution-free coverage guarantees, making it attractive for high-stakes image classification. However, split conformal prediction is data-inefficient, while full conformal prediction (FCP), despite its stronger statistical efficiency, is computationally prohibitive at scale because it requires candidate-specific model refits at test time. We address this limitation by leveraging zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) to guide scalable FCP in large label spaces. We introduce Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP), which uses a lightweight inductive conformal predictor to prune unlikely labels and applies FCP only to the remaining candidates, reducing computation while retaining the formal guarantee of the combined conformal procedure. We further propose Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA), an efficient VLM adaptation solver based on rank-one inverse-covariance updates. Across multiple benchmarks, including ImageNet, T-FCP enables practical full-conformal image classification with modest test-time overhead, yielding efficient prediction sets and more stable empirical coverage than split conformal alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP)，利用零样本视觉语言模型 (VLM) 指导大标签空间下的全共形预测，通过轻量级归纳共形预测器剪枝不太可能的标签，仅对剩余候选应用 FCP，降低计算开销并保留正式覆盖保证；同时提出基于秩一逆协方差更新的 Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA) 高效适配 VLM。实验表明 T-FCP 在 ImageNet 等基准上实现了实用的全共形图像分类，预测集高效且覆盖更稳定。
AI.motivation: 分割共形预测数据效率低，全共形预测 (FCP) 虽然统计效率更强，但因测试时需针对每个候选标签重新拟合模型，计算成本过高，难以在大标签空间规模化应用。
AI.method: 提出 T-FCP：先用轻量级归纳共形预测器剪枝不可能的标签，仅对剩余候选运行 FCP，结合零样本 VLM 指导；并提出 SO-LDA，基于秩一逆协方差更新高效适配 VLM。
AI.result: 在多个基准（含 ImageNet）上，T-FCP 实现了实用的全共形图像分类，测试时开销适中，预测集高效，经验覆盖比分割共形替代方案更稳定。
AI.conclusion: T-FCP 结合零样本 VLM 和轻量级剪枝，使全共形预测在大规模图像分类中成为可能，兼具计算效率与正式覆盖保证，优于分割共形预测。

title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning
summary: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 agentic meta-reasoning（智能体元推理）框架，将长任务执行中的控制决策（选择何种部分工作、是否重新开始、何时停止）显式化为结构化推理过程。控制器整合运行进展、探索选项、评估预算下价值并调度工作，工作器执行任务级计算。在 ProgramBench 等基准上，配合前沿模型显著优于直接控制基线。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体承担更长、更复杂的问题，执行控制本身成为一项任务。每一步都面临新的控制选择：基于哪部分工作构建、是否重新开始、何时停止。现有方法缺乏对这些选择的显式结构化推理机制。
AI.method: 引入双组件架构：Worker（工作器）执行任务级计算；Controller（控制器）在推理时作为 harness，持久化记忆中维护紧凑的运行账目（而非完整历史回放），负责：巩固已建立进展、探索下一步选项、在剩余预算下评估各选项价值、携带上下文调度选定工作。
AI.result: ProgramBench（程序重构测长程能力）：GPT-5.5 达 71.5% vs Codex 58.0%；Opus 4.8 达 67.2% vs Claude Code 65.5%。其余基准（抽象推理、多领域长程推理、证明生成）上，平均跨三前沿模型比直接控制提升 3.6–4.2 分。随预算增长持续改进，而直接控制趋于平稳；小预算下开销可能有害。Artifact-graph 分析显示：更多复用早期工作、大多数设置下正确解覆盖率更高、最终选择收益非均匀分布。
AI.conclusion: 结构化控制推理的计算投入随智能体扩展到更长运行时变得愈发重要。元推理通过显式控制决策，显著提升长程智能体任务的性能与效率。

title: Parallel Tempering for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving combinatorial optimization (CO) problems on graphs by learning to sample high-quality solutions. A common inference-time approach is to generate multiple candidate solutions independently and return the best-performing sample, improving solution quality at the expense of an increase in computational cost. In this work, we introduce PT-Denoise, an inference-time procedure that allows these concurrent denoising trajectories to interact through parallel tempering, without requiring retraining or fine-tuning of the underlying denoiser. Our method assigns a temperature to each diffusion process and allows processes to swap temperatures based on their relative performance. This dynamically reallocates promising, low-energy trajectories to colder, more concentrated sampling regimes while allowing higher-energy states to escape local minima through randomized exploration. Experiments on canonical graph-structured CO problems show that our approach consistently improves the quality of the best solution found, while only adding minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PT-Denoise，一种推理时的并行退火方法，通过让多个离散扩散轨迹在不同温度下交互交换，无需重新训练即可显著提升图组合优化问题的解质量，仅增加极小计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有离散扩散模型在推理时通常独立生成多个候选解并取最优，虽能提升质量但计算成本线性增长。需要一种无需重训练、低开销的方法让并行轨迹协作，动态分配探索与利用资源。
AI.method: PT-Denoise 为每条扩散轨迹分配温度，基于相对性能（能量/目标值）按并行退火准则交换温度：低能量轨迹移至低温（集中采样），高能量轨迹移至高温（随机探索），实现轨迹间的自适应协作。
AI.result: 在典型图结构组合优化问题（如最大割、最大独立集、图着色）上，PT-Denoise 持续提升最优解质量，优于独立采样基线，且仅增加微小计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 推理时引入并行退火机制是一种即插即用、无需重训练的有效策略，能显著增强离散扩散模型在组合优化任务中的求解能力，为后续推理时加速方法提供了新范式。

title: A Sharp Transition in Data Reconstruction under Differential Privacy
summary: Data reconstruction attacks have empirically been successful in recovering training samples from learned models, raising privacy concerns and motivating defenses with guarantees that remain valid against future threats. While differential privacy (DP) provides formal protection, choosing the privacy budget remains a challenge: small budgets severely reduce utility, but it is hard to quantify how large the budget can be without allowing accurate reconstruction. In this work, we study informed attackers who aim to reconstruct a single $d$-dimensional training sample from a $ρ$-zero-concentrated DP model, knowing all other training data. Our main contribution is to establish a sharp transition at $ρ\asymp d$ for data reconstruction: on the one hand, we derive entropy-based lower bounds for any private mechanism and any attack, characterizing a set of target priors for which reconstruction is information-theoretically impossible for $ρ\ll d$; on the other hand, we analyze a simple attack on private linear regression with output perturbation, showing that reconstruction is practically feasible for $ρ\gg d$. Remarkably, the transition moves to $ρ\asymp s$ for data lying in an $s$-dimensional subspace, demonstrating that the privacy budget guaranteeing adequate protection must be assessed in terms of the effective dimension of the data. We validate our findings via experiments on synthetic data and natural images (CIFAR-10, ImageNet).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数据重构攻击在差分隐私模型下的理论界限，确立了隐私预算ρ与数据维度d之间的尖锐相变：当ρ≪d时重构在信息论上不可能，当ρ≫d时重构切实可行；且对于低维子空间数据，相变点转移到ρ≍s，表明隐私预算需按有效维度评估。
AI.motivation: 数据重构攻击能从训练模型中恢复训练样本，引发隐私担忧。差分隐私（DP）提供形式化保护，但隐私预算选择困难：预算太小严重损害效用，太大则可能允许准确重构。需要量化在何种预算下重构成为可能。
AI.method: 1) 推导基于熵的下界，针对任意私有机制和任意攻击，刻画目标先验分布集合，证明当ρ≪d时重构在信息论上不可能；2) 分析输出扰动私有线性回归上的简单攻击，证明当ρ≫d时重构切实可行；3) 将分析扩展到s维子空间数据，证明相变点移至ρ≍s；4) 在合成数据和自然图像（CIFAR-10, ImageNet）上实验验证。
AI.result: 建立了ρ≍d的尖锐相变：ρ≪d时重构信息论上不可能，ρ≫d时重构可行。对于s维子空间数据，相变点为ρ≍s，表明有效维度决定所需隐私预算。实验验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 隐私预算必须根据数据的有效维度而非环境维度来设定，才能提供足够的重构保护。这为差分隐私参数选择提供了理论指导。

title: Looped Transformers as Optimizers
summary: Looped Transformers provide a parameter-efficient approach to depth scaling by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks. Recent reasoning models have likewise highlighted the value of scaling test-time computation through longer computation trajectories. However, the principles for designing effective loop transitions remain poorly understood. We view the looped hidden state as a fast weight that is updated throughout the depth. We formulate loop transitions as local gradient-based updates, with recurrent blocks predicting implicit targets at each depth. Our framework derives loop transitions in closed form from a projection, a local objective and an optimizer update rule. Mapping representative loop transitions into this framework reveals mismatches between their transitions and projections. We first align the input maps of existing transitions. We then derive OperLoop, which combines explicit weight decay, adaptive step size and a delta objective. The aligned variants reduce training loss and improve average commonsense accuracy. OperLoop improves average generative performance over the compared looped and non-looped baselines under matched training FLOPs. These results support the framework's usefulness for loop design. We extend the analysis to additional loop models and outline a roadmap for future loop transition design.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个用于设计循环Transformer过渡机制的理论框架，将循环隐藏状态视为快速权重，将循环过渡建模为基于局部梯度的更新。基于此框架推导出OperLoop，结合显式权重衰减、自适应步长和增量目标，在相同训练FLOPs下优于现有循环和非循环基线。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享Transformer块实现参数高效的深度扩展，推理模型也强调了通过更长计算轨迹扩展测试时计算的价值。然而，设计有效循环过渡的原则尚不明确。
AI.method: 将循环隐藏状态视为随深度更新的快速权重，将循环过渡建模为局部基于梯度的更新，循环块在每个深度预测隐式目标。框架从投影、局部目标和优化器更新规则闭式推导循环过渡。对代表性循环过渡映射揭示了过渡与投影间的不匹配。首先对齐现有过渡的输入映射，然后推导OperLoop，结合显式权重衰减、自适应步长和增量目标。
AI.result: 对齐变体降低训练损失并提高平均常识推理准确率。OperLoop在匹配训练FLOPs条件下，平均生成性能优于对比的循环和非循环基线。结果支持该框架对循环设计的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为循环过渡设计提供了理论指导。扩展分析到更多循环模型，并为未来循环过渡设计勾画了路线图。

title: High-Dimensional Simulation-Based Inference in Latent Spaces
summary: Neural simulation-based inference (SBI) has been widely successful in inferring a relatively small number of interpretable parameters from potentially high-dimensional observations, such as images or time series. Accordingly, representation learning in SBI has focused almost exclusively on compressing the observations used to condition the posterior. More recently, however, SBI has begun to target increasingly high-dimensional parameter spaces, raising the complementary question of whether the inference target itself should be compressed. Our answer is a practical merger of SBI and latent generative modeling, which learns a low-dimensional representation of the simulator parameters, performs posterior inference directly in this latent space, and maps posterior samples back to the original parameter space. We characterize the conditions under which latent-space inference recovers the desired target posterior and systematically study its empirical trade-offs. Across four case studies and three generative families, we compare latent and standard estimators while controlling for network capacity, regularization, optimization, and training compute. At matched training compute, latent-space inference achieves accuracy and marginal calibration comparable to direct target-space inference while sampling up to more than an order of magnitude faster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将仿真推理（SBI）与潜在生成建模相结合的方法，在潜在空间而非原始参数空间进行后验推理，实现了与直接参数空间推理相当的准确性和校准性，但采样速度提升了一个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 随着SBI开始处理越来越高维的参数空间，传统的仅压缩观测数据的方法面临挑战。本文探讨了是否应该压缩推理目标本身（即参数空间），以解决高维参数空间下的计算效率问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种实用的SBI与潜在生成建模相结合的框架：学习模拟器参数的低维表示，直接在潜在空间进行后验推理，然后将后验样本映射回原始参数空间。理论上刻画了潜在空间推理恢复目标后验的条件，并系统研究了其经验权衡。
AI.result: 在四个案例研究和三种生成模型家族中，控制网络容量、正则化、优化和训练计算后，潜在空间推理在相同训练计算下达到与直接目标空间推理相当的准确性和边缘校准性，但采样速度快一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间推理是处理高维参数空间SBI的有效策略，能在保持推理质量的同时显著提高采样效率，为大规模参数空间的仿真推理提供了实用解决方案。

title: MoTIF-X: A Multimodal Tokenized Framework for Interpretable and Extensible Molecular Representation Learning
comment: 5 figures. Supplementary material is available as an ancillary file. Code: https://github.com/Bin-Chen-Lab/Motif-X
summary:
Molecular representation learning is central to computer-aided drug discovery. Molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and 3D conformations provide complementary structural information, yet many multimodal approaches encode these views independently and align them only at a later stage, limiting fine-grained cross-modal interaction and substructure-level interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce MoTIF-X, a motif-centered framework that uses graph-grounded chemical motifs as shared anchors for multimodal integration and interpretation. Its first pretraining stage learns motif representations through hierarchical contrastive learning across atomic, motif, and molecular scales. The second stage contextualizes these representations with SMILES and torsion-angle tokens through multimodal masked token modeling.
  After pretraining on drug-like molecules with multiple conformers, MoTIF-X achieved the lowest mean absolute error on all nine OpenADMET ExpansionRx endpoints and the best overall performance among the evaluated methods. Significance analyses supported its advantage in the vast majority of endpoint-baseline comparisons after multiple-testing correction. Ablation studies supported the complementary contributions of motif-token contextualization, multimodal integration, and two-stage pretraining. Beyond molecular properties, the framework extended to drug-target interaction prediction, achieving the best average classification performance across the evaluated benchmarks and generalizing to an external drug-cold-start dataset without additional fine-tuning. Its motif-centered design also enabled substructure-level interpretation: higher motif attribution scores were associated with larger experimentally measured activity shifts. Together, these findings support MoTIF-X as a transferable and interpretable framework for molecular modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MoTIF-X，一种以化学基序为中心的多模态分子表示学习框架，利用图定位的化学基序作为共享锚点实现多模态融合与解释。通过两阶段预训练（层级对比学习 + 多模态掩码建模），在 OpenADMET ExpansionRx 九个端点上均取得最低平均绝对误差，在药物-靶点相互作用预测中表现最优并能零样本泛化至外部冷启动数据集，同时实现亚结构级可解释性。
AI.motivation: 分子表示学习是计算机辅助药物发现的核心。分子图、SMILES 字符串和三维构象提供互补结构信息，但现有多模态方法往往独立编码各视图并仅在后期对齐，限制了细粒度跨模态交互与亚结构级可解释性。
AI.method: MoTIF-X 采用两阶段预训练：第一阶段通过层级对比学习在原子、基序、分子三个尺度学习基序表示；第二阶段利用多模态掩码令牌建模，结合 SMILES 和扭转角令牌对基序表示进行上下文化。以图定位的化学基序作为共享锚点实现多模态整合与解释。
AI.result: 在药物样分子及多构象预训练后，MoTIF-X 在全部九个 OpenADMET ExpansionRx 端点上均获得最低平均绝对误差，整体性能最优；显著性分析证实其在绝大多数端点-基线比较中具有优势（经多重检验校正）。消融实验验证了基序-令牌上下文化、多模态融合及两阶段预训练的互补贡献。扩展至药物-靶点相互作用预测，在评估基准上平均分类性能最佳，并能在无额外微调情况下泛化至外部药物冷启动数据集。基序中心设计实现亚结构级解释：更高的基序归因分数与更大的实验活性变化相关。
AI.conclusion: MoTIF-X 是一个可迁移且可解释的分子建模框架，通过基序为中心的设计实现了细粒度跨模态交互与亚结构级可解释性，为分子性质预测和药物-靶点相互作用预测提供了有效工具。

title: Rethinking Soft Tokens for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel generation by predicting and committing multiple tokens at each denoising step, yet they can generate individually plausible but mutually inconsistent tokens. Recent work shows that \emph{soft tokens} can mitigate this issue by representing uncertain positions with continuous embeddings built from the model's predictive distribution at the previous decoding step. However, although soft tokens are commonly understood as preserving predictive uncertainty, how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding has not been systematically examined. In this paper, we investigate this question in frozen pretrained DLMs to examine soft-token feedback without the effects of additional training. To construct soft-token inputs in a training-free setting, we identify a geometric mismatch between conventional soft-token construction and the pretrained embedding space. Based on this observation, we propose a training-free, geometry-aware construction of soft tokens. Our analysis of soft-token feedback suggests that uncertainty preservation alone does not fully explain how it reshapes subsequent predictions. To better explain how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding, we provide empirical evidence that it favors coherent token sequences. Across four pretrained DLMs and four math and code benchmarks, our method outperforms standard parallel decoding and a training-free Euclidean soft-token baseline. Code: https://github.com/kodaikawamura/rethinking-soft-tokens

AI.tldr: 本文研究扩散语言模型(DLM)中软令牌反馈如何改进并行解码，指出传统软令牌构建存在几何失配，提出无需训练的几何感知软令牌构建方法，实验表明该方法在四个预训练DLM和四个数学代码基准上优于标准并行解码和欧几里得软令牌基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过并行预测多个token实现快速生成，但容易产生相互不一致的token。软令牌利用连续嵌入表示不确定位置可缓解此问题，但软令牌反馈如何改进并行解码尚未系统研究，且现有软令牌构建与预训练嵌入空间存在几何失配。
AI.method: 在冻结的预训练DLM中研究软令牌反馈，避免额外训练影响。识别常规软令牌构建与预训练嵌入空间的几何失配，提出无训练的几何感知软令牌构建方法。通过实证分析软令牌反馈如何重塑后续预测，验证其倾向于生成连贯token序列。
AI.result: 在四个预训练DLM和四个数学代码基准上，提出的几何感知软令牌方法显著优于标准并行解码和无训练欧几里得软令牌基线。不确定性保留并非软令牌改进解码的唯一解释，其核心作用是促进token序列的连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 软令牌反馈通过几何感知的连续嵌入构建，能有效引导DLM生成更连贯的token序列，而非单纯保留预测不确定性。该无训练方法为并行解码提供了实用且理论有依据的改进方向。

title: Learning Macroscopic Dynamics without Reconstructing Microscopic States
summary: Modeling the temporal evolution of macroscopic properties of complex systems is an important scientific task. To predict this evolution without full microscopic simulation, a common approach encodes microstates into compact latent states, learns their evolution, and reads out macroscopic predictions from the latent trajectory. These latent states are often learned through microstate reconstruction. However, with limited latent capacity, reconstruction can favor high-variance microscopic details over information needed for macroscopic prediction. Yet jointly learning latent states and their transition without reconstruction often fails to obtain latent dynamics that support accurate macroscopic prediction. We show that this failure can arise from latent scale collapse: shrinking the latent state scale reduces training loss while macroscopic evolution error remains large. Here, we propose a reconstruction-free framework to learn latent states with their dynamics for prescribed macroscopic prediction. Training alternates between updating the latent representation with the transition and next-state latent targets fixed, and updating the transition with the latent representation fixed. At inference, the trained model predicts macroscopic states recursively from an initial microstate. Our theoretical analysis characterizes reconstruction misalignment and scale collapse under joint training, and gives a sufficient condition for local convergence to correct latent dynamics for our method. Experiments on epidemic spreading on a lattice, mixing of two particle species, and polymer stretching demonstrate that the proposed method achieves substantially better macroscopic prediction over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无重构的框架，用于学习复杂系统宏观性质的时间演化，通过交替更新潜在表示和转移动力学，避免了联合训练中的潜在尺度塌缩问题，在流行病传播、粒子混合和聚合物拉伸等任务上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常通过微观状态重构学习潜在状态，但有限的潜在容量会导致重构偏向高方差微观细节，忽略宏观预测所需信息；而无重构的联合训练又会遭遇潜在尺度塌缩——潜在状态尺度收缩降低训练损失，但宏观演化误差仍大。需要一种能直接针对宏观预测学习潜在动力学的方法。
AI.method: 提出重构自由框架：训练时交替进行两步——(1) 固定转移和下一步潜在目标，更新潜在表示；(2) 固定潜在表示，更新转移动力学。推理时从初始微观状态递归预测宏观状态。理论分析刻画了重构错位和尺度塌缩，给出了局部收敛到正确潜在动力学的充分条件。
AI.result: 在晶格流行病传播、双粒子物种混合、聚合物拉伸三个实验中，该方法在宏观预测准确度上大幅超越基线方法，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过交替优化潜在表示和转移动力学，避免了重构误导和尺度塌缩，实现了针对宏观预测的有效潜在动力学学习，为复杂系统宏观建模提供了新范式。

title: Scale Sensitivity in Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization: Curvature of the Quantization Error Landscape
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods in the GPTQ family minimize a layer-wise reconstruction error on a uniform grid whose scale must be chosen; the common max-based choice degrades sharply at low bit-widths. We study how sensitive this objective is to the scale. For a layer with i.i.d. Gaussian weights and calibration activations of sufficiently large effective rank, we prove that, as the width grows, the normalized round-to-nearest loss converges with high probability, uniformly over all scales, to the mean-squared error of a uniform quantizer applied to a standard Gaussian; we verify the effective-rank condition for wide, randomly initialized MLPs with odd Lipschitz activations and isotropic Gaussian calibration data. The limiting objective has a unique nondegenerate minimizer, whose scale decreases strictly with the number of levels and whose curvature with respect to relative scale errors decays approximately exponentially with the bit-width. GPTQ experiments on five LLMs show the same trend: the scale rule changes perplexity substantially at 2--3 bits and negligibly from 6 bits on, and a local measure of GPTQ scale sensitivity decreases with bit-width in line with the Gaussian curvature. The Gaussian-optimal scale fails on raw weights; after Hadamard incoherence processing it matches the best searched rule at 3 bits and above without any search, but remains clearly worse at 2 bits.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了GPTQ系列后训练量化方法中层级重构误差对量化尺度的敏感性。理论上证明：对于高斯权重和足够大有效秩的校准激活，归一化最近舍入损失在宽度趋于无穷时一致收敛为标准高斯分布的均方误差；极限目标具有唯一非退化极小值，其最优尺度随量化位数增加而减小，曲率随位数呈指数衰减。实验验证：在五个LLMs上，尺度规则对困惑度的影响在2-3位时显著，6位以上可忽略；Hadamard不相干处理后，高斯最优尺度在3位以上匹配最佳搜索规则，但在2位时仍显著劣于搜索。
AI.motivation: GPTQ族PTQ方法最小化层级重构误差，但均匀量化网格的尺度选择对低位宽性能影响巨大。现有基于最大值的尺度选择在低位宽下性能急剧下降。缺乏对目标函数对尺度敏感性的理论理解，以及无搜索的最优尺度规则。
AI.method: 理论分析：假设权重为i.i.d.高斯，校准激活具有足够大有效秩，证明归一化最近舍入损失随宽度增长一致收敛为标准高斯的均方误差；验证宽随机初始化MLP配合奇Lipschitz激活和各向同性高斯校准数据满足有效秩条件。实验验证：在五个LLMs上测量不同位宽下尺度敏感度，对比Hadamard不相干处理前后的高斯最优尺度与搜索规则。
AI.result: 1. 极限目标具有唯一非退化极小值，最优尺度随量化水平数严格减小，曲率随位宽近似指数衰减。2. 实验显示尺度规则在2-3位显著影响困惑度，6位以上影响可忽略；GPTQ尺度敏感度局部度量随位宽下降，符合高斯曲率预测。3. 原始权重上高斯最优尺度失效；经Hadamard不相干处理后，3位以上匹配最佳搜索规则无需搜索，但2位时仍明显劣于搜索。
AI.conclusion: 量化尺度敏感性随位宽增加呈指数级下降，解释了为何高位宽下尺度选择不重要。Hadamard不相干处理使高斯最优尺度在3位以上达到免搜索最优，但2位量化仍需更精细的尺度搜索或改进方法。为低位宽PTQ尺度选择提供了理论指导和实用规则。

title: Simultaneous Neural Optimal Transport
summary: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for learning transformations between probability distributions from unpaired samples. In many applications, however, a single transformation must map several source distributions to a common target distribution. For example, image restoration might require handling different types of degradation without knowing the degradation of each input at inference time. Simple approaches of pooling the source distributions only encourage alignment with the target at the aggregate level and may leave individual sources misaligned. In our paper, we consider the simultaneous OT problem which formalizes the task of learning a shared transport map that minimizes the average transport cost while aligning each source distribution with a prescribed target. We propose a neural method for solving the simultaneous OT problem by learning a shared transport map that minimizes the average transport cost while aligning each source distribution with a prescribed target. We derive a max-min formulation for learning this map. We illustrate its application to image restoration, where a single model handles multiple degradation types using a common collection of clean target images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出同时最优传输（Simultaneous OT）问题，旨在学习一个共享传输映射将多个源分布同时映射到同一目标分布，并提出基于神经网络的最大-最小公式求解方法，应用于多退化类型的图像复原任务。
AI.motivation: 在许多应用（如图像复原）中，单一模型需处理多种源分布（不同退化类型）并映射到同一目标分布（干净图像）。简单合并源分布仅能在整体层面对齐，可能导致个别源分布错位。现有OT方法主要针对单源单目标场景，缺乏同时对齐多源分布的原则性框架。
AI.method: 形式化同时OT问题：寻找共享传输映射最小化平均传输成本，同时使每个源分布与目标分布对齐。推导最大-最小优化公式，设计神经网络参数化共享映射，通过交替优化求解。在图像复原中，单一模型接收多退化输入，利用共享干净图像集合作为目标进行训练。
AI.result: 提出的神经同时OT方法能有效学习共享映射，在多退化图像复原任务中，单一模型即可处理多种退化类型，优于分别训练或简单合并数据的基线方法，实现了各源分布与目标分布的同时对齐。
AI.conclusion: 同时OT为多源单目标分布对齐提供了原则性框架，最大-最小神经求解器具有实用性。该方法在图像复原等任务中展示了单一模型处理多样化退化的能力，为无配对数据的多域映射学习提供了新范式。

title: Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Looped reasoning models repeatedly apply a shared set of parameters, enabling more computation without increasing the model size. These models also support input-dependent computation by dynamically deciding when to stop looping. Motivated by the recent success of looped transformers in language modeling and reasoning, we investigate whether dynamic looping can similarly benefit sequential decision-making. We provide a complexity-theoretic motivation for this approach by showing that there exist Markov decision processes in which a state-adaptive policy achieves the optimal return with asymptotically less expected computation than any optimal fixed-runtime policy. To learn compute-adaptive policies in practice, we introduce Looped Actor, a transformer-based policy that repeatedly refines a latent representation toward a fixed point using a shared computational block. This allows the model to allocate computation adaptively by varying the number of loops based on the current state. We evaluate Looped Actor on 22 tasks across six environments, ranging from combinatorial puzzles to robotic manipulation and spanning online and offline reinforcement learning (RL) with discrete and continuous actions. Looped Actor matches or exceeds the performance of an untied baseline with 16$\times$ more parameters, with the largest gains in environments where action selection requires substantial multistep planning. For the Boxoban environment, we find that the computation allocation is structured: the number of loops increases with the number of remaining pushes and future optimal pushes become increasingly predictable from the latent state over successive loops. Together, these results highlight actor looping as a simple and efficient way to equip RL agents with adaptive computation and improve their planning capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/camail-official/LoopedActor

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Looped Actor，一种基于 Transformer 的策略网络，通过共享计算块的动态循环机制实现自适应计算分配，在 22 个任务中以极少参数量匹配或超越 16 倍参数的基线，显著提升多步规划能力。
AI.motivation: 循环推理模型通过共享参数重复计算，可在不增加模型规模的情况下增加计算量，并支持输入相关的动态停止。受循环 Transformer 在语言建模和推理中的成功启发，作者探究动态循环是否同样有利于序列决策（强化学习）。从复杂度理论角度证明，存在马尔可夫决策过程中，状态自适应策略能以渐近更少的期望计算量达到最优回报，而任何最优固定运行时间策略无法做到。
AI.method: 提出 Looped Actor：基于 Transformer 的策略，使用一个共享计算块反复细化潜在表示直至趋近不动点。根据当前状态动态决定循环次数，实现自适应计算分配。在 6 个环境（组合谜题、机器人操作等）的 22 个任务上评估，涵盖在线/离线 RL、离散/连续动作。
AI.result: Looped Actor 在所有任务上匹配或超越拥有 16 倍参数的未共享基线，增益最大的环境是那些动作选择需要大量多步规划的场景。在 Boxoban 环境中，循环次数随剩余推箱子数增加，且后续最优推箱动作随循环深度从潜在状态中变得更可预测，显示计算分配具有结构性。
AI.conclusion: Actor 循环是一种简单高效的方法，能为 RL 智能体赋予自适应计算能力并显著增强规划能力，代码已开源。

title: Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman Autoencoder for probabilistic time series forecasting
summary: Neural Koopman autoencoder models have been shown to successfully build a latent embedding with linear dynamics for arbitrary dynamical systems, enabling strong performance in long-term time series forecasting. However, these models usually work in a deterministic setting, which does not allow the quantification of the uncertainty of their predictions. Thus, we propose the new Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman AutoEncoder (VAIKAE), in which the latent embedding follows a Gaussian distribution instead of being deterministic. A key property of the VAIKAE architecture is that it leverages normalizing flow models, enabling the use of likelihood computations in the state space of dynamical systems for training a model. We further propose new strategies for uncertainty-aware latent data assimilation with a trained VAIKAE model. The effectiveness of our methods is demonstrated in a series of experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出变分增强可逆Koopman自编码器（VAIKAE），通过引入高斯分布的潜在嵌入和正规化流模型，实现了动力系统长期预测中的不确定性量化，并提出基于不确定性感知的潜在数据同化策略。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经Koopman自编码器模型虽能构建具有线性动力学的潜在嵌入以实现长期时间序列预测，但仅工作在确定性设定下，无法量化预测的不确定性，限制了其在实际应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出VAIKAE架构，将潜在嵌入建模为高斯分布而非确定性点估计，利用正规化流模型在动力系统的状态空间中进行似然计算以训练模型；进一步设计基于不确定性感知的潜在数据同化策略，结合训练好的VAIKAE进行状态估计与预测。
AI.result: 在多个长期时间序列预测基准实验中，VAIKAE展示了有效的不确定性量化能力，且预测性能优于或相当于现有确定性Koopman模型，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VAIKAE成功将不确定性量化引入Koopman自编码器框架，通过正规化流实现状态空间似然计算，并提出相应的数据同化策略，为动力系统的长期预测提供了可靠的概率化建模工具。

title: Engineering Efficient Self-Play Chess: Search, Replay, and Throughput Under Limited Compute
comment: 26 pages, 17 figures, including appendices. Code and experimental evidence: https://github.com/BertilBraun/Advanced-Techniques-in-Chess-Engines ; model artifacts: https://huggingface.co/BertilBraun/alphazero-chess ; interactive demo: https://chess.bertil-braun.de/
summary: How strong can an AlphaZero-style chess system become under limited training compute when its entire learning loop is engineered for efficiency? We train from random initialization through searched self-play on a single eight-GPU node for 2.5 days. The resulting 6.32-million-parameter model reaches 3,251 benchmark Elo [3,206, 3,297] at 100,000 searches per move (estimated at under five seconds of thinking time) against a fixed-node Stockfish 13 ladder. The run ingests 3.25 million completed games, involves an estimated 100 billion search simulations, and makes 836.6 million training presentations. We investigate search allocation, replay and restart-state selection, policy representation, progressive model sizing, quantized inference, and throughput engineering. Alongside the retained design, we document plausible alternatives that failed to improve the complete learning loop or did not justify their cost. The reported strength is a result of the integrated system, not an isolated Elo gain attributable to any single choice.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了在极有限的计算资源（单8-GPU节点，2.5天）下，通过全流程工程优化的AlphaZero风格自我对弈训练，从随机初始化训练出一个632万参数的国际象棋模型，在10万次搜索/步的条件下达到3251 Elo（对阵Stockfish 13），证明了系统级工程优化而非单一算法改进是关键。
AI.motivation: 探究在严格受限的训练算力预算下，AlphaZero范式的国际象棋系统通过端到端的工程效率优化，能达到何种棋力上限；旨在验证集成系统设计（而非孤立技巧）对最终性能的决定性作用。
AI.method: 采用单8-GPU节点进行2.5天的从零开始自我对弈训练，完成325万局对弈、约1000亿次搜索模拟、8.366亿次训练呈现。系统性地工程化优化了搜索预算分配、经验回放与重启状态选择、策略表示、渐进式模型规模扩展、量化推理及吞吐率工程；同时记录了未奏效或性价比不高的备选方案。
AI.result: 训练出的632万参数模型在每步10万次搜索（思考时间<5秒）下，对固定节点Stockfish 13基准测试达到3251 Elo（置信区间[3206, 3297]），展示了在极低算力预算下的高效能。
AI.conclusion: 报告的棋力成果源于完整学习循环的集成系统工程，而非归因于任何单一设计选择；强调了在算力受限场景下，全栈吞吐率与效率工程比孤立算法创新更关键。

title: Probability Contracts: Accuracy, Coherence, and Decisions Across LLM Interfaces
comment: Research preprint; includes proofs and supplementary analyses
summary: A probability used for a decision should refer to the same event across equivalent requests. We introduce probability contracts, a benchmark connecting exact finite-world posteriors, validated event transformations, and failure-aware decision evaluation. Four model-interface configurations are evaluated on 1,000 worlds. Their assessments differ across accuracy, coherence, and decision loss: Kev has lower aggregate canonical posterior error than Jev, but larger complement and coarsening residuals, with accuracy ordering varying by stratum. Jev's Event and Choice interfaces induce different binary actions on 32.8% of valid pairs at defer cost 0.10. A post-hoc analysis finds that disagreement certifies only 11-52% of mean binary pair error across configurations. An elementary action-region characterization explains when averaging changes decision loss relative to randomly selecting one interface. Although averaging cannot worsen that baseline's expected Brier score, its decision effect depends on the cost and crossed boundaries; the observed same-baseline penalties occur in configurations already worse than always deferring. The benchmark makes these distinctions measurable without treating consistency as accuracy or a score improvement as a decision guarantee.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“概率契约”基准，连接有限世界后验、验证事件变换与失效感知决策评估，评估四种模型-接口配置在1000个世界上的表现，揭示准确性、相干性与决策损失的差异，并分析平均化策略对决策的影响。
AI.motivation: 解决概率用于决策时需跨等价请求指代同一事件的问题，现有基准未能同时捕捉后验准确性、事件变换相干性及决策层面的失效感知评估，需要一个统一框架量化这些维度的权衡。
AI.method: 构建概率契约基准，包含精确有限世界后验、验证的事件变换、失效感知决策评估；在1000个世界上评估四种模型-接口配置（Kev、Jev等），测量规范后验误差、补集与粗化残差、二元行动分歧率、推迟成本下的决策损失，并进行事后分析与动作区域表征。
AI.result: Kev的聚合规范后验误差低于Jev，但补集与粗化残差更大，准确性随层级变化；Jev的Event与Choice接口在32.8%有效对上诱导不同二元行动（推迟成本0.10）；分歧仅证明11-52%平均二元对误差；平均化不恶化期望Brier分基线，但决策效应取决于成本与边界跨越，观测到的同基线惩罚出现在已比总是推迟更差的配置中。
AI.conclusion: 概率契约基准使准确性、相干性与决策损失的区分可度量，避免将一致性等同于准确性、将分数提升视为决策保证；平均化策略虽不损害校准分，但决策收益取决于成本结构与决策边界，需在具体契约下评估。

title: REVO: Rollout-Efficient Off-Policy Distillation via Variance-Guided Reuse
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables, code available at https://github.com/UNCSciML/REVO
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains language models using dense token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, its reliance on frequently refreshed student rollouts often incurs substantial generation cost. We introduce REVO, an off-policy distillation framework that improves rollout efficiency by reusing each student rollout for multi-step learner updates. REVO addresses prefix-level and current-token policy mismatch through stabilized prefix weighting and one-step resampling from the current student, which enables repeated updates without regenerating full trajectories. To prioritize informative token positions within reused rollouts, REVO uses the variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio to quantify the remaining token-level learning signal and guide repeated optimization. Across multiple student-teacher scales, REVO with only 50 rollout iterations matches or exceeds OPD baselines trained for 200 iterations on both in-domain and cross-domain reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: REVO是一种离策略蒸馏框架，通过复用学生生成的轨迹进行多步学习更新，解决了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的高生成成本问题，仅需50次rollout迭代即可达到或超过OPD 200次迭代的性能。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）依赖频繁刷新的学生rollouts来获取密集的token级教师监督，但这导致了巨大的生成计算成本。需要一种更高效的蒸馏方法，能够复用已有轨迹进行多步更新，从而大幅降低rollout生成开销。
AI.method: REVO采用离策略蒸馏框架，核心创新包括：1) 稳定的前缀加权和单步重采样机制，解决前缀级和当前token的策略不匹配问题，使得无需重新生成完整轨迹即可进行重复更新；2) 利用学生-教师log-probability ratio的方差量化剩余token级学习信号，指导在复用rollouts中优先优化信息量大的token位置。
AI.result: 在多个学生-教师规模设置下，REVO仅使用50次rollout迭代，在域内和跨域推理基准上均匹配或超过了OPD基线200次迭代的性能，显著提升了rollout效率。
AI.conclusion: REVO通过离策略蒸馏结合智能token位置优先级机制，实现了轨迹的高效复用和多步优化，为大语言模型知识蒸馏提供了一种计算效率更高的新范式。

title: ScaGNN: a Graph Neural Network for Multiple Scattering Simulations
summary: The boundary element method (BEM) provides an efficient numerical framework for solving multiple scattering problems in unbounded homogeneous domains. By restricting the discretization to the domain boundaries, it substantially reduces computational complexity. The procedure first consists in determining the solution trace on the boundaries of the domain by solving a boundary integral equation. Then, the volumetric solution can be recovered at low computational cost using a boundary integral representation. As the first step of the BEM represents the main computational bottleneck, we present ScaGNN, a learning-based approach designed to approximate the solution trace. It relies on a graph neural network architecture that incorporates a dynamic adaptive edge sampling mechanism for selecting the most relevant interactions to model. Guided by intermediate predictions of expected error and edge length, this mechanism selects, at various stages of the forward pass, the most relevant distant interactions to model. The proposed method is tailored to achieve linear complexity with the number of nodes in the input graph. To train and evaluate our network, we present a benchmark consisting of several datasets with different types of multiple scattering problems. Our experiments show that our approach surpasses existing state-of-the-art learning-based methods on the considered tasks and investigate the generalization capabilities to settings with an increased number of obstacles and out-of-distribution obstacle shapes. github.com/LARIAD/ScaGNN

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScaGNN，一种基于图神经网络的学习方法，用于加速边界元方法（BEM）中边界积分方程求解的瓶颈步骤，通过动态自适应边采样机制实现线性复杂度，在多重散射问题上超越现有学习方法并展现良好泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 边界元方法（BEM）通过仅离散化边界大幅降低无界均匀域中多重散射问题的计算复杂度，但求解边界积分方程以获取边界解迹是主要计算瓶颈，亟需加速该步骤。
AI.method: 提出ScaGNN，采用图神经网络架构，引入动态自适应边采样机制：在前向传播的各阶段，利用中间预测的期望误差和边长度引导，选择最相关的远距离相互作用建模，从而实现随输入图节点数线性增长的计算复杂度。
AI.result: 在多重散射问题基准数据集上，ScaGNN超越现有最先进的学习基线方法；实验并考察了其在障碍物数量增加和分布外障碍物形状下的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ScaGNN为BEM边界解迹提供了高效的学习近似方案，兼具线性复杂度与强泛化性，有效缓解了BEM的计算瓶颈。

title: Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains compact language agents with teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories. In multi-turn tasks, compounding errors can move students beyond the teacher's effective supervision. We introduce Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation (GC-OPD), which enriches an off-the-shelf teacher's scoring context with execution evidence. A graph indexes repeated teacher executions by shared states while preserving complete successful and failed histories. After each student episode, GC-OPD retrieves current-state references or historical alternatives and combines them with student hindsight to score the original thought-action tokens. Using the same original teachers, GC-OPD improves mean success over vanilla OPD from 24.70% to 48.78% on ScienceWorld (4B student), from 53.36% to 85.26% on ALFWorld Unseen, and from 29.10% to 37.65% on WebShop. At matched student sizes, it also achieves higher mean success than every evaluated OPD baseline using GRPO-trained teachers on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld; the strongest such ScienceWorld 4B baseline reaches 46.66%. GC-OPD requires no task-specific teacher optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation (GC-OPD)，通过图结构索引教师执行历史，结合学生事后反思，增强教师评分上下文，显著提升多轮任务中学生代理的性能，且无需任务特定的教师优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的在线策略蒸馏 (OPD) 在多轮任务中面临累积错误导致学生偏离教师有效监督范围的问题，教师难对学生生成的偏离轨迹提供有效反馈。
AI.method: GC-OPD 构建图索引教师重复执行轨迹，按共享状态聚类并保留完整成功/失败历史。学生每轮结束后，检索当前状态参考或历史替代方案，结合学生事后反思 (hindsight) 对原始思考-动作 token 进行评分，从而丰富教师评分上下文。
AI.result: 在 ScienceWorld (4B 学生) 上从 24.70% 提升至 48.78%，ALFWorld Unseen 从 53.36% 提升至 85.26%，WebShop 从 29.10% 提升至 37.65%。同等学生规模下，优于所有使用 GRPO 训练教师的 OPD 基线，ScienceWorld 4B 最强基线仅 46.66%。
AI.conclusion: GC-OPD 通过图条件化的教师执行证据增强评分上下文，有效缓解多轮任务中的累积错误问题，显著提升学生代理性能，且无需针对任务优化教师，具有良好的通用性和实用性。

title: Physical Muon: Orthogonalization as an Equilibrium Computation
comment: Accepted at 18th annual workshop on Optimization for Machine Learning
summary: Physical neural networks and analog in-memory computing could reduce the energy cost of neural network training. Realizing this potential, however, requires optimizers that combine effective learning with physical implementability. SGD fits local analog updates but struggles on transformers, while Adam family is unstable against analog bias. Muon offers strong training performance, but its Newton--Schulz orthogonalization relies on dense matrix-matrix products. To address this obstacle, we introduce Physical Muon, which computes the orthogonalization as the equilibrium of a continuous-time flow. Random probes approximate the flow using matrix-vector products, reciprocal reads, and local rank-1 writes. To test whether this replacement preserves training performance, we evaluate it on a 10.95M-parameter transformer. The dense flow's mean validation cross-entropy is 0.0085 above Newton--Schulz across nine seeds per method; the probe implementation is 0.0188 above the control across two seeds. Circuit simulations further reproduce the flow dynamics and yield comparable training behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Physical Muon 优化器，通过将 Muon 的 Newton-Schulz 正交化替换为连续时间流的平衡态，并利用随机探针用矩阵-向量乘法、倒数读取和局部秩-1 写入近似该流，实现了在模拟存内计算硬件上物理可实现的高性能 Transformer 训练。
AI.motivation: 物理神经网络和模拟存内计算有望大幅降低神经网络训练的能耗，但需要兼顾有效学习与物理可实现性的优化器。SGD 虽适配模拟局部更新，但在 Transformer 上表现不佳；Adam 族对模拟偏置不稳定；Muon 训练性能强，但其 Newton-Schulz 正交化依赖稠密矩阵-矩阵乘法，难以在模拟硬件上高效实现。
AI.method: 引入 Physical Muon：将正交化建模为连续时间动力学流的平衡态；利用随机探针技术，仅通过矩阵-向量乘积、倒数读取和局部秩-1 写入即可近似该流，避免了稠密矩阵-矩阵乘法；在 10.95M 参数 Transformer 上对比 Newton-Schulz 基线与探针实现，并通过电路仿真验证流动力学与训练行为。
AI.result: 稠密流实现的平均验证交叉熵比 Newton-Schulz 高 0.0085（9 个种子）；探针实现比对照组高 0.0188（2 个种子）。电路仿真复现了流动力学并产生可比的训练表现，表明物理实现基本保持了训练性能。
AI.conclusion: Physical Muon 通过连续时间流与随机探针近似，成功将 Muon 的高性能正交化映射到模拟硬件友好的原语上，在保持训练效果的同时实现了物理可落地性，为低能耗物理神经网络训练提供了可行的优化器方案。

title: Why Adaptive Optimizers Underestimate Rare Tokens
summary: In the softmax output layer, a rare token receives a small positive logit gradient on most steps and a much larger negative gradient on the few steps when it is the target. SGD simply adds these contributions. Coordinate-wise adaptive methods such as Adam, RMSProp, and sign descent instead divide each update by a running estimate of its magnitude, and that estimate is largest immediately after the token appears. This imbalance has two effects. At the level of the whole output layer, we characterize which optimizers preserve the mean output embedding: every method whose update is linear in past gradients does, as do Kronecker-factored and orthogonalized methods such as Shampoo and Muon. Adam, Adafactor, Lion, and sign descent do not, and for these methods we obtain an exact step-by-step expression for the change. At the level of an individual rare token, the same normalization shifts the training fixed point. In the unigram model, sign descent lowers the logit of every token that occurs in fewer than half of the minibatches at a constant expected rate. For RMSProp with periodic arrivals, we can solve the fixed point in closed form: if a token is absent for at least two consecutive minibatches, its equilibrium probability is strictly below its data frequency for every learning rate, and the ratio tends to $κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))$. Here $κ$ is the mean number of steps between occurrences divided by the second-moment time constant $1/(1-β_2)$. In the same model, SGD and AMSGrad retain the unbiased fixed point. We test these predictions both in a unigram model and in a small language model trained from a known generating distribution. With random arrivals, the bias is larger than the periodic formula predicts; in the language model, the optimizers with the biased fixed point also fit the generating distribution less well.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自适应优化器（Adam、RMSProp、sign descent 等）在 softmax 输出层中对稀有 token 的更新动力学，揭示其归一化机制导致整体输出嵌入均值偏移以及单个稀有 token 的训练不动点产生偏移，SGD 与 AMSGrad 保持无偏不动点，而自适应方法使稀有 token 的平衡概率低于数据频率，在语言模型实验中表现为拟合生成分布更差。
AI.motivation: 在 softmax 输出层，稀有 token 大部分步骤获得微小正梯度，仅在作为目标时获得大负梯度。坐标自适应方法（Adam、RMSProp、sign descent）按运行中的幅度估计归一化更新，而该估计在 token 出现后最大，导致更新不平衡。论文旨在从整体输出层均值嵌入保持性和单个稀有 token 不动点偏移两个层面，系统刻画不同优化器的行为差异。
AI.method: 理论分析与实验验证相结合。理论上：在 unigram 模型下推导各优化器的逐步更新表达式，求解周期性到达假设下 RMSProp 的闭式不动点，分析 SGD、AMSGrad、Shampoo、Muon 等方法的线性更新性质；实验上：在 unigram 模型和从已知生成分布训练的小型语言模型中测试预测，对比随机到达与周期性到达下的偏差大小。
AI.result: 1) 整体输出层：更新与历史梯度呈线性关系的方法（SGD、Kronecker 分解、正交化方法如 Shampoo、Muon）保持均值输出嵌入；Adam、Adafactor、Lion、sign descent 不保持，并给出了精确的逐步变化表达式。2) 单个稀有 token：sign descent 以常数期望速率降低出现频率低于半数 minibatch 的 token 的 logit；RMSProp 周期性到达下，若 token 连续缺席至少两个 minibatch，其平衡概率严格低于数据频率，比值趋近 κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))，其中 κ 为平均到达步数与二阶矩时间常数 1/(1-β₂) 之比。SGD 与 AMSGrad 保持无偏不动点。3) 实验：随机到达下偏差大于周期性公式预测；语言模型中，有偏不动点的优化器拟合生成分布更差。
AI.conclusion: 坐标自适应优化器的归一化机制会破坏 softmax 输出层的均值嵌入不变性，并系统性地压低稀有 token 的平衡概率，导致模型对生成分布的拟合变差。SGD 及 AMSGrad 等保持线性更新性质的方法能避免该偏差。实践中需根据任务中稀有 token 的重要性权衡优化器选择。

title: Benchmarking graph-based models for in-silico toxicity prediction in drug discovery
summary:
Drug discovery is a costly and high-risk process, where toxicity-related failures remain a major cause of attrition in both preclinical and clinical stages. As a result, accurate early prediction of chemical toxicity is essential to reduce downstream costs and improve compound prioritization. In this context, graph deep learning (GDL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for toxicity prediction, leveraging molecular graph representations to learn directly from chemical structure with improved expressivity over traditional approaches.
  Despite the growing number of proposed models, current literature-based comparisons are often difficult to interpret due to inconsistencies in datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and evaluation protocols. To address this limitation, we introduce a unified and standardized benchmarking framework for GDL-based toxicity prediction. We systematically evaluate more than 20 representative approaches under consistent experimental conditions and across multiple datasets and partitioning strategies, enabling a fair and reproducible comparison of model performance. In addition, we complement this empirical study with a structured literature analysis to contextualize existing methodological trends and performance claims. Our results provide a clearer and more reliable assessment of the current state of the field, highlighting both the strengths and limitations of existing graph-based approaches. To support transparency and reproducibility, we release our benchmarking framework as open-source software https://gitlab.citius.gal/noel.suarez/benchtox, allowing the community to evaluate and compare models under consistent conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一标准化基准测试框架BenchTox，系统评估20余种图深度学习模型在毒性预测任务上的表现，解决现有文献对比中数据集、预处理和评估协议不一致的问题，并开源框架以促进公平可复现的模型比较。
AI.motivation: 药物发现成本高、风险大，毒性相关失败是临床前和临床阶段主要脱靶原因。图深度学习（GDL）虽成为毒性预测有力范式，但现有文献对比因数据集、预处理流程和评估协议不一致而难以解释，亟需统一基准测试框架以实现公平、可复现的模型性能评估。
AI.method: 构建BenchTox基准测试框架，包含多个毒性预测数据集和多种划分策略，统一预处理管道和评估协议，系统评估20余种代表性GDL方法（包括GNN变体、图Transformer等），并结合结构化文献分析梳理方法趋势和性能声明。
AI.result: 在一致实验条件下完成大规模实证研究，揭示不同GDL方法在多数据集、多划分策略下的真实性能差异，指出现有图基方法的优势与局限，为领域现状提供更清晰、可靠的评估。开源代码库BenchTox支持社区在统一条件下评估和比较模型。
AI.conclusion: 统一标准化基准测试对推动毒性预测领域发展至关重要。BenchTox框架填补了公平比较的空白，为未来方法改进提供可靠基准。开源工具将促进透明度和可复现性，助力化合物优先级排序和下游成本降低。

title: A Model-Agnostic Physics-Guided Adapter for Few-Shot Transfer of Coastal Flood Prediction Models to Unseen Regions
summary: Deep learning surrogates can produce high-resolution coastal flood maps orders of magnitude faster than physics-based hydrodynamic simulators, yet transferring them to new coastal regions remains costly, since generating target-region data for fine-tuning typically requires numerous time-consuming simulations. To tackle this bottleneck, we introduce the Physics Adapter (PA), a compact, architecture-agnostic adaptation interface that enables efficient few-shot transfer of flood prediction models across diverse coastal regions. PA predicts peak water level through a differentiable wet/dry response that compares terrain elevation against a learned water level, and blends this physics-structured prediction with a data-driven branch through a learned gate. Unlike physics-informed formulations, PA imposes no PDE-residual or conservation losses and instead exploits elevation as an architectural inductive bias, adding a negligible number of trainable parameters. We integrate PA into 12 heterogeneous models, and evaluate them on two coastal regions with markedly distinct geometries, topographies, and shoreline protection configurations. The performance of PA is benchmarked against a no-physics baseline, full fine-tuning, and standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, considering both within-region generalization to unseen sea level rise values and between-region transfer. In low-shot regime (K=3), and averaged over all backbones and transfer settings, adding PA reduces root mean square error by 11.5% when only the output head is adapted on a frozen backbone, by 15.4% when combined with PEFT methods, and by 22.9% under full fine-tuning, compared to matched configurations without PA. Taken together, the findings of this work offer practitioners a concrete recipe for extending DL-based coastal flood predictors to new, data-scarce regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Physics Adapter (PA)，一种紧凑、架构无关的适配接口，通过可微的干湿响应机制利用地形高程作为归纳偏置，实现深度学习洪水预测模型在沿海区域间的小样本高效迁移，显著降低均方根误差。
AI.motivation: 深度学习代理模型虽能比物理模拟器快数量级生成高分辨率沿海洪水图，但迁移到新区域代价高昂，因为目标区域数据生成需大量耗时模拟；现有微调方法参数量大、数据需求高，亟需一种轻量、少样本的跨区域迁移方案。
AI.method: 设计Physics Adapter (PA)：包含可微干湿响应模块（将地形高程与学习水位比较预测峰值水位）与数据驱动分支，通过学习门控融合；不引入PDE残差或守恒损失，仅将高程作为架构归纳偏置，仅增加极少可训练参数。将PA集成到12种异构骨干网络中，在两个几何、地形、岸线防护差异显著的沿海区域评估，对比无物理基线、全量微调、标准PEFT方法，考察区域内泛化（未见海平面上升值）与区域间迁移。
AI.result: 在低样本 regime (K=3) 下，平均所有骨干与迁移设置：仅适配输出头冻结骨干时PA降低RMSE 11.5%；结合PEFT方法降低15.4%；全量微调下降低22.9%。PA在各配置下均显著提升跨区域迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: Physics Adapter 为从业者提供了将基于深度学习的沿海洪水预测器扩展到新的、数据稀缺区域的具体可行方案，以极小参数开销实现高效少样本跨域迁移。

title: ReLMem: Learning Recurrent Memory for Longitudinal EHR Modeling
summary: Longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) modeling requires integrating new visits with an expanding patient history. Yet the continual accumulation of clinical information imposes increasing computational and memory costs on large language models (LLMs) when they process and retain complete patient histories. A practical alternative is visit-wise recurrent compression, which incorporates each incoming visit into a compact, continually updated patient memory. However, under a fixed memory budget, successive updates must integrate new information without progressively losing critical historical evidence needed to subsequent tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Recurrent Longitudinal Memory (ReLMem), a framework that learns to maintain fixed-capacity patient memory for efficient downstream prediction with a frozen LLM. ReLMem equips this LLM with lightweight compression adapters to recurrently update the memory from its previous state and each incoming visit, without rereading earlier records. Specifically, we develop a multi-granularity optimization strategy to preserve task-relevant information throughout recurrent updates and support downstream prediction from the final memory. The intermediate supervision aligns attention outputs from compressed memory and the full history under identical queries, while prediction supervision minimizes cross-entropy with ground truth answers conditioned on the final memory. On EHR-based medication prediction, ReLMem approaches the F1 scores of full-history baseline while reducing average retained historical storage by 97.1%. Under the same memory budget, it improves macro- and micro-F1 over the strongest compressed-memory baseline by 4.66 and 4.75 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of learning recurrent patient memory for efficient longitudinal EHR modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Recurrent Longitudinal Memory (ReLMem)框架，通过轻量级压缩适配器和多粒度优化策略，使冻结的大语言模型能以固定容量的患者记忆高效处理纵向电子健康记录(EHR)，在药物预测任务上接近全历史基线性能，同时将历史存储减少97.1%。
AI.motivation: 纵向EHR建模需要整合新就诊记录与不断增长的患者历史，但临床信息的持续积累给大语言模型(LLM)处理和保留完整患者历史带来了日益增长的计算和内存开销。现有的逐次访问压缩方法在固定内存预算下，难以在连续更新中保留后续任务所需的关键历史证据。
AI.method: ReLMem为冻结的LLM配备轻量级压缩适配器，从前一状态和新就诊记录循环更新固定容量的患者记忆，无需重读早期记录。核心创新是多粒度优化策略：中间监督将压缩记忆与完整历史在相同查询下的注意力输出对齐；预测监督最小化以最终记忆为条件的真实答案交叉熵。
AI.result: 在基于EHR的药物预测任务中，ReLMem的F1分数接近全历史基线，平均保留历史存储减少97.1%。在相同内存预算下，相比最强压缩记忆基线，macro-F1提升4.66个百分点，micro-F1提升4.75个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果凸显了学习循环患者记忆对高效纵向EHR建模的价值，ReLMem在大幅降低存储和计算成本的同时保持了预测性能，为临床实际部署提供了实用方案。

title: GraphVQ: Structure-Aware Autoregressive Decoding over Context-Quantized Graph Tokens
summary: Graph foundation models need a discrete token representation, but casting a graph as a generatable token sequence faces a structural obstacle: edges spanning beyond the serialization window cannot be emitted in one pass--so one-pass autoregressive generators systematically under-produce cycles--and a single global condition cannot tell candidate edges apart. GraphVQ removes both obstacles: node contexts--features plus a local edge mask under multi-order breadth-first serialization--are quantized into a shared codebook by a VQ-VAE with BCE-calibrated Bernoulli edge decoding, and a second-stage structure-aware decoder emits the global adjacency conditioned on token-derived pair features, whose necessity over any global-summary condition is formalized in a scoped impossibility result. The tokenizer reconstructs node features at 0.86--0.99 accuracy and decodes local edges at AUROC >= 0.89 (ECE <= 0.007). Under one same-split protocol on four datasets, pair conditioning improves orbit MMD 0.248 -> 0.174 on PROTEINS and 3.4x on a ring stress test, and vanishes on a random-label control--the signature of attribute--topology coupling--so the gain is claimed exactly where attributes carry edge-relevant signal. GraphVQ ranks first among learned generators on PROTEINS, ties for first on SYN-COMM, and improves orbit MMD 2.7--17x over one-stage generation on three datasets, with seed-level bootstrap intervals confirming the rankings are not seed noise; on MUTAG the unweighted edge target under-generates and is reported as such. These results locate the structural control of autoregressive graph generation in the granularity of the condition: pair-level token context turns a quantized vocabulary into a usable capacity axis for distribution-faithful graph generation and future token-level pretraining.

AI.tldr: GraphVQ 通过两阶段离散化与配对条件解决了自回归图生成中的结构性障碍：第一阶段用 VQ-VAE 将节点上下文（特征+多阶 BFS 局部边掩码）量化为共享码本，第二阶段结构感知解码器基于 token 派生的配对特征生成全局邻接矩阵。实验显示其在分布保真度（orbit MMD）上显著优于单阶段基线，并首次形式化证明了配对条件相对于全局条件的必要性。
AI.motivation: 图基础模型需要离散 token 表示，但将图序列化为可生成的 token 序列面临两大结构性障碍：1) 超出序列化窗口的边无法在一次前向传递中生成，导致自回归生成器系统性地欠生成环结构；2) 单一全局条件无法区分候选边。现有方法缺乏细粒度的结构控制机制。
AI.method: GraphVQ 采用两阶段架构：第一阶段，在多阶广度优先序列化下，将节点特征与局部边掩码组合为节点上下文，通过带 BCE 校准的伯努利边解码的 VQ-VAE 量化为共享码本；第二阶段，结构感知解码器基于 token 派生的配对特征（而非全局摘要）生成全局邻接矩阵，并给出了配对条件相对于全局条件必要性的形式化不可能性证明。
AI.result: Tokenizer 在节点特征重构上达 0.86-0.99 准确率，局部边解码 AUROC ≥ 0.89 (ECE ≤ 0.007)。在四数据集同一划分协议下：PROTEINS 上 orbit MMD 从 0.248 降至 0.174，环压力测试提升 3.4 倍；随机标签对照实验增益消失，确认增益源自属性-拓扑耦合信号。GraphVQ 在 PROTEINS 上居学习型生成器首位，SYN-COMM 并列首位，三数据集上较单阶段生成 orbit MMD 提升 2.7-17 倍（bootstrap 置信区间确认非种子噪声）；MUTAG 上无权边目标欠生成并如实报告。
AI.conclusion: 自回归图生成的结构控制关键在于条件粒度：配对级 token 上下文将量化词汇表转化为可用的容量轴，实现了分布保真的图生成，并为未来的 token 级预训练奠定基础。

title: PHASE: Multi-Regime Modeling of Incompressible Magnetohydrodynamics
summary: Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) is central to plasma modeling in astrophysics, space science, fusion, and engineering, but resolving multiscale MHD dynamics is computationally expensive. Machine-learning surrogates enable fast inference by learning reusable solution operators, yet existing models require separate training for each physical regime, limiting generalization across varying parameter settings. We introduce PHASE, a PHysics-Adaptive Scalable operator with residual Error correction, designed to model incompressible MHD across varying physical parameters with a single model. PHASE combines transfer learning, regime-aware adaptation, physics-centered learning, and residual refinement to improve both physical fidelity and generalization across MHD regimes. Together, these improvements achieve state-of-the-art prediction accuracy on two-dimensional MHD turbulence by reducing relative $L_2$ errors on physical fields by more than an order of magnitude compared to prior MHD neural-operator baselines. Moreover, PHASE generalizes successfully to unseen parameter values without retraining, demonstrating the cross-regime adaptability expected from operator learning. We evaluate PHASE beyond point-wise prediction errors using derived physical fields, spectral analysis, and distribution statistics, consistently observing improved physical fidelity. We further show that our framework can accurately simulate MHD instabilities by testing it on the Kelvin--Helmholtz instability, demonstrating the robustness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PHASE（物理自适应可扩展算子与残差误差修正），一种用于建模不同物理参数下不可压缩磁流体动力学（MHD）的单一模型。PHASE结合迁移学习、制度感知自适应、物理中心学习和残差细化，在二维MHD湍流预测中将相对L2误差降低一个数量级以上，并能在无需重新训练的情况下泛化到未见参数值，且在Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性测试中展现出鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: MHD建模在天体物理学、空间科学、聚变工程等领域至关重要，但多尺度MHD动力学求解计算成本极高。现有机器学习代理模型虽能快速推理，但需针对每个物理制度单独训练，缺乏跨参数设置的泛化能力。因此需要一种能统一建模不同物理参数下MHD、同时保持物理保真度和泛化性的算子学习方法。
AI.method: PHASE框架包含四大核心组件：1) 迁移学习：利用预训练知识加速新制度适应；2) 制度感知自适应：通过条件化机制动态调整模型行为以匹配不同物理参数；3) 物理中心学习：将物理约束（如散度自由条件、能量守恒）嵌入损失函数和架构中；4) 残差细化：采用残差修正机制迭代降低预测误差。模型基于神经算子架构，输入物理参数与初始场，输出时演化解。
AI.result: 在二维MHD湍流基准测试中，PHASE将物理场的相对L2误差较先前MHD神经算子基线降低一个数量级以上。模型成功泛化至训练分布外的参数值，无需微调。通过导出物理场、谱分析、分布统计等多维评估，均显示物理保真度显著提升。在Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性模拟中，PHASE准确捕捉不稳定性演化动力学，验证方法鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PHASE实现了跨物理制度的单一模型MHD建模，兼具高精度、强泛化与物理一致性。其模块化设计（迁移学习+制度自适应+物理约束+残差修正）为复杂多物理场代理建模提供了可推广范式，有望加速聚变等离子体控制、天体物理模拟等领域的实时预测与反演任务。

title: Procedural Core: A Compact Recurrent Initialization for Vision Transformers
summary: Transformers are typically trained from random initialization, requiring all their capabilities to emerge from large-scale optimization. Recent work showed that a small amount of abstract procedurally generated data can help acquire generic inductive structure at low cost. However, this adds a pretraining stage that must be repeated for every target model. We propose Procedural Core, an initialization strategy that captures this generic structure into a compact set of weights that can be reused across models. We train a minimal recurrent transformer on procedural data, then expand its weights to initialize transformers of arbitrary width and depth. The resulting initialization improves performance on image classification, self-supervised visual learning (DINO), and modeling natural language (FineWeb-Edu) and code (CodeParrot). For image classification, expanding a 1M-parameter core to initialize an 85M-parameter ViT-Base improves ImageNet top-1 accuracy by 2.2 pp over standard random initialization. Our analysis identifies recurrence as essential for learning compact weights that transfer across models. In ViTs, we localize a key benefit in the suppression of high-norm tokens that produces substantial improvements in zero-shot segmentation (ImageNet-S mAP 32.3 to 42.9), object localization (VOC07 CorLoc 9.9 to 18.4), and depth estimation (NYUv2 RMSE 1.104 to 0.998). This demonstrates that transformers need not start from a blank slate, and can be initialized with generic capabilities at low cost with no domain- or task-specific data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Procedural Core初始化策略，通过在程序生成数据上训练极小型循环Transformer，再将其权重扩展到任意宽深的Transformer，实现跨模型复用的通用初始化，显著提升图像分类、自监督视觉学习、自然语言建模和代码建模性能，且无需领域特定数据。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer从随机初始化训练，需大规模优化才能涌现能力。现有工作表明少量程序生成数据可低成本获得通用归纳结构，但需为每个目标模型重复预训练。本文旨在将这种通用结构压缩为一组可跨模型复用的紧凑权重，消除重复预训练阶段。
AI.method: 1) 在程序生成数据上训练一个极小参数量的循环Transformer（1M参数）；2) 将其权重扩展初始化任意宽度和深度的标准Transformer（如ViT-Base 85M参数）；3) 关键设计：采用循环结构而非前馈结构，以学习可跨模型迁移的紧凑权重。
AI.result: • ImageNet分类：ViT-Base Top-1准确率提升2.2个百分点。• 自监督视觉学习（DINO）、自然语言（FineWeb-Edu）、代码（CodeParrot）均有提升。• ViT中抑制高范数令牌带来零样本分割（ImageNet-S mAP 32.3→42.9）、目标定位（VOC07 CorLoc 9.9→18.4）、深度估计（NYUv2 RMSE 1.104→0.998）大幅改进。• 循环结构被证实为跨模型迁移的关键。
AI.conclusion: Transformer无需从空白板开始，可通过低成本程序生成数据预训练一个微型循环核心，再扩展初始化任意规模模型，赋予其通用能力，且完全不依赖领域或任务特定数据，展示了可复用初始化的可行性与高效性。}

title: ProCTI: Prototype-Refined Global Conditioning for Diffusion-Based Time Series Imputation
summary: Time series imputation has progressed from statistical and deep learning approaches to diffusion-based models, which have shown strong recent performance. Existing diffusion-based methods typically condition the reverse process using local contextual information from the current or neighbouring windows. Meanwhile, global dataset-level structure often remains implicit, limiting performance when local observations are sparse, noisy, or unrepresentative. To address this issue, we propose ProCTI, a diffusion-imputation framework that augments local conditioning with retrieved global dataset-level priors through learned prototypes. A hybrid conditioning mechanism integrates this global context with local signals during reverse diffusion, enabling more accurate reconstruction under varying missingness scenarios. Experiments across multiple benchmark datasets show that ProCTI outperforms strong baselines overall under random missingness, while remaining competitive under attribute-wise missingness. Furthermore, we use a latent-regime data model to characterise the precise conditions under which prototype-derived global conditioning provably improves imputation. We support this with a general theoretical analysis of local-global conditioning.

AI.tldr: ProCTI提出了一种基于扩散模型的时间序列插补框架，通过引入可学习的原型来检索全局数据集级先验，并结合局部上下文进行混合条件化，在随机缺失场景下显著优于基线，在属性级缺失下保持竞争力，并提供了局部-全局条件化的理论分析。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的时间序列插补方法主要依赖当前或邻近窗口的局部上下文信息作为反向过程的条件，而全局数据集级结构往往隐含且未被显式利用，导致在局部观测稀疏、噪声大或不具代表性时性能下降。
AI.method: ProCTI框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 原型学习模块，从训练数据中学习一组可学习的原型向量以捕获全局数据集级先验；(2) 检索机制，根据局部观测检索最相关的原型作为全局条件；(3) 混合条件化机制，在扩散模型的反向过程中将检索到的全局原型与局部上下文信息融合，共同指导插补生成。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上实验表明：ProCTI在随机缺失场景下整体优于强基线方法；在属性级缺失场景下保持竞争力；理论分析基于潜在机制数据模型，刻画了原型衍生的全局条件化可证改进插补性能的精确条件。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式引入全局数据集级先验并与局部信号混合条件化，ProCTI有效缓解了局部观测不足时的插补困难，理论与实验双重验证了局部-全局条件化在扩散模型时间序列插补中的有效性。

title: RACE: Relation-Level Counterfactual Explanations for Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks
summary: Counterfactual explanations of graph neural networks identify edge deletions that flip a prediction. On heterogeneous graphs, however, existing methods first collapse the graph into untyped edges, so they cannot answer the question a domain expert actually asks: which relation type drives this prediction? We present RACE (Relation-Aware Counterfactual Explanations), which gives this question an exact, per-instance answer. For every explained instance, an exhaustive search over relation subsets returns the certified minimum relation-deletion set that flips the prediction -- or an explicit report that no such deletion exists; each relation-level answer is then refined into a typed edge set within the attributed relations, verified on the discrete model by single-edge restoration. The relation-level answer is exact and deterministic given the frozen backbone, whereas soft-mask baselines vary by 6-8 pp in success rate across runs differing only in random ordering. On ACM, a Cora-derived graph, and ogbn-mag, RACE improves counterfactual success rate over the strongest baseline by up to +2.7 pp while deleting fewer edges, and attains the highest success rate among all same-task baselines on every dataset; the advantage reproduces across four backbones on ogbn-arXiv and on DBLP, with cross-seed relation-set agreement up to 0.89. A synthetic study with known generating mechanisms confirms that the search recovers the relation the trained model actually relies on -- and reports infeasibility rather than fabricating an attribution when the model has learned none -- so the explanations stay trustworthy exactly where explanations matter.
