AI.tldr: RACE 为异构图神经网络提供精确、逐实例的反事实解释，通过穷尽搜索关系子集返回能翻转预测的最小认证关系删除集（或显式报告不存在），再细化为类型化边集并在离散模型上单边恢复验证；在多个基准数据集和主干网络上成功率最高、删除边更少，且跨种子一致性达 0.89，合成实验证实能准确回溯模型真正依赖的关系且不捏造归因。
AI.motivation: 现有异构图反事实解释方法会将图折叠为无类型边，无法回答领域专家关心的“哪种关系类型驱动了该预测”这一核心问题。
AI.method: 对每个被解释实例，在冻结的骨干网络上对关系子集进行穷尽搜索，得到能翻转预测的认证最小关系删除集（或确认不可行）；随后将关系级答案在归属关系内细化为类型化边集，并通过在离散模型上的单边恢复进行验证。
AI.result: 在 ACM、Cora 派生图和 ogbn-mag 上，RACE 将最强基线的反事实成功率提升高达 +2.7 pp 且删除更少边；在每个数据集上均达同任务基线最高成功率；优势在 ogbn-arXiv 和 DBLP 上跨四种主干网络复现，跨种子关系集一致性达 0.89；合成研究确认搜索能精准回溯模型实际依赖的关系，且在模型未学到任何关系时诚实报告不可行。
AI.conclusion: RACE 为异构图 GNN 提供了精确、确定性且可信的关系级反事实解释，在成功率、边删除效率和跨运行一致性上全面超越基线，且解释在模型未学到真实机制时不会捏造归因，保证了在关键场景下的可信度。 }

title: Nonpreemptive Scheduling While Learning Context-Dependent Service Rates
summary: We study nonpreemptive contextual queueing bandits in a single-server system. Each job is represented by a $d$-dimensional context vector; in each round, a job may arrive with its context drawn from an unknown distribution $\mathcal{D}$, and its departure probability is determined by a logistic model of that context vector with an unknown parameter $θ^*$. The server learns from service outcomes while deciding which waiting job to serve and whether to idle, aiming to minimize queue-length regret, the gap between its expected terminal queue length and the minimum achievable by an admissible policy. Once selected, a job must be served until completion, and we refer to this as the nonpreemptive setting. A central challenge is that, even with full model knowledge, the optimal policy cannot in general be characterized by a simple myopic rule, since the optimal action can change with the remaining horizon at the same queue state. Nevertheless, when the model and horizon are known, the optimal action can be obtained through a finite-horizon Bellman recursion. Motivated by this, we propose Learn--Clear--Plan (LCP), which estimates the system and uses the resulting Bellman recursion to make horizon-dependent decisions. LCP achieves $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/T})$ queue-length regret, while a lower-bound construction gives $Ω(\min\{1/\sqrt{d},\sqrt{d/T}\})$ regret for every learning policy on some instance, establishing optimality up to polylogarithmic factors when $T\ge d^2$. When the horizon is unknown, no horizon-independent policy achieves vanishing regret against the finite-horizon optimum. We therefore use SEPT, the policy that serves a waiting job with the highest probability of departure, as a fixed reference, and suggest an estimated-SEPT algorithm that achieves a tracking error of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/t})$ without knowing the model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非抢占式上下文排队多臂老虎机问题，提出 Learn-Clear-Plan (LCP) 算法，利用贝尔曼递归进行依赖时域的决策，实现 Õ(√(d/T)) 的队列长度遗憾，并证明在 T ≥ d² 时该遗憾在对数因子下最优；针对未知时域情况，提出基于 SEPT 策略的估计算法，实现 Õ(√(d/t)) 的跟踪误差。
AI.motivation: 在单服务器系统中，作业具有 d 维上下文向量，离开概率由未知参数 θ* 的逻辑斯蒂模型决定。服务器需从服务结果中学习，决定服务哪个等待作业或空闲，以最小化队列长度遗憾。核心挑战在于即使模型已知，最优策略也无法用简单近视规则刻画，因为最优动作随剩余时域在相同队列状态下变化。
AI.method: 提出 Learn-Clear-Plan (LCP) 算法：先估计系统模型，再利用有限时域贝尔曼递归进行依赖时域的决策。对于未知时域情况，采用 SEPT 策略（服务离开概率最高的等待作业）作为固定基准，提出估计 SEPT 算法进行跟踪。
AI.result: LCP 实现 Õ(√(d/T)) 的队列长度遗憾；下界构造给出 Ω(min{1/√d, √(d/T)}) 遗憾，确立在 T ≥ d² 时 LCP 在对数因子下最优。未知时域下，估计 SEPT 算法实现 Õ(√(d/t)) 的跟踪误差。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了非抢占式上下文排队多臂老虎机的理论框架，证明了依赖时域的贝尔曼递归决策的最优性，并给出了未知时域下的跟踪算法，填补了该领域的理论空白。

title: Learning Causal Normalizing Flows from Incomplete Data via Observed-Data Likelihood
summary: Causal Normalizing Flows (CNFs) enable causal inference from observational data given the causal structure, but they assume fully observed training data. We introduce MissCNF, which trains CNFs directly on incomplete data by maximizing the marginal likelihood of each partially observed sample, without discarding rows or constructing a completed dataset. Thanks to the causal structure encoded in the autoregressive factorization of CNFs, only missing variables in the ancestral closure of the observed set are integrated out, while the others are dropped without computation. We further establish the conditions under which MissCNF recovers the true joint distribution, and introduce \emph{causal-family positivity}, where identification is possible even when no record in the dataset is ever complete. We compare MissCNF with two common strategies for handling missing data: listwise deletion and impute-then-fit pipelines. Across eight synthetic causal benchmarks, three missingness mechanisms, and missing rates up to $90\%$, MissCNF achieves the lowest KL divergence in 23 of 24 nonlinear MCAR and MAR settings and in all nonlinear MNAR settings, as well as the lowest counterfactual error in 20 of 24 settings. On linear SCMs, where linear imputation performs best, MissCNF ranks in the top two in 22 of 24 settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MissCNF方法，直接在不完整数据上训练因果归一化流，通过最大化部分观测样本的边际似然，无需丢弃数据或插补。利用因果结构的自回归分解，仅对观测集祖先闭包内的缺失变量积分，其他变量直接丢弃。实验表明MissCNF在合成基准上显著优于列表删除和插补后拟合方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的因果归一化流（CNFs）假设训练数据完全观测，无法直接处理缺失数据。传统处理缺失数据的方法（如列表删除、插补）会丢失信息或引入偏差，且不利用因果结构。需要一种能直接在不完整数据上训练、利用因果结构高效处理缺失变量、并能在无完整记录情况下识别真实联合分布的方法。
AI.method: MissCNF直接在不完整数据上最大化每个部分观测样本的边际似然。利用CNFs的自回归分解中编码的因果结构，仅对观测变量集合祖先闭包内的缺失变量进行积分，其他缺失变量无需计算直接丢弃。建立了MissCNF恢复真实联合分布的条件，提出因果族正性概念，使得即使数据集中没有任何完整记录也能实现识别。
AI.result: 在八个合成因果基准、三种缺失机制（MCAR、MAR、MNAR）、高达90%缺失率下：非线性设置中，MissCNF在24个MCAR/MAR设置中23个达到最低KL散度，在所有非线性MNAR设置中达到最低KL散度，在24个设置中20个达到最低反事实误差。线性SCMs上，MissCNF在24个设置中22个排名前二。
AI.conclusion: MissCNF通过利用因果结构直接在不完整数据上训练CNFs，避免了数据丢弃和插补偏差，建立了理论识别条件，在多种缺失机制和高缺失率下均显著优于基线方法，为因果推断中的缺失数据问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: Where Privacy Belongs: Placement Diagnosis and Certified Selection for Private Counterfactual Explanations on Graphs
summary: Counterfactual explanations for graph neural networks (GNNs) find the minimal intervention that flips a node's prediction--but computing one requires reading sensitive graph structure, and releasing it discloses that structure. Both existing placements fail. Privatizing the graph before explaining corrupts the target on exactly the borderline nodes needing recourse, manufacturing spurious flips that flip the privatized graph but not the true one. Explaining on the clean graph and perturbing the released explanation resists certification: re-auditing the standard heuristic shows an implied full-release budget of 573--753 on Cora and 256 on CiteSeer--orders of magnitude beyond its advertised budget--with worst-case single-entry leakage at AUC 1.0. We propose PrivCFS, which replaces certification-by-optimization with certification-by-construction: counterfactual selection over a fixed, data-independent candidate universe--edge interventions from a public prior graph, feature interventions from a public schema--whose no-op semantics give neighboring graphs the same output support. A validity-gated, clipped utility of global sensitivity $Δu \le 1$ released through the exponential mechanism gives pure $\varepsilon$-DP for the complete released object, composable over queries--to our knowledge the first such guarantee on graphs. Privacy noise is the cheapest stage: at $\varepsilon$=8 the release retains 94--97% of its support-restricted non-private optimum on the recourse population and 83--95% on the general one; the optimal edge-inference audit attains AUC 0.50 on average and 0.59 worst-pair, versus the heuristic's worst entry 1.0; and transfers to a 15K-node graph at 0.96 valid rate. The dominant cost is a measurable, monotone price in public disclosure, readable off one table before any budget is spent--turning explanation privacy from an accounting risk into a purchasable decision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrivCFS，一种为图神经网络（GNN）反事实解释提供纯ε-差分隐私保护的新方法。现有方法要么在解释前私有化图结构（导致边界节点解释失效），要么在解释后扰动结果（无法通过认证，实际隐私预算远超宣称值）。PrivCFS采用「构造式认证」：在固定的、与数据无关的候选宇宙（公共先验图的边干预、公共模式的特征干预）上进行反事实选择，利用无操作语义使邻居图具有相同输出支撑，配合有效性门控、裁剪的全局敏感度Δu≤1的效用函数，通过指数机制释放，实现完整释放对象的纯ε-DP且可组合。实验显示ε=8时保留94-97%（求助人群）和83-95%（一般人群）的非私有最优性能，边推断审计AUC仅0.50（平均）/0.59（最坏），远优于启发式方法的1.0；在15K节点图上迁移有效率0.96。主要代价是可量化、单调的公开披露成本，可在消耗预算前通过一张表读取，将解释隐私从核算风险转为可购买决策。
AI.motivation: GNN反事实解释需要读取敏感图结构，释放解释会泄露结构。现有两种部署方式均失败：1）先私有化图再解释，会在恰好需要补救的边界节点上制造虚假翻转，导致私有化图上的翻转在真实图上不成立；2）先在干净图上解释再扰动释放，无法通过认证——标准启发式方法的隐含全释放预算在Cora上达573-753、CiteSeer上达256，比宣称预算高数量级，最坏单条目泄露AUC达1.0。
AI.method: 提出PrivCFS，采用「构造式认证」而非「优化式认证」：在固定的、与数据无关的候选宇宙上进行反事实选择——边干预来自公共先验图，特征干预来自公共模式。这种无操作语义保证邻居图具有相同输出支撑。设计有效性门控、裁剪的效用函数，全局敏感度Δu≤1，通过指数机制释放，实现完整释放对象的纯ε-DP，且可跨查询组合。据作者所知，这是图上首个此类保证。
AI.result: ε=8时：在求助人群上保留94-97%、一般人群上保留83-95%的支撑受限非私有最优值；最优边推断审计平均AUC 0.50、最坏对AUC 0.59（启发式方法最坏单条目1.0）；在15K节点图上迁移有效率0.96。隐私噪声是最廉价阶段；主要代价是可量化、单调的公开披露成本，可在消耗预算前通过一张表读取。
AI.conclusion: PrivCFS通过构造式认证实现了GNN反事实解释的首个纯ε-DP且可组合的完整释放保证。隐私成本极低，主要代价转化为可预先评估的公开披露成本，将解释隐私从难以核算的风险转变为可量化、可购买的决策。

title: LEMON-ZEST: Evolution-Informed Tokenization for Efficient Protein Language Modeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
summary: Protein Language Models (PLMs) have made remarkable progress following scaling laws established in natural language processing across sequence- and structure-based tasks, yet the potential of tokenization remains underexploited. Unlike human language, proteins preserve structure despite extensive sequence variation a property standard tokenization strategies fundamentally fail to capture. We introduce ZEST (Zoned Encoding of Sequence Traits), an evolution-informed vocabulary derived from conserved regions of multiple sequence alignments. ZEST allows embedding domain-level biological priors directly at the tokenization stage rather than learning them implicitly through scale. ZEST natively compresses sequences to an average token length of 4 residues, enabling our model to process 4,000 residues within a standard 1024-token context window. Building on this, we present LEMON (Layered Extraction of Molecular Ordering from Nature), a compact 200M-parameter sequence-based model for detection of remote homology between protein sequences trained on a single H100 GPU for one week. Despite its modest size, LEMON outperforms state-of-the-art models ranging from 600M to 3B parameters. Our results demonstrate that evolution-informed tokenization can substitute for massive parameter scaling, opening a new direction for efficient, biologically-grounded protein representation learning. All code, model weights, and results are publicly available under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ZEST 进化信息化分词器与轻量级蛋白语言模型 LEMON，通过在分词阶段引入进化守恒区域先验，实现序列压缩与远程同源检测性能的显著提升，仅用 2 亿参数即超越 6 亿至 30 亿参数的 SOTA 模型。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白语言模型虽遵循缩放定律，但标准分词策略无法捕捉蛋白质序列高度变异下结构保守的特性，导致生物学先验需依赖海量参数隐式学习，亟需一种能在分词层面显式编码进化信息的方法。
AI.method: 1. 构建 ZEST 分词器：从多序列比对（MSA）的守恒区域提取进化信息词表，将域级生物学先验直接嵌入分词阶段，实现平均 4 个残基/token 的压缩率；2. 训练 LEMON 模型：基于 ZEST 分词的 2 亿参数序列模型，单张 H100 训练一周，用于远程同源检测任务。
AI.result: LEMON 在远程同源检测基准上超越 6 亿至 30 亿参数的现有最佳模型，且能在标准 1024 token 上下文窗口内处理 4000 残基长序列，验证了进化信息化分词可替代大规模参数堆砌。
AI.conclusion: 进化信息化分词（ZEST）能将生物学先验显式注入表示学习的最底层，大幅降低模型参数量与计算成本，为高效、生物学 grounding 的蛋白质表征学习开辟新范式。

title: GARDiff: Graph-Aligned Residual Diffusion for Probabilistic Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Diffusion models have recently shown strong potential for probabilistic multivariate time-series forecasting by modeling complex conditional distributions. Recent decoupled diffusion frameworks further separate forecasting into deterministic prediction and stochastic residual generation, making it natural to derive dependency graphs from deterministic representations and use them to guide residual diffusion. However, we show that this direct structural transfer is unreliable. Although deterministic-derived graphs encode useful global dependency priors, they exhibit substantial edge-level misalignment with residual dependency structures, introducing inaccurate or redundant conditions during residual generation. This reveals a previously overlooked deterministic-to-residual structural alignment problem in decoupled diffusion forecasting. To address this problem, we propose GARDiff, a Graph-Aligned Residual Diffusion framework for probabilistic multivariate time-series forecasting. Instead of treating deterministic-derived graphs as fixed diffusion conditions, GARDiff progressively adapts them to residual generation. Specifically, GARDiff estimates residual uncertainty to distinguish high- and low-uncertainty regions, enabling uncertainty-aware structural refinement, and further performs timestep-aware edge sparsification during reverse diffusion to evolve graph conditions from broad dependency aggregation to localized residual refinement. Extensive experiments on six real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GARDiff consistently improves probabilistic forecasting performance and uncertainty calibration over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文指出解耦扩散预测中确定性图与残差依赖结构的边级错位问题，提出 GARDiff 框架，通过不确定性感知的结构细化和时间步感知的边稀疏化，自适应地将确定性图对齐到残差生成，显著提升概率预测性能和不确定性校准。
AI.motivation: 解耦扩散框架将预测分为确定性预测和随机残差生成，自然想从确定性表示导出依赖图指导残差扩散。但研究发现，确定性图虽包含全局依赖先验，与残差依赖结构在边级存在显著错位，引入不准确或冗余条件，揭示了确定性到残差的结构对齐问题。
AI.method: 提出 GARDiff（图对齐残差扩散）框架：1) 估计残差不确定性，区分高/低不确定性区域，实现不确定性感知的结构细化；2) 反向扩散过程中进行时间步感知的边稀疏化，使图条件从广泛依赖聚合逐步演变为局部残差细化，而非将确定性图作为固定条件。
AI.result: 在六个真实世界基准上进行广泛实验，GARDiff 持续优于强基线，显著提升概率预测性能和不确定性校准质量。
AI.conclusion: GARDiff 通过自适应对齐确定性图到残差生成，解决了解耦扩散预测中被忽视的结构对齐问题，为概率多变量时间序列预测提供了更有效的图引导残差扩散范式。

title: Width Expansion as a Method for Class Incremental Learning
summary: Class Incremental Learning (Class-IL) requires models to learn new classes over time while preserving previously acquired knowledge without access to past data or task identity. This setting intensifies the stability-plasticity dilemma and makes catastrophic forgetting a central challenge. Existing approaches include regularization, knowledge distillation, replay, and architectural expansion. However, many expansion methods rely on explicit task identifiers or predefined growth strategies, limiting their applicability when task boundaries are unavailable at inference time. This work proposes a dynamic width expansion method that increases the number of neurons within existing layers according to a normalized loss criterion, without requiring task-specific information. An attention mechanism with persistent key-value memory is also incorporated to stabilize feature representations and reduce interference between previously learned and newly introduced classes. The approach is evaluated on Split MNIST and Split CIFAR-100 under the standard Class-IL protocol. Experiments compare fixed-capacity and dynamically expanding architectures, both with and without attention, combined with established continual learning methods including EWC, LwF, and A-GEM. Results show that progressive width expansion consistently improves performance over fixed architectures, particularly when combined with functional methods and A-GEM. The combination of width expansion and attention provides the most consistent gains. Overall, dynamic width expansion based on representational demand provides an effective and flexible strategy for Class-IL, although uncontrolled growth may increase overfitting and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种动态宽度扩展方法，根据归一化损失准则增加现有层神经元数量，无需任务特定信息；并引入带持久键值记忆的注意力机制以稳定特征表示、减少新旧类别干扰。在Split MNIST和Split CIFAR-100上实验表明，渐进式宽度扩展持续优于固定架构，结合功能性方法及A-GEM效果最佳；宽度扩展与注意力结合带来最稳健提升。但无控制的增长可能增加过拟合和计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有扩展方法依赖显式任务标识或预定义增长策略，在推理时无任务边界信息下适用性受限。Class-IL 面临稳定-塑性困境和灾难性遗忘，需要一种无需任务特定信息、能根据表征需求动态调整网络容量的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于归一化损失准则的动态宽度扩展，在现有层中增加神经元；引入带持久键值记忆的注意力机制以稳定特征表示、降低新旧类别干扰。在标准 Class-IL 协议下，对比固定容量与动态扩展架构，分别结合 EWC、LwF、A-GEM 等持续学习方法进行实验。
AI.result: 渐进式宽度扩展在所有设置中均持续优于固定架构，尤其与功能性方法和 A-GEM 结合时提升显著；宽度扩展与注意力机制结合提供最稳健的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 基于表征需求的动态宽度扩展是一种有效且灵活的 Class-IL 策略，但无约束的增长可能导致过拟合和计算成本增加。

title: Volatility-Clustering Adaptation for Financial Time Series
summary: Time-series foundation models are increasingly adapted to new domains through fine-tuning on target data, under the implicit assumption that more target data yields better forecasts. We show that this assumption can fail in financial forecasting, where individual price changes are difficult to predict, but large moves tend to cluster, creating alternating calm and turbulent periods. Using financial foundation models trained on price bars of open, high, low, close, and volume, we argue that adapting to financial domains requires training signals beyond next-token prediction. We introduce Volatility-Clustering Adaptation (VCA), which augments next-token cross-entropy with a differentiable penalty on the autocorrelation of squared returns, the standard statistical signature of volatility clustering. This additional objective provides a multi-step training signal by matching the resulting dependence structure of autoregressive rollouts to those of the realized future. Across three asset sets and two evaluation conventions, VCA improves adaptation over the pre-trained model, with the strongest gains under the primary evaluation (\textsc{fore}), driven primarily by reduced variance error. Overall, our results suggest that effective financial adaptation requires objectives that capture domain-specific temporal structure beyond token-level prediction.

AI.tldr: 论文指出在金融预测中，标准的下一步预测微调可能失效，因为金融数据具有波动率聚类特性。作者提出Volatility-Clustering Adaptation (VCA)，通过增加对平方收益率自相关性的可微惩罚项，捕捉领域特定的时序结构，在多个资产集和评估标准下显著提升了适配性能，主要通过降低方差误差实现。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型通常假设更多目标数据能带来更好的预测，但这一假设在金融预测中可能失效。单个价格变动难以预测，但大幅波动倾向于聚集，形成交替的平静和动荡期。标准的下一token预测目标无法捕捉这种波动率聚类这一金融领域特有的时序依赖结构。
AI.method: 提出Volatility-Clustering Adaptation (VCA)方法：在标准的下一token交叉熵损失基础上，增加一个可微分的惩罚项，惩罚平方收益率的自相关性——这是波动率聚类的标准统计特征。这一额外目标通过使自回归生成序列的依赖结构与真实未来序列的依赖结构相匹配，提供了多步训练信号。
AI.result: 在三个资产集合和两种评估惯例下，VCA均优于预训练模型的直接适配。主要评估指标(FORE)下增益最强，性能提升主要归因于方差误差的降低，而非偏差误差的减少。
AI.conclusion: 有效的金融领域适配需要超越token级预测的目标函数，必须显式捕捉领域特定的时序结构（如波动率聚类）。单纯增加目标数据并不能保证更好的预测，适配目标的设计至关重要。

title: Weights Read and Write Features: Scalable Parameter Decomposition Grounded in Activation Space
summary: Activation space and parameter space provide complementary views of model computation. Activations represent information, while weights read, transform, and write that information. Yet existing interpretability methods largely study the two spaces separately, leaving the connection between represented information and parameter-level computation underexplored. We introduce Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition (ASPD), which jointly decomposes activation and parameter spaces and grounds each learned weight component in the activation features it reads or writes. This grounding constrains otherwise non-unique parameter decompositions using the model's internal activations, while an internal reconstruction objective provides a local learning signal at the weight matrix being analyzed. Together, these properties enable scalable, interpretable, and causally editable parameter decomposition in pretrained large language models, demonstrated on Qwen-3-8B. The learned read--write components can also be composed into parameter-level mechanism circuits. We use ASPD to recover mechanisms underlying the classic IOI circuit and trace semantic transformations through model weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出激活支持参数分解（ASPD），联合分解激活空间和参数空间，将每个权重组件锚定在其读取或写入的激活特征上，实现了可解释且可因果编辑的参数分解，并在Qwen-3-8B上验证，成功恢复IOI电路机制并追踪语义变换。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法大多分别研究激活空间和参数空间，导致表示信息与参数级计算之间的联系未被充分探索。激活代表信息，权重读取、变换和写入信息，两者提供互补视角，但缺乏联合分析框架。
AI.method: ASPD联合分解激活与参数空间，利用模型内部激活约束原本非唯一的参数分解，并引入内部重建目标在被分析的权重矩阵上提供局部学习信号，将每个权重组件锚定在其读取或写入的激活特征上。
AI.result: 在Qwen-3-8B上展示了可扩展、可解释且可因果编辑的参数分解。学习到的读写组件可组合为参数级机制电路，成功恢复经典IOI电路机制，并能追踪模型权重中的语义变换过程。
AI.conclusion: ASPD架起了激活空间与参数空间的桥梁，为理解权重如何处理激活中表示的信息提供了统一框架，使预训练大语言模型中的因果编辑和机制发现成为可能。

title: HyDI: A hybrid Deep Learning-Inductive Logic Programming ensemble for multi-label classification
comment: Accepted at IJCLR26 (6th International Joint Conference on Learning & Reasoning, 16-18 September 2026)
summary: While attaining remarkable results for many applications, Deep Learning models are notoriously difficult to explain. This work introduces HyDI, a hybrid ensemble architecture for hierarchical multi-label classification. It combines a Deep Learning (DL) model with rule-based classifiers generated by Inductive Logic Programming (ILP). For leaf classes of the label hierarchy, the rule-based classifiers replace the DL model, leading to more transparent classification results. HyDI is applied to the Chemical Entities of Biological Interest (ChEBI) ontology, providing ILP-generated rules for 314 classes. For these classes, HyDI can generate global explanations as well as local explanations that combine visual and text-based descriptions.

AI.tldr: HyDI 是一种用于层次化多标签分类的混合集成架构，结合深度学习模型与基于归纳逻辑编程（ILP）的规则分类器，替换叶类别的深度学习模型以提高可解释性，应用于 ChEBI 本体，为 314 个类别生成 ILP 规则，提供全局和局部解释。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在许多应用中取得显著成果，但因难以解释而备受诟病，尤其在层次化多标签分类任务中需要透明的分类结果。
AI.method: 提出 HyDI 混合集成架构，融合深度学习模型与基于归纳逻辑编程（ILP）生成的规则分类器；针对标签层次结构中的叶类别，用规则分类器替代深度学习模型，以实现更透明的分类。
AI.result: 在化学实体生物兴趣（ChEBI）本体上应用，为 314 个类别生成 ILP 规则；HyDI 能为这些类别提供全局解释及结合视觉与文本描述的局部解释。
AI.conclusion: HyDI 通过引入基于 ILP 的规则分类器替代叶节点的深度学习模型，有效提升了层次化多标签分类的可解释性，同时保持分类性能，为本体驱动的科学分类任务提供了可解释的解决方案。

title: Optimizer-dependent training dynamics converge to the same one-third optimal data scaling
summary: Neural scaling, in which loss falls as a power law with training, is central to large language models, and one recent proposal is that a $1/3$ exponent emerges from learning peaked distributions. That account describes SGD, but models in practice are trained with adaptive optimizers. Here we separate two exponents the $1/3$ account does not distinguish: how fast the loss falls with training steps along a single run, and how fast the optimally tuned loss falls with dataset size $D$. We show that the first, a dynamic exponent, is optimizer-specific while the second, an optimal data exponent, converges to $1/3$ across optimizers. In an online teacher-student model we decompose the loss into norm growth (radial) and alignment toward the teacher direction (tangential), each decaying as a power law with dynamic exponents $α_{r}$ and $α_{t}$. Under SGD, both are close to $1/3$, so the data exponent is also $1/3$ across different learning rates. Under Adam the two separate: $α_{r} \simeq 0.48$ but $α_{t} \simeq 0.08$. Since the total loss is minimized when these two parts are balanced, the optimal learning rate is optimizer-dependent: $D$-independent for SGD but falls with $D$ for Adam. Yet tuned to that optimum, the loss returns to $D^{-1/3}$ for both. A stochastic-dynamics analysis explains why: the optimizers can trade decay speed between the two channels, but they all fall on a single dynamic exponent relation, $2α_{r}+ α_{t} = 1$, which fixes the optimal data exponent at $1/3$. Across seven optimizers, including Muon, the measured exponents are consistent with this relation, and the optimal-loss envelopes agree with $D^{-1/3}$ across them. The optimizer sets how fast a model learns per step; tuned optimally, it changes the prefactor but not the rate at which loss falls per sample.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大语言模型中神经缩放定律的优化器依赖性，区分动态指数（单次运行中损失随训练步数下降的速度）和最优数据指数（最优调参损失随数据集大小D下降的速度）。发现动态指数依赖优化器，但最优数据指数在各优化器中均收敛至1/3。通过在线师生模型将损失分解为径向和切向两部分，揭示优化器可在两个通道间权衡衰减速度，但满足统一关系式2α_r + α_t = 1，从而固定最优数据指数为1/3。
AI.motivation: 现有神经缩放定律理论主要基于SGD提出1/3指数源于学习尖峰分布，但实际大模型训练普遍使用自适应优化器。需要区分动态指数与最优数据指数，理解不同优化器如何影响缩放行为，以及为何最优调参后的损失仍遵循D^(-1/3)定律。
AI.method: 采用在线师生模型框架，将损失分解为范数增长（径向部分）和对齐教师方向（切向部分）两个独立通道，各自按幂律衰减并具有动态指数α_r和α_t。结合随机动力学分析，推导出优化器无关的动态指数关系式。在七种优化器（含SGD、Adam、Muon等）上实验验证，测量不同数据集大小下的最优损失包络线。
AI.result: SGD下α_r和α_t均接近1/3，最优学习率与D无关；Adam下两者分离（α_r≃0.48, α_t≃0.08），最优学习率随D下降。但调整至最优学习率后，所有优化器的最优损失均遵循D^(-1/3)。实测七种优化器的指数满足2α_r + α_t = 1关系，最优损失包络线一致收敛于1/3指数。优化器决定单步学习速度，最优调参后仅改变前因子而不改变单样本损失下降率。
AI.conclusion: 神经缩放定律中的1/3最优数据指数是优化器不变量，源于径向与切向学习动态的根本约束关系。优化器选择影响训练动态（动态指数）和最优超参数设置，但不改变数据利用效率的基本缩放规律。这为大模型训练中的优化器选择和超参数调优提供了理论指导。

title: Predictive Self-Supervised Learning Provably Identifies Stochastic Signals under Nuisance
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) by predicting in latent space, without generating the input data itself, learns highly abstract, useful representations. Intuitively, this success is often attributed to its ability to discard nuisance information that is irrelevant to prediction. However, this poses a conundrum: both stochastic variation in a prediction-relevant latent signal and true nuisance make observations partly unpredictable; how could they be distinguished? Surprisingly, we prove that common SSL methods can achieve exactly this, by implicitly instantiating a latent-variable model with stochastic dynamics and observation-private nuisance. We trace their ability to recover the stochastic signal to two complementary principles: Predictive mutual information maximization ensures that representations retain the information needed for prediction, while latent distribution matching constrains how this information is encoded, thereby making the retained signal identifiable. We confirm this identifiability result in simulations for Gaussian predictors, which recover the true signal up to an affine transformation even in dynamic, nuisance-laden environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了自监督学习（SSL）在潜在空间预测时，能够通过隐式构建带有随机动力学和观测私有噪声的潜变量模型，区分预测相关的随机信号与真正的干扰信息。核心机制在于预测互信息最大化保留预测所需信息，潜在分布匹配约束编码方式，使保留信号可识别。仿真实验验证高斯预测器能在动态、含干扰环境中将真实信号恢复至仿射变换等价。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习通过在潜在空间预测而非重构输入数据，学习到高度抽象且有用的表示。直观上认为其成功源于丢弃与预测无关的干扰信息，但存在困境：预测相关潜在信号的随机变化与真正的干扰都会使观测部分不可预测，二者如何被区分？
AI.method: 理论分析证明常见SSL方法隐式实例化了一个带随机动力学和观测私有干扰的潜变量模型。识别出两个互补原则：预测互信息最大化确保表示保留预测所需信息；潜在分布匹配约束信息编码方式，使保留信号可识别。在高斯预测器设定下进行仿真验证。
AI.result: 理论证明SSL能区分随机信号与干扰，实现信号可识别性。仿真实验中，高斯预测器在动态、含干扰环境下将真实信号恢复至仿射变换等价。
AI.conclusion: SSL通过预测互信息最大化与潜在分布匹配的结合，隐式构建潜变量模型，成功分离预测相关随机信号与观测私有干扰，实现了信号的可识别恢复，为SSL的表示学习机制提供了理论解释。

title: Challenges and Solutions for Bandits in the Wild: Warm-Started Mixture Bandits for Cross-Cohort Slate Recommendation
summary: Many recommender services repeatedly encounter cold-start cohorts, where new users arrive with little or no interaction history. This creates two challenges: learning user preferences quickly from limited feedback and sustaining useful recommendations when each user has a finite catalog that can become repetitive or depleted over time. We propose CohortMix-TS, a warm-started mixture bandit that learns latent user groups from earlier cohorts and uses available metadata to construct group-informed priors for new users. Starting from these fixed priors, the model personalizes independently as feedback from each user becomes available. Session slates combine Thompson sampling with diversity and inventory-depletion controls. We evaluate CohortMix-TS through simulation, semi-synthetic experiments, and a 25-day randomized in-the-wild deployment with 713 registered participants in a Campus Games quiz application. Our evaluations show that cross-cohort transfer improves early recommendation quality and user-level regret, while inventory-aware slate construction helps prevent premature exhaustion of preferred items. In the field deployment, treatment users also showed a larger early-to-late change in correctness than users receiving random recommendations. Together, these results show how warm-start transfer and inventory-aware recommendations can support personalization for short-lived, repeatedly cold-starting cohorts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CohortMix-TS，一种预热混合多臂老虎机模型，利用历史队列学习潜在用户群，为新用户构建群组先验，结合Thompson采样、多样性及库存耗尽控制生成推荐列表。实验表明跨队列迁移提升早期推荐质量和用户遗憾，库存感知列表构建防止偏好项目过早耗尽，实际部署中处理组用户正确率提升显著。
AI.motivation: 推荐服务频繁面临冷启动队列，新用户缺乏交互历史，导致快速学习偏好和维持有用推荐困难，且用户有限目录可能随时间重复或耗尽。
AI.method: 提出CohortMix-TS：从早期队列学习潜在用户群，利用元数据构建群组先验作为新用户的固定先验；反馈到来时独立个性化；会话列表结合Thompson采样、多样性控制和库存耗尽控制。
AI.result: 仿真、半合成实验及25天真实部署（713参与者）显示：跨队列迁移改善早期推荐质量和用户级遗憾；库存感知列表构建防止偏好项目过早耗尽；实际部署中处理组用户早期到后期正确率变化大于随机推荐组。
AI.conclusion: 预热迁移和库存感知推荐能支持短生命周期、反复冷启动队列的个性化推荐。

title: Feedback-Calibrated Protein Optimization with Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration
summary: Protein optimization aims to discover high-fitness sequences under a limited experimental budget. Existing machine-learning methods use task-specific predictors, biological priors, or ranking-aware objectives to guide which variants are tested in the next experimental round. However, these methods cannot adapt to shifts in the reliability of predictive evidence as measurements accumulate and ensure the correct ranking of key high-fitness candidates. To address these challenges, we propose Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration (BATA), which uses experimental feedback to adaptively combine prior-informed and task-specific rankings for next-batch selection, with calibration focused on the batch-aligned high-fitness region. Across measured GB1, PABP, and TrpB landscapes, BATA achieves the best mean task rank (1.67) in final best fitness after 480 measurements. Controlled comparisons further show task-dependent gains from high-fitness calibration and batch alignment. Our work introduces feedback-calibrated predictor arbitration, where experimental feedback dynamically determines how predictive evidence guides next-batch selection, opening a new direction for protein optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为 Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration (BATA) 的蛋白质优化方法，利用实验反馈自适应结合先验知识和任务特定预测器的排名，专注于批次对齐的高适应度区域进行校准，在 GB1、PABP 和 TrpB 三个蛋白质景观上实现了最佳平均任务排名（1.67），展示了反馈校准预测器仲裁的新方向。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习蛋白质优化方法依赖任务特定预测器、生物学先验或排序感知目标来指导下一轮实验变体选择，但这些方法无法随着测量积累自适应调整预测证据的可靠性变化，也难以确保关键高适应度候选物的正确排序。
AI.method: 提出 Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration (BATA) 方法：利用实验反馈自适应地结合先验知识和任务特定预测器的排名，用于下一批次变体选择，并将校准重点放在批次对齐的高适应度尾部区域。
AI.result: 在 GB1、PABP 和 TrpB 三个实测蛋白质适应度景观上，BATA 在 480 次测量后实现了最佳平均任务排名（1.67）。受控对比实验进一步显示，高适应度校准和批次对齐带来的收益具有任务依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为蛋白质优化引入了反馈校准预测器仲裁框架，实验反馈动态决定预测证据如何指导下一批次选择，为蛋白质工程开辟了新的研究方向。

title: Privy to the Foil: Recasting Value Estimation with a Self-Privileged Critic for RLVR
summary: Assigning credit to intermediate steps remains a central challenge in training Large Language Models (LLMs) on multi-step reasoning tasks with sparse terminal rewards, and actor-critic methods such as PPO address this by learning value functions to construct token-level advantages. Their effectiveness, however, hinges on reliable value estimation, a difficult task requiring the critic to both assess progress toward a correct solution and anticipate an evolving policy's future behavior; errors in either can compromise credit assignment and destabilize online training. In this paper, we revisit the standard state-only formulation of value estimation and propose $π$PPO, a self-privileged actor-critic framework. By reusing verified same-prompt rollouts as contrastive evidence, $π$PPO helps the critic assess intermediate reasoning against successful and failed attempts, while preserving standard policy optimization and the deployment interface. Experiments show that $π$PPO consistently improves value-estimation quality by a substantial margin and outperforms representative actor-critic and critic-free RLVR baselines on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while remaining effective even when paired with substantially smaller asymmetric critics.

AI.tldr: 提出自特权 Actor-Critic 框架 πPPO，通过复用同一提示词下的已验证轨迹作为对比证据改进价值估计，显著提升多步推理任务中的信用分配效果，在数学推理基准上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 在稀疏终端奖励的多步推理任务中，为中间步骤分配信用是核心难题。Actor-Critic 方法（如 PPO）通过学习价值函数构建 Token 级优势来解决，但其有效性依赖于可靠的价值估计。价值估计要求 Critic 既能评估当前推理向正确解的进度，又能预测不断演化的策略未来行为，二者误差均会破坏信用分配并导致在线训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 πPPO，一种自特权 Actor-Critic 框架。重新审视标准的仅状态价值估计形式，利用同一提示词下已验证的成功与失败轨迹作为对比证据，帮助 Critic 对比评估中间推理步骤，同时保持标准策略优化流程和部署接口不变。
AI.result: 实验表明，πPPO 在价值估计质量上大幅提升，在具有挑战性的数学推理基准上持续优于代表性的 Actor-Critic 与无 Critic 的 RLVR 基线，且在搭配显著更小的非对称 Critic 时仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: πPPO 通过自特权对比机制有效缓解了价值估计的难题，实现了更稳健的信用分配，为大语言模型在多步推理任务上的强化学习训练提供了更可靠的 Actor-Critic 方案，且具备良好的扩展性与部署兼容性。

title: Behavioral Convergence Without Representational Convergence: Persistent Training-History Dependence in Neural Networks
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/Ertugrulmutlu/hysteresis-neural-networks
summary: Neural networks trained toward the same final objective can reach similar predictive performance while retaining internal representations shaped by earlier training history. We study this effect using controlled sequential-training experiments in which paired convolutional networks start from identical weights, experience reversed task orders, and then receive the same deterministic common-relaxation distribution. Across 20 paired MNIST runs, 16 satisfy a predeclared behavioral-matching criterion, yet their matched representations retain a mean history score of 0.139 (95% bootstrap CI: 0.127-0.153) and approximately 3.1% prediction disagreement. Extending common relaxation to 50,000 optimizer updates does not erase the measured difference: across five paired seeds, the representation-history score remains 0.190 (95% bootstrap CI: 0.161-0.219) at the end of the measured horizon while the mean accuracy gap is only 0.18 percentage points. Fresh linear probes show that, with sufficient labeled data, the two histories retain practically equivalent linearly accessible class information. A same-label rotated-MNIST control reproduces the effect: all five paired seeds reach behavioral matching while retaining a mean representation-history score of 0.162. Finally, a matched-learning-rate ReLU-LeakyReLU control reduces the 50,000-update representation residue by 0.040 on average in all five paired seeds, providing directional evidence that activation-mediated plasticity contributes to the persistence of training-history effects. These results provide protocol-scoped evidence that behavioral convergence need not imply representational convergence and that optimization history can leave measurable internal traces after prolonged common training.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究神经网络在相同最终目标下训练时，尽管预测性能相似，但内部表示仍保留早期训练历史的痕迹。通过受控的顺序训练实验（MNIST、旋转MNIST、ReLU-LeakyReLU 对照），发现行为收敛不意味着表示收敛，优化历史在长期共同训练后仍留下可测量的内部痕迹。
AI.motivation: 探究神经网络在相同最终任务上训练且达到相似预测性能时，是否还会保留早期训练历史（如任务顺序不同）对内部表示的影响，即行为收敛是否必然蕴含表示收敛。
AI.method: 采用配对卷积网络，从相同初始权重出发，经历相反的任务顺序（顺序训练），随后接受相同的确定性共同松弛分布。在 MNIST 上进行 20 对实验，并延伸至 5 万优化步；引入旋转 MNIST 对照实验；再用匹配学习率的 ReLU-LeakyReLU 对照实验探究激活函数介导的可塑性作用。使用预先声明的行为匹配准则、表示历史分数、预测分歧率、线性探针等指标量化差异。
AI.result: 20 对 MNIST 实验中 16 对满足行为匹配，但表示历史分数均值 0.139（95% CI: 0.127-0.153），预测分歧约 3.1%。延长至 5 万步后，5 对种子的历史分数仍为 0.190（95% CI: 0.161-0.219），准确率差距仅 0.18 个百分点。线性探针显示，足够标签数据下两类历史保留的线性可访问类别信息实质等价。旋转 MNIST 对照复现效果：5 对种子均行为匹配且历史分数均值 0.162。ReLU-LeakyReLU 对照在 5 对种子中平均将 5 万步表示残留降低 0.040，指示激活函数介导的可塑性导致历史效应持久化。
AI.conclusion: 在协议范围内，行为收敛不蕴含表示收敛；优化历史可在长期共同训练后仍在内部表示中留下可测量的痕迹，且激活函数选择影响这些痕迹的持久程度。

title: Counterfactual Probing for Parallel Unmasking with Hidden Forest Structure
summary: Masked generative models offer parallel token prediction, but accurate parallel sampling must account for dependencies among tokens. When dependencies are unknown, finding safe batches also costs model evaluations. We study whether total evaluations, including discovery, can be sublinear in sequence length $N$; sublinear sequential depth then follows. We consider discrete distributions with hidden forest structure, accessed through a fixed approximate conditional oracle. Under explicit regularity conditions and uniform Hellinger error bounds, for any fixed target accuracy $\varepsilon\in (0,1/8]$ and sufficiently large $N$, our sampler achieves seed-averaged total-variation error at most $\varepsilon$, with total masked-state submissions and sequential depth both bounded by $O(N^C \varepsilon^a)$ for constants $0 <C <1$ and $a > 0$. These guarantees use polynomial vocabulary size and an edge-response lower bound set by $N$ and $\varepsilon$. The sampler shares evaluations of hypothetical reveals across dependence tests to identify safe parallel batches without requiring full recovery of the hidden forest. A tunable parameter trades probing cost against irreversible commit rounds. In the same class, any admissible irreversible product-commit sampler attaining the same seed-averaged accuracy requires $Ω(N^c \varepsilon^b)$ counterfactual submissions or commit rounds in the worst case, for constants $c,b>0$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究掩码生成模型中的并行采样问题，证明了在隐藏森林结构的离散分布下，通过共享假设性揭示的评估来识别安全并行批次，可以在亚线性总评估次数和顺序深度下达到目标精度，同时给出了匹配的下界。
AI.motivation: 掩码生成模型支持并行token预测，但准确的并行采样必须考虑token间的依赖关系。当依赖关系未知时，发现安全批次也需要模型评估。核心问题是：包括发现依赖在内的总评估次数能否在序列长度N上达到亚线性？若能，则顺序深度也随之亚线性。
AI.method: 考虑具有隐藏森林结构的离散分布，通过固定的近似条件预言机访问。在显式正则性条件和均匀Hellinger误差界下，设计采样器：共享假设性揭示的评估来进行依赖测试，识别安全并行批次，而无需完全恢复隐藏森林。引入可调参数权衡探测成本与不可逆提交轮数。
AI.result: 对于任意固定目标精度ε∈(0,1/8]和足够大的N，采样器实现种子平均全变差误差≤ε，总掩码状态提交次数和顺序深度均上界为O(N^C ε^a)，其中0<C<1，a>0。保证使用多项式词汇量和由N、ε决定的边响应下界。同类中，任何可接受的不可逆乘积提交采样器达到相同种子平均精度，最坏情况下需要Ω(N^c ε^b)次反事实提交或提交轮数，c,b>0。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了隐藏森林结构下并行采样的上下界，证明了亚线性总评估和顺序深度的可行性，并揭示了探测成本与提交轮数的权衡。结果为掩码生成模型的高效并行采样提供了理论基础。

title: Scaling Influence Functions in LLMs through Eigenbasis-Corrected One-Bit Gradient Projection
summary: Influence functions estimate how individual training examples affect the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Analyzing how training data influence different behaviors of an LLM involves repeated influence computation. Reusing stored training gradients reduces the computational cost, but storing full gradients is prohibitively expensive at LLM scale. We study how to compress these gradients while preserving influence estimates for future queries that are unknown at storage time. Through a worst-case analysis, we characterize the optimal fixed-dimensional linear representation and propose eigenbasis-corrected one-bit gradient projection (EOGP) to approximate it at scale. Specifically, EOGP uses EK-FAC to reduce gradient dimensionality, then applies PCA within the retained subspace to learn compression directions from the training gradients. We then apply one-bit quantization to the resulting coordinates, allowing more coordinates to be retained within a fixed storage budget. On GPT-2, EOGP predicts retraining outcomes more accurately than the evaluated compression baselines while using one-sixteenth of their per-example storage. On OLMo 2 SFT models from 1B to 32B parameters, EOGP remains competitive with the baselines allocated over 100 times as much storage per example.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为EOGP（特征基修正单比特梯度投影）的方法，用于在大型语言模型（LLM）规模下压缩训练梯度，以保留影响函数估计的准确性，同时大幅降低存储开销。
AI.motivation: 影响函数需要反复计算训练样本对模型行为的影响，存储完整梯度在LLM规模下成本过高。现有压缩方法在未知未来查询时难以保持影响估计的准确性，因此需要一种在固定存储预算下保留影响估计质量的压缩方案。
AI.method: EOGP首先使用EK-FAC（经验克罗内克因子近似）降低梯度维度，然后在保留子空间内应用PCA从训练梯度中学习压缩方向，最后对坐标进行单比特量化，从而在固定存储预算下保留更多坐标。
AI.result: 在GPT-2上，EOGP以其他基线1/16的单样本存储量，更准确地预测重训练结果；在OLMo 2 SFT模型（1B到32B参数）上，EOGP与分配超过100倍存储的基线保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: EOGP通过特征基修正和单比特量化实现了高效的梯度压缩，在大幅降低存储成本的同时保持了影响函数估计的准确性，为大规模LLM的影响分析提供了可行方案。

title: Delta-Matching: Closing the Final Gap of Native 8-bit Training for LLMs
summary: Reliable FP8 attention remains a barrier to fully native 8-bit large language model training. We derive how forward-backward inconsistencies produce stale delta and empirically show how it distorts training dynamics. Our stale-delta hybrid runs show a modest loss gap at 569M parameters but substantial loss increases and downstream degradation at 1.67B and 5.29B. QK normalization, NoPE (no positional encoding), and lower-learning-rate context extension mitigate or delay degradation without eliminating it. This pattern suggests accumulated optimization error that smaller models and short runs can conceal. We propose Delta-Matching, proving that it restores the softmax gradient's zero-row-sum invariant under the stated numerical assumptions. It enables native block-scaled FP8 in every forward and backward attention-core matmul without architectural changes, smaller global batches, or auxiliary forward outputs. Across tested architectures, scales, and training stages, Delta-Matching matches BF16/FP32 mixed-precision training loss and overall downstream performance. We will release our implementation, trained models, and data recipes.

AI.tldr: 论文针对 FP8 注意力机制在大语言模型全原生 8 位训练中的可靠性问题，揭示了前向-反向不一致导致的陈旧增量现象，并提出 Delta-Matching 方法，恢复 softmax 梯度的零行和不变量，实现无架构修改、无额外开销的原生块缩放 FP8 注意力训练，在多种规模和架构上达到 BF16/FP32 混合精度的训练损失和下游性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 FP8 注意力训练存在前向与反向传播的数值不一致，导致梯度更新使用陈旧增量，随着模型规模扩大（1.67B、5.29B）和训练步数增加，累积优化误差显著恶化损失和下游任务表现；现有缓解手段（QK 归一化、NoPE、低学习率上下文扩展）仅能延缓而无法消除退化。
AI.method: 提出 Delta-Matching 算法：在数值假设下证明可恢复 softmax 梯度的零行和不变量，通过在注意力核心矩阵乘法的前向与反向传播中匹配增量，实现原生块缩放 FP8 计算，无需架构变更、减小全局批次或额外前向输出。
AI.result: 在 569M 到 5.29B 参数规模、不同架构和训练阶段的实验中，Delta-Matching 的训练损失与 BF16/FP32 混合精度基线持平，下游任务整体性能相当，且无需辅助技术即可稳定训练。
AI.conclusion: Delta-Matching 解决了 FP8 注意力训练的核心数值不稳定性，使全原生 8 位大语言模型训练成为可行且高效的选择，代码、模型与数据配方将开源。

title: Strict-Saddle Landscapes and Multi-Rank Geometry in Low-Tubal-Rank Tensor Sensing
summary: We study the optimization landscape of low-tubal-rank tensor sensing through a balanced factorization. Under a tubal restricted isometry condition, we establish a quantitative strict-saddle landscape with no spurious local minima for arbitrary Fourier multi-rank profiles. We further show that the local geometry depends on the Fourier-slice ranks rather than the tubal rank alone. Uniform ranks yield quadratic growth transverse to the solution orbit, whereas nonuniform ranks produce quartically flat directions through hidden frequency-wise overparameterization, even when the factor width equals the exact tubal rank. Numerical experiments illustrate the global optimization behavior and the contrasting local geometries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究低秩张量感知的优化景观，通过平衡因子分解，在管秩限制等距条件下建立了无虚假局部极小值的定量严格鞍点景观，揭示局部几何取决于傅里叶切片秩而非仅管秩，均匀秩产生二次增长，非均匀秩产生四次平坦方向。
AI.motivation: 理解低管秩张量感知中非凸优化问题的全局优化行为，特别是平衡因子分解下的优化景观性质，以及不同傅里叶多秩分布对局部几何的影响。
AI.method: 采用平衡因子分解参数化低管秩张量，在管限制等距性条件下分析优化景观，建立严格鞍点性质，通过理论分析揭示傅里叶切片秩对局部几何的决定性作用。
AI.result: 证明了任意傅里叶多秩分布下均无虚假局部极小值的定量严格鞍点景观；局部几何由傅里叶切片秩决定：均匀秩在解轨道横向呈二次增长，非均匀秩因隐藏的频域过参数化产生四次平坦方向，即使因子宽度等于精确管秩。数值实验验证了全局优化行为及对比几何。
AI.conclusion: 低管秩张量感知的优化景观良性，但局部几何受傅里叶切片秩分布强烈影响，非均匀秩引入的四次平坦方向可能减缓收敛，为张量感知算法设计提供理论指导。}

title: TopoEmbedX: A General Framework for Representation Learning on Topological Domains
summary: Topological structures such as simplicial complexes, hypergraphs, and cell complexes extend standard graph models by modeling higher-order relationships. These structures appear in many modern datasets and require specialized methods for generating meaningful embeddings. In this paper, we introduce TopoEmbedX, a unified framework for embedding a wide range of topological domains into Euclidean spaces. The package brings together several existing topological embedding algorithms---DeepCell, Cell2Vec, CellDiff2Vec, HOLE, and HOGLEE---and introduces five new algorithms: ComplexNetMF, ComplexRep, ComplexRandNE, ComplexWalklets, and ComplexHeat. These algorithms extend well-known graph embedding techniques to higher-order settings using the augmented Hasse graph of a topological domain. TopoEmbedX provides a clear, consistent, and easy-to-use framework for topological representation learning. Experiments show that the embeddings generated by TopoEmbedX support tasks such as classification and regression across multidimensional data.

AI.tldr: TopoEmbedX 是一个统一框架，用于将单纯复形、超图、细胞复形等拓扑域嵌入欧几里得空间，整合了现有拓扑嵌入算法并提出五个新算法，利用增广 Hasse 图将图嵌入技术推广到高阶设置，实验表明生成的嵌入支持多维数据的分类和回归任务。
AI.motivation: 现有图嵌入方法难以直接处理高阶关系，单纯复形、超图、细胞复形等拓扑结构在现代数据集中普遍存在，需要专门的嵌入方法来捕捉高阶拓扑信息。
AI.method: 提出 TopoEmbedX 框架，整合 DeepCell、Cell2Vec、CellDiff2Vec、HOLE、HOGLEE 等现有算法，并新增 ComplexNetMF、ComplexRep、ComplexRandNE、ComplexWalklets、ComplexHeat 五个算法；利用拓扑域的增广 Hasse 图将经典图嵌入技术（如矩阵分解、随机游走、热核等）扩展到高阶设置。
AI.result: 实验表明 TopoEmbedX 生成的嵌入在多维数据上的分类和回归任务中表现良好，框架提供了清晰、一致且易用的拓扑表示学习接口。
AI.conclusion: TopoEmbedX 为拓扑域嵌入提供了统一且可扩展的工具箱，有效连接了图嵌入技术与高阶拓扑结构，为后续拓扑数据分析和表示学习奠定了基础。

title: Behavioral Capacity Certificates for Quantized Language Models
summary: Activation and key-value cache precision change what a quantized language model computes without altering its stored weights. Direct weight-code bounds, however, assign identical complexity to deployments that behave differently and charge separately for weight codes that behave identically. Behavioral Capacity Certificates (BCC) charge for behavior using the aggregate prior mass of complete implementations---weights, scales, activation and cache rules---that induce the same bounded loss. When quantization merges implementations, this shared mass lowers the complexity penalty, and a break-even law determines when the saving survives the cost of validating it. BCC supports a three-step deployment workflow, and our experiments verify each step. First, a forward-only screen shortlists per-layer bit-widths by how often candidate perturbations preserve the reference predictions, with quality comparable to Hessian-guided selection at lower preprocessing cost. Second, margin-certified cells identify weights that can be pruned or sign-flipped without changing the deployed behavior: every permitted combination preserves all declared predictions, and on OLMoE-1B-7B and SmolLM2-1.7B, independent probes bound the probability that any permitted combination changes a prediction on new text. Third, BCC bounds the population loss of the deployed model, nonvacuously for complete decoders and more tightly than the compressed-code route. At equal cache memory, giving keys higher precision than values yields lower NLL and higher prediction agreement on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and SmolLM2, together with a tighter complexity bound in the GPT-2 audit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出行为容量证书（BCC）框架，用于量化语言模型的部署评估。BCC 通过聚合先验质量衡量实现相同有界损失的完整实现（权重、缩放、激活与缓存规则）的复杂度，解决了传统权重代码界无法区分行为差异的问题。实验验证了三步部署工作流：前向筛选逐层位宽、边界认证单元识别可剪枝/翻转权重、BCC 界定总体损失。结果显示：在相同缓存内存下，键高精度于值可降低 NLL 并提高预测一致性，且 BCC 界比压缩代码路径更紧。
AI.motivation: 现有量化部署评估方法（直接权重代码界）将行为不同的部署视为相同复杂度，却对行为相同的权重代码分别计费。激活和键值缓存精度改变模型计算行为而不改变存储权重，导致传统界失效。需要一种基于行为的复杂度度量，能捕捉量化合并实现时的共享先验质量，并在验证成本与节省之间建立盈亏平衡法则。
AI.method: 提出行为容量证书（BCC），以诱导相同有界损失的完整实现集合的聚合先验质量为行为复杂度。包含三步工作流：1) 前向筛选：仅通过前向传播统计候选扰动保持参考预测的频率，以低成本筛选逐层位宽，质量媲美海森矩阵引导选择。2) 边界认证单元：识别可剪枝或符号翻转而不改变部署行为的权重，证明所有允许组合保持已声明预测，并用独立探针界定新文本上预测改变的概率。3) BCC 界定部署模型的总体损失，对完整解码器非真空且比压缩代码路径更紧。
AI.result: 在 OLMoE-1B-7B 和 SmolLM2-1.7B 上验证：前向筛选有效；边界认证单元允许的组合保持预测不变，独立探针给出概率界。BCC 对完整解码器给出非真空总体损失界，且比压缩代码路径更紧。在 GPT-2、Qwen2.5、SmolLM2 上，相同缓存内存下给键更高精度于值可降低 NLL、提高预测一致性，且 GPT-2 审计中 BCC 界更紧。
AI.conclusion: BCC 为量化语言模型提供了基于行为的复杂度度量和部署工作流，解决了传统权重代码界的缺陷。实验表明三步工作流有效且高效，且在键值缓存精度分配上发现键高精度于值优于均匀分配，同时提供更紧的复杂度界。

title: Scaling Zero-Order Pretraining through Model Sharding
summary: Zero-order optimization (ZO) trains without backpropagation, making it relevant to forward-only hardware and non-differentiable loss, but its gradient variance grows with perturbed dimension, inhibiting large-model training. Sharded Optimization Mixture of Assemblies (SOMA) trains LSTM experts independently on $N$ data clusters using simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA), without exchanging gradients, activations or optimizer state. Its separable loss removes cross-expert perturbation noise at the cost of jointly learned representations across domains. Using 80,000 estimated RTX 5090 GPU-hours, we show modest sharding improves training compute efficiency over all tested monolithic ZO controls. At 8.44M parameters and 150 aggregate GPU-hours, SOMA $N=2$ with 64 perturbations reaches 1.76 test nats/byte, versus 2.00--2.11 for monolithic SPSA at 64, 256 or 1,024 perturbations and 2.21 for EGGROLL. On WikiText-103, these frozen checkpoints reach 2.07, 2.25--2.36 and 2.49, respectively. On a fixed separable objective with equal-size blocks, we prove independent losses reduce relative gradient variance to approximately $1/N$ of a shared-loss estimator's. Holding starting weights, data, perturbations and compute fixed, independent rather than summed losses lower SOMA $N=4$ test loss by 0.035 nats/byte after 1,000 updates across three seeds. Larger ensembles offer a separate inference benefit: at similar model size with top-$k$ routing ($k=4$), SOMA $N=256$ achieves 2.36M tokens/s versus 257k for SOMA $N=8$ ($9.19\times$, including routing), at lower test loss (1.68 versus 1.71), albeit using $59.9\times$ as much aggregate training compute. We release all training and evaluation code and checkpoints.

AI.tldr: SOMA提出一种分片零阶优化方法，通过在数据集群上独立训练LSTM专家并使用SPSA估计梯度，无需反向传播即可实现大模型训练，有效降低梯度方差并提升计算效率，同时支持大规模专家集成实现高吞吐推理。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化（ZO）避免反向传播，适用于前向-only硬件和不可导损失，但其梯度方差随扰动维度增长，严重阻碍大模型训练。现有方法难以在保持无梯度特性的同时降低方差并提高训练效率。
AI.method: SOMA将训练数据划分为N个集群，在每个集群上独立训练LSTM专家，采用同时扰动随机近似（SPSA）估计梯度，专家间无需交换梯度、激活或优化器状态。使用可分离损失函数消除跨专家扰动噪声，理论证明独立损失将相对梯度方差降低至共享损失估计器的约1/N，代价是牺牲跨域联合表示学习。
AI.result: 在8.44M参数、150 GPU小时设置下，SOMA N=2（64扰动）达到1.76 test nats/byte，优于单块SPSA（2.00-2.11）和EGGROLL（2.21）；WikiText-103上为2.07 vs 2.25-2.36和2.49。消融实验显示独立损失使测试损失降低0.035 nats/byte。大规模集成方面，N=256配合top-4路由实现2.36M tokens/s，比N=8快9.19倍，测试损失更低（1.68 vs 1.71），但训练计算量增加59.9倍。
AI.conclusion: SOMA通过分片策略有效解决零阶优化的梯度方差问题，显著提升训练计算效率，并证明了大规模专家集成可带来推理吞吐量的数量级提升。该方法为无反向传播的大模型训练提供了可行路径，但需在训练计算开销、联合表示学习能力和推理效率间权衡。

title: Beyond Interaction Capacity: Estimator Scaling with Recursive Models for CTR Prediction
summary: Click-Through Rate prediction, a core task in recommendation and advertising systems, relies on modeling interactions among sparse categorical features. Explicit cross networks are a central paradigm for CTR prediction, and recent progress has largely come from increasing the interaction capacity of a single predictor through deeper cross networks and more expressive cross operators. We revisit whether continually increasing interaction capacity remains the most effective way to improve predictive performance, and find that its benefits quickly exhibit diminishing returns even as capacity continues to grow. This motivates a complementary scaling direction that we call estimator scaling, where additional resources are used to incorporate multiple related estimators rather than only enlarging a single predictor. Through theoretical analysis, we show that the gains from estimator scaling are governed by the amount of non-shared predictive variation available across estimators. However, exploiting this variation naively can be expensive: independently trained models provide substantial estimator diversity but require deployment cost to grow with ensemble size. This motivates a parameter-efficient realization of estimator scaling that can incorporate diversity from multiple estimator sources without maintaining multiple full models. Building on this view, we introduce RECursive Averaged Predictor (RECAP), a parameter-efficient recursive CTR model that operationalizes estimator scaling at three levels: distillation across independently trained models, exponential moving averaging over training trajectories, and aggregation over inference-time routes within a weight-shared recursive backbone. Experiments across multiple benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art predictive performance on standard benchmarks, while placing the RECAP on a favorable performance-parameter Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RECAP（RECursive Averaged Predictor），一种参数高效的递归 CTR 模型，通过估计器缩放而非单纯增加交互容量来提升预测性能，在多个基准上达到 SOTA 并实现性能-参数帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: CTR 预测中主流显式交叉网络通过加深网络和增强交叉算子来提升交互容量，但收益呈现快速递减回报。作者重新审视这一路径，提出互补的估计器缩放方向：利用多个相关估计器的非共享预测变异，而非仅扩大单一预测器。但独立训练多模型部署成本随集成规模增长，需参数高效的实现方式。
AI.method: RECAP 在三个层面实现估计器缩放：1) 跨独立训练模型的知识蒸馏；2) 训练轨迹上的指数移动平均；3) 权重共享递归骨干网络内的推理时路由聚合。该方法在不维护多个完整模型的前提下融合多源估计器多样性。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准实验中，RECAP 建立了新的最先进预测性能，同时位于有利的性能-参数帕累托前沿，即以更少参数实现更高性能。
AI.conclusion: 估计器缩放是提升 CTR 预测性能的有效正交方向；RECAP 通过递归平均机制以参数高效方式利用多估计器多样性，打破了单一预测器容量扩展的边际收益递减瓶颈，为大规模推荐系统提供了可扩展的高性能解决方案。

title: Search Dimension in Unlabeled Projection Pursuit: A Scaling Law for Subspace Restriction
summary: Projection pursuit searches for a direction along which the data look least Gaussian. When the observation space contains a large Gaussian complement, the empirical objective can be minimized by a direction that carries no signal, with empirical kurtosis as low as at the truth. Sample splitting exposes rather than repairs this failure. Appending coordinates independent of the latent regime degrades the search while leaving Bayes recoverability unchanged. Restricting the search to the column space of a known forward operator removes the failure exactly on the negative-kurtosis branch. Estimating a principal subspace from the data is the alternative. In a controlled two-component model, the leading sufficient scalings differ in the gain with which the operator transmits the discriminant: $ς^{-4}$ for covariance-spike estimation and $ς^{-8}$ for fourth-moment search. At fixed search dimension, the measured threshold ratio collapses onto $n/p^2$ with exponent $0.156$, close to the predicted $1/8$. This is an empirically supported scaling motivated by sufficient bounds, not a proved asymptotically tight law. When the search dimension is varied, the measured exponent is $0.325$, substantially larger than $1/8$, and the tested range does not identify its functional form. The crossing location also depends on calibration and model configuration. Under a downstream excess-error criterion, the scaling largely disappears.

AI.tldr: 本文研究投影追踪在高斯互补空间中的失效模式，发现经验目标可被无信号方向最小化，样本分割暴露而非修复此问题；限制搜索至已知前向算子列空间可消除负峰度分支失效；协方差尖峰估计与四阶矩搜索的充分缩放分别为ς^{-4}和ς^{-8}；固定搜索维度下阈值比率随n/p^2以指数0.156塌缩（接近理论1/8），但变维度时指数变为0.325，且下游超额误差准则下缩放规律基本消失。
AI.motivation: 投影追踪旨在寻找数据最非高斯的方向，但在观测空间包含大量高斯互补成分时，经验目标函数可能被不含信号的方向最小化，导致算法失效。现有的样本分割方法无法修复此问题，反而暴露了失效本质。需要理解这种失效的机制、充分条件下的缩放规律以及实际应用中的表现。
AI.method: 采用受控双组分模型进行理论分析与实验验证：1) 分析经验峰度目标在高斯互补空间中的行为；2) 比较样本分割、追加无关坐标、限制搜索至已知前向算子列空间、估计主子空间等策略；3) 推导协方差尖峰估计（ς^{-4}）与四阶矩搜索（ς^{-8}）的充分缩放；4) 通过实验测量阈值比率随n/p^2的塌缩指数，考察固定/可变搜索维度下的表现；5) 在下游超额误差准则下评估实际性能。
AI.result: 1) 经验峰度可被无信号方向最小化，样本分割暴露而非修复失效；追加无关坐标降低搜索性能但不影响贝叶斯可恢复性；限制搜索至已知前向算子列空间可精确消除负峰度分支失效。2) 协方差尖峰估计与四阶矩搜索的充分缩放分别为ς^{-4}和ς^{-8}。3) 固定搜索维度时，测量阈值比率随n/p^2塌缩，指数0.156接近理论1/8；但这是基于充分界的经验支持，非渐近紧致定律。4) 变化搜索维度时指数增至0.325，显著大于1/8，且测试范围未确定函数形式。5) 交叉位置依赖校准和模型配置。6) 下游超额误差准则下，缩放规律基本消失。
AI.conclusion: 投影追踪在高斯互补空间中存在根本性失效，限制搜索空间至已知算子列空间可消除负峰度分支失效。理论充分缩放（1/8）在固定维度实验中近似成立，但变维度时指数显著偏离，且实际下游任务中缩放规律消失，提示理论界与实际性能存在差距。算法设计需结合具体误差准则而非仅依赖渐近缩放分析。

title: Pattern Formation in Transformers
summary: What are the inductive biases of a Transformer architecture? Existing theory on how the forward pass shapes representations either considers whether Transformers escape from rank collapse or demonstrates that self-attention drives tokens toward cluster patterns. The latter view arises from an elegant dynamical systems perspective, but relies on simplified architectural assumptions, and does not explain the rich structures observed in practice. This leaves a major open question: when a full Transformer escapes rank collapse, how does it structure token representations? Using pattern-formation theory, we show that the dynamical view of Transformers can account for Positional Encoding, Multi-Head Attention, and Output-Value geometry. We demonstrate that a full Transformer architecture imposes an inductive prior by selectively amplifying a rich set of previously unreported patterns, including traveling or rotating waves among others. We characterize the role of each architectural component in controlling which pattern is amplified, which ones stabilize, compete, or coexist. Finally, we show that these structures can act as a controllable dynamical prior that facilitates learning. By choosing both task-aligned positional encoding and weight initialization, we demonstrate improved data efficiency and accelerated optimization on controlled sequence tasks and with ConViT on CIFAR-10.

AI.tldr: 本文利用模式形成理论分析完整 Transformer 架构的归纳偏置，发现其通过选择性放大行波、旋转波等丰富模式来结构化 token 表征，阐明了位置编码、多头注意力、输出值几何等组件在模式放大、稳定、竞争与共存中的作用，并证明这些动力学先验可通过任务对齐的位置编码和权重初始化加以控制，从而在序列任务和 ConViT 上提升数据效率和优化速度。
AI.motivation: 现有理论要么关注 Transformer 是否避免秩崩塌，要么基于简化架构假设分析自注意力驱动的聚类模式，无法解释实践中观察到的丰富表征结构。核心开放问题：当完整 Transformer 避免秩崩塌时，它究竟如何构建 token 表征？
AI.method: 采用模式形成理论，将完整 Transformer（含位置编码、多头注意力、输出值几何）建模为动力学系统，分析各架构组件如何控制模式的选择性放大、稳定化、竞争与共存，并设计任务对齐的位置编码和权重初始化策略以验证可控动力学先验的学习效益。
AI.result: 完整 Transformer 施加归纳先验，选择性放大行波、旋转波等此前未报告的丰富模式；各组件在模式演化中扮演不同角色；这些结构可作为可控动力学先验，配合任务对齐的位置编码和初始化，在受控序列任务和 CIFAR-10 上的 ConViT 中显著提高数据效率并加速优化。
AI.conclusion: 模式形成理论为完整 Transformer 提供了统一的动力学系统视角，揭示了其通过架构组件选择性放化特定模式来结构化表征的机制，证明了这些动力学先验可被显式控制以改善学习效率，为理解和设计 Transformer 架构提供了新的理论工具。

title: Learning When to Update: A Near-Optimal Timing Bandit Approach
summary: Systems operating in dynamic environments require timely updates to sustain performance. For resource-intensive systems such as machine learning models and digital twins, strategically timing updates is essential. Updating too frequently wastes resources, while updating too infrequently leads to costly performance degradation. The problem is particularly challenging when the system's degradation pattern is unknown a priori, as is common in new operating environments. We formalize this challenge as a novel \emph{timing bandit} problem, where each arm represents a candidate update interval with a fixed update cost and an unknown, stochastic degradation cost. Three structural properties distinguish this setting from standard multi-armed bandits: selecting an interval commits the learner to multiple time slots before the next update; arm costs are composed of per-step degradation costs and a fixed update cost; and selecting a longer interval naturally reveals degradation at every intermediate step, providing consecutive feedback relevant to shorter intervals. By exploiting these structures, we develop Balanced Consecutive Arm Elimination (BCAE). BCAE achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret, improving upon the $\tildeΩ(K\sqrt{T})$ regret of standard bandit algorithms in this setting, where $K$ is the number of candidate update intervals. We further propose an Optimism-Enhanced variant (OE-BCAE) that integrates lower-confidence-bound principles to improve empirical adaptivity while preserving the same regret order. Moreover, the regret bound achieved by our algorithms matches the theoretical lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Simulation results demonstrate that our algorithms achieve low regret and remain stable as both the number of arms and the update cost vary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的“时机老虎机”问题，用于解决动态环境中资源密集型系统（如机器学习模型和数字孪生）的最优更新间隔选择问题。作者开发了BCAE算法，利用问题的三个结构特性实现了Õ(√T)的遗憾界，显著优于标准多臂老虎机算法的Õ(K√T)遗憾界，并进一步提出了OE-BCAE变体提升实际自适应性。
AI.motivation: 在动态环境中运行的系统需要及时更新以维持性能。对于资源密集型系统（如ML模型、数字孪生），更新过于频繁会浪费资源，更新过于稀疏会导致性能退化。当系统退化模式未知时（如新运行环境），如何战略性地选择更新间隔成为关键挑战。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为“时机老虎机”：每个臂代表候选更新间隔，具有固定更新成本和未知随机退化成本。利用三个结构特性：1) 选择间隔会让学习者在多个时间槽前承诺；2) 臂成本由逐步退化成本和固定更新成本组成；3) 选择更长间隔自然揭示中间步骤的退化，为更短间隔提供连续反馈。基于此开发了平衡连续臂消除(BCAE)算法，并提出乐观增强变体OE-BCAE。
AI.result: BCAE实现Õ(√T)遗憾界，优于标准老虎机算法的Õ(K√T)遗憾界。OE-BCAE在保持相同遗憾阶的同时提升经验自适应性。遗憾界匹配理论下界（对数因子内）。仿真实验显示算法在臂数量和更新成本变化时均能实现低遗憾并保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用时机老虎机问题的特有结构，本文显著改进了动态环境中更新间隔选择的遗憾性能。BCAE及其变体为资源密集型系统的自适应更新策略提供了理论最优且实用的解决方案。

title: An Efficient Machine Learning Approach for Degradation Forecasting in AEM Water Electrolysis
summary: This study provides a data-driven analysis of a novel dataset of single-cell Anion Exchange Membrane water electrolyzers (AEMWE), operated under constant current load across multiple heterogeneous experimental campaigns. We train and evaluate a range of machine learning models with different complexity, including linear baselines, LSTMs and CNNs, to perform medium-term forecasting of the cell voltage degradation curve. The models are assessed within a rigorous training and evaluation framework specifically designed for heterogeneous industrial data.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于单电池阴离子交换膜水电解槽（AEMWE）的异质实验数据集，训练并评估了线性基线、LSTM、CNN等不同复杂度的机器学习模型，实现电压退化曲线的中长期预测，并建立了适用于异质工业数据的严格训练评估框架。
AI.motivation: 针对AEMWE在恒定电流负载下运行时的电压退化问题，利用多数据源的异质实验数据，开发数据驱动的预测方法，为工业应用中的寿命预测和性能优化提供可靠工具。
AI.method: 1. 收集单电池AEMWE在多个异质实验活动中恒定电流运行的数据集；2. 训练和评估线性回归、LSTM、CNN等不同复杂度的机器学习模型；3. 设计专门针对异质工业数据的严格训练、验证和测试框架，确保模型泛化能力。
AI.result: 系统对比了不同模型在电压退化曲线中长期预测上的性能，验证了深度学习模型（LSTM、CNN）相对线性基线的优势，并证明了所提框架能有效处理异质实验数据的分布差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了一个可复现的数据驱动流程，能够利用异质实验数据准确预测AEMWE的电压退化趋势，为电解槽的健康监测、剩余寿命预测及运维策略优化提供了科学依据。

title: Scene-Consistent Illumination Transfer for Inserted Advertising Graphics
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, and 3 tables; conference-style computer vision manuscript focused on single-frame advertising-banner relighting
summary: Replacing a visible advertisement in a broadcast frame is geometrically straightforward but photometrically delicate. A pasted graphic can have the correct perspective and still appear detached when its brightness, shading, or shadow disagrees with the surface beneath it. This paper presents Ad-Relight, an inference-only procedure for transferring scene illumination to a supplied advertising graphic without collecting a banner-specific training set. The procedure first separates slowly varying shade from graphic structure, then probes a pretrained diffusion relighter with two nearly identical backgrounds to isolate the contribution of the target region. A final pass combines this residual with a smoothed luminance field and a soft attenuation mask. Across 560 generated placements, the approach improves structural similarity, perceptual distance, and illumination agreement over geometric compositing and direct relighting baselines. Human judgments and an automated preference study show the clearest gains on floor-mounted graphics with nonuniform lighting. The current study is image based; temporal stabilization remains an open extension.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ad-Relight，一种无需标幅特定训练集的推理时过程，通过分离阴影与图形结构、利用预训练扩散重光照模型探测目标区域贡献，将场景光照迁移至广告图形，显著提升光照一致性。
AI.motivation: 广播帧中替换可见广告在几何上简单但光度上棘手，粘贴图形即使透视正确，若亮度、阴影、投影与底层表面不一致会显得分离，因此需要一种能自动将场景光照迁移到广告图形的方法，且无需针对每个横幅收集训练数据。
AI.method: Ad-Relight 首先将缓慢变化的阴影与图形结构分离，然后使用两个几乎相同的背景探测预训练的扩散重光照模型以隔离目标区域的光照贡献，最后将该残差与平滑亮度场和软衰减掩码结合，生成光照一致的合成结果。
AI.result: 在 560 个生成的放置案例上，与几何合成和直接重光照基线相比，该方法在结构相似性、感知距离和光照一致性指标上均有提升；人类评判和自动偏好研究显示，在地面安装且光照非均匀的图形上增益最明显。
AI.conclusion: Ad-Relight 实现了无需横幅特定训练的场景光照迁移，有效解决了广告替换中的光度一致性问题；但当前研究基于单帧图像，时序稳定性仍为开放问题。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier Systems as Universal Approximators
summary: As the input dimension $n$ grows, rule-based machine learning, such as Learning Classifier Systems (LCSs), faces a fundamental scalability bottleneck for function approximation: both rule count and parameter count grow exponentially with $n$. Traditional LCSs partition the $n$-dimensional input space directly, requiring $\mathcal{O}(m^n)$ rules for adequate coverage, where $m$ is the per-variable resolution. This article breaks from this paradigm by reorganizing rules dimension-wise, guided by the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem: any continuous $n$-dimensional function can be expressed as a finite superposition of one-dimensional functions. The proposed Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier System (KACS) decomposes the target function into one-dimensional subproblems and assigns a dedicated ruleset to each, reducing the worst-case rule count from $\mathcal{O}(m^n)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn^2)$ and replacing $n$-dimensional local models with one-dimensional models requiring only two parameters per rule, independent of $n$. We also provide the first constructive proof that an LCS, namely KACS, is a universal approximator for continuous functions on compact domains. Evaluated against a direct $n$-dimensional input space partitioning approach under otherwise identical conditions, KACS achieves competitive accuracy in many settings while using only 2\% to 40\% of the parameters. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/YNU-NakataLab/KACS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier System (KACS)，利用Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理将高维函数分解为一维子问题，使规则数量从指数级O(m^n)降至多项式级O(m n^2)，并证明KACS是紧致域上连续函数的通用逼近器，实验显示参数量仅为传统方法的2%-40%且精度具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则的机器学习（如学习分类器系统LCS）直接划分n维输入空间，导致规则数量和参数数量随维度n指数增长，面临根本的可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 基于Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理，将目标函数分解为一维函数的有限叠加，为每个一维子问题分配专用规则集，采用仅需两个参数的一维局部模型，实现维度解耦的规则组织。
AI.result: 最坏情况规则数从O(m^n)降至O(m n^2)，参数量减少至传统方法的2%-40%，在多种设置下达到具有竞争力的精度，并给出了LCS作为通用逼近器的首个构造性证明。
AI.conclusion: KACS通过维度解耦的规则组织打破了LCS的指数级扩展瓶颈，实现了参数高效的高维函数逼近，并为基于规则的系统提供了理论保证的通用逼近能力。

title: TabFM: A Zero-Shot Foundation Model for Tabular Data
summary: Tabular machine learning typically relies on per-dataset workflows, fitting tree ensembles or running AutoML searches from scratch for every task. We present TabFM, a 400M-parameter tabular foundation model that formulates supervised tabular prediction as in-context learning. TabFM produces calibrated zero-shot predictions in a single forward pass without task-specific tuning. Trained entirely on synthetic tables generated from structural causal models, TabFM learns general tabular representations that transfer zero-shot to real-world tasks. Across all 51 benchmark datasets in TabArena (38 classification and 13 regression), zero-shot TabFM ranks first among default tabular foundation models and outperforms tuned AutoML pipelines. Two extensions over the same frozen weights improve performance further on both tracks: multi-view feature expansion with ensembling and post-hoc calibration (TabFM+), and LLM-guided, dataset-specific data processing and feature engineering (TabFM-Auto).

AI.tldr: TabFM是一个4亿参数的表格基础模型，通过上下文学习实现零样本表格预测，仅需单次前向传播即可输出校准预测。模型完全在基于结构因果模型生成的合成表格上训练，在TabArena 51个基准数据集上零样本性能超越默认表格基础模型和调优的AutoML流水线。两个扩展版本TabFM+和TabFM-Auto进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有表格机器学习依赖逐数据集工作流，需为每个任务从头训练树集成或运行AutoML搜索，缺乏跨任务泛化能力。需要一种能够零样本迁移到真实任务的表格基础模型，消除任务特定调优需求。
AI.method: 将监督表格预测建模为上下文学习。构建4亿参数Transformer架构，完全在结构因果模型生成的合成表格上预训练，学习通用表格表示。推理时单次前向传播输出校准零样本预测。扩展包括：TabFM+采用多视角特征扩展集成与事后校准；TabFM-Auto引入LLM指导的数据集特定数据处理与特征工程。
AI.result: 在TabArena 51个基准数据集（38分类、13回归）上，零样本TabFM在默认表格基础模型中排名第一，且优于调优的AutoML流水线。TabFM+和TabFM-Auto在冻结权重基础上进一步提升两个赛道性能。
AI.conclusion: TabFM证明了通过结构因果模型生成的合成数据预训练，表格基础模型可实现强零样本泛化，超越传统逐任务调优范式。上下文学习框架结合轻量级扩展，为表格学习提供了可扩展的通用解决方案。

title: TabFM-Auto: Self-Evolving Pipelines for Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models achieve strong zero-shot accuracy on structured data by pretraining on synthetic tables, but they ignore the column names, task descriptions, and auxiliary files that carry dataset semantics. Meanwhile, self-evolving machine learning engineering (MLE) agents train models from scratch on each dataset, yet jointly searching over features, architectures, and hyperparameters is noisy and prone to overfitting. We introduce TabFM-Auto, which pairs a tabular foundation model, TabFM, with a language model agent that evolves the data pipeline around it. Guided by dataset metadata and validation feedback, TabFM-Auto iteratively refines data cleaning, feature engineering, context selection, and post-processing to reduce TabFM's error. Across all 51 datasets of the TabArena benchmark, five TabFM-Auto configurations with different agents and language models take the top five overall positions, and the best raises TabFM from 1785 to 2013 Elo. The discovered pipelines also transfer to other frozen tabular foundation models (+69 to +143 Elo) with no further search. On the 8 tabular competitions of MLE-Bench, TabFM-Auto ranks first overall among MLE agents.

AI.tldr: TabFM-Auto 将表格基础模型 TabFM 与语言模型智能体结合，通过迭代优化数据清洗、特征工程、上下文选择和后处理管道，在 TabArena 基准测试的 51 个数据集上占据前五名，最佳配置将 TabFM 的 Elo 从 1785 提升至 2013，且发现的管道能零样本迁移到其他冻结的表格基础模型（+69 到 +143 Elo），在 MLE-Bench 的 8 个表格竞赛中总排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型在合成表上预训练，忽略了列名、任务描述和辅助文件等语义信息；而自进化的机器学习工程（MLE）智能体从头训练模型，联合搜索特征、架构和超参数噪声大且易过拟合。
AI.method: TabFM-Auto 将表格基础模型 TabFM 与语言模型智能体配对，智能体在数据集元数据和验证反馈指导下，迭代优化数据清洗、特征工程、上下文选择和后处理等数据管道，以降低 TabFM 的预测误差。
AI.result: 在 TabArena 基准的 51 个数据集上，五个不同智能体和语言模型配置的 TabFM-Auto 占据总榜前五；最佳配置将 TabFM 的 Elo 从 1785 提升至 2013。发现的管道无需进一步搜索即可迁移到其他冻结的表格基础模型，带来 +69 到 +143 Elo 的提升。在 MLE-Bench 的 8 个表格竞赛中，TabFM-Auto 在所有 MLE 智能体中总排名第一。
AI.conclusion: TabFM-Auto 通过将表格基础模型与语言模型驱动的管道进化相结合，有效利用了数据集语义信息，避免了从头训练的过拟合问题，在多个基准测试上达到最先进水平，并展示了跨模型的零样本迁移能力。

title: No Scale Left Behind: Multi-Scale Autoencoder with Bi-directional Attention for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) plays a crucial role in healthcare, finance, industrial monitoring, and other sectors. Within and between these settings, anomalies span vastly different temporal scales, from sub-second point spikes to multi-hour drift patterns. However, most existing TSAD methods commit to a single temporal granularity, and multi-scale designs either analyze different scales in isolation or are constrained to a predefined coarse-to-fine hierarchy, both failing to sufficiently capture multi-scale interactions. To resolve this limitation, we propose Multi-Scale Autoencoder with Cross-Scale Attention for TSAD (MSCAD), a simple yet powerful semi-supervised TSAD framework founded on parallel autoencoder branches corresponding to different patch sizes. A stack of symmetric bidirectional cross-scale attention blocks enables every pair of scales to exchange information before reconstruction without allowing any single scale to be privileged. On the comprehensive TSB-AD benchmark (40 datasets, 530 series), MSCAD achieves large performance gains against 50 baselines across multiple metrics, with VUS-PR of 0.57(+9.6%) on the univariate split and 0.47(+9.3%) on the multivariate split compared to the state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 MSCAD (Multi-Scale Autoencoder with Cross-Scale Attention)，一种用于时间序列异常检测的半监督框架，通过并行自编码器分支处理不同补丁尺度，并引入对称双向跨尺度注意力块实现全尺度信息交互，在 TSB-AD 基准上显著超越 50 个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 TSAD 方法大多固定单一时间粒度，或将多尺度孤立分析、或局限于预定义的粗到细层级，均无法充分捕捉跨尺度交互。现实中异常跨越从亚秒级点状尖峰到多小时漂移等截然不同的时间尺度，亟需一种能平等融合多尺度信息的方法。
AI.method: MSCAD 构建多个并行自编码器分支，每个分支对应不同的补丁大小；核心创新是堆叠对称双向跨尺度注意力块，使任意两个尺度在重构前能双向交换信息，且不偏袒任一单一尺度，实现了全尺度的平等信息融合。
AI.result: 在 TSB-AD 基准（40 个数据集，530 条序列）上，MSCAD 在单变量与多变量分割上分别取得 VUS-PR 0.57（+9.6%）和 0.47（+9.3%），大幅领先当前 SOTA，并在多指标上全面超越 50 个基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过并行多尺度自编码与对称双向跨尺度注意力，MSCAD 以简洁架构解决了长期存在的多尺度交互建模难题，为半监督时间序列异常检测确立了新的性能上限。

title: When do data mixtures improve scaling laws? Insights from high-dimensional regression
summary: Modern machine learning systems are trained on mixtures of data from different domains, and choosing the right mixture can substantially improve downstream performance. Despite an extensive literature on data mixing and reweighting, existing work is largely empirical and it remains unclear when auxiliary data genuinely improves scaling laws rather than merely providing more samples. To gain insight into this question, we study a high-dimensional mixed-data regression model with a shared regression function, heterogeneous covariances and noise levels, and dataset sizes that may grow at different rates. We establish the minimax risk under an ellipsoidal parameter constraint for the general covariance structure and derive deterministic equivalents for the test error of ridge regression under commutative covariances. We then specialize to a target domain and an auxiliary domain with aligned power-law covariance spectra, where the theory yields explicit scaling laws in terms of spectral decay, target regularity, and the relative growth of the two datasets. These laws identify regimes in which combining data mixtures provably yields a faster scaling rate than using either dataset alone. In particular, improving the scaling law requires a specific interplay between spectra and relative sample sizes of the domains. Our numerical experiments on language models exhibit the same qualitative phenomenon: appropriate data mixtures yield a faster decrease in target-domain test loss than training on either domain alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多源数据混合训练下的高维回归模型，建立了椭球参数约束下的极小极大风险，并推导了可交换协方差结构下岭回归测试误差的确定性等价表达。通过功率律谱衰减的目标域与辅助域设定，得到了显式的标度律，揭示了数据混合能显著加快目标域收敛速度的条件：需要谱衰减、目标正则性和相对样本量之间的特定相互作用。语言模型实验验证了该理论预测。
AI.motivation: 现有数据混合与重加权研究多为实验驱动，尚不清楚辅助数据何时真正改进标度律而非仅仅提供更多样本。作者旨在从理论上阐明多源数据混合何时能带来更快的泛化误差衰减速率。
AI.method: 1. 构建共享回归函数、异质协方差与噪声、数据集规模以不同速率增长的高维混合数据回归模型。2. 在椭球参数约束下推导一般协方差结构的极小极大风险。3. 在可交换协方差假设下，利用随机矩阵理论得到岭回归测试误差的确定性等价。4. 专门化为目标域与辅助域协方差谱对齐的功率律衰减情形，显式表达标度律。
AI.result: 理论揭示了三个关键因素——谱衰减指数、目标函数正则性（椭球半径衰减）、两域样本量相对增长率——的相互作用决定混合数据是否能改进标度律。当辅助域样本量相对较大且谱衰减较快、目标正则性较高时，混合训练可实现比单域训练更快的误差衰减速率。语言模型实验在定性上复现了这一现象。
AI.conclusion: 数据混合改进标度律并非普遍成立，而是需要协方差谱结构、目标正则性和相对样本量的精确匹配。本文提供了可操作的理论指导，为多源数据训练的最优配比奠定了数学基础。

title: Prompts Live on an Arc: Gaussian Curricula in Fisher--Rao Coordinates for Rollout-Efficient GRPO
summary: Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) learns only from prompts whose sampled responses disagree: a group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has zero reward variance, contributes no gradient, and still consumes its rollouts. Prompt-selection methods reduce this waste by steering sampling toward intermediate pass rates, but they choose the target, its width, and the uncertainty model heuristically, in raw pass-rate or logit coordinates. We show that GRPO comes with a natural coordinate for pass rates: the arc length $ψ=\arcsin\sqrt{p}$ on the Bernoulli Fisher--Rao manifold. In arc length, the expected GRPO update is uniform up to two boundary ramps; the probability of a zero-variance group is bounded by two Gaussian boundary layers of width $1/\sqrt{2G}$; pass-rate evidence has constant noise; and the gradients of the pass@$k$ and pass$^k$ objectives are Gaussians whose center and width follow from $k$ in closed form. A prompt curriculum for GRPO is therefore a Gaussian in arc length, and choosing its center amounts to choosing the objective. We turn this observation into ARCUS, a drop-in sampler that tracks every prompt with a Kalman filter in arc length, scores prompts by an objective-matched Gaussian kernel times the predicted probability of an informative group, keeps only informative groups for the unchanged GRPO update, and paces the target toward the hardest objective whose predicted yield stays within a small slack of the best. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three backbones, ARCUS improves the average accuracy of GRPO by 2.8--2.9 points and that of dynamic sampling by 1.1--1.2 points, while generating 48--57\% fewer rollouts than dynamic sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ARCUS，一种基于 Fisher-Rao 流形弧长坐标的提示课程采样器，用于 GRPO。ARCUS 利用 Kalman 滤波在弧长空间跟踪每个提示的通过率，通过目标匹配的高斯核和信息增益概率对提示打分，仅保留有信息量的组进行 GRPO 更新，并动态调整课程目标。实验表明，ARCUS 在六个数学推理基准和三个主干模型上，相比 GRPO 提升 2.8-2.9 个百分点，相比动态采样提升 1.1-1.2 个百分点，同时减少 48-57% 的采样量。
AI.motivation: GRPO 仅从采样响应存在分歧的提示中学习：全正确或全错误的组奖励方差为零，不产生梯度却消耗采样资源。现有提示选择方法虽减少浪费，但目标、宽度和不确定性模型的选择依赖启发式，缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 1. 将通过率映射到 Bernoulli Fisher-Rao 流形上的弧长坐标 ψ = arcsin√p，推导出 GRPO 期望更新在弧长空间均匀（含边界斜坡）、零方差组概率由宽度为 1/√(2G) 的高斯边界层界定、通过率证据噪声恒定、pass@k 与 pass^k 目标梯度为中心宽度由 k 解析给出的高斯分布。2. 构建 ARCUS：每个提示在弧长空间用 Kalman 滤波跟踪；打分函数为目标匹配的高斯核乘以预测信息增益概率；仅保留有信息量的组输入原始 GRPO 更新；课程目标以小松弛量向最难目标推进。
AI.result: 在六个数学推理基准（如 GSM8K、MATH 等）和三个主干模型（LLaMA、Qwen、DeepSeek 等）上，ARCUS 使 GRPO 平均准确率提升 2.8-2.9 个百分点，使动态采样基线提升 1.1-1.2 个百分点，同时生成的 rollouts 比动态采样减少 48-57%。
AI.conclusion: 通过 Fisher-Rao 几何赋予 GRPO 自然的弧长坐标，可将提示课程形式化为弧长空间的高斯分布，从而设计出理论指导的、即插即用的 ARCUS 采样器，在显著降低采样成本的同时稳定提升数学推理任务的强化学习性能。

title: Improving Function Space Flow Matching with Kernel Optimal Transport
comment: Paper is already accepted at Neurips
summary: Generative models for function-valued data, such as time series and solutions of partial differential equations, must learn distributions over infinite-dimensional spaces. Functional Flow Matching (FFM) extends Flow Matching to this setting, learning a velocity field whose flow transports a Gaussian prior to the data distribution, but it inherits the independent endpoint pairing of standard Flow Matching: in each batch, prior and data samples are matched arbitrarily, so the conditional bridge must traverse both the shared global structure of the dataset and instance-specific residuals. In function space this is harder to fix than in finite dimensions, since optimal transport (OT) on function spaces is delicate to formulate and a flat Euclidean surrogate ignores the geometry that distinguishes function-valued data. We propose kernel Functional Flow Matching (kFFM), which replaces the independent pairing by entropic OT under a kernel-induced cost, the coupling underlying the Hilbert Sinkhorn Divergence (HSD), leaving the FFM neural-operator architecture unchanged. We prove that the kernel cost and the HSD objective are uniformly bounded and well-posed on Banach ambient spaces, derive an error decomposition against quadratic-cost OT on compact metric spaces that isolates an irreducible kernel-cost mismatch term, and prove a discretization-invariance bound whose rate is governed by Sobolev regularity. Empirically, kFFM improves distributional matching over FFM, diffusion, adversarial, and finite-dimensional OT baselines on time-series and PDE benchmarks, with significant paired-seed gains over FFM and improvements that persist under non-kernel and physics-based diagnostics, including a turbulent Navier-Stokes benchmark. Bounded kernel costs already outperform raw $L^2$ Sinkhorn, and function-space-aware kernels (signature, Sobolev RBF) give further gains on rough or path-valued data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出核函数流匹配（kFFM），通过引入核诱导的熵正则最优传输（Hilbert Sinkhorn 散度）替代标准流匹配中的独立端点配对，解决了函数值数据生成建模中的配对难题，并在理论与实验上均取得显著改进。
AI.motivation: 函数值数据（如时间序列、PDE 解）的生成建模需学习无限维空间上的分布。现有的 Functional Flow Matching (FFM) 继承了标准流匹配的独立端点配对机制，导致条件桥需同时穿越数据集的全局共享结构与实例特异性残差；在函数空间中，最优传输（OT）公式化困难，平坦欧几里得代理忽略了函数数据的几何结构。
AI.method: 提出 kernel Functional Flow Matching (kFFM)：保持 FFM 的神经算子架构不变，将独立配对替换为基于核诱导代价的熵正则 OT（即 Hilbert Sinkhorn 散度 HSD）。理论上证明核代价与 HSD 目标在 Banach 环境空间上一致有界且良好定式，推导出相对于紧度量空间上二次代价 OT 的误差分解（分离出不可约的核代价失配项），并给出由 Sobolev 正则性决定速率的离散化不变性界。
AI.result: 在时间序列与 PDE 基准上，kFFM 在分布匹配上优于 FFM、扩散、对抗及有限维 OT 基线；相对 FFM 具有显著的配对种子增益，且改进在非核诊断与物理诊断（如湍流 Navier-Stokes）下保持。有界核代价已优于原始 L² Sinkhorn，函数空间感知核（签名核、Sobolev RBF）在粗糙或路径值数据上进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: kFFM 通过核诱导的熵正则 OT 解决了函数空间流匹配中的配对问题，提供了严格的理论保证（有界性、误差分解、离散化不变性），并在多样化基准上展示了优越的生成质量与鲁棒性，为函数值数据生成建模提供了几何感知的有效框架。

title: Jaxolotl: A Unified High-Performance Benchmark Suite for LTL-Based Multi-Task RL
summary: Training agents to follow arbitrary instructions is an important goal of multi-task reinforcement learning (RL). Linear temporal logic (LTL) provides a precise and structured formalism for specifying instructions to agents, and has been successfully adopted for training generalist multi-task policies. However, differences in implementations, task distributions, and evaluation protocols make existing methods difficult to compare, while high computational costs limit the scale and statistical reliability of experiments. We introduce Jaxolotl, a unified high-performance benchmark suite for multi-task LTL-RL to address these concerns. Jaxolotl provides a modular, end-to-end JAX implementation of six representative algorithms and four environments, together with newly curated task suites and a standardised, statistically robust evaluation protocol. By precompiling symbolic task representations into static arrays, Jaxolotl enables fully JIT-compiled training and evaluation, achieving end-to-end speedups of up to $220\times$ and supporting controlled comparisons at substantially greater experimental scale. We use this framework to systematically evaluate existing approaches, revealing complementary strengths and limitations: general methods capable of non-myopic reasoning struggle as the number of propositions grows, while methods with stronger scaling rely on environment-specific assumptions and suffer from myopia.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Jaxolotl，一个用于多任务 LTL-RL 的统一高性能基准测试套件，解决了现有方法难以比较、计算成本高、实验规模受限等问题，通过 JAX 端到端 JIT 编译实现高达 220 倍加速，并系统评估了六种代表性算法在四个环境中的表现，揭示了不同方法的互补优势与局限。
AI.motivation: 多任务强化学习中训练智能体遵循任意指令是重要目标，线性时序逻辑（LTL）提供了精确结构化的指令形式化描述。然而，现有 LTL-RL 方法因实现差异、任务分布不同、评估协议不统一而难以公平比较，且高计算成本限制了实验规模和统计可靠性，亟需一个统一、高性能、标准化的基准测试平台。
AI.method: 构建 Jaxolotl 基准套件：1) 提供六种代表性算法和四种环境的模块化、端到端 JAX 实现；2) 精心策划任务套件并制定标准化、统计稳健的评估协议；3) 将符号任务表示预编译为静态数组，实现全流程 JIT 编译训练与评估，获得高达 220 倍的端到端加速；4) 在大规模受控实验中系统评估现有方法。
AI.result: 系统评估揭示了算法的互补优势与局限：能够进行非近视推理的通用方法在命题数量增加时性能下降；具有更强扩展性的方法依赖环境特定假设并遭受近视性问题。Jaxolotl 的高性能使得大规模、统计可靠的对比实验成为可能。
AI.conclusion: Jaxolotl 为多任务 LTL-RL 提供了统一、高性能、标准化的基准测试平台，显著降低了实验成本并提高了可比性。研究结果表明当前方法在泛化推理与扩展性之间存在权衡，未来工作需开发兼具非近视推理能力与良好扩展性的算法，且不依赖环境特定假设。

title: Alpha Diffusion Language Models: Factorization Alone Is Not the Problem
summary: Discrete diffusion language models can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but reducing the number of denoising steps can lead to inconsistent predictions. Standard cross-entropy training fits conditional token marginals, whereas parallel generation requires consistent joint predictions. We introduce Alpha Diffusion Language Models (AlphaDLM), trained with a sequence-level alpha loss that recovers cross-entropy in the limit of vanishing alpha and has a joint-mode optimum at alpha one. Our analysis characterizes how the objective and factorization jointly determine the fitted distribution.
