We identify conditions under which intermediate alpha preserves multiple valid completions while excluding invalid token combinations. Trained on TinyGSM, our method achieves 34.6% accuracy on GSM8K with only four model evaluations. We further scale the method to SDAR-1.7B and evaluate it on code and mathematics benchmarks. These results show that changing the training objective can improve the accuracy-computation trade-off of factorized diffusion language models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AlphaDLM，通过序列级 alpha 损失训练离散扩散语言模型，在仅 4 次模型评估下于 GSM8K 达到 34.6% 准确率，并扩展至 1.7B 参数模型，证明改变训练目标可显著提升因子化扩散模型的精度-计算权衡。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型虽支持并行生成多 token，但减少去噪步数会导致预测不一致。标准交叉熵训练仅拟合条件 token 边缘分布，而并行生成需要一致的联合预测。现有方法在少步推理时无法保证多 token 预测的联合一致性。
AI.method: 引入 AlphaDLM，采用序列级 alpha 损失函数：当 alpha 趋近 0 时退化为交叉熵；alpha=1 时达到联合模式最优。理论分析目标函数与因子化如何共同决定拟合分布，证明中间 alpha 值能同时保留多个有效补全并排除无效 token 组合。
AI.result: 在 TinyGSM 上训练，仅用 4 次模型评估在 GSM8K 达到 34.6% 准确率。进一步扩展至 SDAR-1.7B 模型，在代码和数学基准上验证有效性。实验表明该训练目标显著改善了因子化扩散语言模型的精度-计算权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计序列级 alpha 损失替代传统交叉熵，可使离散扩散模型在极少推理步数下实现联合一致的并行生成，为提升扩散语言模型的采样效率提供了新的理论框架和实用路径。

title: A foundation model for energy and radiation systems built on heterogeneous scientific interfaces
summary: Scientific foundation models are commonly evaluated after heterogeneous physical problems have already been translated into a compatible gridded, tokenized or symbolic representation. This leaves the scientific interface outside both the pretrained model and the audit of what is actually reused. We study the complementary setting in which boundary histories, sparse monitor records and loading histories retain their native inference classes and their outputs remain on Cartesian, latitude-longitude and unstructured domains. GEODE couples task-specific scientific interfaces to a shared routed library of wavelet operators. A single jointly pretrained model represents cavity flow, radiation dose and elastoplastic stress, then acquires a heat exchanger and a reactor subchannel by training a private interface containing 2.1% of its parameters. Earlier predictions remain unchanged by parameter isolation, whereas unrestricted fine-tuning degrades them by factors of 14-29. Crucially, preservation alone does not establish reuse: norm-matched randomized-library controls show that the contribution of pretrained computation is conditional on the task and data regime. A separate decomposition shows that full-field relative L2 error can substantially understate error relative to spatial variation when field level dominates the norm. Task-specific operators remain more accurate on three of the five problems. These results distinguish multi-task coverage, preservation and pretrained reuse as separate properties that must be tested independently when scientific foundation models span heterogeneous interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GEODE 框架，将任务特定的科学接口与共享的小波算子库相耦合，实现异构物理问题（空腔流动、辐射剂量、弹塑性应力、热交换器、反应堆次流道）的联合预训练与参数隔离微调。实验表明：仅冻结参数（2.1% 私有接口）即可保持旧任务性能不变，而无约束微调会导致性能下降 14-29 倍；但参数保留 ≠ 预训练复用，随机化库控制实验揭示预训练计算的贡献依赖于任务与数据制度。此外，全场相对 L2 误差在场均值主导时会严重低估空间变化相对误差，任务特定算子在 5 个问题中有 3 个仍优于共享库。结论：多任务覆盖、知识保持、预训练复用是三个独立属性，需分别评估。
AI.motivation: 现有科学基座模型评估通常在问题已被转换为统一的网格化、token 化或符号表示后进行，导致科学接口（边界条件、稀疏监测、载荷历史等）位于预训练模型与审计流程之外，无法考察原生推理类别与输出域（笛卡尔、经纬度、非结构化网格）下的真实复用能力。
AI.method: 构建 GEODE：将任务特定的科学接口（私有，仅 2.1% 参数）与共享的路由小波算子库（公共）解耦；采用联合预训练覆盖空腔流动、辐射剂量、弹塑性应力三任务；新任务（热交换器、反应堆次流道）仅训练私有接口，冻结共享库实现参数隔离；设置无约束微调、范数匹配的随机化库控制、任务特定算子基线等消融实验。
AI.result: 1. 参数隔离微调使旧任务预测完全保持（零退化），无约束微调导致误差放大 14-29 倍。 2. 随机化库控制显示：预训练共享库的贡献并非普遍有效，强烈依赖任务与数据制度——保留参数 ≠ 复用知识。 3. 全场相对 L2 误差在场均值占主导时严重低估空间变化相对误差，需引入以空间变化为基准的误差指标。 4. 任务特定算子在 5 个问题中的 3 个上仍优于共享库，表明共享库尚未完全替代专用设计。
AI.conclusion: 多任务覆盖能力、灾难性遗忘抑制（知识保持）、预训练计算的实际复用效益是三个正交维度。科学基座模型跨越异构接口时，必须分别设计实验独立验证这三个属性，不能仅凭参数冻结或整体误差下降声称成功复用。

title: Traversing the solution space of neural networks with Hessian Null Space Continuation
comment: 55 pages, 39 figures. Project page and code: https://ann-huang-0.github.io/Hessian-null-space-continuation/
summary: On a single task, deep networks can learn many solutions, depending on their optimizer, training data, architecture, and hyperparameters. Many of these solutions are mode-connected: rather than isolated points in weight space, they are connected by low-loss regions. Yet how their internal computation varies within these regions is unknown. A parallel line of work has identified the degeneracy of neural representations: many networks reach similar training loss with distinct internal structures. However, it is unclear how these solutions are related in weight space. We unify these subfields and show for the first time that many different internal mechanisms exist within a local mode-connected region in weight space. To do so, we introduce Hessian Null Space Continuation (HNC), a scalable method that uses local curvature to traverse regions of weight space that preserve network function, and can be steered toward solutions with specified properties. In RNNs trained on a memory task, HNC reaches drastically different representations and dynamics with maintained behavior. In ImageNet-trained Vision Transformers, HNC finds representations that differ more from the original network than any independently trained model with a different architecture or objective. In reinforcement-learning agents, HNC uncovers a distinct navigation strategy at comparable return and exposes reward hacking in an AI Safety Gridworld. Finally, HNC measures the local geometry of the solution set, showing how model size and task complexity shape its dimension and functional sensitivity. Our results show that a surprisingly large amount of representational diversity exists near a single trained solution, unseen by standard gradient-based optimization. HNC identifies and quantifies this diversity, opening new possibilities for mechanistic understanding of solution spaces and for model merging, editing, and fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hessian Null Space Continuation (HNC)方法，首次证明在单一训练解附近的局部模式连通区域内存在大量不同的内部计算机制，揭示了标准梯度优化未捕捉到的表示多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究发现：1) 深度网络在单一任务上可学到多个解，且这些解常通过低损失区域模式连通；2) 神经表示存在退化性，不同网络可达相似损失但内部结构不同。但这两条研究线尚未统一：模式连通区域内的内部计算如何变化不明，且不同解在权重空间中的关系不清。本文旨在统一这两个子领域，探索局部模式连通区域内的机制多样性。
AI.method: 提出Hessian Null Space Continuation (HNC)——一种可扩展方法，利用局部曲率（Hessian零空间）遍历保持网络功能不变的权重空间区域，并可导向具有特定性质的解。HNC在保持网络输入输出行为不变的前提下，沿零特征值方向移动权重，从而探索解集合的局部几何结构。
AI.result: 1) 在记忆任务的RNN中，HNC到达截然不同的表示和动力学但保持行为；2) 在ImageNet训练的Vision Transformers中，HNC找到的表示差异大于任何不同架构或目标独立训练的模型；3) 在强化学习智能体中，HNC发现同等回报下的不同导航策略，并揭露AI Safety Gridworld中的奖励黑客行为；4) HNC量化了解集合的局部几何，展示模型大小和任务复杂度如何塑造其维度和功能敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 单一训练解附近存在惊人大量的表示多样性，标准梯度优化无法发现。HNC能识别并量化这种多样性，为机制性理解解空间、模型合并、编辑和微调开辟新可能。

title: Mira: Memory-Efficient MoE Inference Using Adaptive Caching and Predictive Expert Staging
summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are a compelling architecture for scaling model capacity, making them especially attractive for deployment on resource-constrained, single-GPU systems. However, this benefit is difficult to realize because expert parameters dominate memory, and token-level routing is dynamic, unpredictable, and skewed. Prior work using offloading and caching remains fundamentally reactive, as systems wait for router outputs before moving experts, leading to inefficient cache utilization and an inability to overlap transfers with compute under tight VRAM budgets.
  To address these challenges, we propose Mira, an algorithm-system co-design that enables high-capacity MoE inference on a single GPU. Mira shifts from a reactive to a proactive stance by coupling predictive expert management with a tailored quantization format. It introduces lightweight per-layer predictors that anticipate expert usage two layers ahead, enabling proactive prefetching. These predictions feed a two-tier HOT+STAGE GPU cache managed by token-level routing telemetry to retain frequently used experts while staging predicted ones. To minimize transfer overhead, Mira implements a custom compression for expert parameters, which reduces metadata and improves packing efficiency, while minimally degrading accuracy.
  Mira is implemented as a fully integrated runtime that coordinates predictors, caching policies, and quantized transfers to maximize overlap between communication and compute. Our experiments show that Mira reduces expert-induced stalls. Compared against state-of-the-art baselines, Mira achieves a 5.71x speedup in average throughput on a memory-constrained GPU. It accelerates Time-to-First-Token by 11.71x and achieves a 3.84$x average speedup in beam search inference, demonstrating its effectiveness across diverse inference scenarios.

AI.tldr: Mira 是一个算法-系统协同设计框架，通过主动预测专家使用模式和定制量化压缩，在单 GPU 上实现高容量 MoE 推理，显著减少专家加载停顿并提升吞吐率。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型虽适合扩展模型容量，但在资源受限的单 GPU 部署时面临挑战：专家参数占用主导显存，Token 级路由动态且不可预测，现有基于卸载和缓存的方法本质上是被动响应式的，需等待路由器输出后再移动专家，导致缓存利用率低、无法在紧张显存预算下实现传输与计算重叠。
AI.method: Mira 提出三大核心创新：(1) 轻量级逐层预测器，提前两层预测专家使用情况，实现主动预取；(2) 双层 HOT+STAGE GPU 缓存，结合 Token 级路由遥测保留高频专家并暂存预测专家；(3) 定制专家参数压缩格式，减少元数据开销、提升打包效率，同时将精度损失降至最低。这些组件集成为一体化运行时，最大化通信与计算重叠。
AI.result: 实验显示 Mira 大幅降低专家导致的停顿。对比最先进基线，在显存受限 GPU 上实现平均吞吐率 5.71 倍加速，首 Token 延迟降低 11.71 倍，Beam Search 推理平均加速 3.84 倍，在多种推理场景均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: Mira 通过从被动响应转向主动预测的专家管理策略，结合定制化量化压缩和软硬件协同运行时，成功解决了单 GPU 部署大容量 MoE 模型的核心难题，为资源受限环境下的高效 MoE 推理提供了实用方案。

title: Dimensionally consistent surrogate modelling through dimensional analysis and harmonic expansions
comment: 45 pages, 15 figures. Published in Scientific Reports
summary: Dimensional homogeneity is a fundamental constraint on physically meaningful models, requiring invariance under changes of units. We present a data-driven method for constructing surrogate models that satisfy this constraint at the level of the hypothesis class. Starting from a dimension matrix of measured variables, the method derives Buckingham $Π$-groups, constructs admissible dimensional prefactors, and approximates the remaining dimensionless dependence using truncated harmonic expansions on normalized invariant domains. Once the prefactor and dictionary are fixed, the coefficients are obtained from a regularized linear regression problem. We test the approach on the simple pendulum, Planck's black-body law, the double-pendulum Lyapunov field, and an experimental COBE/FIRAS black-body spectrum dataset. The results show that dimensional constraints improve conditioning, robustness to noise, and sample efficiency relative to unconstrained baselines, while the choice of dictionary becomes important in non-periodic or multi-invariant settings. The learned expressions are explicit and inexpensive to evaluate, which makes them useful as surrogate models for structured physical problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动方法，构建满足量纲齐次性约束的代理模型，通过Buckingham Π群、量纲预因子及调和展开近似无量纲依赖，利用正则化线性回归求解系数，在多个物理问题上验证了其改善条件数、抗噪性和样本效率的优势。
AI.motivation: 量纲齐次性是物理模型的基本约束，要求模型在单位制变换下不变。现有数据驱动建模往往忽略此约束，导致模型缺乏物理一致性、鲁棒性差且样本效率低。
AI.method: 从变量量纲矩阵出发推导Buckingham Π群，构造满足量纲约束的预因子，利用截断调和展开在归一化不变域上近似无量纲关系，固定预因子与字典后通过正则化线性回归求取系数。
AI.result: 在单摆、普朗克黑体辐射定律、双摆Lyapunov场及COBE/FIRAS实验黑体光谱数据上测试，量纲约束显著提升条件数、抗噪能力和样本效率；字典选择在非周期或多不变量场景中至关重要。学习得到的表达式显式且计算廉价，适合作为结构化物理问题的代理模型。
AI.conclusion: 将量纲齐次性硬编码进假设空间能显著增强数据驱动模型的物理一致性与泛化能力，该方法为构建高效、可解释的物理代理模型提供了系统性框架。

title: Probe-Space Preconditioning for Fast and Stable Zero-Order Training
summary: Backpropagation (BP) dominates deep learning but imposes a massive memory tax. For example, training OPT-30B with Adam requires $\approx$ 600GB of GPU memory (assuming batch size 8 and sequence length 2048). Alternatively, zero-order optimization (ZOO) trains in inference-mode (requiring only $\approx$ 60GB for the same model): no stored activations, no gradients, and no optimizer states. However, ZOO convergence has lagged behind BP. In this work, we evaluate two methods to close this gap. First, we show that reallocating training compute budget from many steps to large effective batch sizes with many perturbations (or probes) but fewer steps, allows 1SPSA (Spall, 1992) to outperform zero order methods like MeZO (Malladi et al., 2023) with less training compute. Next, we introduce 1.5-SPSA, adding a single "clean" forward-pass per step to 1SPSA to calculate a cheap diagonal preconditioner in probe-space, which improves convergence rate and convergence by down-weighting high curvature directions. Benchmarking on 6 post-training datasets on both Qwen3 and OPT model families, we show that 1.5-SPSA achieves State-of-the-Art results over previous ZOO solvers with much less optimization steps. For example, we train OPT-13B (for direct comparison to MeZO) and find 1.5-SPSA achieves +3.1% accuracy on SST-2 over both MeZO and BP in only 70 steps vs. MeZO's 100,000 steps. Finally, we combine an 8-bit-packing random generator, triton fused unpack/apply kernels, and distributed parallelism to achieve fast and stable training of models as large as OPT-30B in-place on commodity GPUs (e.g. A100).

AI.tldr: 本文提出1.5-SPSA零阶优化方法，通过单次前向传播计算对角预条件子，在仅需推理模式内存（~60GB）的情况下，以极少步数（70步 vs MeZO的100,000步）超越反向传播和现有ZOO方法，实现OPT-30B等大模型在普通GPU上的原地训练。
AI.motivation: 反向传播（BP）虽主导深度学习但内存开销巨大（如OPT-30B需约600GB显存），而零阶优化（ZOO）仅需推理模式内存（约60GB），但收敛性落后于BP。研究旨在弥合ZOO与BP的性能差距，使大模型训练在普通硬件上成为可能。
AI.method: 1. 1SPSA：重新分配训练计算预算，从多步转向大有效批次大小配合多扰动但少步数。2. 1.5-SPSA：在1SPSA基础上每步增加一次'干净'前向传播，计算探针空间的廉价对角预条件子，通过降权高曲率方向改善收敛。3. 工程优化：8位打包随机生成器、Triton融合解包/应用内核、分布式并行。
AI.result: 在Qwen3和OPT模型族的6个后训练数据集上，1.5-SPSA以远少优化步数达到SOTA。OPT-13B上SST-2任务比MeZO和BP高+3.1%准确率，仅用70步（MeZO需100,000步）。成功在A100等普通GPU上原地训练OPT-30B。
AI.conclusion: 1.5-SPSA通过极少的前向传播开销引入预条件机制，成功缩小ZOO与BP的性能鸿沟，以推理级内存实现大模型高效训练，为资源受限环境下的大规模模型微调提供了实用路径。

title: Tail-Influence Sampling for CVaR Policy Evaluation
summary: Policies with similar mean returns can differ sharply in rare failures, yet estimating lower-tail conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) accurately can require many costly rollouts. When different conditional components of a stochastic workflow can be queried separately, we ask how to allocate a fixed evaluation budget to estimate a fixed policy's CVaR most accurately. We derive a tail influence for each queryable conditional law that aggregates how its uncertainty affects CVaR across every Bellman reuse. Its variance yields the fixed-design efficiency bound and the oracle Neyman allocation. Tail-Influence Sampling (TIS) estimates these influence scales from a pilot model and reallocates fresh queries toward kernels that matter most for the tail; a visitation-anchored variant protects against pilot underallocation. Under fixed dimension and a positive quantile margin, TIS attains oracle asymptotic variance and first-order MSE including pilot cost, while the anchored variant is within a factor two of the oracle. We also characterize an exact-grid regime in which tail- and mean-optimal allocations coincide. On CliffWalking, TIS reduces MSE by 41% versus learned occupancy and 76% versus complete rollouts at the same charged transition budget. In frozen language-model review workflows, anchored TIS beats an equally regularized mean-influence blend in 23 of 24 MMLU-Pro settings and reaches 2.4-3.4$\times$ lower MSE than rollouts on six-call FinQA reviews.

AI.tldr: 本文提出尾部影响采样（TIS），通过估计各可查询条件分布对CVaR的影响来最优分配评估预算，实现了Oracle渐近方差和MSE，并在CliffWalking及语言模型评审任务上显著降低MSE。
AI.motivation: 策略在罕见失败上的差异大，但准确估计CVaR需要大量昂贵的rollout；当随机工作流的条件分量可单独查询时，如何分配固定预算以最准确估计固定策略的CVaR？
AI.method: 推导每个可查询条件律的尾部影响度量，聚合其不确定性对所有Bellman复用的CVaR影响；基于先导模型估计影响尺度，将新查询重新分配给对尾部最重要的核；提出访问锚定变体防止先导欠分配。
AI.result: 固定维度和正分位数边界下，TIS达到Oracle渐近方差和一阶MSE（含先导成本），锚定变体在Oracle的两倍因子内；精确网格制度下尾部和均值最优分配一致。CliffWalking上TIS比学习占用率降低41% MSE，比完整rollout降低76%；冻结语言模型评审工作流中，锚定TIS在24个MMLU-Pro设置中23个胜过均值影响混合，在六调用FinQA评审上比rollout低2.4-3.4倍MSE。
AI.conclusion: TIS通过尾部影响驱动的预算分配高效估计CVaR，理论最优且实证有效，适用于可分解查询的随机工作流，显著优于基线方法。

title: Explore Broadly, Reason Sharply: Push Small Models toward the Frontier via Sampling
summary: Power-sharpened sampling is an inference-time alternative to reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training for enhancing reasoning in large language models (LLMs). High-probability sequences are amplified under the base model without parameter updates or external rewards, avoiding the costly optimization and jagged generalization of RL. However, this approach faces a fundamental exploration--exploitation trade-off, as % strong sharpening restricts exploration, trapping samplers in plausible but incorrect reasoning trajectories, whereas weak sharpening leaves the answer distribution diffuse. To resolve this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{Parallel Power Tempering (PPT)}, instantiating power-sharpened LLM sampling via parallel tempering. Running multiple \emph{interacting} replicas in parallel at different sharpening levels allows lower-power replicas to explore diverse reasoning trajectories and higher-power chains to further exploit higher-likelihood responses favored by the sharpened target. Specifically, we tailor \method{} to inference-time sampling by mitigating a truncation bias, identified in prior power samplers, and investigate effective swap strategies under finite memory and compute budgets. Extensive experimentation shows that \method{} substantially improves single-chain power-sharpened sampling and outperforms RL-post-trained models, producing higher-quality reasoning traces and even achieving performance comparable to frontier models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并行功率退火（PPT），一种基于并行退火的推理时功率锐化采样方法，通过多个不同锐化程度的交互副本平衡探索与利用，无需参数更新即可显著提升大语言模型推理能力，超越RL后训练模型并接近前沿模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有功率锐化采样虽避免RL的高昂优化成本和锯齿泛化问题，但面临探索-利用权衡：强锐化限制探索导致陷入错误推理轨迹，弱锐化导致答案分布分散。需一种方法在推理时无参数更新前提下解决此权衡。
AI.method: 提出并行功率退火（PPT），在并行退火框架下实例化功率锐化LLM采样。运行多个不同锐化水平的交互副本：低功率副本探索多样推理轨迹，高功率链利用锐化目标偏好的高似然响应。针对推理时采样定制PPT，缓解先前功率采样器中的截断偏差，并在有限内存和计算预算下研究有效的交换策略。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PPT显著优于单链功率锐化采样，并超越RL后训练模型，生成更高质量的推理轨迹，甚至达到与前沿模型相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: PPT作为一种推理时的无参数更新方法，通过并行退火机制有效平衡探索与利用，为提升LLM推理能力提供了比RL后训练更高效、泛化更好的替代方案，且性能可媲美最先进模型。

title: WUSH-KV: KV Cache Quantization with Data-Adaptive Transforms
summary: KV cache memory and bandwidth costs grow with context length and batch size, which limits efficient long-context inference. To address this bottleneck, we introduce WUSH-KV for low-bit KV-cache quantization. It adapts WUSH, which constructs a data-aware transform from the second-order statistics of both factors in a matrix product to reduce quantization error. WUSH-KV uses calibration data to construct separate key and value transforms, with the value transform folded into the model weights and the key transform applied after RoPE. The transforms can be paired with clipped quantizers. For one such quantizer, QuEST INT, we show that, under mild assumptions, the WUSH transform is near-optimal. With this quantizer, WUSH-KV reduces layerwise reconstruction error and achieves the lowest end-to-end perplexity among other tested transforms. For end-to-end evaluation, we integrate WUSH-KV into SGLang using OSCAR-style percentile-clipped affine quantization. At 2-bit, WUSH-KV performs comparably to or outperforms the OSCAR transform across all evaluated models and downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WUSH-KV，一种用于低比特KV缓存量化的方法，通过构建数据感知变换（基于矩阵乘积双因子的二阶统计量）来降低量化误差。该方法在2比特下达到或超越OSCAR变换的性能，显著降低长上下文推理的内存和带宽开销。
AI.motivation: KV缓存的内存和带宽开销随上下文长度和批大小增长，限制了高效长上下文推理。现有量化方法在低比特下性能下降明显，需要一种能同时针对Key和Value、且适配RoPE和模型权重的量化方案。
AI.method: WUSH-KV基于WUSH变换，利用校准数据分别构建Key和Value的变换矩阵：Value变换融入模型权重，Key变换在RoPE之后应用。变换可与裁剪量化器（如QuEST INT）配合，理论上证明WUSH变换在QuEST INT下近似最优。集成到SGLang中，采用OSCAR风格的百分位裁剪仿射量化。
AI.result: WUSH-KV降低逐层重构误差，在测试的变换中实现最低端到端困惑度。在2比特量化下，WUSH-KV在所有评估模型和下游任务上表现与OSCAR变换相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: WUSH-KV通过数据感知的二阶统计变换有效解决了低比特KV缓存量化误差问题，为长上下文推理提供了高效的内存和带宽优化方案，且易于集成到现有推理框架中。

title: Achieving an $O(1/N)$ Optimality Gap in Average-Reward Weakly-Coupled MDPs
summary: We study average-reward weakly-coupled Markov decision processes (WCMDPs), where a WCMDP consists of $N$ smaller MDPs, called arms, that share multiple per-step budget constraints. We consider the setting where the arms have identical model parameters, multiple actions, and state- and action-dependent costs. For restless bandits (RBs), a well-studied special case of WCMDPs, prior work has developed policies that achieve an $O(1/\sqrt{N})$ optimality gap under general conditions, and has further identified conditions under which policies can achieve a better-than-$1/\sqrt{N}$ optimality gap. However, for general WCMDPs, no prior result achieves an optimality gap better than $1/\sqrt{N}$. In this paper, we identify conditions analogous to those for RBs under which a better-than-$1/\sqrt{N}$ optimality gap is achievable, and design a policy that attains an $O(1/N)$ optimality gap. Notably, unlike prior approaches based on generalizing priority orderings, our policy is not priority-based but rather is designed to induce locally linear mean-field dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平均奖励弱耦合马尔可夫决策过程（WCMDP），在多预算约束下提出一种非优先级的策略，通过诱导局部线性均场动力学，实现了O(1/N)的最优性缺口，优于现有的O(1/√N)界限。
AI.motivation: 现有研究在 restless bandits (RBs) 中已实现优于 1/√N 的最优性缺口，但对于一般 WCMDP（多动作、状态/动作相关成本、多预算约束），此前无算法能突破 1/√N 界限。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立类似 RB 的条件并设计相应策略。
AI.method: 设计了一种非基于优先级的策略，核心思想是诱导局部线性均场动力学。通过分析均场极限系统的线性化性质，构建能够精确跟踪最优流体轨迹的控制策略，从而实现更快的收敛速度。
AI.result: 在识别的条件下（类似 RB 的索引性或可解性条件），所提策略达到 O(1/N) 的平均奖励最优性缺口，显著优于现有的 O(1/√N) 结果。这是一般 WCMDP 首次实现此阶数的性能保证。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了通过均场动力学线性化设计，而非传统优先级推广，可以在通用 WCMDP 中实现 O(1/N) 最优性缺口。这为大规模弱耦合系统的最优控制提供了新的理论基础和算法范式。

title: Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance
summary: Generative modeling is widely used for producing diverse objects from complex, multimodal distributions. However, its expressivity does not, in general, come with formal guarantees that the generated objects satisfy hard constraints or requirements. In multi-agent generation, this problem becomes more challenging because a hard requirement can depend on multiple agents, while each agent may need to determine its own guidance input without relying on the simultaneously computed guidance inputs of other agents. To this end, we introduce DeGG-Flow, a general framework for multi-agent flow matching with decoupled generative guidance. By representing the generative process as a control-affine dynamical system, we develop guidance conditions for two classes of coupled requirements: shared requirements whose satisfaction depends on multiple agents together, and private requirements associated with each individual agent dependent on its neighbors. For both classes, we establish feasibility conditions and finite-horizon convergence guarantees. We further derive a Wasserstein bound that characterizes the distributional deviation induced by the guidance. We demonstrate DeGG-Flow on multi-robot collaboration for crossing a spatial gap by reconfiguring the environment, and on multi-object scene generation with affordance requirements. Across both applications, DeGG-Flow directly generates objects that satisfy all corresponding hard requirements, including at team sizes unseen during training.

AI.tldr: DeGG-Flow 是一种用于多智能体流匹配的通用框架，通过解耦生成引导实现硬约束满足，提供可行性条件、有限时域收敛保证和 Wasserstein 分布偏差界，并在多机器人协作和多物体场景生成中验证了其泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 生成建模虽能产生多样化对象，但缺乏对硬约束的形式化保证；多智能体场景下，约束耦合且各智能体需独立决策引导输入，现有方法难以同时满足共享需求和私有需求。
AI.method: 将生成过程建模为控制仿射动力系统，针对共享需求（依赖多智能体）和私有需求（依赖邻居）分别推导解耦引导条件，建立可行性条件与有限时域收敛保证，并导出 Wasserstein 界量化引导导致的分布偏移。
AI.result: 在多机器人跨越空间间隙重构环境任务和多物体场景生成（含 affordance 要求）中，DeGG-Flow 能直接生成满足所有硬约束的对象，且在训练未见的团队规模上仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: DeGG-Flow 为多智能体生成提供了理论保证的解耦引导框架，成功解决耦合硬约束下的生成问题，并展现出强泛化性，为安全关键的多智能体系统提供了可靠生成范式。

title: A Spectral Theory of Distortion in LLM Graph Reconstruction: Sharp Bounds and Empirical Characterization
summary: Evaluations of graph reconstruction by language models typically report a single aggregate distance between the original and the reconstructed graph. We prove that for the Wasserstein distance between Laplacian spectra such a summary is bracketed by two edge counts, the net change in edge number from below and the symmetric difference from above, each scaled by $2/n$ where $n$ is the number of vertices. The bracket is sharp: its two ends coincide exactly when the reconstruction only adds edges or only deletes them, and on that class the distance is a rescaled edge count that says nothing about which edges changed. When the ends differ, the residual between the distance and the lower end is positive only if the reconstruction both invented and lost edges, which turns it into a certificate of mixed editing computable from the reported summaries alone. We characterize these regimes in 135 reconstructions produced by three open-weight models over 45 synthetic graphs. Seventy-seven outputs are one-sided and 29 mixed outputs have $X > 0$, including cases where edge count is exactly preserved while nineteen edges were simultaneously invented and lost. The three models differ in editing policy, ranging from copying the input to attempting completion at the cost of large hallucination volume, a distinction that aggregate distortion does not reveal.

AI.tldr: 论文证明了图重构中Wasserstein距离（拉普拉斯谱）被两个边计数界定，揭示了单一聚合指标无法捕捉的编辑模式差异。
AI.motivation: 现有图重构评估仅报告单一聚合距离，无法区分仅添加边、仅删除边还是混合编辑（同时增删），导致模型行为差异被掩盖。
AI.method: 理论证明Wasserstein距离由净边数变化（下界）和对称差（上界）缩放2/n界定；实证分析三个开源模型在45个合成图上产生的135次重构，计算边界和残差以分类编辑模式。
AI.result: 发现77次单侧编辑，29次混合编辑残差>0（含边数不变但19条边同时增删的情况）；三模型编辑策略迥异：从复制输入到激进补全伴随大量幻觉，聚合失真无法揭示此差异。
AI.conclusion: 单一聚合指标不足以评估图重构质量；提出的边界框架能从报告摘要中证书混合编辑，揭示模型编辑策略本质差异。

title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization
summary: Recent LLMs increasingly adopt hybrid designs that replace standard attention with linear attention, such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). Although they compress the context into a fixed-size recurrent state and substantially reduce the cost of long-context processing, repeatedly reading and updating that state remains a major inference bottleneck. Quantization offers a natural way to reduce this cost, but can significantly degrade model quality, due to the accumulation of rounding errors and the presence of outlier rows and columns in the state. To address these challenges, we propose LeapQuant, a training-free method that achieves near-lossless performance under 8-bit recurrent-state quantization. First, to mitigate error accumulation, we propose per-window quantization, which leaps over a window of tokens and quantizes the state only once at its end. Within a window, outputs are computed from the fixed low-bit state together with high-precision buffered updates. Second, to reduce the error introduced by each quantization, LeapQuant retains the state's largest outliers as a few high-precision Compensator Tokens, which share the update path of real tokens. We then smooth the remaining residual before quantization to further reduce the error. Comprehensive experiments across the Qwen, Kimi, and GLM model families show that LeapQuant substantially reduces memory and compute costs during inference. With accuracy comparable to the FP32 baseline, it achieves average speedups of 2.05--3.70$\times$ at the kernel level and 1.47$\times$ for end-to-end inference on NVIDIA B200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090 GPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LeapQuant，一种无需训练的8位递归状态量化方法，针对线性注意力模型（如GDN、KDA）通过逐窗口量化和补偿器令牌技术，实现近无损性能，显著降低推理内存与计算开销。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力模型将上下文压缩为固定大小的递归状态，虽降低长上下文处理成本，但反复读写该状态成为推理瓶颈。量化虽可降低开销，但舍入误差累积和状态中的异常值行列会严重损害模型质量。
AI.method: LeapQuant包含两大核心创新：1) 逐窗口量化：跨越一个Token窗口仅在窗口末尾量化一次状态，窗口内用定点低比特状态加高精度缓冲更新计算输出，缓解误差累积。2) 补偿器令牌：保留状态中最大的异常值作为少量高精度补偿器令牌，共享真实Token的更新路径，并对剩余残差进行平滑再量化，进一步降低量化误差。
AI.result: 在Qwen、Kimi、GLM三大模型家族上的综合实验表明，LeapQuant在精度接近FP32基线的前提下，显著降低推理显存与算力消耗，内核层面平均加速2.05-3.70倍，端到端推理在B200、RTX PRO 6000、RTX 5090上平均加速1.47倍。
AI.conclusion: LeapQuant有效解决了线性注意力模型递归状态量化中的误差累积与异常值难题，以免训练、低比特量化实现高效推理，为长上下文大模型部署提供了实用方案。

title: Breakdown of Local Denoising as Semantic Speciation
comment: 9 pages main, 13 pages appendix, 4 figures. Comments very welcome
summary: The dynamics of generative models exhibit two apparently distinct temporal windows: a speciation window, in which a sample commits to a semantic class, and a nonlocality window, in which local context windows become insufficient for generation. Motivated by evidence of their near-concurrence in a variety of frontier models, we investigate their relationship through the spatial distribution of semantic information. Under a "common cause" hypothesis, we prove that the nonlocality window must lie in the speciation window. This hypothesis postulates that semantic labels explain a fraction of the correlations between distant tokens, a condition that is natural for many real datasets. We further give conditions under which both windows shrink to a single limiting time as system size grows, defining a "phase transition", and verify this behavior analytically in Gaussian mixtures. Together, these results identify conditions under which semantic information explains the concurrence of speciation and nonlocality, connecting two complementary perspectives on the emergence of semantic structure in generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 论文研究生成模型中“物种形成窗口”与“非局域性窗口”的关系，证明在“共同原因”假设下非局域性窗口必须位于物种形成窗口内，并给出两者随系统规模增长收敛为单一相变时间的条件，在高斯混合模型中验证了这一行为。
AI.motivation: 生成模型动力学中存在两个明显的时间窗口：样本承诺语义类别的物种形成窗口，以及局部上下文不足以生成的非局域性窗口。前沿模型中两者近乎重合的现象促使作者探究其内在联系，从语义信息的空间分布切入，建立二者关系的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出“共同原因”假设：语义标签解释了远距离 token 间部分相关性。在此假设下，通过理论证明非局域性窗口必包含于物种形成窗口；进一步给出系统规模趋于无穷时两窗口收缩为单一极限时间（相变点）的充分条件，并在高斯混合模型中进行解析验证。
AI.result: 1. 在共同原因假设下，非局域性窗口严格位于物种形成窗口内部。2. 当系统规模增长时，若满足特定条件（如语义信息强度随规模适当缩放），两个窗口同时收敛到同一临界时间，形成明确的相变。3. 高斯混合模型的解析计算完全吻合理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 语义信息的空间分布为物种形成与非局域性的近乎同时发生提供了统一解释：语义标签作为共同原因，同时驱动了类别承诺与长程相关性的建立。这连接了生成建模中涌现语义结构的两种互补视角，为理解大模型训练动力学提供了理论基础。

title: PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units
comment: Accepted at ECML-PKDD 2026. 18 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. This work was funded by the European Commission as part of the MANOLO project under the Horizon Europe programme Grant Agreement No.101135782
summary: Enabling efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference on edge devices with different hardware constraints is a challenging task that typically requires DNN architectures to be specialized for each device separately. To avoid the huge manual effort, one can use neural architecture search (NAS). However, many existing NAS methods are resource-intensive and time-consuming because they require the training of many different DNNs from scratch. Furthermore, they do not take the resource constraints of the target system into account. To address these shortcomings, we propose PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs). We propose a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform. First, we present a novel search space that not only cuts out smaller DNNs from a single large architecture, but instead combines the structural optimization of multiple architecture types, as well as optimization of their pruning and quantization configurations. Second, we explore the use of an ensemble of zero-shot proxies during optimization instead of a single one. Third, we propose the use of Hypervolume subset selection to distill DNN architectures from the Pareto front of the multi-objective optimization that represent the most meaningful tradeoffs between accuracy and FLOPs. We evaluate the effectiveness of PrototypeNAS on 12 different datasets in three different tasks: image classification, time series classification, and object detection. Our results demonstrate that PrototypeNAS is able to identify DNN models within minutes that are small enough to be deployed on off-the-shelf MCUs and still achieve accuracies comparable to the performance of large DNN models.

AI.tldr: PrototypeNAS是一种零样本神经架构搜索方法，旨在为微控制器单元(MCU)自动选择、压缩和专业化深度神经网络。它通过解耦架构设计与训练，结合多架构类型的结构优化、剪枝量化配置、零样本代理集成及超体积子集选择，在几分钟内找到可部署于商用MCU且精度媲美大模型的轻量化模型。
AI.motivation: 现有NAS方法通常需要从头训练大量DNN，计算资源消耗大、耗时长，且未充分考虑目标边缘设备的硬件资源约束，导致人工设计针对不同MCU的专用架构负担极重。
AI.method: 提出三步搜索方法：1) 新颖搜索空间，融合多架构类型的结构优化及剪枝/量化配置联合优化；2) 使用零样本代理集合而非单一代理进行优化；3) 引入超体积子集选择从多目标优化的帕累托前沿提取精度与FLOPs最佳权衡的架构。
AI.result: 在12个数据集的图像分类、时间序列分类和目标检测三大任务上验证，PrototypeNAS能在几分钟内搜索出满足MCU部署尺寸限制且精度接近大型DNN的模型。
AI.conclusion: PrototypeNAS通过零样本NAS实现了高效自动化的DNN针对性部署，显著降低了边缘设备适配的工程成本，为资源受限平台上的深度学习应用提供了实用解决方案。
